steps: 1. Make the gravy:
2. In a small saucepan, add the beef stock, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, oyster sauce, and white pepper powder over medium heat. Whisk together and bring to a simmer.

3. Combine the cornstarch and water in a small bowl and whisk to dissolve. Add to the saucepan and whisk until the gravy thickens and coats the back of the spoon, 2 to 3 minutes. Cover the saucepan with a lid and keep it warm on the lowest possible heat.
4. Make the egg foo young batter:
5. In a medium bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and water until dissolved. Add the eggs, salt, and sugar. Whisk until well combined and there are no more egg white clumps.
6. Add the green onion, bean sprouts, and shrimp. Stir until everything is evenly coated.
7. Fry the egg foo young:
8. Add the vegetable oil to a large wok; it should reach about 2 inches up the sides. Heat the oil over medium-high heat to 350°F, or until vigorous bubbles form around an inserted wooden chopstick.

9. With a ladle, gently and slowly add 1/4 of the omelet batter. Egg foo young should immediately bubble and puff up like magic. Fry until golden brown and crispy on each side, about 2 minutes per side. If there are any light spots, use a ladle to gently baste it with hot oil.
10. Tip

11. Egg foo young can be a bit tricky to flip. The easiest method is to put a tool in each hand (a spider, slotted spoon, tongs, and large chopsticks are all good candidates) and gently coax the omelet over, pulling up on one side and pushing down and around on the other.

12. Remove the omelet and place it on a paper towel-lined baking sheet. Let it cool for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, repeat with the remaining batter to make 4 omelets. If needed, add more oil to the pan between batches.
13. Serve and enjoy:
14. Plate each egg foo young over a bed of rice. Spoon the warm gravy over the top and serve immediately.
title: Egg Foo Young

title: Chinese Bbq Chicken Skewers

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients and add dates and nuts.
2. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan and bake for 40 minutes at 350°. Score into 1-inch squares while warm.
title: Sugar-Free Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2 lemons, zested, 1 juiced, and the other cut into wedges

steps: 1. Prick the chicken pieces all over with a fork and set aside. In a large bowl, whisk the balsamic vinegar with half of the lemon zest, salt, and 2 tsp. of the ground pepper. Add the chicken and turn to coat. Refrigerate for 20 minutes or overnight. Mix the sugar with the remaining lemon zest in a small bowl and set aside.

2. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Heat the oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until very hot, about 2 minutes. Melt 2 Tbsp. of the butter, and place chicken skin-side-down in the pan along with the remaining marinade. Cook until the chicken is browned on one side, 3 to 4 minutes, and then flip each piece over and cook 1 minute more. Sprinkle some of the lemon sugar and remaining 1/2 tsp. of ground pepper over the chicken and transfer skillet to oven. Roast until chicken is completely cooked through and a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F, about 25 minutes.

3. Remove chicken from oven. Cut remaining 2 Tbsp. of butter into small pieces and scatter around chicken. Pour lemon juice over everything. Once butter is melted, serve with pan sauce drizzled over the chicken and lemon wedges on the side.
title: Balsamic Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Put all in crock pot and cook on low all day long (8-10 hours) or high (5-6 hours).
2. You can also cook this in the oven on 350° for about and hour or maybe a little more--just check for doneness.
3. The lemon sauce is good on mashed potatoes and rice!
title: Anitas Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. In a shallow dish stir together the cornmeal, lemon-pepper seasoning, and dried parsley. In another shallow dish, combine the lemon juice with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil.
2. Dip each chicken thigh into the lemon juice mixture; coat thighs evenly with the cornmeal mixture.

3. In a very large nonstick skillet heat 1 tablespoon remaining olive oil over medium heat. Add chicken thighs to the skillet. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender, evenly browned, and no longer pink; turning once. (Add more oil during cooking, if necessary).
title: Crispy Lemon Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Stir together orange juice, soy sauce and ginger root. Add chicken. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain chicken. Reserve sauce. Saute chicken in olive oil. Stir together reserved sauce and cornstarch. Stir into pan and heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in orange sections and cashews.
title: Orange Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Steam the broccoli and snow peas for about 5 minutes, till crisp tender.
2. Heat large skillet and oils, then add onions and peppers.
3. Stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes, or until vegetables start to soften.
4. Add mushrooms, garlic, and gingeroot and stir-fry an additional two minutes.
5. Add remaining vegetables, chicken, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and stir-fry for another minute.
6. Mix cornstarch into broth, then add to the wok.
7. Cook until sauce starts to thicken.
8. This recipe makes one 3 block serving.
title: Zone Chicken & Vegetable Stir Fry

steps: 1. Mix first 4 ingredients together like a pie crust.
2. Press into an 8 x 8-inch greased baking dish.
3. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
4. Mix remaining ingredients well and pour over crust.
5. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
6. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when cool.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Sift sugar, flour, baking powder and salt into bowl.
2. Stir
3. in raisins and nuts.
4. Add eggs; mix thoroughly. Spread into 15 1/2 x 10 x 1-inch pan sprayed gently with Pam spray.
5. Spread into pan to cover entire pan.
6. Bake in moderate oven at 375° about 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.
7. Sprinkle gently with powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2/3 cup walnuts, chopped (you could substitute pecans)

steps: 1. Toast walnuts under the broiler for 2 to 3 minutes or until lightly toasted, transfer to a small bowl.
2. In another small bowl blend and mix together the cheese, cover and place in refrigerator to firm up slightly for approximately 15 minutes.

3. Put one heaping teaspoon of the mixture in the palm of your hand with a grape in the center and roll between both palms until the grape is completely coated, then roll in the toasted walnuts. Place on a plate single layer without touching each other and chill for 30 minutes or until coating is firm, and serve.
title: Amuse Bouche Walnut And Blue Cheese Grape In Chinese Spoon

steps: 1. Combine first 9 ingredients in a bowl, stirring well with a whisk.
2. Sprinkle breadcrumbs on both sides of chicken.

3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium- high heat; add vegetable oil. Add chicken, and cook 3 minutes. Turn chicken. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and cook 12 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken from pan; keep warm.
4. Add broth mixture to pan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, and simmer 2 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring constantly. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken. Sprinkle with cilantro.
title: Hoisin Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil.
2. Add garlic; add ginger; add shrimp; cook 1 minute.
3. Add corn starch to water.
4. Add with ketchup and soy sauce; cook until thickened and shrimp are pink, stirring constantly.
5. Serve over rice.
6. Top with scallions.
title: Shrimp Mandarin Style (Kair-Jop-Har-Kow)

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

2. Heat oil in a large wok or saute pan. Stir fry mushrooms, carrots, peppers, onion and garlic until tender. Stir in bean sprouts and green onions; cook one minute. Mix cornstarch and chicken broth in a small bowl and add to stir fry. Stir in hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, ginger, cayenne pepper and curry powder. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
3. Add cooked spaghetti, and toss. Serve immediately.
title: Vegetable Lo Mein

steps: 1. Place chicken in baking dish.
2. Mix parsley, thyme, salt, pepper, garlic and lemon juice.
3. Pour half over the chicken.
4. Bake 20 minutes.
5. Turn chicken over and pour remaining liquid over chicken.
6. Bake another 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup orange juice, I use Simply Orange

steps: 1. Marinate the chicken breasts with the Italian dressing overnight.
2. Heat about 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan and toast the almonds until they are golden brown; set aside.
3. Heat another 2 tablespoons of oil in pan and sautee the chicken breasts until done; remove the chicken and set aside.
4. In a bowl, mix together the chicken broth, orange juice, brown sugar, soy sauce and cornstarch.
5. In the same pan used for sauteeing the chicken, put in the orange sauce mixture and cook until its a thick glaze consistency. Stir in the almonds.
6. Add the chicken back to the orange sauce mixture to coat.
7. Enjoy!
title: Orange Chicken Almondine

steps: 1. Mix ranch, mustard and brown sugar. Reserve 1/2 c of sauce.

2. With the reserved 1/2 c sauce, heat in a saucepan over Medium heat, stirring slowly, but constantly until it starts to get bubbly. Remove from heat. (This wasn't on the French's site but I always do it to get the brown sugar to blend into the recipe a little better. Use your own judgment.)
3. Coat chicken with remaining, uncooked sauce in a 3 qt baking dish.
4. Bake chicken at 350 for 30 minutes or until juices are no longer pink. Serve with cooked sauce.
5. STIR FRY INSTRUCTIONS:
6. Mix the sauce ingredients the same but do not heat them.
7. Dice 4 chicken breasts and cook in olive oil over medium heat until no longer pink.
8. Add the sauce and heat until bubbly.
9. Serve over already cooked veggies and rice. (You may hold the sauce in pan over lowest heat setting on your stove while making the veggies and rice, just make sure you stir it occasionally.).
title: French'S Tangy Ranch Chicken (Baked Or Stir-Fry)

ingredients.text: 1 cup finely chopped chicken, skin removed before cooking

steps: 1. Cut a 1/2" thick slice from the side of each pepper, reserving slices; remove seeds.
2. Place peppers in boiling water, boil 5 minutes, drain, set aside.
3. Coat a large skillet or wok with Pam; add sesame oil, and place over med heat until hot.
4. Add garlic and gingerroot; stir fry 30 seconds.
5. Add carrots and green onions; stir fry 2 minutes more.
6. Remove from heat.
7. Add chicken and remaining ingredients, stirring well.
8. Spoon 3/4 cup mixture into each reserved pepper.
9. Top with reserved pepper slices.
10. Arrange peppers, cut side up, in a 10 x 6 x 2" baking dish.
11. Cover and bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
title: Chinese Chicken-Stuffed Bell Peppers

steps: 1. Drain the tofu: Place several paper towels on a cutting board; place the tofu on the cutting board, and then place a heavy object such as a plate or book on top.
2. Drain the tofu for at least 15 minutes, changing the paper towels as required (If possible, it's helpful to tilt the cutting board so that the water drains directly into the sink).
3. Cut the tofu into cubes.
4. Mix together the tofu with the salt, garlic powder, and black pepper, and allow to marinate for 1-2 hours in the refrigerator.
5. Toss the tofu cubes with cornstarch to coat.
6. Heat oil in wok or large skillet.
7. Carefully add the tofu to the wok, add fry in small batches until tofu is golden; drain on paper toweling, and serve hot.
8. Serve with Asian condiments, if desired.
title: Chinese Salt And Pepper Tofu

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken breast, cut in small pieces
1 c. fresh broccoli, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Brown 2 cloves of chopped garlic in hot oil in wok.
2. Remove garlic.
3. Add chicken to hot oil and cook until browned.
4. Remove from oil.
5. Add vegetables to oil and stir-fry until tender.
6. Return chicken to wok.
7. Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 1/2 cup chicken broth.
8. Stir until heated.
title: Chicken Primavera Stir-Fry

steps: 1. In skillet, brown meat; add onions,garlic and celery.
2. Cook until vegetables have softened.
3. Add mushrooms and green pepper.
4. Let simmer another 5 minutes.
5. Add beef broth, soya sauce and macaroni.
6. Cover and cook until macaroni is tender.
title: Ground Beef Chinese Style

steps: 1. Beat eggs well.
2. Add shrimp and vegetables; mix thoroughly. Heat oil in skillet.
3. Place about 1/4 cup egg mixture in oil; brown lightly on each side.
4. Serve with sweet-sour sauce and soy sauce and sprinkle with green onions.
title: Egg Foo Yong

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Place breast into a roasting pan. Place the orange into the middle of the roasting pan among the breasts.
3. Mix together the orange juice, salt, pepper and ginger. Pour over the chicken.
4. Roast for 30 minutes.
5. Remove from oven and turn over.
6. Smear chicken breasts with honey.
7. Baste with pan juices.
8. Cook for 20 minutes more or until done.
title: Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon chili sauce (can add extra tsp of chili paste for extra spice)
1 lb beef, sliced into bite-size pieces (chicken may be substituted)

steps: 1. Heat vegetable oil in a pan.
2. Add the finely minced garlic and saute' until slightly golden.
3. Combine the chili sauce, soy sauce and sugar in a bowl.
4. Mix well before adding into the pan.
5. Add the beef (or chicken) into the simmering sauce mixture in the pan.
6. Continue to simmer until the liquid is reduced.
7. Add the shredded onion with a dash of sesame oil.
8. Stir fry until everything is tender and fully cooked.
9. Serve with rice and enjoy.
title: Mongolian Beef

ingredients.text: 1 c. chopped ham, chicken, etc., cooked
1 to 2 tsp. olive or vegetable oil

steps: 1. Add oil and vegetables to hot skillet or wok; saute until vegetables are almost tender (3 to 5 minutes).
2. Add rice, meat and soy sauce and mix well.
3. Lower heat and stir in beaten eggs.
4. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, remove from heat and let set for 2 to 3 minutes (or until eggs are done).
5. Additional soy sauce can be added to taste.
title: Quick And Easy Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine barbecue sauce, orange juice, brown sugar, oil, flour and salt; mix well.
2. Cook, stirring, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly.
3. Add chicken, pineapple, water chestnuts and ginger; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
4. Serve with rice.
title: Mandarin Chicken

steps: 1. Sift together sugar, flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Beat eggs, dates, nuts, vanilla and flour mixture.
3. Place batter in a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. While hot, cut in small squares, then roll into balls.
5. Dust with powdered sugar.
6. Makes 4 dozen delicious cookies.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Mix sauce all together and pour over spareribs.
2. Roast ribs for 2 or 3 hours at 350°.
3. Baste them while baking.
title: Chinese Spareribs

steps: 1. PUT ALL INGREDIENTS IN A BAG
2. TO COOK- Place in crock pot, remove the lemon rinds and cook on low for 8-10 hours.
3. TO SERVE- Pair with rice, quinoa or potatoes.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cut up chicken. Sprinkle chicken pieces with curry powder. Rub into meat. Arrange in baking dish, skin side down.
2. Combine orange, juice, honey and mustard in small saucepan.
3. Simmer until blended.
4. Pour over chicken.
5. Bake in a 375° oven for 30 minutes. Turn chicken and continue baking 20 minutes longer or until tender.
6. Remove chicken to serving platter.
7. Keep warm.
title: Curried Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Remove fat from meat.
3. Combine soy sauce, wine, sugar, honey, food coloring, cinnamon, garlic and onion.
4. In large bowl, add pork, turning to coat completely. Cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.
5. Drain pork; reserve marinade. Place pork on wire rack over baking pan.
6. Bake in preheated oven until done, about 45 minutes.
7. Turn and baste frequently during baking.
8. To serve, cut into diagonal slices (like London broil).
title: Barbecued Pork Chinese Style

steps: 1. Combine broccoli, cauliflower, edamame, carrots, and water in a microwave-safe bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute until vegetables are tender. Set aside.
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; add onion. Cook and stir until onion is softened and beginning to brown, about 10 minutes.
3. Stir cooked broccoli, cauliflower, edamame, carrots, zucchini, mushrooms, and garlic into the pan; cook and stir until vegetables are cooked through, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in reduced-sodium teriyaki sauce and agave nectar; cook 5 more minutes.
title: Zucchini And Soy Bean Stir Fry

steps: 1. Marinate chicken in rest of ingredients for 30 minutes to several hours.
2. Broil 5 minutes per side.
title: Rosemary Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Mix
2. all together and spread in greased pan.
3. Bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes.
4. Cut while warm and roll in powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews From Alaska(By Jimmie Mae King)

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded cooked chicken, pork, shrimp, lobster or crab

steps: 1. Slice mushrooms thin; saute in butter or margarine for 3 minutes.
2. Add onion, meat or fish, sprouts and seasonings.
3. Add this to the well beaten eggs; blend well.
4. Drop from large spoon into frying pan with about 1/4 inch of hot fat.
5. Brown one side; turn and brown other side.
6. Serve hot with Chinese Sauce.
title: Egg Foo Yong

steps: 1. Cream the sugar and margarine.
2. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts last.
3. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Heat 1 teaspoons Cooking oil in deep skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Cook ground beef, breaking it up but leave it a bit chunky, until browned. Drain.
2. Add 1 Tbls. Cooking oil to pan and cook vegetables until softened, about five minutes.
3. Add tomatoes, broth, and meat into pan. Bring to a simmer and cover.
4. Cook 20 minutes. Add pasta, cover and cook 20 minutes more.
5. If desired, mix in cheese and serve.
title: Creamy American Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (1 lb. total)

steps: 1. In a plastic bag, shake together flour, salt, and pepper.
2. Add the chicken and shake to coat.
3. Remove chicken and reserve excess flour.
4. In a large skillet, warm 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat.
5. Brown chicken on one side for 5 minutes.
6. Add remaining oil; turn the chicken and brown well on the other side.
7. Transfer chicken to plate and set aside.
title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme(Makes 4 Servings)

ingredients.text: 3 lb. chicken, skinned and cut up

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in large bowl to make marinade. Add chicken.
2. Cover and chill at least 8 hours.
3. Remove chicken from marinade.
4. Reserve marinade.
5. Place flour in plastic bag. Add chicken and shake to coat.
6. Heat oil in large skillet.
7. Add chicken and brown on all sides.
8. Drain on paper towel.
9. Place in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
10. Pour marinade over; cover with foil and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
title: Greek Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Saute first 3
2. ingredients
3. until
4. done
5. on medium-high (approximately 10 minutes).
6. Add
7. cream
8. cheese
9. to
10. center of pan, reduce heat and cook
11. 5 minutes.
12. Stir and blend in cream cheese.
13. Set aside.
14. In
15. same skillet put 2 tablespoons margarine, broccoli, onion,
16. mushrooms
17. and soy sauce.
18. Stir-fry on high approximately 5 minutes just until color of onion/broccoli changes.
19. Add in chicken
20. and simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
21. Stir in cashews if desired.
title: Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
1 small head cauliflower, trimmed and broken into small florets

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Carefully slide the sage leaves under the skin of the chicken. Season the cavity and the skin of the chicken.

2. Place the lemon quarters and onion halves inside the cavity. Tie the ends of the legs together with kitchen string. Place the chicken on a wire rack in a roasting pan and rub the chicken with 1 tbsp of the olive oil. Roast for 1 hour 15 mins.
3. Meanwhile, combine the sweet potatoes, cauliflower, lemon slices and remaining olive oil in a bowl. Season to taste.

4. 25 minutes before the end of cooking time, remove the roasting pan from the oven. Remove the wire rack and chicken and set aside. Transfer the vegetable mix to the roasting pan, then replace the wire rack with the chicken on top. Return to the oven to roast for the remaining cooking time.
title: Sage And Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup sliced onion, separated into rings

steps: 1. In a

2. or wok, stir-fry the carrots, parsnips and onion in hot oil for 2 minutes. Add potatoes, sweet potatoes and ginger. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the broth, orange juice concentrate, salt and red pepper flakes. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Uncover; cook and stir until sauce is thickened, about 2 minutes.
title: Winter Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Chop the orange into pieces.
2. Combine all ingredients in a Zip-Loc bag.
3. Massage the bag for a few minutes.
4. Let marinate in the refrigerator for at least an hour.
5. Grill breasts for 4-8 minutes, or until juices run clear.
title: Grilled Orange Chicken On The George Foreman Grill

steps: 1. Mix beaten eggs, corn starch and salt in med size bow and set aside.
2. Zest the orange into a small bowl or large measuring cup.
3. Cut the orange in half and juice 3 tablespoons into the zest.
4. Add the soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar, ginger and crushed peppers to the zest and juice, mix and set aside.
5. Heat 1/2" oil in a wok or frying pan until hot.
6. Dip the cubed chicken into the cornstarch/egg mixture letting the excess drip off.
7. Fry cubes in a single layer in hot oil, turning as necessary until cubes are golden; drain on paper towels. Repeat until all of the chicken is fried.
8. Drain the oil from the pan.
9. Place all of the cooked chicken back in the pan on a med/high heat.
10. Stir the orange sauce and pour over the chicken; gently stir the chicken into the sauce until sauce thickens and covers the chicken pieces.
11. Serve with hot rice and a steamed vegetable or veggie stir-fry.
title: Karen'S Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Mix flour, pepper and salt in plastic bag.
2. Coat chicken with mixture; reserve remaining flour.
3. In skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat.
4. Brown chicken 5 minutes.
5. Add remaining oil.
6. Turn chicken brown 5 minutes.
7. Remove and set aside.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Mix together soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, sesame oil, mustard, ginger, garlic and pepper to make marinade in small bowl. Place chicken in medium bowl and pour marinade over it. Cover; place in refrigerator and marinate at least 1 hour. Turn occasionally to coat all sides.

2. Place chicken (Legs Down), on a center stem of the stoneware bundt pan. Pour 1/4 cup beer in pan filling with more as it evaporates if needed. Place in 350 degree oven roast until chicken is dark-brown about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Till 165° to 170°F cook until juices run clear. Rest for 15-20 minutes. Serve hot, or refrigerate and serve cold.
title: Crispy Chinese Roast Chicken In A Bundt Pan!

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Mix together the chicken, lemon rind, lemon juice, olive oil and oregano.
2. Marinate in the fridge for at least 1/2 an hour.
3. Skewer the chicken onto 6 metal or wooden skewers.
4. Grill for about 20 minutes turning frequently, adding the remaining marinade each time you turn them.
5. Sprinkle with the paprika and serve.
title: Lemon Chicken Souvlaki

steps: 1. Lightly freeze steak so it will slice easily.
2. Cut steak into thin strips. Heat oil in a large skillet (electric is fine) and add garlic, salt, ginger and pepper.
3. Saute until garlic is golden.
4. Add steak and brown lightly.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Wash and Dice chicken, pepper, green onion, onion.
2. Cut the white part of green onion to small pieces and cut about 1 inch the green part.
3. Dice Onion.
4. Marinade Chicken with 2 Tbs of Oyster sauce for 30 minutes.
5. Fry Chicken with 2 Tbs of oil until The Chicken has no pink anymore.
6. Take it out and leave it and drain all the liquid.
7. Mix the sauce, mix ketchup, the rest of oyster sauce and vinegar in a bowl.
8. Fry garlic with 2 Tbs of oil until golden do not burn. Add onion fry for about 1 to 2 mins, add cashew.
9. Add chicken and pepper.
10. Add sauce.
11. Then add green onion.
12. Serve with rice.
title: Cashew Chicken (Kai Phat Met Mamuang Himaphan)

steps: 1. Mix first four ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish or pan.
2. Bake 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven. Mix remainder of the ingredients in bowl and spread on top of the partially baked crust.
3. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
4. Let cool; cut in pan.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Spread in thin sheet.
2. Bake 30 minutes.
3. Cut in squares while hot.
4. Form into balls by rolling each square in palm of hand. Roll in granulated sugar.
5. Makes 24 chews.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak, cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat oil and brown meat.
2. Add salt.
3. Add onion, garlic, green peppers and hot peppers.
4. Pour in beef stock.
5. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours or until tender.
6. Blend water, soy sauce and cornstarch. Stir into broth.
7. Cook until liquid is translucent.
8. Serve on rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 1 c. beef, sliced thin (I cut up a sirloin steak)

steps: 1. May substitute or add other vegetables (carrots, celery or zucchini, etc.).
title: Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 4 (4 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Mix lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; pour into a sealable plastic bag. Add the chicken to the bag, coat with the marinade, and squeeze air from the bag before sealing. Refrigerate 8 hours to overnight.
2. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
3. Remove chicken from the marinade and shake off excess. Discard the remaining marinade.

4. Cook chicken on hot grill until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
title: Lemon Chicken Oregano

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken, cut up and skin removed

steps: 1. Spray a cool grill with all-natural Pam to ensure chicken doesn't stick to grill.
2. Combine sugar, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, paprika, salt and pepper to make sauce; set aside.
title: Spicy Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. In a large container, combine all the marinade ingredients and mix well.
2. Cut the pork into long 1 1/2" round pieces.
3. Marinate pork in refrigerator overnight.
4. Preheat oven to 360°F
5. Using a baking tray, place aluminum foil on the tray and place pork pieces on top of the aluminum.
6. Cook for pork 45 minutes.
7. Turn pieces over and bake for another 30 minutes.
8. Remove pork from oven and cut into 1/8 slices. Serve with sesame seed and mustard.
title: Chinese Bbq Pork

ingredients.text: 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk 1 tbs water wit hcornstarch until smooth. Whisk in honey, soy sauce, and broth.
2. Warm oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper; cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly.

3. Add chicken and stir-fry until opaque, 5-6 minutes. Add snow peas, bell pepper and cashews, and continue stir-frying for 1-2 minutes. Stir reserved sauce and pour it in to skillet. Cook for 1-2 minutes longer, stirring constantly, until sauce is bubbling and has thickened. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve over rice if desired.
title: Honey Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, sliced thin

steps: 1. Pour oil in wok and preheat on high for 3 minutes.
2. Place meat in hot oil.
3. Stir-fry.
4. Turn meat occasionally.
5. Add celery.
6. Cook 2 minutes.
7. Add onion.
8. Cook 2 minutes.
9. (When pan gets dry, add vegetable broth as needed.)
10. Add mushrooms and green peppers.
11. Cook 2 minutes.
12. Add remaining vegetable broth and soy sauce.
13. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with 1/4 c. water

steps: 1. Cook meat (1/8-inch slices cut across grain) with oil in skillet.
2. Add garlic, salt, ginger and pepper.
3. Saute until garlic is golden.

4. Remove all from skillet. Add green peppers and onions to skillet. Cook for 3 minutes. Return meat to skillet. Add soy sauce, bouillon and cornstarch mixture. Add beef bouillon cube dissolved in 1/2 cup boiling water. May replace canned beef bouillon.
5. Simmer 2 minutes or until thickened. Serve over hot white rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Mix until crumbly and spread in greased 8 x 16-inch pan.
2. Bake at 300° for 10 minutes.
title: James Beard'S Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 lb. fryer, cut up and skinned

steps: 1. Spray a baking dish with Pam and line chicken in dish in a single layer.
2. Combine oil, lemon juice, garlic powder and brush on chicken.
3. Cover and bake in 350° preheated oven for 35 minutes. Remove cover and brush again with lemon oil mixture.
4. Bake another 20 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika.
6. This recipe can be used on chicken breasts too.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. boneless pork, cut into strips
1 small green pepper, cut into strips

steps: 1. Brown pork in oil to remove excess fat; drain.
2. Place pork and all other ingredients in crock-pot, 6 to 8 hours on low or 3 hours on high.
3. Serve over rice.
4. Can be made stovetop.
title: Cantonese Dinner

steps: 1. Cut the pork into long strips, 2 inches wide.
2. Score each strip of meat with 3 or 4 shallow diagonal cuts for better absorption of the marinade.
3. Make the marinade: Combine the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, rice, wine, oil and salt. Add the pork and turn to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
5. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
6. Remove the pork from the marinade; reserve the marinade and add it to the honey.
7. Place the strips of pork on a wire rack in a baking pan.
8. Pour water into the pan just below the level of the rack.
9. Roast for 20 minutes.

10. Turn the strips over, brush them with the honey marinade, and continue to roast until the pork is no longer pink when cut in the thickest part, about 20 minutes. Cut into slices and serve hot or cold.
title: Char Siu

steps: 1. Heat butter in saucepan over low heat until melted.
2. Blend in flour; cook until mixture is bubbly.
3. Remove from heat.
4. Stir in remaining ingredients, except chicken.
5. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
6. Brush on chicken.
7. Grill chicken.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cut chicken into cubes.
2. Marinate chicken in soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch.
3. Chop all vegetables into bite size pieces.
4. Heat wok or large frying pan to 400°.
5. Add 2 tablespoons of oil and stir-fry vegetables for 3 minutes, then remove from wok.
6. Add 3 tablespoons of oil; add chicken and stir-fry until chicken is white.
7. Immediately add hoisin sauce; mix thoroughly.
8. Re-add vegetables to heat.
9. Add cashews.
10. Serve over rice.
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Pound chicken breasts to 1/4 thick.
2. Marinate at least 2 hours.
3. GRILL.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 cup vegetable oil, for deep frying

steps: 1. Coat the beef in cornstarch and mix with the ingredients except the green onions.
2. Sautee the garilc and ginger in the 2 teaspoons of vegetable oil (about 2 to three minutes).
3. Put the rest in the skillet and cook.
title: Chinese Beef

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork tenderloin, cut into strips
1 large tomato, seeded and peeled, cut up

steps: 1. Combine sherry, cornstarch, cumin, garlic and seasoned salt in a medium bowl.
2. Add pork slices and stir to coat well.
3. Heat oil to medium-high.
4. Add pork mixture and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes. Add pepper, onion and tomato pieces.
5. Cover pan and simmer 3 to 4 minutes.
6. Do not overcook.
title: Pork Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Place round steak in freezer for 30 minutes to get firm.
2. Remove from freezer, trim off fat, and slice into 1/8 inch thick.
3. Place oil into wok and heat up oil.
4. Add garlic, meat, salt, ginger and pepper.
5. Stir-fry over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes.
6. Remove meat from wok and place on a heat platter covered in aluminum foil.
7. Add green peppers and onion to wok and cook for 3 minutes.
8. Return meat to pan and add water chestnuts.
9. Mix together soy sauce, sugar, bouillon, cornstarch, and cold water.
10. Stir into wok and cook for additional 4 minutes or until sauce thickens.
11. Serve over hot rice topped with green onions.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb snow peas, trimmed and halved crosswise
1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch and the cold water together until smooth. Add the garlic, ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes and whisk to combine. Stir in the peas and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk the egg whites, remaining 3 tablespoons of cornstarch, salt, and pepper until well combined. Add the chicken pieces, and toss to coat.

3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium to medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil, and once shimmering, add half of the chicken from the egg white mixture (be sure to shake the excess off). Cook the chicken until golden on all sides, about 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil. Add the remaining oil to the pan and repeat with the other half of the chicken.

4. Reduce the heat under the pan then add the snow pea mixture to the now empty skillet. Cover the pan and cook until the peas are tender and the sauce thickens, about 3-5 minutes. Add the chicken (and any juices on the plate) back to the skillet. Toss to coat with the sauce and, if necessary, finish cooking the chicken through. Serve the chicken on a bed of rice, if desired.
title: Lighter General Tso'S Chicken

steps: 1. Cut beef into thin strips, 2 to 3-inches long.
2. Toss with 1/4 to 1/2 cup soy sauce and the meat tenderizer.
3. Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until ready to use.
4. Fry over medium heat until done.
5. Cut green pepper and onion into rings. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter and 1/4 cup soy sauce until tender. Saute rice in 2 tablespoons butter and 1/4 cup soy sauce until coated well.
6. Place rice on platter; layer onion and beef on top, then cover with beef tips.
title: Beef Tips Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Melt butterscotch chips in a double boiler. Add the rest of the ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful onto wax paper; refrigerator about 30 minutes. Store in airtight container.
title: Chinese Scotchies

steps: 1. Combine orange juice, lemon juice, oil, soy sauce and pepper in bowl.
2. Rinse and dry chicken.
3. Add chicken to marinade and turn to coat well.
4. Marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Grill chicken 20 minutes until tender.
5. Brush occasionally with marinade.
title: Grilled Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-1/2-in . pieces
3 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 1-1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the first nine ingredients; set aside 1/4 cup for basting.
2. Pour half into a large resealable plastic bag; add chicken. Seal bag and turn to coat.
3. Pour the remaining marinade into another large resealable plastic bag; add the zucchini, onions and tomatoes. Seal bag and turn to coat.
4. Refrigerate chicken and vegetables for up to 4 hours or overnight.
5. Drain and discard marinade.
6. Alternately thread chicken and vegetables onto metal or soaked wooden skewers.
7. Grill, covered, over medium heat for 6 minutes on each side or until chicken juices run clear, basting occasionally with reserved marinade.
title: Lemon Chicken Skewers (Kabobs)

steps: 1. Pre-heat an bleskiver pan over medium heat. Put a small amount of butter or oil in each hold and heat until hot.
2. Combine all ingredients and stir until well mixed.
3. Fill each hole with batter and let cook for several minutes (about 3).
4. Using a chopstick or knitting needle, flip the half-cooked batter 1/4 turn (90 degrees).
5. Let it cook for another minute or so, flipping 1/8 of a turn each time part touching the pan starts to dry up. They are done when a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out cleans.
title: Chinese Egg Puffs

steps: 1. Cut chicken breast into one inch pieces and set aside.
2. In a medium bowl add Hoisin sauce, fresh ginger, sesame oil and rice vinegar, mix well.
3. Reserve about two tablespoons of the sauce to base the chicken while it's cooking.
4. Add chicken and mix well.
5. Cover and refrigerate for ten minutes.
6. Preheat BBQ or grill to medium high heat.
7. After ten minutes, thread chicken onto metal or wooden skewers.

8. Place the chicken on the BBQ or grill and cook chicken. While cooking base chicken with reserve sauce and turn often. Cooking time will depend on the thickness of the chicken, but should take about eight minutes until its slightly charred.
9. Serve and garnish with a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
10. Enjoy.
title: Hoisin Chicken Kebabs

steps: 1. Place each chicken breast half between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap; pound each piece to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet or small heavy skillet. Sprinkle both sides of chicken evenly with salt and pepper; dredge chicken in flour.

2. Heat oil and butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; cook for 1 minute or until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. Add chicken to pan; cook 4 minutes on each side or until done. Remove chicken; slice thinly, and keep warm. Add wine and juice to pan; cook until reduced to 1/2 cup (about 4 minutes). Serve sauce over chicken.
title: Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. lean pork, cut in 1/2 inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine pork and 2 tablespoons soy sauce.
2. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
3. Combine remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar, cornstarch, crushed pepper and 1/4 cup water.
4. In wok or large skillet, stir-fry pork and garlic in hot oil 3 minutes.
5. Add bell pepper.
6. Stir-fry 3 minutes.
7. Add cornstarch mixture.
8. Cook and stir until slightly thickened.
9. Add peanuts enjoy.
10. Great served over rice.
title: Kung Pao Pork

steps: 1. Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes. Mix lemon juice, soy sauce, mustard, oil, and cayenne pepper. Put marinade and chicken in a 1-gallon bag and freeze.
2. To prepare, thaw chicken and remove from marinade. Bring marinade to a boil in a small saucepan.
3. Spray broiler pan with nonstick spray and place cubed chicken on the pan, with pieces about 1 inch apart.
4. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for about 7 minutes, brushing with marinade once.
5. Turn cubed chicken and broil another 4 minutes.
6. While chicken is cooking, prepare rice according to package directions.
7. Suggested sides: Lentil salad.
title: Chinese Chicken Morsels

steps: 1. For the lemon honey sauce start by squeezing the lemons into a bowl. Then put the lemon pepper inches Next put the honey in, mix it well, cover it and then let it marinate in the fridge for at least half an hour. The longer the better.

2. For the put a frying pan over medium / high heat and put the oil in the pan. Next clean the chicken. Then cover each piece with flour. After that, cover the chicken with egg and place it in the pan. when it is cooked three quarters of the way through pour a little of the sauce on, then flip them and pour some sauce on the other side. When they're done cooking pour as much or as little extra sauce on and serve hot with rice. And if you really want to impress your guests put a little bit of sauce on the rice.
title: Amazing Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Brown meat thoroughly in a small amount of oil.
2. Cook until tender.
3. Add onion.
4. Cook until tender.
5. Add bouillon, soy sauce and garlic.
6. Add green peppers.
7. Cover and cook about 10 minutes. Thicken slowly with cornstarch and water mixture.
8. Reduce heat to simmer.
9. Add tomatoes and heat through.
10. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fresh pork loin, cut in strips
1 large onion, sliced and separated in rings

steps: 1. Place pork and sliced vegetables in greased casserole.
2. Mix other ingredients and pour over pork and vegetables.
3. Cover tightly with foil.
4. Bake at 400° for about 1 hour or until pork is tender.
title: Pork Cantonese Casserole

steps: 1. Take oil, lime juice, cumin and cayenne and mix together in a glass bowl. Put chicken in bowl and let it marinade for 1-2 hours.
2. In a wok, heat 1 tablespoon of water until very hot. Add chicken with marinade and stir-fry over high heat until chicken is white throughout, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove to plate.

3. Add another 2 tablespoons of water to wok and heat until very hot. Add peppers, onion, garlic; stir-fry until crisp-tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Return chicken to wok and season with pepper. Toss until heated through, about 1 minute.
4. Serve with flour tortillas, shredded cheese, sour cream and guacamole.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken Fajitas - Ww

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat oil until hot.
2. Place water chestnuts, celery, carrots and cabbage in skillet.
3. Cover; cook over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes.
4. Add baked chicken. Pour chicken broth in center of mixture.
5. Cover and steam 1 minute.
6. Dissolve cornstarch in water.
7. Add soy sauce; toss with chicken-vegetable mixture to thicken sauce to cover all ingredients.
8. Serve immediately over rice, noodles or chow mein noodles.
title: Chinese Chicken

steps: 1. Remove stem end and string from snow peas.
2. In large nonstick skillet or wok, heat oil over high heat.
3. Add garlic, gingerroot and snow peas; stir-fry for 1 minute
4. Add bean sprouts; stir-fry for 1 minute or until vegetables are tender-crisp, adding water if necessary to prevent burning.
5. Stir in soy sauce.
title: Sprout And Snow Pea Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Remove and discard fat from meat.
2. Combine soy sauce, wine, sugar, honey, food coloring, cinnamon and garlic in a large bowl. Add pork, turning tenderloins to coat completely.
3. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour or refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.
title: Chinese Barbecued Pork

steps: 1. Combine hoisin sauce, beer, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and brown sugar in a large bowl. Remove 1/2 cup of this mixture and reserve. Add chicken thighs to bowl, turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate, turning occasionally, at least 2 hours or over night.
2. Prepare grill for direct cooking.

3. Remove chicken from hoisin mixture and place, skin side down, on lightly oiled grate over medium-high heat. Grill 10 minutes; turn and brush with 1/3 of reserved hoisin mixture. Grill an additional 10 minutes; turn again and brush with another 1/3 of the hoisin mixture. Grill 5 minutes more and turn chicken one last time and brush with remaining hoisin mix. Grill 4 to 6 minutes longer until cooked through and instant read thermometer reads 170°F at thickest part of thigh.
title: Hoisin Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Roll chicken in flour mixture.
2. Melt 1/3 cup butter and coat pieces of chicken well.
3. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
4. Combine honey and lemon juice and glaze chicken pieces.
5. Bake another 15 minutes at 350°.
title: Honey Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine and mix together in a mixing bowl. Rub one 3 1/2 pound fryer in and out with the mixture. Marinate for 45 minutes before roasting.
2. Bake chicken at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours. Can also be done with chicken pieces.
title: Roast Chicken Cantonese

steps: 1. Saute pork in oil.
2. Add and simmer next 6 ingredients.
3. Stir in 1 can chop suey vegetables and 1 can bean sprouts.
4. Heat until warm.
5. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Sally'S Chop Suey

steps: 1. Cut the pork into 1 inch wide strips.
2. Mix sugar, rice wine, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and salt (I use only 1 teaspoon salt) in a bowl or zippered plastic bag.
3. Add meat to marinade and refrigerate overnight, turning a couple of times if you can.
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
5. Line roasting pan with foil.
6. Spray rack with oil for ease of cleanup.
7. Place meat on rack in pan and roast for 30 minutes.
8. Serve hot or cold.
9. Note: I sometimes add garlic, star anise, or ginger to the basic marinade. I slice at least half of the meat and freeze the slices.
title: Chinese Roast Pork

ingredients.text: 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, chopped

steps: 1. Heat a skillet on medium heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add mushrooms and saute until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet. Season chicken with salt and pepper, then sprinkle cornstarch on chicken pieces and make sure each piece is somewhat coated. (You can add a little more if needed.) Add the remaining olive oil to the skillet and add chicken. Brown on both sides until cooked, about 5 minutes per side. Add garlic, red pepper, edamame, half of the green onions and cashews and stir for 30 seconds. Turn heat to medium low.
2. In a small bowl, mix soy sauce and honey. Pour into skillet, coating chicken and vegetables. Serve with jasmine rice.
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, broth, soy sauce, salt and ginger until smooth; set aside.
2. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry the mushrooms, celery, onion, pepper and carrot in oil for 5 minutes. Add garlic; stir-fry 1-2 minutes longer or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
3. Stir cornstarch mixture and add to the pan. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Add chicken; heat through. Serve with rice; sprinkle with chow mein noodles.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400 degrees/.
2. Trim fat from pork.
3. Combine sugar, five-spice, salt and cayenne pepper. Rub pork with spice mixture.
4. Place pork on a rack coated with cooking spray in a foil-lined broiling pan.
5. Bake for 10 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, combine hoisin sauce, orange juice and oil; brush all over tenderloin. Bake 10 to 15 minute or until thermometer registers 155 degrees.
7. Remove from oven; tent with foild and let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
title: Chinese Barbecue Pork Tenderloin

steps: 1. Cook celery and onions in 2 tablespoons hot oil for 5 minutes. Add salt, bean sprouts and cook, covered, 5 minutes.
2. Place on platter.
3. Fry pork in remaining oil until cooked.
title: Chow Mein

steps: 1. Cube chicken into bite size pieces. Marinate 30 mins. in lemon juice.
2. Coat with above breading and fry until golden brown.
title: Lemon Chicken Nuggets

steps: 1. Cook chicken and shred in long thin strips (1 to 1 1/2 cups). In a skillet, heat cooking oil and saute onions until lightly brown.
2. Add celery, cabbage and salt; cook for 5 minutes.
3. Add chicken, soy sauce and broth.
4. Cook over low heat.
5. Cover until vegetables are done.
6. To thicken broth, use cornstarch or flour (blend with 1 tablespoon cold water).
7. Serve hot.
8. May add additional vegetables.
title: Chicken Chop Suey

steps: 1. Thinly slice beef on the diagonal (for easy slicing,place meat in the freezer until slightly frozen);place in a snug-fitting bowl.
2. Combine soy sauce,sherry,garlic,and black pepper;pour over meat,tossing to coat completely.
3. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours.
4. In a large skillet or wok,heat oil.
5. Add green pepper and onion saute for 2 minutes.
6. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water.
7. Add beef and marinate.
8. Bring to boiling point.
9. Reduce heat and simmer,covered for 8 minutes.
10. Blend cornstarch with cold water.
11. Stir into mixture in skillet.
12. Cook and stir until thickened.
13. Cut tomatoes into wedges; add to skillet;stir gently.
14. Cover and simmer, just until tomatoes are hot,about 3 minutes.
15. Serve hot over rice with scallions,if desired.
title: Chinese Beef And Tomatoes

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a plastic bag.
2. Stab the chicken a few times to make sure it soaks up all the goods, then add to the liquid.
3. Place in fridge for at least a few hours.
4. Remove chicken from marinade and grill until done turning once.
title: Chinese Grilled Chicken

steps: 1. In a large frying pan, melt butter. Add chicken and cook about 10 minutes on each side.

2. In medium size nonaluminum saucepan, combine orange juice, cranberries, honey, orange peel, cornstarch and cloves. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Spoon sauce over chicken breasts.
title: Cranberry Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1 tablespoon fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped

steps: 1. Stir hoisin, vinegar, and water in a small bowl until well blended and set aside.
2. Season chicken with salt and set aside.
3. Heat wok on high until hot, then add oil, swirling to coat then add ginger, stirring until fragrant (about 10 sec).
4. Add chicken and stirfry for about a minute then add carrot and stirfry another 2 minutes or until chicken is just cooked and carrots are tender.
5. Add hoisin mixture and green onions and toss until heated through.
6. Remove from heat and add cashews.
7. Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves, wrap up, and enjoy!
title: Cashew Chicken Lettuce Wraps

steps: 1. In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt and pepper.
2. Add chicken, a few pieces at a time; shake to coat.
3. In a large skillet, brown chicken in margarine until golden brown.
4. Add lemon juice and mushrooms.
5. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes or until tender.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Jeff'S Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch, soya sauce, vinegar, honey and garlic together.
2. Add sliced pork and marinate a few hours:this can be done on the morning; refrigerate.
3. Remove meat from marinade.
4. Heat wok or large frypan on High.
5. Add oil,ginger and pork;stir fry until golden brown. Remove meat.
6. Add onion, celery,pepper,mushrooms and broccoli.Stir fry for 2-3 minutes.
7. Add chicken broth, marinade,pork and beansprouts.
8. Stir on High until vegetables are tender crisp.
9. Recipe can be easily doubled.
title: Pork Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the carrots and celery and stir fry for 3 minutes. Add remaining 1 teaspoon oil, then add the chicken and stir fry for 5 more minutes.

2. In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch into the orange juice. Mix in the soy sauce, honey and ginger. Add this sauce to the wok and cook over medium heat until thickened. Top with the cashews and green onions.
title: Chicken Honey Nut Stir Fry

steps: 1. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the eggs, nuts, dates, raisins, and coconut. Mix well. Add the flour and beat until blended. Bake in a wax-paper-lined 8x8x2 inch baking pan in a moderate oven, 350*, for 40 minutes. While still warm, cut into 2- inch squares.
title: Old Fashioned Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored and add sugar gradually.
2. Add the three dry ingredients which have been mixed together.
3. Add vanilla and fold in dates and nuts.
4. Fold in the 3 egg whites which have beaten stiff.
5. Bake in a (9 x 13-inch) pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
6. Cut in squares when cool.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cream sugar and butter or margarine.
2. Blend in flour.
3. Pat mixture onto greased cookie sheet and bake in moderate (350°) oven for 15 minutes.
title: Emily Clyburn'S Recipe For A Family Favorite - Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2/3 lb. flank steak, sliced across the grain (I used chuck steak which worked fine and was 1/4 of the price of flank steak)

steps: 1. Pat the steak pieces and make sure they're dry; then, toss the steak and cornstarch together. Be sure all pieces are fully coated, but shake off excess corn starch. Mix together the soy sauce, water, brown sugar and red pepper flakes.
2. Heat half the oil in a wok at medium-high heat and add the ginger and garlic. Once fragrant (30 seconds or so), add the soy sauce mixture. Cook for about 2 minutes and transfer to a bowl.

3. Turn the heat up on the wok and add the remaining oil. Add the beef and cook, stirring until just browned. Pour the sauce back in and let it cook with the meat. Let the sauce thicken to your liking.
title: Mongolian Beef

steps: 1. In heavy saucepan, melt chocolate and butterscotch chips, stirring constantly, over low heat.
2. Remove from heat and stir in noodles and nuts. Mix quickly, coating all noodles.
3. Dip out by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and cool.
4. You can substitute peanut butter chips for the butterscotch chips.
title: Chow Mein Clusters

steps: 1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position, place baking stone or sheet pan on rack, and heat oven to 375&deg. Lightly grease a 12 cup muffin tin. Stir butter, sugar, and salt in a large bowl until combined. Stir in egg, and then flour until completely combined. Divide dough into 16 portions and roll into balls.
2. Press a dough ball into each cup, pressing dough up sides to about 1/4 inch from top of cup, and maintaining a thickness about 1/8-inch thick. Chill for 30 minutes.
3. Whisk sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk in milk, cream, yolks, and vanilla until combined.

4. Fill each cup with custard to about 1/8-inch from top of crust (don't overfill). Bake until crust is golden and custard is just set, about 20 minutes. Let tarts cool in pan for 15 minutes then carefully transfer to wire rack to cool. Let pan cool, then repeat with remaining dough and custard. Serve room temperature or chilled.
title: Chinese Egg Tarts Recipe

steps: 1. Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir okra until tender and golden brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer okra to a plate.

2. Sprinkle turmeric into hot oil; heat until turmeric becomes aromatic, 1 to 2 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, onions, and tomatoes; cook and stir until onions are tender, about 10 minutes. Stir okra into onion mixture. Garnish with cilantro.
title: Chef Kiran'S Okra Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 4 to 6 skinless, boneless chicken breasts (whole or cubed)

steps: 1. Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice and lemon pepper seasoning together.
2. Dip chicken in mixture, then place in pan or crock-pot.
3. Put onions and green pepper on top of chicken.
4. Pour remainder of sauce over chicken mixture.
5. Cook until chicken is done or "all day" in crockpot.
6. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Creamy Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Saute onions and celery in oil until crisp.
2. Add the next 5 ingredients; simmer for 10 minutes.
3. Stir in cornstarch with water, a little at a time.
4. Cook until thickened.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Mix the first 3 ingredients as for pie dough. Pat firmly into pan and partially bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Slice steak into narrow strips.
2. Brown in the oil.
3. Combine with garlic, salt, pepper, soy sauce and sugar.
4. Cook on low in crock-pot for 6 to 8 hours.
5. Turn to high.
6. Add bean sprouts, tomatoes and pepper.
7. Dissolve cornstarch in water; stir into pot. Cover and cook on high 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened. Sprinkle with onions.
8. May serve over rice.
9. Suitable for freezing.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 1 (1 lb) pork tenderloin, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine the first 4 ingredients.
2. Sprinkle pork with 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and toss.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, and add 1 tablespoon canola oil, and swirl.
4. Add pork, and cook 3 minutes, browning on both sides. Remove pork from pan, and keep warm.
5. Heat pan over high heat, and add the remaining canola oil, and swirl to coat.
6. Add onion, and stir fry for 1 minute.
7. Add bell peppers and jalapeno, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
8. Return pork to pan, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
9. Stir in broth mixture (1st 4 ingredients), the remaining salt, and remaining black pepper, and bring to a boil.
10. Remove from heat, stir in tomatoes, and sprinkle with cilantro.
title: Baja Pork Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 3/4 pound peeled and deveined large shrimp
2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice (1/2 small lemon)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and garlic, and saute 5 minutes or until done. Add snow peas and remaining ingredients; saute 30 seconds.
title: Shrimp And Snow Pea Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add curry powder, cumin and red pepper flakes; cook and stir about 30 seconds.
2. Stir in jalapeno pepper and garlic. Add bell pepper and carrots; mix well. Add cauliflower; reduce heat to medium.
3. Stir in 1/4 cup water; cook and stir until water evaporates. Add remaining 1/4 cup water; cover and cook about 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring occasionally.
4. Add salt; mix well. Sprinkle with cilantro and garnish, if desired.
title: Indian-Style Vegetable Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (2 lb) boneless pork shoulder, trimmed (Boston butt)

steps: 1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well with a whisk. Place in a large zip-top plastic bag. Add pork to bag and seal. Marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours, turning occasionally.
2. Place pork and marinade in a crock pot. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.
3. Remove pork from slow cooker using a slotted spoon. Place on a cutting board or work surface. Cover with aluminum foil and keep warm.
4. Add broth to sauce in slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 30 minutes or until sauce thickens. Shred pork with 2 forks and serve with sauce.
title: Slow Cooker Char Siu (Chinese Barbecued Pork)

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breasts, boneless, skinless and sliced

steps: 1. Stir together soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch and chicken broth. In wok or frypan, stir-fry chicken for about 3 minutes.
2. Add garlic, green onions, green pepper and mushrooms and continue to stir-fry for about 2 minutes.
3. Lower heat and stir in soy sauce mixture.
4. Cook until sauce thickens.
5. Serve hot over cooked rice. Sprinkle with cashew nuts.
title: Stir-Fry Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high.

2. Peel and devein the shrimp(if not already done). Trim off the greens from the scallions, reserving them for another dish, then trim off the roots; you should be left with 2-inch sections of scallion white. Cut the bacon strips crosswise in half.

3. Nestle each scallion white in the cucrved hollow of a shrimp, then wrap in piece of bacon and secure with a bamboo skewer or toothpick by running the skewer or toothpick through the wrapped shrimp.
4. When ready to cook, arrange the dim sum on the hot grate and grill until the shrimp are firm and pink and the bacon is crisp, 2 to 4 minutes per side, turning once with tongs. Serve immediately.
title: Grilled Shrimp Dim Sum

ingredients.text: 3/4 cup fresh baby carrots, quartered lengthwise
1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced

steps: 1. In a nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry broccoli and carrots in oil for 5 minutes. Add the zucchini, salt and pepper; stir-fry 4-5 minutes longer or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
title: Vibrant Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Bring rice and beef broth to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.
2. Combine cornstarch and ginger in a small bowl. Stir in orange juice, soy sauce, beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic until blended.

3. Heat 3 teaspoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook and stir carrots, broccoli, and cauliflower until just tender, 4 to 5 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon oil, mushrooms, snow peas, and tofu; continue cooking until mushrooms soften, about 3 minutes. Push vegetable mixture to one side of skillet and cook and stir egg in remaining space until set; combine egg with vegetables. Stir in orange juice mixture and boil until thickened, about 2 minutes.
4. Serve over rice and top with slivered almonds.
title: Five-Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix together ingredients, except chicken. Marinate chicken several hours. Sprinkle generously with lemon pepper while barbecuing over low heat. Turn chicken often to prevent burning.
title: Barbecue Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Place each chicken breast on a 12-inch square of aluminum foil. Sprinkle 1 Tablespoon of lemon juice on each breast, then sprinkle with the tarragon and garlic powder.
2. Carefully fold the foil so that the lemon juice can't run out.
3. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into stir-fry strips
1 1/3 lbs fresh strawberries, washed and hulled, and cut into quarters

steps: 1. Place the chicken in a bowl and combine with the light soy sauce, rice wine or dry sherry, and cornstarch. Marinate the chicken for 15 minutes.

2. In a small bowl, combine 1/4 cup water, orange juice, lemon juice and sugar. In a separate small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch into 2 or 4 teaspoons water (2 teaspoons for a thicker sauce; 4 teaspoons for a thinner sauce). Set aside.

3. Heat a wok or heavy skillet over medium-high heat. When the pan is hot, add 2 tablespoons oil, swirling the oil so that it coats half-way up the sides as well as the bottom. When the oil is hot, add half the minced garlic and ginger. Stir-fry until aromatic (about 10 seconds), then add the chicken. Let the chicken brown for about 30 seconds, then stir-fry the chicken until it turns white and is nearly cooked through. Remove the chicken and drain in a colander or on paper towels.

4. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in the wok or skillet, swirling the oil so that it coats half-way up the sides as well as the bottom. When the oil is hot, add the remaining garlic and ginger. Stir-fry for 10 seconds, then add the strawberries. Stir-fry briefly (about 30 seconds), give the sauce a quick stir and add into the pan. Re-stir the cornstarch and water mixture and pour into the sauce, stirring quickly to thicken.
5. When the sauce thickens, add the chicken back into the pan. Stir-fry for another minute to blend the ingredients and make sure the chicken is cooked through. Serve immediately.
title: Strawberry Chicken Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the first six ingredients; remove 3 tablespoons for basting. Add chicken to remaining soy sauce mixture; toss to coat. On four metal or soaked wooden skewers, alternately thread chicken and broccoli.

2. Place skewers on greased grill rack. Cook, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 in. from the heat until chicken is no longer pink, 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally. Baste with reserved soy mixture during the last 4 minutes of cooking.
title: Chinese Takeout-On-A-Stick

steps: 1. In a large resealable plastic bag, mix the lemon juice, olive oil, and rosemary. Place the chicken and lemon slices in the bag. Seal, and shake to coat. Marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours or overnight.
2. Preheat the grill for high heat.

3. Lightly oil the grill grate. Discard marinade, and grill chicken 8 minutes per side, or until juices run clear. Don't worry about the rosemary sticking to the chicken, it tastes great when it's grilled. If you use fresh rosemary sprigs, throw the stems onto the coals - they give the chicken even more of a smoky rosemary flavor!
title: Marinated Rosemary Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cut and skin (if not already) chicken in thin strips.
2. Set aside.
3. In small bowl, blend sauce mixture.
4. Set aside.
5. Add oil to wok.
6. Preheat.
7. Slice green pepper, carrots and onions into thin strips.
8. Cut broccoli into small pieces.
9. Stir-fry carrots and broccoli for 2 minutes.
10. Add onions and green pepper.
11. Add chicken to wok, stir-fry for 4 minutes.
12. Add sauce mixture. Cover and simmer on low for 2 minutes . Serve.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, arrange chicken in a single layer, skin side down.
3. In a small bowl combine oregano, salt and pepper.
4. Whisk in oil, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.
5. Drizzle half over chicken and bake for 20 minutes.
6. Drain excess fat from the chicken.
7. Turn chicken over and brush on the remaining mixture.
8. Continue baking until done, about 15 minutes.
title: Oregano Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Thinly slice the chicken and place on a lightly oiled, foil lined tray.
2. Grill for 3-4 minutes on each side under moderate heat until cooked through.
3. Cut the celery, green onions and cucumber into 2 inch lengths, then cut them lengthways into fine shreds.
4. Grate the carrot.
5. Spread the hoisin sauce over the tortillas to within 1 inch of the edge.
6. Arrange the chicken slices down the centre and sprinkle with the sesame seeds and prepared vegetables.
7. Roll up tortillas and serve.
title: Hoisin Chicken Wraps

steps: 1. Mix soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder and ginger in a medium bowl.
2. Add beef; let stand 10 minutes to marinate.
3. Drain. Stir-fry beef in hot oil in a large skillet until brown.
4. Add peppers and onion.
5. Stir-fry until tender.
6. Mix broth and cornstarch, add to skillet and bring to a boil for 1 minute. Meanwhile, prepare 4 servings of instant rice.
7. Add to skillet, mix well and serve.
title: Pepper Steak Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, sherry, sugar, ginger, and red pepper in a small cup.
2. Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet.
3. Stir-fry the shrimp until pink and firm, about 2 minutes.
4. Remove shrimp with a slotted spoon to a heated bowl.
5. Add garlic to the skillet and stir-fry 1 minute.
6. Add soy sauce mixture and cook stirring constantly, until bubbly.
7. Return shrimp to skillet and heat for about 1 minute.
8. Great served with fried rice or white. Enjoy!
title: Szechuan Shrimp

steps: 1. Cut steak into 1-inch pieces, as thin as possible.
2. Heat shortening, garlic, salt and pepper in skillet and in it cook beef until brown on both sides.
3. Add soy sauce and sugar.
4. Cover and cook on high heat 5 minutes.
5. Add bean sprouts, tomato and green pepper.
6. Cover and cook 3 minutes.
7. Stir in cornstarch dissolved in water.
8. Cook until sauce is thickened.
9. Sprinkle with green onions.
10. Serve with rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 2 c. boneless chicken, cut in pieces
3 medium zucchini, cut in thin slices
2 medium onions, cut in small pieces
1 stalk celery, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Put the oil in a large skillet.
2. Turn the heat to medium.
3. Add chicken.
4. Stir.
5. Cover the skillet.
6. Cook about 5 minutes.
7. Add the zucchini, green peppers, onion and celery to the skillet.
8. Stir gently until the vegetables are coated with oil.
9. Cook until the chicken and vegetables are hot.
10. Put the lid on the skillet.
11. Turn the heat to low.
12. Cook about 5 minutes.
13. Cook until the zucchini is tender and firm.
14. If the mixture gets dry, add a little water.
15. If there is liquid in the skillet, cook with the lid off.
16. Add black and red pepper.
17. Stir gently.
18. Cut cheese and place on top, if desired.
title: Chicken-Zucchini Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat peanut oil in a wok or skillet until hot.
2. Stir-fry squash and carrots about 1 minute.
3. Add onion and celery for approximately 2 minutes.
4. Add the rest of the vegetables and stir-fry for another 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Add salt, pepper and soy sauce and stir-fry approximately 30 seconds.
title: Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sirloin, cut into thin slices

steps: 1. Combine sesame oil and five-spice powder in a skillet and heat to medium-high heat; add beef and brown. Remove from pan.
title: Beef Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine everything except the chicken in a large bowl.
2. Add the chicken and mix well to ensure that all the pieces are covered with the sauce.
3. Marinate at least 2 hours preferrably overnight.
4. Grill until the chicken is cooked through about 20 to 30 minutes.
title: Grilled Char Siu Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves

steps: 1. Whisk together 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/2 cup cilantro, ginger, and garlic in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Add the pork and toss to evenly coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator overnight.
2. Remove the pork from the marinade and shake off excess. Discard used marinade.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry pork in the hot oil until browned, about 10 minutes. Set pork aside.

4. Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to wok; stir in onions until slightly softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in red bell pepper for 3 more minutes. Return pork to wok. Add lime juice and 1/2 cup cilantro. Cook and stir until cilantro has wilted, about 1 minute.
title: Cilantro And Pork Stir Fry

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325.
2. Cut each chicken breast into 3 pieces then.
3. marinate them in the soya sauce.
4. Whisk the 1/4 c.cornstarch and baking powder together, then beat in the eggs.
5. Chill in refrigerator while you make the sauce.
6. In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar and 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Stir in the lemon juice and chicken broth, then set aside.
7. Dip the chicken pieces into the chilled batter, then fry in hot oil in a frying pan until brown.
8. Spray a 9x13 glass pan with cooking spray, then lay the chicken in it.

9. Using the same frying pan, add 2 tablespoons oil. Slice one of the lemons, and stir fry until they start to brown. Stir in the remaining sauce mixture, continue stirring until the sauce has thickend.
10. Pour over the chicken.
11. Slice the remaining lemon, and layer over the chicken.
12. Bake for 30-40 min's until the chicken is done.
13. Serve over steamed or fried rice.
title: Lemon Chicken-Just Like Take Out !

steps: 1. In measuring cup, combine first 5 ingredients.
2. Heat wok and add next 4 ingredients.
3. Fry 3 minutes.
4. Remove chicken.
5. Add next 5 ingredients.
6. Add sauce.
7. Heat until it bubbles.
8. Add chicken and serve over hot rice.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Cut zucchini into bite sized sticks or slices.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add almonds.
3. Cook for about 4-5 minutes until golden brown and lightly toasted.
4. Stir constantly or they will burn.
5. You can also toast them under a broiler/griller if you prefer.
6. Set almonds aside.
7. Add zucchini and garlic to pan.
8. Cook until tender but not mushy.
9. Add a small amount of water to the pan if needed to prevent burning or sticking.
10. Stir through the soy sauce and almonds and serve.
title: Zucchini Almond Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and pepper in small bowl. Dredge chicken in cornstarch.
2. Heat oil in wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add chicken and garlic; stir-fry until chicken is opaque, about 5 minutes.
4. Add soy mixture and stir-fry 30 seconds.
5. Mix in green onions.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Szechuan Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (1 lb.)

steps: 1. In a plastic bag, combine the flour, salt and pepper; shake to mix.
2. Add the chicken; shake to coat lightly.
3. Remove the chicken; reserve the excess seasoned flour.
4. In a large skillet, warm 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium heat.
5. Add the chicken; brown on one side for about 5 minutes.
6. Add remaining tablespoon oil.
7. Turn the chicken; brown well on the second side, about 5 minutes longer.
8. Transfer the chicken to a plate; set aside.
9. Coarsely chop onion.
10. Add the margarine to the skillet.
11. When the margarine melts, add the onion and cook, stirring, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
12. Stir in the reserved seasoned flour and cook, stirring, until the flour is completely incorporated, about 1 minute.
13. Add the broth, 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice and the thyme; bring the mixture to boil, stirring constantly.
title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar; add flour, salt, nuts, water and vanilla.
2. Dough is dry.
3. Press into balls the size of large olives.
4. Bake on ungreased cookie pans in slow oven (300°) for 25 to 30 minutes.
5. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.
title: Chinese Wedding Rings

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice and butter.
2. Salt chicken and place skin down in baking pan.
3. Pour 1/3 lemon juice and butter over chicken. Bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes.
4. Turn chicken over.
5. Pour remainder of juice over chicken and bake 40 minutes longer. Baste occasionally.
6. Serve with rice or potatoes.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 pork chops, half frozen, sliced as thin as possible (1/2 x 1 1/4-inch)

steps: 1. Heat shortening.
2. Cook meat for 2 minutes on high heat, stirring.

3. Add soy sauce, celery (all the leaves chopped from the top) and 4 or 5 outside stalks, sliced; mushrooms, bean sprouts and onion sliced crosswise 3 times then finely sliced up and down. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
4. Cook 3 to 5 minutes with lid on, stirring often.
title: Chop Suey

steps: 1. Peel and rinse fresh water chestnuts. If using canned be sure to rinse well and drain. Marinate chestnuts in soy sauce for 2 1/2 hours.

2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Put the brown sugar in a dish and break up any clumps. Remove chestnuts from soy sauce and immediately roll in brown sugar. Wrap each with 1 piece of the cut bacon and secure with a toothpick.
3. Place chestnuts on a rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake 30 minutes, turning once.
4. Note: They can be prepared in advance and frozen before cooking. Lasts 2 to 3 months in a sealed freezer bag.
title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnut Dim Sum

steps: 1. Add the ginger, soy sauce, and sugar to a bowl. Add the chicken to the bowl and coat well. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.
2. Add the almonds to a skillet and toast on medium heat for about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, add the oil, carrot, and shallot. Saute for 5 minutes. Add the almonds and mix well. Set aside.
4. Drain the chicken and add to the skillet. Saute for 3 minutes on each side.
5. Add the almonds and vegetables. Cover with chicken stock and let simmer 10 minutes. Before finishing, add the cornstarch dissolved in a little cold water. Let simmer for another 2 minutes.
title: Chinese-Style Almond Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 pounds boneless chicken breasts, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large bowl combine the chicken pieces, sherry, soy sauce and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Mix together, cover and refrigerate. Let marinate for 15 to 20 minutes.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup cornstarch and the baking powder; beat in eggs to form a batter. Coat chicken pieces with batter and set aside.
3. In a wok, heat 2 cups oil to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Working in batches, fry chicken pieces in hot oil until browned. Transfer to paper towel-lined plate.

4. In a medium bowl combine the sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, broth, lemon juice and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix together and add lemon slices. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in small saucepan and slowly stir in lemon sauce mixture. Cook, stirring, until sauce is clear. Pour sauce over chicken and serve.
title: Lemon Chicken Ii

ingredients.text: 2 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced thin
1/2 lb. broccoli, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, garlic and 1/4 cup water; set aside.
2. In wok or skillet, stir-fry chicken in hot oil 2 minutes.
3. Add vegetables.
4. Stir-fry 4 minutes.
5. Add soy sauce mixture.
6. Cook and stir until slightly thickened.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Cut meat lengthwise in half.
2. Mix remaining ingredients in medium bowl.
3. Add meat and turn to coat on all sides.
4. Cover and refrigerate, turning meat occasionally, at least 8 hours.
title: Chinese Pork Slices

steps: 1. Using the KitchenAid(R) Pro Line(R) Series Food Processor set up with the Adjustable Slicing Disk, slice the carrots. Make sure the lid is secure and latched into place before you feed the carrots through the food chute opening. You may also need to cut the carrots to fit the feed tube. Make sure you push the vegetables down the chute with the feed tube and not your hands. Also set the speed lever to "High" to obtain better results while slicing your vegetables.
2. Once the carrots are sliced place them in a plate and set aside. Slice the zucchini and mushrooms the same way you sliced the carrots.
3. In a medium bowl, mix the soy sauce, water, honey, white vinegar and corn starch until combined. Set aside.
4. Place the olive oil and extra-firm tofu in a non-stick skillet over medium to high heat. Cook for 3-5 minutes stirring occasionally until the tofu starts to brown.

5. Add the carrots, zucchini, mushrooms and ginger. Cook the vegetables for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally or until they are tender. Add the sauce and cook for one extra minute or until the sauce has thickened. If using, you can sprinkle the sesame seeds over the vegetables at this time. Turn the heat off and serve the stir fry over brown rice or quinoa while it is still warm.
title: Vegetable Stir Fry

steps: 1. Spread pine nuts on baking dish and roast for about 4 minutes at 400°. Gently pound chicken breasts thin.
2. Salt and pepper. Heat oil in skillet and saute chicken until cooked.
3. Remove from pan and place on warm plate.
4. Drain skillet, add wine and bring to boil, scraping bottom of pan, reduce by half over high heat and add lemon juice and capers.
5. Remove from heat and add butter, whisking 1 tablespoon at a time.
6. Add any juice from chicken on platter.
7. Pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with pine nuts.
title: Lemon Chicken With Capers

ingredients.text: 16 ounces mixed vegetables (sugar snap pea variety is what I used)

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add Angel hair pasta and mixed veggies to pot.
2. Continue to cook for 5 minutes.
3. While the pasta is cooking, prepare the sauce. Combine the hoisin sauce, broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, and ginger in a small bowl.
4. When pasta is done, drain well. Transfer back into the pot, or into a serving dish.
5. Combine with the sauce mixture.
6. Serve and enjoy!
title: Super Easy Lo Mein

steps: 1. Trim fat from beef; cut into 1/2 x 1/8 x 2-inch strips. Drain tomatoes;
2. reserve	liquid.
3. Combine tomato liquid, soy sauce, ginger, cornstarch and sugar; mix well.
4. Stir-fry beef in hot
5. oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat;	remove meat.
6. Add green pepper and onion to skillet; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes.
7. Add beef,
