13. Stir. Cover.
14. Cook 3 to 4 minutes.
15. Makes 5 cups.
title: Beef And Tomato Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Lightly brown nuts in small amount of oil.
2. Remove.
3. Stir-fry vegetables until tender-crisp.
4. Place all ingredients in pan and reheat.
5. Serve over rice.
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Rinse and pat dry scallops. If using sea scallops, cut into quarters; set aside.
2. Wipe mushrooms with damp towel and slice.
3. Rinse and chop broccoli and pepper into bite size pieces. Mince garlic and set aside with vegetables.
4. Heat half of the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat:saute garlic for 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Raise temperature to medium high, add vegetables and stir-fry until tender about 4 to 5 minutes.
6. Add remaining oil and scallops to pan and stir-fry until scallops are opaque, about 4 to 5 minutes. Add teriyaki sauce and heat about 1 minute. Serve over cooked brown rice.
title: Stir-Fry Scallops

steps: 1. Coat chicken with seasoned flour.
2. Brown chicken in butter. Add lemon juice and mushrooms; reduce heat.
3. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup lemon juice, fresh squeezed (4 lemons)
1 tablespoon fresh thyme, minced (or 1/2 teaspoon dried)

steps: 1. In a large non-reactive bowl, whisk together all ingredients and add chicken to coat.
2. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for a minimum of 6 hours to overnight.
3. Over a hot grill, cook chicken breasts for 10 minutes on each side, until just cooked through.
4. Cool slightly, slice and serve.
5. At this point, you may skewer with wooden skewers and serve with satay dip, if desired.
title: My Favorite Grilled Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a large zip-lock bag. Add chicken, and seal bag. Marinate for 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
2. Combine eggs, 1/4 cup cornstarch, and baking powder in a large bowl; stir well. Dip chicken into batter, coating well.

3. Pour 2 cups oil into a large heavy skillet. Fry chicken in hot oil over medium-high heat until golden, turning occasionally. Drain on paper towels. Cut chicken into 1 1/2 inch X 1 inch pieces. Arrange on a serving platter.

4. Combine chicken broth and next 4 ingredients; set aside. Place 2 tbsp oil in a large non-stick skillet; place over medium-high heat until hot. Add lemon slices, and stir fry 30 seconds. Add broth mixture, and stir fry 3 additional minutes or until sauce is thickened and clear. Pour over chicken. Serve immediately.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 green onions, cut in half lengthwise

steps: 1. Mix soy sauce, honey, cinnamon, garlic, onions and ginger. Pour this marinade over pork. Marinate in refrigerator at least 6 hours or overnight. Place tenderloins in cooking bags with approximately 1/2 cup marinade. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until pork is done.
title: Chinese Pork

steps: 1. Mix cabbage and red bell peppers together in a bowl. Mix onion, garlic, and ginger together in a separate bowl.

2. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat; add 1/4 cup sesame oil. Cook and stir beef and onion mixture in the hot oil until beef is browned on both sides, 3 to 4 minutes. Add cabbage mixture to beef mixture; cook, stirring quickly, until cabbage wilts, onion begins to brown, and beef is fully cooked, about 5 minutes.

3. Stir remaining 1/4 cup sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper into beef and cabbage mixture; toss to coat. Mix water and cornstarch together in a bowl until cornstarch is dissolved; pour into beef and cabbage mixture. Cook and stir until sauce reduces and thickens, about 5 minutes.
title: Sesame Pepper Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (No. 2) bean sprouts, drain off liquid and save

steps: 1. Blend the mixture gently together with a fork. Heat about 1/2 cup salad oil in a skillet. Pour about 1/3 cup of the mixture for each cake in skillet. Flatten and shape each cake with a pancake turner. Turn when brown on the under side.
title: Egg Foo Young

title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 8 oz. cooked lean roast beef, cut into strips

steps: 1. Combine the beef broth, soy sauce, cornstarch and mustard. Stir until cornstarch is dissolved.
2. Set aside.
3. Cut the broccoli into bite size pieces.

4. In a nonstick wok or large nonstick skillet, warm the oil over medium heat, until hot, but not smoking. Add the vegetables and stir-fry until vegetables are crisp-tender and onion begins to brown, 4 to 5 minutes.
5. Stir the cornstarch mixture again and pour it into the wok.
6. Stir in the beef, peanuts, red pepper flakes and black pepper.
7. Stir-fry until the sauce thickens and the beef is heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.
8. If necessary, reduce the heat to keep the sauce from evaporating. Serves 4.
title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine 1st 8 ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well with a whisk.
2. Place in a large zip-top plastic bag.
3. Add pork to bag and seal.
4. Marinate in refrigerator at least 2 hours, turning occasionally.
5. Place pork and marinade in an electric slow-cooker.
6. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.
7. Remove pork from slow-cooker using slotted spoon. Place on cutting board or work surface. Cover with foil to keep warm.
8. Add broth to sauce in slow cooker.
9. Cover and cook on low for 30 minutes or until sauce thickens.
10. Shred pork with 2 forks. Serve with sauce.
title: Slow Cooker Char Siu Pork Roast

ingredients.text: 4 heads baby bok choy, halved lengthwise

steps: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sprinkle sugar evenly over cut sides of bok choy. Add oil to pan; swirl to coat. Add bok choy to pan, cut side down; cover and cook 2 minutes or until browned. Turn bok choy over; add 3 tablespoons water to pan. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until bok choy is crisp-tender. Sprinkle evenly with salt.
title: Seared Baby Bok Choy

steps: 1. Clean baby bok choy in cold water several times to get out the sand/dirt. You can slice the vegetable in half length-wise if you like.
2. heat oil over medium heat in skillet. (very briefly if using sesame oil since this burns quickly).
3. If you are using fresh garlic instead of garlic salt, add to oil now.
4. Add baby bok choy to skillet, stirring constantly, about 1 min until leaves are coated with oil and beginning to wilt.
5. Add chicken broth and cover pan.
6. Simmer for 2-3 minutes. Test for doneness with a fork - if it can pierce the white thick part of the stalk without much resistance it is ready.
7. Remove from heat, add garlic salt.
8. When transferring to serving dish, you can move some of the broth but don't take the bottom bits since this may have residual sand.
title: Baby Bok Choy - Authentic Chinese Recipe

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, thinly sliced
1 stalk (4 inches) fresh lemongrass, finely chopped
1 1/3 lbs gai lan, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths

steps: 1. Heat half the oil in a wok on high heat. Stir-fry chicken, in batches, for about 2-3 mins, or until browned. Remove from wok.

2. Heat remaining oil in wok. Stir-fry lemongrass and garlic for about 1 min or until fragrant. Add gai lan, pepper, lemon juice and soy sauce; stir-fry for about 2 mins, or until vegetables are tender.
3. Return chicken to wok; stir-fry until heated through.
title: Lemon Chicken With Asian Greens

steps: 1. Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored.
2. Gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating well.
3. Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture, beating well.
4. Fold in dates and pecans.
5. Spread batter evenly into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
6. Bake in a 300° oven for 35 minutes.
7. Cut into 3 x 1-inch bars.
8. Remove to wire racks to cool.
9. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving. Yields about 3 dozen.
title: Texan Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons orange zest (grated or julienned (try to avoid the white pith)
2 tablespoons mustard, prepared table mustard (preferably wholegrain mustard)
1 tablespoon rosemary, fresh, chopped (or 1/2 Tbsp dried)

steps: 1. Set oven at 350 deg F/180 deg Celsius.
2. In a small pot, mix all the ingredients EXCEPT the chicken pieces. Use a whisk to mix everything well.
3. Simmer this sauce, stirring now and then, until the sauce has reduced by one quarter or more. This reduction process will thicken it slightly and intensify the flavours.

4. Watch it, as it can boil over if heat is too high. You want a brisk bubbly simmer. As the liquid evaporates, the sauce will thicken just a little. Donlt worry if some "scum" forms. It's just foam, and will disappear as the sauce boils.

5. Add the brandy after you've removed the sauce from the heat. (The alcohol will evaporate in the baking process, but it gives additional flavour, and boy, you can taste that extra flavour, especially if you use a good brandy/cognac/Armagnac).
6. Taste a little of the sauce with a teaspoon, being very careful not to burn your tongue! If too acid, stir in more honey, or a little sugar. You want a tangy taste.
7. Pack the chicken pieces, skin side up, in a large oven dish, preferably in one layer, and pour over the thickened orange sauce. Put in preheated oven, open.
8. Bake about 3/4 hour. You will need to check after 15 mins., and lay a piece of foil loosely over the chicken, to prevent burning.
9. Baste with the sauce a few times during baking. Take off the foil to let the chicken brown.
10. Note: if you use fewer chicken pieces, as I often do, you'll probably have sauce left over. Save for another purpose, or add it to the chicken when baking is nearly done.

11. To serve to guests, put in heated serving dish, and decorate with thin strips of orange zest and a scatter of very finely chopped parsley. Goes well with fluffy rice or roast potatoes, young green beans (steamed) and a large salad. Serve with an off-dry wine such as a good blanc de noir, chenin blanc or a dry rose.
title: South African Orange Chicken

steps: 1. In a small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in 1/4 cup dry white wine. Set aside.

2. In a large skillet, heat peanut oil on medium-high heat until almost smoking. Remove the skillet from heat and add green onions. Return the skillet to heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the scallions are soft.
3. Add the scallops to the skillet. Cook the scallops for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add clam juice or broth to the skillet. Continue stirring. Add salt and red pepper or hot sauce to taste. Stir in ginger and water chestnuts.
5. Stir in the mixture of dissolved cornstarch and white wine. Turn the heat to high, and cook the mixture until it boils and thickens.
title: Scallops A La Peking House

steps: 1. Slice beef into thin strips.
2. Heat margarine in large skillet.
3. Add beef and brown.
4. Add onions,garlic,celery and green pepper.
5. Saute until onions and peppers are tender but not browned.
6. Add broth,salt and pepper.
7. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until beef is tender.
8. Blend cornstarch with water and soy sauce until smooth.
9. Gradually add to mixture of beef and vegetables and simmer 3 minutes.
10. Serve hot over cooked rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into thin slices
2 cups celery, sliced on the diagonal

steps: 1. In the oil brown the meat in batches in a heavy saucepan.
2. Remove from pan and brown the onions in the drippings.
3. Return the meat to the pan.
4. Combine the "Au Jus Mix" with the water and orange juice and soy sauce. Stir well to combine.
5. Add to the meat.
6. Add the ginger. Stir well.
7. Heat to boiling; reduce heat to simmer; cover and cook for 35-40 minute Depending on the size of your meat slices. (Sample a piece to see if it is tender). Cook more if needed.
8. Combine the corn starch with the 1/4 c water,and stir into the meat mixture.
9. Stir until thickened.
10. Add the vegetables. Cover and cook 10 more minute.
11. You may stir in a can of drained Mandarin orange slices or chunks of pineapple. This makes a pretty presentation.
title: Pork Cantonese

steps: 1. Begin rice first, using instructions on package.
2. Slice sausage in 3/4" pieces or smaller pieces if Desired and place in a heated wok or a large skillet.
3. Add broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, onion, bell pepper, and garlic after the sauage becomes slightly browned.

4. Let saute for approximately 8 minutes or until the onion becomes clear Add the soy sauce, worcestershire sauce and sugar and continue to saute until the vegetables are tender and the sausage is browned.
5. Serve over rice and ENJOY!
title: Kielbasa Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Season chicken with pepper and place in bowl with lemonade, stirring to coat.
2. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Drain. Roll in cornflake crumbs, coating completely.
3. Place in melted butter in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown and tender.
4. Makes 8 servings.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cook and stir garlic in oil in wok for 1 minute.
2. Add sliced beef (1/2 at a time). Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Remove.
5. Add zucchini; stir-fry until tender.
6. Return beef to wok with tomatoes and dressing.
7. Heat through.
8. Serve over cooked spaghetti.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Italian Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless top sirloin steak, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Saute first 3 ingredients in hot oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 5 to 7 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in cooked rice and next 4 ingredients.
2. Stir in apple and apple juice; cook, stirring often, until thoroughly heated. Sprinkle with almonds, if desired.
title: Curried Beef Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in small airtight container.
2. Store in a cool, dry place.
title: Chinese 5 Spice

ingredients.text: 1 cup unsweetened flaked coconut, firmly packed

steps: 1. Pound chicken to 1/4 inch thickness.
2. In a small bowl, place egg, water, salt (optional) and pepper, stir to mix well.
3. Place coconut in shallow dish.
4. Dip chicken first in egg mixture, then in coconut, pressing to coat well.
5. Place oil and butter in nonstick frying pan. Cook chicken about 10 minutes or until brown and juices run clear.
6. Sauce:.
7. Place cornstarch in a small dish. Add orange juice and stir to mix well.
8. Place marmalade in small saucepan. Stir in orange juice mixture and cook over low heat and cook over low heat, stirring to thicken but do not boil.
9. Spoon over chicken, top with kiwi slices (optional).
title: Tropical Kiwi Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Slice pork tenderloin lengthwise, cutting to, but not through, other side. Open halves, laying pork flat. Place plastic wrap over pork; pound to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or small heavy skillet. Cut pork crosswise into 4 steaks; sprinkle with salt.
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add pork; cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until done. Transfer pork to a plate. Reduce heat to low.

3. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients in a small bowl, stirring with a whisk. Stir vinegar mixture into pan drippings; cook 1 minute. Return pork to skillet; remove from heat. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated, turning often.
4. Serve with: Sesame Bok Choy
title: Hoisin Pork Steak

ingredients.text: 1 cup red pepper, cut in strips
2 teaspoons dry roasted peanuts, unsalted, finely chopped

steps: 1. Combine chicken broth, hoisin sauce, sherry, and cornstarch in a small bowl; stir well, and set aside.
2. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add peanut oil, and place over medium-high heat until hot.
3. Add snow peas and bell pepper strips; saute' 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
4. Add broth mixture, and cook 2 minutes or until mixture is thick, stirring constantly.
5. Sprinkle with peanuts.
title: Ww Hoisin Snow Peas And Peppers - 2 Pts.

ingredients.text: 2 c. celery, cut thin in 1-inch strips

steps: 1. Cook celery, onion and ground beef until brown.
2. Drain.
3. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup of water.
4. Add soy sauce.
5. Stir until thick and clear.
6. Add cabbage, cover and cook 10 minutes or so.
7. Serve over rice or Chinese noodles.
title: Ground Beef Chow Mein

steps: 1. Slice
2. onions.
3. Cook
4. in
5. shortening
6. with
7. ground beef until meat is brown.
8. Add cut celery, bouillon cube (dissolved in 1 cup boiling
9. water) and add flavoring to meat.
10. Cover and cook 10 minutes.
11. Add remaining ingredients.
12. Serve over rice.
title: Hamburger Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 1 lb. lean pork, cut in pieces

steps: 1. Pour boiling water over bouillon cubes and soy sauce.
2. Stir until smooth; set aside.
3. Saute pork in Crisco until brown.
4. Add flour; stir and blend.
5. Add other ingredients.
6. Cook, covered, slowly.
7. Stir often.
8. Cook 30 minutes.
9. Good over rice or chow mein noodles.
title: Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 1 kg boneless chicken breast, cut in 1 1/2 inc cubes
5 celery ribs, peeled and cut in 1 inch pieces
1 1/2 teaspoons ground szechwan pepper (may be substituted by 1/2 t cayenne)

steps: 1. Toss chicken pieces with cornstarch to coat.
2. Heat oil in wok or skillet, stir-fry celery pieces over high heat for one minute and set aside.
3. Add more oil to utensil if required and quickly brown chicken pieces with garlic. Work in two batches if necessary.
4. Return celery and chicken to utensil, add rest of the ingredients, cover and simmer until chicken is cooked, approximately 3 minute.
5. Serve with boiled or fried rice and stir-fried vegetables.
title: Spicy Honey Chicken And Celery, Szechuan Style.

steps: 1. Combine butter, seasoning and lemon juice.
2. Put chicken in baking pan and brush both sides with seasoned butter.
3. Sprinkle with oregano.
4. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
title: Lemon Chicken Oregano

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon garlic, minced (I like the kind that is still wet or pasty)
1/4 cup soy sauce (I like Kikkoman best)

steps: 1. First of all, I like to season my chicken breasts with Asian 5 Spice for an hour or two before cooking them. If I don't have time to grill them, I use Tyson's precooked grilled chicken strips.
2. Grill the chicken breasts until done. Cut into strips and set aside to keep warm.

3. Mix garlic, ginger, lemon juic, oil, sugar, and soy sauce over low heart. Whisk continually until sugar disolves. Mix flour with water in a seperate bowl and set aside. When sauce warms up, add flour mixture a teaspoon at a time until sauce thickens.
4. Serve chicken over steamed rice and drizzle sauce over it. Serve while warm.
title: Grilled Mandarin Chicken

steps: 1. Dump all ingredients into large skillet except rice and eggs. Stir over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until heated through thoroughly.
2. Add scrambled eggs and cooked rice; stir just to heat through.
title: Chinese Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon until crisp.
2. Add onion and cook 2 minutes.
3. Drain off excess fat and add celery.
4. Cool.
5. Beat eggs and salt slightly.
6. Add bacon, bean sprouts, parsley, ham, scallions and bouillon and stir well.
7. Heat oil in skillet hot, but not smoking. Drop in big spoonfuls of egg mixture about 3 inches across. Shape into round cakes before egg sets.
8. Cook until lightly browned.
9. Turn and brown underside.
10. Lift onto paper towel, then serve piping hot.
title: Egg Foo Yong

ingredients.text: 1 small onion, cut into 1 inch pieces
1/2 red bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces
1/2 green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces
1 lb large shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. In a bowl, mix the orange juice, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and cornstarch.
2. In a wok or large frypan, heat the oil over high heat until smoking.
3. Add the chiles and salt; stir-fry until browned, 45 seconds.
4. Add the onion, ginger and garlic; stir-fry until fragrant, 15 seconds.
5. Add the peppers and cook until crisp-tender, 30 seconds.
6. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until nearly cooked through, about 5 minutes.
7. Stir the sauce, add to the wok and cook until thickened slightly, 30 seconds.
8. Stir in the cashews and sesame oil; serve.
title: Kung Pao Shrimp With Cashews

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons fresh ginger, minced or grated
1 lb boneless beef roast, partially frozen

steps: 1. Grate peel from one of the oranges.
2. Squeeze juice from both oranges into a bowl, add grated peel, sherry, soy sauce, and ginger.
3. Slice meat 1/8th inch thick across the grain, place in marinade.
4. Let meat marinate at least 5 minutes or cover and chill for 24 hours.
5. Remove beef from marinade before cooking and set aside.
6. Mix marinade with corn starch.
7. Heat wok or heavy frying pat to high heat, add 2 tsp.
8. oil.
9. Stir fry meat quickly, in several small batches, until lightly browned.
10. Add more oil as needed.
11. Stir fry celery, sprouts and snow peas until peas are bright green, about 1 minute.
12. Add marinade, stir until boiling, mix in meat and remove from heat and serve.
title: Citrus Beef Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, strips
1 lb fresh shrimp, peeled,deveined,cut in half lengthwise
1 lb flank steak, sliced in strips
1 (14 ounce) package firm tofu, cut in 1 inch squares
2 slices fresh ginger, smashed with a knife

steps: 1. Divide the chicken, shrimp, flank steak, spinach leaves and tofu evenly and decoratively on individual platters for each guest.
2. Bring the chicken stock, ginger and green onions to a simmer in a fondue pot.
3. Your guests spear and cook their food with fondue forks.
4. Try to keep the level of chicken stock at 6 cups by adding more to the fondue pot as needed.
5. We also provided chopsticks for eating with.
6. Suggested dipping sauces: Chinese hot mustard, sweet and sour sauce, peanut sauce and curry sauce.

7. If desired, once all the ingredients have been cooked, add 2 beaten eggs, baby spinach and 4 ounces of cooked Chinese noodles to the hot chicken stock and serve in small soup bowls for a delicious soup.
8. End the meal with fortune cookies and green tea ice cream.
title: Mongolian Fire Pot

steps: 1. Cut chicken into cubes.
2. Add egg white, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
3. Marinate for 1/2 hour.
4. Deep fry and set aside.
title: Chinese Chicken

steps: 1. Reserve 2 tablespoons of orange juice.
2. Mix with soy sauce. Set aside.
3. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil.
4. Add chicken, cashews and garlic.
5. Cook 2 minutes on hot heat.
6. Remove chicken and cashews. Heat remaining oil in the same pan.
7. Add onion and snow peas. Stir-fry 3 minutes.
8. Put chicken and cashews back in pan.
9. Stir in sauce.
10. Cook long enough to coat with sauce.
11. Add mandarin oranges. Heat through.
12. Serve over rice.
title: Orange-Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. For the sweet onion, look for Vidalia, OSO Sweet, or Walla Walla. The super-sweet varieties are more suited to this stir-fry because at the end of cooking, the onion still has a slight crunch.
2. Make the sauce:
3. In a bowl, combine the sesame oil, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
4. Cook the rice noodles:

5. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil, add the noodles, and use tongs to turn them so they are submerged. Cook for 2 minutes, or until they are tender but still have some bite (they will cook a little more once you add them to the skillet).
6. Drain, rinse with cold water, and use scissors to snip the noodles several times to break them up into shorter lengths.
7. Scramble the eggs:

8. In a small bowl whisk together the eggs. Heat the skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the peanut or canola oil. Add the eggs and scramble them for 2 minutes, or until they form large, soft curds. Transfer them from the pan to a plate or bowl.
9. Cook the vegetables:

10. Add 1 tablespoon of the remaining oil to the pan. When it is hot, add the ginger, garlic, carrots, jalapeño, onion, and salt. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes or until the vegetables start to soften.
11. Add the remaining ingredients:

12. Sprinkle the vegetable mixture with the remaining 1 tablespoon peanut or canola oil. When the oil is hot, add the ham, cabbage, scallions, red pepper, and curry powder to the pan. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
13. Add the shrimp and cook, stirring, for 3 more minutes or until the shrimp are bright pink and cooked through.
14. Add the noodles in batches:
15. Add the eggs, the sauce mixture, and half the noodles to the pan. Toss for 1 minute.
16. Add the remaining noodles and continue tossing for 1 minute more until they are thoroughly combined and the mixture is heated through.
17. Serve:
18. Taste for seasoning and add more salt or soy sauce, if you like. Sprinkle with cilantro leaves and serve.
title: Singapore Noodles with Shrimp

steps: 1. Cook rice according to package directions.
2. Fry pork in oil until coated and heated for about a minute, stirring constantly. Add rice, eggs, pepper and soy sauce;
3. fry over medium heat for 5 minutes.
4. Sprinkle green onions over top and serve.
5. Cooked ham, chicken, or shrimp may be used in place of pork.
6. Serves 5 or 6.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Use a deep, nonstick skillet, turn heat to high and preheat skillet.
2. Put in chilled rice and heat through, stirring constantly.
3. Add eggs and stir until eggs are cooked.
4. Add meat and vegetables.
5. Heat through.
6. Add soy sauce and margarine.
7. Heat still steaming and serve.
8. Serves 6.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 4 c. cold cooked rice (1 c. raw)

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Drain fat from pan.
3. Set bacon aside. Beat eggs lightly and scramble in frypan, breaking up large pieces. Remove from pan.
4. Heat oil in wok or large frypan and add cooked rice.
5. Stir-fry a few minutes, then add soy sauce, salt, eggs, green onions and bacon.
6. Heat through.
7. Freezes well.
8. Serves 4.
title: Bacon Fried Rice

steps: 1. Add all ingredients to the rice cooker bowl, stir and turn to cook. Watch the liquid level near the end of the cooking time, as you may want to add a little more water. When the rice cooker switches to 'warm', fluff with a paddle. It can sit on 'warm' if you are not ready to serve.
2. I add all the ingredients at once and let the rice cooker do its thing. If you want the vegetables to have more crunch, add them about 10 minutes after you turn the rice cooker on.
3. You could easily modify this recipe by adding steamed vegetables, or diced cooked chicken for the carnivores.

4. The number of servings depend on how many other dishes you have; for us it makes 3 servings as a side with one other dish, but if you have two other dishes I would say you could get 4 servings out of this.
title: Rice Cooker Stir Fried Rice (Chinese Style)

steps: 1. Mix all listed ingredients.
2. Chill and serve.
3. May be placed in dessert dishes or in lettuce cups.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Mandarin Orange Salad

ingredients.text: 1 medium green pepper, cut in thin diagonal slices

steps: 1. In medium skillet, mix water and vegetables.
2. Cover.
3. Steam 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring several times.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Stir in soy sauce.
6. Makes 4 servings (40 calories each).
title: Chinese-Style Vegetables

steps: 1. Cook bacon until crisp; drain.
2. Saute onion, pepper and celery in bacon drippings.
3. Remove vegetables with slotted spoon.
4. Add rice to skillet.
5. Cook until rice starts to brown.
6. Add onion, pepper and celery to rice.
7. Add bacon, crumbled; mix well.
8. Make a hole in mixture.
9. Put eggs in hole.
10. Stir with fork until eggs are cooked, then shred egg through mixture.
11. Serves 4.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In skillet, combine water, soy sauce and oil.
2. Add the zucchini and onion, stir fry for 4-5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
3. Add the rice, tomato and carrot.
4. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until heated through. sprinkle with almonds.
5. Yield:
6. 4 servings.
title: Brown Rice Veggie Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 or 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, blended with small amount of water

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or deep skillet; add chicken cubes and stir-fry until half cooked.
2. Add broccoli, mushrooms, water chestnuts and onion.
3. Stir-fry.
4. Add chicken broth, soy sauce and blended cornstarch, cooking until thickened.
5. Serve over white rice.
6. Serves 3 or 4.
title: Chicken Broccoli Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Clean and cut carrots in julienne strips.
2. Cover with water and cook only crisp-tender.
3. Drain.
4. Cook butter, sugar, orange juice, nutmeg and cinnamon 4 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Add Mandarin oranges.
6. Baste frequently until oranges are heated through.
7. Serves 12 to 16.
8. Serve hot or cold.
title: Mandarin Orange Carrots(Excellent Side Dish)

steps: 1. Cook rice in oil until brown.
2. Add salt, water, bouillon cube and soy sauce.
3. Cover and cook 20 minutes.
4. Add rest of ingredients and 1/4 cup more water, if necessary.
5. Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes more.
6. Serves 4.
title: Chinese Rice Pork

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts, boned and cut into approximately 1 x 3/4 x 3/4-inch pieces
2 Tbsp. oyster sauce (most markets carry in oriental food section)
4 c. cooked long grain rice (do not use instant rice)

steps: 1. Scramble eggs until firm; break up into small pieces. Set aside.
2. Marinate chicken pieces with 1/2 soy sauce, cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
3. Heat oil in frying pan (medium-high heat).
4. Fry chicken pieces, separating pieces at the same time, for 2 1/2 minutes or until chicken is cooked.
5. Set aside.
6. Using the same frying pan, stir-fry onion, green onion and frozen peas for 2 minutes.
7. Reduce heat to low; add cooked rice, soy sauce and oyster sauce.
8. Mix and stir; add cooked egg and chicken.
9. Mix well.
10. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Slice steak diagonally into 1/4-inch thick strips.
2. Place in bowl with garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
3. Refrigerate, covered, 20 minutes.
4. Cut broccoli flowerets.
5. Peel stem and slice 1/4-inch thick.
6. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons of oil in large saucepan.
7. Add beef and marinade.
8. Stir-fry until brown 2 to 3 minutes.
9. Remove from pan and set aside.
10. Swirl remaining oil around pan.
11. Add beef broth and onion.
12. Stir-fry for 6 to 8 minutes.
13. Add beef broth as needed to prevent sticking.
14. Stir in meat; heat through.
15. Makes 4 servings.
title: Beef And Broccoli Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat pan; add oil and fry onions until brown.
2. Add cold rice and saute.
3. Add eggs, seasoned with soy sauce and salt.
4. Saute until done.
5. If you don't like shrimp, add anything like ham, chicken, green pepper or bacon.
6. Serves 6.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cut chicken into narrow strips.
2. Melt margarine in skillet or wok (medium heat). Add chicken, pepper, onion and celery. Toss while cooking. When chicken changes color (from pink to white), add dressing and soy sauce.
3. Cook over low heat. Stir often. Cook about 30 minutes. Good over rice.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken And Veggies

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients.
2. Add mayonnaise to chicken mixture, adding just enough to moisten.
3. Cover and chill.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Cashew Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Arrange all ingredients for easy access.
2. Whisk eggs together in a small bowl.
3. Preheat wok or skillet on medium to medium-high heat.
4. Add peanut oil and heat 1 minute.
5. Then add eggs and let cook for 1 minute, without stirring, or until top is moist and bottom is cooked.
6. Add rice and toss with eggs, coating rice with moist egg while chopping in cooked egg.
7. Stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add scallions, carrots and ham.
8. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes more.
9. Add peas and soy sauce; toss until heated through.
10. Serves 4.
title: Best Ever Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, bring 1 1/4 c water to a boil.
2. Stir in rice and remove from heat.
3. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Meanwhile using a 10 in skillet, cook egg (slightly beaten) in 3 Tbsp, butter.
4. Add 1/3 c chopped onion and the rice.
5. Saute, stirring over medium heat until mixture slightly browned.
6. Mix 1/4 c water with 2 to 3 Tbsp soy sauce and stir into the rice.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chinese Style Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a large, heavy skillet, heat enough oil to cover bottom of skillet, one or two tablespoons of sesame oil will enhance the flavor.
2. Add green onions, celery, green pepper and chicken.
3. Stir well and saute for about 1 minute.
4. Add rice, stirring quickly so it won't stick.
5. Add soy sauce; mix well.
6. Push mixture to one side and drain oil to empty side.
7. Scramble eggs in open area. When set, stir into rice mixture.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Additional soy sauce may be sprinkled on top of individual servings.
10. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut bite-size

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium high heat.
2. Add chicken.
3. Cook and stir until lightly browned.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Cook and stir until heated through.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chinese New Year Rice

steps: 1. Saute rice in a little peanut oil for a few minutes.
2. Add rice to water and cook as on package.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in pan over medium heat and add eggs.
4. Stir quickly with fork until thoroughly cooked.
5. Transfer to small bowl and chop into small pieces.
6. Over medium heat (can use same pan, just wipe), add onions and ham. Stir quickly 2 to 3 minutes until golden or your preference.
7. Add rice and soy sauce.
8. Blend quickly.
9. Add eggs.
10. Toss and serve. Serves 6.
title: China Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cut celery and pepper into thin diagonal slices, each measuring about 1 cup.
2. Chop onion (3/4 cup) and shred cabbage. Heat oil in skillet; stir in vegetables.
3. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender.
4. Sprinkle with salt
5. and pepper.	Makes 4 servings.
title: Chinese-Style Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add chicken; cook and stir until lightly browned.
3. Add remaining ingredients; cook and stir until heated through.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chinese New Year Rice

steps: 1. Cook scallions in margarine with eggs.
2. After eggs are firm, add rice and soy sauce.
3. Cook until hot.
4. Can add cooked chicken, pork or beef.
5. Serves 4.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb. medium Russet potatoes, cut into julienne strips

steps: 1. Soak potatoes in cold water 15 minutes; drain and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Arrange potatoes in a single layer in a large shallow pan coated with cooking spray.
3. Bake at 450° for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
4. Combine potatoes, bell pepper and green onions in a medium bowl.
5. Combine vinegar and hoisin sauce in a small bowl.
6. Pour over potato mixture, tossing gently. Sprinkle with sesame seed and serve immediately.
7. Yield:
8. 4 servings.
title: Hot Shoestring Potato Salad

steps: 1. Wash broccoli, discarding leaves and toughest part of stem. Blanch entire head in boiling water for 1 minute.
2. Rinse under cold water.
3. Break off florets and cut remaining stems (peeled if desired) into 2 inch pieces.
4. Preheat oven to 450°.
5. Spread broccoli pieces in one layer on a greased baking sheet.
6. Roast at 450° for 5 minutes, turn broccoli pieces over and continue roasting until broccoli begins to brown, about 5 minutes more.
7. Whisk together soy sauce, vinegar and oils.
8. Stir in 3 tablespoons sesame seed.
9. When broccoli is done, transfer to a bowl and pour dressing over it, stirring gently to coat.
10. Sprinkle with remaining tablespoon sesame seed.
11. Serve warm or at room temperature.
12. Yield: 8 servings.
13. Carbohydrate 2 g, protein 2 g, fat 9 g, calories 94.
title: Broccoli Salad

steps: 1. Core and dice tomatoes.
2. Peel and halve cucumber lengthwise. Scoop out seeds using a spoon and slice.
3. Mix sesame oil, soy sauce, red pepper and sugar.
4. Add cucumber, tomatoes and onions; toss gently.
5. Sprinkle with sesame seed.
6. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Oriental Tomato-Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
2. In a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, heat oil. Brown chicken on both sides. Set chicken aside.
3. In same pot, saute scallions and garlic. Add rice and saute for 1 minute. Add hoisin and stir, then add red wine, stirring occasionally until liquid is reduced by three quarters, about 2 minutes.
4. Add stock, cranberries, and reserved chicken to pot and bring to a simmer; cover and transfer to oven for 30 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Ming Tsai'S Cranberry Hoisin Chicken Rice

steps: 1. 1. Cut up vegetables to the same-sized pieces, preferably bite-sized (nothing is more annoying than having an enormous piece of broccoli that you have to cut up on your plate). Suggestions: broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, mushrooms, pea pods. Tip: many grocery stores carry pre-cut up vegetable mixes that you can use.
2. 2. Heat pan until pan is VERY HOT-drops of water will 'dance' when sprinkled on the pan.
3. 3. Add peanut oil and swirl to coat the pan.
4. 4. Stir fry the veggies until desired softness (about 5-8 minutes). If some vegetables take longer to fry (e.g. carrots), start with them first and then add the others.
5. 5. Stir in teriyaki sauce and sesame oil.
6. Enjoy!
title: Chinese-Style Stir Fried Vegetables

ingredients.text: 6 ounces small shrimp, uncooked, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch and water. Mix with 1st four ingredients and marinate shrimp for 15 minutes.
2. Beat the eggs lightly with chopsticks and add a dash of salt and pepper.
3. Heat wok and add 1 tbsp oil. Pour 1/2 egg mixture into wok and cook over medium heat, turning once. Cook the other half the same way. Cut the egg into small strips and set aside.
4. Add 2 tbsp oil to wok and stir-fry the onion and shrimp on hight heat for a few moments. Remove and set aside.
5. Repeat for ham and green peas.
6. Add 2 tbsp oil, turn down heat to medium and stir-fry rice. Add a bit of oyster sauce and soy sauce, if desired.
7. Combine all the ingredients and stir-fry to blend.
8. Enjoy!
title: World'S Best Shrimp Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in a wok or skillet.
2. Add green beans, ginger and garlic.
3. Stir-fry for 2 minutes at high heat.
4. Add soy sauce and water and cook, covered, for 3 to 5 minutes, until beans are done.
title: Stir-Fry Green Beans

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Stir with a fork, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 10 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat. Remove and discard vanilla bean, and fluff rice with a fork; set aside.
2. Place sesame oil and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and onion, and saute 2 to 3 minutes or until tender, stirring often. Add pineapple; cook 3 more minutes.
3. Stir in rice. Add soy sauce, and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Fold in remaining ingredients.
title: Pineapple Fried Rice

steps: 1. Drain liquid out of tofu. You can do this by placing tofu block on a large plate and covering with a cutting board or another plate. Then put something heavy (like a full teapot) on top and let drain for at least 30 minutes.
2. Discard the liquid and cut tofu into 1/2 inch cubes. Sprinkle cornstarch on tofu and lightly cover on all sides.
3. In a medium pot, heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil over medium heat. Add rice and stir to coat. Add water, bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat and cook until fluffy.
4. Meanwhile, in a medium sized bowl, combine ginger, garlic, soy sauce, water, and brown sugar. Mix until all sugar is dissolved. Set aside.
5. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add tofu and cook until browned (about 5 minutes), then flip and brown on opposite side (an additional 5 minutes).
6. Add soy sauce mixture to pan, bring to a boil, and reduce heat. Stir to make sure tofu is covered. Once liquid starts to thicken, add in green beans and cook for 3-4 minutes.
7. Serve tofu and green beans over rice. Top with scallions and sesame seeds.
title: Mongolian Tofu And Green Beans With Rice

steps: 1. You can use any rice you like, I perfer jasmine rice. Either way, prepare 2 cups of uncooked rice ahead of time so the rice is cool/warm. Slice bacon into quarter inch pieces. Use liberal amount of pepper (course ground is best). Fry until al dente to crispy. Remove bacon and drain oil leaving enough to coat the pan to cook the eggs. Scramble the eggs, then again be liberal with the pepper (fine grind or table for the eggs) and cook in the pan, breaking up the eggs so the are now in small pieces/flakes. Add chopped green onions and cook until the onions have begun to wilt. Add back the bacon and mix thoroughly. Add rice and add soy sauce (again liberal but to taste) and mix thoroughly.
title: Bacon Fried Rice

steps: 1. Rinse chicken and place in a large cooking pot 3/4 full of water.
2. Cut onions to desired size.
3. Place in water with chicken. Add salt and pepper.
4. Bring to a boil, then simmer on medium for 1 1/2 hours.
5. Remove chicken and let cool to touch.
6. Strip meat and place back in soup.
7. Let simmer on low.
title: Chicken Soup With Dumplings

steps: 1. In a nonstick skillet, saute the cabbage, tomatoes, celery, onion and green pepper in margarine until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Season with salt and dill.
title: Tomato Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 6 cups fresh spinach, stems removed (about 8 oz)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook 1 minutes. Add spinach, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar; stir fry 2 minutes until spinach begins to wilt.
2. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.
title: Spinach Stir Fry With Garlic

steps: 1. Cut pork in julienne strips and cook with ham in 2 tablespoons oil until brown.
2. Add onion, green pepper, parsley and garlic. Cook until tender.
3. Add remaining oil, salt, pepper, ginger and rice.
4. Stir lightly to mix.
5. Make a well in center of rice mixture, add eggs and cook until semi-solid.
6. Then stir into rice mixture while cooking over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a medium pot, fry the onions and the garlic in the oil till golden brown.
2. Add the grated carrot and fry for about 3 minutes.
3. Add the chilli powder, turmeric, salt, and egg and stir for another minute.
4. Stir in the rice.
5. Stir the mixture 2-3 minutes until the rice is properly mixed with the rest of the ingredients.
6. Pour 3 cups of water and stir well.
7. Let it cook uncovered until the water boils.
8. Lower the heat and cover the pot.
9. Let it cook till all the water dissapears from the bottom of pan.
10. (till you think the rice is cooked, usually it takes about 15 minutes).
11. Serve hot with your favorite curry or as a side dish.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked rice (firm but not mushy)

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Chop.
3. Beat eggs with a little salt and fry.
4. Take out and chop the eggs.
5. Fry finely chopped onion with chicken bouillon cube.
6. When clear, add rice, finely chopped celery, bell pepper, egg, bacon and shrimp.
7. Season with soy sauce.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine cornstarch, garlic powder and lemon peel. Stir in broth and lemon juice until smooth; set aside. In a 3-cup microwave-safe dish, cook pepper and zucchini in butter until crisp-tender. Stir in broth mixture and rice. Cover; microwave on high for 4 minutes. Stir in chicken. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes; fluff rice. Cook 30-45 seconds, until heated through.
title: Easy Lemon Chicken And Rice

ingredients.text: 1/4 pound uncooked small shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 slices pepper Jack cheese (3/4 ounce each)

steps: 1. In a small skillet, saute the shrimp, onion and peppers in 1 tablespoon butter until shrimp turn pink; remove and keep warm.

2. In a small bowl, whisk the egg. In the same skillet, heat 1 tablespoon butter until hot. Add egg; cook and stir over medium heat until egg is completely set. Stir in the rice, soy sauce and shrimp mixture.

3. Spread remaining butter over one side of each tortilla. Place tortillas butter side down, on a griddle. Place a slice of cheese on each tortilla. Sprinkle shrimp mixture over half of each tortilla. Fold over and cook over low heat until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes on each side. Cut into wedges.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice Quesadillas

ingredients.text: 6 medium baking potatoes, cut into 2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Pat insides and outsides of chickens dry, discarding excess fat.
2. Using a two-tined fork, pierce the lemons at 1/4-inch intervals.
3. Place a lemon in the cavity of each chicken and close the cavity with metal skewers.
title: Whole Roast Lemon Chicken With Vegetables

steps: 1. Wash asparagus well.
2. Break off bottoms and cut spears diagonally into 1 1/2 inch pieces.
3. In large frying pan, heat oil and butter over medium heat.
4. Add asparagus, garlic and ginger.
5. Stir fry one minute.
6. Add sugar, cover and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add mushrooms and stir fry for 2 minutes.
8. Remove from heat and stir in soya sauce and sesame oil.
9. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.
title: Asparagus & Mushroom Stir Fry

steps: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat. Stir in the grapes and chicken; cook and stir until the chicken is hot, and the grapes are tender, about 3 minutes. Add the rice and chicken broth; continue cooking until the rice is hot, about 2 minutes more.
title: Grapes And Rice Stir Fry

steps: 1. put cabbage and scallion in a bowl.
2. heat remaining ingredients to boil and lower heat, cook until sugar is dissolved.
3. pour over cabbage, toss to combine.
title: Hot And Sour Cabbage Salad

ingredients.text: 2 c. diced cooked meat (use ham, chicken, pork, shrimp, steak, whatever)

steps: 1. Place eggs, pepper and soy sauce in small bowl.
2. Stir slightly and set aside.
3. Heat wok or pan hot and dry.
4. Add oil.
5. Brown garlic and ginger slightly, then add rice.
6. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring to break up lumps.
7. Add meat and vegetables.
8. Fry and stir constantly until thoroughly heated.
9. Add the egg mixture while stirring rice so it will cover as much as possible.
10. Stir constantly while cooking until egg mixture begins to firm, about 2 minutes.
11. Serve hot.
title: Fried Rice And Ham

ingredients.text: 1 cup carrot, sliced in 1/4 inch pieces
1/2 cup celery, cut in 1/4 inch pieces

steps: 1. Mix cornstarch, soy sauce, and oil( i didnt add oil ) together; add pork and mix.
2. Bring the chicken stock to a boil; add carrot, celery, and mushrooms.
3. Bring to a boil; cover; simmer 20 minutes.
4. Add pork mixture and cook covered another 10 minutes.
5. Break in unbeaten egg; ( i made it egg drop by beating egg swirling soup fast and pouring egg over tongs of fork and then stirring ) cook for 3 minutes.
title: Chop Suey Tong, Chop Suey Soup With Egg

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut in thin strips
2 tablespoons cornstarch, dissolved in the water

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large, nonstick skillet or wok.
2. Add the chicken and cook, stirring, for 4 minutes, then remove from the pan.
3. Add the broccoli, celery, carrots and red pepper, and cook, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the vegetables are softened.
4. Stir together the cornstarch slurry, chicken broth, soy sauce, jelly and red pepper flakes.
5. Add it to the pan and stir.
6. Return the chicken to the skillet and cook the mixture until the sauce is thickened and glossy, about 3 minutes.
7. Taste and correct the seasoning with salt and additional red pepper flakes, if desired.
8. Divide among four plates and top each with 1 tablespoon of the scallions.
title: American Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless pork, cut in bite size pieces
1/2 green pepper, cut in thin strips

steps: 1. Combine the first 7 ingredients and set aside.
2. Stir-fry pork in 1 tablespoon oil, browning all sides. Remove pork and add remaining tablespoon of oil.
3. Add the next 5 ingredients and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
4. Add pork and cook all ingredients 2 more minutes.
5. Slowly add the set-aside mixture, stirring until sauce thickens and boils.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Stir-Fry Pork And Veggies

steps: 1. Shred cabbage, carrot and radishes (I use a mixer for this).
2. Mix the vinegar and the sugar and pour over vegetables. Mix well.
3. Slice the onions thinly.
4. Heat the oil in a pan or wok, on high heat.
5. Add the onions. Saute for 2 minutes, while stirring.
6. Add the vegetables. Stir fry for 5-7 minutes, until hot but not soggy.
7. Add the soy sauce, and mix well.
8. Remove from heat and serve immediately.
9. Note: those who like it hot can add sliced hot pepper.
10. Note 2: If you have leftover non-creamy coleslaw, saute the onions, add the coleslaw, cook for 5-7 minutes, add soy sauce and serve.
title: Chinese Cabbage Stir Fry

steps: 1. Place the ground pork, soy sauce, cilantro and water chestnuts in a bowl and mix until well combined.

2. Working with 1 wonton wrapper at a time, spoon a teaspoon of the filling into the center of wrapper. Brush the edges with water then fold in half diagonally to enclose the filling and form triangles. Moisten the opposite corners of wonton triangles with water then join together by pressing firmly.

3. Cook about 6 wontons at a time in a large pan of boiling water for about 4-5 mins or until cooked through. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the wontons from the pan to individual serving bowls. Repeat with the remaining wontons.
4. Meanwhile, bring the chicken stock to a simmer in a medium saucepan. Pour the hot chicken stock over the wontons. Serve garnished with green onions, if desired.
title: Wonton Soup

steps: 1. In a medium skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
2. Drain and crumble.
3. Set aside.
4. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings. To drippings in skillet, add green peppers and onion; saute 3 minutes.
5. Add rice and stir-fry until golden brown about 5 minutes.
6. Stir in Worcestershire sauce, salt, and reserved bacon. Heat until hot.
title: Our Best Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 whole chicken breasts, skinned and cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Combine 3/4 cup water, 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 2 tablespoons soy sauce; set aside.
2. Combine remaining cornstarch and soy sauce; stir it into chicken pieces until well-coated.
title: Chicken Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 cups rice (cooked, and a day old)

steps: 1. Chop vegetables and prepare the shrimp.
2. Heat oil in a wok or a large fring pan over high heat.
3. Add garlic, onion, and peas in the pan and saute.
4. Add green pepper and chicken in the pan and saute.
5. Add rice in the pan and mix with the ingredients.
6. Sprinkle salt, chicken bouillon, and curry powder over the fried rice and stir quickly.
7. Turn the heat down to low, and add Worceter sauce.
8. Stir quickly and stop the heat.
title: Chicken Curried Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Pour eggs into skillet. As eggs set, lift edges, letting uncooked portion flow underneath. When eggs are completely cooked, remove to a plate; set aside.

2. In the same skillet, cook turkey and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Stir the rice, bean sprouts and cilantro. In a small bowl, whisk the remaining ingredients until blended; stir into skillet. Chop egg into small pieces; stir into skillet and heat through.
title: Peanut Turkey Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 head cabbage, cored and cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Heat canola oil in large frying pan or wok over medium heat.
2. Add beef, salt, pepper, and coriander; cook until beef is no longer pink. Remove from pan and allow fat and oil to drain retaining some fat and oil in the pan.
3. Add cabbage, carrots, and sesame oil to same pan. Stir-fry for approximately 2 minutes, when cabbage begins to soften.
4. Meanwhile, combine soy sauce and corn starch in measuring cup.
5. Pour soy sauce mixture into pan once cabbage is adequately cooked; Stir until thickened and remove from heat.
6. Depending on your serving style, either mix the beef back into the cabbage mixture before plating, or place the beef on top of cabbage mixture once it is plated.
title: Beef And Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 4 cups cold cooked rice (= 2 1/2 Cups uncooked instant rice)

steps: 1. Beat eggs with 1/4 tsp salt.
2. Heat 2 Tbls peanut oil in large skillet over medium heat 1 minute.
3. Pour in beaten eggs.
4. Stir continuously until eggs are cooked dry and separated into small pieces.
5. Remove eggs and set aside.
6. Heat 3 Tbls peanut oil over medium heat 1 minute.
7. Add green onions and rice.
8. Stir-fry 5 minutes.
9. Add chicken broth, remaining salt and soy sauce.
10. Stir to mix well.
11. Stir in cooked eggs, pepper and sesame oil and cooked pork (if desired).
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Shell the shrimp and cut them crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces. Mix shrimp with cornstarch and salt in bowl.
2. Heat wok on high. Add oil.
3. Cook shrimp 10 seconds.
4. Turn heat to medium and stir briskly.
5. Pour in dish.
6. Clean pan.
7. Add oil.
8. Pour in eggs.
9. When fluffy, scoop in dish.
10. Clean pan.
11. Set pan on medium.
12. Add cooked rice; toss 1 minute.
13. Sprinkle salt and add scallions, eggs and shrimp last.
14. Pour in hot serving dish.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
3 c. green cabbage, cut into 1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. Cut chicken breast halves into strips.

2. Heat oil in frypan. Add chicken strips; stir-fry over moderately high heat, turning pieces constantly, until lightly browned, about 2 or 3 minutes. Add cabbage; stir-fry 2 minutes, until cabbage is tender-crisp. Mix cornstarch and seasonings; add to water and soy sauce, mixing until smooth.
3. Stir into chicken mixture.
4. Cook until thickened and pieces are coated, about 1 minute.
5. Serve over vermicelli, pasta or rice.
title: Chicken-Cabbage Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or pan.
2. Add egg and scramble.
3. Add rice and saute until rice clumps are loosened.
4. Add salt to taste.
5. Saute in green onion and sesame oil for fragrance.
6. Serve immediately.
title: Easy Chinese Egg Fried Rice

steps: 1. Saute carrots, green peppers, onions and celery in oil until tender.
2. Stir in meat, cooking until tender.
3. Add eggs to vegetables and meat mixture, then combine with rice.
4. Add garlic powder, salt, pepper and soy sauce to taste.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 c. raw shrimp, shelled, deveined and diced

steps: 1. Set ingredients (prepared and measured) by stove in order listed.
2. Set skillet over high heat for 30 seconds.
3. Swirl in half of the oil.
4. Add onions; brown lightly.
5. Add shrimp; stir-fry 3 minutes.
6. Salt.
7. Add eggs; scramble until cooked.
8. Remove from pan.
9. Swirl remaining oil in pan, then add chicken.
10. Stir-fry 2 minutes.
11. Add rice, soy sauce and pepper.
12. Stir and toss until all is heated.
13. Add eggs and stir.
14. Add lettuce last, just before serving and serve with soy sauce.
title: Three Flavors Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and stir-fry the carrots for 1 minute. Add the pepper and cauliflower and cook for 1 minute longer. Add the mushrooms and cook for another minute.

2. Salt the mixture and stir-fry for another minute. Combine the sugar, soy sauce and water and pour into the pan. Mix well and let cook for a minute. Add the cashews and mix well. Cook until the liquid begins to form a slightly thickened glaze, about another minute. Serve with rice.
title: Mushroom Cauliflower And Cashew Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. In nonstick 12-inch skillet, toast sesame seeds over medium-high heat until fragrant and golden, about 4 minutes. Transfer to small bowl.

2. To same skillet, add olive oil and heat until hot. Add asparagus, garlic, and soy sauce, and cook, stirring, until asparagus is tender-crisp, 6 to 8 minutes. Toss with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.
title: Sesame-Asparagus Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet.
2. Stir-fry meat.
3. Add vegetables and stir-fry.
4. Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce and water together, then add to meat and vegetables.
5. Cook for 1 minute.
title: Oriental Beef And Broccoli

ingredients.text: 1 lb bacon, chopped into small pieces
3 cups rice, cooked and cooled (great way to use up leftover steamed rice)
1/2 cup small cooked shrimp (you can use the canned shrimp)

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove bacon and pour off half the bacon fat, reserve a little (1 tsp or so) to add to pan after cooking your egg. Sometimes the egg will absorb every bit of bacon fat and sometimes it leaves behind enough to coat the rice.
2. Fry garlic in bacon fat until golden, remove and discard. Fry onion in the same bacon fat. Remove onion from pan and add to bacon.
3. Spread eggs on bottom of pan as if preparing an omelet. Fold over. Remove to cutting board or plate. Cut into strips.
4. Add reserved bacon fat (if pan is dry) and cold rice to pan, stir until all grains are coated with grease and grains are no longer sticking together.
5. Add bacon, onion and ham; mix well. Always scraping bottom of pan to prevent sticking.
6. Turn heat to low and add sliced egg pieces. Add cooked shrimp. Heat 1-2 minutes, just until shrimp is warmed.
7. Remove from heat and serve.
title: Guam Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 cups cubed cooked turkey or chicken

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine the turkey, celery, peas and onions. In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, lemon juice, soy sauce, garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Add to turkey mixture and stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
2. Just before serving, stir in chow mein noodles and almonds.
title: Chow Mein Turkey Salad

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 None lemons, 2 chopped, 1/2 zested and juiced
1/4 lb spring onions, trimmed and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Mix the lemon zest, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp olive oil together and season. Spread over the chicken. Fill the chicken with the chopped lemon then place in a roasting pan. Mix the thyme, potatoes, 3 tbsp olive oil and the olives together and season. Spread around the chicken then bake for 1 hour 20-30 mins, until cooked through.

2. Meanwhile, place the red lentils and cold vegetable stock in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 5-6 mins over low heat. Remove from the heat and leave to sit for 2-3 mins. Mix 3 tbsp water, the vinegar and 2 tbsp olive oil into the lentils and season.
3. To serve, mix the lettuce, spring onions and tomatoes together in a serving bowl. Add the dressed lentils on top. Remove the chicken from the oven and serve.
title: Mediterranean Lemon Chicken With Lentil Salad

steps: 1. Cook rice according to package directions. In a large skillet melt butter.
2. Add onions, carrots and scallions. Saute until carrots are translucent.
3. Set aside. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Place sesame seeds in a shallow pan.
4. Bake until golden brown (10 to 15 minutes), shaking pan occasionally for.
5. even color. Lightly grease another skillet. Beat eggs. Pour into hot.
6. skillet. Cook as you would scrambled eggs. Combine rice, vegetables,.
7. sesame seeds and eggs. Add soy sauce. Stir. Salt and pepper to taste.
8. YOU CAN ADD cook CHICKEN-PORK-OR BEEF.
9. 1-Cup to recipe.
title: Fried Chinese Rice

ingredients.text: 1 (1-pound) pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into strips
1 tablespoon Sriracha (hot chile sauce, such as Huy Fong)
12 cups coarsely chopped green cabbage (about 2 pounds)

steps: 1. Combine pork, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, white pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl; set aside.
2. Combine remaining 2 teaspoons cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl; set aside.
3. Combine ketchup and next 3 ingredients (through soy sauce) in a small bowl; set aside.

4. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add pork mixture and garlic; saute 2 minutes. Remove pork from pan; set aside. Add cabbage; saute 2 minutes. Add ketchup mixture; saute 2 minutes. Stir in pork; saute 1 minute. Stir in cornstarch mixture; cook 30 seconds or until thick. Remove from heat; stir in onions.
title: Hot And Sour Pork With Cabbage

ingredients.text: 3 cups of grated raw cauliflower (use a cheese grater or food processor)

steps: 1. In a large pan, saute garlic and onions in olive oil on a medium/high heat, until onions become soft and transparent. (about 2-3 minutes).
2. Next add in peas, and carrots and cook until carrots begin to soften and peas are heated through, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Next stir in scrambled eggs , cauliflower and soy sauce. Cook stirring frequently for about 5-7 more minutes.
4. Enjoy adding in your favorite protein and veg. Possible add-ins: baby corn, broccoli, cabbage, bok choy, water chestnuts, chicken, tofu, and shrimp!
title: Simple Cauliflower Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients (except flour); blend thoroughly. Shape into small balls the size of a large marble.
2. Roll in flour, drop into your simmering soup and simmer for 20 minutes.

3. Notes: This is admittedly done on a small scale, but easily doubled. The yield will depend on how faithful you are to size. I like to use 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce to add smoky flavor + darker color to the meat mixture, but you can also add 1-2 tbsp of Pepperidge Farm dressing mix to enhance the flavor & stretch the yield. It's a tiny recipe w/lots of versatility!
title: Swedish Meat Dumplings For Soup

steps: 1. In a large saucepan bring broth to a boil over medium heat.
2. Whisk cornstarch and 1/4 cup water in a small cup until smooth; and then whisk mixture into broth. Simmer until soup thickens (2-5 minutes). Reduce heat.
3. Drizzle eggs into soup while stirring quickly and cook for one mintute and then stir in vinegar.
4. Heat peas according to package directions and then divide into 4 bowls. Ladle soup over the peas.
title: Chinese Egg Flower Soup (Ww)

steps: 1. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a skillet; cook the eggs in the hot oil until set, 3 to 5 minutes. Cool and slice into thin ribbons; set aside.

2. Heat 2 more teaspoons oil in a large skillet; fry the garlic in the oil, mashing it while frying until light brown and almost crispy, about 5 minutes. Add the rice and mix thoroughly until it is well blended with the garlic. Add the soy sauce and mix again; cook for 2 minutes. Stir the ham into the mixture; cook and stir another 5 minutes. Fold the sliced egg into the mixture and cook until hot, about 3 minutes.
title: Fried Rice (Sinangag)

steps: 1. In large wok or skillet, heat oil.
2. Add garlic and ginger. Stir-fry 15 seconds.
3. Add broccoli and carrots, tossing to mix well.
4. Add broth and cover pan.
5. Cook for 3 minutes over medium heat.
6. Remove cover; turn heat to high and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
7. When veggies are cooked, stir in soy sauce. Remove from heat and sprinkle with sesame seed.
title: Carrot And Broccoli Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Boil 1 cup of
2. water; add rice and set aside.
3. Brown mushrooms; add butter, onions and egg (scramble all).
4. Add rice to mixture and brown.
5. Add 1/3 cup water and soy sauce.
6. Heat 5 minutes.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and celery. Cook until softened. Add cold rice and soy sauce. Heat, stirring until hot.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Prepare rice as directed, preferably 1 hour before preparation of rest of dish.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 6 c. cooked rice (long grain or converted works best), chill thoroughly

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or skillet.
2. Saute chilled rice until golden (5 to 10 minutes in hot skillet).
3. Stir in onions, bacon, sesame seed, soy sauce, peas, carrots and sugar.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Brown together sausage
2. and onion, then add rice.
3. Pour enough water over this to cover.
4. Simmer until rice is cooked. You may have to add
5. more
6. water
7. until
8. rice
9. is
10. cooked, but simmer down until all liquid is gone.
11. Put this over chow-mein noodles, sprinkle with soy sauce.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Brown ground beef, onion, celery and bell pepper.
2. Drain and add soy sauce.
3. Add cooked rice; mix well.
4. Turn heat to low. Place lid on skillet and steam for 10 minutes.
5. Add more soy sauce when served, if needed.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Make dressing: Combine vinegar, oil, orange juice, mustard, orange peel, lemon juice, sugar, and salt.
2. Drain mandarin oranges.
3. Slice onions into very thin slices.
4. Combine mandarin oranges, sliced avocados and onion rings.
5. Cover orange/avocado/onion mixture with dressing and refrigerate.
6. Immediately before serving, break up lettuce and spoon orange/avocado mixture over lettuce.
title: Avocado And Mandarin Orange Salad

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon oil (flavoured infused oil works very well)
1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (corn kernels and peas will do)

steps: 1. Turn Rice Cooker onto cook.
2. Add oil, bacon, onion and garlic to Rice Cooker.
3. Stir frequently until onion is soft.
4. Add rice to Rice Cooker and coat in oil.
5. Add frozen vegetable and beef stock and mix well.
6. Place lid on Rice Cooker and let it do its thing.
7. When finished mix in Soy Sauce and stir.
8. Serve.
title: Rice Cooker Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat vegetable oil and sesame oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add cooked rice and stir until rice is coated and heated through.
3. Stir in soy sauce, then eggs and green onions.
4. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
title: Fried Rice In A Flash

steps: 1. Bring 1 cup of the water to a boil in saucepan.
2. Stir in rice. Remove from heat; cover.
3. Let stand 5 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, cook egg in margarine in a 10-inch skillet until set.
5. Ad onion and the rice and cook and stir over medium heat until rice and onion are lightly browned.
6. Combine remaining water and soy sauce.
7. Stir into rice.
8. Makes 3 cups or 4 servings.
title: Chinese Style Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook the chicken and shred or cut into cubes.
2. Get the chicken broth boiling and add in cubed potatoes. Cover and let boil for 10 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, dice the onion and saute in the oil for about 5 minutes. Mince the garlic and add. Wash and slice the kale into bite size pieces and add, sauteing for another 2 minutes.
4. Add lemon juice and rosemary to the chicken broth. Stir for a minute, then add the onion, garlic, and kale.
5. Finally, add the cooked and shredded chicken. Serve hot with some yummy bread!
title: Magic Lemon Chicken Soup

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, saute garlic in sesame oil for 1 minute. Add mushrooms. Cook until moisture is out.
2. Add broccoli and water chestnuts.
3. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes. Add noodles, soy sauce and green onion.
4. Toss together well. Steam for 2 more minutes, then serve.
title: Broccoli, Mushroom, Water Chestnut Stir-Fry

steps: 1. In a hot pan, stir fry chicken in a small amount of olive oil. Add 1 Tbs soy sauce while cooking. Remove from pan.
2. Stir fry celery and onions in a small amount of olive oil. When done, add mushrooms and stir fry 1 minute.
3. Add chicken back into vegetables and mix well. Add in rice and additional soy sauce to taste.

4. In a small bowl, beat egg. Make an open space in your pan and pour the egg on it. Quickly scramble the egg and then mix into the rice mixture. Season with salt, pepper and/or more soy sauce to taste.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook rice omitting salt; set aside. Cook bacon and ham in vegetable oil until bacon is crisp. Add mushrooms and stir-fry over medium heat for 2 minutes. Stir in rice, onions and soy sauce. Stir-fry at medium heat for 3 minutes. Serve immediately.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
3 1/2 cups cooked, chilled long-grain brown rice

steps: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to pan, swirling to coat. Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon salt over chicken. Add chicken to pan, and saute for 3 minutes or until browned, stirring occasionally. Remove the chicken from pan. Add leek, black pepper, and remaining 5/8 teaspoon salt to pan; saute for 4 minutes or until leek is tender and golden. Add leek mixture to chicken.

2. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil to pan, swirling to coat. Add rice, stirring well to coat rice with oil; cook, without stirring, 2 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Stir rice mixture; cook, without stirring, 2 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Stir in chicken mixture, cranberries, and sage. Add wine; cook for 2 minutes or until mixture is dry, stirring constantly.
3. Total time is 4 hr. 26 min. if you don't have leftover chilled rice.
title: Chicken Fried Rice With Leeks And Dried Cranberries

ingredients.text: 3/4 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the chicken, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and garlic; set aside. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry broccoli and green onions in 1 tablespoon oil for 5 minutes. Add carrots; stir-fry 4 minutes longer or until crisp-tender. Remove and set aside.
2. In the same skillet, stir-fry chicken in remaining oil until no longer pink and juices run clear. Add the rice, pepper, vegetables and remaining soy sauce. Stir-fry until heated through.
title: Chicken Carrot Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb green beans, tipped and tailed
2 scallions, trimmed and cut into 2-inch lengths

steps: 1. Finely chop garlic, ginger and scallions together. Place in 14" x 11" x 2" dish, cover with vegetable oil. Cook on high for 3 minutes.
2. Removed dish from microwave oven, stir in soy sauce and rice wine vinegar.
3. Add green beans, stirring to distribute sauce.
4. Cook, uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring 3-4 times during cooking.
5. Serve hot or cold. Can be made ahead and reheated for serving.
title: Easy Microwave Szechuan Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1 medium onion, fried in 2 Tbsp. oil

steps: 1. Cook rice until tender in salted water.
2. Mix all ingredients. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
3. Add 1/2 cup diced Cheddar cheese.
4. Pour into flat bakeware.
5. Top with cooking cheese.
6. Brown cheese in hot oven.
7. Serve.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain.
2. Add oil to a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat. Add onion to pan and cook for 3-5 minutes or until onion is translucent.
3. Add cabbage to pan and stir-fry for 10 minutes or until cabbage is softened and beginning to brown. Add salt and pepper.
4. Add cooked pasta to pan and toss with cabbage mixture; saute 3 more minutes.
title: Pasta Cabbage Stir-Fry , Low Cal, Low Fat

ingredients.text: 1 chicken, cut up and skin removed

steps: 1. In large pan, put chicken, orange juice, onion and seasonings; cover.
2. Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
3. Simmer for 30 minutes.
4. Add rice; cook for 20 minutes or until rice is done.
title: Bertha'S Orange Chicken With Rice

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken in oil for 7 minutes or until juices run clear; remove and set aside. In the same skillet, stir-fry onion until tender. Add broccoli, green pepper and garlic; stir-fry until tender. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients until smooth; pour over vegetable mixture. Add chicken; bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 1 minute or until sauce is thickened and bubbly.
title: Broccoli Pepper And Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Divide cauliflower into florets, wash, blanch briefly in boiling water, and drain.
2. Wash bell pepper, remove stem and seeds, and cut into thin slivers.
3. Over highest heat, heat the empty wok, then add oil and swirl to heat. Add cauliflower and stir-fry briefly. Add bell pepper, sugar, salt, and MSG, tossing after each addition.
4. Transfer to serving platter, and serve as part of a Chinese meal: rice, soup, and a balanced variety of dishes--one per person.
title: Qing Chao Cai Hua (Chinese Stir-Fried Cauliflower)

steps: 1. First mix the milk and eggs in a medium sized bowl.
2. Next add the flour, salt and baking powder and form a dough.
3. Put your dough onto a floured surface and roll very thin. (I use a pasta roller - #3 setting).
4. Cut into long (long equals longevity according to the Chinese ) noodles of your liking. We like a wider noodle, like a fettuccini.
title: Lo Mein Noodles

ingredients.text: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Combine chicken and 2 tablespoons teriyaki sauce in a bowl. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add chicken; cook and stir until no longer pink in the center, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a separate bowl.
2. Stir scallions, garlic, ginger, and remaining vegetable oil into skillet until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in snow peas and chicken broth; cover and cook until tender; 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Stir rice, cooked chicken, and remaining teriyaki sauce into skillet; cook and stir until rice is heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle with cashews.
title: Chicken, Snow Pea, And Cashew Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: 1. 1.	Start the instant pot in SAUTE mode and heat it. Add oil, onions and garlic. Stir and saute for 2 minutes.
2. 2.	Add chicken and mix with the onions. Spread them in the pot and let them saute for 3 minutes.
3. 3.	Add carrots, celery, orzo, salt, pepper and broth. Stir well. Press Cancel and close the lid with vent in sealing position.
4. 4.	Set the instant pot on Pressure cook mode at high pressure for 6 minutes.
5. 5.	When the instant pot beeps, quick release the pressure manually. Open lid and stir the soup. Remove bay leaf and rosemary sprig.
6. 6.	Stir in spinach lemon juice until spinach is mixed in the soup. Press Saute and let the soup come to a quick boil in about a minute; stir in the cream.
7. 7.	Soup is ready to be served. Offer shredded Parmesan when serving this creamy lemony soup.
8. Notes.
9. If you are making this soup ahead; DO NOT add cream; do this only after you have reheated your soup and are ready to serve it.
10. Cooking time does not include the time needs to reheat and cool down the Instant Pot.
title: Instant Pot Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup

ingredients.text: 4 oz. can mushrooms, sliced and drained

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp; drain.
2. Add 1/4 cup bacon drippings to pan.
3. Add onion, celery, mushrooms and rice.
4. Cook over low heat, stirring frequently (5 minutes).
5. Stir in soy sauce.
6. Stir in beaten egg to rice mixture and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until egg sets (3 minutes).
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet and add onion.
2. Saute until light golden.
3. Add eggs.
4. Mix.
5. Stir in cooked rice before eggs set.
6. Mix well and cook, stirring constantly, for 6-8 minutes.
7. Add soy sauce before serving.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp; cook 4 minutes or until done. Remove from pan; keep warm. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in pan. Add eggs; stir-fry 30 seconds or until soft-scrambled, stirring constantly. Stir in onions and ginger; stir-fry 1 minute. Stir in soy sauce mixture, shrimp, rice, and peas; cook 3 minutes or until heated.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, you may omit if necessary (for heat)

steps: 1. In a large sauce pan.
2. add the vinegar, garlic, red pepper flakes, broth, soy sauce, and ginger. Bring to a slight boil.
3. Add shrimp and fresh or frozen but thawed broccoli florets.
4. Take some of the excess sauce and pour into a bowl (about 3 tbsp sauce and add 1 tbsp cornstarch). Whisk and return to pan. Bring to full boil and stir constantly.
5. As soon as thickening begins, remove from heat and serve over white rice. You may also use one of them premade Asian vegetable medleys in this recipe and pour sauce over it.
6. Can be used for beef, chicken or pork as well.
title: Shrimp And Broccoli Stir Fry Spicy

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove to paper towels. In the drippings, saute the chicken, carrots and celery until chicken juices run clear; remove and keep warm. In the same skillet, scramble eggs over medium heat, breaking into small pieces. Stir in the chicken mixture, rice, soy sauce and bacon.
title: Fried Rice With Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet.
2. Saute the onions and garlic until just golden, about 7 minute.
3. Add the tequila and lime juice.
4. Increase the heat to high.
5. Add the rice.
6. Stir the rice frequently to coat the rice with oil.
7. Fry until rice is golden brown and all of the grains are coated, about 5 minute.
8. Stir in the parsley.
title: Tequila Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook 1/2 cup of white rice according to package directions, using the 1 cup of water. (I must highly suggest that you do not substitute brown rice here. It throws off the flavor a little bit. But you must do as your heart leads, so I don't judge.)
2. Dice onions and carrots. Set aside.

3. When rice is almost finished cooking, scramble eggs on medium-high heat in a frying pan or wok. Add a dash of salt and a dash of pepper. (Don't go crazy though, there's plenty of flavor coming). Remove cooked eggs to a separate bowl.

4. Put oil in the hot pan and dump the cooked rice in. Turn the heat down to 2 or 3 (medium-low). Add eggs and soy sauce. Rice will not be completely covered with the soy sauce at first, but should turn brown when mixed.
5. Add garlic powder, pepper and salt. The magic is really in the garlic powder. It gives this dish a special pop of flavor. Stir.
6. Add veggies and sesame seeds. These bring incredible texture to the dish.
7. Add margarine. Stir and taste. Adjust seasonings as you see fit. *NOTE* This is the place to add more soy sauce if your first go at it was a little short.
8. Pile the rice up like the hibachi chef that you now are and let it cook for another 5-10 minutes, stirring once or twice.
9. Please refrain from twirling knives. Thank you.
10. This tastes wonderful with a ribeye or with some teriyaki chicken.
11. Enjoy!
title: Jake’S Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb. asparagus, bias cut in 1 1/2-inch lengths
2 small tomatoes, cut into thin wedges

steps: 1. Stir first 3 ingredients together and set aside.
title: Asparagus-Tomato Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 cups cold cooked long grain rice

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry mushrooms in oil until tender. Stir in the rice, chicken and soy sauce. Cook over low heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. Add egg and onion; cook and stir for 1-2 minutes or until egg is set.
title: Quick Chicken Fried Rice For Two

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. chopped scallions, cut in 1/4-inch pieces
1/2 c. frozen or blanched fresh peas

steps: 1. Heat small pan; add 1 tablespoon oil and dry scramble the eggs.
2. Remove and set aside.
3. Heat wok; add 3 tablespoons oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
4. Add scallions; mix few times.
5. Add rice and mix in thoroughly.
6. Add sugar; mix.
7. Add soy; mix.
8. Add eggs, cut into small strips or pieces.
9. Add peas.
10. Heat through.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat together the egg whites and whole egg; let sit.
