2. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
3. Add vegetables and saute for 20 to 30 seconds.
4. Add the eggs, saute for an additional 30 seconds. Add rice, chicken and soy sauce. Stir until well mixed.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 12 oz peeled deveined small shrimp, thawed if frozen

steps: 1. Heat 1 T oil in electric skillet cook shrimp (3 minutes). Remove to plate.

2. Heat 1 T oil in same skillet, add scallion garlic & ginger. Cook while stirring one minute. Add rice and stir to coat about 2 minutes. Push rice to one side and add eggs and cook, stirring and working into the rice mixture, 2 minutes.
3. Add edamame, peas, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, and shrimp. Cook, tossing constantly until heated through. Top with scallion greens.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 cups chicken breasts, diced into bite sized chunks

steps: 1. Bring the broth, lemon juice and bay leaf to a boil.
2. Let boil for 10-15 minutes.
3. Remove bay leaf.
4. Bring down to simmer.
5. Add the chicken and spaghetti.
6. Simmer until both are cooked through.
title: Lemon Chicken Noodle Soup

steps: 1. In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice. Set aside.
2. In a large skillet or wok heat oil over medium-high heat, heat vegetable oil and add onion. Cook until just tender.
3. Move onions off to the sides of pan to form a circle and pour egg in middle. Begin scrambling the egg, and when they begin to solidify, add the rice mixture and cook 1-2 minutes.
4. Add Peas, carrots, and bean sprouts (if using). Toss to combine ingredients and heat through. Serve immediately with garnish of freshly chopped green onions.
title: Basic Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a skillet, saute onion in oil until tender.
2. Add ginger and garlic, saute 1 more minute.
3. Add teriyaki sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, salt and hot sauce.
4. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cook and stir 2 minutes.
5. Add rice and vegetables, cook and stir until vegetables are tender.
title: Vegetable Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 3 ounces spaghetti, Approx 1 cup & Broken Into 2 inch Pieces
2 (6 ounce) chicken breasts, Diced Into Small Bite-Sized Pieces

steps: 1. Combine the first 3 ingredients in a pot and bring to a boil.
2. Boil for approximately 20-25 minutes.
3. In the meantime, dice the chicken & break the spaghetti.
4. Add the chicken & spaghetti, reduce to a simmer, cover.
5. Simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the spaghetti is cooked through.
title: Lemon Chicken Soup With Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked rice (calrose or long grain rice)

steps: 1. Scramble eggs in 2 tablespoons of oil, breaking up into small pieces.
2. Set aside.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook and bone 3 large chicken breasts; shred into 1-inch pieces.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Wash and sanitize all equipments before use.
2. Place corn kernels in food processor and make a coarse puree; set aside.
3. Heat the oil in a medium-sized soup pot.
4. Add the ginger and shallots or green onions, lightly saute until aromatic.
5. Add minced chicken; increase heat to high.
6. Add the corn; stir for 30 seconds.
7. Add the chicken stock, soy sauce and pepper.
8. Stir until the soup reaches a boil, then add the crab and sesame oil.
9. Reduce heat to medium-high. Pour the cornstarch mixture into the soup, stirring until the soup thickens, about 15 seconds.
10. Turn off the heat.
11. Lightly beat the egg whites with the salt until almost frothy.
12. Pour the egg whites into the soup in a slow, steady stream and in a circular motion.
13. Gently stir, allowing the lacy ribbons to surface.
14. Remove from fire and transfer into a suitable covered container.
title: Chinese Corn Soup

steps: 1. Bring 1 cup of water to boil in saucepan.
2. Stir in rice.
3. Cook over medium heat until tender.
4. Meanwhile, cook egg in butter in a 10-inch skillet until set.
5. Add scallions and rice; cook and stir over medium heat until rice and scallions are lightly browned. Combine remaining water and soy sauce.
6. Stir mixture into rice.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets. Peel tough skin off stem and qarther it into 2 inch pieces cut slantwise.
2. Bring 2 1/2 quarts water, 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon salt to boil. Add broccoli and boil quickly for 1 minute; plunge into cold water to set color; drain and place on platter or in a bowl.
3. In a small bowl combine soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, 1/4 teaspoon salt and sugar. Pour mixture over broccoli, toss. This salad can be served hot or cold, your choice!
title: Chinese-Style Broccoli Salad

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless pork, cut into small pieces

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, heat one tablespoon of oil over a medium high heat. Add egg and cook until barely set. Scramble into small pieces and set aside.
2. Add remaining oil, onion, red pepper, garlic and Red Curry. Stir-fry until onion is translucent and curry dissolved.
3. Add pork, Fish Sauce and sugar. Stir-fry until pork is no longer pink. If using leftover pork, stir fry until hot & sugar dissolved.
4. Add Jasmine Rice and reserved egg to skillet. Toss lightly to combine and stir-fry until rice is heated through. Mix in cilantro or basil, and serve.
title: Pork Fried Rice

steps: 1. Fry the rice with oil at medium temperature until it is brown. Add onions until soft.
2. Add tomato sauce.
3. Stir it up.
4. Add boiling water, salt and garlic powder for flavor.
5. Cook at low temperature for about 40 minutes until the rice is soft.
title: Mexican Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cut asparagus in diagonal pieces and cook a few minutes in 2 tablespoons oil.
2. (Can add chicken breasts.)
3. If you add cubed pieces of chicken, after stir-frying the asparagus, remove with a slotted spoon and brown chicken in oil.
4. Then add asparagus, sherry, soy sauce, chicken broth and cornstarch.
5. Stir and cook a few minutes until chicken is done and asparagus is tender.
title: Asparagus Chinese Style

steps: 1. In a medium sized microwave safe bowl, melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter. Heat it for 30 seconds at a time, stirring after each, and stopping once the chips are melted. Stir until smooth. Gently fold in the marshmallows, followed by noodles.
2. Drop by spoonfuls into a wax paper lined cookie sheet. Chill at least one hour.
3. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks. Freeze for up to 4 months.
title: Butterscotch Chinese Noodles

steps: 1. Pour the veggies into a large mug. Microwave for 60 seconds until defrosted.
2. Add the ginger, garlic, and sauce to the mug. Stir to combine.
3. Add the brown rice and egg to the mug, and stir thoroughly until all the ingredients are well-combined.
4. Microwave the mug for another 90 seconds until the egg has coagulated. Remove the mug from the microwave, stir, and serve.
title: Fried Rice In A Mug

steps: 1. Cut fresh spinach stems into 3-inch pieces.
2. Tear leaves into bite size pieces.
3. Cook, covered, in a very small amount of water. Reduce heat when steam forms.
4. Cook 3 to 5 minutes, turning frequently with a fork.
5. Drain well.
6. Heat oil, sugar and soy sauce in a skillet. Add spinach, water chestnuts and onion.
7. Cook, tossing lightly, 2 to 3 minutes or until spinach is coated and heated.
title: Chinese Spinach

steps: 1. Cook rice, chill.
2. Heat 1/2 of oil, add eggs and scramble slightly. Remove from heat.
3. Add rest of oil, fry onions and chicken. Add rice, stir to coat.
4. Stir in eggs and remaining ingredients. Heat through.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless beef chuck roast, sliced into thin strips

steps: 1. Place beef in a crock pot.
2. In a small bowl, combine consomme, soy sauce, brown sugar, oil, and garlic. Pour over beef. Cook on low for 6-8 hours.
3. In a cup, stir cornstarch and 2 tablespoons sauce from the crock pot until smooth. Add to crock pot. Stir well to combine.
4. Add broccoli to the crock pot. Stir to combine.
5. Cover and cook an additional 30 minutes on high (the sauce has to boil for it to thicken).
6. Serve over hot cooked rice.
title: Crock Pot Beef And Broccoli

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, fry bacon until crisp.
2. Add onion and cook until onion starts to soften.
3. Push onion and bacon aside and scramble eggs in the center.
4. Mix bacon, onion and eggs together, then push to side.
5. In center of skillet, mix ginger, celery seed, garlic and soy sauce.
6. Stir in bacon mixture.
7. Add rice.
8. Stir until thoroughly mixed and all rice is coated.
9. More soy sauce can be added if necessary.
10. Cook until rice is thoroughly heated.
title: Pork Fried Rice

steps: 1. Boil rice until fully cooked.
2. Saute ham, onion and green pepper in butter.
3. Add cooked rice, scrambled eggs, soy sauce and salt and pepper to taste.
4. Fry for 5 minutes.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Simmer onion, green pepper and celery in oil until cooked. Add drained mushrooms.
2. Mix onion mixture and mushrooms to macaroni.
3. Add cooked chicken and soy sauce.
4. Serve.
title: Chinese Macaroni Salad

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the egg whites, egg and 1/4 teaspoon salt. In a

2. or wok coated with cooking spray, cook the egg mixture over medium heat. As eggs set, lift edges, letting uncooked portion flow underneath. When the eggs are set, remove and cut into 1-in. pieces; keep warm.

3. In the same pan, stir-fry the onion and garlic until tender. Add vegetables; cover and cook over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes or until no longer frozen. Stir in the chicken, soy sauce and remaining salt; cook for 1 minute. Add rice; stir-fry for 4-5 minutes or until heated through. Add eggs; heat through.
title: Chicken Fried Rice For Four

steps: 1. In a large skillet stir-fry pork, until no longer pink. Remove pork from skillet, and keep in warm place.
2. In the same skillet, stir-fry broccoli about 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Add green pepper and garlic, cook for 2 minutes.
4. Stir in the mushrooms, cook 2 minutes longer.
5. In a small bowl combine cornstarch, chicken broth and soy sauce, until smooth, and stir into skillet.
6. Bring to a boil, cook and stir constantly until thickened.
7. Return pork to the skillet, heat through.
8. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Pork Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cubed

steps: 1. In a skillet combine chicken, water, vinegar, brown sugar, vegetable oil, soy sauce and bouillons.
2. Cook and stir over medium heat for 20 minutes or until chicken is tender and liquid has evaporated.
title: Mandarin Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 4 ounces broccoli florets, broken up into smaller pieces

steps: 1. Mix sauce (last 7 ingredients) together in a blender so it's ready to go.
2. Saute broccoli and carrots in 2 tbsp of water for 3-4 minutes.
3. Add leek and pepper and cook 1-2 minutes.
4. Add peas and greens and cook 1-2 minutes.
5. Add rice, seeds, and nuts, and cook 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Add sauce. Cook 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, then serve.
title: Peanut Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Pour in the eggs; cook and stir until scrambled and firm. Remove from wok, and set aside.

2. Put remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in the wok and turn heat up to high. Stir in rice until each grain is coated with oil. Stir in chicken, celery, carrot, peas and green onions. Reduce heat to medium, cover and allow to steam for 5 minutes. Stir in scrambled eggs and soy sauce, and cook until eggs are heated through.
title: Day Before Pay Day Fried Rice

steps: 1. (If you do not use monosodium glutamate, substitute 1/4 teaspoon of sugar.)
title: Chick 'N Ham Fried Rice

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain off grease.
2. (Roll sausage in a few paper towels for more removal of grease, if desired.) Return sausage to skillet and add carrots, celery, onion and pressed garlic.
3. Simmer in covered skillet until desired tenderness.
4. Add eggs and rice.
5. Season as desired.
6. Good with hot sauce.
7. Use your favorite veggies.
title: Breakfast Fried Rice

steps: 1. Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.

2. Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Transfer bacon slices to a paper-towel lined plate to drain and crumble into bite-size pieces; reserve rendered bacon fat in skillet.

3. Cook and stir eggs in the same skillet over medium heat until slightly set, 1 to 3 minutes. Stir yellow onion, peas, green onion, and 1 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce into eggs; cook and stir until yellow onion is translucent, about 5 minutes more. Reduce heat to low; stir rice, crumbled bacon, and remaining soy sauce into egg mixture until well-combined and heated through, 1 to 3 minutes.
title: Breakfast Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat a wok or large skillet; add oil, salt and bean sprouts; cook for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs and add the green onions and cilantro.
2. Allow to cook for 2 minutes, then, when it still looks moist but is cooked through, with a spatula turn half of the omelette over the other half.
3. Drizzle the omelette with the oyster sauce mixture and serve.
title: Chinese-Style Omelette

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. minced, cooked pork, beef or chicken

steps: 1. Prepare meat and vegetables.
2. Place in individual bowls and reserve.
3. Beat 2 eggs for each omelette.
4. In a wok or skillet, heat 1 teaspoon of the sesame oil.
5. Add eggs; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons each of meat, water chestnuts and mushrooms.
6. Cook over low heat until omelette is set but moist on top.
7. Sprinkle with soy sauce.
8. Roll up and serve.
title: Chinese Omelettes

ingredients.text: 1 small sweet potato, diced into 1/4" cubes
freshly ground black pepper, to taste

steps: 1. Heat a large saute pan over medium heat. When pan is hot, add coconut oil.
2. Add onions, mushrooms, sweet potatoes, and thyme.
3. Stirring frequently, cook until sweet potatoes are tender but firm (about 12-15 minutes).
4. Add small amounts of water (a few drops) to the pan and cover for a few minutes at a time in order to hasten the sweet potatoes' cooking time.
5. Toss in ham until heated through.
6. Season with freshly ground black pepper, if desired, and top with avocado to serve.
title: Ham Stir-Fry Breakfast

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup frozen stir-fry vegetable blend, thawed

steps: 1. In a small nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, saute the rice, chicken, vegetable blend and teriyaki sauce until heated through. Remove from skillet and set aside.
2. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Whisk the eggs, water, salt and pepper. Add egg mixture to skillet (mixture should set immediately at edges).

3. As eggs set, push cooked edges toward the center, letting uncooked portion flow underneath. When the eggs are set, spoon rice mixture on one side; fold other side over filling. Slide omelet onto a plate.
title: Fried Rice Omelet

steps: 1. Chop the uncooked bacon into 1/2-1 inch squares. Cook them in a wok until crispy.
2. Remove the bacon and set it aside, leaving enough bacon grease to generously coat the wok. Saute the onion and garlic in the bacon grease until the onion has taken on some color (golden brown.)
3. Add the cooked bacon back into the wok, add the cooked rice and mix well. Add soy sauce, salt and pepper to taste.

4. Push the rice mixture up the sides of the wok to create a 4-inch hole in the center. Add 4 of the eggs, cracking them into the center of the wok. Let them start to cook - about 3-4 minutes - before mixing them into the rice mixture. Continue stirring until the egg is cooked.
5. While the eggs are cooking, make 6 sunny-side up eggs.
6. Sprinkle chopped green onion over the fried rice. Scoop the breakfast fried rice into individual bowls. Add a single, sunny-side up egg on the top of each individual serving.
title: Breakfast Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 4 medium size eggs (brown shell is best)

steps: 1. Fry corned beef in a large frying pan over medium heat, stirring occasionally until all fat nodules disappear.
2. Then remove from pan.
3. Saute garlic and green onions in the corned beef liquid until all onion is glossy, then remove and add to corned beef.
4. Add butter/oil to the pan, then scramble the eggs in the butter/oil. Then, when cooked to your taste, remove from the pan.
title: Breakfast Fried Rice(Serves 4)

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 cup Brown Rice, Cooked Per Package Directions And Refrigerated Ahead Of Time

steps: 1. Cook the brown rice according to package directions and store it in a large gallon size zip top bag in the refrigerator so it's ready when you want to make this recipe.

2. In a 12" pan over medium heat, fry the diced bacon until crispy. Then remove it from the pan and set aside on a paper towel to drain. Add beaten eggs to the bacon drippings and fry it in a single layer like a pancake. When it has cooked and solidified, fold it in half to remove it from the pan. Put it onto a cutting board and dice it.

3. Add olive oil (if needed) into the bacon drippings and saute shredded carrot for 1 minute. Then add rice and heat through. Add soy sauce to taste and then add the fried bacon, diced egg and green onion. Heat everything through and cook until the onions are softened a bit. Serve!
title: Breakfast Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 5 ounces white fish, cut into small chunks
1 (3 inch) piece fresh ginger root, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Combine water and rice in a large pot over high heat. Bring to a boil; simmer for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until rice is tender, about 30 minutes.
2. Combine fish, ginger, spring onion, chicken bouillon granules, and pepper in a bowl. Let marinate for 15 minutes.
3. Stir fish mixture into the pot. Simmer gently until rice is very soft and fish is falling apart, about 20 minutes. Season with parsley and salt.
title: Chinese Fish Congee

steps: 1. Combine chicken, bean sprouts, water chestnuts and soy sauce and mix well.
2. Set aside.
3. Mix eggs, water, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper with a fork.
4. Heat butter or margarine in a 10-inch skillet.
5. Pour in egg mixture.

6. With spatula, draw cooked portions of egg toward center so that uncooked portions flow to bottom. Cook until bottom is set and lightly browned and top is creamy. Arrange chicken mixture on half of omelet.
7. With spatula, fold other half over and turn out on serving platter.
8. Yields 2 servings.
9. Each serving equals 3 ounces of meat and 1 vegetable.
title: Oriental Omelet(From Joslin Diabetic Clinic)

ingredients.text: 10 king prawns (shrimp cooked, peeled and deveined)

steps: 1. Lightly combine eggs, sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic and ginger.
2. Heat a medium frypan to hot and add the vegetable oil.
3. Add the egg mixture and give it a few good stirs to move the set mixture of the base.
4. When almost set, arrange the prawns down the middle.
5. Remove from the heat and then add the herbs and the sprouts. Fold the omelette and slide on to a serving plate.
6. Combine the oyster and the soy sauce and drizzle it over the omelette.
title: Asian Prawn Omelette

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons green onions, thinly sliced, divided

steps: 1. Discard seasoning packet from ramen noodles or save for another use. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water; transfer to a bowl and set aside.

2. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick ovenproof skillet over medium heat, cook celery in canola oil for 1 minute. Stir in the mushrooms, 2 tablespoons green onions and ginger; cook and stir for 7 minutes or until mushrooms are lightly browned. Stir into noodles.
3. Whisk the eggs, egg whites, sesame oil, sugar and salt. Stir into noodle mixture; spread into an even layer in the skillet. Cook on medium for 2 minutes.
4. Bake, uncovered at 350° for 10-12 minutes or until set. Cut into wedges. Sprinkle with remaining green onions. Drizzle with soy sauce.
title: Asian Oven Omelet

ingredients.text: 1 None long red chili, thinly sliced
None None chopped peanuts, to serve

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk eggs, chives and soy sauce together. Season to taste.

2. Heat a lightly oiled wok on high. Add 1/2 cup of the egg mixture, swirling to coat base and sides of wok and cook 1-2 minutes or until just set. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with remaining egg mixture.
3. In a small bowl, whisk hoisin and vinegar together.
4. In a large bowl, combine bok choy, tomatoes, sprouts, green onions, chili and cilantro. Toss with the dressing. Divide among serving plates.
5. Thinly slice omlette and sprinkle over salad. Garnish with peanuts to serve.
title: Shredded Omelette Salad

ingredients.text: 5 ounces crabmeat, thawed and drained (or 5 ounces shrimp)

steps: 1. Lightly beat eggs with salt and pepper, set aside.
2. Heat wok with 2 tsp oil and sesame oil.
3. Add onion and fry until soft.
4. Push to one side of the wok, add crabmeat or shrimps and stir-fry well.
5. Stir in soy sauce, more salt and pepper if desired, then remove crabmeat mixture and set aside.
6. Heat the remaining 2 tsp oil in the wok; add beaten eggs.
7. Swirl pan around to spread the omelette evenly.
8. When eggs have set, add the cooked crabmeat/shrimp mixture and sprinkle with spring onion and red chillies.
9. 'Fold'in the four corners of the omelette to cover the filling.
10. Cover pan with a lid for 1 minute, then turn out omelette onto a plate and serve immediately.
title: Crab Meat Or Shrimp Omelette

ingredients.text: 8 cups unsalted chicken stock, homemade or low-sodium canned
2 cups bok choy, coarsely chopped, or napa cabbage

steps: 1. Place all the ingredients in a slow-cooker and cook on low for six hours.
2. Serving suggestion: serve in flat bowls garnished with fresh coriander and chopped scallions. Toasted sesame seeds or sesame oil are also a nice touch.
title: Chicken Rice Congee Recipe

steps: 1. Combine ingredients; roll out and cut into 1 to 1 1/2-inch squares.
2. Drop in boiling chicken or beef broth.
3. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Serves 4.
title: Pot Pie(Square Dumplings)

steps: 1. Combine flour, egg, salt and water to make thin batter.
2. Add pork cubes to batter mix until well coated.
3. Fry in hot cooking oil until browned.
4. Drain.
5. Combine green pepper strips, pineapple, brown sugar, vinegar, 1 cup water and molasses.
6. Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
7. Add tomatoes, cut in eighths. Combine cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
8. Add to hot mixture.
9. Stir constantly until thickened.
10. Add pork and cook 5 minutes.
11. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
12. Serve over rice.
title: Sweet And Sour Pork Over Rice

steps: 1. Slice the onions and arrange in a 1-quart baking dish.
2. Mix the rest of the ingredients and pour over the onions.
3. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
4. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Onions

steps: 1. Cook carrots in lightly salted water until just tender, about 15 minutes.
2. Add peppers.
3. Cover and cook 3 minutes.
4. Drain. Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
5. Add water to make 1/3 cup liquid.
6. In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and salt.
7. Stir in juice, vinegar and soy sauce.
8. Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in vegetables and pineapple.
9. Beat through.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Carrots

ingredients.text: 2 apples, peeled, cored and finely chopped

steps: 1. Place cabbage in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients.
3. Pour over cabbage.
4. Cook, covered, for 9 to 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender.
5. Stir once during cooking period.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage

steps: 1. Shred cabbage in process mixer the thinness you wish or shred by	hand

2. or large grater.	Mix cabbage, chopped pepper, minced onion and carrots in bowl.	In small bowl whisk together vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper for about 1 minute until sugar dissolves.	Whisk in vegetable and olive oil until well mixed. Refrigerate
3. at
4. least
5. 1 hour or up to 24 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Cole Slaw

ingredients.text: 1 lb. lean pork, cut in 3/4-inch cubes
1 medium green pepper, cut in 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine flour, monosodium glutamate and salt.
2. Dip pork cubes in beaten egg and then in flour mixture; coat well.
3. Fry pork in deep, hot fat (360°) for 6 to 8 minutes or until browned and done. Remove and drain pork on paper towels and keep warm.
4. In a wok or deep skillet, combine sugar, vinegar, pineapple juice, ketchup and soy sauce; bring to boiling.
5. Blend cornstarch in, stirring constantly until sauce thickens.
6. Stir the warm deep fat fried pork cubes, drained pineapple chunks and green pepper pieces into the thickened sauce.
7. Serve while hot with steamed rice.
8. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Pork

ingredients.text: 20 oz. pineapple chunks, drained (reserving 2/3 c. liquid)

steps: 1. In a large skillet, melt shortening.
2. Add pork.
3. Sprinkle with paprika.
4. Brown well.
5. Cover.
6. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, or until tender, stirring occasionally.
7. In medium bowl, combine brown sugar, cornstarch and salt.
8. Add 2/3 cup pineapple liquid, vinegar, water, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
9. Mix well. Stir into meat.
10. Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
11. Stir in green pepper, onion and pineapple.
12. Cover. Simmer 6 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
13. Serve over rice.
14. Serves 6.
title: Sweet And Sour Pork

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. red-skinned potatoes, peeled, cooked and diced

steps: 1. Heat vinegar and sugar in small saucepan until sugar dissolves.
2. Transfer to large bowl and add green onion, salt, pepper, catsup and mayonnaise.
3. Add potatoes, celery and toss to coat.
4. Chill before serving.
5. Makes 4 servings.
6. Calories: 319; Fat: 11 grams; Cholesterol: 30 mg.
title: Potato Salad, Sweet And Sour

steps: 1. Dice and fry bread in butter until crisp.
2. Remove and place on paper towel.
3. In large bowl, mix flour and salt.
4. Mix egg and milk and stir into flour mixture.
5. Form into dumplings around bread cubes, using 3 to 4 cubes per dumpling.
6. Drop into boiling water, taking care that dumplings do not stick.
7. Cover and boil gently 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Bread Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
2. Cut in shortening with 2 knives, a fork or pastry blender.
3. Add milk, using more if necessary to make a soft dough.
4. Pat out to 1/2-inch thick and cut into 1-inch squares.
5. Drop into boiling chicken or beef stock.
6. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Biscuit Dumplings

steps: 1. Cook cabbage, apple, water and salt over low heat for 15 minutes.
2. Mix flour and vinegar until smooth.
3. Add to cabbage mixture.
4. Add remaining ingredients and cook 15 minutes longer. Serves 6.
title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage

steps: 1. Cut chicken in 1/2-inch cubes.
2. Coat with flour, sugar and salt mixture and place in 1 1/2 to 2-quart dish.
3. Mix soy sauce, vinegar and water and pour over chicken.
4. Top with sliced onions and bell pepper.
5. Microwave 6 minutes.
6. Stir and cook 6 minutes more.
7. Check chicken for doneness.
8. If not done, microwave for 1 to 2 minutes more and check again.
title: Microwave Sweet And Sour Chicken

ingredients.text: 17 5/16 ounces puff pastry sheets thawed, 1 package

steps: 1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Peel and core apples.
3. Mix together sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.

4. Unwrap one sheet of puff pastry, keeping the other refrigerated until ready to use. Cut pastry sheet into 4 equal squares. Gently roll each square with a rolling pin to roughly 1 1/4 times its original size, just large enough to fully encase one apple. Remove remaining puff pastry from refrigerator and repeat.
5. To assemble dumplings, place an apple in the center of a puff pastry square. Sprinkle 2 heaping spoonfuls of the cinnamon sugar over the apple, letting some collect in hollowed core.

6. Gently gather the puff pastry around the apple by lifting corners and tucking them into the core. Pinch together any places left open in the pastry so that none of the apple is exposed. Place dumpling on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining apples and puff pastry.
7. Once dumplings are assembled, transfer baking sheet to freezer while oven preheats. A short freeze ensures the puff pastry stays in place on apples while baking.
8. Preheat oven to 375°F.
9. Once oven is preheated, remove baking sheet from freezer. Lightly brush each dumpling with the beaten egg.
10. Bake dumplings on middle rack of oven for 35-40 minutes, until pastry is flaky and golden brown and apples are fork-tender.
11. Check to see that dumplings are done. Remove from oven or add time as needed.
12. Allow to cool 10 minutes before serving.
title: Puff Pastry Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Bring 5 to 6 cups water with 2 teaspoons salt to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Drain. Using cold water repeat one more time. Drain and cool.
2. Chop peppers.
3. Mix cornstarch with the water and set aside. [If lumpy. well there are such things as blenders -- ].
4. Add 1 tbsp oil to wok and heat.
5. Add walnuts when hot ans stir fry briefly then add the peppers and the pineapple.
6. Stir in the sauce.
7. Restir the corn starch mixture and add. Mix. It will thicken and serve hot garnished with the carrot.
title: Chinese Sweet And Sour Spareribs Vegetarian

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt and leave for 45 minutes, then brown.
2. Bake chicken 1 hour at 350°; turn only once, then pour sauce over chicken.
3. Bake approximately 1 hour, covered.
4. To fry chicken, brown in skillet on both sides; drain fat, then pour sauce over chicken.
5. Turn once.
6. Fry approximately 15 minutes, covered.
title: Sweet And Sour Chicken

steps: 1. Place 1 1/2 cups sugar and water in a 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Cook for 5 minutes.
title: Apple Rolls(Quick, Easy Apple Dumplings.)

steps: 1. Set the oven at 250 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Trim excess fat off the pork chops.
3. Add oil to frying pan and heat on high.
4. Add garlic and swirl around for 30 seconds- don't let it brown or burn.
5. Lower heat under frying pan. Brown the chops on both sides.
6. Remove chops and place in an ovenproof baking dish in a single layer.
7. Scrape the garlic and "brown bits" from the frying pan onto the top of the chops.
8. Mix remaining ingredients together well and pour over the chops.
9. Place chops into the oven.
10. Lower heat to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
11. Leave chops in the oven for 2 hours or more.
12. When the chops come from the oven - the longer the better - the meat will fall from the bones and the fat is easily removed.
13. Shred the pork and return it to the "sauce".
14. Leave the meat in the oven until you are ready-to-serve.
15. Serve over rice.
title: Clever Connie'S Sweet & Sour Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs. lean pork shoulder, cut into 2 1/2 inch strips

steps: 1. Brown pork in hot fat. Add 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer till tender, about 1 hour. Drain pineapple, reserving syrup. Combine sugar, cornstarch, syrup, vinegar, soy sauce & salt. Add to pork. Cook and stir until gravy thickens; add pineapple, green pepper and onion;
2. cook 2 or 3 minutes. Serve overrice (hot) or brown noodles.
title: Sweet & Sour Pork

steps: 1. Brown meat in oil and add all ingredients, except cornstarch. Cover and cook 3 hours (simmer).
2. Add cornstarch to thicken.
3. Pour goulash over noodles.
title: Sweet And Sour Goulash

steps: 1. Mix all together.
2. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Top each with a sliver of almond.
3. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Combine sugar, vinegar, salt and pepper in a small saucepan. Heat until sugar is dissolved, stirring constantly.
2. Cool.
3. Pour over cucumbers.
title: Sweet And Sour Cucumbers

steps: 1. Sprinkle the yeast over 1/2 cup of warm water in a small bowl. The water should be no more than 100 degrees F (40 degrees C). Let stand for 5 minutes until the yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam.

2. Beat egg, melted butter, vanilla extract, and milk together in a large bowl, until smooth. Sift cake flour, cornmeal, sugar, and salt together in a small bowl, then stir the flour mixture into the egg mixture, mixing until just combined. Stir in the yeast mixture until smooth. Cover with a light cloth and let rise in a warm place (80 to 95 degrees F (27 to 35 degrees C) until doubled in volume, 1 to 2 hours. Pour mixture into a 9 inch round pan lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with raisins.

3. Place a steamer insert into a saucepan, and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Cover, and bring the water to a boil over high heat. Add the cake, recover, and steam until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 25 minutes. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes before removing to cool completely on a wire rack.
title: Traditional Chinese Steamed Cake (Fa Gao)

steps: 1. Mix the salt into the flour with a fork. Pile the flour onto a clean counter and make a well in it with your fingers. Pour the oil into the well, followed by about half of the hot water. Mix the flour into the water and make into a dough, adding a little water at a time until you have a damp dough. Knead the dough for a bout 10 minutes or until smooth.

2. Divide the dough into 18- 20 balls of about equal size. Flatten and roll them out into discs about 2-3 inches in diameter. Brush the tops of half of these with a little oil and place the other half of these on top. Dust with a little flour and roll out into thin pizza like circles about 6-8 inches across. Stack with waxed paper in between the pancakes.

3. Heat a griddle or large ungreased skillet over medium-low heat. cook one at a time turning often until bubbles begin to form in the dough. Do not brown! With the tip of a knife seperate the pancake into two and place on a warm plate covered with a clean dampened towel mositened with hot water. Continue doing this until all the pancakes are done. Enjoy with Toni's Moo Shu Vegetables!
title: Moo Shu Pancakes

ingredients.text: 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled and de-veined

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium heat. Add celery, bell pepper, onion and ginger; stir fry 5 to 7 minutes. Add soy sauce, lemon juice and sugar; cook and stir 1 minutes.
2. Add shrimp; stir fry 3 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender.
title: Sweet And Sour Shrimp Stir Fry

steps: 1. Cook bacon.
2. Cook onion in bacon drippings.
3. Add cabbage (cut in quarters), salt, pepper and water.
4. Cook on low for 10 minutes. Add vinegar and brown sugar.
5. Cook 15 to 20 minutes more.
6. Add crumbled bacon.
7. You may add a tart sliced apple the last 15 minutes if desired.
title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage

steps: 1. Mound flour on kneading board and make hole in center.
2. Drop eggs into hole and cut into flour with knife.
3. Add salt and water and knead until firm.
4. Let rest for 10 minutes, covered with a warm bowl.
5. Divide dough into halves and roll thin.
6. Cut circles with large biscuit cutter.
7. Place a small spoonful of filling a little to one side on each round of dough.
8. Moisten edge with water, fold over and press edges together firmly.
9. Be sure they are well sealed to prevent the filling from running out.
10. Drop pierogi into salted boiling water.
11. Cook gently for 3 to 5 minutes.
12. Lift out carefully with perforated spoon.
title: Pierogi(Filled Dumplings)

steps: 1. Shred cabbage into a large container, top with the onions,sliced into thin rings and sprinkle with 3/4 cup of sugar.
2. Combine vinegar, salt, remaining sugar, mustard, and celery seeds and bring to a boil. Add the salad oil and pour over cabbage mixture while hot.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
4. In the morning, stir well.
title: Sweet And Sour Cole Slaw

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 325°F.

2. 2. Sift together the flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. Cut in the butter and Crisco with a pastry blender or two knives until the mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Add 1 egg, milk, and almond extract. Mix well.

3. 3. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Set them 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Place an almond on top of each cookie and press down to flatten the cookie slightly. Beat a whole egg with 1 Tablespoon of water to make an egg wash. Lightly brush the top of each cookie with egg wash.
4. 4. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until just beginning to brown. Cool on a rack before serving.
title: Chinese Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Cut off wing tips; cut each wing in half.
2. Mix all ingredients.
3. Pour over wings and let stand, covered, in refrigerator for several hours.
4. Place in shallow baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° until brown.
5. Baste during cooking 1 1/2 hours or until done (being careful not to brown).
title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Combine sugar, dry mustard, salt, vinegar, oil, onion and poppy seed.
2. Pour over raw broccoli, carrots, green pepper and zucchini.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
title: Sweet And Sour Vegetables

steps: 1. Drain oranges.
2. Combine dry ingredients; cut in butter.
3. Add milk and egg; stir until moistened.
4. Stir in oranges.
5. Fill paper cups 3/4 full.
6. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Spicy Mandarin Muffins

steps: 1. Place cabbage and apple in Dutch oven.
2. Mix remaining ingredients.
3. Pour over cabbage.
4. Place lid on Dutch oven and simmer until tender, about 30 to 40 minutes.
title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage

steps: 1. Stir all ingredients until moist.
2. Drop by tablespoon into greens with generous liquid.
3. Cover and cook about 15 minutes. Never remove cover while cooking.
title: Corn Bread Dumplings

ingredients.text: 1 pound Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts, Cut Into Strips

steps: 1. To make the filling, combine 3 tablespoons of the soy sauce, 1 clove of minced garlic, half of the green onions, and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a Ziploc bag; shake well to combine. Place the chicken strips in the bag, press out the excess air, and seal. Refrigerate and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 3 hours.

2. Heat 2 tablespoons of the vegetable in a wok or large skillet over high heat. When the oil is very hot, add the chicken to the pan and cook, stirring constantly, until the chicken is cooked through and lightly browned. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

3. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the pan. Add the shredded cabbage and carrots and the remaining tablespoon of soy sauce. Stir to toss the vegetables. Cook over high heat for about 2 minutes. Toss in the bean sprouts, the remaining garlic and green onions and cook for 1 more minute. Remove from heat.

4. Dice the chicken breast and add it to the vegetable mixture. Place the mixture in a colander in the sink. Press down firmly on the filling mixture to remove as much excess liquid as possible. Let the filling cool for 30 minutes before filling the wrappers.
5. To finish the egg rolls, heat about 3 inches of oil to 375 degrees F in a heavy bottomed pot.

6. While the oil is heating, assemble the rolls. Lay an egg roll wrapper out on your work surface with one corner pointing toward you. Add a tablespoon or two of the filling to the center of the wrapper. Fold the corner closest to you up over the filling. Roll slightly away from you then fold in the two outside corners, and continue rolling the wrapper tightly away from you. Securely close the egg roll by lightly brushing the inside top corner of the wrapper with the corn starch mixture (1 Tablespoon corn starch and 3 Tablespoons water, mixed). Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.

7. Fry several egg rolls at a time in the hot oil but without overcrowding, about 4-5 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to a large plate lined with paper towels and place the finished egg rolls vertically to help drain excess grease. Repeat with the remaining rolls. Serve warm with soy sauce or sweet n' sour.
title: Chicken Egg Rolls

steps: 1. Blend with mixer for 2 minutes.
2. Pour mix into skillet.
3. Bake for 10 minutes in 450° oven.
4. Lower oven temperature to 350° and bake for another 10 minutes.
5. While pancake is baking, melt 2 to 3 tablespoons butter in pan and saute vegetables and spices of your choice.
6. Spoon vegetables over the pancake.
7. Can add grated cheese and salt and pepper to taste.
title: Stir-Fry Vegetable Pancake

steps: 1. Combine mustard and jelly in 1-cup glass measure.
2. Cover with plastic wrap; cook on 60% power for 3 minutes.
3. Cut each frankfurter diagonally into 8 slices.
4. Place butter and franks in 1-quart glass casserole; cover.
5. Cook on High for 4 minutes.
6. Let stand 2 minutes.
7. Serve hot on toothpicks.
8. Makes about 40 pieces.
title: Microwave Sweet And Sour Hot Dogs

steps: 1. Combine sugar, soy sauce, wine, vinegar and catsup in saucepan; bring to a boil (stir constantly).
title: Sweet And Sour Kielbasa

ingredients.text: 1 carrot, cut into small wedges, boil 8 minutes

steps: 1. Make meatballs and put them in the oven until brown at approximately 350°.
2. Put oil in a frying pan and deep fry onion and peppers.
3. Put meatballs in a big pan and mix all the ingredients together.
4. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup water and cook in pan until thick.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

ingredients.text: 2 lb. uncooked pork, cut into pieces about 1-inch thick and 2-inches long

steps: 1. Mix the sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, water and cornstarch. Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly. Place in a kettle the pork. Add the cold water and boil 20 minutes or until tender. Pour off water if there is any left; cool. While meat is cooling, saute the onion and carrots in oil (substitute green pepper, pineapple, bamboo shoots and apples). Remove from pan. Combine ingredients with hot sweet and sour sauce and sauteed vegetables. Serve with steamed rice.
title: Sweet And Sour Pork

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine the ground beef, egg, bread crumbs and onion. Mix thoroughly and shape into golf ball-sized balls.
2. In a large skillet over medium heat, gently brown the meatballs and set aside.
3. In a large saucepan, combine the brown sugar, flour, water, white vinegar and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly. Add meatballs and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring often, for 30 minutes.
title: The Best Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Sift together first 4 ingredients.
2. Add 2 Tbsp. butter, milk and vanilla.
title: Caramel Dumplings

steps: 1. Add water and sugar to a saucepan and put on medium heat. As soon as sugar is fully dissolved into water, remove from heat.
2. Place fine strainer above the pan and squeeze fruit into pan. Mix. Place into a secure container and save up to 1 month in the refrigerator.
title: Simple Homemade Sweet And Sour Mix

steps: 1. Melt first 3 ingredients together; do not boil. Cream together the sugar and butter. Add flour alternately with milk, then add vanilla, cinnamon and nuts.
2. Put syrup in a 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
3. Add batter by spoonfuls to syrup.
4. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
5. (Test with toothpick.)
6. Serve upside down.
title: Caramel Dumplings

steps: 1. Break lettuce in small pieces; slice onions thin. Break apart. Cube bacon and brown.
2. Add vinegar, sugar and water mixture. Just before serving, pour over lettuce.
3. Vinegar mixture may be adjusted to taste.
title: Sweet And Sour Lettuce

steps: 1. Place all the ingredients in a blender, blend for 1 minute.
2. Scrape down the sides, blend for a few seconds more until smooth.
3. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
5. A- Use upside down crepe pan& follow instructions or B- Use a non stick skillet, you do not need oil or additional fat on the pan.
6. Pour a little batter in the pan, tilt the pan and turn the pan to spread an even thin layer of batter on the bottom of the pan.
7. Cook over medium heat for a minute or two (these wraps will not be brown when they are cooked but will brown when you fill and fry them later).
8. Flip the wrap and cook second side for a few seconds.
9. When freshly cooked these are very easy to fill and fold, I recommend to have your filling ready and fill each one as it comes off the pan.
10. Filling suggestion available under Chinese recipes here on Zaar.
11. You may now continue to fry the egg rolls or wrap them in plastic wrap& foil and freeze them for future use.
title: Chinese Egg Roll Wrap

steps: 1. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Slowly add sugar while beating constantly. Add in vanilla. Mix remaining dry ingredients and fold into egg mixture. Pour batter into slightly greased pan. Steam for 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
title: Ma Lai Go (Steamed Chinese Sponge Cake)

steps: 1. Cook beef in large pan or wok until all the red color is gone. Add remainder of ingredients; steam about 3 to 5 minutes, just until cabbage is wilted.
2. Drain in colander and cool before filling the wrappers.
3. Fill wrappers (directions for filling on wrapper package).
4. Fry in peanut oil until brown.
title: Beef Egg Roll Filling

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Beat the shortening with sugar and egg until light and fluffy.
3. Add egg, then vanilla.
4. Add dry ingredients and beat until well combined.
5. Add chocolate a little at a time, cutting in with a knife. Do not stir.
6. Form dough into balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with the bottom of a sugar-coated glass.
7. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until lightly golden.
8. NOTE: I find these a bit salty, i will have to reduce the salt next time. Baked them for 15min.
title: Chinese Marble Cookies

steps: 1. Heat all ingredients in a soup pot until it boils.
2. Reduce heat and simmer slowly, covered, for 1 hour.
title: Lean Sweet And Sour Cabbage Borscht

steps: 1. Heat a large skillet over high heat. Sear the pork chops until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. Mix the brown sugar, ketchup, onion, and lemon juice in a bowl; spoon over the pork chops.
2. Cook on Low until the pork chops are very tender, 4 to 6 hours.
title: Easy Slow Cooker Sweet And Sour Pork Chops

steps: 1. Stir together flour, cornstarch, oil, and enough water to make a thin batter.
2. Lightly oil a small (6") frying pan and heat.
3. Spoon 2 Tbsp of the batter into the center of the pan.
4. Swirl the batter around to coat the bottom of the pan.
5. Cook until the wrapper is dry and starts to shrink from the edge of the side of the pan. Do not let it change colors.
6. Transfer the wrapper to a plate and cover it with a damp cloth until you have made all that you need.

7. To fill: place your favorite filling slightly off center of the wrapper. Fold the sides over, then roll the wrapper up to enclose the filling. Brush around the edges with a beaten egg to seal it. Deep fry the spring roll about 4 minutes and enjoy!
title: Quick Homemade Spring Roll Wrappers

ingredients.text: 2 (3 lb.) chickens, cut up (legs, breasts, thighs)

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken parts on all sides with salt and 2 teaspoons paprika.
2. Melt margarine in large skillet; add chicken.
3. Saute until golden.
4. Turn pieces; add onion.
5. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon paprika.
6. Simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
7. Add 2 cups broth; cook slowly, covered, until tender.
8. Remove chicken; keep warm.
9. Blend sour cream, 1/2 cup water and flour until smooth.
10. Gradually add to broth in skillet.
11. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened. Return chicken to sauce.
12. Keep on low heat, uncovered, until serving time.
13. Serves 6 to 8.

2. Drop from tablespoon atop bubbling stew.
3. Cover; return to boiling.
4. Reduce heat; simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 10 servings.
title: Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Add broth and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moist.
3. Form ball.
4. Roll dough until 1/16-inch thick.
5. Using a sharp knife, cut the entire rolled dough into 1-inch strips, then cut crosswise into 1 1/2-inch rectangles.
6. Drop dumplings into boiling broth.
7. Cover and cook on medium-low heat 15 minutes, or until tender.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Old Fashioned Chicken Dumplings

steps: 1. Cut chicken wings at joints.
2. Place in a large bowl.
3. Combine the oil, soy sauce, ginger, lemon juice and garlic.
4. Pour over chicken wings.
5. Marinate wings several hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
6. Discard marinade.
7. Bake wings at 350° for 45 minutes.
8. Increase heat to 450° and bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 20 to 25 people as a party appetizer.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Toss beef cubes in flour seasoned with the salt, garlic salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Brown in the 3 tablespoons oil.
3. Add onion and saute lightly.
4. Add 2 cups of water; reduce heat to low.
5. Add celery, parsley, bay leaves, thyme leaves, garlic salt, onion salt and potatoes.
6. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours, covered.
7. Stir occasionally, adding water if necessary to keep from sticking to bottom of pan.
8. Add carrots, green pepper and frozen peas.
9. Cook 1/2 hour more.
10. Add more water if needed.
11. Place dumplings on top (recipe follows), dropping with spoon.
12. Cook slowly uncovered for 10 minutes and covered for 10 minutes.
13. (Do not use self-basting cover.)
14. If too much liquid in pot, skim some off into saucepan. Thicken with seasoned flour to make gravy.
15. Serve with dumpling on top of meat and pass the gravy.
16. Sprinkle a little paprika over top.
17. Serves 4 to 6.
18. Expect compliments!
title: Beef Ragout With Dumplings

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Arrange wings into baking pan.
3. Mix all ingredients well.
4. Pour over wings coating well.
5. Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until brown.
6. Serves 4-6 people.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Sift flour and salt in mixing bowl.
2. Combine eggs and water. Add to flour mixture and beat well.
3. Drop by teaspoonful into boiling salted water.
4. Cook for about 12 to 15 minutes or until dumplings float.
5. Drain and serve with melted butter.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Dumpling Noodles

steps: 1. Disjoint chicken wings and discard tip ends.
2. Stir together soy sauce, vinegar, sugars, ginger and garlic for marinade.
3. Put wings in heavy plastic bag and pour in marinade. Close bag and place in a bowl in case the bag leaks.
4. Marinate at least 2 hours, overnight is best.
5. To cook place in a 13 x 9-inch oblong pan and bake at 350° for over 1 hour.
6. Yield:
7. 12 servings.
8. Carbohydrate 8 g, protein 17 g, fat 7 g, calories per serving 163.
9. One serving = 1/2 bread exchange, 2 meat exchanges.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients and mix.
2. Combine milk and oil.
3. Add to dry ingredients.
4. Stir until moist.
5. Drop from tablespoon on top of bubbling broth, or stew.
6. Cover tightly.
7. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat.
8. (Do not lift lid.)
9. Simmer 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 servings.
title: Fluffy Dumplings

steps: 1. Heat tomato juice with salt, sugar and pepper. Sift dry ingredients;
2. add
3. milk.
4. Blend
5. into

7. Drop by teaspoonfuls
8. into

12. Cover during cooking.
13. Serve at once. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Tomato Dumplings

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. In small bowl, combine soy sauce and sesame oil.
3. Place wonton wrappers on nonstick baking sheet.
4. With pastry brush, brush wontons evenly with soy mixture.
5. Sprinkle with sesame seed.
6. Bake 5 to 6 minutes or until golden brown.
7. Cool on wire rack.
8. Serves 4.
title: Baked Wontons

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch and pineapple juice until dissolved well. Bring water, vinegar and sugar to a boil.
2. Add first ingredients into hot liquid and cook until it is thick as desired.
3. Yield:
4. 4 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Sauce

steps: 1. In Dutch oven with tight fitting lid, bring blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cup water and dash of salt to boiling. Cover and simmer 5 minutes; add lemon juice. Stir together flour, 1/4 cup sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cut in butter until like coarse meal. Add milk; stir only until moistened. Drop from tablespoon into bubbling sauce, making 6 dumplings. Cover tightly; simmer 15 minutes without uncovering. Serve hot. Sprinkle with sugar, if desired. Serves 6.
title: Blueberry Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in shortening.
3. Add milk, carrots and parsley.
4. Stir until flour is moist.
5. Drop dumplings into simmering liquid in approximately 8 mounds (chicken or beef stock may be used).
6. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without lifting cover.
7. Serves 8 people.
title: Carrot Dumplings

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. green beans, sliced diagonally (may use one 10 oz. pkg. frozen beans)

steps: 1. Stir-fry beans, water chestnuts, mushrooms and garlic in oils. Add the remaining ingredients.
2. Cover and cook until beans are tender, about 4 to 5 minutes.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Green Beans With Water Chestnuts

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup rice vinegar (do not substitute for best results)

steps: 1. Mix the vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup, and soy sauce together and bring to a boil in a small pot. Mix together the cornstarch and water, add to the other ingredients and stir to thicken.
2. For a thicker sauce, increase the cornstarch to 5 teaspoons.
title: Easy Sweet And Sour Sauce For Chicken Or Pork

steps: 1. Combine sugar, vinegar and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan on medium heat. Stir until sugar has dissolved.
2. Add hoisin sauce; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, for 5 mins, or until thickened slightly. Remove from the heat and stir in nuts.
title: Hoisin And Peanut Dipping Sauce

steps: 1. Simmer vinegar, hoisin sauce, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small heavy saucepan, uncovered, stirring frequently, until reduced to about 1 1/2 cups, 20 to 25 minutes.
2. Remove from heat and stir in butter until melted.
title: Balsamic Hoisin Sauce

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 cups white wine (substitute with red wine if you like)
4 celery ribs, cut in 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Coat Beef in flour and add to the hot oil. Saute beef until browned on all sides. Add beef stock, water, wine, tomato paste, sugar, thyme, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, bay leaf, celery, onions and carrots. Do not add the parsley at this point!
2. Bring mixture to boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and simmer for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
3. Discard bay leaves.

4. Make dumplings according to recipe (see recipe description above for my suggested recipe--Recipe#30965). Roll into small bite size rounds and drop into stew. Continue to simmer for an additional 15 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.
title: Mmm Beef Stew & Dumplings

steps: 1. Stir the first 4 ingredients until mixed and melted, then add eggs one at a time, stirring in each one.
2. The mixture will be runny, so have your fire low and keep stirring until you start getting it lumpy.
3. Keep cooking until it is thick.
4. It takes a lot of stirring and elbow muscle.
5. (Mixture will turn a dull color so you will know it is done.)
6. After mixture is done, take a teaspoonful and dip it in boiling chicken broth.
7. Cover; it takes about 20 minutes per kettle.
8. (I usually put in about 12 to 18 dumplings at a time.)
9. Once in awhile, I will put in that instant chicken broth in my dumpling mixture to give it more taste.
10. When I do that, I add about 1 teaspoon of milk.
title: Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Make a rich dough using flour, baking powder, lard and milk. Roll like a pie crust and cut into 6 equal parts.
2. Boil water, sugar, cinnamon and butter together.
3. Fill each piece of dough with quartered red apples (pared and cored), sugar and cinnamon. Pinch edges together and place in greased baking dish.
4. Pour boiling mixture over dumpling.
5. Bake until apples are tender in a 350° oven.
title: Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix until thick and sticky.
2. Drop into boiling water by small teapsoonfuls.
3. Cook about 3 minutes.
4. Add to sauerkraut and cook with sauerkraut until done.
title: Sauerkraut Dumplings

steps: 1. Heat the milk and butter in a medium sized saucepan and on medium heat, bring to a boil.
2. Once at a boil turn off heat and add the nutmeg, salt and flour.
3. Stir until thick and the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a compact mass.
4. Set aside and let cool for around a half an hour you don't want to cook the eggs.
5. When it is cool beat the eggs in one at a time.
6. Drop into hot soup and cover for ten to fifteen minutes.
7. They are done when they've risen to the top and doubled in size.
title: Danish Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour and salt together. Mix shortening in flour mixture. Add about 3/4 cup milk and mix. Roll thin. Cut in strips. Store in refrigerator for about 2 hours. Drop in boiling broth, either chicken or turkey. Cook for 6 or 7 minutes without stirring.
title: Rolled Dumplings

steps: 1. Place apples, butter, milk, sugar and cinnamon into a large pot.
2. Cover with cold water.
3. Cook at slow boil until apples are done. Turn up heat to medium, stirring often.
4. Tear biscuits into pieces and drop in boiling mixture.
5. Reduce heat to low. Stir often.
6. Cook until biscuits are done.
title: "Granny Decie'S Apple Dumplings"

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients to make soft dough.
2. Divide into two parts.
3. Roll very thin and let dry 15 to 20 minutes.
4. Cut into strips or 2-inch squares and drop into simmering chicken broth. Cook until done or 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Good Dumplings

ingredients.text: 30 chicken wings (discard tips and cut in 2 segments)

steps: 1. Combine ingredients.
2. Marinate chicken at least 1 hour, turning often.
3. Place on broiler pan (lined with foil for easy cleanup).
4. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, basting often, turning once.
5. Also good on outdoor grill.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Cut up and remove skin from chicken.
2. Place in a large pan. Add water, salt, celery and onion.
3. Simmer for 2 hours or until meat is tender.
4. Remove chicken meat from the bone.
5. Return chicken to stock.
6. Bring chicken and stock to a boil.
7. Add dumplings.
8. Cover and boil gently 8 to 10 minutes (remove celery and onions from stock).
9. This is a diabetic recipe.
10. It is very good.
title: Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Divide dough into 10 portions.
2. Roll dough thin.
3. Fill with apple slices and place in baking dish.
4. Pour hot syrup over them and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
5. May put 6 red hots in each.
title: Apple Dumplings

ingredients.text: 5 pounds chicken wings, split and tips discarded

steps: 1. Stir the soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic powder together in a saucepan over medium heat; cook and stir until the sugar melts completely. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

2. Place the chicken wings in a large bowl. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the wings and toss to coat evenly. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Allow chicken to marinate in refrigerator overnight or 8 hours.
3. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
4. Pour the chicken wings and marinade into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.
5. Bake in the preheated oven until thoroughly hot, about 45 minutes. Remove the aluminum foil from the baking dish and continue baking uncovered another 15 minutes. Serve hot.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Mix flour, shortening and milk.
2. Roll out.
3. Place apples down center of dough.
4. Fold dough over.
5. Cut in 1-inch thick slices. Place in buttered pan.
6. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil.
7. Pour over dumplings.
8. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
title: Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix flour and salt together.
2. Set aside.
3. Put water and butter on stove until butter is melted.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Then pour water/butter into flour mixture.
6. Mix together.
7. Set aside or refrigerate until cool, then knead and roll out and cut, then add to boiling broth.
title: Homemade Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a jar with tight fitting lid. Shake well.
2. Refrigerate.
title: Italian Sweet And Sour Dressing

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Let stand to cool and refrigerate for several hours.
title: Prize-Winning Freezer Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine baking mix, cornmeal and parsley.
2. Add milk and corn, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.
3. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto your favorite simmering chili.
4. Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 minutes.
5. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer or until dumplings are dry.
title: Corn Dumplings

steps: 1. Place cut-up fryer in enough water to cover it all.
2. Add salt, pepper and onion.
3. Boil until tender, but not falling apart. Remove chicken from broth, but save broth.
4. Skim off excess fat.
title: Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Wash and cut up greens. In a large pot, bring 3 c water to a boil. If you wish, add ham hocks or pig tails for seasoning. Cook greens for about 45 minutes. Add an additional 3 c water. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes. Make dumplings by combining cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt in a medium bowl. Slowly pour in warm milk (warm water can be added if milk is not available) Stir between additions. Dough should be slightly moist but not soupy. Scoop up mixture in large spoon. Shape into a small biscuit with finger tips. Drop dumplings on top of the greens and reduce heat to simmer. Cover and steam for 30 minutes or until dumplings are done. Use a dome lid to encourage steam.
title: Mustards & Cornmeal Dumplings

steps: 1. Remove wing tips.
2. Cut wings in half through joint.
3. In large bowl, stir soy sauce and rest of ingredients.
4. Add chicken.
5. Toss and coat well.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
7. Place wings in jelly roll pan.
8. Bake, uncovered, in 375° oven for 45 minutes. Brush twice with marinade.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Mix ingredients.
2. Chill if desired and serve.
3. Makes 4 2 tablespoon servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Separate the chicken wings, discarding the tips.
2. Combine all ingredients in a Ziplock bag.
3. Marinate in the fridge for an hour.
4. Place wings on a baking sheet.
5. Broil a few inches from the heat on high until browned.
6. Flip and continue to broil until the skin is crispy. If the heat is too high, move to a lower rack.
title: Amazing Chinese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Broil chicken until tender; remove chicken from broth and debone.
2. The remaining broth is for your dumplings.
3. Mix flour, egg yolks, shortening, milk, broth and 1 teaspoon salt together. Mixture will be like a dough.
4. Add additional water, if necessary. Add 1/2 stick of margarine to the remaining broth.
5. Roll out the dumplings in flour; cut in strips.
6. As you put the dumplings in the broth, pull them a little so that they won't be too thick. Add the deboned chicken.
7. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes.
8. Yum, yum!
title: Chicken Dumplings

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. fresh vegetables, chopped (carrots, celery, water chestnuts, snow peas, broccoli, etc.)

steps: 1. In a wok, heat peanut oil on high.
2. Stir-fry vegetables until crisp, placing the veggies that take the longest to cook in the middle of the wok until somewhat crisp.
3. Then push the veggies out of the middle and up the walls of the wok to make room for the next veggie to go in the middle.
4. Keep going in this manner until the last veggie has been added.
5. Broccoli should be steamed and does not take long to cook, so it should be the last veggie you add. Add water to veggies and cover to steam until done.
6. Add meat and cornstarch to mix.
7. Stir until thick.
8. Add cashew nuts.
9. Serve over rice.
title: Cashew Chicken Chinese

steps: 1. In plastic bag, dredge chicken in flour, salt and pepper.
2. In skillet in oil, brown chicken.
3. Take out chicken and brown onion. Add leftover flour.
4. Add broth, 3 tablespoons of lemon juice and thyme.
5. Return chicken and cook until chicken is cooked.
6. Sprinkle parsley on top.
7. Garnish with lemon wedges.
title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme

ingredients.text: diced green onions and tops (1 bunch)

steps: 1. Beat all together; fry in oil like pancakes.
2. Serve with brown gravy.
title: Egg Foo Yong

ingredients.text: 12 asparagus spears, broken off at soft spot, tallowy ends discarded
4 large green onions, chopped, white and green parts separated

steps: 1. Using an electric wok at high setting, heat 2 tbsp oil, 1/2 tbsp ginger and 2 tbsp garlic, until sizzling.
2. Cook shrimp until heated through, drizzle with 1/4 tsp onion salt. Set aside.
3. Clean wok and add 2 tbsp oil, 1/2 tbsp ginger and 2 tbsp garlic and bring to a sizzle at high heat.
4. Add celery, broccoli, asparagus and green pepper, cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Toss in the mushrooms and white part of green onions and cook for 3 minutes.
6. Toss in the green part of green onion and the baby bok choy and 1/4 tsp onion salt and cook for another 2 minutes.
7. Add cooked shrimp, toss and serve over rice or noodles or by itself.
title: Bea'S Shrimp And Green Veggie Stir Fry With Mushrooms

steps: 1. MARINADE: In small mixing bowl, stir bouillon cube into boiling water until cube is dissolved; then add remaining ingredients, except pork; mix well.
2. Place pork steaks in resealable 1-gallon storage or freezer bag; add marinade and seal bag.
3. Refrigerate at least 2 hours up to overnight, turning meat occasionally.
4. Prepare outdoor grill.
5. Grill the pork steaks 4 inches from coals, 12-15 minutes on each side or until juices run clear.
6. Baste the steaks frequently with marinade while cooking.
title: Mandarin Grilled Pork Steaks

ingredients.text: 1 (1 1/2 lb) beef tenderloin, trimmed, cut into 1/4 inch slices, pounded slightly
2 None medium Spanish onions, cut into thin wedges

steps: 1. Whisk together sugar, cornstarch, soy sauce, oyster sauce and 1 tbsp sherry in a medium bowl. Add beef and turn to coat in marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight.
2. Heat 2 tsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry onions until just tender then remove from wok.
3. Add remaining oil to wok. Stir-fry beef, in batches, until browned. Return all beef to wok along with remaining sherry, onions and bean sprouts. Stir-fry until combined.
title: Cantonese Style Beef Tenderloin

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Bake chicken in foil.
3. Salt and pepper to taste, dot with margarine and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
4. Cut chicken in bite size pieces.
5. Pour water into skillet.
6. Heat on medium high.
7. Add frozen vegetables and sliced chestnuts.
8. Add wine and soy sauce; gently stir in chicken.
9. Continue to stir until all food items are well coated.
10. Cover with lid; cook until all liquid has evaporated.
11. Stir occasionally.
12. Serve immediately.
title: Simple Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan.
2. Add remaining ingredients and saute for about 30 minutes, until meat is tender.
3. Serve over hot rice.
title: Stir-Fry Venison

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 bunch green onion, cut into 1-inch lengths

steps: 1. Combine 2 tablespoons cornstarch and 1 tablespoons soy sauce in small bowl; stir in chicken. Let stand 30 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, combine sugar, 2-1/2 teaspoons cornstarch, lemon peel and juice, remaining 3 tablespoons soy sauce and 1/4 cup water.
3. Heat oil in hot wok over high heat, Or if using skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and green onions; stir-fry 3 minutes. Remove.

4. Reduce heat to medium-high. Pour soy sauce mixture into wok; bring to boil. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Add chicken and green onions, stirring to coat all pieces well with sauce. Serve immediately.
title: Stir Fry Empress Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. Place rinsed and dried chicken on a tray. Rub butter all over the chicken, top and bottom, then season evenly with salt and pepper to taste.
3. Pour the pineapple juice and orange juice in the tray, not directly over the chicken.
4. Bake chicken uncovered in the preheated oven for 1 1/2 hours, basting every 5 to 10 minutes with the juices. When it is done it should be a perfect golden brown.
title: Perfect Pineapple Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Spread cornstarch into a wide, shallow bowl. Dredge flank steak in the cornstarch to coat completely; put into a large resealable plastic bag.
2. Stir water, soy sauce, brown sugar, carrots, green onions, olive oil, garlic, and ginger together in a bowl; pour into the bag with the beef and seal.
3. Put bag of marinating beef in the freezer until the day before you wish to prepare it.
4. Remove bag from freezer and put bag into a bowl and place in refrigerator to thaw, at least 24 hours before you wish to prepare the beef.
5. Empty bag into the crock of a slow cooker.
6. Cook on High until the beef is tender, 2 to 3 hours. Alternately, you can cook this on Low for 4 to 5 hours.
title: Mongolian Beef From The Slow Cooker

steps: 1. Peel pumpkin, remove seeds, wash and cube.
2. Heat oil in a large pan, stir fry garlic, ginger and green onions until fragrant (2-3 minutes).
3. Add pumpkin, sprinkle in sugar and saute for about 8-10 minutes until the pumpkin is soft.
4. Add in chicken stock and fish sauce, bring to a boil.
5. Then reduce heat and let it simmer for about 15 minutes.
6. The pumpkin will be a little mushy at this point.
7. Stir in preserve evenly, sprinkle with pepper and serve with jasmine rice (or just eat by itself).
title: Oriental Pumpkin Stir Fry

steps: 1. Brown beef.
2. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour into casserole.
3. Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
title: Chow Mein

steps: 1. Saute chicken in a large skillet until lightly browned, about 7 to 10 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.

2. In a medium bowl combine the flour, broth, juice, marmalade and pepper. Mix together. Heat mixture in a medium saucepan over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly. Add chicken and cook over low heat for 4 minutes.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Cut chicken breasts into strips or chunks.
2. Cook chicken and onion in 1 Tbsp. oil until done.
3. Add the cooked rice.
4. Add soy sauce, salt and pepper.
5. Stir together.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix all dry ingredients.
2. Add dates, nuts and eggs (beaten light).
3. Bake at 375° in as thin a sheet as it will spread for approximately 15 minutes.
4. Cut in small squares.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 12 ounces chicken breasts, cooked and cubed
2 cups chicken broth, low sodium, low or 2 cups no fat

steps: 1. Saute celery, bok choy, onion, garlic and snow peas in oil.
2. When tender/crisp add broth and bean sprouts.
3. Simmer until sprouts are soft.
4. Increase heat to boil, add chicken and soy sauce.
5. Add corn starch mixed with a small amount of cold water, stir until thickened.
title: Chicken Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb potatoes, peeled, cut into wedges
2 oz preserved lemon, cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large, heavy-based saucepan or tagine over high heat. Saute chicken in batches for 2 mins per side, until golden. Set aside. Reduce heat to medium and saute onion and garlic for 3 mins, until onion is soft. Add turmeric and cumin and cook for 1 min, until fragrant.

2. Return chicken to pan and cover with 2 1/2 cups water. Bring to a boil then simmer for 25 mins, covered, until chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken and keep warm. Add potatoes and cook for 12-15 mins, until potato is tender.
3. Meanwhile, place olives in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil then drain. Repeat process.
4. Return chicken to pan along with olives, preserved lemon, lemon juice and parsley. Serve immediately.
title: Lemon Chicken And Green Olive Tagine

steps: 1. Wash the cooked spaghetti, make sure it is damp.
2. Prepare broccoli florets. Peel and slice carrot. Slice button mushrooms into thin slices. Chop up garlic cloves.
3. Heat up some olive oil in a wok. When hot, pour out excess oil from wok. (I don't like my food oily, so I do this; but it's optional.).

4. Fry 1/2 of the chopped garlic until fragrant. Add carrots and stir-fry, making sure heat is evenly spread. After about a minute, add broccoli florets. Stir-fry for a few minutes, until broccoli begins to darken, and then add the mushrooms and continue stir-frying for about a minute.
5. Turn heat down and add 1/2 cup water to the wok. Add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp mirin sauce. Continue stir-frying for a couple of minutes.
6. Turn the stove off and cover the wok with a lid to make sure it remains warm.
7. Prepare another wok by heating up some olive oil. Pour out any excess oil.
8. Fry the rest of the garlic until fragrant. Add the spaghetti and stir-fry, making sure to mix well.
9. Add 2 tbsp soy sauce (or to taste) and mix well. Turn heat down a little bit and add 1/4 cup water. Continue stir-frying for a few minutes before turning your stove off.
10. Pour spaghetti and the spaghetti's 'sauce' into a plate. Add the vegetable stir-fry on top, making sure that the vegetable stir fry's sauce is also added inches.
11. Serve hot.

steps: 1. Cut meat lengthwise into long strips about 3 inches thick and wide. Place in a wide frying pan with the water, soy, sherry, sugar, salt, star anise, ginger, onions and chile peppers. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer turning meat occasionally for 30 minutes.

2. Remove meat from cooking liquid, cool, and chill for at least 1 hour or until firm. Thinly slice meat across the grain. Return meat slices to cooking liquid. Cook, uncovered, over medium heat, turning slices occasionally until all liquid is absorbed (about 50 minutes) Turn meat more frequently as liquid is absorbed. Discard onion, ginger, and star anise.

3. Arrange strips of meat slightly apart in a single layer on cooky sheets. Bake, uncovered, in a 300 degree F oven until dry to the touch but still pliable (about 20 minutes) Pat dry any beads of oil with paper towels, let cool thoroughly. Place in plastic bag, seal, and store in refrigerator up to 2 months.

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons curry powder (only buy from the chinese grocery store, don't use authentic)
2 tablespoons fresh ginger (cut in large slices, take out later)

steps: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan and add the garlic and ginger. When they begin to smell fragrant, add the onions.
2. Stir until they have gone soft, then remove to a platter.
3. Turn up the heat on the pan and - if necessary - add a little more oil.
4. Add the chicken and leave on the heat without stirring for as long as you can bear.
5. When the chicken smells delicious and is starting to achieve a nice brown crust, you can stir briefly to brown the other side.
6. The more patient you are, the more flavor the chicken will have.
7. Once the chicken is browned to your satisfaction, put the garlic, onion and leek mixture back in the pan.
8. Stir in the curry powder and let the mix cook for a few minutes to bring out the flavor of the curry.
9. Stir in the coconut milk and the soy sauce.
10. Add the carrots and allow to simmer for five minutes.
11. Then add the peas.
12. Simmer for five minutes and then add the broccoli and tomatoes.
13. Bring the mixture back to heat and simmer for another 8-10 minutes, until the broccoli goes bright green and the rest of the vegetables are tender. Serve over steamed rice immediately.
title: Chinese Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried thyme

steps: 1. Grate enough peel from lemon to make 1 tbsp (15 mL). Remove any remaining peel and white pith from lemon and cut flesh into thin slices.

2. Separate garlic into cloves, cut off root ends but do not peel. Add to chicken stock in a pot and bring to boil. Simmer three minutes. Strain stock and reserve. Peel garlic cloves. If garlic cloves are large, cut in half lengthways.
3. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).

4. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Season breasts with salt, pepper and thyme, and fry skin-side-down four to five minutes or until golden brown. Turn over and fry second side for one minute. Remove breasts.
5. Place skin-side-up in oiled ovenproof dish that fits chicken snugly. Discard fat from skillet.
6. Scatter lemon slices and garlic cloves around chicken. Sprinkle sugar on lemon slices.
7. Meanwhile, add wine to skillet, bring to boil, reduce by half.
8. Stir in stock, brandy and grated zest and bring to a boil, stirring.
9. Add cream and continue to boil until slightly thickened, about five to eight minutes.
10. Stir in parsley.

11. Bake chicken for 15 to 20 minutes or until it is tender but not dry. Remove chicken and any lemon bits to serving platter. Scatter over garlic cloves. Remove any fat and pour any juices into sauce.
12. To serve, pour sauce over chicken.

steps: 1. TO MAKE SUSHI ROLLS: Pat out some rice. Lay a nori sheet on the mat, shiny-side down. Dip your hands in the vinegared water, then pat handfuls of rice on top in a 1cm thick layer, leaving the furthest edge from you clear.
2. Spread over some Japanese mayonnaise. Use a spoon to spread out a thin layer of mayonnaise down the middle of the rice.
3. Add the filling. Get your child to top the mayonnaise with a line of their favourite fillings – here we’ve used tuna and cucumber.
4. Roll it up. Lift the edge of the mat over the rice, applying a little pressure to keep everything in a tight roll.
5. Stick down the sides like a stamp. When you get to the edge without any rice, brush with a little water and continue to roll into a tight roll.
6. Wrap in cling film. Remove the mat and roll tightly in cling film before a grown-up cuts the sushi into thick slices, then unravel the cling film.
7. TO MAKE PRESSED SUSHI: Layer over some smoked salmon. Line a loaf tin with cling film, then place a thin layer of smoked salmon inside on top of the cling film.
8. Cover with rice and press down. Press about 3cm of rice over the fish, fold the cling film over and press down as much as you can, using another tin if you have one.
9. Tip it out like a sandcastle. Turn block of sushi onto a chopping board. Get a grown-up to cut into fingers, then remove the cling film.

10. TO MAKE SUSHI BALLS: Choose your topping. Get a small square of cling film and place a topping, like half a prawn or a small piece of smoked salmon, on it. Use damp hands to roll walnut-sized balls of rice and place on the topping.
11. Make into tight balls. Bring the corners of the cling film together and tighten into balls by twisting it up, then unwrap and serve.

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine ingredients and mix until smooth. Let stand for 15 minutes.
title: Tempura

steps: 1. Measure flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in a bowl.
2. Add beaten eggs and water.
3. When adding water, start off by adding 2 1/2 cups water.
4. If the batter is too thick, add more water.
title: Tempura Batter

steps: 1. In a shallow dish, combine the soy sauce, vinegar, honey and garlic powder. Place chops in dish, and turn to coat. Cover, and marinate for 2 to 4 hours in the refrigerator.
2. Preheat grill to high heat, and lightly oil grate.
3. Grill steaks 5 to 8 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.
title: Easy Teriyaki Chops

steps: 1. Place berries, lemongrass, sugar, water and ginger in a medium pot and bring to a gentle simmer.
2. Cook for about 7 minutes, or until the berries begin to break down.
3. Remove from heat and place the contents of the pot, along with soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil in a blender and pulse to combine.
