2. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add potato, onion, celery, ginger, and garlic; cook 5 minutes or until celery and onion are tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in lemongrass, sugar, fish sauce, and clam juice. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes or until potato is tender.
3. Stir in zucchini, clams, and chiles. Bring to a boil; cook 2 minutes. Stir in coconut milk, lime juice, and cilantro; remove from heat. Remove lemongrass; discard.
title: Vietnamese Clam Chowder

ingredients.text: 1/2 head of a small cabbage, shredded

steps: 1. Mix the fish sauce and lime juice together and toss all the ingredients. Taste and season with more fish sauce is needed. Enjoy cold!
title: Vietnamese Chicken & Cabbage Salad

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 pinch ground white pepper, or to taste
1 pound T-bone steak, sliced lengthwise into 1 1/2-inch strips
1 pound bean sprouts, or to taste

steps: 1. Combine beef stock, chicken stock, lime juice, onion, cilantro, basil, lemongrass paste, red pepper flakes, cumin, garam masala, ginger, and white pepper in a stockpot. Add steak and shrimp; simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

2. While soup is cooking, prepare noodles about 30 minutes into the process. Bring a separate pot of water to a boil and add noodles. Boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 6 minutes. Drain, rinse, and add to the soup. Stir in bean sprouts and season with salt.
title: Jessica'S Not-Quite-Ghetto Pho

ingredients.text: Optional For Garnish: Lime Wedges, Mung Bean Sprouts, Chopped Peanuts And Thin Ginger Strips

steps: 1. Put the basil, mint, cilantro and leek in a food processor and blend until they're chopped.
2. Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot, and then add the chopped greens, plus the pak choi and the rice noodles. Turn heat down to a simmer and cook for around 5 minutes.
3. Pour the soup onto individual bowls and garnish with lime wedges, mung bean sprouts, chopped peanuts and thin ginger strips.
title: Pho Bo

ingredients.text: 1 cup torn herbs (cilantro, mint, basil, etc.)
1/2 Thai bird chili, minced (or 3/4 tsp siracha sauce)

steps: 1. Put melon, herbs, sprouts and chili in a bowl.
2. Make a dressing:
3. Dissolve sugar in 2 tbsp warm water. Whisk in garlic, ginger, lime and oil.
4. Dress salad, season with salt, then toss. Arrange on plate and sprinkle with peanuts.
title: Vietnamese Watermelon Salad

ingredients.text: 1 medium yellow onion, cut in half and unpeeled
1 small piece of fresh ginger, unpeeled

steps: 1. Char the ginger and onion by placing them over an open flame, hot griddle, or under the broiler (~8 minutes).
2. In a pan, dry roast the spices (~2 minutes) and stir to prevent burning. This will bring out the flavor!
3. Peel and scrape away the charred skin of the onion and ginger.

4. In a large pot, add 8 cups of homemade chicken stock. Place spices in a spice bag. Add the spices, ginger, onion, sugar, and cooking fish sauce into the pot. Cover and bring to a boil and then reduce heat to medium low (~30 minutes). Remove spice bag. Add your shredded chicken pieces.
5. Add cooked rice noodles to the soup bowls. Ladle chicken broth over the noodles. Serve with lime wedges and cilantro.
title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup (Pho Ga)

ingredients.text: fresh spinach, rinsed and cut into 3 inch stalks
1 large tomatoes, sliced into thin wedges

steps: 1. Trim any fat from steak. Sliced thinly, against the grain.
2. Chop onion finely and combine with meat, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce and cornstarch, set aside 10mins.
3. Heat 1 TB oil in a wok/skillet. Add the meat mixture and stir fry until meat is cooked. Remove from pan, set aside.
4. Heat remaining 1 TB oil in the pan, stir fry the garlic until fragrant.Add spinach and stir fry for 3 minutes.
5. Add remaining fish sauce and tomato.
6. Stir fry 2 minutes, then add the meat to the pan and give the mixture a good stir.
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 tsp pepper and serve immediately with jasmine rice and other dishes if desired.
title: Rau Muong Xao (Made With Spinach)

steps: 1. Bring a pot of water to the boil and cook rice noodles for 3 minutes. Be fairly generous with the amount of water like you are cooking pasta.
2. Remove from heat, allow to rest a few minutes, drain and place in a bowl.
3. Toss through salmon, olive oil, capers, mushroom, cabbage, soy sauce, chilli sauce and pepper and leave to cool in refrigerator for 10 minutes. You could also do in advance and leave longer.
4. Soak rice paper sheets in warm water a few minutes until soft.
5. Place mixture evenly in middle of rice paper sheets using a fork so any excess liquid is left behind.
6. Wrap by folding end closing and furthest away from you inwards, and then wrap around the outside pieces to form a roll.
7. Lightly pour a little left-over sauce over the top and serve.
title: Smoked Salmon Rice Paper Wraps

ingredients.text: 2 stalks fresh lemongrass (each 12 to 18 inches long)
2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves
2 tablespoons asian fish sauce (nam pla or nuoc mam)

steps: 1. In an 1 to 10-quart pan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, pull off and discard course outer layers from lemon grass and trim off and discard stem ends. Cut each stalk into about 3-inch lengths. With the flat side of a knife, lightly crush lemon grass and ginger. Cut one or two chilies in half lengthwise (use two if you'd like it spicy); stem remaining chilies (seed, if desired, for less heat), finely chop and reserve. Add lemon grass, ginger, and halved chilies to boiling broth. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 30 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, rinse cabbage and cut into shreds about 1/4 inch wide and 2 to 3 inches long. Rinse mushrooms, trim off and discard stem ends and discolored parts, and slice lengthwise 1/4 inch thick. Peel carrots and slice 1/4 inch thick. Rinse chicken and cut into 1/4-inch thick slices 1 1/2 to 2 inches long.
3. With a slotted spoon, remove and discard lemon grass, ginger and chilies from broth.
4. Add cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, and garlic to broth; cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender when pierced, 8 to 10 minutes.

5. Add chicken and tomatoes with their juice. Cover and cook over high heat until chicken is no longer pink in the center (cut to test). This will take about 3 to 5 minutes. Add lemon juice and fish sauce to taste. Sprinkle with green onions.
6. Place rice, lemon wedges, cilantro and chopped chilies in separate bowls and offer with soup to add to taste.
title: Lemon Grass Chicken Soup

steps: 1. Finely slice a quarter of the chilli, then put the rest in a food processor with the ginger, garlic, coriander stalks and one-third of the leaves. Whizz to a rough paste with a splash of water if needed.

2. Heat the oil in a frying pan, then quickly brown the chicken chunks for 1 min. Stir in the paste for another min, then add the peanut butter, stock and yogurt. When the sauce is gently bubbling, cook for 10 mins until the chicken is just cooked through and sauce thickened. Stir in most of the remaining coriander, then scatter the rest on top with the chilli, if using. Eat with rice or mashed sweet potato.
title: Nutty Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Heat butter in a large skillet. Brown chicken on all sides. Add mushrooms, lemon and Amaretto. Simmer 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring over low heat until thickened. Serve over rice with pea pods and tomatoes. Serves 6.
title: Chicken-Amaretto Curry

steps: 1. Mix together first eight ingredients.
2. Marinate chicken in mixture for at least 30 minutes, but preferably a few hours. Refrigerate.
3. Cook onion in shortening until it begins to color. If using mushrooms, add at this time and tomato and bay leaves. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Add chicken and marinade and mix together.
5. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 800 g lean meat, cut into 3cm pieces

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except oil, onion and meat. Leave standing while you cook the onions.
2. Heat oil in medium to large pot and add onions. Stir until onions are soft.
3. Add vindaloo mix to pot and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
4. Add meat and mix so that it is covered with the vindaloo mix. Add 1/2 C water.
5. Simmer, covered, over low heat for about 1 1/4 hours or until meat is tender.
title: Easy 5 Step Chicken, Pork, Beef Or Lamb Vindaloo

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients, except almonds.
2. Pour over chicken breasts; cover with foil.
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 1/2 hour.
4. Uncover; baste.
5. Add almonds and bake 10 minutes more.
title: Chicken Curry Bake

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container.
2. The important thing here is that all ingredients are present in equal parts - feel free to make as much or little of this as you need; don't be limited by the measurements given above!
title: Homemade Curry Powder

steps: 1. Sift together flours.
2. Cut in butter and oil.
3. Knead until smooth and glossy.
4. Cut into 96 balls.
5. Roll out and flatten then fill with meat mixture.
6. Bake at 400 for 10 inches Let cool.
title: Ground Beef Curry Pasty

steps: 1. Put cooked broccoli in 2-quart casserole dish. Put chicken on top.
title: Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 (3 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Place the chicken breasts in the hot oil and cook until browned on one side, about 3 minutes. Flip the chicken and add the onions; cook another 2 minutes. Add the tomatoes, garlic salt, and water to the chicken; stir. Season with 1 1/2 teaspoon garam masala. Bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

2. Stir the remaining 1/2 teaspoon garam masala through the mixture. Raise heat to medium and bring mixture to a boil. Cook until the chicken no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 5 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
title: Garam Masala Chicken

steps: 1. In a large kettle, saute onion and garlic in oil and butter. Add ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and salt.
2. Stir 1 minute.
3. Add chicken and brown.
4. Stir in sour cream.
5. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
6. Then cover and cook on low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add raisins and lemon juice.
7. Cook for 10 more minutes.
8. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Chicken Korma

steps: 1. Dry-roast the cumin, coriander, cardamom, and cloves in a skillet until lightly browned, 1 or 2 minutes. When cool, combine with the black pepper and cinnamon in a spice grinder and grind to a powder. Mix with the cayenne pepper and pour into an airtight container. Store in a cool, dry place for up to several months if not using immediately.
2. Note: To make a paste, stir a bit of tepid water into the spice mixture.
title: Garam Masala

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb carrots, peeled and finely chopped
1 lb chicken breast, cut into small cubes
1 None onion, peeled and finely diced

steps: 1. Cook the beans and carrots in boiling salted water for about 10 mins. Drain. Cook the macaroni in boiling salted water according to the package directions. Drain.

2. Heat the oil in a pan and saute the chicken and onion for about 5 mins. Season to taste and sprinkle with curry powder and flour. Pour in the milk and stock, bring to a boil then simmer for about 5 mins. Add the beans and carrots. Add a little more curry powder to taste and serve with the pasta.
title: Chicken Curry With Macaroni

ingredients.text: 3 1/2 ounces cod, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Combine curry powder, ground ginger, and ground turmeric in a skillet; toast the spices over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Pour olive oil and garlic into the spice mixture and stir to make a paste.

2. Stir onion into the spice mixture; cook and stir until the onion is tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir about half the coconut milk and half the water into the onion mixture; simmer together for 5 minutes. Add cod to the mixture; continue cooking until the fish is firm, about 5 minutes. Add tomato, remaining coconut milk, and remaining water to the skillet; cook until the tomato is softened, about 5 minutes.
title: Coconut Fish Curry

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. cooked chicken, cut up

steps: 1. In a large skillet, add all ingredients, keep stirring, until hot.
2. Add chicken; heat over low heat until hot.
3. Serve with hot rice and Mango Chutney.
title: Quick Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook and stir onion, curry powder, and dry mustard in the hot oil until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, garlic, garam masala, cumin, and salt; simmer over medium-low heat until tomatoes have broken down and ingredients have blended, about 40 minutes.
2. Cook and stir chicken into tomato mixture until chicken is cooked and no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. Add peas and cook for 1 more minute. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cilantro.
title: East Indian Chicken With Tomato, Peas, And Cilantro

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 lbs chicken (cut up into approx 2 in. pieces)

steps: 1. Wash chicken with vinegar and cold water in a pot or kitchen sink.
2. Combine chicken with all dry ingredients into a bowl and rub into chicken.
3. Pour cooking oil and 2 teaspoons curry powder into pot and place over high heat until the oil is hot.
4. Reduce flame/heat and add chicken to hot oil. add enough water to cover chicken.
5. Add diced potatoes and remaining ingredients, then cover pot to simmer for about 15 minutes.
6. Allow chicken to cook, stirring occasionally. Allow "gravy" to thicken with pot uncovered on low heat.
7. Serve over white rice or Rice & Peas.
title: Jamaican Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 whole boneless chicken breasts, skinned and halved lengthwise

steps: 1. Rinse chicken.
2. Coat chicken pieces with flour.
3. In a skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
4. Drain bacon on paper toweling; crumble and set aside.
5. Reserve drippings.
6. Add chicken to skillet; slowly brown chicken on all sides in hot drippings about 10 minutes. Transfer chicken to an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
7. Bake chicken, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
8. Combine honey, mustard, salt and curry powder.
9. Drizzle over chicken in baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 5 to 10 minutes more.
10. Top with crumbled bacon.
title: Curry Chicken Delight(Makes 8 Servings)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk eggs, milk, curry powder, salt, pepper and, if desired, cardamom until blended.
2. Place a
3. coated with cooking spray over medium heat. Pour in egg mixture; cook and stir until eggs are thickened and no liquid egg remains. Serve with tomatoes.
title: Curry Scramble

steps: 1. Place potatoes, carrots and green beans in the cold water. Allow to soak while you prepare the rest of the vegetables; drain.
2. In a microwave safe dish place the potatoes, carrots, green beans, peas, salt and turmeric. Cook for 8 minutes.

3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook mustard seeds and cumin; when seeds start to sputter and pop, add the onion and saute until transparent. Stir in the tomatoes, garam masala, ginger, garlic and chili powder; saute 3 minutes. Add the cooked vegetables to the tomato mixture and saute 1 minute. Garnish with cilantro leaves.
title: Vegetable Masala

steps: 1. Dip chicken in sauce.
2. Place in casserole dish skin side up.
3. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour, basteing every 15 minutes.
title: Super Easy Honey Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 2/3 cup fresh pineapple, peeled and chopped
24 shrimp, jumbo, raw, shelled and deveined (leave tailshell on)

steps: 1. In a large pot add the pineapple, coconut cream, curry paste, fish sauce and sugar.
2. Cook on medium high heat, but do not boil.
3. Add the shrimp and cilantro and simmer until the shrimp turn a bright pink color, about 3 - 5 minutes.
4. Serve over top the cellaphane noodles and garnish with fresh basil.
title: Pineapple Curry With Jumbo Shrimps

steps: 1. Wash eggplant.
2. Beat remaining ingredients with beater until smooth.
3. Heat oil to 375° in a skillet.
4. Slice eggplant into 1/4-inch slices.
5. Dip slices into batter.
6. Let excess drip off. Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
title: Indian Fried Eggplant

ingredients.text: 1 chicken, cut up into small pieces

steps: 1. Wash chicken in 2 cups of water and vinegar.
2. Pat dry. Marinate chicken in black pepper, seasoned salt, garlic powder, soy sauce, thyme and curry powder for about 2 hours.
3. Heat cooking oil in skillet.
4. Place chicken in skillet until slightly brown. Add marinade along with 2 cups water, onions and potatoes.
5. Simmer on low heat until chicken is fully cooked.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Curry Chicken

steps: 1. Spoon each of the spices into a spice jar, put the lid on, and shake it well to mix.
2. OR, if you don't have such a jar on hand, mix by stirring in a small bowl.
title: Home Mixed Curry Powder

steps: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine cumin, coriander, turmeric, red pepper flakes, mustard seed, and ginger. Process to a fine powder. Store in an airtight container.
title: Mild Curry Powder

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Add the apple and the next 8 ingredients. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
2. Combine the cornstarch and chicken stock, stirring until smooth. Add to the apple mixture. Stir in the cooked chicken and raisins.
3. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium, stirring constantly until thickened. Serve over rice.
title: Low Calorie Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Heat oil in saucepan until it begins to smoke.
2. Add onions and saute until translucent.
3. Stir in curry powder, cumin, coriander, and cayenne and cook for 2 minutes.
4. Add mango, sugar, and water and cook until syrupy, about 10-12 minutes.
5. Season with salt to taste.
title: Mango Curry

steps: 1. Mix and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375°.
2. Cover and turn often.
title: Indian Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lb. chicken, cut into small portions

steps: 1. Mix first 8 ingredients in large bowl.
2. Mix in half the oil. Put remaining half of oil in a pot and wait until very hot, then put in chicken.
3. Cover and reduce heat.
4. Let simmer until cooked. Keep stirring so that chicken does not stick to pot.
5. Serve with rice.
title: Curry Chicken

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Cook as you would a pancake, the thinner, the better.
3. Fill with your own taco recipe.
title: Indian Taco Shells

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 pounds medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a small skillet, and place over medium-high heat. Cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly; stir in salt. Cool. Combine spice mixture and shrimp in a large zip-top plastic bag. Seal and marinate in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours.
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp mixture; saute 7 minutes or until shrimp are done.
3. Warm tortillas according to package directions. Spoon about 1/2 cup shrimp mixture down center of each tortilla; roll up.
title: Indian-Spiced Shrimp Wrap

steps: 1. Fry onions in butter.
2. Add spices, salt and tomato sauce.
3. Add chicken (with skin removed) and cook for 40 minutes, turning every 10 minutes.
4. Add 1 1/2 cups water and cook 10 to 12 minutes longer.
5. Add pepper and cool for 10 minutes.
6. Serve over rice or slices of bread.
title: Chicken Curry(Native American Style)

steps: 1. In a

2. , cook cashews over medium heat until toasted, about 4 minutes. Add the oil, curry powder, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, cumin and cayenne. Cook and stir for 2-4 minutes or until cashews are well coated. Spread on foil to cool completely. Stir in cranberries; store in an airtight container.
title: Curry Spiced Cashews

ingredients.text: 500 g almonds, blanched,peeled and ground in a mixer

steps: 1. Heat ghee in a thick-bottomed pan.
2. Add the ground almonds.
3. Stir until they become lightly browned.
4. Add the condensed milk.
5. Stir until it thickens and starts leaving the sides of the pan.
6. Remove onto a lightly greased serving tray.
7. Garnish with almonds and serve.
8. Enjoy!
title: Instant Indian Shahi Halwa

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds cooked medium shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook and stir onion and curry powder in hot butter until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Add flour, sugar, salt, and ginger; stir until completely incorporated.
2. Gradually pour milk and chicken broth into onion mixture, stirring constantly; cook and stir until mixture is hot and thickened. about 5 minutes.
3. Stir shrimp into milk mixture and cook until shrimp are heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in lemon juice.

4. Spread 2/3 cup cooked rice into a ring on a dinner plate. Spoon about 1 cup shrimp curry mixture into the center of the rice ring. Repeat with remaining rice and shrimp curry. Add condiments as desired.
title: Shrimp Curry (My Dear Mudder'S Version)

ingredients.text: 3 c. cooked chicken breasts, skinned, boned and shredded into large chunks

steps: 1. Melt butter; add onion and garlic and cook until tender.
2. Add remaining ingredients (except cooked chicken).
3. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
4. Add chicken; cover and heat.
5. Serve over hot rice.
title: Indian Chicken Curry

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, melt butter and saute onion, celery and apples for 5 minutes.
2. Stir in curry and flour.
3. Gradually stir in chicken broth, cream of coconut and half and half.
4. Stir over moderate heat until sauce bubbles and thickens.
5. Stir in chicken and season to taste with salt and pepper.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Indian Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Fry finely chopped onion in butter until brown.
2. Add all spices to yogurt and tomato sauce; mix well.
3. Pour spice mixture over chicken pieces.
4. Cover and bake in oven temperature of 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until well done.
5. A little water may have to be added to chicken while baking.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Mohines Chicken Curry(Chicken Curry Bombay)

steps: 1. Peel and dice onion, carrot and celery.

2. Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic in butter over low heat until soft. Stir in flour, curry powder, ginger, and salt; add chicken broth and cream, blend, and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
3. Add seafood and lemon juice and cook gently for 5 minutes. Do not allow to boil. Correct seasonings and add more curry powder if you like it hot.
4. Serve over hot cooked rice.
title: Seafood Curry

steps: 1. Place ingredients in a small dry skillet.
2. Heat over low heat, stirring, just until aromatic, but do not burn.
3. Cool, and store in an airtight container until needed, no more than 3 months.
title: Quick Garam Masala

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a saucepan.
2. Stir-fry green curry paste for one minute.
3. Add chicken and fish sauce.
4. Stir fry until chicken is done.
5. Add coconut milk and bring to boil.
6. Add sweet peas and green chilies.
7. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes.
8. Remove from heat.
9. Serve with rice.
title: Spicy Green Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1 cup butter, cut into small pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In medium bowl, stir together the flour, salt, and curry powder. Add butter and combine with fingers until it resembles a course meal. Add chives and cheeses. Work dough with fingertips until smooth. Divide dough in half. Roll out 1/2 of dough on a lightly floured work surface until 1/4 of an inch thick. Cut strips 1/4 inch wide and 5 inches long. Place strips on large
2. and bake for 20 minutes. Cool and transfer to plate. Repeat process with second half of dough. Serve warm.
title: Cheddar-Curry Cheese Straws With Fresh Chives

steps: 1. preheat oven to 350.
2. heat butter, honey, dijon mustard, and curry together in a pan.
3. place chicken in a baking dish and pour sauce over chicken.
4. bake for 50-55 mins.
title: Curry Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter; add cocoa and blend well.
2. Add sugar and then eggs (unbeaten), one at a time, beating each one well.
3. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Bake in a slow 300° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
5. Remove from oven and cut in squares.
6. Let cool before removing from the 8 x 8-inch pan.
title: Indians

steps: 1. Mix honey, mustard, salt, and curry powder. Dip chicken breast in mixture & place chicken side up on foil lined baking pan. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes to one hour, basting ever 15 minutes.
2. Server over rice with your favorite vegetable (I preferre brocolli
title: Honey - Curry Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy-bottomed 12-inch stainless steel skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add curry powder and shallot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shallot is soft and curry powder is fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to bowl along with mayonnaise and lemon juice. Stir well until mixed. Wipe out skillet.

2. Cut baguette diagonally into eight slices about six inches long and 1/4 inch wide. Brush one side of each with softened butter, and other with curry mayonnaise. Set four slices of bread, buttered-side down, on a cutting board. Divide the cheese amongst each, and top with sliced fennel. Cap each with remaining slices of bread, buttered-side up.
3. Set cleaned skillet over medium heat. When hot, add two sandwiches. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side until bread is golden brown and cheese melts. Repeat with remaining two sandwiches.
title: Dinner Tonight: Grilled Cheddar And Fennel Sandwiches With Curry Mayo Recipe

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped peeled granny smith apple
1 1/2 lbs large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add in apple and the next 3 ingredients; stir/saute for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.
3. Stir in flour and curry powder; cook and stir for 1 minute.
4. Gradually add in milk, raisins, and broth, stirring constantly using a whisk.
5. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
6. Lower heat and simmer for about 5 minutes or until thick.
7. Stir in shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook 3 minutes or until shrimp are done.
title: Shrimp And Apple Curry With Golden Raisins

steps: 1. 1, In a shallow bowl mix curry powder, coriander, cumin, ginger and 1/4 tsp of salt.
2. 2. Sprinkle spices evenly over chicken thighs.
3. 3. Heat olive oil in a pan. Add chicken and cook on meadium high for 6 minutes on each side.
4. 4. Meanwhile combine yogurt, cilantro, garlic and remaining 1/4 tsp of salt in a bowl.
5. 5. Serve chicken over a serving of couscous or brown rice with yogurt sauce.
title: Chicken Thighs With Indian Spices And Yogurt

steps: 1. Mix all together, and place in a small jar/bottle & store in a cool, dark place for up to 2 months.
title: Homemade Curry Powder

steps: 1. Stir curry powder in the center of a large, heavy frying pan over heat.
2. When hot, add garlic.
3. Mash and stir in a little oil at a time.
4. Add salt, pepper and ginger; mix well.
5. Add meat and onions; stir and cook until onions are tender.
6. Add soy sauce and bouillon.
7. Cover pan, bring to boil and cook until meat is tender.
title: Beef Curry With Onions

steps: 1. Mix spices in an oven proof dish and roast in a 400F oven for 20 min. Cool spices completely and grind into a fine powder
title: Garam Masala

steps: 1. Microwave the okra for about 4 minutes.

2. Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a sauce pan. Add cumin seeds. Stir till they swell which is about 2 minutes. Add onion. Stir and cook for about 3 minutes. Add tomato and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the rest and cook for about 3 more minutes.
title: Okra Curry

steps: 1. Place the okra in a large, microwave-safe dish; cook in microwave on High for 6 minutes.

2. Heat the olive oil and cumin seeds together in a large skillet over medium heat until the cumin seeds swell and turn golden brown. Fry the onions in the heated oil for 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes to the mixture and cook another 3 minutes. Stir the okra into the mixture; season with the curry powder and salt. Cook and stir the mixture until hot, about 3 minutes more. Serve hot.
title: Bhindi Masala (Spicy Okra Curry)

steps: 1. Shell green prawns and return to fridge.
2. heat the oil and slowly cook the onions and garlic until soft, add the spices and stir to blend. Add the water and simmer for 2 minutes.
3. Add the prawns and stir making sure that the prawns are well coated then add the tomatoes and simmer for just another few minutes. Do Not overcook as the prawns will become tough.
4. Serve with hot rice, pappadums and side dishes of, chopped spring onions, tomatoes, capsicums, dried coconut, Fresh Chilli, cucumber etc.
title: Prawn Curry - Quick And Easy

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and save in an airtight container.
title: Garam Masala

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon curry powder (or more depending on preference)

steps: 1. Mix all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl.
2. Pour over chicken for the last 30 minutes of roasting, or if using other cooking method, use like you would bbq sauce.
3. Baste often.
4. Serve when chicken is cooked through and glaze is golden and bubbly.
5. Cook time does not include initial cook time for chicken.
title: Sticky Garlic Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 cups penne pasta, or to taste
6 ounces cooked skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 11 minutes. Drain.
2. Heat oil and butter together in a deep skillet over medium-high heat. Saute onion, mushrooms, and bell pepper in the hot oil-butter mixture until softened, 5 to 10 minutes.

3. Mix maple syrup, garlic, and sugar into onion mixture, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until mixture is reduced and almost caramelized, about 5 minutes. Add chicken, cream, and curry powder to maple syrup mixture and cook until heated through and thickened, 7 to 10 minutes. Serve sauce over penne pasta.
title: Maple Curry Penne

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large pot and add the cumin and mustard seeds, fry for 2 minutes.
2. Add the courgette, aubergine, pepper, onions ans garlic. Fry for 5 minutes.
3. Add the turmeric, chili powder, ground coriander, cumin and salt, cook 5 minutes stir so that the mixture does not burn.
4. Mix the tomato puree with the chopped tomatoes and the water, add to the pot.Cover with a lid and cook for 10 minutes till the sauce starts to thicken.
5. Stir in the fresh coriander leaves and the garam masala, cook for 5 minutes.
6. Serve with a meat curry or INDIAN STUFFED ROASTED CHICKEN, super.
title: Indian Style Ratatouille

ingredients.text: 1 large garlic clove, minced and crushed
1 bunch spinach (or other leafy green, frozen or fresh)
1 1/2 cups chickpeas (cooked or canned, rinsed and drained)

steps: 1. Preliminaries: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Have available one 8-quart, heavy, ovenproof skillet or Dutch oven with a lid (or have aluminum foil available). If you cut recipe in half, a 6-quart pot will do.

2. For the initial saute: In the skillet or Dutch oven, brown the onions in moderately hot oil along with the cumin and mustard seeds. Add the potato pieces (peeling is optional), and stir to coat each piece with the spices. Add the remaining spices and garlic and continue to stir for several minutes.

3. Add the liquids: Thin the tomato paste with about ⅔ cup of water, then stir into the pot. Lower heat to medium. Add vegetables, one at a time, cooking for a minute or so between each addition, and put in the cooked chickpeas last.

4. Bake the mixture: Cover with a lid or seal with foil and bake in preheated oven for about 45 minutes, checking after the first 20 minutes. The consistency should be rather thick, but add water if necessary to prevent burning. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
5. Presentation: Serve over steamed rice or with Indian bread (such as naan).
title: Kenyan Vegetable Curry

steps: 1. Cook onions
2. and
3. celery
4. in
5. margarine until softened. Blend in flour, salt and curry powder.
6. Gradually stir in milk and chicken broth.
7. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly; add chicken and
8. apples.
9. Cover and cook gently for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1 cut up chicken, skinned or 6 thighs and 3 breasts, cooked

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter.
2. Add curry powder and stir in flour. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, then add chopped garlic and green pepper. (Mixture will be very thick.)
3. Add chicken broth and evaporated milk.
4. Simmer slowly until thickened (about 15 to 20 minutes). Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Add chicken.
6. Serve over rice.
7. Suggested condiments:
8. chopped eggs, bacon bits and peanuts.
9. Sauce without the chicken added freezes well.
title: Chicken Curry

steps: 1. With your hands, mix flour, dry milk, baking powder, salt and shortening.
2. Add milk.
3. Roll out on floured board.
4. Fry in 1-inch hot oil until brown.
5. Top with favorite taco filling or fruit or etc.
title: Indian Tacos

steps: 1. Lightly score chicken breasts 3 or 4 times with a sharp knife.
2. Place in a med bowl.
3. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
4. Toss to coat.
5. Combine yogurt, garlic, ginger, cardamom and red pepper in a small bowl.
6. Add to chicken.
7. Coat well with marinade.
8. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or over night.
9. Remove chicken from refrigerator 15 minutes before cooking.
10. Preheat broiler.
11. Line broiler pan with foil.
12. Arrange chicken on foil without the chicken touching.
13. Brush with remaining marinade.
14. Broil 3 inches from heat for 5 to 6 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in the center.
title: Tandoori Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Combine the first 10 ingredients in a resealable plastic bag or shallow glass container; mix well.
2. Rinse and dry the chicken thighs and add to the marinade (I did not do this but I suggest setting some of the marinade aside so that you can baste the chicken toward the end of the cooking time).
3. Seal or cover and refrigerate for 1-2 hours.
4. Place the chicken in a shallow baking pan and spoon additional marinade on top of chicken.
5. Cover with foil and bake at 400 degrees for 35 minutes.
6. Uncover, spoon reserved marinade on chicken and continue baking uncovered for an additional 10 minutes.
7. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.
title: Baked Curry Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large deep frying pan adding chopped onions and fry for 4 to 5 minutes on a medium heat until the onions are slightly brown. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for a further 1 or 2 minutes. Add the salt, turmeric and ground cumin.

2. Turn up the heat and further cook for another 1 minute then add the chicken. It is very crucial that spices are mixed within the pan at this point and stirred to ensure that the chicken cooks with texture and flavor. Add water after stirring the chicken into the spices. Turn down the heat slightly and stir in the garam masala and cream cook for a further 5 minutes. Serve sprinkled with green coriander.
title: Food Network Chicken Korma

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon fresh lime juice, plus more to taste

steps: 1. In medium bowl, whisk together all ingredients. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Taste and add more lime juice if desired.
title: Curry-Lime Yogurt

steps: 1. Cut up the watermelon, remove the rind and seeds and chop the flesh into 1-inch cubes (You'll need about 10 cups.) Puree 1 cup of flesh to make juice.
2. Add the paprika, ground red pepper, turmeric, coriander, garlic and salt to taste.
3. Heat the oil in a skillet over high heat and fry the cumin seeds 20 seconds.
4. Immediately add the juice.
5. Lower the heat and simmer until the liquid is reduced by one-third, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the lime juice and sugar to taste.
7. Cook 1 minute.
8. Add the watermelon pieces and cook over low heat 3 to 4 minutes, tossing to coat until heated through.
title: Watermelon Curry (Matira)

steps: 1. Trim the excess fat and sinew from the meat, and cut it into 1 inch cubes/.
2. Place the coriander, cumin, mustard seeds, peppercorns, chilli powder, turmeric, slat, garlic and ginger in a small bowl; stir to combine.
3. Add the vinegar and mix to a smooth paste.
4. Heat the oil in a large pan; add the onion and cook over medium heat until just soft.
5. Add the spice paste and stir for 1 minute.
6. Add the meat and cook, stirring until it is coated with the spice paste.
7. Add the tomato paste and stock.
8. Simmer, covered for 1 hour 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
title: Beef Madras Curry

steps: 1. 1. Melt the butter in a frying pan
2. 2. Add cloves, ginger, garlic and cumin and fry slightly
3. 3. Add onions and sautee until they start to caramelize
4. 4. Add shrimp, salt, sugar and lemon juice and sautee until done
5. 5. Add chicken broth and cayenne and simmer 15-20 minutes
title: Shrimp Curry

steps: 1. Mix cumin, coriander, cardamom, pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg in a bowl. Place mix in an airtight container, and store in a cool, dry place.
title: Easy Garam Masala

steps: 1. Toast the almonds in the oil; remove.
2. Add paprika, chili flakes, cumin, and coriander to the oil; cook.
3. Add onion; cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
4. toss in garlic at last end with onions
5. Toss in green beans and coat.
6. Add coconut milk and lime juice; warm it.
7. Plate; top with cilantro and almonds.
title: Bihari French Cut Green Bean Masala

ingredients.text: 1 green chile pepper, seeded and diced

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, melt butter over medium-high heat, and cook and stir cumin seed, chile pepper, garlic, and turmeric until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

2. Stir in the chopped mustard greens and spinach a little at a time, adding the tougher parts first (the stems and thicker leaves). Continue to add greens, and cook and stir until all greens have been added and all are thoroughly wilted. Stir in the cumin, coriander, and salt. Cover; reduce heat and simmer until greens are tender, about 10 minutes, adding water as needed to keep the greens moist.
title: Indian Saag

ingredients.text: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, stirring well.
2. Spoon into lightly greased casserole dish (covered).
3. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°. Serve over cooked white or yellow rice.
4. Yields about 6 servings.
title: Chicken Curry

steps: 1. In saucepan,melt butter and add honey,mustard,curry powder and salt.
2. Place chicken breasts,skin side up,in a 9x13 pan.
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.
4. Baste with sauce and continue baking for 1 hour,basting with sauce every 15 minutes until done.
title: Easy Honey Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 36 medium shrimp, peeled and devined (shells reserved)

steps: 1. Combine shells, green onion, garlic and curry powder in medium skillet over med.
2. high heat and cook for 1 minute.
3. Blend in cream and wine.
4. Increase heat to high and cook, stirring constantly for 5 minutes.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Discard shells.
7. Set sauce aside.
8. Season shrimp and scallops with salt, pepper and curry powder.
9. Heat butter in saucepan over med.
10. high heat.
11. Add shrimp and scallops in batches and cook for 2 minutes.
12. Remove shrimp and scallops from pan and set aside.
13. Add cream sauce to pan and cook until sauce is thick about 3 minutes.
14. Return shrimp and scallops to saucepan.
15. Blend in parsley.
title: Shrimp And Scallop Curry

ingredients.text: pinches of oregano, chili powder, ginger and black pepper

steps: 1. Mince onions and garlic and fry in large sauce pan until brown.
2. Add turmeric, curry, salt, chili powder, oregano, ginger and pepper.
3. Stir well and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Add chicken and fry for 5 - 10 minutes.
5. Add 1 cup of warm water, cover and cook for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Indian Chicken

steps: 1. Pour the oil into a large skillet set over medium-high heat. Toss in the onion, cayenne, turmeric, cumin, garam masala, a pinch of salt, and then reduce heat to medium. Cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, or until the onions are tender.
2. Add the okra, still well, and cook for 15 minutes. Add the tomato and lemon juice, stir well, and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Sprinkle with the cilantro, season to taste with salt, and serve.
title: Dinner Tonight: Okra Curry Recipe

ingredients.text: 1 -2 teaspoon curry powder (depending on your taste)
3 -4 carrots, peeeled and sliced into matchsticks

steps: 1. Heat oil, and saute onions, and carrots on a low heat.
2. Add spices, cook 2-3 minutes without a lid.
3. Add zucchini, carrots, tomato puree, orange juice, lemon juice, and salt and pepper.
4. Stir frequently until zucchini and carrots are tender.
5. Have lid on if the mix is too dry, Serve over rice.
title: Zucchini And Carrot Curry

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound kabocha squash - halved, seeded, and sliced into 1/4-inch pieces

steps: 1. Wash chicken wings well and dry with paper towels.
2. Combine curry powder and salt together in a bowl. Toss in the chicken wings to coat evenly. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator to marinate for 20 minutes.
3. Cut eggplant in half lengthwise and slice into several pieces diagonally. Soak in water to prevent browning.

4. Place chicken in a microwave-safe bowl; distribute eggplant and kabocha evenly on top. Pour in chicken stock. Cover with a microwave-safe lid or plastic wrap. Cook in the microwave at 600 watts until chicken is no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, about 7 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
title: Steamed Chicken Curry With Kabocha

ingredients.text: 2 pounds salmon fillets, cut into 2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Stir together first 9 ingredients in a large shallow dish. Add fish, tossing gently to coat. Cover and chill 30 minutes.
2. Alternately thread salmon, onion, and tomatoes on 8 (6- to 8-inch) skewers. Grill, covered with lid, over medium-high heat (350° to 400°) 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until done.
title: Tandoori Seafood Kebabs

ingredients.text: 1 lb lean round steak, trimmed and cut into 1/2 inch cubes

steps: 1. heat the oil in a large pan. and the shallots, garlic and beef cubes and cook over low heat,stirring occasionally, for 5 min until the beef is evenly browned all over.
2. blend together the curry paste and stock. add the mixture to the beef and stir to mix thorougly. bring to a boil cover and simmer for about 1 hour.
3. grate the rind of 1 orange. squeeze the juice from the orange and from 1 other . peel the other 2 oranges, remove the pith.slice between each segment and remove flesh.

4. blend the cornstarch with the orange juice. at the end of the cooking time stir the orange rind into the beef with the orange and cornstarch mixture. bring to a boil and simmer ,stirring constantly, for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens season to taste with salt and pepper stir inthe orange segments.
title: Beef And Orange Curry

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Place all the ingredients except the chicken in a medium-sized bowl; mix well. Coat the chicken with the mixture and place on a baking sheet that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until the juices run clear and no pink remains.
title: Tandoori Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb dried chickpeas, soaked overnight then drained
1 None small cauliflower, cut into florets
5 None spring onions, trimmed and sliced

steps: 1. Place the soaked chickpeas in a large pot of fresh water, bring to a boil and simmer for 45-50 mins then drain.

2. Heat the oil in a saucepan, saute the onion and garlic for 1-2 mins. Add the curry powder and cook for another 1-2 mins. Add the carrots, cauliflower and chickpeas and cook for 2-3 mins, stirring. Pour in the stock and coconut milk then season and mix in the spring onions. Cover and simmer gently for 12-15 mins until the chickpeas and vegetables are tender. Divide between 4 bowls then sprinkle with peanuts. Serve.
title: Chickpea Curry

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Place chicken and water in a medium saucepan and simmer over medium low heat for about 15 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside.

2. When water is almost reduced, season chicken with salt and pepper to taste. In a small bowl, combine yogurt and curry powder and mix together. Stir this mixture into saucepan until all chicken pieces are coated, then simmer for another 5 minutes to heat through and marinate.
title: Yogurt Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons toasted cashew nuts, to serve

steps: 1. Stir fry the curry paste in a saucepan for a couple of minutes until fragrant.
2. Add the pork and stir to combine.
3. Add the coconut cream and stir to combine.
4. Add the pineapple pieces and the red bell pepper, stir.
5. Cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes until pork is tender.
6. Garnish with the cashew nuts.
7. Nice served on a bed of sweet mashed potato or steamed rice.
title: Pork And Pineapple Curry

steps: 1. Combine the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, anise seeds, fenugreek seeds, and allspice berries in a skillet. Toast over medium heat until the color of the spices slightly darkens, and the spices are very fragrant, about 10 minutes. Remove the spices from the skillet, and allow to cool to room temperature. Grind the spices with the turmeric in a spice grinder. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
title: Jamaican Curry Powder

steps: 1. In nonstick skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and chicken breast and cook, stirring ocassionally, until chicken is almost cooked through.
2. Add tomato juice, red wine, chutney, and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice.
title: Easy Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 3 -5 fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped (to garnish)

steps: 1. Wash the chicken and cut it into 3 cms long pcs.
2. Place in a large bowl.
3. Add in all the ingredients, other than the oil.
4. Mix well.
5. Keep aside for 3 hours.
6. Pan-fry the chicken with olive oil for 5 minutes on moderate flame.
7. Cook in a pre-heated oven at 200C for 25 minutes or until tender.
8. Garnish with tomato wedges and corriander leaves.
9. Serve hot.
10. ENJOY!
title: Chicken Tikka !

steps: 1. Fry onion in oil, add garlic and ginger; stir.
2. Add turmeric and chili powder.
3. Add hamburger meat and cook through.
4. Stir in yogurt and peas.
5. Cook 15 minutes, simmer on low.
6. Add garam masala and salt.
7. Garnish with chili and coriander.
8. Serve over hot rice.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Kheema Mattar(A Mild Ground Beef Curry)

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and saute the onions until they turn dark brown.
2. Mix the garlic, cayenne, turmeric, and cumin with 1 Tablespoon water to make a thick paste.
3. Add the paste to the onions and saute for 5 minutes.
4. Add the tomates and stir constantly over medium head until the tomatoes start to break up, about 2 minutes. Avoid scorching.
5. Add the chicken and mix to coat with the spices.
6. Stir over medium heat for 10 minutes.
7. Add 1 cup water and the salt and bring mixture to a boil.
8. Lower heat and simmer, uncovered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes.
9. Add the vinegar and sugar, simmer for 1 minute, then taste--adjust sugar, salt, and vinegar as necessary.
title: New Bride Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1 roasting chickens, cut up or 2 split rock cornish game hens

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in a glass dish or plastic bag. Close tight and refrigerate, turning occasionally, 4 hours or overnight.
2. Place chicken, skin side up 5-7 inches from medium hot coals. Grill 50-60 minutes or until done. Turn every 10-15 minutes.
3. Or cook at 350 for 45- 60 minutes.
title: Tandoori-Style Chicken

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and bring to a light boil in a saucepan.
2. Turn to low and let simmer (stirring occasionally) for 30 minutes.
3. Serve over hot rice with a variety of toppings such as peanuts, coconut, raisins, mandarin oranges and pineapple.
4. Be as creative and brave as you like.
title: Quick Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Combine the ginger, chili powder, cinnamon, turmeric, and pepper; stir into the hot oil and cook for 5 seconds. Add the onion and garlic; stir and cook until onions become transparent, about 7 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes and chicken, and cook until chicken is no longer pink, 5 to 8 minutes.
2. Combine the chicken stock with the chicken-onion mixture; stir and cook 3 minutes. Stir in the almonds, cream, and yogurt; continue cooking 2 to 4 minutes.
title: Steve'S Chicken Korma

steps: 1. Saute the garlic, ginger, onions and green chili together until the onion starts to brown. Then add the cilantro and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts. Place in a blender and puree to desired consistency. Cook the potatoes (boil, or microwave) until almost done. In a deep pan heat the butter and fry the cumin seeds for about 20 seconds till they start to lightly brown. Add the turmeric and other spices and fry for about 30 seconds. Add the spinach-onion mixture, salt, and potatoes and cook for a few minutes for the flavors to meld and the potatoes to fully cook.
title: Aloo Palak

ingredients.text: 150 g smoked salmon, cut into ribbons

steps: 1. Brin a large pot of water to th eboil and add salt.
2. Blend the ricotte, curry, cream, mascarpone and parmesan.
3. Season.
4. Toss pasta in the boiling water and cook as instructed.
5. In a saucepan heat the sauce mixing all the time on a low flame until slightly hot. Add the salmon.
6. drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.
7. season with pepper and serve hot.
title: Pasta With Cream Curry And Salmon

ingredients.text: 1 c. apple, cut in small cubes
3 c. meat, cut in bite size pieces

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan and add onion, garlic, celery and apple.
2. Cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes.
3. Blend flour, curry powder and mustard; sprinkle it over vegetables.
4. Stir.
5. Add bay leaf and chicken broth; rapidly stir with wire whisk.
6. When mixture has thickened, let simmer for 15 minutes.
7. Stir bottom often to prevent from sticking.
8. Add meat, milk and finely chopped chutney; simmer 4 to 5 minutes longer.
9. Serve with rice.
title: Meat Curry

steps: 1. Dismember the chicken. Take the breasts off the ribcage.
2. Heat the ghee. Add the onion and fry until translucent.
3. Add all the spices and mix to combine. Fry for a few second to flavor the ghee.
4. Add the chicken and brown.
5. Add water and tomato. Cover and simmer until chicken is almost cooked.
6. Add rice and continue simmering 20 minutes.
title: Murgi Kalia - Chicken Curry From Bengal

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a bowl, then add beef, tossing to coat. Shake off excess flour. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir onions and beef until browned. Stir in beef stock, bay leaves, and curry powder. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in carrots, rice vinegar, molasses, and potatoes and simmer for an additional hour until tender.
title: Molasses-Beef Curry

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste

steps: 1. Heat canola oil in a wok over medium heat. Cook and stir cumin and mustard seeds in the hot oil until they begin to dance, 1 to 2 minutes. Add coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper; cook about 1 minute.

2. Stir cabbage, potatoes, ginger-garlic paste, and salt into spice mixture; stir to coat. Pour enough water into wok to steam vegetables; cover and cook, stirring occasionally and adding more water as needed, until potatoes and cabbage are very tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat; sprinkle vegetables with cilantro.
title: Indian Sabji Recipe

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°. Combine curry powder, cinnamon, cayenne, salt and flour in a plastic bag. Add chicken and shake well to coat. Put chicken on baking sheet and spray with cooking oil. Bake 20 minutes. Turn the chicken over and continue baking until golden brown, about 15 minutes longer.
title: Oven-Baked Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb firm white fish fillets, coarsely chopped
1 oz fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped
None None peanut oil, for deep-frying

steps: 1. In a food processor, combine fish, curry paste, green onions and cilantro. Process until combined. Add 2 tbsp sweet chili sauce. Season. Shape into 12 sausages.
2. Heat oil in large deep saucepan. Deep-fry fish cakes until browned and cooked through.
3. Skewer each fish cake with a bamboo skewer. Serve with remaining sweet chili sauce.
title: Curry Fish Skewers

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup almonds, preferably blanched and slivered
1/4 cup sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: 1. In a skillet, heat 1-2 tbsp butter and sautee tofu until it is nicely browned. You will need a thin, flat spatula to flip your tofu pieces without breaking them, and don't hesitate to add more butter if you think the tofu cubes are starting to stick. Once your tofu is light brown on at least two sides (it's hard to get all four, but if you can go for it!), sprinkle on your garam masala. You want each piece to get a dose of garam masala, but with tofu you can't just stir everything around because your cubes will break. If you use extra-firm tofu that is less likely to happen, but I prefer the mouthfeel of firm. Once you've sprinkled your garam masala on all the tofu, keep on sauteeing for another minute, turning the pieces over so the spices get stuck on the tofu via sauteeing in butter. Set aside.

2. In a large saucepan, sautee shallots, jalapno, garlic and ginger in the remaining butter. When they are soft, add spinach a handful at a time and sautee until cooked down. When the spinach is all cooked down and most (but not all) of its juices have evaporated, place the mixture in a blender. Add salt, almonds, and sour cream yogurt, and puree until smooth. I recommend using blanched, sliced or slivered almonds because they are easier to puree than whole raw almonds.
3. Return mixture to pan and add tofu, heat tofu through in spinach puree, and serve over basmati rice.
title: Spicy Saag Tofu

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. chicken breasts, cooked and cut in bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Cook rice according to directions; spread in bottom of large baking dish. Cover with frozen peas.
2. In separate bowl, combine soups, mayonnaise and curry powder; then spread 1/2 this mixture over peas.
3. Next, place chicken pieces in dish.
4. Spread remaining mixture over top.
5. Sprinkle cheese and bake in 375° oven until heated through, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
6. Great dish to make ahead of time and freeze.
7. Serves 8.
title: Chicken Curry Casserole

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion till golden.
2. Add all of the ingredients EXCEPT THE PRAWNS, simmer and cook till reduced by 1/3rd.
3. Add the prwns and cook gently till they are cooked.
title: Sri Lankan Prawn And Tomato Curry

steps: 1. Shell and devein prawns.
2. Place prawns in a bowl and pour cream over, cover and chill for 1 hour.
3. Chop onion.
4. Crush garlic and add salt.
5. Melt butter in a heavy pan and saute onion and garlic over a low heat until onion is soft but not coloured.
6. Add curry power, still over low heat and cook for about 3 minutes to release aroma.
7. Sprinkle plain flour and continue cooking for 1 to 2 minutes.
8. Remove pan from heat and add chicken stock, whisking until smooth.
9. Return to a higher heat and cook until it boils and thickens.
10. Reduce heat and add prawns with the cream, stirring to mix well together and until prawns are heated through.
title: Prawn Curry

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon light olive or vegetable oil

steps: 1. Heat oil in large saucepan and saute onions and garlic until soft, 6-8 minutes.
2. Cut tofu into 1/2-inch cubes. Add to pan and brown, 4-5 minutes.
3. Add spices & ginger, stirring to coat. Add spinach & stock, bring to a boil, then turn down flame to simmer 15-20 minutes.
title: Vegan Palak Paneer

steps: 1. On stove top heat vegetable oil and butter in dutch oven at medium high. Add onion and cook until soft (4 min.). Add dry spices (curry powder, coriander, cloves, black pepper, red pepper flakes, salt, and cinnamon stick) and grated ginger. Stir a few time and let cook for 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce and water, scraping bottom of pan.

2. Peel potatoes. Chop chicken and potatoes into bite size chunks. Add potatoes and chicken to the sauce once it begins to simmer. Simmer with lid on for about 40 minutes until potatoes are done. Turn off burner and let sit for a few minutes before serving.
title: Indian Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Cook onion in oil until transparent.
2. Blend in flour and curry.
3. Add soup and cook gently until sauce is heated.
4. Mix in seafood, sherry and sour cream.
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
6. Serve hot over fluffy cooked rice.
title: Seafood Curry

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon garlic paste (or more to taste)

steps: 1. Prepare marinade and pour into large resealable bag.
2. Clean and chop chicken into desirable tenderloin slices.
3. Place chicken in bag and coat.
4. Marinade for one hour.
5. Grill.
title: Tandoori Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder (more if you REALLY like curry)

steps: 1. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.
2. Saute chicken, mushroom and onion in oil in large skillet until chicken is lightly browned on all sides and completely cooked, about 10 minutes.
3. Stir in flour, salt, and curry powder.
4. Add apple and parsley.
5. Stir in milk and broth.
6. Simmer, stirring constantly for three minutes or until apple pieces are crisp tender.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Curry In A Hurry

ingredients.text: 3 skinless chicken breasts, cut into cubes
2 bunches broccoli, with the stems cut off
1 (14 ounce) can cream of chicken soup

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
2. In a bowl, mix together the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and cheddar cheese.

3. Grease a 9 x 13" casserole dish with butter or PAM spray. Layer the broccoli and chicken in the pan as desired. Pour the curry mixture on top and use a spoon to fill it in around the chicken/broccoli.
4. In a pan on the stovetop, melt the butter on medium to high heat. Pour in the bread crumbs and stir around swiftly until all butter is absorbed into bread crumbs and bread crumbs are browned.
5. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of casserole.
6. Place in oven and bake at 350 for 1 hour. Casserole should be bubbly and lightly browned when finished.
7. Serve over white rice.
title: Curry Chicken Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked, diced chicken or turkey

steps: 1. In a large skillet, saute chicken, mushrooms and onions in oil until chicken is lightly browned on all sides.
2. Stir in flour, broth and curry powder (optional).
3. Add parsley, then pour in milk and water.
4. Simmer, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes, or until chicken pieces are tender.
title: "In A Hurry" Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs country-style boneless pork ribs, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place the ginger in a small bowl with 1/3 cup of hot water and set aside until needed.
2. Cook the pork with the curry paste and brown sugar in a large deep skillet, stirring to coat meat, for about 15 minutes, until pork is nicely browned.
3. Meanwhile, mix the turmeric, and soy sauce into the water and add to the pork.
4. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until meat is tender and sauce has thickened, about 45 minutes.
5. Add the ginger (with its water), the shallots, garlic, and lime juice.
6. Simmer for 5-7 more minutes, allowing the flavors to blend through.
7. Check seasoning, adding more sugar, lime juice, or even a little salt, if necessary.
8. Serve at once with steamed jasmine rice.
title: Burmese-Style Pork Curry

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, peeled and grated

steps: 1. Heat half of the oil in a large pan and add the onion and pepper. Cook gently for 8-10 mins, until softened. Stir in the garlic and ginger and spices, and cook for 1 - 2 mins more.

2. Add the remaining oil and the chicken, and cook for 2-3 mins until coated in the spice mixture. Stir in the stock and lentils, bring to the boil then cover and simmer for 25 mins, stirring occasionally until the lentils are tender and the chicken is thoroughly cooked.
3. Stir in half the yogurt and cover; simmer for a further 5 minutes.
4. Spoon the curry into individual bowls with basmati rice, and top with the remaining yogurt and a sprinkling of almonds.
title: Chicken And Red Lentil Curry

steps: 1. Fry bacon in a large pan.
2. Add a drizzle of olive oil to hot pan and saute onion, and garlic until translucent.
3. Add coconut milk and bring to a boil.
4. Add shrimp.
5. In a small bowl, dissolve curry and cornstarch in milk and add to shrimp mixture.
6. Bring to a boil, so shrimp infuses with curry flavor.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Serve with white rice and chutney, to taste.
title: Shrimp Curry

ingredients.text: 6 chicken thigh fillets, halved (breasts can be used, I cut into strips)
2 cups sweet potatoes, chopped (kumara, the orange one)
1 1/2 cups coconut milk (I use skim evaporated coconut milk)

steps: 1. Place the curry paste in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
2. Add the chicken and sweet potato to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, then add the stock and coconut milk and reduce the heat to low.
3. Allow to simmer gently for 12 minutes or until the chicken and sweet potato are cooked.
4. To serve, sprinkle the coriander over the chicken and serve with steamed rice or steamed greens.
title: Chicken Poached In Coconut Curry

steps: 1. Boil chicken until tender.
2. Save two cups of chicken broth. Slice onion and saute in the shortening.
3. Add flour, curry, ginger, salt, pepper and lemon juice.
4. Simmer until onions are soft.
5. Add chicken broth and chicken.
6. Cook one-half hour over medium heat.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Make the filling, following the same method as the wheat flour modak.
2. Heat 2 cups of the water in a large pot/vessel and then add salt and butter.

3. As the water starts boiling, add rice flour to the water. Lower heat. Mix well. The mixture should be a smooth paste; there should be no lumps. If mixture is becoming too dry then add the remaining ½ cup water. Keep heating on low heat until rice flour is cooked.
4. Cover the mixture with a lid and remove from the heat. Let it cook in its own steam.

5. While it is still warm rub some ghee on your palms and take a small portion of the dough. Make a ball out  of it. With your thumb shape the ball into a cup. Put 2 teaspoons of the filling and close the ends in a manner to get the shape of a fresh fig.
6. Make 10 modaks and place them in a colander or steamer basket greased with ghee. Place the modak in such a way that they do not touch one another in the colander.
7. Place the colander in a steamer and steam the modaks for 10 minutes.
8. Dribble with a teaspoon of ghee, and serve hot.
title: Rice Modak (Coconut Pastries) I

ingredients.text: 4 cups butternut squash, cubed (peeled and seeded)
2 teaspoons minced garlic (in a squeeze bottle)

steps: 1. Saute in Instant Pot on Hot - coconut oil, onion, ginger, garlic until onion is soft. Cancel
2. Add all other ingredients to Instant Pot. Set on Manual, 10 minutes, high pressure. Instant release.
3. Blend with immersion blender.
title: Instant Pot Curry Ginger Squash Soup

steps: 1. Chill for 2
2. hours.
3. Then add the last four ingredients.
title: Curry Rice Salad

ingredients.text: 1 granny smith apple, peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425-degrees.
2. In 18x12-inch jelly-roll pan, combine pumpkin, shallots, carrots, apple onion, garlci, olive oil, coriander, cumin, and turmeric, tossing to coat.
3. Spread in single layer.
4. Roast 30 minutes or until tender.
5. Transfer mixture to blender.
6. Add broth and coconut milk.
7. Cover and blend until smooth.
8. Stir in 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper, or to taste.
title: Indian Roasted Pumpkin Soup

steps: 1. In a large pan heat oil over medium heat and saute onions and cumin until onions are tender, but not browned. Rinse the rise several times and drain well. Add the rice to the pan with the onions and pour in the 2 cups of water. Stir in salt, garam masala and vegetables. Cover the pan and increase the heat to high.

2. Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to low, keeping the rice covered at all times. After cooking for about 10 minutes, gently stir the rice to distribute the spices evenly. Cook 25 to 30 minutes, or until all of the water has evaporated and the rice is tender.
title: Indian Vegetable Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup pickle (I recommend Maxine's Curry Pickle (A Sweet Pickle), finely chopped)
1 teaspoon curry powder, if curry pickle is not available (optional)

steps: 1. Hard boil eggs, then chop. (I put eggs in a pan in cold water, bring to boil, remove from heat, cover, let stand 17 minutes, drain water, cover with cold water and ice for 5 minutes, then peel).
2. While eggs are cooking, dice chicken, celery, pickle and onion (finely for hors d'oeuvres, coarsely for sandwiches or salads).
3. Mix chicken, celery, onion, pickle, and eggs in medium sized bowl.
4. Add mayonnaise, and mix together adding sugar, salt, and pepper to your taste.
5. Serve on bed of lettuce for salad, on toast for sandwiches, or stuff puffs for hors d'oeuvres. Part of prep time is during cooking of the eggs.
title: Curry Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 1 large potato, chopped into small chunks
1 aubergine, trimmed and chopped into chunks (eggplant)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large saucepan and add onion and potato. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes until potatoes begin to soften. Add aubergine and mushrooms and cook 2-3 minutes more.
2. Stir in curry paste, pour over the stock and coconut milk and bring to a boil. Turn heat down to simmer 10 minutes or until potato is tender. Stir through coriander and serve.
title: One-Pot Mushroom And Potato Curry

steps: 1. Stir the rice, water, and curry powder together in a rice cooker; cook for 1 full cycle or until all the water is absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Easy Curry Rice

ingredients.text: 12 ounces fresh spinach, torn in pieces

steps: 1. In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook the cauliflower until crisp-tender; about 3 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold running water and drain again.
2. In a casserole dish, heat oil. Add onion and cook over medium heat until the onion is lightly browned; 4-5 minutes.
3. Add the green pepper and garlic and cook until the pepper is softened; 2-3 minutes. Add ginger, cumin and curry powder and cook, stirring 1-2 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, cauliflower, potatoes and broth. Cover and cook over medium heat until the potatoes are tender; 12-15 minutes. Add additional broth or water if the mixture becomes too dry.
5. When potatoes are cooked, stir in spinach, peas, salt and cayenne. Cook until the spinach is just wilted, about 2 minutes. Serve hot.
title: Potato Cauliflower Curry

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup fresh green beans, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat the corn oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in the onion, garlic, red bell pepper, and whole cloves. Cook and stir until the onion has softened and begun to brown, about 10 minutes. Stir in the rice, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add 4 cups of water, salt, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, place the broccoli, corn, green beans, carrot, and 1/4 cup water into a microwave-safe bowl. Cover, and cook in the microwave at full power until the vegetables are tender, 2 to 4 minutes depending on the microwave. Once the rice has finished cooking, gently stir the vegetables into the rice along with the turmeric, black pepper, and cashews. Sprinkle with cilantro to serve.
title: Indian-Style Vegetable Rice

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees and line a large baking sheet with heavy duty foil or a Silpat baking mat.
2. Cut cauliflower into 3/4" steaks, then into smaller pieces.
3. Mix oil, salt and spices in a large zip-lock bag.
4. Add cauliflower pieces and tumble gently to coat.
5. Spread out on baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes or until desired degree of doneness.
title: Roast Cauliflower With Curry, Turmeric And Lemon Pepper

steps:
1. Preparing the rice
Take a deep pan. Add basmati rice to it. Fill it up with water. It will be cloudy. Strain it.
If you are draining rice along with water, that is no good. Use a fine mesh Sieve/strainer and then put the rice in it. Now place this strainer in the pan. Start washing the rice. This way, water will be strained but rice grains will remain inside, with no wastage.
You must wash the rice, till the water runs clear through it, about 4-5 times.

2. SOAKING THE RICE
Once the rice is washed till the water runs clear, Soak the rice in 2 cups of water or just enough to keep the rice covered.
Soak the rice for 30 minutes. This will extract out any further starch from Basmati.

3. COOKING THE RICE
After 30 minutes, drain the water out from the rice.
Take a wide and deep pan. Add soaked rice, 4 cups of water, 2 tsp ghee and salt to the pan.
Bring the rice to a gentle boil on high heat.
Lower the heat to medium low. Give it a gentle stir.
Cover with a lid and let the rice cook on low heat till all the water is evaporated. It will take about 7-8 minutes. No need to stir the rice in between.
Switch off the heat. Remove the lid. Let the rice stand like that for another 5-7 minutes.
DO NOT TOUCH THE RICE AT ALL DURING THIS TIME.
Now take a FORK and gently & slowly fork the rice to fluff it up. Watch the video above.
Once fluffed, let stand for another minute or so.
Serve it hot with the daal, vegetable, korma, of your choice.
title: Indian Restaurant Style Basmati Rice

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon curry powder (or use curry paste as we do- to taste)

steps: 1. Mix together the lemon juice, soy sauce and water and set aside.
2. Heat a large skillet and add the olive oil. Stir in the curry until mixed.
3. Add the rice and mix well. Stir in the pinto beans.
4. Add the lemon juice mixture, combine well.
5. Serve topped with the chopped tomatoes, green onions and eggs, eating along side a warm tortilla!
title: Kedgeree Curry (Curried Pinto Beans And Rice)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in large pot except rice.
2. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low.
3. Cover for 30 minutes.
4. Add rice and continue to cook until rice and chicken are done.
5. Add water if needed.
title: Curry Chicken And Rice

ingredients.text: 8 ounces russet potatoes, peeled, and chopped into 1/2-inch cubes
8 ounces green tomatoes, cores removed, sliced into 1-inch segments

steps: 1. Pour the oil into a large skillet set over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook until it is reddish brown, about a minute or so. Stir often. Make sure it doesn't burn. If it does, then start over.
2. Add the potatoes, tomatoes, garam masala, salt and turmeric. Turn heat down to medium. Stir occasionally, and cook for about 10 minutes.

3. Pour in a cup of water. Scrap the pan with a wooden spoon, dislodging any browned bits. When the mixture comes to a boil, cover the skillet, reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the potatoes and tomatoes are tender. Stir every few minutes or so.
4. You want the final sauce to be kind of thick, so mash up a few of the potatoes and tomatoes with the wooden spoon. Turn off the heat, stir in the cilantro, and serve.
title: Dinner Tonight: Green Tomato Curry With Potatoes And Garlic Recipe

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Place eggplant and cauliflower in a large bowl with a lid.

3. Whisk olive oil, curry powder, ground cumin, garlic salt, and basil together in a bowl; pour over eggplant and cauliflower. Place lid on bowl with eggplant mixture and shake until well coated. Arrange eggplant and cauliflower on prepared baking sheet.
4. Bake in preheated oven until browned and caramelized, about 30 minutes.
title: Cauliflower Eggplant Curry-Cumin Roast

ingredients.text: 8 ounces Greek yogurt (plain, I used fat free)
1 teaspoon ground ginger (less if you're using fresh)

steps: 1. At least 2 hours ahead of time, mix yogurt, spices, lemon juice in a small bowl, refrigerate until ready to use.
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
3. Break cauliflower into small to medium sized florets.
4. Toss in a large bowl with salt, pepper and olive oil.
5. Spread on a cookie sheet in one layer and bake in pre-heated oven for about 15 minutes until beginning to soften.
6. Remove from oven and return to large bowl.
7. stir chopped cilantro into yogurt/spice mixture and spoon over califlower.
8. toss to coat well (you may not need ALL of the yogurt, depending on how large of a head of cauliflower you have).
9. return to baking sheet and continue to bake for about another 5-10 minutes (cook to your liking, some prefer some crunch left in their veggies).
10. remove from oven and enjoy!
title: Curry Yogurt Roasted Cauliflower

ingredients.text: 1 large cucumber, seeded and diced (about 1 1/2 cups)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.
2. Cover and chill until ready to serve.
title: Cucumber-Red Pepper Raita

steps: 1. 1. Wash and peel the skin off of the zucchinis. Then cut them down the middle vertically and then slice them in half horizontally. After that is done grab each piece of zucchini and slice each piece into fours vertically to create French fry sized pieces.
2. 2. Place the pieces into a plastic bag and add the melted butter and curry. Close the bag and shake it very well until all of the zucchini fries are coated with the curry butter mixture.
3. 3. Grab a baking sheet pan and spray it with non-stick cooking spray. Place the zucchini fries onto the pan. Make sure they are spread out evenly. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese on top of them.
4. 4. Place the fries in a preheated 350 degree F oven for 40 minutes.
5. 5. Once they are done take them out and sprinkle some salt and pepper to taste.
6. 6. Then enjoy!
title: Curry Zucchini Fries

ingredients.text: 1 pound leeks (white portion only), thinly sliced

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, saute leeks and carrots in butter until leeks are tender. Add potato and curry powder; cook and stir for 2 minutes. Add broth, salt and pepper; bring to a boil.
2. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the vegetables are very tender. Cool slightly.
3. Process in batches in a food processor or blender until pureed. Return to the pan; heat through.
title: Curry Carrot-Leek Soup

ingredients.text: 2 pounds Squash (I Used Butternut), Peeled, Seeded, And Chopped Into Cubes
4 cups Chicken Stock (or Stock Of Your Choosing), Sodium Reduced

steps: 1. Preheat your oven to 425 F.
2. In a large casserole dish or roasting pan, add the squash, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper; mix well. Roast for 45 minutes or until the veggies are fork tender and slightly charred.
3. In a large pot, bring the stock up to a boil just before the veggies are ready to come out of the oven.
4. When the veggies have finished roasting, remove them from the oven and carefully add them into the stock. Add the curry powder, if using. Mix well.
5. Let the soup come up to a boil and then drop the heat down to medium-low. Let the soup simmer for 20 minutes.

6. Puree the soup using an immersion blender or regular blender. If you use a regular blender, blend in small batches and leave the lid open just a tad, to avoid any explosions of the hot soup. Return the pureed soup to the pot.
7. Taste and adjust and seasoning before serving.
8. Notes:
9. - You can roast the veggies ahead of time and refrigerate them until you are ready to make the soup.
10. - Use any stock of your choosing; vegetable would make this vegetarian!
11. - This is honestly a wonderful soup on a cold night.
title: Roasted Squash And Onion Soup (With Curry)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 20-30 minutes.
2. I start checking the rice mixture at about 20 minutes and then every 3 minutes thereafter.
3. Now remember, this is a great addition to Alsace Chicken, which is listed in this site as well.
title: Curry Raisin Rice

ingredients.text: 8 medium potatoes, unpeeled and cut into cubes
2 medium tomatoes, deseeded and cut into strips

steps: 1. Defrost the spinach and drain well. Squeeze it to get rid of as much moisture as possible.
2. Meanwhile, boil the cubed potatoes until they are almost cooked through (but not falling apart). Drain well.
3. Heat the oil in a large pan or wok and, when hot, add the potatoes and all the spices, stirring to coat everything.
4. When the potatoes have started to crisp up slightly, add the garlic and tomatoes and stir for a few more seconds, then add the spinach.
5. If using fresh spinach, you want it to be just wilted, or with frozen, warmed through.
6. Taste and adjust seasoning as required then serve immediately.
title: Simple Sag Aloo (Indian Potato And Spinach)

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons whole cumin seeds (must be whole seeds)

steps: 1. In order to get the maximum benefits of the fluffy, loose consistency that is typical of Indian rice, pre-soak the rice in a large bowl of water for approximately 1 hour. Then thoroughly drain it and you can get started right away.

2. Heat the butter in the pot over medium heat and saute the cumin seeds for 10 seconds. Pour 4 cups of water in that same pot, bring the heat up to a high until water simmers. Add basmati rice and salt, simmering on medium heat for approximately 20-30 minutes, or until liquid is completely soaked and the rice is fluffy and loose. Fluff rice with a fork and garnish with cilantro.
title: Jeera Pulao {Cumin Basmati Rice}

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. oil, butter or bacon fat

steps: 1. Stir-fry 10 minutes over hot burner. Turn off burner and put on lid 10 minutes.
title: Indiana Cabbage

ingredients.text: 2 large eggplants (about 1 1/2 pounds each), pricked all over with a fork
1 jalapeno pepper, seeds and ribs removed, minced
1 pound baking potatoes (about 2), peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Heat the broiler. Put the whole eggplants on a baking sheet and broil, turning occasionally, until charred and soft, about 10 minutes. Set aside to cool.

2. In a Dutch oven, heat the oil over moderately low heat. Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the coriander, cumin, fennel seeds, and jalapeno and cook, stirring, for 1 minute longer. Add the potatoes, salt, and water and bring to a simmer. Cook, covered, until the potatoes start to soften, about 10 minutes.

3. Cut each eggplant open and spoon the pulp into the potato mixture. Simmer, uncovered, until the potatoes are tender, about 5 minutes more. Add the tomatoes and heat through, about 2 minutes. Stir in the lemon juice and cilantro.
