3. Melt butter.
4. Butter a 9" x 13" pan and place 4 sheets of phyllo. Use a pastry brush to brush melted butter on each individual sheet.
5. Add about 2/3 cups of walnut mixture on top and add 2 more sheets of phyllo, buttering each sheet.

6. Repeat until you either have only 4 sheets left (which you use for the top layer) or until you are out of walnut mix. I usually come pretty close to using one pack of phyllo (the Athens brand comes with 2 sealed bags).
7. Cut the baklava in a diamond pattern, making sure to get all the way to the bottom of the pan.
8. Top with the remaining butter and bake at 350 for 40 minutes (or until top is nicely golden brown).
9. During the last 10 minutes of baking time, mix the sugar, honey, vanilla, lemon juice and 1 1/2 cups of water in a pot and boil for 5 minutes.

10. Remove any froth off the top and pour over the baked baklava. I don't end up using all the honey mixture... I usually have about 2/3 of it remaining - so I only use about 1/3 on the batch of baklava.
11. Serve cold.
title: Baklava

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Line your cookie sheets with parchment paper, set aside.
3. While the oven preheats, chop the pepitas and toast them in a dry skillet over medium heat just until slightly browned, set aside.
4. In a large mixer bowl, cream 2 cups of sugar, butter, oil and the zest of 2 of the limes.
5. Add the eggs and mix well, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
6. Measure the lime juice and add 1/4 cup to the eggs mixture, reserving any additional juice for other uses.
7. In a medium size bowl, mix together the flour, pepitas, soda and salt.
8. Gradually add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture mixing well.
9. In a small bowl, combine the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar with the remaining zest of 2 limes.
10. Using a heaping tablespoonful of dough, lightly form the dough into a ball and drop the into the sugar/zest mixture and roll lightly to coat.
11. Place the dough balls on a cookie sheet; flatten slightly with the bottom of a glass.
12. Bake in preheated oven for 9 to 10 minutes or until the edges just begin to brown.
title: Lime And Pepita Sugar Cookies

steps: 1. Place pita breads on an ungreased
2. ; brush with butter. Combine basil and thyme; sprinkle over pitas. Cut each into eight wedges. Bake at 400° for 8-10 minutes or until crisp.
title: Herbed Pita Chips

ingredients.text: 5 lbs meat, cut into cubes (pork & chicken)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and pour over meat.
2. Marinade in fridge for three days, stirring at least twice a day.
3. (This is important).
4. Remove meat from marinade; discard marinade.
5. Skewer meat and grill.
6. Serve with sliced Italian bread.
7. Cooked meat can be frozen and heated up.
title: Spiedies (Kabobs)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9 inch square baking dish.

2. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, 3/4 cup of sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and cloves. Cut in the shortening until it is in very small pieces, then mix in the milk and egg using an electric mixer on low speed. Mix for about 1 minute, scraping the bottom of the bowl at least once to avoid lumps. Stir in walnuts by hand. Pour into the prepared pan, and spread evenly.
3. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until a knife inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool cake in the pan for about 30 minutes while you prepare the honey syrup.
4. In a saucepan, stir together 1/4 cup of sugar and the water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir in the honey and lemon juice, and remove from heat.
5. Make slashes in the top of the cake in a diamond pattern using a knife. Pour the hot syrup over the top of the cake.
title: Karithopita

steps: 1. Preheat the grill to high.
2. Cut larger pitas into 8 wedges, smaller pitas into 6 wedges. Generously brush both sides of each wedge with oil. Sprinkle one side of each wedge with sesame seeds (if using).

3. When ready to cook, arrange the pita wedges on the grill, turning with tongs, until nicely browned, 1-2 minutes each side. Place the wedges in a single layer on a tray, platter or rack and allow to cool. The wedges will crisp on cooling.
title: Grilled Pita Chips

ingredients.text: 10–40 g fresh, peeled garlic (less for a milder thoum, more for a stronger one)

steps: 1. Use a pestle (traditionally wooden) to smash the garlic with salt until very smooth; you can add the salt at the beginning or after the garlic is well smashed.

2. Gradually mix in the oil—start by adding one drop at a time and stirring the oil into the garlic with the pestle. After you've added about 1 tbsp of oil and it's been well incorporated, you can drizzle the oil in rather than adding it drop by drop. After half of the oil is added, alternate a bit of lemon juice with a bit of oil. Don't stop for long while mixing; it's necessary to keep stirring, stopping only for very brief periods. When finished the toum will have a similar consistency to thick mayonnaise.
title: Toum (Lebanese Garlic Sauce)

steps: 1. Pour yoghurt into a bowl and beat until smooth. Add water and continue beating until thoroughly blended. Alternatively, combine in an electric blender and blend until smooth.
2. Season to taste with salt and dried mint. Chill thoroughly and serve in tall glasses, with ice.
title: Ayran (Turkish Yogurt Drink)

ingredients.text: ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped
¼ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped
½ teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (optional, for added spice)

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine the ground beef or lamb, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, ground paprika, ground cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and pepper. Mix well until all the ingredients are evenly incorporated.
2. Take a small portion of the meat mixture and shape it into a cylindrical or oval meatball shape. Repeat the process with the remaining meat mixture, shaping them into uniform-sized meatballs.
3. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for about 30 minutes to prevent them from burning on the grill.
4. Preheat your grill or stovetop grill pan over medium heat.
5. Thread the meatballs onto the skewers, leaving a bit of space between each meatball.
6. Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil to prevent sticking.
7. Place the meatball skewers on the grill or grill pan and cook for about 10–12 minutes, turning them occasionally to ensure even cooking. The meatballs should be browned and cooked through.
8. Once cooked, remove the meatball skewers from the grill or grill pan and transfer them to a serving platter.
9. Serve the kofta hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro. They can be enjoyed on their own as a main course or used in sandwiches, wraps, or other dishes.
title: Egyptian Meatballs (Kofta)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Place falafel on a baking sheet.
2. Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, 8 to 10 minutes.
3. While falafel bake, whisk tahini, water, lemon juice, garlic, and paprika together in a bowl.

4. Cut about 1 inch from the top of each pita to form a pocket. Add 2 falafel to each pita with equal amounts lettuce, tomato, cucumber, pickle, and red onion. Drizzle each with about 1 tablespoon tahini sauce and some harissa.
title: Falafel Pita Sandwich with Tahini Sauce

steps: 1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan, add the onion and fry until soft and lightly browned, about 10 mins. Add the chilli, ginger and spices and mix well. Stir in the chickpeas, tomatoes and 5 tbsp water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 mins. Add a little salt and pepper and the lemon juice.

2. Arrange the aubergines over a grill pan. Brush lightly with oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, then grill until golden. Flip them over, brush again with oil, season and grill again until tender and golden.

3. Mix the yogurt with the garlic, most of the walnuts and coriander and a little salt and pepper. Arrange the aubergine slices over a warm platter and spoon over the chickpea mix. Drizzle with the walnut sauce and scatter with the remaining walnuts and coriander.
title: Grilled aubergines with spicy chickpeas & walnut sauce

ingredients.text: 2 cups couscous (I used Near East brand)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Combine 2 cups of water and salt in a large saucepan; bring to a boil.
3. Add couscous and carrots; stir, and remove from the heat.
4. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
5. Uncover and stir in 2 tbsp pesto.
6. Tear off 6 12-inch lengths of aluminum foil.
7. Put 1/6th of couscous mixture on one half of each piece of foil.
8. Top each with chicken breast.
9. Spread a bit of pesto over each piece of chicken.
10. Fold up the foil and seal.
11. Place packets on baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes.
title: Pesto Chicken With Couscous

steps: 1. Pierce eggplants all over with a fork. Place on baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 50 to 60 minutes, or until eggplants collapse and are soft; cool to room temperature.

2. Slice eggplants from stem to bottom and scrape out flesh with a large spoon. Flesh will be soft but still hold together; cut in half along long axis and scoop out seed mass; discard seed. Place remaining flesh in large, fine mesh strainer. Place strainer in bowl or sink and drain well (about 20 minutes).

3. Transfer eggplant to large bowl and add remaining ingredients. Beat with the KitchenAid(R) Stand Mixer on low until eggplant is beaten smooth and ingredients are all well combined. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend.
4. *Tahini is a prepared sesame seed paste used in Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cooking. Look for jars of tahini in the ethnic foods aisle of large supermarkets and in ethnic grocery stores.
5. To purchase the
6. used in this recipe, please visit
title: Baba Ghanoush

steps: 1. Rinse garbanzo beans in a strainer .
2. Soak garbanzo beans in water for 1-2 minutes.
3. Put garbanzo beans in food processor.
4. Put olive oil, black pepper, oregano, dried basil, and lemon juice in food processor seperately.
5. Turn on the food processor for five minutes.
6. If not satisfied with texture, put in olive oil to make smoother and turn on food processor for 1 minute until satisfied.
title: Sesame Free Hummus

steps: 1. Combine well and store in jar.
2. Use to season rice, lentils, meats, etc.
title: Middle Eastern Spice Mix

steps: 1. Place garlic cloves in a medium bowl, first cutting the large cloves in half. Mix in the red bell pepper.

2. In a large saucepan over medium high heat, place the vinegar and white sugar. Place ground dry mustard and celery seed in the liquid mixture. Add salt and peppercorns. Bring to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and peppers. Continue boiling 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

3. Place garlic and peppers in sterile container to within 1 inch of the top. Fill with remaining liquid to within 1/4 inch from the top. Seal and store in the refrigerator approximately three weeks before serving.
4. Note:
5. If you blanch the garlic you won't have to wait the whole three weeks.
title: Iranian Sugar Pickled Garlic

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon mustard (we use regular sandwhich mustard)

steps: 1. Melt the butter first.
2. Combine the rest of ingredients saving the ketchup for last.
3. Stir together and simmer.
4. For a spicier sauce add some tobasco sauce. Be careful not to overpower the sauce.
title: Beef Kabob Sauce

steps: 1. Wash and peel the apples.
2. Cut each into thin slices, removing the seeds and the hard middle core.
3. Pour apples in a non-stick pot.
4. Add enough water to cover the apples, and bring to boil.
5. Cook over high heat for about 10 minutes.
6. Add sugar and cook for another 10 minutes.
7. Add rose-water and lime juice and cook for 2-3 minutes.
8. The mix should be quite thick when cooking is over.
title: Littlemafia'S Persian Apple Jam

steps: 1. Grill eggplant over a charcoal fire for 30 to 40 minutes, turning frequently.
2. Alternatively place on center shelf in a hot oven and cook until soft, again turning often.
title: Baba Ghannouj

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor.
2. Finely chopped vegetables (onion, carrot, green pepper, etc.) may be added.
3. Serve with crackers.
title: Hummus Dip

ingredients.text: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed & rinsed

steps: 1. In 3 qt saucepan, saute onion in olive oil until tender, about 5 minutes, over medium heat.
2. Add minced garlic, stir & cook 30 seconds.
3. Add green beans, turn heat to high and stir quickly for about 1 minute.
4. Add tomato sauce and enough water to almost cover beans.
5. Add parsley, cumin, sugar, salt and pepper.
6. Cover pot and simmer on medium heat for about 25 minutes.
7. If it seems too watery, cook uncovered for 10 minutes. There should be about 1/3 to 1/2 the amount of liquid you started with.
title: Egyptian Green Beans In Tomato Sauce

steps: 1. Put garlic in blender and slowly add the oil.
2. Blend until you have a consistency somewhat like mayonaise.
3. Add the lemon juice, while still blending.
4. Keep in the refrigerator in a jar.
title: Arabic Garlic Sauce

ingredients.text: 1 pound carrots, peeled and thinly sliced
1 (2 inch) piece fresh ginger root, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Put carrots, garlic, ginger, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a large saucepan. Add 2 cups water to cover. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, until carrots are tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain.
2. Transfer carrot mixture to a food processor along with remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, apricot preserves, lemon juice, sesame oil, coriander, and cayenne. Process until almost smooth.
title: Moroccan Carrot Dip

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in small bowl until well blended.
2. Seal in an airtight container and store in a dark dry spot in the pantry. It will keep for up to a year.
title: Clean Eating Ras El Hanout Moroccan Spice Mix

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (to taste)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet.
2. Cook shallot and pine nuts over medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until shallot is tender and pine nuts lightly browned.
3. Add shrimp, vegetables, curry powder, and red pepper flakes.
4. Cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Stir in salt, pepper, and chicken broth.
6. Bring to a gentle boil and stir in couscous.
7. Cover, remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes.
8. Fluff with a fork and serve.
title: Curried Couscous With Shrimp

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, combine the water, ham, spinach and garlic salt. Bring to a boil. Stir in couscous. Remove from the heat; cover and let stand for 5-10 minutes or until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese.
title: Ham & Spinach Couscous

steps: 1. Melt butter in a small Dutch oven over medium heat. Add rice; cook, stirring constantly, until rice is lightly browned. Add next 4 ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover, and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients.
title: Persian Rice

steps: 1. Combine cauliflower and 2 tablespoons water in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at HIGH 6 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain.
2. Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add panko to pan; cook 3 minutes or until toasted, stirring constantly. Remove panko from pan.

3. Heat remaining 1 1/2 tablespoons oil and garlic in pan over medium-high heat. Add cauliflower; saute 5 minutes or until golden, stirring occasionally. Add panko, parsley, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
title: Israeli Cauliflower With Panko

ingredients.text: 1 None medium carrot, peeled, coarsely grated
1/4 head red cabbage, core removed, shredded

steps: 1. Sprinkle mustard over both sides of pork chops. Heat a large frying pan over medium heat. Lightly coat pork with oil. Cook for 3 mins per side, or until cooked to your liking. Transfer to a heatproof plate, cover with foil and let rest for 5 mins.

2. Meanwhile, place couscous in a medium heatproof bowl. Add crumbled stock cube and butter. Stir in 1 2/3 cups boiling water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 mins, or until liquid is absorbed. Using a fork, fluff and separate grains. Add carrot, cabbage, celery, onions, cilantro and feta. Mix well.
3. Cut pork into thin strips. Add to couscous along with lemon juice and garlic. Season and stir to combine. Spoon into shallow serving bowls. Serve.
title: Pork And Cabbage Couscous

steps: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 350.

2. Boil the cabbage in a large pot for about 5 minutes. Drain and put the pieces in a lightly greased baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the cabbage. Bake for about 20 minutes and serve.
title: Moroccan Baked Cabbage And Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 large cucumber, seeded and chopped (about 2 cups)

steps: 1. In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the orzo until just done, about 12 minutes. Drain. Rinse wih cold water and drain thoroughly.
2. Combine with the tomatoes, cucumber, scallions, parsley and mint.
3. In a small bowl, whisk the lemon juice iwth the salt and pepper. Add the oil slowly, whisking.
4. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss.
title: Orzo Salad - Middle Eastern Style

steps: 1. Cut all the peppers in half length wise and de-seed them.
2. Cut all the peppers, length-wise, into 1/2 inch slices.
3. In a large covered pot, saute onions in oil until translucent, then add the peppers and cook for 5 minutes.
4. Add tomato juice, cover and cook on med heat for 5-10 minutes.
5. Add tomatoes, salt and pepper; cover and cook another 15 minutes.
6. Add vinegar, cover and cook another 10-15 minutes.
7. serve hot, cold or at room tempreture.
8. Excellent side dish with almost anything.
title: Egyptian Salad

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons fresh dill (I used 1 t of dried)

steps: 1. Bring water to boil and add carrots. Cook 5 minutes and drain.
2. Place garlic, cilantro and rest of ingredients in a food processor until combined. Spoon mixture over carrots and toss to coat. Serve warm or room temperature.
title: Israeli Carrots

ingredients.text: 4 oz. lasagna noodles, uncooked (2 c. cooked)

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and garlic in saucepan until redness disappears.
2. Drain off excess fat.
3. Add tomato paste, tomatoes and seasonings.
4. Simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Cook lasagne noodles.
6. In a casserole dish, spread 1/3 meat, then 1/2 noodles, 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese.
7. Repeat once and lastly top off with meat sauce.
8. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
9. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or cover with waxed paper for 20 minutes, rotating every 8 minutes.
10. Serves 4.
title: Lasagne(Low Calorie)

steps: 1. Melt butter in frying pan.
2. Add garlic, salt, pepper, shrimp and lemon juice.
3. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Meanwhile, cook linguine in boiling, salted water, following package directions; drain.
5. Place linguine in heated serving bowl.
6. Pour seafood sauce on top.
7. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Shrimp Linguine

steps: 1. Cook zucchini, uncovered, 1 to 2 minutes.
2. Drain.
3. Cook meat, onions and garlic until meat is brown and onions transparent. Stir cooked rice, tomato sauce, salt, pepper and oregano into meat mixture.
4. Combine egg, cottage cheese and shredded cheese.
5. Layer in casserole dish zucchini sprinkled with salt, meat mixture, cheese mixture and another layer of zucchini.
6. Sprinkle with salt. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
7. Sprinkle cheese around edge.
8. Bake 10 more minutes.
9. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Zucchini Burger Italiano

steps: 1. Crumble ground beef into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.
2. Add onion and cover with lid.
3. Cook on High (max power) 4 minutes. Stir to break up meat into small pieces.
4. Continue to cook on High for 1 or 2 minutes more. Drain fat.
5. Stir in salt, pepper, cinnamon and pizza sauce.
6. Cook, covered, on High 5 to 6 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
7. Stir in 1/2 cup Mozzarella.
8. Arrange 4 bottom halves of buns on micro-proof plate.
9. Spoon on half meat mixture.
10. Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese.
11. Top with bun tops.
12. Cook on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until cheese melts. Repeat with other buns.
13. Makes 8 servings.
title: Microwave Pizza Burgers

ingredients.text: 4 slices Mozzarella cheese, cut into strips

steps: 1. Combine ground beef, onion, salt and 1/4 teaspoon oregano. Shape into 4 patties, rising the edge 1/4 inch to form a center well.
2. In baking dish, arrange patties.
3. Heat 5 1/2 minutes; drain.
4. Fill center well with spaghetti sauce.
5. Sprinkle with oregano; heat 1 to 2 minutes.
6. Top with cheese.
7. Let stand, covered, 4 minutes before serving.
8. Yields 4 servings.
title: Microwave Pizza Wheels

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam.
3. In large bowl, combine spinach, zucchini, cottage and Parmesan cheese, mushrooms, carrots, onions and eggs; stir to mix well. Set aside.
4. In prepared pan, spread tomato sauce to cover bottom of pan; next place lasagna noodles over sauce, then spread half of the vegetable mixture over noodles.
5. Repeat layering, ending with sauce.
6. Cover with foil.
7. Bake for 15 minutes.
8. Uncover and top mixture with Mozzarella cheese; bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
9. Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting. Serves 6.
title: Vegetable Lasagna(Less Calories)

steps: 1. Boil noodles and drain.
2. Combine butter, sour cream and half and half and cook over low heat.
3. Add noodles to sauce, then add cheese.
4. Mix well.
5. Serves 8.
title: Fettuccini Alfredo

steps: 1. Dip chicken in melted margarine.
2. Coat chicken with combined remaining ingredients.
3. Place in a greased pan.
4. Bake 400° for 20-25 minutes.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Heat sauce and water.
2. Mix together cheeses and spices.
3. Spoon mixture into uncooked manicotti.
4. Pour 1 cup sauce into bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
5. Arrange filled manicotti in single layer over sauce.
6. Pour remaining sauce over manicotti.
7. Cover with foil.
8. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
9. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer.
10. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Easy Manicotti

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in shallow pan.
2. Pour dressing over; marinate for 15 minutes.
3. Place chicken on rack of broiler pan. Broil for 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until juices run clear. Serves 4.
title: Marinated Italian Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan with cooking spray.
3. Mix together the margarine, Parmesan cheese, crumbs and seasonings.
4. Coat chicken breasts in mixture and place in baking dish.
5. Sprinkle any remaining coating mix over top of chicken. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese, all the zucchini, Ricotta cheese and Parmesan cheese.
3. Spread 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce in ungreased 11 x 7-inch rectangular baking dish. Top with 3 noodles.
4. Spread half the cheese mixture over noodles in dish.
5. Top with 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce.
6. Repeat with 3 noodles, remaining cheese mixture and 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce.
7. Top with remaining noodles and sauce.
8. Bake, covered, in preheated oven about 1 hour until noodles are tender.
9. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with reserved Mozzarella.
10. Let stand, uncovered, 15 minutes before cutting.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Cheesy Zucchini Lasagna

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fish fillets, fresh or frozen, thawed

steps: 1. In large skillet, cook onion in margarine until tender.
2. Add fish, lemon juice, oregano, zucchini and mushrooms; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
3. Top with tomato and cheese; cover and simmer 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
4. Serve immediately.
5. Serves 4.
title: Skillet Fish Italiano

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the first seven ingredients.
2. Dip chicken in butter and then into crumb mixture.
3. Place in a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
4. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Mix dressing and seasonings.
2. Pour dressing mixture over chicken.
3. Cover; refrigerate 20 minutes.
4. Drain.
5. Place chicken on grill or greased broiler pan.
6. Grill on broil for 10 to 12 minutes on each side or until tender.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Marinated Italian Garlic Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 to 4 c. spaghetti sauce (nonfat; low salt)

steps: 1. Place a small amount of sauce on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
2. Place 1 layer of noodles in pan.
3. Combine cottage cheese and egg whites.
4. Place on top of noodle layer, then add sauce.
5. Place another layer of noodles; top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese.
6. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
7. Serves 6 (259 calories, 24.8 grams protein, 7.2 grams fat, 53 mg cholesterol and 332 mg sodium).
title: Lasagne

steps: 1. Put ketchup on bread.
2. Top onion and pepper on ketchup.
3. Top with cheese.
4. Bake at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes, or golden brown and cheese melts.
5. Makes 1 serving.
6. Make as many as you like.
title: Poor Man Pizza

steps: 1. Cut fettuccine until al dente.
2. Return to pan.
3. Over low heat gently toss with cream, cheese, butter, salt and pepper.
4. Heat until butter melts and mixture is heated through.
5. Serve immediately.
6. Serves 4 main dishes.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

ingredients.text: 4 c. cooked noodles (my family likes rotini)

steps: 1. In microwave bowl melt butter and cream cheese, stirring at 30 second intervals until melted.
2. Gradually add milk and Parmesan cheese until hot.
3. Best if stirred with wire whip.
4. Serve over cooked noodles.
5. May also be cooked on stove top over medium high heat in heavy saucepan.
6. Stir constantly.
7. Serves 4.
title: Fettucine Alfredo

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Cut bread into one-inch thick slices. Cover a baking tray with aluminum foil and place slices on tray so they won't overlap.
3. Top each slice with one teaspoon tomato sauce and an even sprinkling of diced ham and cover with shredded cheese. Bake about twenty minutes, or until cheese bubbles.
4. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Mini Pizzas

steps: 1. Saute meat, breaking into small pieces as it browns.
2. Add the spaghetti sauce and salt.
3. Simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Cook lasagna noodles 12 to 15 minutes.
5. Combine remaining ingredients to prepare a cheese filling.

6. Place a small amount of the sauce in the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or casserole dish. Alternate layers of noodles, cheese filling, meat sauce, noodles, filling, noodles and meat sauce.
7. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Makes 8 servings.
title: Lasagna

steps: 1. In shallow dish, pour dressing over chicken.
2. Cover and marinate in refrigerator, turning occasionally, 3 hours or overnight.
3. Remove chicken, reserving marinade.
4. Grill or broil, turning and basting frequently with reserved marinade, until done. Makes about 4 servings.
title: Marinated Chicken Italiano

steps: 1. Crumble meat into 1 1/2-quart casserole (or microwavable colander).
2. Cook on High 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink.
3. Drain; stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, basil, oregano, garlic and water.
4. Cover; cook on High 4 to 5 minutes until mixture begins to boil.
5. Combine cottage cheese, egg, Parmesan cheese and parsley; pour 1 1/2 cups tomato mixture into 12 x 8-inch dish.
6. Spread evenly.
7. Place 4 uncooked noodles over sauce.
8. Top with 1/2 cottage cheese mixture.
9. Sprinkle with 1/2 Mozzarella cheese.
10. Spoon 1 cup sauce over cheese, then repeat layers.
11. Top with remaining sauce.
12. Cover tightly with 2 layers of plastic wrap.
13. Cook on High 15 minutes, then 30% power for 15 minutes.
14. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
15. Serves 6.
title: Microwave Lasagne

steps: 1. (Meat eaters can add 1 pound ground beef).

2. Boil pasta until barely tender, drain and rinse. (Brown meat if using). Saute onion and pepper until softened. Add spaghetti sauce and combine with cooked pasta. Divide into 3 meals and store in gallon freezer bags. Divide mozzarella into 3 quart bags and keep with pasta bags.
3. To serve, thaw and spread in 9x13 baking pan. Sprinkle with mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350. Remove cover and bake 5 more minutes. Makes 18 servings.
title: Oamc Baked Ziti

ingredients.text: 12 oz. spaghetti, cooked al dente and drained
12 to 15 strips bacon, fried crisp and drained

steps: 1. In a large skillet, brown garlic in butter.
2. Stir in cooked spaghetti, Parmesan cheese, cream and pepper; simmer over low heat until thick.
3. Place in heated serving dish, crumble bacon over top and serve immediately.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Spaghetti Alla Bacon

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onions in skillet.
2. Drain.
3. Put hamburger back in skillet and add tomato sauce and the next 4 ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, 3/4 hour.
4. Mix cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, salt and oregano.
5. In oblong baking dish, layer 1/2 of the noodles, sauce and cheese mixture; repeat.
6. Reserve enough sauce for thin layer on top.
7. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 45 to 55 minutes.
8. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
9. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Baked Lasagna

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. chopped yellow bell pepper (about 1 1/2 medium)
1 1/2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. Cook spaghetti as directed on package; drain.
2. Cook asparagus, tomatoes, garlic, bell pepper and onion in broth in 10-inch skillet over medium heat 5 minutes.
3. Stir in chicken.
4. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly, until asparagus is crisp-tender and chicken is no longer pink in center.
5. Stir in spaghetti and remaining ingredients.
6. Toss about 30 seconds or until heated through.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Italian Chicken Pasta

ingredients.text: 1 medium green bell pepper, cut up fine
3 medium cloves garlic, cut up fine
1 large can tomatoes, cut up fine

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in a large saucepan; drain grease.
2. Add remaining ingredients (except spaghetti).
3. Cook until onion and celery are tender.
4. Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
5. Drain and mix with sauce.
6. Serves 6.
title: Mom'S Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 2 lb. steak (1 1/2 inches thick; shell sirloin)

steps: 1. Place steak in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Pour tomatoes and spices over steak.
3. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
4. Top with cheese.
5. Bake until cheese melts and is light brown.
6. Makes 6 servings.
7. Good winter dish.
title: Beefsteak Pizza

ingredients.text: 16 oz. cottage cheese, mixed with 8 oz. plain yogurt

steps: 1. Spread 1 cup spaghetti sauce in 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Layer 1/3 each of noodles, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese.
3. Repeat twice.
4. Pour water around the sides of the pan; cover tightly with foil.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes or longer, until noodles are tender.
7. Let stand 20 minutes before serving.
8. Serves 6.
title: One Step Lasagna

steps: 1. Cook noodles in salted water for 2 to 3 minutes; drain.
2. Brown ground beef; drain off fat.
3. Add sauce, salt and pepper to ground beef.
4. Put half of noodles in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
5. Cover with half of the sauce and cheese.
6. Repeat layers.
7. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
8. Serves 12.
title: Pizza Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced thin

steps: 1. Marinate pork chops in salad dressing for 3 hours, turning occasionally.
2. Remove chops from marinade.
3. Brown chops on both sides in oil over medium heat.
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Return browned chops to marinade in baking dish.
5. Layer potatoes and onion over chops.
6. Dot with butter.
7. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons dressing.
8. Sprinkle cheese over top.
9. Cover with foil. Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until potatoes and chops are tender.
10. Makes 4 servings.
title: Easy Italian Pork Dinner

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Place margarine in a quiche dish or a deep dish pie plate, place in oven and let melt for about 3 to 5 minutes.
3. While margarine is melting, lightly brown sausage, onion and green pepper for about 10 minutes or until onion and pepper is slightly soft, drain if needed.
4. Beat together eggs, milk, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper until light and slightly foamy.
5. Then add in sausage mixture, and 3/4 cup of mozzarella cheese.
6. Pour into dish, and top with remaining cheese.
7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until center is puffy.
8. Test for doneness with a toothpick inserted between the center and edge of pan.
9. Let set for 10 minutes.
10. This will serve 6 with a salad or 4 without a salad.
title: Italian Style Crustless Quiche

ingredients.text: 2 raw boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/2-inch thickness

steps: 1. In a small microwave-safe bowl, microwave butter for 10 seconds, or until melted.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk melted butter, broth, wine, and cornstarch until cornstarch has dissolved.
3. Bring a large skillet sprayed with nonstick spray to medium-high heat. Cook and stir mushrooms until softened, which is about 5 - 7 minutes.

4. Move mushrooms to the sides of the skillet. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and basil, and lay in the center of the skillet. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring mushrooms occasionally. (You can also move mushrooms to another dish and add them again with the broth mixture.).
5. Flip chicken. Give broth mixture a stir and add to the skillet. Stirring mushrooms occasionally, cook until sauce has thickened and chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
6. MAKES 2 SERVINGS.
title: Skinny Girl Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Warm the Spaghetti Sauce; stir in Cottage Cheese and Mozzarella.
2. Fold in Noodles.
3. Pour into two greased 2-cup casseroles.
4. Sprinkle with Parmesan Cheese.
5. Bake uncovered at 374 for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
6. Yield:
7. 2 servings.
title: Lazy Lasagna For 2

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain. Combine butter and next 4 ingredients; stir in sour cream. Combine fettuccine and sour cream mixture; add cheese and toss until fettuccine is coated.
2. Serve immediately.
3. Yield:
4. 6 servings.
title: Fettuccine With Poppy Seed

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Mix crumbs, cheese and chopped almonds together.
3. Blend butter and next 5 ingredients and spread over chicken breasts.
4. Dip pieces in crumb mixture to coat.
5. Put chicken in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
6. Bake, uncovered, for 55 to 65 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Parmesan Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium green pepper, cut into strips
2 whole medium chicken breasts, skinned (boneless and halved lengthwise)

steps: 1. In a 1 3/4-quart microwave-safe pan, combine mushrooms, green pepper, onion and water.
2. Cook, uncovered, on 100% power for 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
3. Drain.
4. Stir in spaghetti sauce, olives, tomato paste and garlic powder.
5. Add chicken breasts to casserole, turning to coat with sauce.
6. Arrange meaty portions toward outside edge of casserole.
7. Cover and cook on 100% power for 10 to 12 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve with rice or pasta, if desired.
8. Makes 4 servings, 176 calories.
title: Cacciatore Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cut off stem end of each zucchini. Lengthwise slice off top third of each zucchini; hollow out, leaving 1/4-inch shell.
3. In medium saucepan, bring water, oleo and 1/2 teaspoon salt to rolling boil.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Stir in milk, egg and potato flakes until well combined.
6. Stir in remaining ingredients.
7. Spoon 1/8 of potato mixture (about 1/2 cup) into each zucchini shell.
8. Place each stuffed shell on piece of foil; wrap loosely.
9. Repeat with remaining potato mixture and shells. Bake at 350°
10. for 20 minutes.
11. Open foil packets; continue baking 15 to 20 minutes longer or until thoroughly heated.
12. Serves 8.
title: Italian Zucchini Boats

steps: 1. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Add butter and toss to coat. In a skillet, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. Spread a fourth of the spaghetti sauce in an ungreased 5-quart slow cooker. Layer with a third of the noodles, a third of the beef, a third of the remaining sauce and a third of the cheeses. Repeat layers twice. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until cheese is melted. Yields 12 to 16 servings.
title: Egg Noodle Lasagna

steps: 1. Melt margarine in a nonstick skillet and add minced garlic and saute for 1 minute.
2. Add flour, then gradually add the milk.
3. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring constantly.
4. Stir in cream cheese and cook for 2 minutes more.
5. Add freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
6. Stir until melted.
7. Serve over cooked hot fettucine tossed well or serve separately.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Light Fettucine Alfredo

steps: 1. Place chicken in baking dish.
2. Add butter.
3. Sprinkle salt and bread crumbs evenly over chicken.
4. Add 1/3 cup water for moistness.
5. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400° or until tender.
6. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: Italian Baked Chicken

steps: 1. Skin chicken and place meaty-side down in a 9 x 14-inch baking dish.
2. Pour 1/2 spaghetti sauce and 1/2 Parmesan cheese over chicken.
3. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
4. Turn chicken over.
5. Pour remaining sauce and cheese over chicken.
6. Bake an additional 20 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Italian Chicken

steps: 1. In frypan, saute diced tomato, onion, garlic and green pepper. In a separate pan, cream together half and half and cheeses.
2. Add seafood and spices to vegie mixture.
3. Saute until cooked, on low, and cover.
4. Drain excess liquid.
5. Add vegetable and seafood mixture to cheese sauce.
6. Serve over egg noodles.
7. Serves 2.
title: Jill'S Seafood Fettucine Alfredo

steps: 1. Spoon over 2 to 3 pounds chicken.
2. Bake 45 minutes at 375°. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.
3. Dip chicken in margarine.
4. Coat with combined remaining ingredients.
5. Place in prepared pan.
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Marinate pork chops in 1/4 cup salad dressing in baking dish for 3 hours.
2. Brown in oil in skillet.
3. Return to marinade. Layer potatoes and onion over chops.
4. Dot with butter.
5. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons salad dressing.
6. Sprinkle with cheese.
7. Bake, covered, at 375° for 1 hour or until tender.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Easy Italian Pork Dinner

ingredients.text: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (2 lbs.)
1/4 tsp. paprika, salt, and black pepper

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray.
3. Dip chicken in margarine and coat with combined remaining ingredients.
4. Place in prepared pan.
5. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tender.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts

ingredients.text: 2 to 3 boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In deep skillet or wok, heat oil on medium-high heat. Add garlic, tomatoes and basil. Saute until tomatoes are soft (5 to 7 minutes). Mash with potato masher.
2. Add chicken and mushrooms. Reduce heat to simmer (medium-low to low).
3. Allow to simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 to 15 minutes.
4. Serve over rice or angel hair pasta.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Chicken Pizzaiola

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Split open hot dog buns and spread each with 2 tablespoons pizza sauce.
3. Cut frankfurters in half lengthwise and lay them on the buns.
4. Top each with one or more teaspoons pizza sauce.
5. Place the pizza pups on a baking sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes.
6. Top with Mozzarella cheese; bake 2 minutes more or until cheese melts.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Pizza Pups

steps: 1. Cook spaghetti, drain and mix in eggs, Parmesan cheese and butter.
2. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Brown beef, onion and green pepper; drain and pour over spaghetti.
4. Cover all with sauce.
5. Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
6. Top with cheese, last 15 minutes.
7. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Spaghetti Casserole

steps: 1. Add carrots and broccoli to cooking noodles for last 2 minutes of cooking time.
2. Drain and rinse with cold water.
3. Stir in dressings and remaining ingredients.
4. Refrigerate.
5. Makes 12 servings.
title: Pasta Primavera

ingredients.text: 2 tsp. chopped fresh parsley, if desired

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain, rinse with hot water.
2. Set aside.
3. Meanwhile, melt margarine in 6 quart Dutch oven.
4. Stir in cream and pepper.
5. Cook over low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly, stirring frequently.
6. Stir in parmesan cheese and cook over low heat just until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Immediately stir in cooked fettuccine; toss to coat with sauce. Stir in parsley and nutmeg.
7. If sauce begins to separate, stir in a little more cream and cook over low heat until smooth.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

ingredients.text: 3 lb. chicken, cut up and skin removed

steps: 1. Dip chicken in melted margarine, then roll in bread crumbs and cheese mixture. Place in any baking pan (no lid).
2. Drizzle remaining margarine over chicken. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Pound (flatten) chicken breasts to about 1/4-inch thickness. Fry in 1 tablespoon margarine until golden brown on both sides. Remove to other dish.
2. Place scallions, mushrooms and carrots in a frypan with chicken broth and 1/2 cup wine.
3. Simmer for 2 minutes. Place chicken in sauce with another 1/2 cup wine and simmer until chicken is done (10 minutes).
4. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain off fat. Add salt, pepper, garlic and basil. Add 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. In a 2-quart casserole dish, layer 1/2 each starting with macaroni, Ricotta cheese, shredded cheese, then meat sauce; repeat.
3. Cook at 375° for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
4. Serve with salad and garlic bread.
title: Mock Lasagne

steps: 1. Spoon over two or three pounds boneless chicken breasts and bake 45 minutes at 375°.
2. This serves 4 to 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Boil potatoes until well done. Cool a little, peel and mash thoroughly. Place on floured board and mix well with flour. Some potatoes will require more flour than others. Knead potato dough well.
2. Roll into finger-thin roll and cut into pieces 2 inches long. Press each piece lightly with fork.

3. Place about 20 gnocchi in boiling salted water. When they come to surface, remove from water with strainer and place in serving dish. Keep water boiling briskly; repeat until all gnocchi are cooked.
4. Add sauce, mix well, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve. Serves 6.
title: Gnocchi

steps: 1. Layer sauce, noodles, cheese and sauce in a 9 x 13-inch pan. When all is layered in pan, cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour, then bake 15 minutes, uncovered.
2. Allow to rest 10 minutes. Serves 12.
title: Easy Lasagne

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine the first 10 ingredients; mix well.
2. Place the tortillas on greased baking sheets; spread with cheese mixture. Bake at 400 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden.
3. Cut into wedges.
4. Yield:
5. 8 servings.
title: Tortilla Pizzas

steps: 1. Combine onion and ground beef.
2. Place in nonstick skillet and brown, draining off fat as it accumulates.
3. Add tomato paste, water, spices, herbs and tomatoes.
4. Simmer 1 or more hours, adding more water if needed.
5. Serve 1/2 cup sauce over 1/2 cup cooked spaghetti.
title: Diet Italian Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Let dough rise.
2. Roll dough on a floured surface into a rectangle.
3. Spray baking sheet with Pam.
4. Combine ground beef, cheese, barbecue sauce, parsley, basil and oregano; mix well. Spread mixture in a strip in the center of the dough.
5. Fold sides of dough over filling, overlapping edges.
6. Pinch together to seal seams and ends.
7. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
8. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.
title: Calzone

steps: 1. Brown meat.
2. Combine meat, green pepper, onion, spices and tomato sauce.
3. Place cooked noodles on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
4. Pour sauce over noodles.
5. Sprinkle cheeses evenly on top.
6. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes with foil over top.
7. Cool a little and cut.
title: Pizza Hot Dish

steps: 1. Preheat the grill by turning it to high.
2. Sandwich the chicken breasts between two plastic food bags and beat them firmly with a rolling pin or base of a saucepan to flaten them by a third.
3. heat the oil in a non stick frying pan, add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
4. Grate the cheese and quarter the tomatoes and mix the two together.
5. Take the chicken out of the pan and wipe out the oil so that it doesn't spit under the grill later.
6. Return the chicken to the pan, spread each with a tsp of pesto, then pile the cheese and tomatoes on top.
7. Put under the hot grill for a minute or so until the cheese has melted and is bubbly.
title: Pizza Chicken Melts

ingredients.text: 12 lasagna noodles (I used the kind you don't have to boil)
3/4 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F; spray 13X9" pan with vegetable oil cooking spray.

2. Melt butter in a large, heavy skillet and cook onion over how heat until very soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook about 1 minutes longer. Over medium-low heat, stir in the flour with a whisk, then gradually add the half-and-half, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly before adding more. When the sauce has thickened to about the consistency of whipping cream, add the Romano cheese and stir well. Add the salt and pepper and stir again. Add the scallops and cook for about 3-4 minutes, then add the shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes or just until the shrimp turn pink. Turn off the heat.

3. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the sauce from the skillet into the prepared pan. Cover the bottom of the pan with lasagna noodles, placing them side by side. Spoon 1/3 of sauce over the noodles, distributing half of the seafood evenly. Layer with more lasagna noodles, 1/3 of sauce, and remaining seafood. Cover with remaining noodles and the remaining sauce. Don't spoon any seafood on top of the noodles, just use sauce. Tuck in any edges of the noodles so they are all coated with sauce. Top with Parmesan.
4. Bake for 25 minutes, uncovered, or until bubbly and browned. Allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Shrimp And Scallop Lasagna

ingredients.text: 1/4 lb. fresh sausage, cooked and crumbled

title: Orzo Primavera

steps: 1. Mix flour, salt, pepper and paprika; put in bowl.
2. Mix egg and milk; put in another bowl.
3. Mix cheese and bread crumbs.
4. Coat chicken with flour, dip in egg mixture and roll in cheese crumbs. Melt butter in pan.
5. Place chicken skin side down.
6. Bake 30 minutes on each side.
7. May use boneless chicken.
8. Bake 20 minutes on each side at 400°.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Crumble ground meat in colander over mixing bowl and microwave on High 5 minutes, stirring halfway.
2. Discard drippings.
3. Combine meat, sauce, water and Italian seasonings; set aside.
4. Combine cottage cheese, egg, parsley, pepper and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese in separate bowl.
5. Pour 1/4-inch meat sauce in baking dish.
6. Layer noodles, sauce, cottage cheese mixture, then Mozzarella cheese. Cover with plastic wrap.
7. Microwave on High 8 minutes.
8. Simmer (1/3 power) for 20 minutes; sprinkle on remaining Parmesan cheese. Allow to stand 15 minutes before serving.
title: Microwave Quick Lasagna

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients well.
2. Use in lasagna recipe in place of ricotta.
title: Tofu Lasagna Filling (Ricotta Substitute)

steps: 1. Brown meat lightly in olive oil with garlic and onion; add tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, oregano, salt and pepper.
2. Bring to a boil and simmer covered 2 to 3 hours.
3. Cook noodles in salted boiling water until tender.
4. Drain noodles just before making.
5. In a shallow baking dish, put a layer of noodles and a layer of meat mixture and layer of each kind of cheese.
6. Repeat layers and top with Parmesan cheese.
7. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
title: Lasagna

steps: 1. Cook pasta in boiling water for 10 - 12 minutes until al dente.
2. Meanwhile, cut the Velveeta into cubes and add it to the cream and butter in a large saucepan over low heat, stirring often.
3. Drain pasta well and add to Velveeta mixture and gently mix to coat.
title: Just Like California Pizza Kitchen Mac & Cheese

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place chicken in a Medium or Large Ziploc(R) Zip 'n SteamTM Bag. Seal bag. Pat chicken into a single layer and place bag in microwave. Cook on full power for 4 minutes (Medium bag) or 3-1/2 minutes (Large bag) or until meat is no longer pink. Chicken should be thoroughly cooked before adding remaining ingredients.

2. Allow bag to stand 1 minute before handling. Carefully open bag. Leave cooked chicken in bag. Add cheese, pizza sauce, flour, oregano, garlic powder and salt to bag. Seal bag and gently shake to combine ingredients. Pat ingredients into a single layer and place bag in microwave.

3. Cook on full power for an additional 1-1/2 minutes to melt cheese and make sauce. Allow bag to stand 1 minute before handling. Wearing an oven mitt, gently squeeze bag to combine cheese sauce. Carefully open bag and serve.
title: Pizza Cheesy Chicken

steps: 1. Add ingredients in the order suggested by your manufacturer. Set bread-maker for dough setting and start machine. When the unit signals, remove dough.

2. Pat dough into 12x15-inch jelly roll pan or greased 12-inch round pizza pan. Let stand 10 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Spread pizza sauce over dough. Sprinkle toppings over sauce. Bake 15-20 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.
title: Pizza Crust I

steps: 1. Mix the first 5 ingredients.
2. Spread 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce over bottom of a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
3. Arrange 4 noodles over sauce.
4. Cover with 1 cup Ricotta cheese mixture, 1 cup shredded Mozzarella cheese and 1 1/3 cups spaghetti sauce. Repeat another layer.
5. Sprinkle over top 1 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
title: 3 Cheese Lasagne(St. Rose Student Recipe)

steps: 1. Brown beef with onion.
2. Add tomato sauce and next 4 spices; let simmer 5 minutes.
3. Slice zucchini and layer noodles and zucchini.
4. Cover with mixture of cottage cheese, egg and flour, then layer of ground beef. Repeat layers until all used.
5. Cook in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
6. Top with shredded Mozzarella cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted.
title: Zucchini Lasagna

steps: 1. Place the water, yeast, oil, salt and oregano into the Thermomix bowl. Mix for 5 seconds/speed 3.
2. Add the flour Mix 6 seconds/speed 8.
3. Set dial to closed lid position. Knead the dough for 2 minutes/interval speed.
4. Transfer dough to an oiled bowl and allow to rise until double - 45 minutes.
5. Punch down and allow to double again - 45 minutes.
6. Divide the dough into four balls and let rest for 15 minutes.
7. Form the pizzas and add favorite toppings.
8. Bake at 400 degrees F for about 12 minutes, or until browned.
title: Thermomix Pizza Dough

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, cubed and cooked

steps: 1. Boil pasta as instructed on package.
2. Mix half-and-half with butter and flour over medium heat.
3. Add cheese, stir until melted, stir frequently.
4. Add cooked, seasoned chicken and pasta.
5. Bake in oven for 20-25 minutes.
6. Chicken is seasoned to meet your taste.
title: Chicken & Cheese Penne Pasta

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (4 ounces each)

steps: 1. Place chicken in a microwave-safe dish. Top with soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese and dot with butter. Cover and cook on high for 4-5 minutes or until a thermometer reads 170°.
title: Microwaved Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Brown beef and garlic.
2. Drain.
3. Add tomato paste, tomatoes, salt, pepper and oregano.
4. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
5. Cook noodles according to package directions.
title: Homemade Lasagne

steps: 1. Beat egg with 1 tbsp lemon juice.
2. Combine flour, garlic powder, and paprika.
3. Dip chicken in egg, dredge in flour, brown in butter in skillet.
4. Dissolve bullion in boiling water, add remaining 2 tbsp lemon juice.
5. Pour over browned chicken and simmer, covered 20 minutes or until tender.
6. You might want to increase seasonings to your liking.
7. We love garlic, so I increase the amount, and also while browning the chicken, you might need more butter.
8. And while the chicken is simmering, you may need to add a bit of water, so it doesn't dry out.
title: Chicken Piccata

steps: 1. Mix the flour, sugar and Crisco; save 1 cup for topping.
2. Add the remaining dough ingredients; mix together and press onto 1 large or 2 small cookie sheets.
3. Pinch edges.
title: Hawaiian Pizza

steps: 1. Combine the ingredients in a mixing bowl.
2. Preheat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
3. Cook the mixture until browned, stirring to crumble it.
4. Drain.
5. Note, the pizza sausage can be frozen in zip bags for later use.
title: Atsa Spicy Pizza Sausage

steps: 1. Brown the ground beef in a large pot.
2. Drain off fat.
3. Add sliced onion and minced garlic. Cook for about a minute.
4. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine and oregano.
5. Simmer for about two hours.
6. Boil water and cook lasagna noodles for about 10 minutes.
7. Drain and let cool.
8. In a blender, mix ricotta, egg, salt and pepper.
9. Spread noodles on bottom of dish. Layer with tomato meat sauce, ricotta mixture, mozzarella and parmesan. Repeat.
10. Cook for 1/2 hour at 350 degrees.
title: Mom'S Meat Lasagna

steps: 1. Spread pizza sauce on each slice of bread.
2. Put cheese on the bread.
3. Top with pepperoni.
4. Put bread on top.
5. Butter both sides and cook in toastmaster for 5 minutes or until brown.
title: Pizza Pockets

steps: 1. cook linguine according to package directions; drain and keep warm.
2. Saute onion and garlic in butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until onion is tender.
3. Stir in sour cream and next 3 ingredients; cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Toss with linguine. Sprinkle with cheese and chopped parsley.
title: Lemon Linguine

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4 inch-thick slices
2 tbsp shredded fresh basil, plus extra leaves, for garnish

steps: 1. To make the pizza dough, combine flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Add 1 cup water and 1/2 tbsp oil and mix until combined. Knead for 3-5 mins, until smooth and elastic. Transfer to a lightly oiled bowl, cover and set aside in a warm area to proof for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
2. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 350°F with a heavy baking tray or pizza stone inside. Process tomatoes, garlic and remaining oil until smooth. Strain.

3. De-gas dough and knead lightly. Divide into 3 equal pieces. Shape each into an 8x12 inch rectangle. Spread tomato sauce over bases, leaving a 1/3 inch border around edges. Top with mozzarella and cherry tomatoes. Scatter with shredded basil. Slide 1 pizza on preheated tray and bake for 10-12 mins, or until cheese is bubbling and edges are golden brown. Sprinkle with basil leaves. Repeat with remaining pizzas.
title: Margherita Pizza

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned

steps: 1. Combine Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs and seasonings in pan. Dip chicken in butter and roll in crumb mixture.
2. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
3. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. In a nonstick skillet, saute mushrooms in butter.
2. Stir in basil and garlic.
3. Cook on low heat until mushrooms are soft. Stir in sour cream and 1/2 of the grated cheese.
4. Stir until blended smoothly.
title: Rich Alfredo

steps: 1. Cream together the first 3 ingredients.
2. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Fruit Pizza

steps: 1. In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast and brown sugar in the water, and let sit for 10 minutes.
2. Stir the salt and oil into the yeast solution. Mix in 2 1/2 cups of the flour.

3. Turn dough out onto a clean, well floured surface, and knead in more flour until the dough is no longer sticky. Place the dough into a well oiled bowl, and cover with a cloth. Let the dough rise until double; this should take about 1 hour. Punch down the dough, and form a tight ball. Allow the dough to relax for a minute before rolling out. Use for your favorite pizza recipe.

4. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). If you are baking the dough on a pizza stone, you may place your toppings on the dough, and bake immediately. If you are baking your pizza in a pan, lightly oil the pan, and let the dough rise for 15 or 20 minutes before topping and baking it.
5. Bake pizza in preheated oven, until the cheese and crust are golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Jay'S Signature Pizza Crust

steps: 1. Heat a large pot of water to boiling and throw in the pasta.
2. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a small sauce pan and put in the white part of the spring onion.
3. Fry for about 30 seconds and then add the tomatoes.
4. Bring to a simmer and let cook for about 10 minutes, adding a spoonful of water if the tomatoes get too dry, until you have a sauce.
5. While the tomatoes are simmering, you can lightly fry your veggies in the other tbsp of oil.
6. When the tomatoes have cooked down, add the ricotta, milk and hot sauce.
7. Blend with a hand blender to make the sauce smooth.
8. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce.
9. Top with the veggies, green part of the spring onion and parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Penne With Shrimp And Mushrooms - On The Lighter Side

steps: 1. Put in a bowl the flour and the baking powder.
2. Add sugar, the salt, 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
3. Add 2 cups of water and started to knead.
4. If the dough will seem sticky, don't worry. Add more flour until it becomes smooth and homogeneous.
5. Now give to the dough the shape of a ball and leave it into the bowl covered with transparent film.
6. Put the dough in the oven closed and turned off.
7. Take back the dough after about 4 hours, or anyway when it will become twice its volume.
8. N.B. I usually prepare the dough in the evening and I pull it out of the oven the next day-.
9. When the dough has doubled in volume, take some flour and detach it from the bowl.
10. Started to manipulate the dough and divide into two equal parts.
11. Form two balls this time, and put them in two different bowls covered with transparent film again, and again put in the oven to rise until they reach twice their volume.

12. When the dough has doubled, take the compound obtained into a bowl and put it in a round baking pan (or square if you don't have round) and being to roll the dough directly into the pan, using your hands, until you have covered all the entire pan.
13. Do the same with the other dough to obtain 2 pizzas.
14. Now put 1 tablespoon of olive oil on the pizza and put 1 grated zucchini and cherry tomatoes cut into 4 pieces.
15. Add the mozzarella cheese on top and put in the oven preheat to 375F for 15/18 minutes, and anyway until the colour will became gold and the cheese will melted.
16. Remove from the oven and enjoy hot.
17. Bonne apetit.
title: Italian Pizza With Zucchini, Cherry Tomatoes And Mozzarella Chee

steps: 1. For filling, in a medium bowl combine chicken, Monterey Jack cheese, celery, ripe olives, basil, oregano, garlic powder, and pepper. Stir in cream cheese. Set aside.

2. For calzones, unroll pizza dough. On lightly floured surface roll dough into a 15x10-inch rectangle. Cut into six 5-inch squares. Divide chicken-olive filling among the squares. Brush edges with water. Lift one corner and stretch dough over to the opposite corner. Seal edges of dough well with tines of a fork. Arrange calzones on a greased baking sheet. Prick tops with a fork. In a small bowl combine egg and 1 tablespoon water; brush over the calzones. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.
3. Bake in a 425 degree F oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Serve with heated spaghetti sauce, if desired.

title: Eggplant Lasagna

steps: 1. In a medium bowl (I used a measuring cup), combine the WARM water (not too hot or you'll kill the yeast), sugar and yeast until dissolved. Leave for 5 - 10 minutes until the yeast activates and the mixture develops a layer of froth on the surface.

2. In a large bowl, mix the sea salt and flour and make a well in the center. Add the yeast and olive oil. Mix together with a fork or wooden spoon, and then use your hands until the dough comes together.

3. Tip the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until the dough is smooth, shiny and elastic (about 5 - 10 minutes) or allow the kitchen aid to do this. If the dough is too sticky or soft, add a little extra flour or if it's too dry and crumbly, add a little water.
4. Shape the dough into a round ball and place in a large, oiled bowl. Cover with a damp cloth for roughly 45 minutes or until the dough doubles in size.

5. Punch down the dough to remove the air and place it on a lightly floured work surface. Divide in 2 and shape each piece into round disks (this step requires common sense, meaning if you want small 6" pizzas or if you scale the recipe for more people you will need to divide the dough into more balls).
6. Place the dough balls on a sheet of parchment. Cover with a light coating of oil and let them rise again, for about 20 minutes.

7. Dough is now ready to add whatever toppings you like bake in a 400°F oven for approximately 15 to 20 minutes (less or more time as required). Keep an eye on it until the cheese browns and the crust looks done to your liking.

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325° F. Cover a pizza pan with foil and spray the foil. Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, and cocoa powder in a mixing bowl. Cut in the butter pieces until it holds together. Press mixture into the pizza pan and bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes until the crust is set. Let cool completely.

steps: 1. Adjust your oven shelf to its lowest position. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.

2. MAKE FILLING:
3. Roast squash, flesh down, in center of oven for 30 mins (or til tender). Scoop & mash flesh when cool.

6. Fill wonton wrapper with 1 tablespoons filling (flour surface under to prevent sticking). Wet edges and top with second wrapper. Press down around filling to seal and remove air. Place on towel to dry slightly, turning. Fill the rest of wontons the same way.
