title: Linguine With Shrimp Sauce

steps: 1. Bring cream to the boil in a small saucepan, then simmer for 2min or until slightly reduced.

2. Add blue cheese to pan, season to taste with pepper, reduce heat to low-medium then cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3min or until cheese has melted (don't worry if mixture isn't completely smooth).
3. Spread the gnocchi over the base of a large baking dish, scatter with prosciutto pieces then pour over the blue cheese sauce. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and parmesan.
4. Bake in 180oC oven for 15-20min or until sauce is bubbling and crumbs are golden.
title: Baked Gnocchi With Blue Cheese And Prosciutto Cream Sauce

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons very finely grated parmesan cheese

steps: 1. Cook the rice in the hot water, simmering over a low heat in a covered pan for around 20 minutes, until all the water has been absorbed.
2. When the rice is fully cooked, remove from the heat.
3. Add the pesto sauce, pine nuts and parmesan cheese. Stir to mix well.
4. If the rice has had a chance to cool at all, you may wish to reheat it at this point- the rice should be hot enough for the mozzarella to melt slightly.
5. Serve onto plates and top with the grated mozzarella if desired.
6. Enjoy!
title: Pesto Rice With Pine Nuts

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl (with spoon or by hand). Form into 1-inch meatballs.
title: Meatballs And Marinara Sauce

steps: 1. Spray electric skillet with Pam.
2. Preheat to 350°.
3. Mix in 16 ounces quick shake or mix in bowl with fork the milk and eggs.
4. Add flour, salt, pepper and Italian seasonings.
5. Shake or mix mixture, then pour in skillet.
6. Add pizza sauce, pepperoni, cheese or whatever else you like on your pizza.
7. Put on cover and let cook for 15 minutes without lifting cover.
8. It's quick and delicious.
title: Quick Shake Pizza

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine, melted
3 tablespoons minced fresh basil, set aside a few whole leaves as garnish (coriander or cilantro can also be used for a different taste)

steps: 1. Place flour and lighlty beaten eggs in separate containers that are large enough to accommodate each chicken breast.
2. Dip chicken in flour then in egg and place in greased 9x13 pan.
3. Combine the cheese, breadcrumbs & butter and sprinkle over chicken.
4. Loosely cover dish with foil & bake at 375 for 20 minutes.
5. Meanwhile combine remaining ingredients.
6. Uncover the chicken and bake an additional 5-10 minutes longer until top is browned.
7. Spoon tomato mixture over chicken, return to oven for 3-5 minutes or until just heated through.
8. Plate each breast and garnish with 2 or 3 whole basil leaves.
title: Bruschetta Chicken

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients. Shape in little balls. Roll in flour-paprika mixture.
2. Fry in 3 tablespoons butter until brown. Add spaghetti and sauce.
title: Meatballs For Spaghetti

steps: 1. Melt together olive oil and butter until warm, not hot.
2. Saute garlic for 5 minutes.
3. Add salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Simmer 5 minutes.
4. Toss with cooked spaghetti.
title: Spaghetti In Garlic Sauce

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups firmly packed fresh basil leaves
1 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 inch long pices. (or a combination of green beans and diced potatoes)

steps: 1. Making the Pesto:
2. Combine the basil and Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese in a blender or food processor and blend until the basil is finely chopped, but not pureed.
3. Add the olive oil, and garlic and blend until almost smooth.
4. Season with salt and pepper and set aside.
5. Cooking the Beans:
6. Pour about 2 inches of water into a 6 quart pot.
7. Place a collapsible steamer in the pot, cover, and bring to a full boil.
8. Place beans in the steamer, cover the pot, and steam 6 minutes, or until tender crisp.
9. Mix 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar with 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar.
10. Remove the beans to a shallow serving bowl.
11. Add the pesto to the beans, stirring in the vinegar/sugar mixture.
12. Toss to thoroughly coat the beans.
13. Taste for seasoning and serve hot or at room temperature.
14. Note: Refrigeration will alter the flavors so best served right after the pesto and beans are combined.
title: Green Beans With Balsamic Pesto

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon sea salt, or to taste (optional)

steps: 1. Blend green onions, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and sea salt together in a food processor until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.
title: Ginger Garlic Pesto

steps: 1. Mix ingredients well.
2. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan.
3. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
4. Cut into squares.
5. (Freeze, if desired.)
title: Zucchini Pizza Appetizers

steps: 1. For the pastry, sift the flour and salt into the bowl of a food processor, add the butter and lard, then whizz together briefly until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Tip the mixture into a bowl, then stir in the cheese and enough of the water for the mixture to come together. Tip out onto a lightly floured surface and knead briefly until smooth. Roll out thinly and line a 23cm x 4cm loose-?bottomed fluted flan tin. Prick the base with a fork. Chill for 20 minutes.

2. 02.Melt the 75g butter in a saucepan over a low heat, then add the leeks and the salt. Cover and cook for ?10 minutes until soft. Uncover the pan, increase the heat and cook ?for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has evaporated. Spoon onto a plate and leave to cool.

3. 03.Preheat the oven to 200°C/fan180°C/gas 6. Line the pastry case with baking paper and baking beans or rice and blind bake for 15-20 minutes until the edges are biscuit-coloured. Remove the paper and beans/rice and return the case to the oven for 7-10 minutes until the base is crisp and lightly golden. Remove and set aside. Reduce the oven temperature to 190°C/fan170°C/gas 5.

4. 04.Put the crème fraîche into a bowl with the whole egg, egg yolks and nutmeg. Lightly beat together, then season. Stir in the leeks. Spoon ?the mixture into the tart case and bake for 35-40 minutes until set ?and lightly golden. Remove from ?the oven and leave for 10 minutes. Take out of the tin and serve.
title: Flamiche

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
3. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
4. Bring mixture to room temperature before baking.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until is firmly set.
6. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Easiest Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. zucchini, grated, cooked and cooled

steps: 1. Put together as listed and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Let stand 15 minutes.
2. Put in round cake pan or quiche pan or 8-inch square pan.
3. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven. Serves 6.
title: Zucchini Souffle

steps: 1. Crumble sausage in skillet and brown.
2. Drain well.
3. Mix eggs, milk, salt, mustard and cubed bread.
4. Stir well.
5. Add sausage and cheese to mixture.
6. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan or baking dish. Refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
8. (If using glass dish, set out 30 minutes prior to baking.)
9. Serves 10.
title: Sausage And Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 F. In a blender or food processor, combine the milk, heavy cream, sugar, flour, eggs, egg yolk and vanilla and blend until smooth. Arrange the berries in a buttered 10-inch pie plate and pour the batter over them. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the flan is puffed and golden. Sift confectioners' sugar over the top and serve warm. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Blueberry Clafoutis

ingredients.text: 2 c. sausage, crabmeat, lobster, bacon, ham or vegetables

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. Remove crusts from bread.
3. Cut into cubes. Beat eggs; add milk and seasonings.
4. Stir in bread, cheese and sausage.
5. Pour into oblong 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.
6. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until center is set.
7. Serves 10.
8. May be mixed the night before you serve it.
title: Egg Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups cooked brown rice, room temperature
3/4 cup shredded low fat mozzarella cheese, divided

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine rice, 1/4 cup egg substitute, and half of the cheese; mix well.
2. Pat into the bottom and up sides of a 9 inch pie plate coated with non stick cooking spray, set aside.
3. In another bowl, combine broccoli, mushrooms, milk, margarine, and remaining egg substitute.
4. Pour into crust.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
6. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
7. Return to the oven until cheese melts.
8. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Vegetable Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.
2. Scald milk. Pour into saucepan. Heat just until bubbles form along edge; do not boil.
3. Remove from heat. Skim. Combine yolks and 1/2 cup of sugar in a bowl. Whisk until smooth. Add flour and cornstarch. Add scalded milk and return mixture to saucepan.
4. Stir over low heat until thickened.

5. Add cheese, butter, lemon juice and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat and spoon cream into bottom of quiche pan. Arrange berries on top and press lightly into cream. Sprinkle sugar on top.
6. Run under broiler until lightly browned. Yields 6 servings.
title: Berries Gratin

ingredients.text: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Line unpricked pastry shells with a double thickness of heavy duty foil.
2. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes.
3. Remove foil; bake 5 minutes longer.
4. Divide ham, cheese and onion between the shells. In a bowl, whisk eggs, cream, salt and pepper.
5. Pour into shells. Cover and freeze for up to 3 months.
6. Or cover edges with foil and bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
7. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.
8. Yield:
9. 2 quiche.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Ham 'N Cheese Quiche

ingredients.text: 6 slices soft white bread, crusts removed and bread cubed
1 lb. uncooked shrimp, shelled and deveined
3 eggs, beaten with salt, mustard and 1 pt. milk

steps: 1. Layer shrimp, bread and cheese in greased casserole.
2. Pour over oleo and egg mixture. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Bake 1 hour at 350°, uncovered.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Shrimp Souffle

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 9 x 13 pan or pyrex dish.
2. Beat the eggs in a large bowl, add flour, baking powder and salt and blend. Add melted butter, chilis, cottage cheese and Jack cheese, and mix until blended.
3. Turn batter into pan and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 35-40 minutes longer.
4. Cut into squares.
5. Serves 12 as a side dish, or cut into smaller squares and serve as a hot hors d'oeuvre.
title: Chili Cheese Souffle ("Rellenos Al Reves")

steps: 1. Pour this over bacon stuff.
2. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
3. Cut and serve.
4. (You can use ham instead of bacon.) Serves 6.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Peel, slice and cook carrots; remove from heat and drain. Process in a food processor till smooth. Beat eggs and set aside. Mix carrots with remaining ingredients; slowly add beaten eggs. Mix until well blended. Pour into a 12 x 18 baking pan sprayed with Pam. Bake for 1 hour or until center is set at 350°. If using convection oven, reduce heat to between 300° and 325°. Check often so that it doesn't brown too quickly. Serves 30 good size servings.
title: Carrot Souffle(Large Quantity Recipe)

ingredients.text: 1 medium green bell pepper, chopped (about 1 c.)

steps: 1. Prepare cubed eggplant (pare if desired).
2. Prepare sliced zucchini.
3. Cook all ingredients in 12-inch skillet over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is tender.
4. Makes 6 servings, 140 calories per serving.
5. Delicious served hot or cold.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Combine honey, mustard, curry powder and soy sauce.
2. Place chicken in a food storage bag with zipper-type closure.
3. Pour in marinade.
4. Marinate in refrigerator overnight.
5. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, place chicken breasts.
6. Pour marinade over chicken. Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
7. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes, uncovered.
8. Serves 4.
title: Honey Dijon Chicken(Fat:  3 Grams Per Serving)

steps: 1. Cook zucchini until tender and drain.
2. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic salt.
3. Combine egg yolks, sour cream and flour. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into sour cream mixture. Place 1/2 of zucchini in a baking dish.
4. Top with 1/2 sour cream mixture and 1/2 of the grated cheese.
5. Layer remaining zucchini, sour cream mixture and cheese.
6. Melt butter and stir in bread crumbs.
7. Sprinkle over top of cheese.
8. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Zucchini Souffle

steps: 1. Dice eggplant into 1-inch cubes and slice zucchini into 1/2-inch rounds.
2. Chop onion coarsely and cut green pepper into squares.
3. Saute onion, garlic and green pepper until they are soft; stir in eggplant and zucchini and saute a few minutes more.
4. Add tomato and seasonings.
5. Cover and simmer gently for about 30 minutes.
6. Uncover and turn the heat up to evaporate some of the liquid.
7. We like to serve Ratatouille over rice.
8. Serves 6 to 8 people.
title: Ratatouille(A Vegetable Stew)

steps: 1. Brown sausage in skillet; drain.
2. Cut into small pieces.
3. Add onion to skillet and cook until soft.
4. Combine onion with sausage and sprinkle over bottom of pastry shell.
5. Sprinkle on cheese. Combine egg, salt, light cream and milk.
6. Beat slightly.
7. Pour over ingredients in pastry shell.
8. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
9. Serves 6.
title: Sausage Quiche

steps: 1. Cook sliced carrots in salted water until tender; drain.
2. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth.
3. Add butter and blend well. Add the eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla.
4. Beat well and pour into a 1-quart casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve warm.
6. Need to double to serve 8.
title: Donna'S Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. Beat egg.
2. Add flour, corn meal, salt and pepper.
3. Mix well. Stir in okra and onion.
4. Drop by tablespoonful into hot oil.
5. Cook 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once and flattening with spatula.
6. Serves 4.
title: Okra Croquettes

ingredients.text: 16 slices firm bread, cut off crust

steps: 1. Place 8 buttered slices of bread in bottom of well-greased baking dish.
2. Top each with slice of boiled ham and cheese.
3. Put remaining buttered bread on top.
4. Beat eggs and milk and seasoning. Pour over top of sandwiches.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Remove from refrigerator 1/2 hour before baking.
7. Have 1 cup crushed corn flakes and mix with 1/2 cup melted butter.
8. Sprinkle over top before baking.
9. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
10. Serves 8.
title: Souffle Sandwiches

steps: 1. Lightly grease 8-inch square pan or 9-inch pie pan.
2. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion into pan.
3. Blend remaining ingredients until smooth and pour over cheese and bacon in baking dish.
4. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
5. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with parsley sprigs and bacon crumbs.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Cook leeks and peeled sliced potatoes in chicken broth, covered, until tender.
2. Run through food mill or sieve or blender. Return to pot and add other ingredients (except chives and paprika).
3. Do not boil after you add the milk and cream.
4. Serve either hot or cold and garnish with the chives and paprika. Serves 4.
title: Vichyssoise

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350° (if using a glass dish, heat to 325°). Saute vegetables in butter until soft.
2. Beat eggs, milk, flour and seasonings.
3. After cooling vegetables, add them to milk mixture. Fold in cheese.
4. Crumble sausage in the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Pour mixture over the top.
6. Bake for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Crustless Quiche

steps: 1. Peel and slice eggplants.
2. Cook in 2 quarts boiling water with salt, bay leaf and cloves for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and discard bay leaf and cloves.
3. Mash eggplants in bowl and add butter, eggs, milk, seasonings, grated cheese and unbuttered bread crumbs.
4. Stir well.
5. Place in greased baking dish.
6. Sprinkle top with buttered crumbs.
7. Bake in moderate oven (350° to 375°) until firm and brown on top, 15 to 20 minutes.
8. Serve at once. Serves 6.
title: Eggplant Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Grease large baking dish with oil.
3. Cut tomatoes crosswise into 1/2-inch slices.
4. Layer 1/2 tomato slices in dish.
5. Sprinkle with half spices.
6. Repeat layers.
7. Top with breadcrumbs; drizzle with oil.
8. Bake for 20 minutes.
9. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Tomatoes Gratin

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp, then drain on paper towels.
2. Combine eggs, milk, dash of pepper, baking mix and melted margarine in blender.
3. Cover and blend 15 seconds.
4. Pour mixture in greased 9-inch pie plate.
5. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese well into mixture.
6. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
7. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
8. Serves 6.
title: Crustless Bacon Quiche

steps: 1. Cook carrots with 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small amount of water until tender; drain.
2. Combine carrots and oleo in blender and blend until smooth.
3. Add eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla; blend well.
4. Spoon mixture into a greased casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Golden Carrot Souffle

ingredients.text: 10 slices bread, trimmed and each cut into 4 pieces

steps: 1. Melt butter and dip bread into it.
2. Put into baking dish. Layer cheese and bread squares alternately.
3. Beat eggs.
4. Add milk and beat again.
5. Pour over bread and cheese.
6. Let stand for several hours or overnight.
7. Bake in slow oven, 325°, for 45 minutes to an hour.
8. Serve at once.
9. Serves 6.
title: Easy Cheesy Souffle

steps: 1. Brown ground beef with onion.
2. Combine with remaining ingredients and pour into pie shells.
3. Bake 40 minutes in a 350° oven.
4. Each quiche serves 4 to 6.
title: Hamburger Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Saute mushrooms in butter.
3. In a blender or food processor, blend eggs, sour cream, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, flour, onion powder and salt.
4. Pour mixture into a large bowl.
5. Add mushrooms, Jack cheese and crabmeat.
6. Pour into quiche dish.
7. Bake 45 minutes.
8. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
9. Makes 8 servings.
title: Crustless Crab Quiche

ingredients.text: 12 slices bacon (about 1/2 lb.), crisply fried and crumbled

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion evenly over bottom of pie plate. Place remaining ingredients in blender container.
3. Cover and blend on high speed 1 minute.
4. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean, about 50 to 55 minutes.
5. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serves 6.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and onion.
2. Beat eggs, milk, mayo, salt, oregano and pepper.
3. Add beef mixture and cheese.
4. Pour into 9-inch pie shell.
5. Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until test knife comes out clean.
6. Let stand 10 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Cheeseburger Quiche

steps: 1. Mix together. Bake in 10-inch pie plate in a 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
2. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
3. Serves 6.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Cook carrots in boiling water until tender; drain.
2. Add carrots to food processor bowl.
3. Add butter and rest of ingredients and process until smooth.
4. Spoon into 2 lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dishes.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done, set and lightly brown.
6. Makes 12 servings.
title: Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. Brown sausage, hamburger and onions on medium heat.
2. Drain. Add celery, garlic, green peppers and eggs.
3. Stir.
4. Add flour and shredded cheese.
5. Stir.
6. Add milk.
7. Stir until ingredients are mixed together.
8. Divide the mixture evenly into 2 pie shells, unbaked.
9. Pies are done when crusts are brown.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sausage Hamburger Quiche

steps: 1. Melt oleo in heavy pan.
2. Add flour and stir.
3. Add chicken stock and cook gently.
4. Add tomatoes; beat egg yolks until thick and stir in.
5. Add diced chicken; then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
6. Bake in casserole about 40 minutes at 350°, or until knife comes out reasonably clean.
7. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Chicken-Tomato Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add carrots and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash. To the carrots, add melted butter, white sugar, flour, baking powder, vanilla extract and eggs. Mix well and put in a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes about 8 servings.
title: Picadilly Cafeteria Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. In a heavy saucepan, combine the carrots, butter, water, salt and chives.
2. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until carrots are tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Sprinkle with flour and stir until mixed.
4. Slowly add the milk, stirring and cook until thickened.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Beat in the egg yolks.
7. Whip the egg whites until they hold soft peaks.
8. Fold into carrot mixture.
9. Pour into a deep, buttered casserole (1 1/2 to 2-quart size).
10. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned.
11. Serve immediately.
12. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. Saute chicken 2 minutes on each side in skillet.
2. Add remaining ingredients that have been mixed together.
3. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring until chicken is tender.
4. Serves 5, 175 calories per serving.
title: Dijon Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter in frypan; saute onion until tender.
2. Stir in flour; remove from heat.
3. Add milk.
4. Heat to boiling point.
5. Stir until thickened; fold in chicken, parsley, salt and pepper.
6. Cover and chill good.
7. Heat oil.
8. Beat egg with water.
9. Spread crumbs on wax paper.
10. Shape in patties; roll in crumbs, then egg mixture and again in crumbs.
11. Fry in oil; drain on paper towels.
12. Serve with ketchup.
13. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Croquettes

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded crabmeat, ham or cooked sausage

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients by hand until well mixed.
2. Pour into lightly buttered quiche pan or 9-inch deep dish pie plate.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is lightly browned and center is set.
4. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Saute meat in olive oil to a golden brown; sprinkle flour over top of meat.
2. Chop onion, garlic and bell pepper very fine.
3. Add other seasonings with 1/2 cup of water.
4. Place lid on stew pan and simmer 2 hours.
5. Serves 4.
6. Add package of mixed vegetables, if desired.
title: Frenchman'S Stew

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, blend the butter and flour; add the milk and remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain and add all other ingredients.
2. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Let stand overnight.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
6. Great for breakfast for overnight guest.
title: Sausage And Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter.
3. Add onion and squash; saute until tender-crisp, 5 minutes.
4. Set aside. Flute edges of pie crust.
5. Place pie plate on baking sheet. Sprinkle cheese over bottom of crust.
6. Spoon onion and squash over cheese; set aside.
7. In medium bowl, whisk eggs with 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and the half and half just until mixed, not frothy.
8. Pour mixture into prepared pie crust.
9. Arrange tomato slices on top.
10. Bake quiche on lower rack of oven for 50 minutes or until custard is puffy and set in center.
11. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes before serving.
12. Makes 6 servings.
title: Summer Vegetable Quiche

steps: 1. Spread bread with softened margarine on both sides.
2. Arrange in baking pan.
3. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
4. Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes until toasty and brown.
5. Serves 2.
title: Toasty French Slices

ingredients.text: 2 lb. Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch slices
1/2 stick cold butter, cut into squares
1 c. finely grated extra sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. In a well-buttered 1-quart shallow baking dish, arrange apple slices and sprinkle with raisins, cinnamon and lemon juice.
2. In a small bowl, combine sugar, flour and salt.
3. Blend in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal, then add cheese and toss.
4. Sprinkle mixture over apples and bake in upper third of oven, preheated at 350,° for 30 minutes or
5. until apples are tender.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Apple And Cheddar Gratin

steps: 1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil in Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook 15 minutes.
2. Uncover and continue cooking until vegetables are tender, but not mushy, and juice is thickened. Stir occasionally. Serves 8.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Alternate 6 slices of bread and half of combined cheeses. Repeat with the remaining bread and cheese. Beat eggs; add dry mustard and milk. Blend well. Pour over bread and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 hour, uncovered, at 350°.
title: Overnight Souffle

steps: 1. Line 9-inch pie pan with pastry.
2. Cook bacon in microwave and crumble (about 7 minutes).
3. Beat eggs with mixer; add onion salt and cheese.
4. Stir in green onion and bacon.
5. Add milk and blend well with mixer.
6. Pour into pie shell and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.
7. Let sit about 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.
title: Quiche Lorraine

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pie plate.
3. Beat milk, Bisquick, eggs, salt and pepper in a medium size bowl with electric mixer until smooth, about 1 minute.

4. Pour into pie plate. Bake in hot oven (400°) for 35 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edges comes out clean. Garnish with tomato slices and bacon strips if you wish. Refrigerate remaining quiche.
title: Impossible Bacon Quiche

steps: 1. Mix eggs, milk, mustard, salt and bread.
2. Add sausage and cheese.
3. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
title: Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Mix the eggs, sour cream, flour, cornmeal, salt and pepper together. Then carefully stir in the green onion, tomatoes, and swiss cheese, reserving a bit of cheese for the top.
2. Pour into a greased pie dish or 9x9 inch pan. Bake in a 350 F oven for 35-345 minutes, or until set in the middle.
3. Sprinkle with reserved cheese and chives and serve hot.
title: Tomato-Basil-Swiss Quiche

steps: 1. Cook ground meat, onion and pepper.
2. Add a little salt, then drain.
3. Mix meat and all ingredients together and pour into pie shell.
4. Cook at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.
title: Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon olive oil, plus more for frying
1/2 cup breadcrumbs, preferably freshly ground from stale baguette

steps: 1. Grate the zucchini into a colander. Toss with the salt and let rest for 20-30 minutes. Using a dish towel, squeeze as much water as you possibly can out of the zucchini.
2. Blot the tofu, then crumble it into a mixing bowl so it looks like ricotta. Add the olive oil; mix well; then add the rest of the ingredients, including the zucchini.

3. In a large pan over medium heat, warm enough oil to cover the bottom. Form into balls-about golf ball size-and add to the oil carefully. Cook for about 4-5 minutes a side until nicely browned, flipping very carefully, as these are slightly delicate. Remove to a paper towel to absorb extra oil. Serve warm or at room temp.
title: Zucchini Tofu Croquettes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Mix ham, egg, mayonnaise, and half the breadcrumbs together in a bowl; shape into 6 meatballs. Spread the remaining breadcrumbs onto a plate; roll the balls in the breadcrumbs to coat. Arrange the balls in a baking dish.
3. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.
title: My Great Grandmother'S Ham Croquettes

steps: 1. Melt butter.
2. Blend in flour, salt and milk.
3. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick.
4. Add chicken, onion and parsley.
5. Spread in an oiled, shallow pan.
6. Chill thoroughly.
7. Divide into 8 portions.
8. Shape into logs.
9. With a fork, lightly beat the eggs.
10. Dip the croquettes in egg mixture and then in crumbs.
11. Fry until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes, in cooking oil heated to 365°.
12. Drain on absorbent paper.
title: Chicken Croquettes

steps: 1. Bake pie crust.
2. Fry bacon.
3. Spread cheese and bacon in shell. Mix other ingredients together; pour into shell.
4. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
5. Reduce temperature to 300°.
6. Bake until light brown on top.
title: Quiche Lorraine

ingredients.text: 1 pound mushrooms, small dice (I used Crimini)
1 cup Gruyere cheese grated, plus more for sprinkling on tops of souffle's

steps: 1. Roast the mushrooms in a 300 degree oven until slightly dried and a lot of their moisture has sweated out. (about 20 minutes)

2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and saute' the onions until translucent. Add the parsley to the onions and saute' for a few minutes. Mix in the mushrooms (after you drain the liquid from the roasting pan). Remove from flame.
3. Make a white sauce: Melt 6 tablespoons of butter in a medium saucepan and when it starts to foam, add the flour and whisk until mixed.
4. Add the milk and keep whisking until the sauce thickens. Remove from the flame.
5. Add 1 cup of the white sauce to the mushroom mixture and blend together.
6. Stir the egg yolks into the mushroom mixture slowly to prevent them from cooking.
7. Beat the egg whites until they are stiff and then slowly fold them into the mushroom mixture.
8. Pour into eight 8 ounce ramekins that have been buttered. Put the ramekins in a large pan to fit, and fill to half way up the sides of the ramekins with hot water.
9. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 20 minutes, until the tops start to brown and the souffle's are set.
10. Remove from the oven, cool slightly and remove from the ramekins. (I use a little rubber spatula to flip them cleanly out of the ramekins).
11. Reheat the remaining white sauce, add 1 cup of cream and 1 cup of grated Gruyere cheese and whisk until blended.

12. Put the souffle's in a large casserole dish and pour the white sauce over them. Sprinkle extra cheese over each little souffle' and bake in a 350 degree oven until the cheese is melted and the sauce is puffing away.
13. Serve with a sprinkle of minced parsley.
title: Twice Baked Mushroom Souffle'S

steps: 1. In top of double boiler, over hot water, put first 3 ingredients.
2. When melted together, stir and add vanilla and eggs. Beat well with eggbeater for three minutes.
3. Cover and cook for thirty minutes (or longer if more convenient) without lifting cover, until serving.
4. Serve with cream (whipped and seasoned) or plain light cream, as is.
title: Chocolate Puff Souffle

steps: 1. Mix all as pastry; roll into small
2. balls.
3. Press
4. into small muffin pans with finger.
title: Miniature Quiche

ingredients.text: 2 c. (1 lb can) salmon, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Make cream sauce with oleo, flour, pepper, broth, and milk. Blend in salmon, onion, and parsley.
2. Refrigerate 1 hour.
3. Shape into eight cones or cylinders.
4. Roll in crumbs.
5. Dip in egg substitute.
6. Roll again in crumbs.
7. Refrigerate another hour.
8. Fry in deep hot 374° corn oil until brown.
9. Draining on paper towels. Serve with sauce made with skin milk, such as curry or mushroom.
title: Salmon Croquettes

steps: 1. Beat egg whites until stiff.
2. Heat milk; add sugar.
3. Stir and bring to a boil.
4. Mix melted butter with flour and stir into boiling milk, blending until consistency is creamy.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Add Grand Marnier.
7. Beat egg yolks until lemon in color. Add to milk mixture, stirring constantly.
8. Gently fold in beaten egg whites.
9. Pour into greased and sugared souffle mould.
10. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes with oven door closed the entire time. Serve immediately.
title: Grand Marnier Souffle

steps: 1. In a covered pan, cook 2 to 3 hours on low heat; water will be totally absorbed when done.
2. Add up to 4 teaspoons each of cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and allspice.
3. Mix and refrigerate.
title: French Coutou

steps: 1. 1. Heat cream and vanilla with half of the sugar until it reaches 170 degrees, simmer.
title: Creme Brulee

ingredients.text: 1 lb. sausage, crumbled and browned (drain off grease)

steps: 1. Freeze enough bread to cover the bottom of a large cake pan, then cube it.
2. Mix bread and meat.
3. Spread over bottom of pan. Sprinkle cheese over this.
4. Mix eggs, milk, 1/2 teaspoon dry milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
5. Pour over it.
6. Drizzle the butter.
7. Cover and let set overnight.
8. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
9. This feeds a crowd.
title: Brunch Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup leek, quartered lengthwise and chopped
1 lb bacon, cooked crisp, drained, and crumbled

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Spread leek and bacon over bottoms of two baked & cooled pie crusts. Set aside.
3. In bowl, beat eggs and whisk in evaporated milk, set aside.
4. In heavy saucepan, melt cheese with mustard, garlic, and worcestershire sauce. Mixture should be completely melted and look like a big glob. Remove from heat.
5. Right away, start to stir in the egg/milk mixture, a little at a time, until smooth (Be patient, this takes a lot of stirring/whisking).
6. Pour an equal amount into each pie crust.
7. Wrap foil loosely around crust to prevent it from overcooking. Try not to let the foil touch the filling.
8. Bake quiches for about 30 minutes, then remove from oven and arrange tomato wedges around the edges.
9. Return to oven and finish baking, about 5-10 minutes, or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
10. Cool slightly before serving.
title: Bacon, Leek, And Tomato Quiche

steps: 1. In heavy saucepan, combine milk, cream, and vanilla bean; cook over med-low heat until bubbles form around edge of pan. Do not boil. Meanwhile place egggs and egg yolks in bowl. Combine sugar & cornstarch; beat into eggs.

2. Gradually pour in hot milk mixture, stirring constantly. Return to pan and cook over med-low heat, stirring until thick enough to coat back of metal spoon. Strain into 4 cup (l L) baking dish or 6 indiv custar cups. Let cool, stirring occas, refrigerate for at least 6 hrs or until firm.
3. About 2 hrs before serving, evenly spread Hazelnut Praline over custard place on baking sheet and broil for 3-4 mins or until praline is dark golden brown. refrigerate until chilled.
title: Light Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Combine cream cheese, oleo and flour in a mixing bowl.
2. Blend well.
3. Shape into roll about 2 inches wide and 8 inches long. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill well or freeze.
4. Shape dough into 1-inch balls (24).
5. Place in ungreased miniature muffin tins. Press dough against bottom and sides of pans.
title: Petite Quiches

steps: 1. Blend above ingredients in blender.
2. Add 1 cup shredded cheese, diced ham, crumbled bacon, shrimp or any combination.
3. Add cooked vegetables, if desired.
4. Pour into pie plate and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Combine eggs and milk for the basic custard.
2. Add Swiss cheese and ham.
3. Pour the custard mixture into a partially baked 9-inch pastry shell.
4. Bake in 325° oven for about 50 minutes or until center is nearly set.
5. (To prebake the pastry shell, place unpricked pie shell in 450° oven for 5 minutes.)
title: Ham And Swiss Cheese Quiche

ingredients.text: 4 cups vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces (onion, broccoli, eggplant, zucchini, mushrooms, etc.)
1 tablespoon tarragon, fesh and finely sliced

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Heat the olive oil in a pan.
3. Saute the begetables (onions first if you use them) until they become tender.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Remove from heat, mix in tarragon and set aside.
6. Beat the eggs, cream and half and half together until well mixed.
7. Place the piecrust in a pie dish.
8. Sprinkle half the cheese onto the piecrust, follwed by the vegetables and the remainder of the cheese.
9. Pour egg mixture over filling.
10. Place quice on a cookie sheet on your oven's middle rack.
11. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes until the center of the quice no longer jiggles.
12. Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before you slice it.
13. Tip: If the quiche is watery, it is overcooked; adjust your cooking time.
title: Fresh Vegetable Quiche

ingredients.text: 3 c. zucchini, sliced thin and diced

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add zucchini, onion, oil, Bisquick mix, cheese and spices.
2. Mix until well blended.
3. Pour into buttered 12-inch pie plate or oblong dish.
4. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
5. Serve warm.
title: Crustless Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Combine the flour, sugar and the salt in a stone crock or bowl; mix well.
2. Add the water; beat to a smooth batter.
3. Add the vinegar.
4. Leave, covered with cloth, in warm place until sour (about 12 hours).
title: Sourdough Starter

ingredients.text: 1 lb. hot sausage, cooked and crumbled

steps: 1. Brown and drain hamburger.
2. Combine rest of ingredients and add to hamburger.
3. Pour into pie shell.
4. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
title: Hamburger Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar, plus more for dusting

steps: 1. In a medium-sized bowl, mash 1 large, ripe banana with a fork. Add 1 & 1/2 teaspoons fresh-squeezed lime (or lemon) juice and 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract. Blend thoroughly and set aside.
2. In a chilled bowl, whip 2 chilled egg whites to a soft peak stage.
3. Gradually add 1 & 1/2 tablespoons confectioner's sugar to soft peaked egg whites. Continue whipping egg whites on high speed until stiff peaks form.
4. Working in thirds, gradually (and gently) fold the stiffly beaten egg whites into the mashed banana until combined.
5. Spoon souffle mixture into 2 or 3 individual ramekins prepared with non-stick cooking spray; divide evenly.
6. Set filled ramekins on a cookie sheet (or jelly roll pan) and place in lower third of a preheated 450 degree F oven with upper rack removed.

7. Turn on the oven's interior light and keep a close eye on your souffles. Resist the temptation to open the door during baking (to do so would risk the souffles falling prematurely). Bake for approximately 10-15 minutes.
8. When souffles are done, remove from oven and dust with confectioner's sugar. Using a non-slip hot pad or thick, textured kitchen towel, remove ramekins to individual plates and serve immediately.
title: Warm Banana Souffle

steps: 1. You will need a Madeleine mold and a pastry bag.
2. Preheat oven to 450°.
3. Grease mold pan.
title: Madeleines

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crust.
2. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
3. (If making more than one, mix one at a time.)
title: Ham And Cheese Quiche

steps: 1. Whisk together the eggs and sugar in a large Stainless Steel or glass bowl.
2. Place the bowl over a large 3 or 4 quart saucepan filled with simmering water.

3. With the heat on low, whisk the mixture vigorously and continuously until you can form ribbons. This is where you can lift the whisk out of the mixture, write your name, and it doesn't disappear for about 5 to 10 seconds. This can take as long as 30 minutes. My son and I used a Black and Decker Gizmo and it took about 15 minutes but was somewhat messy.
4. Slowly whisk in the cream.
5. Split and scrape the vanilla beans into the mixture. Put the vanilla beans in there too.
6. Stir often with the whisk until the mixture can coat a spoon with only a slow drip. It will be about the consistency of vegetable oil.
7. Remove the custard from the stove and whisk in the butter, one pat at a time.

8. When the butter is fully melted, strain the mixture through a sieve and transfer it into ramekins or custard cups. Be sure to leave about 1/2 inch for the last step. You can transfer it into a bowl and chill first before putting it in ramekins.
9. Place in refrigerator until cold.
10. Remove the cups from the refrigerator and sprinkle sugar on top until it is about 1/8 inch thick.
11. Heat the tops of the custard with a kitchen torch until the sugar is caramelized. (I've heard you can do this in a broiler, but I've never tried. The torch is too much fun.).
title: "Diamond" Creme Brulee

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. sharp cheese (not processed), broken up and sprinkled alternately with bread

steps: 1. Into a well buttered baking dish, put bread and cheese.
2. Beat eggs, milk and dry mustard slightly and pour over bread and cheese.
3. Bake in a 325° oven for 3/4 hour or until firm.
title: Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Crust:
2. Cut the butter into the flour; add the salt and egg and mix until dough holds.
3. Roll out on lightly floured board. Flute and prick; fill with wax paper and rice and bake at 400° for 12 minutes.
4. This will be pale.
5. (Discard paper and rice.)
title: California Quiche Lorraine

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Spread diced ham over bottom of pastry shell.
3. Sprinkle with cheeses, reserving 3 to 4 tablespoons for top of quiche.
4. Lightly beat eggs with a wire whisk.
5. Add half and half and seasonings; blend until smooth.
6. Set the pastry shell on a cookie sheet and carefully add custard mixture.
7. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses.
title: Ham And Cheese Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup red bell pepper (cut in strips)

steps: 1. Mix ham, bell pepper, green onion, cheese and flour; toss all ingredients lightly.
2. Mix half-and-half gently into eggs.
3. Still gently; fold ham mixture into egg mixture.
4. Pour this mixture into unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake 10 minutes at 425 degrees, and then lower heat to 325 degrees and bake 20 minutes more or till done.
title: Ham Quiche

steps: 1. Mix together flour, Crisco and salt.
2. Add water slowly. Refrigerate dough 1/2 hour.
3. Roll out to make pie shells.
4. Makes 2 pie shells.
title: Crab Meat Quiche

steps: 1. Pour caramel into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Blend all other ingredients in blender.
2. Pour over caramel layer.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in pan of water. Cool. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Invert and serve.
title: Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Place shredded zucchini in a colander and drain.
2. Gently squeeze a little of the water out.
3. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie plate.
4. Bake in
5. a preheated 400° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
6. This quiche makes its own crust.
title: Zucchini Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. Swiss cheese, grated (may mix with Cheddar cheese)

steps: 1. You may use ham or sausage or all 3 meats.
title: Quiche Lorraine

steps: 1. Shell the prawns, then fry the shells in the oil in a large pan for about 5 mins. Add the onion, fennel and carrots and cook for about 10 mins until the veg start to soften. Pour in the wine and brandy, bubble hard for about 1 min to drive off the alcohol, then add the tomatoes, stock and paprika. Cover and simmer for 30 mins. Meanwhile, chop the prawns.

2. Blitz the soup as finely as you can with a stick blender or food processor, then press through a sieve into a bowl. Spend a bit of time really working the mixture through the sieve as this will give the soup its velvety texture.

3. Tip back into a clean pan, add the prawns and cook for 10 mins, then blitz again until smooth. You can make and chill this a day ahead or freeze it for 1 month. Thaw ovenight in the fridge. To serve, gently reheat in a pan with the cream. If garnishing, cook the 8 prawns in a little butter. Spoon into small bowls and top with the prawns and snipped fennel fronds.
title: Prawn & Fennel Bisque

steps: 1. In 2-quart microwave safe dish, combine potatoes and water. Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 9 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice.
2. Drain and set aside.
3. In large microwave safe bowl, heat butter on High until melted (30 seconds). Add onion.
4. Microwave, uncovered, 1 to 2 minutes or until tender. Whisk in flour until blended.
5. Gradually stir in the milk.
6. Cook, uncovered, on High for 2 1/2 minutes; stir.
7. Cook 3 to 4 minutes longer, stirring every minute or until sauce is thickened and bubbly.
8. Stir in cheese and salt.
9. Pour over potatoes.
10. Add spinach and pimientos; mix well.
11. Microwave uncovered on High for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through, stirring once.
12. Sprinkle with bacon.
13. Yield:
14. 8 servings.
title: Spinach Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. In a Dutch oven, saute onions in margarine until they are translucent but not yet beginning to brown.
2. Add water and all spices.
3. Simmer at least 30 minutes.
4. Under the broiler, toast the bread on both sides.
5. Put log of cheese in the bottom of each bowl. Ladle the soup into the bowls.
6. Float 1 piece of bread in each bowl.
7. Garnish each piece of toast with 1 ounce of cheese.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Serves 6.
title: French Onion Soup

ingredients.text: 1 lb. baking potatoes (about 2 or 3 medium size)
2 to 3 tsp. onion powder, garlic powder, chili powder or paprika

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450°.
2. Peel the potatoes and cut into 1/4 x 1/4 x 3-inch strips.
3. Pour the oil into a wide 1 or 2-quart bowl. Toss the potato strips in the oil.
4. Shake off any excess oil, then place the strips on an ungreased baking pan.
5. Sprinkle them with onion powder or one of the other seasonings.
6. Bake for 20 minutes or until one side of the potato strips are brown.
7. Turn them over and bake until brown and crisp on the other side, about 10 more minutes.
8. Drain on absorbent paper towels.
9. Yield:
10. makes 50 to 60 fries and serves 6.
title: Potato Croquettes

steps: 1. Melt margarine in a large saucepan.
2. Stir in onions.
3. Cook, covered, over medium heat until done.
4. Add beef broth and Worcestershire sauce; and if you want, a dash of pepper.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
7. Serves 3 to 4.
title: French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. In small bowl, combine all ingredients except fish.
3. Place fish on individual squares of greased foil. Spoon crumb mixture over fish.
4. Seal securely and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Fish Fillets Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 2 cups potatoes (cold boiled or baked, cubed)

steps: 1. Melt butter.
2. Add flour and salt; stir until well blended.
3. Add milk gradually, stirring constantly.
4. When thickened, add grated cheese.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Place potatoes in greased baking dish.
7. Cover with sauce.
8. Bake at 400° for 30-40 minutes.
9. Serves 4.
10. My brother used to call these "rotten potatoes", but they are really good.
title: Pat'S Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.text: 5 c. cooked onions, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Mix onions, 4 cups cheese and remaining ingredients.
2. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.
3. Sprinkle 1 cup grated cheese on top.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Onion Au Gratin

steps: 1. Saute corn and zucchini in 2 tablespoons butter for 5 minutes. Stir in onion and set aside.
2. Heat 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan.
3. Blend in flour, pepper and nutmeg.
4. Cook until smooth and bubbly.
5. Add milk gradually.
6. Stir and cook over medium heat until mixture thickens. Remove from heat.
7. Beat egg yolks into a bowl, then gradually stir into hot mixture. Add sauteed corn and zucchini mixture.
8. Stir in shredded cheese.
9. Beat egg whites until stiff.
10. Blend 1/3 of the egg whites into milk mixture. Carefully fold in the remaining eggs until no white streaks remain.
11. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until puffy and golden brown on top.
12. Serves 6.
title: Corn And Zucchini Souffle

ingredients.text: 2 large baking potatoes (peeled and sliced thin)

steps: 1. Layer potato slices in buttered 13 x 9 baking dish, Stir together cream, garlic, salt and pepper. Pour over
2. potatoes. Bake at 400 degrees for 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender and mixture is bubbly and golden. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Yields 8 servings.
title: Gratin Potatoes

steps: 1. Melt butter and saute all ingredients, except cheese, in a covered skillet for 5 to 10 minutes until zucchini is tender. Sprinkle with cheese.
2. Cover and let stand until cheese melts. Serve immediately.
3. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Zucchini Au Gratin

steps: 1. Mix onions with 1 cup cheese and add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.
2. Sprinkle remaining cup of cheese on top.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly at sides.
4. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Onions Au Gratin

steps: 1. In melted butter, saute onions, green pepper and pimento about 1 minute. Add seasoning and flour. Blend in milk. Stir until thick. Add potatoes and 1 cup cheese. Stir until cheese is melted. Pour into 3-quart casserole. Spread remaining cheese on top. Bake in 350° oven 30 to 45 minutes, until bubbly. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Place hash browns in a greased 9-inch microwave-safe dish. Microwave, uncovered, on high for 4 minutes or until thawed.
2. Press onto botom and halfway up the sides of rhe dish.
3. Microwave, uncovered, on high 3 minutes, sprinkle with cheese, ham and broccoli.
4. In a bowl, beat the eggs, milk and seasonings.
5. Pour over the ham mixture.
6. Cover with wax paper.
7. Microwave at 70% power for 10-12 minutes or until set.
8. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.
9. Yield:
10. 4-6 servings.
title: Broccoli Ham Quiche

steps: 1. Saute onions in butter in heavy saucepan.
2. Stir in flour. Cook until flour is lightly browned.
3. Add water, bouillon and salt.
4. Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve bouillon.
5. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
6. Ladle into ovenproof bowls.
7. Top with French bread.
8. Sprinkle with cheese.
9. Broil until cheese is light brown.
10. Yield: 4 servings.
title: French Onion Soup

ingredients.text: 10 oz. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps: 1. Beat cheese until creamy.
2. Beat in eggs, milk and pepper. Stir in spinach, ham and onion.
3. Pour into pie crust; salt and pepper to taste.
4. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Spinach Quiche

steps: 1. Boil potatoes in skins; chill, peel and shred.
2. Stir in cheese and 4 tablespoons melted butter.
3. Fold in sour cream, onion, salt and pepper.
4. Place in greased casserole and dot with remaining butter.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Shredded Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 30 minutes. Drain and mash. Add milk, margarine, seasonings and baking powder.
2. Beat until fluffy. Add onion.
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: French Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings

steps: 1. Coat 10-inch gratin dish with vegetable oil.
2. Layer 1/3 potatoes over bottom of dish, overlapping in a spiral pattern. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour and spices mixed over potatoes.
3. Layer another third of potatoes and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon flour and spice mix plus 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese.
4. Top with zucchini and remaining potatoes.
5. Pour evaporated milk over top.
6. Add remaining Parmesan cheese and spices.
7. Cover with foil.
8. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
9. Remove foil, lower oven temperature to 350° and bake 15 minutes or until top is golden brown.
10. Serves 8.
11. This dish is low calorie.
title: Potato Au Gratin

steps: 1. Combine corn flake crumbs and 2 Tbsp. margarine; set aside. Add onion to remaining margarine and saute over low heat.
2. Add flour, salt and pepper.
3. Stir in milk.
4. Increase heat to medium, cook until bubbly and thickened, stirring constantly.
5. Add cheese and stir until smooth.
6. Stir in carrots and parsley.
7. Spread in shallow 1 1/2 quart baking dish and sprinkle with crumbs.
8. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until crumbs are brown.
9. Serves 8.
title: Carrots Au Gratin

steps: 1. Preheat oven.
2. Mix flour, salt and butter together until smooth,
3. then

12. baking dish.

17. Bake at 350° for 25
