title: Spinach Souffle

steps: 1. Slice potatoes and arrange in a greased 1-quart casserole dish. Layer with minced onion and top with shredded cheese.
2. Pour milk over mixture and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
3. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Melt butter; add flour and mix to a smooth paste.
2. Add milk and corn; cook until thick, stirring occasionally.
3. Remove from heat; add beaten egg yolks, salt, cheese and green pepper.
4. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites; pour into greased baking dish.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serve hot.
7. Yield:
8. 6 servings.
title: Corn Souffle

steps: 1. Melt butter; blend in flour and salt.
2. Stir until smooth. Turn to low heat and slowly add milk, stirring constantly.
3. Cook and stir until thick and smooth.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts.
6. Arrange potatoes in 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish.
7. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes; top with crumbs.
8. Dot with additional butter.
9. Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
10. Serves 4.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Combine
2. eggs and flour; beat well.
3. Add milk, corn and melted oleo.
4. Turn
5. into a greased casserole dish and bake at 400° for 45 to 60 minutes.
6. Makes 10 servings.
title: Corn Souffle

steps: 1. Saute onions with margarine in skillet until browned.
2. Add next 5 ingredients; blend well.
3. Simmer for 30 minutes.
4. Place 1 slice of French bread in a bowl.
5. Add soup.
6. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add onions. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden, stirring gently.
3. Stir in sugar and flour.
4. Cook for 3 minutes longer, stirring constantly.
5. Add broth, thyme, bay leaf and pepper; mix well. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
6. Boil for 6 minutes, stirring constantly; reduce heat.
7. Simmer, loosely covered, for 30 minutes.
8. Remove and discard bay leaf.
9. Ladle into ovenproof bowls.
10. Top with French bread; sprinkle with Swiss and Parmesan cheese.
11. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat source for 2 minutes or until golden.
12. Yield:
13. 4 servings.
title: Hearty French Onion Soup

steps: 1. In a large, heavy-bottomed pan, over medium heat, melt margarine.
2. Add onions; saute, stirring often, until caramelized, but not burned, 15 to 20 minutes.
3. With slotted spoon, remove onions to medium bowl.
4. Add beef to pan; brown well on all sides. Return onion and any juices to pan.
5. In small bowl, mix flour, sugar, cumin, salt and pepper.
6. Add to pan; stir 1 minute, until bubbly.
7. Gradually add broth, stirring to scrape drippings from pan; simmer 10 minutes.
8. Heat broiler.
9. Place 1/2 cup fettuccine in each of 4 (about 16 ounce) ovenproof bowls; divide beef mixture over pasta.
10. In medium bowl, stir cheeses together; sprinkle over beef.
11. Broil until cheese is melted and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
12. Makes 4 servings.
title: French Beef Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 6 soda crackers, crushed (1/4 c.) or use Ritz crackers

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Cook carrots in 1/2 inch boiling salted water for 10 minutes.
3. Combine crackers, onion salt, green pepper and pepper.
4. Alternate layers of carrots and crumb mixture in greased 1-quart baking dish.
5. If any carrot liquid is left, spoon over the top.
6. Pour butter over and sprinkle with cheese.
7. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrots Au Gratin

steps: 1. In large pot, cover potatoes with water and boil until tender (about 30 minutes).
2. Drain, peel and slice while potatoes are still warm.
3. Dissolve instant chicken bouillon in water and pour over potatoes.
4. Mix together olive oil, white wine vinegar, dry mustard, salt and pepper and pour over potatoes.
5. Mix together, add onions and let stand at room temperature to develop flavors.
title: French Potato Salad

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 F (190 C).
2. Pour the white wine into a very large saucepan, or soup pot. Add the peeled and sliced shallots, salt and pepper, and gently saute until they begin to soften.

3. Add handfuls of the fresh spinach and keep turning it over as it cooks, you want to gently wilt it and have it reduce to about half it's volume, but NOT to be cooked down to mush. This should only take about 2-3 minutes for all of the spinach.
4. Pour all of the spinach/shallot mixture into a large mixing bowl, and let cool a little. (You will have some wine left in the bottom of the pan, and yes, it goes into the mixing bowl too).
5. While the spinach is cooling, beat the five eggs in a seperate bowl.
6. The add the flour to the spinach mixture and mix it in well, then add the Gouda cheese, milk, the finely diced sundried tomatos, and finially the beaten eggs. Mix well.
7. Pour the mixture into a shallow quiche dish approx: 11 inches x 1 1/2 inches deep (27 cm x 4 cm deep) that has been sprayed with a small amount of baking spray.

8. Sprinkle the un-toasted pine nuts on the top of the quiche and bake at 375 F (190 C) for between 45-55 minutes. To test that it is cooked, a wooden skewer should come out clean and the top will be a little puffed up and golden brown.
9. Serve warm and enjoy the sublety of the wine flavours as they compliment the rest of the spinach quiche.
title: Spinach Quiche, Crustless, Sophisticated & Grown Up

ingredients.text: 3 large (4 c.) white onions, thinly sliced

steps: 1. In large skillet, cook onions in butter until lightly browned. In crock-pot, combine browned onions in butter with bouillon, water and Worcestershire sauce.
2. Cover and cook on low 4 to 6 hours.
3. Sprinkle top with grated cheese.
4. Serve with warm French bread.
title: French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Melt
2. oleo.
3. Add
4. flour, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, milk and cheese.
5. Bake at 400° until bubbly.
6. Add shrimp; heat until shrimp is heated, about 4 to 5 minutes.
title: Shrimp Au Gratin

steps: 1. You will need:
2. 3/4 bushel fresh red chile, string or twine and sisal rope.
title: Rice Croquettes

steps: 1. Melt better in large skillet.
2. Saute garlic and ham for 2 minutes.
3. Add cauliflower; cook until crisp-tender.
4. Combine flour and cream; stir into skillet and blend well.
5. Add salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
6. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
7. Cook and stir one minute more.
8. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese.
9. Place under a preheated broiler until brown, 2 to 4 minutes.
10. Sprinkle with parsley.
11. Serve immediately.
title: Cauliflower Au Gratin

steps: 1. In a greased shallow 3-qt. baking dish, combine the potatoes and fennel; set aside.

2. In a small saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour until smooth; gradually add the broth, cream, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Pour over potato mixture; gently toss to coat.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.
title: Fennel-Potato Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. nuts, raisins or drained pineapple

steps: 1. Mix the ingredients in the order listed and turn into a well buttered baking dish.
2. Lightly cover the top with coconut and bake at 350° until coconut is golden yellow or souffle is hot.
title: Butternut Squash Souffle

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. bread crumbs, mixed with 2 Tbsp. melted butter

steps: 1. Saute onion
2. and
3. green pepper in butter for 5 minutes. Add flour,
4. seasonings	and milk; stir constantly until smooth and thick.
5. Combine
6. this
7. mixture
8. with
9. corn and beaten egg. Put mixture into shallow casserole.
10. Cover with buttered bread crumbs; brown in a moderate oven at 350° to 375°.
title: Corn Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 1 cup whole milk, do not use lowfat

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Butter 8x8x2-inch glass baking dish.
3. Combine potatoes, cream, milk, tarragon and nutmeg in heavy large saucepan.
4. Season generously with salt and pepper.
5. Bring to boil over medium heat.
6. Reduce heat; simmer 4 minutes.
7. Using slotted spoon, transfer potatoes to prepared dish.
8. Pour cream mixture over.
9. Bake until top is golden brown, potatoes are tender and cream mixture thickens, about 1 hour.
10. Let stand 10 minutes.
11. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.
title: Potato-Tarragon Gratin

ingredients.text: 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch slices
2 pounds Granny Smith apples (unpeeled), cut into 1/8-inch slices

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400° F. Coat a 3 1/2-quart casserole with cooking spray. In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, buttermilk, thyme, salt, and pepper; set aside. Arrange a layer of slightly overlapping potatoes in the casserole. Cover with a layer of apples and sprinkle with a third of each cheese. Pour a third of the egg mixture on top. Make 2 more layers. (Can be made up to 6 hours ahead.) Bake, covered, 1 hour, 15 minutes. Remove cover and bake another 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Remove from oven. Serve warm or at room temperature.
2. Note: Assemble 3 casseroles to serve Put one in the oven every 45 minutes so there is always a fresh gratin on the buffet.
title: Potato-Apple Gratin

ingredients.text: 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1 1/2-inch pieces
2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into bits
4 slices firm white bread, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
2 ounces finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese (1 cup)

steps: 1. Butter a 2- to 2 1/2-quart shallow ceramic flameproof baking dish.
2. Cook asparagus in a 5- to 6-quart pot of boiling salted water, uncovered, until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes.
3. Drain in a colander, then transfer to baking dish and keep warm, tightly covered with foil.
4. Meanwhile, heat oil and butter in a 12-inch heavy skillet over high heat until foam subsides, then cook shallots, stirring occasionally, until pale golden, about 3 minutes.
5. Add bread and pine nuts and cook, stirring, until browned in spots, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and add pepper, 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano, and 1/4 teaspoon salt, tossing to combine.
6. Preheat broiler.
7. Toss warm asparagus with mascarpone, remaining 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt until combined well.
8. Sprinkle bread-crumb mixture evenly over asparagus. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat until topping is golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
title: Asparagus Gratin...Fancy And Good!

steps: 1. Combine potato, onion, egg, cheese, and parsley in medium bowl; blend thoroughly.
2. Shape into 8 patties. At this point, you should refrigerate them.
3. Spread bread crumbs onto waxed paper. Dip croquettes in crumbs, turning to coat evenly; set aside.
4. Heat vegetable oil in large skillet on moderate heat. Place croquettes in hot oil; cook about 4 minutes, or until brown on each side. Serve hot.
title: Potato Croquettes With Parmesan

steps: 1. In a large, deep bowl, lightly whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
2. In another bowl, mash the cream cheese with parsley and dill until well blended.
3. In a large skillet (nonstick) heat butter until it's sizzling, but not brown.
4. Pour in egg mixture and over low heat, gently stir the eggs until they just begin to thicken.
5. Immediately add the herbed cream cheese in several chunks and stir constantly until the eggs are set and creamy. Serves 6.
title: French Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Brown crumbled sausage in heavy skillet, drain on paper towels. Mix eggs, milk, mustard and salt.
2. Stir in bread, sausage and cheese.
3. Pour mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12 people.
title: Jane'S Breakfast Souffle

ingredients.text: 8 slices bacon, sausage or ham, cooked and cut up

steps: 1. Prepare 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
2. Cut a circle from the center of each slice of bread.
3. Tear crusts and place in baking dish.
4. Spread cooked meat and shredded cheese over torn bread.
5. Place bread circles on top.
6. In a large mixing bowl, mix eggs and milk; pour over ingredients in baking dish.
7. Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight.
8. Preheat oven to 350°.
9. Bake souffle approximately 1/2 hour, covered.
10. Remove foil and bake about another 1/2 hour or until golden brown.
11. Serves 4.
title: Breakfast Souffle

steps: 1. Combine flour, milk, salt, eggs and melted butter in blender container.
2. Process until smooth.
3. Pour scant 1/4 cup batter into hot, lightly greased crepe pan.
4. Tilt pan to spread batter evenly. Bake until light brown on both sides; stack between waxed paper. May sprinkle with sugar or confectioners sugar or fill with jam, fresh fruit or preserves.
5. Yield:
6. 12 servings.
title: Crepes

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded

steps: 1. Press hash browns between paper towels to remove moisture.
2. Add seasoning to hash browns.
3. Grease a 9 inch pie plate with 2 tbsp butter.
4. Press hash browns onto the bottom and up the sides of the dish.
5. Drizzle with remaining butter.
6. Bake uncovered at 425°F for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are brown.
7. Combine cheese and ham; spoon into crust.
8. Beat eggs with cream and seasoning pour over ham and cheese.
9. Reduce heat to 350°F and bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
10. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.
11. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Easy Hash Brown Quiche

steps: 1. Fry sausage until crumbly and then drain it.
2. Combine all ingredients and put in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
5. Serves 8 to 10. Ham or bacon can be used instead of sausage.
title: Breakfast Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 or 4 slices bread, trim crusts and cube

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain.
2. Mix eggs, milk, mustard and salt; mix well.
3. Stir in bread, sausage and cheese.
4. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
5. Refrigerate overnight, covered.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Serves 10.
8. Great for a brunch or Christmas morning.
title: Breakfast Souffle With Sausage

steps: 1. Melt margarine and add flour to make a paste (set aside). Whip eggs in a large bowl; add cheeses, baking powder, salt and sugar.
2. Add flour/margarine paste.
3. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish (glass is best) and bake for 45 minutes at 350°.
4. Can also mix night before, refrigerate and bake in morning.
5. Serves 6 to 8 people.
title: Breakfast Quiche

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add milk, eggs and vanilla.
3. Mix or beat thoroughly.
4. Cook in melted butter.
5. Add a small amount of butter to pan.
6. Add some batter and roll around to spread evenly.
7. Turn once.
8. Serves 4.
title: Crepes

steps: 1. Mix ingredients quickly; don't overbeat.
2. Blend eggs, salt, sugar and milk in blender.
3. Gradually add flour, blending after each addition.
4. Add and blend melted margarine.
5. Heat a nonstick lightly greased 10-inch skillet.
6. Add a small quantity of batter. Tip the skillet and let the batter spread to cover entire pan. Cook over moderate heat.
7. When edges dry and underneath is lightly brown, reverse it and brown other side. Roll pancake up.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Colorado Crepes

steps: 1. 1.	Place milk, vanilla in blender. Add yolks, sugar, salt, flour and then butter. Blend on high speed for 30 seconds. Scrape sides of blender; blend 30 seconds more.
2. 2.	Transfer batter to an airtight container; refrigerate at least two hours or overnight.

3. 3.	Brush a 6 1/2 to 7 inch crepe pan with oil. Heat on medium until just starting to smoke. Remove pan from heat; quickly pour 2 tblsp batter into middle of pan. Quickly tilt pan in all directions so the batter covers entire bottom in a thin layer. Cook, then flipcook some more
title: Vanilla Crepes

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and stevia. Whisk in the coconut milk, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth.
2. Add strawberries to a medium microwave safe bowl. Microwave in 30-seconds increment, until strawberries are no longer frozen. Mash with a fork. Set a side.

3. Spray an 8" skillet with cooking spray and set on medium heat. Add 1/4 cup of the batter mix to the bottom of the skillet, swirling to coat the bottom of the skillet as evenly as possible with the batter.
4. Cook until edges are lightly browned and the crepe is almost dry on top. Loosen the edges with a thin spatula and flip the crepe over. Cook crepe for an additional 15 seconds.
5. Transfer to a plate and continue cooking remaining batter.
6. Add warmed strawberries over the cooked crepes.
7. Recipe from the Skinny Bitch Cookbook.
title: Crepes With Strawberries

steps: 1. Mix all dry ingredients together in a mixing bowl.
2. Add all liquid ingredients and stir until batter is smooth & creamy.
3. Let batter rest in the refrigerator until the air is settled, about 2 hours.

4. When ready to prepare crepes, heat crepe pan over medium heat & pour a small amount of the batter into the hot pan. Rotate the pan until the batter is cooked through & then turn to cook the other side.
5. When done remove from pan & let cook on a rack.
6. Store until ready to serve.
7. May be made 1-2 days in advance.
8. Fill with seasonal fresh fruit, sorbet & garnish with flowers from the garden.
title: Chocolate Breakfast Taco (Crepes)

steps: 1. Beat Egg Beaters and milk together.
2. Add flour and beat well. Let the batter stand, but beat again before cooking.
3. Heat a crepe pan or a small nonstick pan until hot.
4. Pour about 2 tablespoons of the batter into the pan.

5. Tilt the pan to coat the whole bottom. Cook about 1 minute or until the underside is lightly brown. Turn the crepe and brown the other side for about 10 to 20 seconds. Remove and cool before filling. This should make about 15 crepes.
title: Chicken Crepes

steps: 1. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife. Combine flour, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Combine milk, water, melted butter, and eggs in a blender. Add the flour mixture to milk mixture, and process until smooth. Cover batter; chill for 1 hour.

2. Heat an 8-inch nonstick crepe pan or skillet over medium heat. Pour a scant 1/4 cup batter into pan; quickly tilt pan in all directions so batter covers pan with a thin film. Cook about 1 minute. Carefully lift the edge of the crepe with a spatula to test for doneness. The crepe is ready to turn when it can be shaken loose from the pan and the underside is lightly browned. Turn crepe over, and cook for 30 seconds or until center is set.
3. Place crepe on a towel; cool completely. Repeat procedure with the remaining batter, stirring batter between crepes. Stack crepes between single layers of wax paper to prevent sticking.
4. Top this delectable crepe recipe with some chocolatey nutella spread and strawberries or bananas for a dessert or an indulgent breakfast. It's one of our favorite
5. . This is a recipe for everyone in the
title: Basic Crepes

ingredients.text: 1 lb stewing beef, cut into smaller cubes (because of Sweet Eddiebears swallowing problems I cut into very small pieces)
1/2 cup onion, chopped (I did a fine chop)
1 cup mushroom, sliced (I did a fine chop)

steps: 1. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides.
2. Pour 1 cup of water over beef cubes, add bay leaf and let simmer, covered for 1 to 2 hours over low heat. Check every 20 minutes and add water if needed. Never let the water boil away.
3. Place onion , mushrooms,pepper and onion powder into the pot and cook about 5 to 10 minutes until tender. Add wine and bring to a low boil for about 1 minute.
4. Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tablespoons water and add to simmering beef to thicken meat juices. (Stir until thickened to avoid lumps).
5. Remove pot from heat. Seperate beef cubes from the thickened beef juices.
6. Place crepe onto a plate, browned side down. Spoon 1/2 cup beef cube mixture onto crepe. Roll crepe and pour thickened sauce across the crepe. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired.
title: Beef Burgundy Crepe

steps: 1. Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, milk, salt and vanilla and mix well.
2. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
3. Combine brown sugar, flour, pecans and butter and mix well.
4. Spread over sweet potato mixture.
5. Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. In blender or mixer, combine first 7 ingredients.
2. Melt margarine in a 12 x 13-inch dish in oven.
3. Place sliced apples and brown sugar on bottom of dish in melted margarine.
4. Return to oven.
5. When sizzling, pour batter over apples, brown sugar and margarine.
6. Bake 20 minutes in preheated 425° oven or until puffed and brown.
7. Serve hot.
8. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Apple Souffle Or Dutch Pancake

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased baking dish.
2. Cover with crunch topping.
3. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle Crunch

steps: 1. Mix
2. potatoes, vanilla, sugar, eggs and oleo thoroughly and pour into buttered casserole dish.
3. Mix brown sugar, nuts, flour and oleo and sprinkle on top of potato mixture.
4. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
5. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Senator Russell Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Mix butter, eggs, vanilla and vinegar together.
2. Add sugar and coconut.
3. Pour in 2 unbaked 9-inch pie crusts.
4. Cook at 300° for about an hour or until brown.
5. Makes 10 servings.
6. Approximate preparation time: 10 to 15 minutes.
title: French Coconut Pie

steps: 1. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
2. Serves 6.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except pie shell. Pour into the pie shell.
2. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
3. Reduce heat to 325° and bake for 40 minutes, or until top is golden and the center is almost set.
4. When cool, store in refrigerator. Yields 8 servings.
title: French Coconut Pie

steps: 1. Mix the first 4 ingredients and add to rhubarb; stir until well coated.
2. Pour into pie shell.
title: French Rhubarb Pie

ingredients.text: 1 c. sliced peaches, including the juice

steps: 1. Combine the first 3 ingredients in a glass gallon jar; let set for 2 weeks, covered loosely with foil with a wooden spoon inserted through the foil to stir daily.
2. Do not remove foil or spoon.
3. Be sure to stir daily.
4. After 2 weeks, add the next 3 ingredients; let set 2 more weeks, stirring daily.
5. In the fourth week, add the next 3 ingredients; stir daily.
6. In the sixth week, strain fruit from the juice using a plastic strainer (do not use metal).
7. You may use fruit for ice cream topping.
8. Juice is starter for Friendship Cake.
title: Friendship Cake Starter

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Mix cottage cheese with mixer until smooth.
3. Process egg whites until foamy.
4. Add eggs, buttermilk, flour, baking powder and salt.
5. Mix until smooth.
6. Stir in cheese, onions and bacon.
7. Fill muffin tins 2/3 full.
8. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
title: Quiche Muffins

steps: 1. Put cottage cheese in food processor; beat well. Put in a large bowl. Put egg white in food processor; beat until foamy. Add to cottage cheese; mix. Add the next 5 ingredients; mix well. Stir in cheese, onions and bacon. Preheat oven to 400°; pour in greased mini muffin pans. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
title: Quiche Muffins

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven at 450 degrees.
2. 2. Melt butter in medium sauce pan.
3. 3. Remove from heat and add corn meal, sugar, and flour.
4. 4. Once batter is cooled, add one egg at a time, stirring continuously to prevent the eggs from cooking.
5. 5. Stir in vinegar and vanilla.
6. 6. Fold in coconut.
7. 7. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 10 minutes.
8. 8. Turn oven temperature down to 350 degrees and bake for 25 minutes.
9. 9. Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
title: French Coconut Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cream thoroughly the shortening, sugar and egg.
3. In separate bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
4. Stir flour mixture into creamed mixture alternately with milk.
5. Fill greased or paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full.
6. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
7. Immediately after baking, roll muffins in melted butter, then into sugar and cinnamon.
8. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.
title: French Breakfast Muffins

steps: 1. Mix sugar and butter until smooth. Melt chocolate and let cool.
2. Add cooled chocolate to sugar and butter mixture; blend until smooth. Add vanilla and cream of tartar, mix well.
3. Beat in eggs, one at a time, mixing well between each addition.
4. Mix until smooth.
5. Pour into pie shell.
6. Chill until firm.
7. Top with whipped cream.
title: French Silk Pie

steps: 1. 1. Preheat the oven to 350 F. Peel the sweet potatoes. Then using a mandolin or very sharp knife cut the potatoes into very thin slices.
2. 2. Grate the cheese, mince the garlic, and strip the thyme off the stems.
3. 3. In a bowl mix the heavy cream, salt, garlic, thyme, and nutmeg.

4. 4. Get ready to assemble! In a large oven-proof dish (use whatever size and shape dish you have, just make sure it's oven-proof and big) layer the sweet potatoes and cheese, leaving a small amount of cheese for the top. There should be 3-4 layers of potatoes and cheese. Pour in the heavy cream mixture. Top with remaining cheese.
5. 6. Bake uncovered at 350 F for an hour. The potatoes should be fork tender and the top should be brown and bubbly when done.
title: Sweet Potato And Gruyere Au Gratin

steps: 1. Mix Bisquick, 1/2 of the Cheddar cheese and onions. Mix milk and beaten egg together and then mix all together. Pour into greased 12 x 8-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread remaining Cheddar cheese on top. Crumble the bacon over the cheese. Make sure that the meat is generous. Pour the melted margarine over top and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Cut while warm. Serves 15 to 18.
title: Appetizer Quiche

steps: 1. Peel and slice carrots diagonally.
2. Cook in salted water until almost done, but crisp.
3. Drain.
4. Add melted margarine and sugar to carrots.
5. Simmer, turning carrots frequently to glaze.
6. Serves 6.
title: Glazed Carrots Au Gratin

steps: 1. heat butter in and sugar in a deep frying pan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar begins to dissolve. turn up the heat and bubble fast until the mixture just starts to go brown and caramelise ( 4 minutes).
2. Pour in juice and zests then bubble for 3-4 minutes to thicken slightly. Add the liqour, flame for a few seconds.
3. Put one crepe into the sauce and coat well then fold in 4 like a handkerchief.Push to one side of the pan and continue with the rest. Serve 2-3 crepes per person.
title: Suzette Sauce ( For Crepes Suzette)

ingredients.text: 2 lbs chicken thighs, skin and fat removed (about 8)
3/4 lb onion, peeled and thinly sliced (resulting to 4 cups)
8 cloves garlic, peeled and thinly sliced
2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro (coriander or Chinese parsley)

steps: 1. Heat oil on large nonstick frying pan.
2. Add thighs in one layer and saute them over medium to high heat for 4 minutes on each side, until nicely browned.
3. Remove the chicken to a platter.
4. Add the onions to the drippings in the skillet.
5. Saute for 1 minute.
6. Stir in the garlic, wine, and cilantro stems and saute for 10 seconds longer.
7. Return chicken to frying pan, add salt and pepper, and bring surrounding liquid to a boil.
8. Cover the pan, reduce heat, and bring to a slow boil for 15 minutes.
9. Stir in cilantro leaves.
10. Serve 2 chicken thighs per person.
title: French Chicken Thighs In Cilantro Sauce

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In saucepan combine milk, cream, 1/2 cup sugar, vanilla and cinnamon over medium high heat until hot, but not boiling.
2. Temper the egg yolks with the cream mixture whisking until smooth then add the peanut butter and mix well.

3. Strain mixture and pour into six 4-ounce ramekins. Set ramekins in a shallow baking pan and place in the oven. Pour enough hot water into the pan to cover the ramekins half way. Bake for 30 minutes.
4. Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
5. Preheat broiler and sprinkle custards with remaining sugar and broil for 40-60 seconds and serve.
title: Peanut Butter Creme Brulee

ingredients.text: 7 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted and cooled, divided

steps: 1. Reserve 1 tablespoon melted butter for brushing skillet.
2. Blend milk, flour, eggs, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons butter, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a blender until smooth, then chill, covered, 30 minutes.

3. Lightly brush a 10-inch nonstick skillet with some of reserved butter and heat over medium heat until hot. Pour in 1/4 cup batter, immediately tilting and rotating skillet to coat bottom, and cook crepe, turning once, until just set and golden, about 1 minute total. Transfer to a plate. Make 7 more crepes, stacking them.
4. Brush each crepe with 1 teaspoon butter and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar, then fold twice to form a triangle.

5. Heat 2 teaspoons each of butter and sugar with a pinch of salt in skillet until sugar has dissolved, then cook 4 crepes, turning once, until golden brown. Repeat with remaining butter, sugar, and crepes.
title: Butter-Sugar Crepes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, Crisco, & peanut butter. Add powdered sugar & beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla & egg and beat until creamy. Stir in the flour, soda, salt, & cream of tarter; mix well. Chill for about 30 minutes or so for easier handling. Roll dough into 1-inch balls & place them 2-3 inches apart on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Slightly, flatten each cookie ball with a fork....using a cris-cross pattern. Note: coat a fork with shortening, and then dip the fork in sugar before cris-crossing each cookie so the fork don't stick to the dough. Bake for about 12 minutes. Cool cookies on cookie sheets a bit because these cookies can crumble easily if you don't let them rest. Then... Remove from cookie sheets & cool on racks completely.
title: French Crème Peanut Butter Cookies

steps: 1. Combine first nine ingredients in a large bowl.
2. Heat applesauce in oil and add to dry ingredients.
3. If desired, add nuts and/or raisins.
4. Mix thoroughly.
5. Pour into tube pan which has been greased and floured.
6. Bake 1 hour at 325°.
title: French Applesauce Cake

steps: 1. Whisk flour and 1/2 cup milk in a medium nonstick pan until smooth. Whisk in the remaining 1 1/2 cup of milk.
2. Scrape seeds of the vanilla bean into pan then add the bean.
3. Bring the mixture to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, then reduce heat to low, cook for 1 minute or until sauce thickens.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and sugar. While beating constantly, add a little bit of milk mixture to the bowl to temper the eggs. Then add the egg into milk mixture.
5. Cook over low heatm stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until sauce thickens. Strain through sieve into a clean bowl.
6. Sauce can be used warm or chilled. Store in air tight container in fridge for up to 2 days.
title: French Custard Sauce (Creme Anglaise) Low-Fat

steps: 1. Using a wooden spoon, combine sugar and water in a large saucepan over a high heat, stirring constantly.
2. Use a dampened pastry brush to brush any stray sugar particles off the sides of the pan.
3. Continue to stir until mixture forms a caramel like mixture of darkened amber color.
4. Remove from heat and GRADUALLY add cream, stirring like a madwoman/madman after each addition.
5. Add cinnamon and vanilla and return to the heat for one minute. Keep stirring! (make sure that you do not leave it on the heat any longer!). Keep on stirring and serve as desired.
title: Creme Brulee Dessert Sauce

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
1/2 cup vegetable shortening, preferably Crisco, at room temperature

steps: 1. In a bowl, sift together first four ingredients. Set aside.

2. In large bowl, cream butter and shortening on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add confectioners sugar and beat on low speed until smooth. add egg and vanilla extract and beat on low until well combined.
3. On low speed, slowly add dry ingredients. Beat until well combined. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until very firm and cool, at least 2 hours.

4. Preheat oven to 350. Take some of the dough and shape it into 1-inch balls. (Keep remaining dough in the refrigerator, as it must be kept chilled.) Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork to flatten. Bake until golden, but not brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly on the baking sheet on a rack. then using a spatula, transfer the cookies to a rack to cool completely.
title: Mama'S French Butter Cookies From Virginia Willis

steps: 1. Mix in a blender the ingredients except salad oil.
2. When well blended, add salad oil.
3. Great on spinach, regular lettuce salads and with fruit.
title: Nellie'S Honey French Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Cook onion in hot oil until tender.
2. Add remaining ingredients; simmer uncovered 15 minutes.
title: French Quarter Sauce

steps: 1. Soak the beans overnight in plenty of water. Drain, rinse, then place in a pan covered with water. Bring to the boil, reduce the heat, then simmer for approx 50 mins until slightly tender but not soft. Drain, then set aside.

2. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan, tip in the onion and garlic, then cook over a medium heat for 10 mins until softened but not browned. Add the tomato purée, cook for a further min, add remaining ingredients, then simmer for 2-3 mins. Season generously, then stir in the beans. Tip into a large ovenproof dish, then bake for approximately 1 hr, uncovered and without stirring, until the beans are tender. The beans will absorb all the fabulous flavours and the sauce will thicken. Allow to cool, then scatter with parsley and drizzle with a little more olive oil to serve.
title: Gigantes Plaki

steps: 1. Melt butter in a medium saucepan; blend in flour until smooth. Slowly stir in milk.
2. Add salt.
3. Cook sauce, stirring constantly, until thickened and smooth.
4. Remove from heat.
5. With a whisk, beat eggs into sauce.
6. Add cheese and mix well.
7. Pour sauce into meat-tomato mixture; mix well.
8. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Moussakas Tis Formas(Molded Moussaka)

steps: 1. Turn on a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)). Select Yogurt function and press Adjust button until Boil appears on display. Pour milk into the pot. Close and lock the lid; set timer for 45 minutes. Check with a thermometer until temperature reaches 185 degrees F (85 degrees C). Remove pot and place on a cooling rack until temperature reaches 110 degrees F (45 degrees C). Take 1 cup milk and mix with plain yogurt and vanilla extract in a bowl; whisk until well combined. Pour back into the pot and reselect Yogurt function. Close and lock lid. Set timer for 9 hours. Strain yogurt with a fine strainer or nut bag and store in sterilized glass jars.
title: Instant Pot® Greek Yogurt

ingredients.text: 1 bunch kale (medium, chopped into 1/4 in pieces (about 4 cups)
1 ounce feta cheese, reduced fat, crumbled

steps: 1. Bring to boil water in large shallow pan. Meanwhile, stir tgether lemon juice and balsamic vinegar and set aside.
2. submerge kale greens in boiling water, pressing down kale into water. cook for 2 minutes.
3. remove kale with skimmer letting water drain for 2-3 minutes. Place on large plate.
4. Sprinkle with feta cheese and lemon/vinegar mix. Top with kalamat olive halves and serve.
5. cooking time includes bringing water to boil. times will vary based on depth of pot.
title: Mediterranean Kale With Feta

steps: 1. Mix first 4 ingredients.
2. Form into patty. Broil 5 minutes per side.
3. Stuff into 1 small pita.
title: Weight Watchers Greek Burger (4 Points)

ingredients.text: 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed (I used freshly cooked spinach and it was just fine)
6 medium olives, black,pitted and chopped (I prefer the green Greek or Italian olives)

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions (without butter or oil), drain and set aside.
2. Coat a large skillet with cooking spray.
3. Add olive oil and heat over medium-high heat until oil sizzles.
4. Add pine nuts and garlic.
5. Cook and stir until pine nuts are golden brown, about 3 minutes.
6. Stir in spinach and tomatoes and cook until heated through, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes.
7. Add spinach mixture to pasta and toss until combined.
8. Serve pasta sprinkled with feta cheese and black or green olives.
title: Greek Penne Pasta (6 Ww Points)

steps: 1. Slice eggplant very thinly.
2. Brown ground turkey with onion and garlic.
3. When brown, add tomato sauce and red wine. Let simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Layer eggplant then meat mixture in 13 x 9 pan, ending with meat mixture.
5. Add milk to clean saucepan and slowly stir in flour a little at a time until sauce thickens. Add feta and parmesan cheese.
6. Pour white sauce over the casserole.
7. Bake at 350 degrees until top starts to turn golden brown.
title: Moussaka Light

ingredients.text: 1 lb. medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
8 oz. pitted Kalamata olives (or other Greek variety)

steps: 1. Heat butter or oil on medium heat in large, heavy skillet. Saute shrimp approximately 1 to 2 minutes on each side until opaque.
2. Transfer cooked shrimp with slotted spoon to warm plate and cover, set to side.
3. Saute tomatoes until tender on medium-low heat, approximately 8 minutes.
4. Add olives and saute for 2 minutes.
5. Add 1/2 crumbled Feta and melt.
6. Add shrimp and saute until warmed approximately 2 minutes.
7. Add reserved Feta to mixture, do not allow to melt completely.
8. Serve as appetizer with chunk of crusty bread or over angel hair pasta as an entree.
title: Shrimp And Feta

ingredients.text: 4 ounces sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.

2. In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium-high heat then add the onions and zucchini and cook, stirring for 6 minutes. Add the mushroom and cook, stirring until the liquid is absorbed and the vegetables are wilted, about 10 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the tomatoes, basil, and thyme then season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring 1 minute. Remove from the heat and cool.
4. In a bowl, beat the eggs and milk together, add the grated cheese and red pepper flakes.
5. Place the pie crust in the pie pan. Add the vegetable mixture. Pour the egg mixture on top. Top with the goat cheese.
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the eggs are set and browned. Remove from the oven and let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
title: Mediterranean Quiche

steps: 1. Combine shredded cucumber, yogurt and garlic. Refrigerate.
title: Tzatziki

steps: 1. Place all ingredients into a food processor fitted with a metal blade and process until smooth. If desired some of the strawberries can be first chopped, then folded in so you have bits in the mix.
2. Freeze about an hour until firm but not too hard to scoop. Serve.
title: Simplest Strawberry Frozen Greek Yogurt - No Machine Needed

steps: 1. In a medium bowl mix beef, onion, lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder, salt and black pepper (overmixing can cause toughness). Shape into patties.
title: Greek Burger

steps: 1. Mix all together and dip chicken in.
2. Remaining mixture will keep well in refrigerator.
3. Bake chicken 1 hour or until chicken is brown and well done.
4. Serve on rice or as main dish.
title: Mediterranean Chicken

steps: 1. Combine the garlic, oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, cracked black pepper, sea salt and the dried oregano in a large bowl. Use the bowl in which you will marinate your fish.
2. Add the fish and ensure it is thoroughly coated in the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 15-20 minutes.

3. Line a broiler/griller tray with aluminium foil and place the fish on in a single layer. Broil/Grill the fish for 5-10 minutes each side. Only turn the fish once during the cooking (as you do not want it to fall apart). Grill until the fish is cooked.
4. Serve with a salad or veges.
title: Lemon Pepper Fish Greek Style

ingredients.text: 1/2 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced
6 large kalamata olives, pitted and quartered

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450*F.
2. Sprinkle counter lightly with flour, then turn dough in flour to coat.
3. Stretch or roll dough to 10 or 12-inch circle, then transfer to nonstick pizza pan.
4. Top dough with tomato, bell pepper, onion, feta, olives, oergano, and pepper.
5. Bake until crust is browned, and crisp, 15-20 minute.
title: Ww 5 Points - Greek Pizza

steps: 1. Dredge chicken in flour; shake off excess.
2. Spray large skillet with cooking spray; add oil. Brown chicken in oil; remove from skillet and set aside.

3. Add green pepper, onion and garlic and saute 5 minutes; add mushrooms and saute additional 3 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, water, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper and red pepper. Bring to a boil and stir in rice. Return chicken to pan.
4. Cover and cook over low heat 30 minutes or until tender and all liquid is absorbed.
title: Mediterranean Chicken

steps: 1. Combine the couscous and 1/2 cup boiling water in a medium heatproof bowl. Cover; let stand for about 5 mins or until the liquid is absorbed, fluffing with a fork occasionally.

2. Meanwhile, halve the peppers and discard the seeds and membranes. Place the peppers, cut-side up, in large parchment paper-lined steamer, over large saucepan of simmering water. Steam for about 8 mins or until tender.
3. Meanwhile, add the tomato, cheese, onion, chopped basil, and lemon peel and juice to the couscous and mix gently.
4. Divide the couscous mixture among the pepper halves. Sprinkle with basil leaves and serve.
title: Basil And Feta Stuffed Peppers

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 and place chicken in baking dish.
2. Combine remainder of ingredients and pour over top of chicken breast.

3. Bake chicken 35-40 minutes or until done.* ( You can substitute Greek seasoning for the oregano and rosemary if you choose)& you can also grill this chicken on the barbeque.Serve with tsatsiki dip to dip your chicken into. Enjoy!
title: Greek Chicken Breast Souvlaki

steps: 1. Heat the oven to 375°. Coat the chicken with the oil; arrange the pieces, skin-side up, in a large roasting pan. Sprinkle the chicken with the oregano, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Top each piece of chicken with a piece of the butter.

2. Cook the chicken until the breasts are just done, about 30 minutes. Remove the breasts and continue to cook the legs until done, about 5 minutes longer. Remove the roasting pan from the oven; return the breasts to the pan. Top the chicken pieces with the feta cheese. Press any cheese that rolls off into the pan back onto the chicken. Baste the chicken with the pan juices.
3. Heat the broiler. Broil the chicken until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Serve with the pan juices.
4. Menu Suggestions: Balance the tanginess of lemon and feta with a mild side dish such as orzo tossed with a little olive oil or sauteed zucchini.

5. Wine Recommendation: This Greek-flavored dish will go nicely with a number of rustic, spicy red wines. Try finding a bottle from the Greek island of Paros or Santorini. Another alternative would be a syrah-based wine such as a Crozes-Hermitage from the northern Rhone Valley in France.
title: Chicken With Lemon, Oregano, And Feta Cheese

ingredients.text: 2 medium uncooked zucchini, cut into 2-inch chuncks

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini and oregano; saute until zucchini is golden brown, about 4-6 minutes.

2. Remove skillet from heat and add parsley; toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. (some feta cheeses are salty so remember when adding salt). Sprinkle feta cheese over top just before serving.
3. Yields about 1/2 cup per serving.
title: Sauteed Zucchini With Oregano And Feta

ingredients.text: 1 baguette, sliced into thin rounds (toasted or untoasted)

steps: 1. Put all ingredients into blender or food processor, and process until combined and of desired texture.
2. Serve on baguette rounds.
title: Greek Olive Tapenade

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons fennel seeds, ground in mortar

steps: 1. Simmer onions in water to cover until translucent, 5-7 minutes. Cool under cold water and drain. Coarsely grind the onions with the chicken using a Kitchenaid or food processor.
2. Add the remaining ingredients to the chicken and blend thoroughly with your hands.
3. Divide into 4 portions. May use now or freeze for later use.
title: Mediterranean Sausage

steps: 1. Halve the egplant lengthwise. Hollow out the halves leaving 1/2 inch thick shells. Chop the eggplant pulp.
2. In a medium skillet, cook mushrooms, onion, and eggplant pulp in hot oil for 5 minutes. Add tomato and cook 2 minutes more. Remove from heat, and stir in cooked rice, salt, and pepper.
3. Lightly grease a square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place eggplant halves, cut side up, in dish. Spoon half of filling into each eggplant half.
4. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 to 15 minutes more until heated through and eggplant shells are tender.
title: Stuffed Eggplant Mediterranean-Style

steps: 1. Combine garlic powder, olive oil, oregano, onion, lemon juice and salt.
2. Marinate chicken pieces in mixture overnight.
3. Melt butter in pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
title: Greek Chicken

steps: 1. Mix ingredients all together.
2. Drop a teaspoon at a time in hot vegetable oil until golden brown.
3. Drain on paper towel, and serve with maple syrup or honey. Sprinkle with chopped walnuts and cinnamon.
title: Loukomades (Greek Honey Balls)

steps: 1. Saute onion and beef together in a skillet. Drain excess fat after the beef is browned.
2. Add the tomato sauce, salt, pepper, oregano, allspice and cinnamon into the meat and onions. Set aside to cool.
3. Beat together one egg and milk, and stir into the uncooked macaroni, along with 1/4 cup of the Parmesan cheese.
4. Place the macaroni mix into a greased 5 qt slow cooker.
5. Whisk one egg into the tomato-meat sauce. Pour it over the macaroni in the slow cooker.
6. Combine the two remaining eggs, flour and half and half in a bowl and whisk together well, Add the remaining 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese and whisk again.
7. Gently pour the half-and-half mixture over the tomato sauce layer, trying not to disturb it if possible. Sprinkle with nutmeg.
8. Cover and cook on Low for 4 to 5 hours, until macaroni is soft and sauce is bubbling around the edges. (Not sure how to check the macaroni when it's the bottom, but that's what she wrote!).
title: Pastitsio (Slow Cooker)

ingredients.text: 2 small scallions, very thinly sliced (green onions)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 and spray baking pan with small amount of vegetable cooking spray.
2. Randomly pierce chicken breasts with a fork to absorb lemon juice.
3. Sprinkle 2 T lemon juice over chicken breasts, then season with salt and pepper.
4. Top evenly with feta cheese, green pepper, chopped tomatoes and scallions, reserving a portion of green stems for garnishing later.
5. Drizzle with remaining lemon juice.
6. Bake uncovered in oven for 40-45 minutes until cooked through.
7. Before serving, sprinkle with diced scallion greens and chopped parsley. If desired, a small amount of additional lemon juice can be drizzled over dish.
8. Serve with crusty bread and butter and green vegetable of your choice. We like cut green beans sprinkled with a little oregano and melted butter.
9. Enjoy!
title: "Oopah!" Feta Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate until serving time.
title: Feta Cream

steps: 1. Squeeze lemons to release 2/3 cup of fresh lemon juice.
2. Mince or crush garlic in garlic press.
3. Remove rosemary leaves from stalk, discard stalk, and chop leaves.

4. Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, cracked red pepper flakes, seasoned salt, & pepper together in bowl, then divide into 2 1-gallon freezer bags. (If freezing, be sure to label bags ahead of time.)
5. Marinate chicken in bag for at least 30 minutes or longer, or press out air from bag and freeze.

6. Thaw if frozen. Grill 7-8 minutes per side, basting with additional marinade, if desired. Alternatively, you can pour contents into slow cooker. Cook on low for 4-5 hours or high for 2-3 hours, or place in casserole dish and bake at 400 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Easy Greek Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced

steps: 1. Cook the pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.

2. While pasta cooks, heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oregano, zucchini, and crushed garlic; saute 3 minutes. Stir in broth, rind, juice, and pepper. Add pasta and cheese; toss well. Serve immediately.
title: Penne With Zucchini And Feta

ingredients.text: 4 boneless chicken breasts (with or without skin)

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper; dust with flour. Add chicken to skillet; saute until brown, about 2 minutes per side. Using tongs, transfer chicken to plate.
3. Add mushrooms, garlic and oregano to same skillet. Saute until mushrooms brown, about 10 minutes.
4. Add broth, lemon juice and wine and boil until sauce is slightly reduced, about 5 minutes.
5. Add chicken to sauce. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until chicken is cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Transfer chicken and mushroom sauce to platter. Sprinkle with parsley.
title: Chicken & Mushrooms (Greek Style)

ingredients.text: 4 ounces feta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a heavy 8-inch skillet or a 1 quart saucepan over low-heat. Add the feta and ricotta cheese, and pepper.
2. Cook, stirring constantly, and mashing the cheeses slightly, until they soften and begin to bubble - about 5 minutes.
3. Stir in lemon juice, and garnish with the parsley if desired.
4. Serve at once. As the fondue cools, it loses flavor. Or put into crock pot or fondue pot to keep it warm if you can't serve it right away.
5. Variations: Substitute fontina cheese for the feta cheese or you can substitute cottage cheese for the ricotta. Or do both!
title: Feta And Ricotta Cheese Fondue

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 lbs skinless chicken thighs, rinsed and patted dry

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. In a baking pan, toss together all of the ingredients except the feta cheese. Bake for 20 minutes.

2. Raise the temperature to 475 degrees. Sprinkle the feta over the top of the chicken and zucchini and continue to bake until the chicken is cooked through and lightly golden, about 10 minutes longer. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
title: Roasted Chicken Thighs With Zucchini And Feta

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese (adjust to taste)

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions to al dente stage.

2. While pasta is cooking, melt butter and saute garlic in a non-stick skillet When pasta is done, drain and toss immediately in skillet, stirring with pasta server to coat with butter and distribute garlic.
3. Serve into pasta dishes and sprinkle with the desired amount of feta.
4. (If you like it like I do, 1/4 cup may not be enough!).
title: Greek Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 1 ounce pitted kalamata olives, halved (1/3 cup)

steps: 1. Let dough stand at room temperature, covered, for 30 minutes.
2. Arrange tomato slices on a jelly-roll pan lined with paper towels; top with more paper towels. Let stand 30 minutes.
3. Place a pizza stone or heavy baking sheet in oven. Preheat oven to 500° (keep pizza stone or baking sheet in oven as it preheats).

4. Combine tomatoes, 2 tablespoons oil, and garlic. Roll dough into a 14-inch circle on a lightly floured surface, and pierce dough liberally with a fork. Carefully remove pizza stone from oven. Sprinkle cornmeal over stone; place dough on stone. Arrange tomato mixture on dough. Crumble cheese; sprinkle over pizza. Bake at 500° for 19 minutes or until crust is golden and cheese is lightly browned. Remove from oven; top with olives and basil. Brush outer crust with remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons oil. Cut pizza into 6 large slices.
title: Fresh Tomato-Feta Pizza

ingredients.text: 10 ounces feta cheese, cut into 1/2 cubes

steps: 1. mix indgrediants together in a resealable plastic bag.
2. chill 2 hours or overnight.
3. place the cubes in a serving bowl.
4. serve with pita wedges.
title: Spicy Marinated Feta Cubes

ingredients.text: 3 small chicken breasts, boneless and skinless, cut into cubes (l lb/454 g)

steps: 1. Heat olive oil over medium high heat in a large stock pot. Add chicken. Cook and stir until chicken is lightly browned, but not cooked through, about 4 minutes.
2. Add onions, zucchini, red pepper and garlic. Cook and stir until vegetables begin to soften, about 3 minutes.

3. Stir in chili powder, cumin and oregano. Cook 1 more minute. Add tomatoes with their juice, pasta suace, chickpeas, brown sugar and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Remove from heat. Stir in cilantro. Ladle chili into serving bowls and top with feta cheese.
title: Greek Chicken Chili (Weight Watcher Friendly 7 Points)

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F.
2. Place the feta in a small baking dish. Sprinkle with the oil and remaining ingredients. Cover.
3. Bake for about 10 mins or until the cheese is heated through.
4. Serve the feta warm from the dish, with slices of French bread and pitted black olives, if desired.
title: Oregano-Baked Feta

ingredients.text: 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded and finely diced

steps: 1. Strain the cucumber for about 1 hour.
2. In a serving bowl, blend all prepared ingredients together and let set in refrigerator for about an hour.
3. When serving, drizzle some olive oil over the Tzatziki and serve as an appetizer or dip with bread as an accompaniment.
title: Greek Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 1/2 cups Strawberries, Plums, Or Whatever Fruit You Like
3 Tablespoons Agave Nectar (or More To Taste)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Place fruit on a small sheet pan lined with parchment paper or a silicone mat.

2. Drizzle oil and sugar over the fruit, and toss to combine. Roast for 20-25 minutes, just until the juices oozing from the fruit start to thicken. Watch carefully or it will burn. Let cool completely.
3. Next, in a small bowl, stir together the Greek yogurt and agave nectar. Taste, and add additional agave if you wish.
4. In a popsicle mold, layer pieces of roasted fruit with the yogurt mixture. Follow your popsicle manufacturer's directions for freeze time.
title: Greek Yogurt Popsicles

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Combine oregano, salt, and pepper.
3. Rub seasonings all over chicken.
4. Arrange chicken parts in a 13x9-inch baking dish.
5. Blend together olive oil and lemon juice.
6. Pour over chicken.
7. Bake 40 minutes or until chicken is tender.
title: Greek-Style Chicken

steps: 1. In a large pot with boiling salted water cook spaghetti pasta until al dente. Rinse with cool water. Drain well.
2. In a large bowl mix the bread crumbs, oregano, basil, and cooled pasta. Pour olive oil to your likening over the mixture.
3. Serve salad cold.
title: Quick Mediterranean Pasta

ingredients.text: 4 (6 ounce) salmon fillets, 1 inch thick, skin on and at room temperature

steps: 1. Preheat a grill to high. Cut four 8-by-12-inch sheets of heavy-duty foil. Place each salmon fillet skin side down on a sheet; top each with 2 tablespoons ranch dressing, 1 tablespoon bacon and 1 tablespoon feta; season with pepper.
2. Fold up the sides of the foil, leaving the top exposed. Place on the grill, cover and cook until almost opaque in the thickest part, 8 to 10 minutes.
3. Serve topped with the tomatoes.
title: Grilled Salmon, Bacon & Feta Packets

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup cucumber, peeled seeded and shredded

steps: 1. In bowl, combine cucumber and 1/4 t salt. Mix well and set aside for 5 minutes.
2. In blender, combine tahini, 1/2 t salt, water, lemon juice, dill and 1/2 clove garlic. Blend until smooth.
3. Remove cucumber from bowl and squeeze out liquid with your hands. Stir in tahini. Grate remaining garlic into mixture.
title: Tahini Tzatziki

steps: 1. Combine olive oil, vinegar, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Using a whisk, blend the yogurt with the sour cream. Add the olive oil mixture to the yogurt mixture and mix well. Finally, add the cucumber and chopped fresh dill. Chill for at least two hours before serving.
2. Garnish with a sprig of fresh dill just before serving.
title: Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup finely grated English cucumber, drained (I leave the skin on, you'll need about 1/2 a large english cuke)
1/4 teaspoon fresh dill weed, finely chopped

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, and stir well.
2. Refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferrably overnight.
3. Remove from refrigerator about 30 minutes prior to serving to take the chill off.
title: Fat-Free Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast halves skinless and boneless

steps: 1. Combine flour and oregano in a shallow dish; dredge chicken breasts in flour mixture.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add chicken breasts, and cook 10 minutes, turning once.
3. Add wine and broth (if wine is not desired, double amount of chicken broth or substitute apple juice); simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
4. Add chopped tomato, olives, and capers; cook until thoroughly heated.
5. Spoon into serving dish; sprinkle with Feta cheese.
title: Greek Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Place salmon in a greased 15x10x1-in. baking pan; sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt. In a small bowl, whisk the oil, vinegar, honey, mustard and remaining salt. Spoon 1 tablespoon over each fillet.
2. In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, onion, green pepper, olives and remaining oil mixture. Spoon over fillets.
3. Bake at 425° for 12-15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
title: Mediterranean Roasted Salmon

steps: 1. Add first nine ingredients to bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer.
2. Process on the basic bread cycle.
3. When the bread cycle completes, brush the lemon juice on top of the bread while it's still in the machine.
title: Greek Oregano And Lemon (Abm)

ingredients.text: 3 -4 lbs chicken (whole, split in half, cut-up, or chicken parts of your choice)

steps: 1. Wash your chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.

2. Combine the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper and stir them together well. If you're using a whole chicken, rub it all over with some of this mixture, making sure to rub plenty inside the body cavity, as well. If you're using cut-up chicken, put it in a large zip-lock bag, pour the marinade over the chicken and seal the bag.
3. Let the chicken marinade for at least an hour, or as long as a day.

4. At least 1 hour before you want to serve the chicken, pull it out of the bag. You can either grill your chicken or you can roast it in a 375 degree oven for about 1 hour. Either way, cook it until the juices run clear when it's pierced to the bone.
5. Recipe from the book "500 Low-carb Recipes" by Dana Carpender.
title: Greek Roasted Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 medium cucumbers, peeled, halved lenghtwise and seeded

steps: 1. Combine walnuts and parsley in blender or food processor until powdery in texture.
2. Add milk, cheese, garlic, paprika and ground red pepper and puree until smooth.
3. Fill cucumbers with feta-walnut mixture, patting into place with fork or spoon.
4. Slice into wedges and lightly sprinkle tops with a little extra paprika.
title: Feta-Walnut Stuffed Cucumbers

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp chopped fresh oregano leaves, plus oreganos sprigs for garnish
1 pt grape tomatoes, each cut lengthwise in half

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 400. From lemons, grate 1/2 teaspoon peel and squeeze 1/4 cup juice

2. 2. In 13" by 9" glass or ceramic baking dish, arrange tilapia fillets. Evenly sprinkle fillets with lemon juice and peel, chopped oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper. Add tomatoes to baking dish around tilapia, cover with foil and roast 16 to 18 minutes or until tilapia is opaque throughout and tomatoes are tender.
3. 3. Meanwhile, heat covered 4 quart saucepan of salted water to boiling on high. Add orzo and cook as label directs. Drain well.
4. 4. Serve tilapia, tomatoes, and orzo with juices from baking dish.
title: Greek Style Tilapia

3. Saute the chicken breasts in the butter until lightly browned on each side.
4. Add any other spices you would like, I usually use salt, pepper and parsley.
5. Bake in the oven at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.
title: Greek Stuffed Chicken

1 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed and left whole

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large non-reactive pot over medium heat. Add the shallots, garlic, and fennel seeds and saute until slightly softened, about 2 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes with their juices and continue cooking until the tomatoes are soft and stewed down, 5 minutes.

2. Stir in the parsley, mint, green beans, wine, water, and salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Then reduce the heat, partially cover the pot, and simmer until the beans are very tender and the liquid is reduced by half and sauce-like, 45 minutes. Serve right away. Serves 6.
3. The Olive and The Caper.
title: Greek String Beans With Shallots, White Wine, And Fennel Seeds

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large saucepan; add onion and cinnamon. Cook, stirring often, 4 minutes or until onion is tender.
2. Add green beans, chicken broth, salt and pepper.
3. Bring mixture to a boil.
4. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
5. Remove from heat and stir in tomato paste.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Greek Green Beans

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large frying pan.
2. Add onion and green pepper and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
3. Add tomatoes, green beans, garlic, salt and oregano.
4. Cover; lower heat and simmer 15 minutes or until beans are tender.
5. Can be served either hot or at room temperature.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Greek Green Beans

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Begin by par-boiling the whole cauliflower in a large pot of salted boiling water for approximately 15 minutes. To know when it's done, when poked with a fork, the cauliflower should give a little resistance. Remove cauliflower from the pot and drain excess water.
2. In a round baking dish, drizzle the bottom with olive oil to prevent the cauliflower from sticking. Place cauliflower in the dish.
3. Prepare the roasting seasoning by combining olive oil and za'atar to form a paste. Brush paste all over the top and sides of cauliflower. Roast for 30 minutes.
4. Remove from oven, drizzle with tahini, top with parsley, and slice into your healthy pie o' heaven.
title: Mediterranean Whole Roasted Cauliflower

steps: 1. Place avocado cubes in a bowl.
2. Whisk olive oil, lime juice, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper together in a bowl; mix in feta cheese. Pour dressing over avocado cubes; toss to coat.
title: Avocado Feta Salad

steps: 1. Place the yellow squash, zucchini, tomato, olives and onion on a double thickness of heavy-duty foil (about 17 inches x 18 in.). Combine the oil, lemon juice, garlic salt, oregano and pepper; pour over vegetables. Fold foil around mixture and seal tightly.
2. Grill, covered, over medium heat for 30-35 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Open foil carefully to allow steam to escape.
3. Transfer vegetables to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with cheese.
title: Greek Style Grilled Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1 cup crumbled feta cheese, divided (about 4 oz)
4 cups sliced fresh zucchini (1/4 inch thick)

steps: 1. Cook rice according to dircetion on package - without salt and oil. Heat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl combined cooked rice and 1/2 cup feta cheese; mix well. Coat a 10 inch quiche dish or pie plate with cooking spray.

2. Press the rice mixture into the sides and bottom of dish. Steam zucchini, covered, 5 minutes. Press zucchini gently between paper towels until barely moist. In a medium bowl, combine zucchini, remaining 1/2 cup feta and salt; mix. Spoon mixture evenly over rice. In a small bowl; combine mint, nutmeg and eggs and mix well with a fork or whisk. Pour over zucchini mixture.
3. Bake for 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Cut into wedges and serve.
title: Baked Zucchini With Rice And Feta

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees F (245 degrees C).
2. Place the cubed potatoes, water, lemon juice, vegetable oil, and olive oil in a 12x18 inch baking dish or roasting pan. Season with oregano, salt, pepper, and garlic.

3. Roast, uncovered, in the preheated oven until the potatoes are tender and golden brown and the water has evaporated, about 1 1/2 hours. Stir the potatoes every 20 minutes as they bake, adding more water as necessary to prevent sticking. Allow the water to evaporate during the final 15 to 20 minutes of cooking, but be careful that the potatoes do not burn. Stir in the chopped fresh parsley, and serve.
title: Greek Garlic-Lemon Potatoes

steps: 1. Arrange figs and feta on a serving platter. Drizzle with oil and season. Sprinkle with mint and serve.
title: Fig, Feta And Mint Salad

steps: 1. Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise. Using a spoon, remove seeds and discard. Cut cucumbers into 1/2-in. cubes; place in a bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Stir in onions. Combine the cheese, lemon juice, oil and pepper; add to cucumber mixture and stir gently.
title: Feta Cucumber Salad

ingredients.text: 8 slices bacon, cooked, crumbled, and divided
1 lb fresh green beans, cooked al dente with still some crunch to them
4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled and divided

steps: 1. Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet.
2. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly browned but only slightly crisp.
3. Drain grease, leaving a small amount in the skillet for later use.
4. Crumble bacon, reserving 2 tablespoons for garnish, then set aside.
5. Cook green beans in a large saucepan of salted water 5-6 minutes, or until they are just crisp, about 5-6 minutes. Don't over-cook. Drain and set aside.
6. Reheat skillet with residual bacon grease over medium-high heat. Stir in bacon and garlic, until garlic is lightly golden.
7. Add green beans and Feta cheese and season with onion powder and freshly ground black pepper.
8. Cook and stir until most of the Feta cheese has melted, about 2 minutes.
9. Transfer to a serving dish, and garnish with remaining Feta cheese and crumbled bacon.
title: Bacon And Feta Green Beans

Remove soup from the heat and cover. Whisk the eggs and lemon juice in a medium bowl until frothy. Remove about 1 cup hot broth from the soup and slowly add it to the eggs. Whisking continually, slowly stir warmed eggs into the soup. Ladle into bowls and serve immediately with a slice of lemon.
title: Greek Lemon-Egg Soup

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450° and butter a 9- by 13-in. baking dish. In a large bowl, toss potato slices with lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, lemon zest, garlic, and salt; layer slices in baking dish.

2. Pour 1 cup boiling water over potatoes and bake, uncovered, until most of the water has evaporated and potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes. Top with feta and bake until golden, about 15 minutes more.

title: Greek Green Beans

steps: 1. Mix lemon juice and olive oil and season to taste. Toss with peppers, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, spinach, red onion and chives then distribute between 4 small salad bowls. Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese and serve.
title: Greek Salad With Feta Cheese

steps: 1. In a large pot over medium-high heat, warm up the oil. Add onion and garlic and saute them in the hot olive oil for about 2 minutes. Add chicken stock, and bring to boil. Add rice, reduce heat, and simmer for about 15 minutes.

2. After the soup has simmered for 15 minutes, whisk together lemon juice, cornstarch, salt, pepper and egg in a small bowl. Slowly pour the egg mixture into the broth, stirring constantly. Add chicken into the soup. Cook until the soup thickens and rice is done, about 3 minutes longer.
3. Makes 4 large servings. Top each bowl with parsley to serve.
4. Adapted from Cooking Light.
title: Avgolemono Soup

steps: 1. Wash Romaine and cut across the width until chop off the end. Put aside.
2. Juice both lemons and set aside.

8. Pour out Ziploc into bowl with remaining Romaine and mix!
9. Enjoy the wonderful meld of flavors!
title: Sunday'S Feta, Dill, Lemon, And Romaine Greek Salad

title: Mediterranean Lentil Quinoa Salad

steps: 1. Combine spinach, bacon, feta cheese, cottage cheese, chopped onion, one teaspoon lemon juice, parmesan cheese and the egg and mix well.

title: Spinach And Feta Stuffed Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.

2. Melt butter in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds. Gradually add spinach to pan, turning with tongs. Sprinkle with salt and pepper; cook 2 minutes or until spinach wilts, stirring frequently. Remove from pan; cool.
3. Place chicken between 2 sheets of plastic wrap; pound to 1/2-inch thickness using a meat mallet or small heavy skillet.

4. Crumble one-fourth of feta cheese over each chicken breast half; divide spinach mixture evenly among chicken breast halves. Roll up, jelly-roll fashion. Tuck in sides; secure each roll with wooden picks. Place chicken in skillet. Cook over medium-high heat 3 minutes. Turn chicken over; cook 2 minutes or until browned. Add tomatoes to skillet; sprinkle chicken with Parmesan cheese. Transfer skillet to oven.

5. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until chicken is done and tomatoes begin to burst. Transfer chicken and tomatoes to a serving platter. Add wine to skillet, scraping pan to loosen browned bits. Remove wooden picks from chicken; cut into slices. Serve with tomatoes and pan juices.
6. Tip: You can prep in the morning, and then pop it in the oven when you're ready.

steps: 1. Preheat broiler on low. Meanwhile, heat a medium skillet over low. Add spinach and cover until leaves have barely wilted (about 1 minute). Place in a small bowl and set aside. Wipe out pan.
2. Add olive oil to cleaned skillet and heat over medium. Add potato-vegetable mixture, cover and cook, turning occasionally, until potatoes are tender but firm (5-7 min). Set aside.

4. Spray an 8-10" ovenproof skillet (non stick) with cooking spray and place over low heat. Cover bottom evenly with potatoes and pour egg mixture over top. Cook until eggs set (about 10 min).
5. Place skillet under broiler for 1-2 minutes to finish cooking top of frittata.
title: Greek Style Frittata

ingredients.text: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Preparation method
2. Prep: 20 minutes	 | Cook: 25 minutes
3. 1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Lightly grease a 25cm square baking dish and line it with baking paper.

4. 2. Place the pumpkin in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and cook in microwave on full power, stirring halfway through cooking time, until tender, about 5 minutes. Place the potato in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and cook in microwave on full power until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 4 minutes.
5. 3. Combine the pumpkin and potato in a large bowl. Add the spinach, feta, cheddar and eggs; stir. Transfer mixture to prepared dish; top with sliced onion.
6. 4. Bake in preheated oven until firm, about 25 minutes. Allow to rest 5 minutes before serving.
title: Pumpkin, Spinach & Feta Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 large red onion, cut into wedges
1/4 cup black olives (pitted are easier to eat)

steps: 1. Heat the grill / broiler to high.
2. Whisk the eggs in a large bowl with the chopped parsley, pepper and salt, if you want.
3. Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan, then fry the onion wedges over a high heat for about 4 mins until they start to brown around the edges.
4. Throw in the tomatoes and olives and cook for 1-2 mins until the tomatoes begin to soften.
5. Turn the heat down to medium and pour in the eggs.
6. Cook the eggs in the pan, stirring them as they begin to set, until half cooked, but still runny in places - about 2 minutes
7. Scatter over the feta, then place the pan under the grill for 5-6 mins until omelette is puffed up and golden.
8. Cut into wedges and serve straight from the pan.
title: Greek Salad Omelette

steps: 1. Cut feta cheese into 1/2 inch chunks.
2. Beat eggs with water, oregano and pepper to blend.
3. Melt butter in a wide skillet with an ovenproof handle, over low heat.
4. Pour in egg mixture. Cook, lifting cooked portion with a wide spatula to let the uncooked eggs flow underneath, until eggs are just softly set.
5. Sprinkle feta cheese evenly over eggs.
6. Put under broiler for about 2 minutes, just until cheese is hot.
7. Sprinkle with tomatoes, parsley & olives.
8. Cut into wedges to serve.
title: Greek Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup sour cream (I used ricotta instead)
60 g sun-dried tomatoes, drained and finely chopped
1/4 cup sour cream (I used 1/4 cp ricotta mixed with 1/2 tsp Dijon mustard)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 180°C Grease 2 12-hole mini-muffin pans (30 ml capacity) or one 24-hole pan.
2. Heat oil to medium high and saute onion and garlic for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, till tender. Set aside to cool for 15 minutes.

4. Spoon mixture into muffin holes until almost full. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until puffed and golden, then cool in pans for 5 minutes.Turn onto wire rack to cool.
5. Top each cooled frittata with 1/2 tsp sour cream (or ricotta/mustard), 1 cherry tomato quarter and a tiny sprinkle of chives. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper.
title: Mini Tomato And Feta Frittatas

4. Saute the leek on butter until it softens. Season with salt and sugar while sauteing
5. In a large bowl, mix eggs, flour and baking powder

title: Melomakaruna(Greek Cookies)

steps: 1. Mix butter, sugar, egg and vanilla thoroughly.

2/3 cup sliced almonds, toasted, finely chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°F. Lightly grease 2 baking trays.

2. Cream butter, vanilla and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg yolk and brandy then transfer to a large bowl. Add almonds and flour and mix until combined. 2 cups unbleached flour, divided (1/2 cup for rolling gnocchi)

steps: 1. In a microwave safe dish put sweet potato and add a little water. Cook on high until potato is soft about 10 minutes ( depends on size of potato and your microwave).
2. Finely dice onion and saute over medium heat until it just starts to brown.
3. In a large pot bring 2 quarts of water to boil .

5. Add salt and pepper and mash.
6. Fold in feta, onion and egg and mix well.
7. Add 1 12 cups flour to the mixture until incorporated. This makes a very soft dough.
8. Pour about a 1/2 cup of flour on a plate or a clean dry surface. I used a teaspoon to take the dough out of the bowl and then dredge the dough in the flour.

10. Repeat until the dough is finished.
11. Add about 12 pieces at a time to the boiling water.
12. When gnocchi floats to the top cook another 3 minutes then remove with a slotted spoon to a colander.
13. Repeat until all the gnocchi are cooked.
14. You can now brown these in an herb butter or just top with your favourite sauce.
15. Enjoy.
