2. Place one oyster in each cup.
3. Cover with a tbsp of salsa -Use hot if you want more heat.
4. Sprinkle each first with a tsp of Feta then with the parmesan.
5. Bake in preheated 350 F oven for 20 minutes or until they are golden.
title: Baked Oysters With Salsa, Feta & Parmesan

steps: 1. Place feta in a bowl and mash well.
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix together thoroughly or alternatively place all ingredients in a food processor and whirr on slow speed until smooth.
3. Serve with crackers or slices of fresh country bread.
title: Feta Cheese And Garlic Dip

steps: 1. Whisk together first 6 ingredients in a bowl; slowly whisk in olive oil. Stir in feta and thyme.
title: Feta Dressing

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except oil and let sit half hour.
2. Then add oils.
title: Greek Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Grate cucumber. Drain juices using a sieve, pressing down to squeeze out as much of the juice as possible.
2. Blend all ingredients together thoroughly.
3. Refrigerate overnight to allow ingredients to blend properly.
title: Tzatziki Sauce (Light)

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine hulled and quartered strawberries, 4 Tbsp sugar and 4 Tbsp liqueur, stir to combine then cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours, stirring once or twice.
2. Two photos of cut strawberries in a bowl with one having sugar being added to the bowl Two photos of cut up strawberries for Strawberry Romanoff

3. Just before serving, in a large mixing bowl, combine 1 cup cold heavy cream and 1/4 cup powdered sugar, and beat with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Using a spatula, fold in 1/4 cup sour cream just until well blended.

4. To serve, stir strawberries then divide between 6 serving glasses or bowls. You can spoon a little syrup over the berries if you like. You can also use this syrup to soak a cake. Spoon cream over strawberries, dividing evenly. You can also use an ice cream scoop with trigger release for a nice rounded puff of cream. Serve right away or chill and enjoy within 2 hours of assembly.
title: Strawberries Romanoff

steps: 1. Place the ground meat in a bowl. Chop the onion very finely and grate the garlic cloves. Add to the bowl. Add the chopped parsley, all sorts of paprika, baking soda, dried breadcrumbs, water, Vegeta, salt, and pepper.
2. Mix well with the hand mixer fitted with the dough hooks. Cover the bowl with cling film/ plastic foil and leave to rest for 1 or 2 hours in the refrigerator.

3. Take portions of the meat mixture, about 50-55 g/ 1.7-1.9 oz/ ¼ cup portions, and form the cevapi. The rolls should be about as thick as your thumb and about 7-10 cm/ 3-4 inches long. I had 18 sausages. The recipe can be easily doubled.

4. Grill the cevapcici on the hot grill pan or on the barbecue for about 12-14 minutes, turning them several times in between, or until brown and cooked through. I checked by cutting one in the middle and then grilling the following batches for the same period of time.

5. Serve hot as suggested above. The cevapcici can be reheated in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius/ 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 10 minutes or until heated through. Check one, if it is not hot enough, give the sausages a few more minutes.
title: Cevapi Sausages

steps: 1. Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bash the garlic, sage, lemon zest, salt and pepper together using a pestle and mortar until the mixture becomes a paste. Stir in the oil, then spread the mixture over the pork shoulder, avoiding the skin on top. Score the skin using a sharp knife, then rub a large pinch of salt into the skin. Tie the pork together using kitchen string.

2. Line a large baking tray with a double layer of foil and put the pork on top, skin-side up. Bring the sides of the foil up around the pork to create a parcel, then pour the wine into the tray around the sides. Transfer to the oven and reduce the temperature to 140C/120C fan/gas 1. Roast for 4-5 hrs, or until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the pork reads 70C.

3. Turn the oven up to 240C/220C fan/gas 9. Carefully spoon the pork roasting juices from the pan into a saucepan and cook over a medium heat for 10-15 mins, or until reduced by a third. Season to taste.

4. Meanwhile, arrange the foil around the meat so only the skin is exposed, then return to the oven for 10-15 mins until the skin is puffed up and browned all over. Leave to rest for 20 mins before slicing. Serve with the sauce drizzled over.
title: Slow-roasted ham with lemon, garlic & sage

steps: 1. Saute onion in oil until tender.
2. Add marjoram, salt and paprika.
3. Add vinegar; mix well.
4. Add meat and brown.
5. Pour in wine; cover and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
6. Add water sparingly while cooking.
7. Serve with noodles.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350F.
2. Saute beef, onions, and garlic in a large saucepan over medium heat.
3. Pour off grease.
4. Add barley and bacon; saute 2 to 3 minutes.
5. Stir in tomato juice, salt and pepper and bring to a low boil.
6. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes.
7. Stir in cabbage and caraway seeds.
8. Spoon mixture into 2-quart casserole.
9. Bake for 30 minutes.
10. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: German Beef And Barley Bake

ingredients.text: 10 oz. beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Broil meat on rack 5 to 10 minutes on each side. Combine remaining ingredients except noodles in heavy skillet.
2. Simmer, covered, for 2 hours until meat is tender.
3. Stir in noodles. Makes 2 portions.
title: Weight Watchers Beef Goulash

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Pour into buttered casserole dish.
3. Bake for 2 hours at 300°.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Savory Sauerkraut Casserole

steps: 1. Cook meat in 1 tablespoon butter until it loses its red color. Add onions.
2. Cook for 5 minutes.
3. Place into casserole.
4. Melt remaining butter in saucepan.
5. Blend in flour.
6. Add bouillon cubes, hot water, salt, pepper, mustard, Worcestershire and ketchup.
7. Cook until thick.
8. Beat in sour cream.
9. Pour mixture over meat.
10. Cool; cover and refrigerate.
11. The day of dinner:
12. Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.
13. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Oven Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak (1/4 to 1/2 inch thick)

steps: 1. Saute mushrooms and onion in 2 tablespoons of butter.
2. Remove from pan.
3. Remove fat and bone from steak.
4. Cut into medium size chunks or strips.
5. Melt additional 2 tablespoons of butter in pan. Toss meat pieces in flour.
6. Coat thoroughly; brown in butter. Add salt and bouillon.
7. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, about 1 1/4 hours.
8. Add mushrooms, onion and sour cream.
9. Heat.
10. Serve over noodles or rice.
11. Yields 6 servings.
title: Beef Or Venison Stroganoff

steps: 1. NOTE:I use 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves to serve 6 because we like extra sauce.
2. Shake chicken in flour, salt, and pepper in a plastic bag.
3. Coat well.
4. Save remaining flour for gravy.
5. Brown chicken, part at a time, in butter and oil in Dutch oven.
6. Remove chicken when browned, pour off drippings, and return 1 tablespoonful to kettle.
7. Stir in onion and saute until soft.
8. Add water, instant chicken broth , and paprika.
9. Scraping brown bits from bottom of kettle, heat to boiling.
10. Return chicken to kettle, cover, and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.
11. Remove chicken to shallow pan and reheat broth to boiling.
12. Measure 2 tablespoons of saved flour and add water to make paste.
13. Stir into broth.
14. Cook, stirring constantly, until gravy thickens and boils 1 minute.
15. Blend sour cream and whipping cream in a small bowl and stir into gravy.
16. Return chicken and reheat slowly to boiling.
17. Serve over noodles or dumplings.
title: Foolproof Chicken Paprikash

steps: 1. Bake sauerkraut and pork for 3 hours.
2. Remove from oven, mince pork and mix with sauerkraut.
3. Mash and whip potatoes.
4. Place sauerkraut and pork in casserole.
5. Top with mashed potatoes; dot with butter and return to oven until butter is melted and potatoes brown slightly.
6. Heat oven to 375°.
7. Serves 6.
title: Sauerkraut Casserole

steps: 1. Dissolve bouillon cube in water; let sit.
2. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and saute.
3. Remove from pan.
4. Saute onion and sliced mushrooms.
5. Stir in flour.
6. Gradually stir in bouillon water.
7. Cook until thickened, stirring often.
8. Stir in sour cream and chicken.
9. Heat thoroughly, but do not boil.
10. Serve over hot cooked pasta.
11. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Stroganoff

steps: 1. Saute beef and onion in Dutch oven until brown.
2. Pour off excess fat.
3. Stir in tomato juice, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Add noodles, a few at a time, so mixture continues to boil.
6. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender.
7. Stir in sour cream thoroughly, but do not boil.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: One Pot Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 medium apple (Granny Smith or similar one)

steps: 1. Drain sauerkraut and wash in sieve or colander several times to remove brine. Chop onion and bacon into small pieces; saute until onion is translucent. Cook in a skillet with a lid. Drain off bacon grease. Add sauerkraut mixing with onion and bacon. Wash and core apple. Slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices. Arrange on top of sauerkraut mixture.
2. Add apple juice and simmer until juice is reduced by 2/3.
3. Serve as a side dish. Serves 4.
title: Bavarian Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Cut steak into 1/4-inch strips.
2. Coat with salt and pepper. Drop in pot with onion.
3. Mix garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce, bouillon and catsup.
4. Pour over meat, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.
5. Turn to high.
6. Add wine and mushrooms.
7. Dissolve flour in small amount of water.
8. Add to meat, stir until blended. Cook on high for 15 minutes or until slightly thickened.
9. Stir in sour cream, turn off heat.
10. Serve with rice or noodles.
11. Serves 5 to 6.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Put all ingredients except wine, flour and sour cream in slow cooker.
2. Cook low, 6 to 8 hours.
3. Turn to high; add wine. Dissolve flour in water and stir until well blended.
4. Cook on high for 15 minutes until thickened.
5. Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly.
6. Serve over noodles.
7. Serves 4.
title: Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. corn, cut from cob (3 ears)

steps: 1. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
2. Remove bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
3. Crumble bacon and set aside.
4. Cook onion in drippings over medium heat, stirring constantly, until tender.
5. Add okra and cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Add corn and remaining ingredients.
7. Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
8. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Okra Goulash

steps: 1. Saute onions in oil until tender.
2. Add caraway seed, marjoram, salt and paprika moistened with vinegar.
3. Mix with onions.
4. Pour in wine.
5. Cover tightly and simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender.
6. If necessary, add water sparingly during cooking. Serve with noodles.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Mckenzie Goulash

steps: 1. Trim fat off meat.
2. Rub steak on both sides with cut clove of garlic.
3. Pound into it a mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
4. Cut steak against grain into thick strips about 2-inches long.
5. Peel onion and cut it into small pieces.
6. In a heavy frying pan, brown onion in some of the trimmed off beef fat.
7. Remove onion with slotted spoon.
8. Brown meat quickly in the same fat; return onion to pan and heat.
9. Cover and simmer over very low heat for 15 minutes.
10. Meat should be quite tender.
11. If you use a lesser cut of meat, it will take a little longer.
12. Add remaining ingredients and simmer an additional 5 to 10 minutes.
13. Serve over egg noodles or rice.
14. Serves 6 appetites.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Cut steak into 1/4-inch strips.
2. Coat with salt and pepper. Drop into bottom of slow cooker with onion.
3. Mix garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce, bouillon and catsup.
4. Pour over meat.
5. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until tender.
6. Turn control to high.
7. Add mushrooms.
8. Dissolve flour in small amount of water. Add to meat mixture, stirring, until blended.
9. Cook on high for 15 minutes or until slightly thickened.
10. Stir in sour cream; turn off heat.
11. Serve over rice or noodles.
12. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Beef Stroganoff(Crock-Pot Recipe)

steps: 1. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan. Add onion and cook until golden yellow. Stir in sauerkraut and cook for 8 minutes.
2. Mix in potato and caraway seed.
3. Pour in the boiling water.
4. Cook, uncovered, over low heat 30 minutes. Cover and continue cooking 30 minutes longer.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked noodles, freshly cooked and still hot

steps: 1. Slice the steak into very thin strips, about 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches In a large skillet heat the butter.
2. Saute the onions and garlic, stirring frequently.
3. Add the steak and mushrooms and cook until the meat is browned on all sides.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in skillet with onion and salt.
2. Drain off excess fat.
3. Put in a 2-quart casserole.
4. Add sauerkraut, brown sugar and tomato juice.
5. Mix well.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
title: Barbecue Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in skillet.
2. Place browned beef in crock pot.
3. Add onion to skillet and saute until it is tender (about 5 minutes).
4. In a bowl mix worcestershire sauce, ketchup, and vinegar, mustard and salt.
5. Add this mixture to meat with one cup of water.
6. Stir and cover.
7. Cook for 4 hours low.
8. Stir in brown sugar and cook for 1 hour more on low.
9. Blend flour with remaining 1/2 cup of cool water and add to meat mixture.
10. Stir until thickened.
11. Serve over noodles.
title: Crock Pot Non-Hungarian Goulash

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, cleaned and sliced
1/4 c. low-fat plain yogurt at room temperature

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.
2. Broil steak 6 inches from heat until rare, about 5 minutes on each side.
3. Cut diagonally into thin, 2-inch strips, set aside.
4. In a large frying pan, bring broth to a boil. Add onion and mushrooms.
5. Simmer, covered, about 5 minutes until vegetables are tender.
6. Remove vegetables with a slotted spoon; set aside.
7. Simmer broth until reduced to 1/2 cup; remove from heat. Combine water, flour and cornstarch; mix well.
8. Stir into broth with a wire whisk.
9. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened, about 2 minutes.
10. Remove from heat.
11. Combine yogurt, paprika, salt, garlic powder and mustard.
12. Add to chicken broth, stirring until smooth.
13. Mix in reserved beef, onion and mushrooms.
14. Warm over very low heat, stirring constantly until hot, about 5 minutes.
15. Serve over noodles, if desired.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine flour and salt. Whisk in eggs and milk until smooth.

2. Fill a large stockpot three-fourths full with water; bring to a boil. With a rubber spatula, press dough through a colander into boiling water. Cook and stir gently for 4-5 minutes or until spaetzle float and are tender.
3. Combine bread crumbs and butter. With a slotted spoon, transfer spaetzle to a large bowl; add crumb mixture and toss to coat.
title: Crumb-Coated Spaetzle

steps: 1. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Brown chicken in butter in large skillet (10 minutes).
3. Add 1/4 cup water; bring to boil. Lower heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or until tender. Transfer to warm platter; keep warm.
4. Scrape up any browned bits from skillet.
5. Cook mushrooms, tomato, green onions and thyme in skillet for 3 minutes.
6. Sprinkle vegetables with flour; stir to mix well and cook 1 minute.
7. Crumble bouillon cube into skillet.
8. Stir in remaining 1/2 cup water.
9. Continue stirring until bouillon is dissolved and mixture smooth.
10. Remove from heat.
11. Stir in sour cream.
12. Reduce heat to low.
13. Cook until thickened and bubbly (3 minutes).
14. Pour over chicken and serve with noodles.
title: Russian Chicken

steps: 1. Place kielbasa in boiling water.
2. Cover kielbasa. Turn off heat, cover and let stand for 30 minutes. Drain.
3. Cool kielbasa. Cut in 1/4-inch slices.
4. Combine sugar, mustard, cloves and juice. Pour over slices in casserole dish.
5. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
title: Candied Kielbasa

steps: 1. Combine 1 tablespoon flour and salt; dredge meat in mixture. Heat pan.
2. Add 2 tablespoons butter.
3. When melted, add beef and brown quickly on all sides.
4. Add mushrooms, onion and garlic; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until onion is tender.
5. Remove meat and mushrooms to platter.
6. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan drippings. When melted, blend in 3 tablespoons flour.
7. Add tomato paste. Slowly pour in cold meat stock.
8. Cook and stir until thickened. Return browned meat and mushrooms to pan.
9. Stir in sour cream and sherry; heat briefly.
10. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Add onion, celery, carrot and green pepper to well drained sauerkraut.
2. Add sugar to oil and vinegar and stir well until blended.
3. Add this mixture to sauerkraut mixture and mix well. Store, covered, overnight.
4. Very good.
title: Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Mix
2. eggs,
3. milk
4. and
5. salt
6. together
7. and
8. add
9. flour. Meanwhile, use a 5 quart
10. pan filled with water, at least half full; bring water to
12. boil.
13. Cut
14. little
15. spaetzles
16. with a sharp knife on edge of
17. bowl
18. or
19. use the tip of a tablespoon. Cut into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
20. Drain and add butter or oleo and serve.
title: Spaetzles

ingredients.text: 1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Heat oil in a heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan.
2. Add onions and cook until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
3. Add tomato, green pepper, paprika, beef, tomato paste and salt.
4. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until beef loses its red color.
5. Reduce heat to medium-low, add water, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
6. Remove meat and set aside.
7. Strain liquid.
8. Discard solids and return liquid to pot.
9. Return meat to pot.
10. Add potatoes and simmer until tender, about 1 hour.
title: Budapest Beef Goulash Ii

steps: 1. In dutch oven, brown beef with garlic, onions, and green pepper.
2. Cook and stir until beef is done, drain off excess fat.
3. Stir in paprika and thyme.
4. Add broth and noodles; bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occ.
6. Mix sour cream with flour; stir into noodle mixture.
7. Simmer for 3 more minutes, stirring until thickened.
title: Beef Noodle Paprikash

steps: 1. Cook, brown and drain sausage and onion.
2. Mix in sauerkraut, 2 tablespoons bread crumbs, cream cheese, mustard, salt and pepper. Refrigerate until cool.
3. Shape into balls.
4. Coat balls in the flour. Mix together eggs, and milk.
5. Dip floured balls into mixture.
6. Then roll in bread crumbs.
7. Deep fry.
title: Sauerkraut Balls

steps: 1. Brown beef and drain. Season with salt and pepper. Add onions and mushrooms and cook until tender. Mix milk and flour. Add to meat mixture. Cook until thick. Serve over buttered noodles.
title: Easy Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onion in frying pan.
2. Salt and pepper to taste; drain.
3. Add catsup, water and sugar.
4. Mix well, then add macaroni.
5. Stir and let simmer until done.
title: Grandma'S Goulash

steps: 1. The wood stove sat in the middle of the church.
2. We would all take out chairs and huddle around the stove for warmth.
3. The patched hole for the flue can still be seen in the ceiling.
title: Hungarian Popovers(Kati Felfujtja)

steps: 1. Put in 2 1/2-quart casserole.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Bake, covered, at 350°, for 20 minutes until heated thoroughly.
title: Franks And Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. round steak, cut 1/4 inch strips

steps: 1. Saute onions in shortening.
2. Add mushrooms.
3. Cover and cook 5 minutes more.
4. Remove onions and mushrooms from skillet.
5. Brown round steak slowly and thoroughly.
6. Add flour and mix well.
7. Add 1 can canned tomatoes, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
8. Cover and cook very slowly for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
9. Add sour cream, onions and mushrooms.
10. Cover and cook 1/2 hour longer. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Drain sauerkraut, rinse well, squeeze out all of the water. Put into saucepan.
2. Cover with just enough water to cover the sauerkraut.
title: Josie'S Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 4 to 6 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In covered skillet, pour oil, place onions and salt and saute until brown.
2. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons paprika and meat.
3. Mix well. Cover and simmer, over very low heat, for 1 hour.
4. Add 4 1/2 teaspoons paprika, water and potatoes to meat.
5. Cover; simmer, over low heat, for 45 to 60 minutes, until tender.
6. May add more water as needed for gravy.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Sift flour and set aside.
2. Combine salt, Crisco, sugar and milk; scald and set aside.
3. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Add eggs to milk mixture after mixture has cooled.
4. Pour all mixtures together, except 1/2 cup of flour, and beat until smooth. Dough should be sort of sticky.
5. If dough is not too firm, use all of the 6 cups of flour.
6. If dough is too firm, do not add the last 1/2 cup of flour.
title: Recipe Of 1985'S Burleson County Kolache(Queen'S Kolaches, Ella Drgac Queen)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients very well, with a strong, upward, whipping motion.

2. Put a batch of the dough on a small cutting board and scrape it off the board into a pot of boiling salted water, forming small button - to thin egg-noodle size noodles. Noodles will float to the top of the water when they are cooked. Remove with a strainer or slotted spoon.
title: Spaetzle

steps: 1. Mix hamburger, pork, eggs, chopped onion, green pepper and milk together.
2. Add bread crumbs to form a patty.
3. Brown patties in a little oil until browned on both sides.
4. Remove patties.
5. Add water to juice and thicken with flour water to make gravy.
6. Put patties back in gravy and let simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.
title: Polish Hamburgers

steps: 1. Sift flour and baking powder together 3 times.
2. Beat eggs until light and thickened (about 10 minutes).
3. Gradually add sugar to eggs, beating constantly.
4. Add lemon juice.
5. Fold in flour, a little at a time. Add the hot milk, mixing quickly until batter is smooth.
6. Lightly grease with flour 3 (9-inch) cake pans, preferably pans with removable bottoms.
7. Divide the batter between the 3 pans.
8. Preheat oven to 300°.
9. Bake cake layers for 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean.
10. Remove from oven and invert pans until cake is cool.
11. Remove from pans and slice each layer crosswise into 2 layers, making 6 layers.
title: Black Forest Cherry Torte(Schwarzwalder Kirschtorte)

ingredients.text: 2 (1 lb.) loaves frozen bread dough, thawed

steps: 1. Saute beef, onions, garlic, salt and lemon pepper in a large skillet over medium-high heat, until beef is browned. Add cabbage, Worcestershire sauce and caraway seeds. Cook until cabbage is limp; drain liquid from mixture. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. On a lightly floured board, roll each loaf of dough into a 12-inch circle. Cut each circle into 6 wedges. Spoon cabbage beef filling into each dough piece, divided equally. Pull three points of each wedge to center and pinch to seal. Place bierocks on a lightly greased cookie sheet. If desired, brush dough with melted butter or egg wash (one egg white with 2 Tbsp. water). Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve hot, or wrap and freeze for heating later.
title: Bierocks(German Meat Turnovers)

steps: 1. Mix the warm water, vinegar and oil.
2. Wash furniture off with cloth saturated with the polish.
3. Wipe dry with a soft dry cloth.
title: Furniture Polish

steps: 1. Fry ground beef and sausage until well cooked; drain/blot excess fat.
2. Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, oregano & mix well.
3. Add Velveeta cheese and heat until the cheese melts.
4. Put mixture on rye rounds and bag.
5. Freeze.
6. When ready to use, bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Polish Mistakes By Mrs. B

steps: 1. Blend sugar and shortening.
2. Add eggs and vanilla.
3. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk to combine all the ingredients.
4. Knead well.
5. Roll out on floured board to about 1/4-inch thickness and cut into 3-inch squares.
6. Fill with either poppy seed or crushed walnuts.
7. Pinch two opposite ends together. Lay folded side down on greased tin.
8. Or, instead of cutting into squares, spread poppy seed or walnuts across dough and roll like jelly roll.
9. Cut into slices.
10. Bake immediately at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Quickly Made Kolache

steps: 1. Fry meats and drain good.
2. Add seasonings and cheese.
3. Mix. Spread on small loaf rye bread (or plain) and bake at 350° until hot through and through.
title: Polish Mistakes

steps: 1. Preheat broiler Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Separate onion slices into rings; add to skillet.
3. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender, about 10 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, sprinkle 1 teaspoon paprika, garlic salt and pepper over both sides of pork chops.
5. Place chops on rack of broiler pan.
6. Broil, 4 to 5 inches from heat source, 5 minutes.
7. Turn; broil 4 to 5 minutes until chops are barely pink in center.
8. Combine cooked onion with sauerkraut, sour cream and remaining 1/4 teaspoon paprika; mix well.
9. Garnish chops with onion mixture, or spread onion mixture over chops and return to broiler.
10. Broil just until hot, about 1 minute.
title: Pork Chops Paprikash

steps: 1. In skillet cook meat untill browned, drain.
2. Blend in onion soup mix, flour, tomato paste. Add water and simmer covered 15 minuetes.
3. When ready to serve stir in sour cream.
4. Serve over noodles or rice.
title: Chopped Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 3 eggs (reduce the no. of eggs to 2 if they are jumbo)

steps: 1. Grease well a 2-quart casserole dish. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook noodles according to package instructions until tender, but not soft. Drain well.

2. Melt butter in a skillet; saute onion and celery. Stir in salt, caraway seed, and pepper. Spread a third of the noodles in casserole dish. Cover with half of the vegetables. Add half of the cottage cheese and half of the sour cream, spreading it over evenly. Repeat alternating layers, ending with noodles. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Pour beaten eggs over the top of the casserole. Bake for on hour. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting into servings.
title: German Noodle Bake (Gemutlichkeit)

steps: 1. Beat all ingredients until smooth.
2. Let stand at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours.
3. Have ready a small container of melted butter.
4. Heat a 10-inch crepe pan.
5. Brush with the melted butter.
6. Pour batter, about 1/4 cup at a time; rotate quickly to spread.
7. Cook over medium heat until bottom is slightly browned and top is set.
8. Turn out on lightly buttered plate; repeat until batter is used.
title: Blini

steps: 1. Measure milk into a bowl, and set over a saucepan filled half way with simmering water. Heat until warm to the touch, then gradually start cracking eggs into the milk while stirring almost constantly. This will scorch very easily. Continue to stir slowly once all of the eggs are in, until the mixture resembles scrambled eggs.

2. Pour into a cheesecloth bag and tie tightly. Hang from the sink faucet or over a bowl and allow to drain for 1 to 2 hours. Place on a cooling rack set over a pan or bowl and set a heavy object on top to press out the liquid. A cool cast iron skillet weighted with heavy cans works well. Press for about 2 hours.
3. Carefully remove the weights and cheesecloth bag from the cheese. Refrigerate the cheese for several hours or overnight before slicing and serving.
title: Slovak Easter Cheese (Cirak)

steps: 1. Brown onion and ground beef in a skillet.
2. Salt and pepper to taste.
3. Drain any excess grease.
4. Add mushroom soup and diced pepper.
5. Simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Add the mushrooms.
7. Serve over rice or noodles.
8. Add one dollop of sour cream to each plate when served.
9. For a crowd, double or triple.
10. Simple and tasty.
title: Hamburger Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 tsp. baking powder, dissolved in 1 1/2 tsp. hot water

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the flour over fruit and nuts.
3. Cream butter and sugar.
4. Beat eggs well and add to creamed mixture.
5. Stir in remaining flour, cinnamon, salt and dissolved baking soda.
6. Lastly, fold in raisins and nuts.
7. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheets.
8. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
title: Russian Rocks

steps: 1. Mix flour and butter together, then add rest of ingredients. Place in refrigerator overnight.
2. Roll a little dough at a time. Cut in squares and fill each square with about 1/2 teaspoon mixture.
title: Hungarian Keifleys

steps: 1. Put sauerkraut, beer, and caraway seeds into a small pot and cook over medium-low heat until bubbling hot.
title: Sauerkraut With Caraway

steps: 1. Brown meat in roaster pan with a small amount of grease drippings or salad oil.
2. Add flour as for gravy.
3. Add chopped vegetables.
4. Add enough water to cover entire mixture.
5. Cover; let simmer for 2 hours.
6. Delicious served on dry toast.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Proof yeast in lukewarm water and 1 Tablespoon sugar.
2. Scald milk and shortening; add sugar.
3. Cool to lukewarm.
4. Add 2 cups flour to make a batter.
5. Add yeast to mixture.
6. Add eggs; mix.
7. Add remaining flour to make a soft dough, a little at a time; amount of flour will vary some from the 7 cups.
8. Knead lightly.
9. Place in a greased bowl; cover; set in place to rise until double, about 2 hours.
10. Punch down; let rise until double.
11. Form into balls; for kolaches make a dent in center and fill; let rise.
12. Bake in 400 degree Fahrenheit oven until nicely browned, about 15 minutes; no time given, guessing here.
title: Kolache Dough

title: Chicken Stroganoff

steps: 1. Cream shortening until fluffy; add remaining ingredients and enough flour to make a soft dough.
2. Roll and cut.
3. Fry in hot oil until brown.
title: Polish Crullers

steps: 1. Mix first 5 ingredients together and add flour and 1 1/2 cups finely chopped pecans.
2. Drop by teaspoon on a cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
3. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm; these are very rich and have to be handled carefully.
title: Russian Wafers

steps: 1. Brown onions in shortening.
2. Add seasonings and chicken brown 10 minutes.
3. Add water and simmer until tender.
4. Remove chicken.
5. Add sour cream to pan mix well.
6. Thicken with 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon flour made into a paste; stir into pan.
7. Replace chicken and heat through.
title: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and brown sugar. Stir in the eggs until everything is well blended. Stir in the baking soda , then gradually add the flour until the dough is thick. This may not require all 5 cups. Finally, stir in the walnuts and raisins. Drop by tablespoons onto unprepared cookie sheets.
3. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven. Cool on the baking sheets.
title: Russian Rocks Ii

steps: 1. In large bowl, beat together butter or margarine and cottage cheese til light and fluffy. Add flour until dough forms a ball.
2. Divide dough into 3 equal portions. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm.
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) and grease cookie sheets.
4. To Make Filling: Combine egg whites, nuts, water, and ground cinammon. Mix well and set aside.
5. On a floured surface roll 1 portion of dough into a 10 inch circle. Spread circle with 1/3 of the filling to within approximately 1/2 inch of the edge.

6. Cut circle into 24 pie-shaped wedges. Beginning at outer edge roll up each wedge tightly. Place point side down on cookie sheet 1 1/2 inches apart. Bake 13-15 minutes or until golden (be sure to watch carefully as these cookies burn easily).
7. Remove to rack to cool. Repeat process with each remaining portion of dough and filling.
title: Hungarian Kifli I

steps: 1. Mix and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Bake for 10 minutes at 300°.
3. Cool.
title: Polish Drumstick Torte

steps: 1. Cream the butter with the cottage cheese and sugar.
2. Sift the flour with the cinnamon and salt.
3. Combine both mixtures and mix well.
4. Chill thoroughly.
5. Pit the prunes, split into halves, and fill each half with a mixture of the nuts and honey.
6. Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut into rounds.
7. Place the filled prune-half on each round, bring the edges together, seal, and shape into an oblong.
8. This is the traditional shape for pyrizhky.
9. Place on a baking sheet, brush with melted butter, and make a slit on the top of each for the steam to escape.
10. Bake in a moderate over 350 degrees F.
11. for 15 to 20 minutes, or until delicately browned.
12. Yield: 40 pyrizhky.
title: Ukrainian Cheese Crust Pyrizhky

ingredients.text: 1/8 tsp. garlic salt or to taste

steps: 1. Shake cut up round steak in a bag with 3 tablespoons flour, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
2. Brown meat, onion and garlic salt in 2 tablespoons shortening in skillet.
title: Rosy Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in a large sauce pan over medium high heat.
2. Remove from pan, add olive oil, garlic, onions and mushrooms, saute till lightly browned.
3. Put ground beef back into pan and add Bullion, Sour cream and Cream.
4. Cook through till thickened.
5. Serve over egg noodles.
title: Ground Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Cream shortening and sugar together. Stir in salt, hot milk, beaten egg yolks, and flavoring. When lukewarm, add yeast to mixture. Let stand 5 minutes. Add flour, beating well. Knead down into bowl. The dough will be slightly sticky. Let rise 1 hour.
2. Cut off small balls of dough. Roll into rounds in your hands, and place on greased cookie sheets 2 inches apart. Let rise 15 minutes.
3. Make a depression into the center of each roll. Fill with fruit preserves.
4. Bake at 450 degrees F (230 degrees C) until brown. Watch carefully. Cool on wire racks.
title: Kolaches Ii

steps: 1. Tip all the ingredients into a large bowl, add 1-1½ tsp freshly ground black pepper, then scrunch it all together with your hands for 5 mins. You might want to wear gloves to avoid staining your skin with the beetroot juices.

2. Press the veg down in the bowl with your hands, then cover the surface and up the side of the bowl with a large sheet of compostable cling film or something reusable like a beeswax wrap. Now place another similar-sized bowl on top. Press down hard and add anything heavy (packs of rice or cans work well) to weigh it down so the juices rise to cover the surface. Cover again.
3. Leave to ferment at room temperature for at least five days, but for maximum flavour, leave for one-five weeks (until the bubbling subsides).

4. Check the sauerkraut. After a few days, you will see bubbles that have built up as it ferments. Give it a stir, then cover and weigh it down again as before. The cabbage will become increasingly sour the longer it’s fermented, so taste it now and again. When you like the flavour, transfer it to sterilised jars and keep chilled. Will keep chilled for up to six months.
title: Beetroot & red cabbage sauerkraut

steps: 1. Make a syrup of the vinegar, sugar and oil.
2. Cook until sugar is dissolved.
3. Drain sauerkraut; rinse in water and drain well. Add celery, peppers, onion and pimento to sauerkraut.
4. Pour syrup over all.
5. Mix together and refrigerate a day or two before serving.
6. Keep covered.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
8. It is a sweet-sour taste and very tasty.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add apple and onion and saute for 5 minutes.
2. Add cabbage and vinegar.
3. Sir together sugar and next 3 ingredients; sprinkle over cabbage.
4. Add wine; cover, reduce heat, and simmer, stirring often, 35 minutes. Yield:
5. 6 servings.
title: German-Style Red Cabbage

steps: 1. Shred cabbage.
2. Combine cabbage, onion and sugar.
3. Let stand for 1 hour.
4. Mix remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
5. Pour over cabbage mixture; cool.
6. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
title: German Cold Salad

ingredients.text: 2 Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
2 Tbsp. butter, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Remove core and cut cabbage into 1/4-inch thick slices.
2. In large saucepan, combine cabbage, onion, apples, wine, sugar, salt and pepper.
3. Cover; bring to a boil.
4. Lower heat and simmer 20 minutes, stirring 2 or 3 times.
5. Add butter and stir until melted. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Braised Red Cabbage(Serve With Sauerbraten)

ingredients.text: 6 medium potatoes, peeled, sliced and cooked

steps: 1. Place potatoes in large bowl; cook bacon in skillet to desired crispness.
2. Remove bacon; drain.
3. Reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings.
4. Add onion and celery; cook and stir until celery is tender.
5. Blend in flour.
6. Stir in dressing.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 3 c. cooked red potatoes, cooled and diced

steps: 1. In medium bowl, combine potatoes, celery and parsley.
2. In large nonstick skillet, cook diced bacon, removing and discarding fat as it accumulates in pan.
3. Add onion and saute until onion is crisp-tender.
4. In small bowl combine water, flour, vinegar, sugar and seasonings; stir into onion mixture.
5. Continue cooking over medium heat until mixture thickens.
6. Remove from heat.
7. Pour sauce over potatoes.
8. toss gently to combine.
9. Serve warm or at room temperature.
10. Serves 6.
title: German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices

steps: 1. Cook potatoes until tender.
2. Drain well.
3. Combine remaining ingredients except eggs in a saucepan.
4. Cook 20 minutes, stirring frequently.
5. Pour vinegar mixture over potatoes.
6. Add eggs and toss.
7. Serve immediately.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Saute bacon and onion until transparent.
2. Add vinegar, sugar, water, salt and pepper.
3. (Bacon should be cut into small crosswise strips before it is cooked.)
4. Mix cornstarch with water to thin paste and stir into other ingredients.
5. Stir until slightly thickened.
6. Add diced, cooked potatoes and serve warm.
7. Serves 6.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Dice or crumble bacon and reserve 2 tablespoons drippings.
3. Combine drippings with vinegar, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
4. Toss cabbage with onion, green pepper and celery.
5. Add dressing just before serving.
6. Garnish with bacon bits.
7. Serves 6.
title: German Bacon Slaw

steps: 1. Boil potatoes.
2. Cool slightly, peel and cut in 1/8-inch slices to make about 4 cups.
3. Cut bacon in small pieces and fry until crisp.
4. Drain on paper towel and set aside.
5. Reserve bacon grease. Stir flour, sugar and seasonings into bacon grease until smooth. Cook until bubbly.
6. Add water and vinegar to flour mixture.
7. Cook until mixture boils and thickens.
8. Add potatoes and bacon; stir gently so potatoes hold their shape.
9. Cover casserole and let stand until ready to serve.
10. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: (Hot) German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon and drain.
2. Reserve 4 tablespoons of fat to fry celery and onion.
3. Then add salt, flour, sugar, vinegar, pepper and water.
4. Bring this to a boil.
5. When thickened pour over potatoes and bacon bits and chopped hard-boiled eggs.
6. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
7. Serves 12.
8. Put in an 8 x 10-inch or 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
2. Remove and crumble bacon.
3. Drain skillet, reserving 3 tablespoons drippings.
4. Saute onions in reserved drippings in skillet until tender.
5. Stir in flour.
6. Add vinegar and water.
7. Cook until slightly thickened, stirring constantly.
8. Stir in sugar, salt and pepper.
9. Add potatoes and bacon; mix gently.
10. Cook just until heated through. Serve warm.
11. May add boiled eggs, if desired.
12. Yields 8 servings.
title: Low-Fat German Potato Salad

steps: 1. In 6 cups of water, simmer for 1 hour the next 6 ingredients. Add cabbage, ketchup, vinegar and sour cream; simmer 1 hour more. Add more water if needed.
2. Serve topped with sour cream.
3. Serves 6.
title: Polish Cabbage Soup Or Stew

steps: 1. In Dutch oven heat sliced kielbasa over low heat, about 10 minutes, to draw out fat.
2. Add onion and cook until tender.
3. Add cabbage and water.
4. Cover and cook 9 minutes until cabbage is barely tender.
5. Core and chop 3 apples.
6. Add apples and carrots. Mix sugar, vinegar and seasonings and pour over.
7. Cover and simmer for 1/2 hour.
8. The last 5 minutes, core and cut into wedges the last apple.
9. Heat in butter until barely soft.
10. Serve with apple wedges on top of kielbasa/cabbage mixture.
11. Serves 8.
title: Kielbasa Cabbage Pot

steps: 1. Boil potatoes in their skins until tender.
2. Drain well, peel and break up into small chunks with a wooden spoon.
3. In a skillet, saute onions
4. and
5. bacon
6. until browned.
7. Remove from heat and stir
8. in
9. the
10. remaining ingredients.
11. Pour over warm potatoes. Mix well and serve.
12. Makes 8 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Let stand 24 hours.
3. Makes 10 servings.
4. This is really tasty!
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Cover cabbage with boiling water.
2. Add onion and nutmeg.
3. Cook 20 minutes.
4. Drain off most of water.
5. Add butter, vinegar and sugar.
6. Cook 5 minutes longer.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: German Cabbage

steps: 1. Stir Tabasco into salad oil in large skillet.
2. Heat.
3. Add onion, thinly sliced potatoes and fry covered, turning occasionally until potatoes are tender and golden.
4. Sprinkle with salt.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: German Fried Potatoes

ingredients.text: 5 to 6 c. cooked, sliced potatoes (about 6 to 7 medium potatoes)

steps: 1. Fry bacon pieces.
2. Drain on paper towel.
3. Remove all but 1/4 cup bacon grease from skillet.
4. To grease, add onion, vinegar, sugar and pepper.
5. Cook over low heat, uncovered, until mixture simmers.
6. Pour over potato slices in bowl and toss gently to combine.
7. Season to taste with salt.
8. Garnish with bacon.
title: German Style Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cut bacon into 1 inch pieces.
2. Pan fry, slowly until almost cooked, add onion, and cook until transparent.
3. Stir in flour, sugar, salt, and paprika.
4. Pour in vinegar and water; cook until mixture thickens.
5. Pour in vinegar and water; cook until mixture thickens.
6. Pour mixture over potatoes and serve.
7. Serve hot.
title: German Potato Salad(Hot Potato Salad)

steps: 1. Boil the beans, and when almost done add the potatoes (peeled and diced).
2. When finished, add paprika, milk and butter.
3. Serve hot.
title: Lima Beans(Germany)

steps: 1. Drain sauerkraut but do not rinse.
2. Mix with chopped vegetables.
3. Prepare dressing and combine with vegetables.
4. Chill several hours.
5. Good with lasagna.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. To potatoes, add the oil and let stand 1/2 hour.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Stir and serve warm or cold.
title: German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 1 c. sugar (or sugar substitute to equal 1 c.)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and pour dressing over all. Let stand at least 4 hours.
2. Will keep in glass jars in refrigerator for 3 weeks.
title: German Coleslaw

steps: 1. Chop bacon.
2. Peel and cut
3. potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Place bacon and green onion in small bowl.
4. Cover and microwave on High until bacon is light brown, about 7 minutes.
5. Stir in vinegar, sugar and salt.
6. Set aside.
7. Place potato slices and water in 2-quart casserole.
8. Cover and microwave on High until potatoes are fork-tender.
9. Pour bacon and vinegar mixture over potatoes.
10. Toss to coat.
title: German Potato Salad(Microwave)

steps: 1. Boil potatoes with peel still on them until medium soft; let cool.
2. Fry bacon until crispy, crumble.
3. Cut up celery and onions. Boil eggs.
4. Peel the peel off of potatoes, smash up with hands. Add bacon, onions and celery.
5. Add salad dressing and vinegar. Peel shell off of eggs, smash with hands.
6. Mix and stir with hands. Salt and pepper to taste.
title: German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 1 pound Sausage, Poche's Pork (or Any Pork Sausage)

steps: 1. Boil potatoes and dice (about 4 medium).
2. Cook sausages by adding a small amount of oil and 1 cup of water to large skillet, then gently fry until done. Remove from skillet.
3. Scrape skillet to remove any stuck on bits (save bits), then fry bacon in same skillet until crisp. Remove from skillet and lay on paper towels to soak up grease.
4. Saute onions and celery in bacon drippings until soft.
5. Add salt, sugar, pepper, dry mustard, water, and apple cider vinegar. Boil for 2 minutes.
6. Crumble bacon then add it, the scraped sausage bits, potatoes, and mayonnaise to the mixture. Heat slowly on top of the stove.
7. Remove to a separate bowl, arrange sausages on top, and serve.
8. OR, you may place entire mixture (minus sausages) in baking dish and bake in a 300 degree oven for 20 minutes.
9. Can get Poche's sausage from www.cajungrocer.com
title: German Potato Salad With Cajun Sausage

steps: 1. Peel potatoes; cut into thin slices.
2. Cook bacon until crisp. Remove from pan.
3. Use as much of the bacon drippings as wanted and cook the onion for 1 minute.
4. Combine flour, sugar, salt and pepper; blend into onion.
5. Stir in water and vinegar; cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Add celery seed, parsley and bacon; toss lightly.
7. Serve warm.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Bring the sugar and vinegar to a boil; cook until sugar is dissolved.
2. Cool and mix all ingredients together.
3. Put in a quart jar and let marinate all night in the refrigerator.
4. Turn jar each day to mix.
5. This will keep for several weeks.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Mix cabbage, bell peppers and onions in bowl.
2. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients in saucepan.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Pour over cabbage mixture.
5. Chill for 24 hours or longer.
6. Yield: 12 cups.
title: German Coleslaw

steps: 1. Dice and cook potatoes.
2. Fry bacon and crumble.
3. Saute onions in bacon grease.
4. Beat eggs with the milk and salt.
5. Cook until almost done and add potatoes, bacon and cheese.
title: German Farmer'S Breakfast

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 tsp. paprika (maybe a little more later)

steps: 1. Fry bacon pieces.
2. Save about 1/3 cup drippings after removing bacon.
3. Add salt, pepper and paprika to onion.
4. Saute in drippings until tender.
5. Add potatoes and stir gently with onion.
6. Add 1 cup water and simmer on medium heat until potatoes are tender.
7. Add bacon and mix gently.
8. Simmer a little longer.
9. You may need to add another 1/4 cup of water.
10. This can be served alone or with eggs.
title: Hungarian Country Breakfast

steps: 1. Cook sausage and onions on medium heat until sausage is no longer pink.
2. In a medium size bowl beat eggs (add two tablespoons of milk if desired) then add to sausage.
3. Cook and scramble eggs until almost completely set.
4. Add cheese and stir until eggs are done and cheese is melted.
title: Breakfast Goulash

steps: 1. Beat eggs with water; season with salt and pepper. Set aside. Spray an 8-inch omelet pan or nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium heat.
2. Add potatoes to skillet. Heat until heated through. (Or microwave until heated through). Set aside.

3. Pour eggs into skillet. (Eggs should set immediately at edges). With an inverted pancake turner, carefully push cooked portions at edges toward center so uncooked portions can reach hot pan surface, tilting pan and moving cooked portions as necessary.
4. Spoon potatoes over half of the omelet. Spoon sour cream over the potatoes. Sprinkle green onions over the sour cream. Cook for about 30 seconds more. Slide from pan onto plate.
5. Top omelet with a dollop of sour cream and green onions if desired.
title: Russian Omelet

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook potatoes in 2 tablespoons butter for 15 minutes or until browned and tender. Sprinkle with onions; set aside and keep warm.
2. In a
3. , melt remaining butter over medium-high heat. Whisk the eggs and milk. Add egg mixture to skillet (mixture should set immediately at edges).

4. As eggs set, push cooked edges toward the center, letting uncooked portion flow underneath. When the eggs are set, spoon potato mixture on one side; fold other side over filling. Invert omelet onto a plate to serve. Cut into wedges and season as desired.
title: German Potato Omelet

steps: 1. wash the mushrooms and cut into slices.
2. in a pot add water ( about half way ) and when it starts to boil add the mushrooms.

3. cut the onion and the kelbasa into cubes ( if you do not have kelbasa, you can cut two hot dogs into small cubes ) and add the onion to a skillet. when the onion starts to become tender add the kelbasa and cook until the kelbasa becomes crispy.
4. drain the mushrooms after 10-15 min and add to the skillet.
5. add the eggs and cook everything together.
title: Scrambled Eggs With Mushrooms And Kielbasa

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. grated cheese (Cheddar, Colby or American)

steps: 1. Fry bacon crisp.
2. Crumble into small pieces.
3. Add green pepper, onion, potatoes, salt and pepper.
4. Cook over medium heat, about 5 minutes or until potatoes are golden brown.
5. Break eggs over potato mixture and cook until eggs are set.
title: German Farmers Breakfast

steps: 1. In large
2. skillet, saute bacon until crisp.
3. Remove and drain. Crumble.
4. Drain
5. off
6. all but 3 tablespoons drippings. Add green pepper,
7. onion,
8. potatoes,	salt and pepper.
9. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until golden.
10. Sprinkle cheese over mixture and stir until
11. melted.
12. Pour
13. eggs and cook over low heat until set. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: German Farmers Breakfast

steps: 1. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and saute til golden, 8-10 minutes.
3. Add mushrooms and paprika.
4. Cook, stirring occasionally til mushrooms start to wilt about 5 minutes.
5. Whisk egggs, salt and peppers in a small bowl.
6. Reduce heat to low.
7. Pour in the egg mixture over the top of veggies in the skillet.
8. Cook omelet slowly for about 10 minutes, or until done enough to flip over without running.
9. Flip and cook 3-4 minutes on the other side.
10. Cut omelet into wedge and serve with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkling of parsley and green onion.
title: Hungarian Omelet

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 160˚C (320˚F) Line a cake pan with parchment paper and set aside.
2. Mix all the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Place the milk in a small saucepan and heat it until it is almost boiling but not quite.

3. Pour the milk slowly into the dry ingredients while whisking. Don't overmix! As soon as it is combined to a smooth batter you pour it into the cake pan. Sprinkle the pearl sugar over the top and bake it in the oven for about 1 hour.
4. Check after about 50 minutes how the cake is progressing. If a cake tester comes out clean the cake it cooked. If not let it cook for a little longer.
title: Dutch Spiced Breakfast Cake (Ontbijtkoek)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup buckwheat flour, 2/3 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1 teaspoon yeast.
2. Make a well in the center and pour in 1 cup warm milk, whisking until the batter is smooth.
3. Cover the bowl and let the batter rise until doubled, about 1 hour.
4. Enrich and Rest the Batter
5. Stir 2 tablespoons melted butter and 1 egg yolk into the batter.
6. In a separate bowl, whisk 1 egg white until stiff, but not dry.
7. Fold the whisked egg white into the batter.
8. Cover the bowl and let the batter stand 20 minutes.
9. Pan-Fry the Blini
10. Heat butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
11. Drop quarter-sized dollops of batter into the pan, being careful not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for about 1 minute or until bubbles form.
12. Turn and cook for about 30 additional seconds.
13. Remove the finished blini onto a plate and cover them with a clean kitchen towel to keep warm. Add more butter to the pan and repeat the frying process with the remaining batter.
title: Blini Pancakes

steps: 1. Whip up eggs; add milk.
2. Sift sugar, salt and flour.
3. Mix all ingredients and fry.
4. Put sugar on and roll up.
5. Serves 4 people.
title: Eirkuchen(Pancakes)

steps: 1. Gradually add flour to eggs, beating with rotary beater.
2. Stir in milk, melted butter or margarine and salt.
3. Thoroughly grease a 9 or 10-inch ovenproof skillet.
4. Pour batter into cold skillet; bake in very hot oven (450°) for about 20 minutes.
5. Loosen pancake from skillet with wide spatula; cut into wedges.
6. Serve with syrup.
7. Makes 2 to 3 servings.
title: German Oven Pancake

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Beat eggs at high speed on electric mixer until thick and lemon colored. Beat in flour, 1 tablespoon sugar, salt and milk.
3. Using 1 tablespoon per pan, butter and preheat two 9-inch pie pans in hot oven.
4. Pour batter into pans and arrange apple slices on top.
5. Sprinkle with mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon.
6. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with maple syrup or sprinkle generously with powdered sugar.
7. Serves 4.
title: German Apple Pancakes

steps: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 300-F degrees.
2. Generously grease and lightly flour two loaf pans, and set aside.
3. In a large mixing bowl, prepare the batter: Cream the butter and sugar together with a hand-held mixer until light and creamy.
4. Add egg yolks, one at a time, and continue to beat the mixture after each additional yolk is incorporated.
5. Add the honey and sour cream and mix again.
6. Beat the eggs whites in a small mixing bowl until stiff peaks form.
7. Sift together the cake flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
8. Fold the flour mixture and the egg whites, ALTERNATING EACH MIXTURE (flour and then egg whites), into the cake batter.
9. Fold in the raisins and walnuts.
10. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pans.
11. Bake for 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean.
12. Remove the cakes from the pans and place on a wire rack to cool.
13. Slice and serve slightly warm.
14. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Ukrainian Christmas Honey Cake Medivnyk

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients well with eggbeater or mixer.
2. Heat flat, well seasoned griddle over medium-high heat.
3. Pour about 1 soup ladle full of batter onto hot griddle.
4. Run batter over entire surface of griddle by carefully tipping griddle.
5. When pancake surface is shiny, carefully lift to check for doneness and flip with a large turner.
6. Done when lightly browned on both sides. Serve with warmed syrup or powdered sugar and lemon wedges. Serves 6 to 8.
title: German Pancakes

steps: 1. Mix, but do not beat, ingredients.
2. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
3. Cover the dough thickly with fresh peeled apple slices.
4. Sprinkle the top with white sugar and cinnamon.
5. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
6. Serve warm.
7. Will serve 15.
title: Apple Kuchen

steps: 1. Combine sauerkraut and sugar.
2. Let stand for 30 minutes.
3. Cut sauerkraut with scissors.
4. Mix all ingredients.
5. Chill for 12 hours.
6. Makes 12 servings.
title: Sauerkraut Relish

steps: 1. Put all ingredients in blender.
2. Blend thoroughly.
3. Shake well before serving each time.
4. Let stand overnight before refrigerating.
title: Russian Dressing

steps: 1. Beat egg yolks until thick.
2. Add sugar and cream.
3. Beat until well blended.
4. Chill dough for easier handling.
5. Roll on lightly floured board.
6. Cut into 1 1/2-inch diamonds.
7. Make a slit in center of each diamond; slip one end through slit and pull gently to make a bow.
8. Fry in hot deep fat at 375°
9. until light brown. Drain.
10. When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.
title: Russian Angel Wings

steps: 1. Preheat oven 375 degrees.
2. Mix ingredients wet to dry.
3. If you plan on using a cookie press allow dough to sit at room temperature for at least an hour.
4. If you plan on rolling the dough and using cookie cutters start right away.
5. Bake for 9 minutes.
6. Allow the cookies to cool slightly on the pan before transferring to cooling rack.
title: German Butter Cookies

steps: 1. Mix thoroughly the butter and sugar.
2. Sift together the flour and salt and stir in.
3. Stir in nuts and form into 1-inch balls. Bake at 400° for 14 to 17 minutes, then roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.
title: Russian Tea Cookies

steps: 1. Cook milk, yolks, flour and oleo until thick.
2. Add vanilla, coconut and nuts.
3. Icing for box of German chocolate cake mix.
title: German Chocolate Cake Icing

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. sour cream (more or less) to taste

steps: 1. In a skillet, brown hamburger and onion. Drain, then return to skillet. Add mushrooms, garlic, salt and pepper; stir in flour. Add Worcestershire sauce, ketchup and chili powder. Mixture will be thick. Just before serving, blend in sour cream to taste. Combine with cooked noodles to serve.
title: Hamburger Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 c. sauerkraut, drained and cut up
1 c. (3 oz.) corned beef, finely cut up

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients, except 2 beaten eggs and 1/2 cup bread crumbs, and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer.
2. Heat oven to 400°. Shape the mixture into 1-inch balls.
3. Dip balls in 2 beaten eggs. Roll in 1/2 cup bread crumbs.
4. Bake on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes or until light brown.
5. Serve hot with mustard.
title: Sauerkraut Balls

steps: 1. Cream butter, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/4 teaspoon vanilla.
2. Blend in flour.
3. Spread on bottom and sides of 8-inch spring-form pan.
title: Bavarian Apple Torte

steps: 1. Cut pork into 2-inch pieces.
2. Add rest of ingredients; mix well.
3. Put in refrigerator at least overnight, mixing once in a while.
4. Add a little more water if needed.
5. Put into casings.
title: Fresh Kielbasa

steps: 1. For the rice, heat the oil in a large, lidded pan, add the onion, then gently fry for 5 mins until softened but not coloured. Add the spices, season with salt, then continue to fry until the mix start to go brown and fragrant; about 3 mins.

2. Add the rice and stir in well. Add 600ml water, stir, then bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer, then cover for 10 mins. Take off the heat and leave to stand, covered, for 10-15 mins more. The rice will be perfectly cooked if you do not lift the lid before the end of the cooking.

3. Meanwhile, put the haddock and bay leaves in a frying pan, cover with the milk, then poach for 10 mins until the flesh flakes. Remove from the milk, peel away the skin, then flake the flesh into thumbsize pieces. Place the eggs in a pan, cover with water, bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer. Leave for 4½-5 mins, plunge into cold water, then peel and cut the eggs into quarters. Gently mix the fish, eggs, parsley, coriander and rice together in the pan. Serve hot, sprinkled with a few extra herbs.
title: Kedgeree

steps: 1. In a large casserole, fry the sausages until brown all over – about 10 mins.
2. Add the tomato sauce, stirring well, then stir in the beans, treacle or sugar and mustard. Bring to the simmer, cover and cook for 30 mins. Great served with crusty bread or rice.
title: Bean & Sausage Hotpot

ingredients.text: 1 small head cabbage (about 1 lb.), cored and shredded

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, cook the potatoes in boiling water, salted, for 30 to 40 minutes, or until tender.
2. While the potatoes are cooking, cook the cabbage in a saucepan in a small amount of boiling water for 5 to 7 minutes, or until tender, and drain very well.
3. Drain the potatoes well, then peel and mash them with enough of the milk to make a soft consistency.
4. Stir the cabbage into the potatoes, then season with salt and pepper.
5. Spoon the colcannon into a serving dish; make a hollow in the center and put the butter in the hollow to melt slowly into the mixture.
6. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Colcannon

ingredients.text: 2 celery stalks, cut into inch pieces
6 medium carrots, scraped and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine
2. flour,
3. salt,	pepper and glutamate in a bowl. Coat meat with flour mixture.
4. Melt butter; add meat, browned. Add water, celery and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and
5. simmer
6. for
9. hours or until meat is almost tender. Add remaining ingredients.	Continue cooking 1/2 hour or
10. until meat
11. and
12. vegetables
13. are	tender.
14. Yield:
15. 6 to 8 servings.
title: Old Fashioned Irish Stew

steps: 1. In a 2 quart saucepan over low heat, melt the butter. Stir in and blend the flour, salt, mustard and pepper. Stir in the milk and Worcestershire sauce. Continue stirring the mixture for 10 minutes, or until thickened.
2. Stirring continuously, melt the cheese into the mixture and blend well. Serve immediately over warm toast.
title: Welsh Rabbit

steps: 1. Stir together flours, oats, sugar, baking powder and salt.
2. Add melted butter, raisins (if using) and water, adding more water if needed to make sticky dough.
3. With floured hands, pat into greased pie plate.
4. Bake in 400F oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned and tester comes out clean.
5. Cut into wedges.
title: Scottish Bannock

steps: 1. Cut the rind off 3 oranges, cutting in fine shreds with no pith. I take all pulp off, no skins or pith; add the rinds.
2. Cook in water and sugar.
3. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to simmer.
4. Simmer for about 20 minutes.
5. Add orange juice.
6. Cook 20 minutes until sticky.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Add whiskey.
9. Let rest for 15 minutes before pouring into hot sterile jars.
10. Seal.
title: Irish Mist Marmalade

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450F and grease a baking sheet.
2. Melt the butter, syrup and sugar over a gentle heat and then stir in the flour, ginger and brandy.
3. Keep stirring for about five minutes.
4. Drop small teaspoonsfuls onto the baking sheet, keeping them well apart.
5. Bake for five minutes or until they are a pale golden brown.
6. Using the greased handle of a large wooden spoon, roll the wafers round the handle while they are still hot- take care not to burn yourself!
7. Allow to cool before use.
title: Traditional Scottish Brandy Wafers

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium head cabbage, cored, cut in wedges

steps: 1. Cook and mash potatoes, adding milk to them.
2. Steam cabbage. Drain and chop fine.
3. Combine potato mixture and cabbage.
4. Season to taste.
title: Bubble And Squeak

ingredients.text: 1 3/4 c. whiskey, rum, bourbon or scotch

steps: 1. Put in blender.
2. Store in refrigerator for a month.
3. Stir before serving.
title: Homemade Irish Cream Liquor

steps: 1. Mix together flour, sugar and oats.
2. Work in margarine until mixture is crumbly.
3. Press 1/2 of mixture evenly into bottom of a greased pan.
4. Spread with jam.
5. Press remaining mixture over jam, covering it completely.
6. Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 40 minutes.
7. Cool and cut in squares.
title: English Matrimonials

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Roll crust thin (use pastry recipe Cream Cheese Pastry).
3. Place 1/2 tablespoon mixture in center of pastry. Fold into a roll.
4. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
5. Makes 115 small rolls.
title: Cornish Pastries

steps: 1. Cream butter and confectioners sugar.
2. Add dry ingredients. Work with hands to mix.
3. Add nuts.
4. Chill.
5. form into balls. Place on lightly greased pan and bake at 400° for 10 minutes. While warm, roll in confectioners sugar.
6. When cold, roll again in confectioners sugar.
7. Yields 50 cookies.
title: English Teaballs

steps: 1. Cream shortening and sugar.
2. Beat in eggs.
3. Add sifted dry ingredients and buttermilk.
4. Mix well.
5. Pour batter over nuts and fruit and mix thoroughly.
6. Drop from teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
7. These keep well and can be frozen.
8. Makes a lot but are delicious.
title: English Rocks

steps: 1. Place flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl and mix well.
2. Beat milk, eggs, and melted butter together in another bowl; stir into the flour mixture with a few strokes. Handle dough as little as possible.
3. Scrape the dough out onto a generously floured surface. Dip your fingers in flour and pat dough into a circle about 1/2-inch thick. Cut into 4-inch rounds to form the scrumpets.

4. Melt butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Frying pan should be greased very lightly, preferably with butter. Fill pan with some scrumpets and immediately reduce heat to medium. Cook for 5 minutes. Turn, lower the heat, and cook for 5 minutes more. Cook remaining scrumpets and serve warm.
title: Scrumpets

steps: 1. Brush mixture on hens while grilling for a delicious lemon flavor.
title: Lemon Herb Baste For Cornish Hens

ingredients.text: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
8 ounces parsnips, peeled and thinly sliced
1/2 medium cabbage, finely shredded (coarse outer leaves removed and reserved)

steps: 1. Arrange 1/3 of potatoes over bottom of heavy medium saucepan.
2. Layer on 1/3 of parsnips, 1/3 of onions, and 1/3 of shredded cabbage; repeat layers twice more.
3. Pour in water, cover tightly with reserved cabbage leaves.
4. Cover and simmer until vegetables are very tender, about 1 hour; discard whole cabbage leaves.
5. Drain mixture in a large sieve or small-holed colander; return vegetables to saucepan.
6. Add butter, salt and pepper.
7. Mash until fluffy, adding milk if dry.
title: Colcannon

ingredients.text: 5 lb. meat, cut small (beef stew or chuck roast)

steps: 1. For dough, mix first 3 ingredients.
2. Mix well.
3. Add water and mix as little as necessary and use as little flour as you can when rolling out the dough.
4. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes until crust is golden brown.
5. Make a small slit in the top of each pastie.
6. When you remove from oven, put a little water oleo mixture into slit (1 teaspoon oleo and 1/2 teaspoon water for each pastie).
7. Let sit for a few minutes.
title: Marilyn'S English Pasties

steps: 1. Mix 3/4 cup flour in bowl with yeast and warm water. Blend until smooth, cover and leave until frothy, about 20 minutes.
2. Gradually stir other ingredients, beating until smooth. You should have a mixture like pancakes, or just a bit thicker. Add flour or water as necessary.
3. Heat a non-stick surface to med/med-high and put non-stick egg rings on surface to heat thoroughly.
4. Pour batter into rings, so it's about 1/2 in deep. Cook until dry on top, about 10 minutes.
5. Remove rings and turn crumpet over to brown on top. Cool on wire rack.
title: Whole Wheat Crumpets

steps: 1. Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Cut butter into flour mixture with pastry cutter. Add buttermilk until dough is soft. Stir in currants.

2. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead for 5 minutes, or until smooth. Form dough into a 7 inch round. Place on a lightly oiled cake pan or cookie sheet. Cut 1/2 inch deep cross side to side. Score with cross 1/2 inch deep on the top.
3. Bake in a preheated 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) oven for 40 minutes.
title: Irish Bannock

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and cook in double boiler stirring frequently until thick.
2. Serve in tart shells or as a filling for layer cakes, or as a spread on toast, biscuits or bread.
title: English Lemon Cheese

steps: 1. Measure flour and salt into bowl.
2. Mix in shortening. Sprinkle in water 1 tablespoon at a time until flour is moistened and dough almost clears side of bowl (1 to 2 teaspoons water can be added if needed).
3. Roll out dough and cut into round circles.
title: Cornish Pasties

steps: 1. Mix together flour and salt.
2. Combine baking soda, vinegar and water.
3. Stir vinegar mixture and water into flour mixture; beat until smooth.
4. Dip fish into mixture allowing excess batter to drip back in bowl.
5. Fry in preheated oil until medium brown. Drain on paper towels.
6. This batter may be used on boneless chicken breasts and various vegetables.
title: Fish Batter(English Pub Style)

steps: 1. Chop fruits and nuts; mix all ingredients well and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
2. Bake at 350° until browned.
title: English Rocks

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar until light.
2. Beat eggs.
3. Add sifted dry ingredients and milk; mix well.
4. Pour batter over nuts and fruit; mix thoroughly.
5. Drop from teaspoon on cookie sheet.
6. Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: English Rocks

steps: 1. Sift flour, soda and salt into a bowl.
2. Make a well in the center and pour in buttermilk.
3. Mix to a rough dough with a fork. Turn out onto lightly floured working surface.
4. Knead lightly. Pat out to a circle and using a floured knife, cut into pie shaped wedges, about 8.
5. Preheat griddle or heavy skillet.
6. Place dough on it and bake slowly for about 5 minutes on each side. Serve with butter.
title: Irish Griddle Soda Farl

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice, eggs, butter, sugar, and lemon zest in a 2-quart saucepan; cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until curd is thick and just beginning to boil, about 8 minutes.
2. Remove curd from heat and cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally to keep the surface soft, about 30 minutes. Pour curd into clean jars, seal, and store in the refrigerator.
title: English Lemon Curd

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 inch chunks

steps: 1. Place potatoes with cold water to cover by 2 inches and 1/2 tsp salt in large saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
3. Add cabbage and boil for 10 more minutes until potatoes are tender.
4. Meanwhile, place green onion in sieve, pour boiling water over them and drain.
5. Add drained onion to a medium saucepan with milk, butter, remaining 1/2 tsp salt and pepper, bring to a boil then remove from heat.
6. Drain cooked potatoes and cabbage and return to large saucepan.
7. Beat on low speed with hand held mixer until coarsely mashed.
8. Increase speed to high and gradually add milk and onion mixture and continue to beat until potatoes are light and fluffy.
title: Colcannon

steps: 1. Brown sausage in 10-inch ovenproof skillet.
2. Do not drain. Keep hot.
3. In bowl, beat 2 minutes.
4. Add flour, milk and salt. Beat until smooth.
5. Stir in chives.
6. Pour over sausage.
7. Bake 15 minutes at 400°.
8. Lower oven to 350°.
9. Bake 5 to 10 minutes until brown.
title: Yorkshire Sausage

steps: 1. Put in blender and beat until mixed.
2. Keep refrigerated.
title: Irish Cream

steps: 1. In large bowl, beat egg yolks until thick.
2. Gradually add granulated sugar, beating until light.
3. Add cream, beating until very well combined.
4. Slowly stir in cognac and rum.
5. Refrigerate, covered, until well chilled.
6. About 1 hour before serving, beat egg whites until foamy.
7. Gradually add confectioners sugar, beating well after each addition; continue beating until soft peaks form when beater is slowly raised.
8. Gently fold into egg yolk mixture.
9. Refrigerate, covered, until serving time.
10. Makes about 28 (4 ounce) servings.
11. Good without the liquor, too.
title: Old English Egg Nog

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in blender. Bottle and refrigerate. Stir each time before using. No waiting. Can be served as soon as it's chilled.
title: Irish Cream

steps: 1. Brown hamburger, onion, celery and salt.
2. Add remaining ingredients and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
3. Bake in casserole, uncovered.
title: Yorkshire Dinner

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients.
2. Store in dark bottle in refrigerator at least overnight before drinking.
3. Makes approximately 1 quart.
title: Irish Creme

steps: 1. Blend 3 to 5 minutes in blender.
2. Keep in fridge.
title: Irish Cream

ingredients.text: 4 eggs, beaten or 8 ounces packages Egg Beaters egg substitute (pasteurized eggs)
1 cup whiskey (please use a good brand; I use Maker's Mark or Knob Creek)

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients together and chill.
2. Serve over ice, or in coffee.
3. Refrigerate leftovers (in the unlikely event that there will be any--).
title: Fabulous Faux Bailey'S Irish Cream

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lb. potatoes, peeled and cut into large cubes
1 lb. rutabaga, peeled and cut into large cubes

steps: 1. Cook potatoes and rutabagas in lightly salted water until tender, about 25 minutes. In meantime, blanch cabbage in boiling water for 4 minutes; drain. When potatoes and rutabagas are done, drain and return to pan. Shake over low heat until they are dry. Mash potatoes and rutabagas in 4 tablespoons butter and 1/3 cup half and half. Add more half and half if necessary to make a thick smooth puree. Season with salt and pepper. Melt 2 tablespoons of the remaining butter in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Add cabbage and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes. Stir in mashed potatoes and scallions. Dot top with remaining butter and bake in preheated oven at 350° for 15 minutes.
2. Serve immediately.
title: Colcannon

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly butter a baking pan.

2. Combine butter, sugar, and golden syrup in a saucepan over low heat. Mix until butter has melted and sugar has dissolved. Remove from heat. Add 2 cups oats and raisins. Mix until oats are well coated. Pour mixture into the prepared pan; flatten down with the back of a spoon.
3. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown on top, 10 to 20 minutes. Let flapjack cool.
4. Melt chocolate in a microwave-safe glass or ceramic bowl in 15-second intervals, stirring after each interval, 1 to 3 minutes. Pour over the cooled flapjack. Let cool until chocolate is set.
title: Simple British Flapjack

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley

steps: 1. Heat half the oil in a Dutch oven on high heat. Cook lamb, in batches, until browned. Remove from pan.

2. Heat remaining oil in same pan. Cook onion, carrots, celery and garlic, stirring, until softened. Return lamb to pan with stock, barley, thyme and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, for 1 hour, skimming fat from surface occasionally.
3. Add potatoes; simmer, uncovered, for 30 mins, or until potatoes are tender. Add cabbage; simmer, uncovered, until cabbage is just tender. Discard thyme. Serve stew sprinkled with parsley.
title: Irish Lamb And Barley Stew

ingredients.text: 2 None sheets puff pastry, thawed if frozen

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine ground beef, 1/2 onion, egg and tomato sauce. Season to taste. Shape into 1 1/2 x 3 inch patties.
2. Heat oil in a medium frying pan on high. Cook patties for 4-5 mins each side, until well browned. Drain on paper towel.

3. Melt butter in same pan on medium. Saute remaining onion and garlic for 2-3 mins, until tender. Add mushrooms and saute for 5-6 mins, stirring until tender. Mix in Worcestershire sauce. Allow to cool.

4. Cut 1 1/2 x 4 inch rounds from 1 pastry sheet. Place on baking sheet. Top each with a meat patty and mushroom mixture. Cut the other sheet into quarters; brush edges with milk. Cover patty, pressing around base to seal.
5. Score tops and brush with milk. Bake for 25-30 mins, until pastry is puffed and golden.
title: Easy Beef Wellington

ingredients.text: 9 ounces grated cheese (Chesire, Lancashire or Smoked Applewood Cheddar, latter is really good)

steps: 1. Heat the cheese, beer and butter over low heat, stirring, until it melts.
2. Add mustard and a splash of Worcestershire sauce.
3. Meanwhile, be toasting bread.
4. Pour sauce over toast and serve.
title: Scottish (Or English) Rarebit

ingredients.text: 1 Cornish game hen, thawed and giblets removed
1/2 cup frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
2. Season hen with salt and black pepper; place in a roasting pan.
3. Roast hen in the preheated oven until partially cooked, 25 to 30 minutes.
4. Mix orange juice concentrate, honey, and ketchup in a saucepan; bring to a boil and cook until syrup consistency, 5 to 10 minutes.

5. Baste hen with orange glaze; continue roasting, basting every ten minutes, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone reads 180 degrees F (82 degrees C), 35 to 40 more minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Orange Cornish Hen For Two

steps: 1. Cover lamb with boiling water and simmer for 1 hour, covered. Add carrots, celery, turnips, cubed potatoes, onion and seasonings. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
2. Add sliced potatoes, simmer another 30 minutes.
3. Serve with crusty bread.
4. Yields 4 servings.
title: Irish Stew(Celtic)

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. Brown beef in shortening in Dutch oven. Arrange vegetables around meat.
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top meat with apricots and mushrooms.
4. Pour catsup over all. Cover and bake 2 1/2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.
5. Baste occasionally.
6. Add a little water if needed.
7. Makes 6 to 9 servings.
title: Scottish Pot Roast

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, or as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add oil. Cook stew meat until browned on all side, 5 to 10 minutes.
2. Transfer browned meat to the insert of a slow cooker. Add potatoes, onion, water, bouillon cubes, salt, and pepper.
3. Cover and cook on Low power for 8 hours.
title: Simple Slow Cooker Irish Stew

steps: 1. Brown the sausage in a skillet.
2. Remove from pan to a bowl, then add the onion to the sausage drippings and cook till limp.
3. Add the onion to the meat; mix well and spread in a buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole.
4. Layer the cabbage on top, salting to taste.
5. To make the white sauce, melt the butter in a heavy saucepan; stir in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, until the paste is thick and bubbling, but not brown, about 2 minutes.
6. Add the hot milk, continuing to stir as the sauce thickens.
7. Bring to a boil; add salt and pepper to taste, lower the heat and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes more.
8. Pour sauce over cabbage and top with the bread crumbs.
9. Bake 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees F till bubbling and hot.
title: Bubble And Squeak

steps: 1. Grease 6 x 10-inch casserole dish.
2. Cover bottom of dish with 1 cup cracker crumbs.
3. Layer peas over crackers; layer with slices of cheese.
4. Dot with butter.
5. Add undiluted soup and onions. Layer again with slices of cheese and top with 1 cup cracker crumbs.
6. Dot with butter.
7. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: English Pea Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Remove and discard the giblets and necks from hens. Rinse hens with cold water; pat dry.

3. Starting at neck cavity, loosen skin from breast by inserting fingers, gently pushing between skin and meat. Combine salt and pepper; rub under loosened skin. Insert 2 thyme sprigs and 2 garlic halves under loosened skin of each hen. Lift wing tips up and over backs; tuck under hens.
