4. Place the hens, breast sides up, in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Pour white wine over hens.
5. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until a thermometer registers 180°, basting occasionally with wine. Let stand for 5 minutes. Discard skin.
title: Roasted Cornish Hens

steps: 1. Mix well in blender.
2. Store in refrigerator.
title: Irish Creme

ingredients.text: 3 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
3 lbs boiling potatoes, peeled and quartered
1 lb carrot, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
6 stalks celery, trimmed and ribs cut into 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a 7 to 8-quart kettle simmer lamb, parsley, thyme, and salt and pepper to taste in 4 cups broth, covered, 1 1/2 hours.
2. To lamb mixture add potatoes, onion, carrots, celery, and remaining 2 cups broth and simmer, covered, 1 hour.
3. In a small bowl whisk together flour and oil until smooth and stir into simmering stew until well incorporated.
4. Simmer stew, uncovered, until thickened, 3 to 5 minutes, and season with salt and pepper.
title: Traditional Irish Stew The Bailey

steps: 1. Place corned beef in large pot or Dutch oven and cover with water. Add the spice packet that came with the corned beef. Cover pot and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Simmer approximately 50 minutes per pound or until tender.
2. Add whole potatoes and peeled and cut carrots, and cook until the vegetables are almost tender. Add cabbage and cook for 15 more minutes. Remove meat and let rest 15 minutes.
3. Place vegetables in a bowl and cover. Add as much broth (cooking liquid reserved in the Dutch oven or large pot) as you want. Slice meat across the grain.
title: Corned Beef and Cabbage

steps: 1. Put the oil, onions, celery, carrots, potatoes and bay leaves in a big casserole dish, or two saucepans. Fry gently until the onions are softened – about 10-15 mins. Fill the kettle and boil it.

2. Stir in the tomato purée, sugar, vinegar, chopped tomatoes and passata, then crumble in the stock cubes. Add 1 litre boiling water and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 15 mins until the potato is tender, then remove the bay leaves. Purée with a stick blender (or ladle into a blender in batches) until very smooth. Season to taste and add a pinch more sugar if it needs it. The soup can now be cooled and chilled for up to 2 days, or frozen for up to 3 months.
3. To serve, reheat the soup, stirring in the milk – try not to let it boil. Serve in small bowls with cheesy sausage rolls.
title: Creamy Tomato Soup

steps: 1. Slice potatoes into 1/2-inch strips and cover with water. Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Put mixture into small bag.
3. Remove potatoes from water, but do not blot.
4. Drop a few slices at a time into the bag and shake.
5. Deep fry until golden brown.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Fried Irish Potatoes

steps: 1. Peel and cut potatoes.
2. Cook approximately 30 minutes.
3. Drain and mash with a mixer.
4. Add other ingredients and mix well.
5. Put in 2-quart dish.
6. Refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

ingredients.text: 6 cooked potatoes, mashed or 4 cups instant mashed potatoes

steps: 1. Put cabbage, onion, and water in saucepan.
2. Bring to boil over high heat and reduce to simmer, cover and cook for 8 minutes or until tender, but not mushy.
3. Drain cabbage and onion.
4. Add mashed potatoes, milk, butter and salt and pepper to taste.
5. Mix well to blend and heat through.
6. Serve warm, as a side dish with meat, chicken or fish.
title: Colcannon (Mashed Potatoes With Cabbage)

steps: 1. Mix thoroughly by hand, ball and roll in cinnamon.
title: Irish Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 ounces sun-dried tomatoes, soaked and chopped

steps: 1. Cook the potatoes 10 minutes in a large pan with enough water to cover; add the beans and cook 7 minutes more.
2. Remove to a large bowl.
3. Add the onions, cucumber, and half of the cheese and tomatoes to the potatoes and the beans and toss the salad.
4. Mix the mayonnaise, mustard and honey and pour over the salad.
5. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and mint leaves. Add a little salt and pepper if you wish.
6. Serve and enjoy!
title: English Garden Salad

steps: 1. Combine asparagus, peas, eggs and soup.
2. Place in casserole dish and cover with grated cheese.
3. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
title: Asparagus-English Pea Casserole

steps: 1. Start with a layer of peas, then cheese and pimentos, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
2. Mix 1/4 cup water with flour and pour over the mixture.
3. Bake in moderate oven about 30 minutes.
title: English Peas (Scalloped)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Chill for 1 hour.
title: Shepherd'S Salad

steps: 1. Sprinkle the sugar on the coconut. Add the cream and mix gently.
2. Take approximately 1/2 tablespoon of dough and roll into balls. Place cinnamon in a plastic bag and shake cookies a few at a time until coated.
title: Irish Potatoes

steps: 1. In casserole dish, place half of the potatoes, half the cheese and 1/2 the margarine.
2. Then add remaining potatoes, cheese and margarine.
3. Top with soup.
4. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup half-and-half cream, or more if needed

steps: 1. Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain.
2. Mash potatoes with a potato masher or an electric mixer on Low in a bowl until smooth.
3. Heat butter and half-and-half in a small saucepan over medium heat until butter is melted and half-and-half is warmed, 3 to 5 minutes.

4. Mash or beat butter mixture, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder into mashed potatoes until potatoes are light and fluffy. Stir additional half-and-half, 1 tablespoon at a time, into potatoes for creamier consistency.
title: Natalie'S Amazing Irish Mashed Potatoes

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet, add onions ginger& salt.
2. Stir fry over medium heat 2-3 minutes.
3. Add 1 cup water and cauliflower, cover and steam 2 minutes.
4. Add broccoli and continue steaming 2 minutes.
5. Add lemon juice just before serving.
6. Sprinkle with the lemon zest& serve immediately.
title: Irish Lemon Cauliflower & Broccoli

steps: 1. Boil potatoes and beat cream cheese until smooth.
2. Add potatoes; beat them.
3. Add sour cream, margarine, garlic and salt; pour into a buttered casserole dish.
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Saute bacon.
2. Add potatoes, onion, marjoram and beef stock. Cook 25 minutes.
3. Add leeks, carrots and celery.
4. Simmer 10 minutes.
5. Add cream.
6. Cook 5 minutes.
7. Season.
8. Garnish with parsley.
title: Irish Potato Soup

ingredients.text: 8 to 10 medium potatoes, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Mash potatoes, adding milk to desired consistency; add ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into buttered/sprayed 2-quart dish. Sprinkle paprika on top. Refrigerate overnight. Remove casserole from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Cook until potatoes are done.
2. Roll out dough according to directions from Bisquick box.
3. Mix and add thin strips to potato mixture.
4. Boil gently a minute or two and turn off heat.
5. Place a lid on the pot and let steam for a few minutes.
6. Use a larger pot (about a 4-quart size one).
7. Serve with Cheddar cheese and goldfish crackers.
title: Irish Potato Soup

ingredients.text: 2 lbs skinless cod fish fillets, making sure all bones are removed

steps: 1. Place cod fillets in the bottom of a 8x8x2 buttered oven dish.Place dish on a cookie sheet pan because there will be sauce that escapes and runs down the outside of the casserole dish.
2. Make a cheese sauce by mixing 2 oz each of butter and flour, 1/2 liter of milk and 3 1/2 oz grated cheese cook till slightly thickened: pour over fish.
3. Top with mashed potatoes sprinkle grated cheese over them and dot with butter.
4. Bake in a hot oven (450 F) for 25-30 minutes, until the potatoes are golden brown.
5. Optional -- I just made this again and put in 2 sliced scallions into the cheese sauce after it was cooked{step #2}.Garnish with scallions.
6. Optional -- 1/2- 1 cup peeled and deviened Shrimp added unto the fish gives some added flavor as well!
title: Irish Cod Pie Topped With Mashed Potatoes

steps: 1. Chop onions and boil until tender in small amount of water. Mash tomatoes with juice and add to onions and water; mix.
2. Bring to low simmer and add American cheese until it breaks into small particles throughout.
3. Leftovers will thicken in refrigerator and are fabulous eaten warmed over buttered toast.
title: Grammpa'S Scottish Soup

steps: 1. Cook potatoes and mash.
2. Beat cream cheese in mixer until smooth.
3. Add potatoes and rest of ingredients and beat until well mixed.
4. Spoon into buttered casserole.
5. Cover.
6. Refrigerate overnight.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except cinnamon until smooth
2. Refrigerate until a bit chilled - allows for shaping
3. Hand roll into either balls or ovals that resemble potatoes.
4. Shake or roll in cinnamon to coat
5. Keep in refrigerator or cool place
title: Irish Potato Confection Balls

steps: 1. Into a baking dish, put a layer of thin sliced potatoes, salt, pepper and dots of butter.
2. Add a layer of thin sliced onions. Cover these with dots of butter, salt and pepper.
3. Repeat until all potatoes and onions are used.
4. Pour enough milk over potatoes and onions to cover them.
5. Cook in a moderate oven until potatoes are well browned.
6. These proportions may be varied according to the size of the casserole.
7. Serves 6.
title: Scalloped Irish Potatoes And Onions

steps: 1. Mix all together; put on top of lettuce.
title: English Pea Salad

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and onion.
2. Chop in large pieces.
3. Cover with water in saucepan; boil until soft.
4. Cool slightly; put through food processor or blender.
5. Return to saucepan with milk; bring to boil.
6. Season to taste.
7. Add the butter.
8. Serves 6.
9. Serve sprinkled with parsley, if desired.
title: Irish Potato Soup

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a roasting pan with foil.
2. Melt the butter and stir in 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper, sage, onion, and celery. Cook until the veggies are soft, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook 3 minutes.
3. Stir in the stuffing and 1/4 cup water. Stir until absorbed and cool for 10 minutes.
4. Sprinkle the hens with the remaining salt and pepper. Fill the cavities of the hens with the stuffing and truss.
5. Roast until the meat thermometer in the thigh reads 180 degrees, about an hour and 15 minutes.
title: Cornish Game Hens With Sage Stuffing

steps: 1. Squeeze any water out of the grated potatoes and place on a paper towel.
2. Heat the oil and unsalted butter and cook the onions until they start to clarify.
3. Spread the potatoes over the top and mix slightly. Cook until they are brown on the bottom.
4. Turn potatoes over and brown the other side.
5. Serve.
title: Irish Pan-Fried Shredded Potatoes

steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients and blend well.
2. Chill until served.
3. Serve on a bed of lettuce.
title: English Pea Salad

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients, except corn flakes and oleo.
2. Melt oleo and add corn flakes.
3. Sprinkle on casserole and bake in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.
title: Irish Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
2. Bring to a boil and pour over vegetables.
3. Cover and chill 24 hours.
title: English Pea Salad

steps: 1. Mix mayonnaise, salt, pepper and onion.
2. Add peas, cheese and diced eggs.
3. Stir gently.
4. Refrigerate.
title: English Pea Salad

steps: 1. Before you start, put your oven on its lowest setting, ready to keep things warm. Peel the potatoes, grate 2 of them, then set aside. Cut the other 2 into large chunks, then boil for 10-15 mins or until tender. Meanwhile, squeeze as much of the liquid from the grated potatoes as you can using a clean tea towel. Mash the boiled potatoes, then mix with the grated potato, spring onions and flour.
2. Whisk the egg white in a large bowl until it holds soft peaks. Fold in the buttermilk, then add the bicarbonate of soda. Fold into the potato mix.

3. Heat a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat, then add 1 tbsp butter and some of the oil. Drop 3-4 spoonfuls of the potato mixture into the pan, then gently cook for 3-5 mins on each side until golden and crusty. Keep warm on a plate in the oven while you cook the next batch, adding more butter and oil to the pan before you do so. You will get 16 crumpet-size boxty from the mix. Can be made the day ahead, drained on kitchen paper, then reheated in a low oven for 20 mins.

4. Heat the grill to medium and put the tomatoes in a heavy-based pan. Add a good knob of butter and a little oil, then fry for about 5 mins until softened. Grill the bacon, then pile onto a plate and keep warm. Stack up the boxty, bacon and egg, and serve the tomatoes on the side.
title: Boxty Breakfast

steps: 1. Combine water, oatmeal and salt in saucepan.
2. Bring to boil. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
3. Serve with granulated raw sugar (available in grocery stores) and milk.
title: Irish Porridge

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons Irish whiskey (don't have it so i leave it out)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in crock pot.
2. Cook on low for 8 hours.
title: Crockpot Irish Oatmeal

ingredients.text: Oil, For The Skillet Or Griddle

steps: 1. Lighly oil a skillet or griddle over medium heat. Whisk together Irish cream, egg, and milk until incorporated very well. One slice at a time, dunk bread in mixture on both sides until coated. Place on hot pan. Cook for about 3 minutes until golden brown and then flip. Cook for additional 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
title: Irish French Toast

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 180C/350F/Gas 4 and line a baking tray with baking parchment.
2. Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder in a bowl and rub in the cubed butter until the mixture looks like breadcrumbs, then mix in the dried fruit.
3. In a clean bowl, beat the egg and milk together with the vanilla extract.

4. Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir with a spoon until the mixture just comes together as a thick, lumpy dough. Add a teaspoon more milk if you really need it to make the mixture stick together.
5. Place golfball-sized spoons of the mixture onto the prepared baking tray. Leave space between them as they will flatten and spread out to double their size during baking.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, until golden-brown. Remove from the oven, allow to cool for a couple of minutes then turn them out onto a wire rack to cool.
title: Rock Cakes

steps: 1. Peel the oranges using a sharp knife, ensuring all the pith is removed. Slice as thinly as possible and arrange over a dinner plate. Sprinkle with the demerara sugar followed by the Grand Marnier and set aside.
2. Crumble the Christmas pudding into large pieces and scatter over the bottom of a trifle bowl. Lift the oranges onto the pudding in a layer and pour over any juices.
3. Beat the mascarpone until smooth, then stir in the custard. Spoon the mixture over the top of the oranges.
4. Lightly whip the cream and spoon over the custard. Sprinkle with the flaked almonds and grated chocolate. You can make this a day in advance if you like, chill until ready to serve.
title: Christmas Pudding Trifle

steps: 1. Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar together.
2. Add caraway seed and raisins.
3. Stir in buttermilk to make a soft dough.
4. Knead dough on a lightly floured board for about 1 minute, then shape it into a round loaf and put it into an 8-inch greased round pan.
5. Pat flour lightly over the top surface, then cut crosswise into the top.
6. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 minutes or until done.
7. Bread should have a hollow sound when tapped.
8. Makes 8 servings.
9. (For heart patients.)
title: Sweet Irish Soda Bread

steps: 1. Sift together flour and sugar.
2. Fold in butter.
3. Place in a 9-inch round tin.
4. Pat down; poke with a fork.
5. Bake at 350° until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes.
6. Cut when hot.
7. Cool on baking rack.
8. Serves 8.
title: Scottish Shortbread

steps: 1. Mix together sugar and butter.
2. Stir in chocolate and mashed potatoes.
3. Mix in flour, baking powder and salt.
4. Stir in buttermilk, walnuts, spices and vanilla.
5. Beat egg whites and fold into mixture.
6. Pour mixture into baking pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
7. Let cool.
8. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Ola'S Irish Potato Cake

steps: 1. Cook ground beef in margarine and onion powder until brown. Mix in broth, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper.
2. Pour mixture in a greased 9-inch square pan.
3. Spread mashed potatoes over meat mixture, sealing to edge of pan.
4. Run a fork over potatoes for rippled surface.
5. Put in a preheated 425° oven for about 30 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Shepherd'S Pie

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. Mix all ingredients.
3. Turn into an 11 x 7-inch baking dish.
4. Score top of loaf with knife to mark off servings.
5. Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until done.
6. Makes 8 servings.
title: English Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Boil the potatoes for 15 mins or until tender. Drain, then mash.
2. Heat the milk and half the butter in the corner of the pan, then beat into the mash, along with the wholegrain mustard.
3. Gently fry the spring onions in the remaining butter for 2 mins until just soft but still a perky green. Fold into the mash and serve. Great with gammon or to top a fish pie.
title: Mustard champ

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 180C/350F/Gas 4.
2. For the beef stew, heat the oil and butter in an ovenproof casserole and fry the beef until browned on all sides.
3. Sprinkle over the flour and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the garlic and all the vegetables and fry for 1-2 minutes.
5. Stir in the wine, stock and herbs, then add the Worcestershire sauce and balsamic vinegar, to taste. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
6. Cover with a lid, transfer to the oven and cook for about two hours, or until the meat is tender.
7. For the dumplings, sift the flour, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
8. Add the suet and enough water to form a thick dough.
9. With floured hands, roll spoonfuls of the dough into small balls.

10. After two hours, remove the lid from the stew and place the balls on top of the stew. Cover, return to the oven and cook for a further 20 minutes, or until the dumplings have swollen and are tender. (If you prefer your dumplings with a golden top, leave the lid off when returning to the oven.)
11. To serve, place a spoonful of mashed potato onto each of four serving plates and top with the stew and dumplings. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
title: Beef Dumpling Stew

ingredients.text: 5 Tablespoons Butter, Cold, Cut Into 1/2 Inch Cubes
1 cup Creamy Peanut Butter (I Use Skippy)
3/4 cups Peanut Butter Chips (I Use Reese's)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. In the bowl of a stand mixer or a large mixing bowl using beaters, place all the dry ingredients except the chips and mix to incorporate.
3. Add the cold butter pieces and process until it resembles a fine crumble, 2-3 minutes on medium.
4. Add peanut butter and process 1-2 minutes on medium, until it resembles sand, scraping down the sides as you go.
5. Add the egg, vanilla, and cream and process until it forms a dough.
6. Add the peanut butter chips and the chocolate chips and mix until incorporated, not more than 30 seconds. It will resemble cookie dough.
7. Dump dough onto a piece of parchment and knead 2 to 3 times until everything is incorporated. Pat dough into a 9" circle and using a sharp knife, cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place on a Silpat or parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes. Do not overbake. I always touch the top and it should give little when done (feel puffy).
9. Store in an airtight container.
10. Serves 8.
11. Enjoy!
title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Scones

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 F.
2. In a small bowl, stir together melted ice cream and instant coffee granules until the coffee granules are dissolved. Whisk in eggs. Set aside.

3. Combine the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder in a mixing bowl; cut in the butter until the butter is in very tiny pieces. Stir in the toffee bits. Add the ice cream mixture to the flour mixture. Mix with a fork until it is all combined.

4. Pat into an 8-10 inch circle about 1-inch thick. Cut the circle into wedges. Bake for 10 minutes at 400 F. Reduce the heat to 300 F and continue to bake 10 more minutes. Remove from the oven. Cut through the wedges again and separate the wedges slightly. Place back in oven and bake 5 more minutes.
title: Toffee Latte Scones

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400 degrees.
2. In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; blend well.
3. Using a pastry blender or fork, cut cold Butter into small slices and blend with the flour mixture until the flour mixture is crumbly looking.
4. Add in the Whipping cream and stir.
5. On a floured surface, gently knead dough 5 or 6 times.
6. Cut dough in half.
7. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press each half into an 8inch circle about 1 inch thick. Cut into 8 wedges each but do not separate.
8. Sprinkle with sugar and bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Cut into wedges and serve warm.
title: English Cream Tea Scones

steps: 1. Remove the cooked corned beef from the pot and place it on a shallow roasting pan lined with aluminum foil and sprayed with Pam. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Mix the brown sugar, soy sauce and mustard together in a small bowl.
3. Spread the mixture over the corned beef and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
4. Remove and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.
title: Irish Glazed Corned Beef Brisket

steps: 1. Combine honey, cloves, cinnamon, and orange slices in saucepan with water.
2. Stir and bring to full boil.
3. Add tea and serve in 8 mugs.
title: English Spiced Tea

ingredients.text: 3 Tablespoons Whiskey (Irish, Of Course-I Used Bourbon)
1 cup Confectioners Sugar, Or As Needed

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a medium-sized, microwave safe bowl and let it cool down a little. Whisk in the espresso powder until smooth (I blend it using a milk frother until the mixture is a creamy light brown).
2. Next, stir in the whiskey and add confectioner's sugar until the icing has a thick, sirupy consistency. Simply pour over your cooled cake and let it drip down the sides.
3. (Recipe adapted from "Piece of Cake" by Camilla V. Saulsbury)
title: Irish Coffee Icing

steps: 1. Blend flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt with butter or margarine with fingers.
2. Sprinkle through raisins.
3. Mix together with buttermilk.
4. Save a little to brush tops.
5. Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into rounds.
6. Brush tops with milk.
7. Bake at 425° for 6 or 7 minutes.
8. Turn; bake approximately 3 minutes more. Serve with butter and jam if desired.
title: English Scones For Tea Time

steps: 1. Cut fruit very finely, including the rinds.
2. To every quart of pulp, add 1 1/2 quarts of boiling water.
3. Let stand for 24 hours.
title: English Marmalade

ingredients.text: 1 pound potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps: 1. Place the potatoes into a saucepan and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 10 minutes. Drain and mash potatoes, then set aside.

2. Meanwhile, combine cabbage and carrot in another saucepan and add just enough water to barely cover the bottom of the pan. Cook over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain off liquid and stir into the mashed potatoes along with the onion, mustard and Cheddar cheese. Season with salt and pepper.

3. Shape the mixture into 4 patties. Heat a greased grill pan over medium-high heat. Place the patties on the pan and grill until heated through and golden brown, about 5 minutes on each side. Serve right away.
title: Scottish Bubbles And Squeak Patties

ingredients.text: 7 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces

steps: 1. Place salmon, butter, lemon juice, lemon zest, Worcestershire and red pepper flakes if used in a bowl.
2. Blend until you will get a smooth paste.
3. Add salt and pepper to taste, blend shortly.
4. In another bowl beat the cream to stiff peaks.
5. Fold cream into the salmon paste and spoon in a nice bowl.
6. Top with some red pepper flakes if desired.
7. Chill for at least 2 hours until serving.
title: Scottish Smoked Salmon Paté

ingredients.text: 2 Cornish game hens (20 to 24 ounces each), split lengthwise

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the first five ingredients; sprinkle over hens. In a large skillet, cook hens over medium-high heat in oil until browned on both sides. Transfer to an ungreased 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish; set aside and keep warm.

2. In the same skillet, saute green onions and garlic until tender. Stir in broth and orange juice concentrate; pour over hens. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35-40 minutes or until meat is tender and juices run clear. To serve, drizzle with pan juices and sprinkle with almonds and parsley.
title: Flavorful Cornish Game Hens

steps: 1. Put the milk, cream, cinnamon stick and all the citrus zest in a saucepan set over a medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until the milk is just steaming but not boiling, about 3-5 mins. Remove from the heat, cover with a plate and leave to infuse for at least 30 mins.

2. When the cream mixture has infused, whisk the egg yolks, sugar and cornflour together in a separate bowl for 3-5 mins, or until light and pale in colour. Pour the infused milk through a sieve into the egg mixture, whisking continuously. Return the mixture to the saucepan.

3. Put the saucepan over a medium-high heat and whisk for around 10-12 mins. The mixture should start thickening to a custard-like consistency – you can tell it’s ready by dipping a wooden spoon in the mixture, then running a finger through the mixture on the back of the spoon. If the line holds, it's ready. Sieve the mixture into a jug to remove any froth.
4. Divide the custard between six 150ml ramekins or small terracotta dishes, then leave to cool for 1 hr at room temperature until set with a slight wobble. Chill overnight.

5. Just before serving, sprinkle 1 tbsp caster sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelise using a kitchen blowtorch. Alternatively, slide the ramekins under a hot grill until the sugar turns golden and starts to bubble. Serve straightaway.
title: Crema Catalana

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Fry the onion and half the chilli for 5 mins until softened. Tip in the spices, fry for 1 min more, then add the cherry tomatoes, potatoes and coriander stalks to the pan. Season the eggs well, pour over the top of the veg and leave to cook gently for 8-10 mins until almost set.
2. Heat the grill and flash the tortilla underneath for 1-2 mins until the top is set. Scatter the coriander leaves and remaining chilli over the top, slice into wedges and serve with a green salad.
title: Spiced tortilla

steps: 1. Take fresh scallops, wash well and drain.
2. Dust with seasoned flour.
3. Heat oil; add scallops and garlic.
4. Cook quickly (about 8 minutes), tossing lightly in hot fat.
5. Just before removing pan from heat, add parsley.
6. Toss scallops to coat with parsley. Makes 3 servings.
title: Scallops Portuguese

steps: 1. Soak gelatin in cold milk for 10 minutes; add sugar and salt and stir
2. until
3. it
4. is dissolved.	Heat in top of double boiler until milk is scalded.
5. Beat egg yolks slightly and add 1/2 cup hot
6. milk.	Stir mixture into remaining milk and cook until slightly thickened (about 4 minutes).
7. Stir constantly. Remove from
8. heat	and
9. cool slightly.
10. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla.
11. Turn into molds and chill until firm. Makes 8 servings.
title: Spanish Cream

steps: 1. Combine milk and gelatin and scald in double boiler.
2. Add slightly beaten egg yolks to which the sugar has been added. Cook until it coats the spoon, about 8 to 10 minutes; but be sure not to overcook.
3. Add 2 egg whites, beaten stiff and almond extract.
4. Chill before serving.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Spanish Cream

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together everything except for the chicken. Add the chicken and toss with tongs to coat in the marinade. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, or at least three hours.

2. When ready to cook, preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Heat a oven-save skillet over medium-high heat until very hot. Use tongs to transfer the chicken breasts out of the bowl and into the pan, reserving the marinade. Let cook for two or three minutes per side, until nice and browned.
3. Pour the reserved marinade into the pan and spoon the sauce onto the chicken. Turn off the stove, and use oven mitts to transfer the pan to the pre-heated oven.
4. Let cook in oven for 15-20 minutes (depending on thickness of chicken breasts), or until cooked through.
title: South African Piri-Piri Chicken

steps: 1. Mix ground pork, salt, chili powder, ground cloves, paprika, garlic, oregano and vinegar together thoroughly. Store in air-tight container in refrigerator for 4 days before using, to let spices blend together.
title: Jim'S Pork Chorizo

steps: 1. Crush the coriander and fennel seeds in a mortar with a pestle. Work in the garlic, then add the rosemary, parsley, vinegar and olive oil. Put the olives in a small bowl and pour over the marinade. Cover with clear film and chill for up to 1 week.
title: Tapas Marinated Olives

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or more to taste

steps: 1. Place turkey, vinegar, chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, salt, cumin, coriander, oregano, pepper, and red pepper flakes in a medium bowl. Mix well using your hands. Refrigerate for best flavor, 8 hours to overnight.
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chorizo, breaking up with a wooden spoon, until browned, 8 to 10 minutes.
title: Homemade Turkey Chorizo

ingredients.text: 5 -6 garlic cloves, peeled and finely minced

steps: 1. Place the oil and garlic in a small saucepan over medium to low heat. Bring the oil to a simmer and let it bubble for just 5 seconds. (Seconds not minutes.) Turn the heat off.
2. Let the oil and garlic sit for 15 minutes to allow the garlic to infuse the oil. Stir in the salt and parsley.
3. The oil is now ready to use or it can be stored for up to a week. If storing, return to room temperature before using.
title: Spanish Style Garlic And Parsley Flavored Olive Oil

steps: 1. Mix water with salt
2. Mix flour with water into a dough and then add melted butter to form a dough
3. Make into small size balls and let sit for 15-20 minutes

4. Roll out balls into empanadas and stuff with desired filling. If frying the empanadas fill a frying pan with about an inch of oil. Preheat oil, fry quickly one side and then fry until golden. Flip over and fry other side until brown.
title: Magdalena'S Empanadas

steps: 1. Beat the eggs and sugar together for a couple of minutes. Add the lemon rind, softened butter and baking powder and beat until the butter is combined. Add the flour and mix well. Cover the dough and refrigerate overnight.
2. Preheat the oven to 350°F.

3. Remove the dough from the refrigerator. Using a spoon, scoop walnut-sized pieces of dough. Roll the dough into 1/2 inches thick, 6-inch ropes. Press the ends firmly together, forming a ring. Stretch the rings slightly to open the centre of hole. (These can also be made into twists by folding the length of the rolled dough in half, then twisting a few times).
4. Place cookies on an ungreased baking sheet, 1-1/2 inches apart. Reduce oven temperature to 300 F, and bake the rings for 20 minutes, or until they have colour.

5. Once all of the cookies have been baked, place the baked cookies on a large baking sheet, piling up the cookies if necessary. Reduce the oven to 150 F and return the cookies to the oven for approximately 30 minutes or until crispy and golden in colour.
title: Portuguese Dry Rings (Rosquilbas Secas)

steps: 1. Trim and discard stem ands of okra. Cut okra into 1/4-inch slices. Dice tomatoes.
2. Melt butter in a skillet. Add okra, tomatoes and onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Add salt, chili powder and water to okra mixture in skillet; mix well.
4. Cover; cook until vegetables are tender and mixture has thickened, about 30 minutes.
title: Southwest Style Spanish Okra

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb of melted butter, cooled to room temperature

steps: 1. Mix the eggs well.
2. Add sugar and mix.
3. Add cooled butter and mix.
4. Add milk and flour, mix well.
5. Spray a muffin tin with Pam cooking spray.
6. Fill muffin tins 3/4 full with mixture.
7. Place in a 325 oven for approximately 3/4 of an hour.
8. If you want, you can sprinkle some with cinnamon when they come hot out of the oven.
title: Portuguese Queijadas

steps: 1. In a blender, combine garlic, oregano, vinegar, red pepper flakes, and water. Blend until smooth.
2. In a bowl pour mixture over ground pork; cover and refrigerate all day. Pour off any water that accumulates. Refrigerate or freeze for future use.
title: Homemade Chorizo

steps: 1. Take round steak and season both sides with garlic.
2. Rub in well.
3. Sprinkle with rest of ingredients.
4. Put into frying pan. Add vinegar, oil and water.
5. Cut onion and green pepper; place on top of steak.
6. Cover.
7. Cook over low heat until well done and tender.
title: Spanish-Style Steak

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb butter, cold and cut in small cubes

steps: 1. Combine flour and salt in a large bowl.
2. Cut in 1/2 lb butter with pastry blender.
3. Add one egg and vinegar.
4. Slowly add water, as needed, mixing to form the dough.
5. Turn dough out onto plastic wrap and knead until smooth, only a few seconds. Wrap well and chill 30 minutes.
6. Saute onion in 2 T butter.
7. Add spinach over medium heat.
8. Cool, then combine with cheese, hazelnuts, and raisins.
9. On lightly floured surface, roll half the chilled dough to 1/8" thick.
10. Cut out 3" circles.
11. Spoon 1 T filling into the center of each circle.
12. Make egg wash with beaten egg and 2 T water.
13. Brush egg wash around edges.Fold up edges forming a pouch, and seal.
14. Refrigerate the empanadas on greased parchment paper for at least 30 minutes.
15. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
16. Brush the empanadas with egg wash.
17. Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes.
title: Cuban Cheese Turnovers (Empanada De Queso)

steps: 1. In a saucepan, whisk together cocoa, cornstarch and water.
2. Whisk in the honey and gradually add milk, vanilla and almond extracts, whisking constantly over medium heat until smooth and slightly thickened.
title: Honey & Almond Spanish Hot Chocolate

steps: 1. Rub oil all over the chicken. Place into a casserole dish. Place uncovered into a preheated (180 degrees c) oven.
2. Bake for 30 minutes.
3. Add the ham, onion, celery, carrots, stock and tarragon. Cover and continue to bake for 1 hour.
4. Remove from oven, strain the broth (keep broth) and carve chicken.
5. Return the chicken to the casserole dish and reserve warm with the vegetables.
6. Heat the butter in a saucepan; stir in the flour and pour in 2 cups of the strained broth. Simmer until sauce thickens; pour over chicken and vegetables. Serve in the casserole dish.
title: Spanish Tarragon Chicken

steps: 1. Cook onion with margarine over medium heat.
2. Cook tomato and pepper with onion for 5 minutes in medium bowl.
3. Beat eggs and milk.
4. Pour into skillet with onion, etc.
5. Cook, stirring until eggs are done.
title: Spanish Eggs

ingredients.text: 3 lbs chicken, chopped into medium chunks
1 cup green peas (frozen, or canned and drained)

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook pieces of chicken until brown. When done, drain the excess fat and combine the sausage, onion, and chicken into the slow cooker. Scatter the saffron, thyme, paprika, pepper, and garlic over the ingredients and pour the broth and water into the slow cooker.
2. Cover, and cook for approximately 8 hours on LOW or 5 1/2 hours on HIGH.
3. When done cooking, add the peas, pepper, and tomatoes to the mixture and serve over cooked rice.
title: Crockpot Homemade Chicken Paella

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl with your hands. Or alternatively, you can mix in batches in a food processor in batches giving a finer texture almost like a paste.
2. Store in an airtight container or large zip-lock bag in the refrigerator. Let sit at least a day or two in the refrigerator before using. You can also put some in the freezer for later use.
3. To use: Pour a little canola or vegetable oil in a frying pan and heat over medium high-heat. Add the chorizo and cook through.
title: Homemade Chorizo

ingredients.text: 5 garlic cloves, peeled and finely chopped

steps: 1. Saute onions garlic and cilantro. Add Ground Beef. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add hard boiled egg.
title: Empanadas De Chacon

steps: 1. Brown pork chops on both sides.
2. Put to one side.
3. Place all other ingredients in casserole.
4. Pour 1 1/2 cups mushroom soup over vegetables.
5. Next, place pork chops on top as well as pan drippings.
6. Place remaining 1/2 cup of soup over top.
7. Cover with aluminum foil in 350° oven for 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.
8. Remove foil and continue to cook for another 1/2 to 3/4 hour.
title: Portuguese Pork Chops

steps: 1. Fry in vegetable shortening.
2. Put milk, butter and salt to boil.
3. Add flour and stir quickly.
4. Put dough into a cookie press. Twist out dough in large concentric circles into hot fat.
5. Turn when brown.
6. Remove when both sides are brown.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. When ready to serve, sprinkle with sugar.
title: Churros Cubanos

steps: 1. Make into balls the size of an egg.
2. Boil 2 hours in 1 quart of tomatoes.
title: Spanish Meat Balls

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper

steps: 1. Rinse pork and pat dry. Cut into 2 pieces.
2. Stir together paprika, garlic salt, oregano and pepper in a small dish. Sprinkle evenly over pork.

3. Heat oil in a medium skillet until very hot. Add pork and cook until well browned on all sides. Add sherry to skillet; cover tightly and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until pork is cooked through. Remove cover and simmer for a few minutes more to reduce sauce slightly.
title: Spanish Pork Tenderloin

steps: 1. Beat together ingredients with rotary beater just until smooth.
2. Pour into well-greased deep muffin cup (3/4 full) or oven glass cups (1/2 full). Bake at 425° for 35 to 45 minutes.
title: Popovers(Portuguese)

steps: 1. Grind pork.
2. Add one at a time; salt, chili powder, vinegar, garlic, oregano, and cumin, mixing well after each addition.
3. Pack in a crock, or glass jar for at least 8 hours but preferably 24 hours.
4. Cook as needed in skillet.
5. It will look like ground meat.
6. May be frozen.
title: Chorizo

steps: 1. Sauce:
2. Mix first 7 ingredients.
3. Use about 2 quarts of shrimp for 1 recipe of sauce, preferably fresh shrimp, unpeeled with heads on.
4. Arrange shrimp in shallow pan in rows very close together and spoon sauce evenly over shrimp.
5. Sprinkle generously with black pepper (garnish with lemon slices, bell pepper slices, pimento, etc., if desired) and marinate 1 hour or longer.
6. Cook 10 to 15 minutes in 350° oven.
7. Serve as an appetizer or one dish meal with plenty of hot, unbuttered French bread to dunk into the sauce.
title: Portuguese Shrimp (G)

steps: 1. In a gallon container combine whiskey, lemon, sugar, milk, chocolate squares and vanilla beans. Keep at room temperature for 10 days, stirring once a day.

2. After 10 days, remove the lemon half, chocolate and vanilla beans. Insert a coffee filter into a large funnel. pour the liquid through the filter into a gallon jug. Change filter as needed. A clear yellow solution should result. This liqueur can be stored in a sealed bottle at room temperature.
title: Portuguese Licoro

steps: 1. 1. Prepare empanada dough and chill.
2. 2. Cook the onions and garlic in the vegetable oil and butter until softened. Add the ground beef, cumin, chile powder, paprika, beef bouillon, and salt and pepper to taste.
3. 3. Cook the beef, stirring and crumbling the meat, until browned. Add the flour and continue to cook for 5 or 10 minutes more.
4. 4. Remove the meat mixture and let cool. The beef mixture will keep up to 2 days in the refrigerator.

5. 5. Shape the empanadas: Separate the dough into golf ball size pieces, and roll into smooth balls. Let rest for 5 minutes. On a floured surface, roll each ball of dough into a 6 inch diameter circle, about 1/4 inch thick. Add 1 tablespoon of the beef filling, a few raisins and some chopped olives, and a slice of hard boiled egg to the middle of the circle.
6. 6. Brush the edges with water and fold the pastry in half over the filling, to make a semi-circle.
7. 7. Seal the edges by pressing down with your fingers. Brush the sealed edge lightly with water, then turn the edge toward the middle and press with your fingers to seal.
8. 8. Mix the egg yolk with 2 tablespoons milk, and brush the empanadas with the mixture.
9. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
title: Empanadas Chilean

steps: 1. Mix the sugar and the flour in a bowl
2. But the watter and the butter in a pot with high flame, and when it starts to boil add the flour with the sugar quick and all in one time.
3. Put the pot away from the flames and start mixing it strongly
4. When you have paste and it's cold add the half egg and keep mixing,do sticks and cook them in the
title: Baked Churro Sticks

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C).

2. Beat egg whites in a glass or metal bowl until foamy. Gradually add sugar and lemon juice, continuing to beat until stiff peaks form. Lift your beater or whisk straight up: the egg whites will form sharp peaks.
3. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls egg mixture onto a baking sheet, making little peaked mounds.
4. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned and dry on the outside yet soft and no longer gooey on the inside, 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Portuguese Snow Drops

steps: 1. Mix the salt and flour in a large bowl. Rub the lard into the flour mixture with the tips of your fingers until it begins to resemble pea-sized pebbles. Next, add the ice water and mix until just combined. Press into a 6 inch disk and wrap in plastic. Chill in the refrigerator for at least one hour.

2. When you are ready to prepare the empanadas, pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees. Remove the dough from the refrigerator and cut the disk into 4 chunks. Flour your work surface and roll one out with a floured rolling pin until it is 1/8 of an inch thick. You should be able to cut 6 four-inch rounds out of each (freehand with a sharp paring knife if you don't have a pastry cutter).

3. Place a small amount of cold filling in the middle of each round, brush the edges with a bit of egg wash, fold into a half-moon, and crimp as desired -- some people fold the edges decoratively while others simply crimp with the tines of a fork.
4. Place the prepared empanadas on a parchment-lined baking sheet and place into the preheated oven. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the crust is blistered and well-browned.
title: Empanada Dough

steps: 1. Sift flour onto a flat work surface. Make a well in the center. Add sugar and salt. Gradually mix in shortening and water with a fork until dough comes together. Knead until smooth, about 10 minutes.
2. Divide dough into 30 pieces. Roll each piece out into a thin, 6-inch round.
title: Masa Para Empanadas (Empanada Dough)

steps: 1. Add sugar and egg; blend together.
2. Sift baking powder, flour and salt together.

3. Add to creamed mixture alternately with the milk. Stir in vanilla. Roll out 1/16-inch thick on pastry cloth. Cut in Christmas designs. Brush with egg white. Decorate. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
title: Christmas Cutouts(Portuguese)

ingredients.text: 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes (see note below)
1 cup olive oil, more as needed (does not need to be extra virgin and can be combined with grapeseed oil)

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, heat herbs, chiles, and oil, slowly, over low heat until they begin to sizzle (less than 220 degrees F).
2. Turn off the heat and when they stop sizzling, cover and allow to cool.
3. Pour into a clean, sterilized bottle, cover tightly and let stand in a cool, dark place for a week before using.
4. NOTE: Instead of crushed red pepper flakes you could also use 12 whole small dried red chili peppers or Japanese chilies, or 8 dried chiles de arbol, broken in half.
title: Piri Piri (Spicy Herb Oil)

steps: 1. Boil fish until cooked drain and mince using care to remove all the bones.
2. Boil potatoes and collards together until the potatoes are cooked but still firm.
3. Fry onions in 1/2 cup of olive oil until slightly browned then add tomatoes and fry for 5 min.
4. Now in a baking dish layer potatoes and collards, fish, onions and tomatoes, potatoes and collards, fish, onions and tomatoes.
5. Drizzle with remaining oil and what's left from frying onions.
6. Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour.
title: Cod Fish Casserole (Portuguese Style)

steps: 1. In a large deep skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat and brown the chicken all over.
2. Remove and set aside.
3. Add the onions and garlic to the pan and cook over medium heat, stirring, for 5 minutes.
4. Add the paprika, salt, turmeric and pepper and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds.
5. Add the tomatoes, rice and stock and bring to a boil.
6. Return the chicken to the skillet.
7. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until the juices run clear when the chicken is pierced and the rice is almost tender.
8. Add the zucchini and cook, covered, for 6 minutes or until the rice is tender.
title: Quick Chicken Paella

steps: 1. 1. Heat water, butter and salt in a large saucepan till butter melts.
2. 2. Add 2 T sugar and bring to a boil.
3. 3. Add 2cups flour and stir till it forms a ball and it removes from the sides of the pan. Stir an additional 30 seconds then remove from heat.
4. 4. Place mixture in the bowl of a mixer with a paddle and mix in eggs one at a time until incorporated before adding the next egg.

5. 5. Place mixture in a pastry bag with a wide star tip. In another saucepan, heat canola oil to 375 degrees. Pipe batter into oil in 3" segments, cutting with a knife after each segment. Do not crowd the oil. 5 or 6 at a time maximum.
6. 6. As the churros turn deep golden, remove them to drain on paper towels.
7. 7. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Toss the churros with the cinnamon sugar.
title: Mexican Churros

ingredients.text: 1 pound cremini mushrooms, coarsely chopped (stems included)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion, carrot, and celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-7 minutes. Add cremini mushrooms, thyme, parsley, peppercorns, salt, and 7 cups cold water, bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes. Remove from the heat and let sit for 30 minutes longer.
2. Strain stock into a clean saucepan and keep warm over low heat (you should have about 6 cups).
title: Kale And Mushroom Paella

steps: 1. Cut a few slits
2. in
3. fat
4. side
5. of roast, then rub roast with salt and
6. pepper.
7. Place garlic in slits and sprinkle with allspice and thyme.
8. Place
9. meat on rack in shallow pan; sprinkle with oil.
10. Roast
11. at
12. 350° until meat thermometer registers 170°. It will take 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 hours.
title: Spanish Style Pork Roast

steps: 1. Melt butter and oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add garlic and saute for one minute.
3. Increase heat to high and add mushrooms. Saute until done.
4. Add tomato paste and stir.
5. Add wine and lemon juice and bring to a boil.
6. Add shrimp and green onions. Cook one minute, stirring constantly.
7. Add scallops and cook 3 minutes or until scallops are opaque.
8. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with parsley.
title: Portuguese Shrimp And Scallops

steps: 1. Mix altogether and bake in oven at 350°.
2. Stir several times. Makes 24 sandwiches.
title: Spanish Hamburger

steps:
1. Have the oil any kind, except olive oil, in a heavy bottom pot and heat in medium heat to reach 325 degrees.
Mix water and achiote powder, add to the Masa Harina, salt and garlic powder, mix, the add the water mixture little by little until all the dough is moist and soft, if you see the is to dry add a little water and if it is to soft almost watery add more masa harina.

2. Divide the dough in balls, and using a plastic bag cut in half and a big plate, place the ball in the center of the plastic, cover with another piece of plastic and press with the plate to form the tortilla.

Add some cheese and ham in one of the sides and them close to form the empanada with the other side of the tortilla.

3. Fry until golden brown, both sides of the empanada, about 5 minutes. Place 3 at a time, so the oil don't get to cold. You can see the difference of color from one cook and the other one not ready.

Serve with a side of your favorite salad, sauce or salsa.
title: Cheese And Ham Empanadas #Weekdaysupper

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large pan, then gently fry the onion for 3-4 mins until it begins to soften. Stir in the carrot, celery, thyme and bay leaves. Season, then cook for 2-3 mins, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic, chorizo, cinnamon and smoked paprika. Gently fry until the vegetables soften and the chorizo starts to release its oils and crisp up.

2. Stir in the chickpeas, vinegar and 150ml water, then bring to a simmer for 1-2 mins until the chickpeas have heated up. Add the spinach, then stir through the chickpeas until it wilts a little. Remove from the heat, season to taste, then serve warm with crusty bread.
title: Chickpea, chorizo & spinach stew

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish and brown the chicken pieces on all sides – you may have to do this in batches. Remove from the dish and put to one side.

2. Lower the heat, add the onion and pepper, and gently cook for 10 mins until softened. Add the garlic and chorizo, and cook for a further 2 mins until the chorizo has released some of its oils into the dish. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min more.
3. Return the chicken pieces to the dish along with the thyme, white wine and stock. Bring the liquid to a boil, cover the dish with a tight-fitting lid and lower the heat. Cook for 30 mins.

4. Tip in the rice and stir everything together. Cover, set over a low heat and cook for a further 15 mins, or until the rice is cooked and has absorbed most of the cooking liquid. Remove from the heat and leave the dish to sit for 10 mins to absorb any remaining liquid. Season to taste and scatter with parsley to serve.
title: Chicken & chorizo rice pot

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan, then soften the leek for 5 mins without browning. Add the chorizo and fry until it releases its oils. Stir in the turmeric and rice until coated by the oils, then pour in the stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 mins, stirring occasionally.
2. Tip in the peas and cook for 5 mins, then stir in the seafood to heat through for a final 1-2 mins cooking or until rice is cooked. Check for seasoning and serve immediately with lemon wedges.
title: Seafood rice

steps: 1. Whizz together all of the marinade ingredients in a small food processor. Rub the marinade onto the chicken and leave for 1 hour at room temperature.

2. Heat the oven to 190C/fan 170C/gas 5. Put the chicken in a roasting tray and cook for 1 hour 20 minutes. Rest under loose foil for 20 minutes. While the chicken is resting, mix together the slaw ingredients and season. Serve the chicken with slaw, fries and condiments.
title: Piri-piri chicken and slaw

steps: 1. In a blender (or with a stick blender), whizz together the passata, red pepper, chilli, garlic, sherry vinegar and lime juice until smooth. Season to taste, then serve with ice cubes
title: Quick gazpacho

steps: 1. Saute bacon slowly and pour off most of the fat.
2. Brown chopped onion and beef in hot fat.
3. Add salt.
4. Wash rice, drain and add with 1 1/2 cups tomato juice and paprika to meat.
5. Pour into greased casserole and bake in moderate oven (350°) until rice is tender, about 30 minutes, adding more tomato juice as it is absorbed.
6. Serves 6.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Mix all together and bake for 30 minutes at 400°.
2. I use Velveeta cheese and stewed Mexican tomatoes.
3. Yield:
4. 8 servings.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Cook rice in 2 cups water with salt until fluffy.
2. Fry bacon, add vegetables and cook until tender.
3. Mix with rice, place in casserole dish and dot with butter.
4. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Yields 8 servings.
title: Spanish Rice

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. butter, margarine or bacon drippings

steps: 1. Melt butter in large skillet.
2. Add rice, onion and green pepper.
3. Cook and stir until mixture is lightly browned.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Quickly bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Quick Spanish Rice

steps: 1. In a medium to large skillet, heat butter and add onions, red pepper and green pepper.
2. Cook until slightly tender.
3. Add rice; mix together.
4. Lower heat and add water.
5. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.
6. When done, add chili powder, mix and serve.
7. Serves 4.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium heat cook beef, chopped green pepper and chopped onion until meat is no longer pink.
2. Drain. Stir in noodles, tomatoes, water, chili sauce, salt and pepper. Mix well.
3. Cover and cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes or until noodles are tender.
4. Stirring frequently.
5. Add bacon.
6. Yields:
7. 5 servings.
title: Spanish Noodles And Ground Beef

steps: 1. In skillet, cook green pepper, onion, garlic, basil and rosemary in hot oil until vegetables are tender.
2. Stir in rice, chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper and 2 cups water.
3. Cook, covered, over low heat for about 20 minutes, or until rice is done.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Spanish Rice(Arroz Con Tomate)

steps: 1. Heat butter in a saucepan.
2. Add onion, green pepper and rice. Cook and stir over medium heat until lightly browned.
3. Add tomatoes, water, salt and pepper.
4. Mix well, bring to boil and cover tightly.
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
6. Fry ground beef and add to rice mixture after 30 minutes.
7. Mix well.
8. Serves 2 to 3 people.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet; add rice and brown slightly.
2. Add onions, peppers and beef.
3. Stir over high heat until meat is lightly browned.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Mix well and bring quickly to boil.
6. Cover tightly and simmer 25 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Skillet Spanish Rice

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine cabbage and green pepper. In a jar with tight-fitting lid, combine remaining ingredients; shake well. Pour over cabbage mixture just before serving; toss to coat. Serve with a slotted spoon. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Spanish Slaw

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet.
2. Drain off most of fat.
3. Add onion to remaining fat and cook over medium heat until onion is yellow.
4. Add bacon and remaining ingredients.
5. Cook, uncovered, over low heat about 15 minutes.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Saute rice, onion and pepper in oil until vegetables are tender.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Heat margarine in saucepan; add onion, green pepper and rice. Cook and stir over high heat until lightly browned.
2. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
3. Add 1/2 pound ground beef if desired. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Saute onions and pepper in fat until brown.
2. Add hamburger, salt, pepper and chili powder.
3. When meat is slightly brown, place alternate layers of rice and meat mixture in casserole.
4. Pour tomatoes over dish and bake at 375° for 50 minutes.
title: Spanish Rice And Hamburger

steps: 1. Brown peppers and onions together in butter, then add other ingredients.
2. Simmer for 10 minutes.
3. Cook beans until just tender, drain.
4. In oven dish, place a layer of beans, layer of sauce and layer of grated cheese.
5. Continue this process until beans and sauce are used.
6. Cover top with buttered bread crumbs and bake for 35 minutes in 350° oven.
title: Spanish Beans

steps: 1. Melt margarine in skillet; add rice and stir until golden brown.
2. Add chopped onion and saute until onion turns color (clear-translucent).
3. Add chicken stock and tomato paste.
4. Simmer, covered, until rice is tender for 30 to 40 minutes.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Cook first 7 ingredients in skillet until meat is brown, breaking up meat particles as it cooks.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Cover and cook 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir often.
title: He-Man Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Brown rice in vegetable oil in medium heat.
2. Blend onion, garlic, tomato, 1/2 cup water and chicken bouillon cubes in blender until pureed.
3. Pour mixture into browned rice and cover with lid to simmer for about 5 minutes, then add 2 cups of cold water and let boil until cooked with lid on.
4. Allow to cool after cooked with lid off.
5. Rice should be puffy.
6. (Do not stir frequently; can turn too mushy.)
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a stainless steel or glass bowl. Cover and chill at least 4 hours. Serve in chilled cups; top with croutons.
title: Spanish Gazpacho

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Fry bacon.
2. Add onions, green peppers and beef.
3. Brown for about 5 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, rice, 1 teaspoon chili powder, garlic, salt and pepper.
5. Mix well and simmer, covered.
6. Toward end of cooking, add additional chili powder.
7. Add water if too dry; should be moist, not soupy.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Saute onion, pepper and meat.
2. Add to tomatoes and rice. Place in casserole.
3. Bake slowly for 1 hour at 325°.
title: Spanish Rice

ingredients.text: 4 eggs, scrambled in a large bowl

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the vegetable oil until the pan is filled halfway. Once the oil is hot, add the potato slices and onion, making sure they are well-covered by the oil; add more oil if necessary. Cook for 20 minutes until the potatoes and onions are soft. Drain the oil and combine the potato mixture with the eggs. Add the salt and mix well.

2. In a 10-inch by 2 1/2 inch deep nonstick skillet, add the olive oil and heat over medium-high heat. Pour in the potato, egg, and onion mixture. Lower the heat to medium-low and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until the bottom of the omelet is very light brown. Using a flat ceramic plate, cover the frying pan and flip the omelet over onto the plate. Immediately slip the uncooked side back into the pan. Cook for another 4 to 5 minutes, until the other side is a very light brown.
3. Remove the omelet from the pan to a plate and cut into 4 wedges.
title: Spanish Omelet

steps: 1. Add 1 teaspoon of coconut oil to a frying pan and gently fry the red onion and chopped parsnip for 5 minutes (until softened), then add in the spring onion and fry for a further 2 minutes.
2. Add the eggs, egg whites and lemon juice to a mixing bowl and whisk, then add in the vegetables from the frying pan and the spinach.
3. Add another teaspoon of coconut oil back into the frying pan and pour in the egg mixture. Fry for 1-2 minutes (until the bottom has browned slightly) then flip and fry the other side.
4. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.
title: Spanish Omelette With Parsnip

steps: 1. Wash & cut potatoes into thin slices.
2. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil, then add potatoes & salt.

3. Fry, stirring occasionally, perhaps about 5 minutes, until potatoes are a golden color, then remove from the skillet & spread out on a paper-towel covered platter so that much of the oil can be removed.
4. In a large bowl, whisk eggs well, then to them add the potatoes, mixing well.
5. Using the same skillet as before, cover the bottom of the pan with a thin layer of oil, about 1-2 tablespoons.
6. Once the oil is hot, add potato & egg mixture, shaking the pan gently as you move the mixture, so that none sticks to the bottom.

7. Once omelet seems to be cooked, about 10 minutes, use a large plate to tip the omelet out of the skillet. After adding a little more oil to the skillet, slide the omelet in again, this time putting it in top-side down & cooking it until the under-side is also golden.
8. Serve hot or cold.
title: Spanish Omelet

steps: 1. Heat 1/4 cup oil in skillet.
2. Add potato and onion.
3. Cook until soft.
4. Add egg.
5. When it's almost done, flip onto a plate.
6. Add 1 tablespoon oil to pan, slide omelet back in and cook until done.
title: Tortilla Espanola("Spanish Omelet")

ingredients.text: 2 large potatoes, peeled and finely sliced

steps: 1. Tip the spinach into a large colander and bring a kettleful of water to the boil.
2. Slowly pour the water over the spinach until wilted, then cool under cold water. Squeeze all the water out.
3. Heat grill/broiler to high.
4. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and gently cook the onion and potato for about 10 minutes until the potato is soft.
5. While the onion is cooking, beat the eggs together in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper.
6. Stir the spinach into the potatoes.
7. Pour in the eggs and cook, stirring occasionally, until nearly set.
8. Flash the omelette under the grill/broiler to set the top.
9. Ease the omelette on to a plate, then flip over back into the pan.
10. Finish cooking the omelette on the underside and turn out onto a board.
11. Serve cut into wedges.
title: Spanish Spinach Omelette

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, bring water, butter, salt, sugar, and cinnamon to a simmer over high heat.

2. When butter has melted and sugar and salt have dissolved, lower heat to medium, add flour, and stir rapidly. The batter will form quickly as the flour absorbs the water mixture. Continue to cook over medium heat, stirring, for 1 minute.

3. Remove saucepan from heat and allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes. Add eggs one at a time to batter mixture, stirring until each is incorporated. The batter will be very stiff and look a bit like buttercream frosting.

4. Mix sugar and cinnamon on a plate for dipping. In a saucepan over low heat, combine cream, chocolate, and corn syrup and stir frequently until chocolate begins to melt. Turn off heat and set chocolate mixture aside.
5. Preheat the waffle iron. (Set it to medium if it has temperature settings.) Coat both sides of the waffle iron with nonstick cooking spray.

6. Place about 1/4 cup of batter on each section of waffle iron. Do not overstuff waffle iron-the batter will expand considerably. (Err on the side of using less batter before you see how much it spreads out and rises.) Close the lid and cook until churros are golden brown, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer churros to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
7. Brush churros with melted butter and then dip them in cinnamon sugar. Serve warm with chocolate sauce for dipping.
title: Waffle Iron Churros Recipe

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 to 2 ounces Spanish chorizo (cured spiced pork sausage), casing removed and sausage finely chopped (1/2 cup)

steps: 1. Cook onion, scallions, and garlic in 1 tablespoon oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.

2. Peel potatoes and coarsely grate. Squeeze any excess water from potatoes and mix with onion mixture, chorizo, parsley, paprika, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper in a large bowl until combined well.

3. Wipe out skillet and heat butter and remaining tablespoon oil over medium heat until butter is melted. Add potato mixture, spreading evenly in skillet and pressing gently to flatten. Cook over medium heat until crisp and golden, 8 to 10 minutes. Invert a large plate over skillet. Holding plate and skillet tightly together, invert hash browns onto plate. Slide back into skillet and press gently to flatten. Cook until golden and cooked through, 8 to 10 minutes more. Cut into wedges and serve.
title: Chorizo Hash Browns

steps: 1. Heat oil in a nonstick frying pan and saute onion, carrot and green pepper, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
2. Add zucchini and cook for another 5 minutes.
3. Add garlic and eggs to the vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
4. Stir gently until the omelette starts to set.
5. When the omelette is set underneath, put it under the broiler to set the top.
6. Do not let it get too firm or it will be rubbery.
7. Cut the omelette in 1/2 and serve immediately.
title: Spanish Omelette

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and cut into slices.
2. Fry the potatoes in very hot oil until they are medium golden and soft.
3. Drain the potatoes.
4. Beat the eggs with some salt.
5. Add the potatoes and mix.
title: Spanish Omelette

ingredients.text: 1 loaf (8 ounces) French bread, cut into 1-inch slices

steps: 1. In a small bowl, mix sugar and cinnamon until blended. In a large shallow dish, whisk eggs and milk. Dip both sides of bread in egg mixture, soaking lightly.

2. In an electric skillet, heat 1 in. of oil to 350°. Working with a few slices at a time, remove bread from egg mixture, allowing excess to drain, and fry 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
3. Dip warm rabanadas in cinnamon-sugar to coat all sides. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Rabanadas (Portuguese French Toast)

ingredients.text: 1/2 red bell pepper, cut in 1/2-inch dice
2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, minced

steps: 1. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
2. Add olive oil, bell peppers and onion, cooking until softened.
3. Add garlic and chorizo, cooking and stirring for another 2 minutes.
4. Add sun-dried tomatoes, stirring to combine.
5. Pour in eggs and rotate pan to distribute evenly.
6. Lift edges of omelette, tilting pan to allow liquid to run under the cooked eggs.
7. Lower heat to medium-low and cook, without stirring eggs, until set.
8. On one half of omelette, sprinkle cheese, then fold over enclosing cheese.
9. You can garnish this omelette with chopped cilantro and sour cream if you like.
10. Serves two people.
title: Spanish Omelette

2. Sugar will caramelize quickly. Immediately
