title: Flan - Caramel Custard

steps: 1. Beat eggs until smooth.
2. Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth.
3. Pour mixture into a well-buttered 1-quart baking dish.
4. Place dish in a large pan, which has been filled with just enough hot water to come up around baking dish.
5. Bake in a preheated oven (350°) for 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Chill for several hours before serving. Serves 6.
title: Flan

steps: 1. Caramelize in a metal dish 3/4 cup sugar and 5 tablespoons water.
2. Carefully coat inside of receptacle with caramel (a stainless steel bowl is excellent).
title: Flan

steps: 1. In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the flour and the salt. Slowly add ice water a 1/2 cup at a time, stirring thoroughly after every addition, until a dough ball forms. I used a little less than 1 cup of water.
2. Kneed on the counter top until a soft ball forms. Don't be afraid to use flour if it gets tacky.
3. Let the dough rest for 20 minutes under a kitchen cloth. Resting the dough will prevent it from shrinking as you shape the dough in the next step.
4. Roll the dough into a rectangle about a 1/2 cm thick.

5. Divide your room temperature butter into thirds. Smear the first third of the butter on top of the dough. Fold it over on itself and pat it down. Then fold it again going the other way. Roll it out and repeat with the other thirds of butter.
6. Wrap the dough with plastic wrap and chill it in the refrigerator to make the butter harder and easier to work with.
7. When you finish your third fold, chill it in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
8. In the meantime we can make the custard. In a bowl whisk together egg yolks, sugar, and heavy cream.

9. Slowly cook the custard over a double boiler, constantly stirring for 5 minutes until the custard heats through and it thickens. When you can draw a line through the custard on the back of a spoon and the line holds the custard is done. Set it aside to cool.
10. Preheat your oven to 475F.
11. Take the dough out of the fridge and lightly dust the dough and your rolling pin with flour. Roll it out to 1/4 cm thick.

12. Working quickly so the butter doesn't melt, cut 1/2 inch strips of dough and wind the dough in a spiral to cover the entire inside. Press the dough with your fingers to make it smooth. Repeat with the remaining dough.
13. You'll get about 16 tarts.
14. Fill the tarts with about a tablespoon of custard.
15. Bake them for 20 minutes on the rack below the middle level. If you insert a toothpick into the center of the custards it should come out clean.
16. Serve piping hot.
title: Portuguese Egg Custard Tarts

steps: 1. Cut onions into 1/2-inch dice. Saute slowly in olive oil until translucent and barely golden, about 15 minutes. Set aside to cool.
2. Add all ingredients including the sauteed onions to your bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer, and select the bread cycle.
title: Portuguese Sofrito Bread (A B M)

ingredients.text: 1/8 teaspoons Green Food Coloring, Adjust Amount As Needed
1/8 teaspoons Red Food Coloring, Adjust Amount As Needed

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray muffin pans with cooking spray (enough for 30 muffins).
2. Melt butter in a medium saucepan on medium heat. Add milk, stirring occasionally, until it is warm. Turn off heat.
3. Whisk flour and baking powder in a small bowl. Set aside.

4. In a deep mixing bowl, beat eggs for 1 minute. Slowly add sugar, 1 cup at a time. Continue beating for 1 minute after the last addition. Add vanilla extract and lemon zest. Blend. Slowly add half of the flour mixture, followed by about 1 cup of the milk mixture, beating for about 30 seconds after the milk addition. Add the rest of the flour, then all of the remaining milk mixture. Beat for just over 1 minute. The batter will be watery and will splash. Angling a large paper plate over the bowl with help contain the splashing.

5. Divide batter equally (it doesn't have to be exact; just eyeball this) into 3 separate bowls. Add a few drops of green food coloring to one bowl and red to another bowl (I use about 1/8 teaspoon of gel food coloring). Whisk thoroughly to blend. Add more if needed to obtain desired color. The third bowl remains undyed.

6. Fill muffin pans 3/4 full (you will have about 10 of each color). Bake for 35-38 minutes. Edges should be golden brown. Cupcake will fall in the center upon standing. Keep refrigerated and serve chilled.
title: Queijadas (Portuguese Custard Cupcakes)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. In a heavy bottomed saucepan over medium heat, melt 1/2 cup sugar until golden. Carefully pour hot sugar evenly into four oven-proof ramekins or custard cups, tilting cups to coat bottoms evenly.

3. In another saucepan, bring milk just to boiling over medium heat. Stir hot milk, a little at a time, into beaten eggs and egg yolks, until well combined. Stir in sugar. Pour milk mixture evenly into ramekins.

4. Line a roasting pan with a damp kitchen towel. Place ramekins on towel, inside roasting pan, and place roasting pan on oven rack. Fill roasting pan with boiling water to reach halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
5. Bake in preheated oven 40 minutes, until set. Let cool, invert and serve.
title: Flan Ii

steps: 1. Heat a large frying pan on a high heat and season the chicken. Add the olive oil to the pan, then the chicken. Brown for about 5 mins on each side, remove onto a plate, then set aside.
2. Lower the heat to medium. In the remaining fat, fry the onions for 3 mins, then add the garlic and saffron. Cook for 3-4 mins more. Add the sherry, then simmer for 3-5 mins until syrupy.

3. Put the chicken leg pieces back into the pan, tip in the stock, thyme and raisins, cover, then gently cook on a low heat for 20 mins. Add the breast meat and any juices left on the plate. Simmer for 10 mins more until cooked through and the sauce in the pan has reduced.

4. While the chicken is cooking, heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Scatter the pine nuts over a baking sheet, then roast for 10 mins until golden and toasted. Once the chicken has cooked through, season to taste, scatter with pine nuts and parsley, then serve with rice.
title: Chicken with saffron, raisins & pine nuts

steps: 1. Drain the beans, then tip into a large pan with 2 litres of water. Simmer with the whole garlic cloves, bay leaves and thyme for 30 mins or until cooked and tender. Remove from the heat and set aside.

2. Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp oil in a frying pan. Fry the bread with the remaining garlic clove. When golden and crisp, scoop out and drain on kitchen paper. Add the chorizo to the pan, fry until crisp, tip out and keep warm with the bread.

3. Add another 2 tbsp oil and the onion to the pan, and cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the paprika. Drain the beans and add to the onions with the chicken stock and 2 tsp salt. Cook for 5-10 mins. Stir through the parsley and keep warm.

4. Season the hake and heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil in the frying pan. Put the hake, skin-side down, in the pan and cook for 3-5 mins over a mediumhigh heat to crisp up the skin. Flip the fish over and cook for a further 3-5 mins until cooked through. Spoon the white bean mix into bowls, place the hake on top and finish with the fried bread, chorizo and a little more thyme.
title: Pan-fried hake, white bean & chorizo broth

steps: 1. Boil sugar and water until clear.
2. Cool.
3. Take 3 slices from center of each fruit and save for garnish.
4. Squeeze remaining fruit and pour white wine and sugar syrup over fruit and juice. Let it steep for several hours or overnight.
5. Remove fruit.
6. Add soda when ready to serve.
7. Pour over lots of ice and garnish with slices.
8. Makes 24 servings.
title: White Sangria

ingredients.text: 2 jalapeno peppers, coarsely chopped, including stems and seeds
1 poblano pepper, coarsely chopped, including stems and seeds

steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients except the garlic in a medium heavy saucepan and cook, stirring, over high heat for 4 minutes.
2. Add the garlic, remove from the heat, and let cool to room temperature.
3. Pour into a food processor or blender and pulse until smooth.
4. Strain through a fine-mesh strainer.
5. Refrigerate in an airtight container for 7 days before using.
title: Piri Piri Sauce

steps: 1. Mix flour, brown and white sugars, nutmeg, salt and oil. Reserve 3/4 cup. Add nuts and cinnamon to reserved portion for topping. To first mixture add buttermilk, soda, and beaten egg. Pour mixture into greased 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Spanish Coffee Cake

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Cream the shortening and sugar.
3. Add egg.
4. Stir in applesauce, flour mixture, raisins and nuts.
5. Pour into 8-inch square pan.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.
title: Old-Fashioned Spanish Bar Applesauce Cake

steps: 1. Mix first six ingredients together and reserve 1/2 cup for top of cake.
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
3. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan or 2 (9-inch) round pans.
4. Sprinkle the 1/2 cup reserved crumbs on top.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.
title: Spanish Coffee Cake

steps: 1. Add sugar to hot tea.
2. Stir until dissolved.
3. Add juices. Serve over ice.
title: Spanish Punch

steps: 1. Shells
3. Combine the flour and powdered sugar in a food processor. Add the butter and pulse until it's evenly distributed. Add the egg and pulse until the dough comes together.

5. Roll out the dough on a floured surface. Cut the dough in circles with a large mug. Press the circles down into a greased muffin pan. Put the pan of shells in the fridge while you prepare the almond filling.
6. Almond filling
8. Preheat oven to 355°F (180°C).
10. Whisk the egg and powdered sugar together until thick and airy. Melt the butter and stir it into the egg mixture. Stir in the vanilla, flour, and almond extract. Stir in the almond flour.
12. Pipe or spoon the almond filling onto the shells, filling the shells about 3/4 full.
14. Bake the mazariner for 20 – 25 minutes, until light golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.
15. Glaze
17. Mix together the powdered sugar and liquid until you get a spreadable glaze. Spread the glaze on top of the mazariner and if you wish, decorate with sprinkles, or anything you like.
title: Mazariner – Scandinavian Almond Tartlets

steps: 2. Whisk the egg and sugar until the mixture thickens.
4. Melt the butter and let it cool slightly, then add the butter to the egg mixture.
6. Mix in spices and then slowly add the flour while stirring to avoid lumps.
8. Let the batter rest for at least 30 minutes. This improves the texture of the krumkaker.
10. Spoon about one heaping tablespoon of batter onto iron and bake. If the batter is too thick, add some water to it.

12. While still hot, shape the krumkake with a wooden krumkake roller or over a cup (if using a cup, make them a bit thicker). The krumkaker harden quickly, so you can just let them sit on the roller/cup until the next krumkake is ready to be shaped.
14. After completely cooled, store the krumkaker in a metal or glass tin lined with paper towels at the bottom. You can also freeze them!
title: Norwegian Krumkake

steps: 2. Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cut beef into 1 inch (2.5 cm) cubes and brown in oil.
4. Dice the onion and add to browning beef. Add the stock and bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and let simmer for about 30 minutes.
6. Peel and cut the rutabaga and celery root into 1 inch (2.5 cm) cubes. Add to the pot, cover, and continue simmering for another 30 minutes.
8. Peel and chop the rest of the vegetables into 1 inch (2.5 cm) cubes and add to the pot. Slice the leek into rings. Cover and continue simmering for about 20 minutes. Stir as little as possible.
10. Top with fresh parsley.
title: Brun Lapskaus (Norwegian Beef Vegetable Stew)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
2. Shape into balls the size of a walnut.
3. Brown in 1/4 cup hot fat or vegetable oil.
4. Remove meat balls and make gravy.
5. Return meat balls to gravy; cook 15 to 20 minutes.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Swedish Meat Balls

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Beat egg yolks until light.
3. Add sugar and beat until thick.
4. Stir in pecans, crumbs and baking powder. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the batter.
5. Pour into a 9-inch cake tin that has been buttered and lined with waxed paper. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
6. Turn out on a cooling rack and peel off waxed paper while very warm.
7. Combine butter, cocoa, powdered sugar and cream, making a smooth frosting.
8. Add coffee and extract.
9. Bottom side up, sprinkle the cake with a little powdered sugar and pipe a border of the frosting around the edges.
10. Serve in wedges.
11. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Betty'S Swedish Nut Torte

steps: 1. Cut cucumbers into paper thin slices.
2. In bowl, mix slices with 2 teaspoons salt.
3. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Drain liquid from cucumbers.
4. Stir in vinegar, sugar, dill and pepper.
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving. Serves 8.
title: Danish Cucumbers

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup vegetable oil (or other neutral oil or melted butter)
2 cups sour milk (or buttermilk or milk soured with vinegar)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, beat the eggs well to combine, and then add in the sour milk and oil and mix well with a whisk (or hand mixer).
2. Add all of the dry ingredients to a separate bowl and whisk to combine.
3. Add the dry ingredients into the bowl with the wet ingredients, and whisk until everything is combined (or use a hand mixer).

4. Depending on your stovetop and your aebleskiver pan, you'll want the heat between medium and medium-low. I generally start at medium and lower down to medium-low as I work my way through the batch. Oil the wells of your pan (or don't, if you have a non-stick pan) and fill each well about 2/3 full with batter.

5. Cook until the edges set and you start to see some bubbles in the middle (like pancakes), and then flip them over (I like to use a chopstick) -- you'll be looking at a cooked dome. Cook until the aebleskiver is fully set -- if you aren't sure, pinch one open and check.
6. Remove cooked aebleskivers from pan and start another batch! Cooked aebleskivers can hang out in a bowl, or in an oven on low heat (I put them on a cooling rack set on a baking sheet in the oven).

7. Serve with whatever accoutrements you enjoy with pancakes. Growing up I never had them with syrup -- I used to treat each one like a mini Pac-Man: pop open its mouth, stuff it full with butter and jam, and eat it with my fingers. Now I'm okay with the transgression, and even endorse the syrupy, peanut butter, and banana mess pictured above.
title: Grammy Great'S Aebleskivers

steps: 1. Whisk together flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut shortening. Make a well in the center of the mixture, and quickly stir in ice cold water. Form dough into a ball. Set aside.
2. Dissolve the bouillon cube in 1/4 hot water. Combine uncooked vegetables, uncooked meats, salt, pepper, and bouillon.

3. Roll out pastry dough into 6 x 8 inch rectangles. Place about 1 1/2 cups of filling in the center of each rectangle. Bring 6 inch sides together, and seal. Cut a slit in the top of each pasty. Place on dull, not black, baking pans.
4. Bake at 425 degrees F (220 degrees C) for 45 minute.
title: Finnish Pasties

steps: 1. Beat eggs slightly.
2. Add sugar and beat lightly; do not overbeat.
3. Add cooled, melted margarine and flavoring.
4. Sift flour and cornstarch; add to egg mixture.
5. Dough will be sticky enough to be dropped by a spoon.
6. Bake on krumkake iron.
title: Krumkake

steps: 1. Add salt, pepper and onions to taste.
2. Shape into balls and bake about 1 hour.
title: Swedish Meat Balls

steps: 1. Mix first 3 ingredients like pie crust.
2. Pat into 2 strips 3 inches wide and the length of a cookie sheet.
3. In pan, bring to a boil, the next two ingredients.
4. Add 1 cup flour and 3 eggs one at a time, beating well and add 1 teaspoon almond extract.
5. Spread this on top of the two pie crust strips and bake 55 minutes at 350°.
6. When cool, frost with 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar, 1/4 cup margarine, 1 teaspoon almond extract and about 2 tablespoons milk. The only sugar is in the frosting.
title: Swedish Kringle

steps: 1. In a bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in extract. Sift together flour, cardamom and baking soda; add alternately with sour cream to creamed mixture. Fold in almonds. Divide dough into 6 parts; shape into logs (like refrigerated cookie dough). Place 3 each on 2 greased
2. . Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until light brown.

3. Remove logs to cutting board. Using a sharp knife, slice logs diagonally 1/2 in. thick. Place cookies on sheets; return to oven and bake until light brown. Cool; store in tightly covered containers.
title: Swedish Almond Rusks

steps: 1. Whisk eggs and sugar untill starting to thicken.
2. Add the flour, cardamum and melted butter.
3. Add the cold water in the end.
4. Stir into a nice smooth batter.
5. Leave the batter in the fridge for an hour or so. (or a day or two if you don't have the time to do the baking right now).
6. And here's the big deal - you have to cook them in a "krumkakejern", either one to use on your stove or and electrical one.

7. Add a tablesppon of batter onto the hot and greased (just the first one) iron. Cook light brown (need some practice) and roll into nice rolls, cool over a small dish to create small "cups" to fill with icecream, whipped cream and berries, or other desserts, or use a "krumkakeruller" which can be bougth in stores overseas (scandinavia), just as the iron. They should be thin and crisp.

8. These "cookies" taste wonderful, and in Norway you just have to have them for Christmas. They're a must, and if you've made them into small cups and fill them with wipped cream and cloudberries, and maybe some cloudberry liquor on top, it's the perfect dessert.
title: Uncle Odd'S "Krumkaker"

steps: 1. Place flour in a small bowl; cut in butter until crumbly. Gradually add water, tossing with a fork until dough holds together when pressed. Divide dough in half. On a lightly floured surface, roll each into a 14x2-1/2-in. rectangle. Transfer to an ungreased
2. ; curve one end of each pastry to form tops of canes. Refrigerate while preparing topping.

3. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large saucepan, combine water, butter and salt; bring to a rolling boil. Add flour all at once and beat until blended. Cook over medium heat, stirring vigorously until mixture pulls away from sides of pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes.
4. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition until smooth. Add extract; continue beating until mixture is smooth and shiny. Spread over pastry dough.
5. Bake 60-70 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Cool on pans 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack; cool completely.
6. In a small bowl, beat confectioners' sugar, butter, water and extract until smooth. Spread over pastries; sprinkle with almonds. Refrigerate leftovers.
title: Holiday Danish Puffs

steps: 1. Topping:
2. Melt butter in saucepan.
3. Stir in flour and add milk slowly.
4. Cook over low heat until thick.
5. Add eggs.
6. Cook over low heat, beating well, until consistency of mashed potatoes.
7. Add onion, cheese, salt and pepper; mix.
title: Danish Pork Chops

steps: 1. Stir bread crumbs into milk or water.
2. Mix well.
3. Beat in egg and onion.
4. Add salt, pepper, nutmeg and ground beef.
5. Mix thoroughly.
6. Divide meat mixture into 50 to 60 even portions. Shape into small balls.
7. Melt butter in skillet.
8. Add meat balls. Brown thoroughly, shaking pan occasionally to keep balls round. Add water.
9. Cover skillet.
10. Simmer 20 minutes.
11. Yields 50 to 60 small meat balls.
title: Kottbular(Swedish Meat Balls)

steps: 1. Use enough flour to roll out and bake on lefse plate at medium heat.
title: Cream Lefse(Rommebro)

steps: 1. Use enough flour to make a stiff dough.
2. Take a small piece of dough and roll into long round strips, forming figure eights. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
title: Kringler

steps: 1. Cut together butter and 1 c. flour like pie crust; add cold water.
2. Roll into ball.
3. Divide in half; spread on cookie sheet to size 4 X 12 (2 sections).
title: Danish Puff

steps: 1. Cream butter and confectioners sugar.
2. Add vanilla, flour, nuts and salt; mix.
3. Chill well.
4. Shape dough into crescents, using 1/2 teaspoon dough.
5. Put on cookie sheet.
6. Bake at 300° for 18 to 20 minutes.
7. Check to be sure they do not brown.
8. When done, roll in 1 cup confectioners sugar to which 1 teaspoon of vanilla has been added.
9. Makes between 6 and 7 dozen.
title: Swedish Crescents

steps: 1. Shred cabbage and toss with salt.
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
3. In a saucepan, heat sugar, vinegar, mustard and celery seed.
4. Cook until the sugar dissolves, about 10 minutes. Cool completely.
5. Add to the cabbage along with remaining vegetables; toss.
6. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 week before serving.
7. Keeps for 4 to 6 weeks in the refrigerator.
8. Yields 12 to 16 servings.
title: Norwegian Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, folding together gently.
2. Chill completely.
3. Serves 6 to 8. May be served with raspberry or strawberry sauce.
4. Canned mandarin oranges is my favorite.
title: Rice A La Malta(Swedish Recipe)

steps: 1. Add the spinach washed and chopped to the boiling stock. Simmer for 6 to 8 minutes.
2. Grind the whole thing in blender. Melt 1 1/2 ounces of butter in saucepan; remove the pan and stir flour in it.
3. With a wire whisk, beat the spinach into the saucepan; bring it to a boil.
4. Season the soup with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
5. Simmer for 5 minutes and stir occasionally.
6. Garnish each serving with a few slices of hard-boiled eggs.
title: Spinach Soup (Danish)

steps: 1. Combine rice, water and salt.
2. Bring to low boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
3. Cook milk, sugar, butter and rice over medium heat until thickened (30 to 45 minutes), stirring often.
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon and/or nutmeg before serving.
title: Swedish Rice

steps: 1. Wipe cucumbers with fresh damp cloth.
2. Score cucumber skin with fork and slice very thin.
3. Place slices in bowl and sprinkle with salt and sugar.
4. Add vinegar.
5. Press slices until quite juicy.
6. Place in jars and refrigerate.
title: Swedish Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Butter 2 quart casserole, combine potatoes, salt, pepper, onion, egg and 3 ounces Gruyere cheese.
3. Heat milk and cream to boiling in saucepan, combine with potato mixture.
4. Place in casserole, sprinkle with remaining cheese and dot with butter.
5. Bake 1 hour.
6. If top not browned, broil until lightly brown.
title: Swedish Potatoes

steps: 1. Shred cabbage and cook in small amount of unsalted water 8 minutes.
2. Drain well.
3. Place half of cabbage in buttered casserole.
4. Sprinkle with half of salt, pepper and paprika.
5. Dot with half of butter.
6. Add half of cheese.
7. Repeat layers, ending with cheese.
8. Beat eggs slightly with milk; pour over top.
9. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
title: Danish Cabbage Casserole

steps: 1. Wash cucumbers and slice cucumbers in thin slices. Some people may want to slice is squares or normal slices.
2. Place cucumbers is a bowl and mix in dill spic, mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
3. Stir together and taste for your own preferable balance of tartness or sweetness.
4. When you are finished mixing and balancing your preferred taste, you may then chill your dish.
5. It's now ready to eat! Yummy Yum!
title: Danish Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Place bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove bacon from the pan, and reserve the grease.
2. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour and baking powder. Stir in potatoes to make a sticky dough.

3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and add 2 teaspoons of salt. Squeeze the potato mixture into 6 or 7 dumplings, or your desired size. Drop carefully into the boiling water. Simmer for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove to a platter with a slotted spoon.
4. Serve with bacon grease brushed over the top, and crumbled bacon. These may also be sliced and fried the next day for another great meal.
title: Norwegian Potato Klub

steps: 1. Cook spinach in broth 10 minutes.
2. Drain, reserving liquid.
3. Melt butter and stir in flour.
4. When blended, add broth a little at a time.
5. Cover, simmer 5 minutes.
6. Add spinach, salt, pepper, nutmeg.
7. Mix thoroughly.
8. Simmer, covered, 5 minutes.
9. Serve with hard-boiled egg slices floating atop.
title: Norwegian Spinach Soup

steps: 1. In a large bowl, pour melted butter over oats. Stir well and set aside for 10 minutes.
2. In a separate bowl, mix egg, sugar and vanilla. Stir into the oat mixture, mixing well.
3. Add flour, coconut, nuts and baking powder, stir well. Add to the oat mixture.
4. Drop by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart onto parchment-lined or ungreased baking sheets.
5. Bake at 350°F for 9-11 minutes or until edges are lightly golden brown. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to wire racks.
title: Swedish Oatmeal Drops

steps: 1. Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl until well combined. Whisk together egg yolks, buttermilk, milk, vanilla extract, and butter in a large bowl until smooth. Whip egg whites in a clean bowl to soft peaks. Fold the flour mixture into the egg yolk mixture until blended, then fold in the whipped egg whites.

2. Preheat a Belgian waffle iron and coat with cooking spray. Spoon about 1/2 cup of batter per waffle, depending on the size of your waffle iron, onto the center of the hot iron. Close the lid and cook until steam stops coming out and the waffle is golden brown, about 90 seconds.
title: Rich Danish Waffles

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients together; lightly beat eggs and add with buttermilk and water to dry mix.
2. Mix well with a whisk and then add melted butter.
3. Stir into batter.
4. Makes about 15 waffles.
title: Norwegian Waffles(As Serves At T.M.Y.)

steps: 1. Blend first five ingredients.
2. Melt butter/margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Mix rest of ingredients in blender, pour in pan. Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.
4. It will rise and then fall upon removal from oven.
title: Swedish Egg Kake(A Breakfast Treat)

steps: 1. Vanilla custard
3. Separate the egg yolks and set aside the whites to use in the meringue.
5. Whisk together the egg yolks, cornstarch and sugar in a bowl.

7. Heat the cream and milk in a saucepan. Split open the vanilla pod and add the beans to the saucepan. Once the milk begins to bubble pour about half of it into the bowl with the egg mixture, whisking constantly. Then return the saucepan to the heat and pour the egg mixture back into the saucepan with remaining milk, whisking constantly. Once the mixture thickens lower the heat and continue whisking for about 30 seconds.
9. Pour the custard into a clean bowl and cover with plastic wrap, placing the plastic directly on the top layer of the custard. Chill in the fridge.
10. Cake

12. Mix together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time, setting aside the egg whites for the meringue. Add the flour mixed with baking powder. Stir in the milk, beating until smooth (you can use an electric mixer if you prefer).
14. Preheat oven to 320°F (160°C). Cover a baking sheet with baking paper and spread out the batter into a large, even rectangle.
15. Meringue topping
17. Whisk together the egg whites and sugar until you get glossy, stiff peaks. The meringue should hold its form – if it still melts continue whisking.

19. Spread out the meringue on top of the cake batter. Use a spatula to form light waves with the meringue. Sprinkle almonds on top of the meringue. Bake for about 30 minutes, until the meringue and almonds are golden.
20. Cream filling
22. Whisk the cream into stiff peaks. Carefully fold in the vanilla custard.
23. Assembly
25. Once the cake has cooled, cut it in half. You can use scissors for this, or a knife on a cutting board, slicing through the baking paper as well.
27. Place half of the cake on a serving platter with the meringue side down and peel off the baking paper.
29. Spread the cream filling across the cake. Then carefully remove the other half of the cake from the baking paper and place it over the cream filling, meringue side up.
31. Serve with fresh berries.
title: Kvæfjord Cake “Verdens Beste” (World’s Best Cake)

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a small saucepan.
2. Add the milk and warm it, but do not let it boil.
3. While the milk heats, beat the eggs, then beat the flour, baking powder and salt into the eggs.
4. Beat the milk and butter into the egg and flour mixture, mixing well. This will be a very thin batter.
5. Fry 5-inch pancakes on a lightly greased, very hot skillet.
6. Serve with maple syrup or topped with strawberries and whipped cream for a real treat.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Swedish Pancakes

steps: 1. Sift flour, soda, cinnamon and salt.
2. Beat eggs, add sugar, oil and vanilla.
3. Add dry ingredients.
4. Fold in chopped apples and nuts.
5. Bake at 350° in 9 x 13-inch greased pan for 40 to 50 minutes.
6. Serves 12 to 15.
7. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.
title: Swedish Apple Cake

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 12 x 16-inch pan.
2. Mix lightly with beater the milk and eggs, then add sugar, salt and flour.
3. Pour mixed batter over melted butter.
4. Bake at 450° for 25 minutes.
5. Serve with maple syrup.
6. Slice into squares.
7. Serves 10 to 15.
8. Good luck.
title: Finnish Pancakes

steps: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine ingredients.
2. Stir until blended.
3. Turn mixture into a 9-inch buttered pie pan.
4. Mixture will be stiff.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until lightly brown.
6. Serve warm or cold.
7. Serve with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.
8. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Norwegian Apple Pie

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and spices.
2. Add raisins and stir well, making sure to coat the raisins in the flour mixture.

3. Add melted butter, molasses and water and mix with a wooden spoon. Form a ball with the spoon or your hands and put the dough ball in a cotton pudding bag. Tie the bag, leaving at least 1 inch of room to allow the pudding to expand while cooking.
4. Boil pudding for 1.5 hours. (In NL, this is typically done in the pot along with Jiggs Dinner, but it can be done independently.)
5. When the duff is firm, remove it from the boiling water and let it cool slightly before removing it from the pudding bag.

6. Slice pudding like a cake and serve with the warm sauce of your choice: rum butter sauce, warmed molasses or Molasses Coady sauce (1 cup (250 mL) molasses, 1/4 cup (60 mL) butter, 1/4 cup (60 mL) water) is common in Newfoundland.
title: Figgy Duff

steps: 1. In a large bowl, with an electric mixer, mix the butter and sugar till the mix is light.
2. Add eggs and vanilla and mix.
3. In another bowl, mix flour and baking powder.
4. Alternate flour mix and milk to the butter mix.
5. Pour into a 13 inch by 9 inch greased pan.
6. MAPLE SAUCE.
7. In a large casserole, bring to boil the syrup, brown sugar, cream and butter and constantly stir.
8. Reduce heat and and gently cook 2 minutes or till sauce has reduced a little bit.
9. Pour sauce gently over cake.
10. Bake at 325°f (160°c) about 35 minutes or till cake is light brown and when toothpick inserted comes out clean.
title: Pouding chomeur

steps: 1. To make the cure, in a small bowl mix together salt, pink salt, black pepper, coriander, sugar, bay leaf, and cloves. Coat entire brisket with the cure and place in an extra-large resealable plastic bag. Place in the coldest part of the refrigerator and cure for 4 days, flipping brisket twice a day.

2. Remove brisket from bag and wash as much cure off as possible under cold running water. Place brisket in a large container and fill with water and let soak for 2 hours, replacing water every 30 minutes. Remove from water and pat dry with paper towels.

3. To make the rub, mix together black pepper, coriander, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dill weed, mustard, celery seed, and crushed red papper in a small bowl. Coat entire brisket with the rub.

4. Fire up smoker or grill to 225 degrees, adding chunks of smoking wood chunks when at temperature. When wood is ignited and producing smoke, place brisket in, fat side up, and smoke until an instant read thermometer registers 165 degrees when inserted into thickest part of the brisket, about 6 hours.

5. Transfer brisket to large roasting pan with V-rack. Place roasting pan over two burners on stovetop and fill with 1-inch of water. Bring water to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to medium, cover roasting pan with aluminum foil, and steam brisket until an instant read thermometer registers 180 degrees when inserted into thickest part of the meat, 1 to 2 hours, adding more hot water as needed.
6. Transfer brisket to cutting board and let cool slightly. Slice and serve, preferably on rye with mustard.
title: Montreal Smoked Meat

steps: 1. The night before, break salt beef into big chunks and soak in water overnight, at least 8-10 hours. Put split peas into a bowl and cover with water to soak overnight.

2. Drain the salt beef and place it into a large stockpot. Cover with fresh water, at least 6-7 litres. Place the split peas into a pease pudding canvas bag or triple layer of cheesecloth and tie, making sure to leave room for peas to expand inside the bag.
3. Put the bag inside the pot, tying the strings to the outside handle so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pot with the salt beef. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 2 hours.
4. Remove the peas pudding bag and empty contents into a bowl, mixing with butter and pepper for taste. Set aside.
5. Add your cabbage to the pot and boil for 20 more minutes. Then add turnip, carrots and potatoes then boil for 20 more, or until vegetables are tender.
6. Remove salt beef and vegetables from the pot and put them on a platter.
7. Use the cooking liquid in two ways; as a pot liquor which some people like to drink or reduce it to make a jus or gravy to pour over the meal.
title: Jiggs Dinner

steps: 1. For the Big Mac sauce, combine all the ingredients in a bowl, season with salt and chill until ready to use.

2. 2. To make the patties, season the mince with salt and pepper and form into 4 balls using about 1/3 cup mince each. Place each onto a square of baking paper and flatten to form into four x 15cm circles. Heat oil in a large frypan over high heat. In 2 batches, cook beef patties for 1-2 minutes each side until lightly charred and cooked through. Remove from heat and keep warm. Repeat with remaining two patties.
3. 3. Carefully slice each burger bun into three acrossways, then lightly toast.

4. 4. To assemble the burgers, spread a little Big Mac sauce over the bottom base. Top with some chopped onion, shredded lettuce, slice of cheese, beef patty and some pickle slices. Top with the middle bun layer, and spread with more Big Mac sauce, onion, lettuce, pickles, beef patty and then finish with more sauce. Top with burger lid to serve.
5. 5. After waiting half an hour for your food to settle, go for a jog.
title: Big Mac

ingredients.text: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) chicken, cut into pieces

steps: 1. Place buttermilk in shallow bowl.
2. Combine flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
3. Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk; place 2 or 3 pieces at a time in bag.
4. Shake to coat.
5. In a large, deep frying pan, place oil and heat at 375°.
6. Add chicken pieces (do not crowd); cook until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
7. Drain on paper towels before serving.
8. Serves 6.
title: Southern Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Cut up and sprinkle salt and pepper over chicken pieces.
2. In separate container, mix eggs with milk and Worcestershire sauce. Dip chicken in this mixture, then flour it well.
3. Then place it in the frying pan that has been preheated to 350°.
4. Cook about 20 minutes until golden brown.
5. Serves 4.
title: Delicious Southern Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter and vegetable oil in a skillet over low heat. Combine flour and salt; coat chicken with mixture and fry over low heat until browned on one side; turn to brown on all sides evenly.
2. Add water.
3. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, adding more water if necessary.
4. Uncover and cook for 15 minutes.
5. Makes about 4 servings.
title: Southern Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Melt margarine in

title: Easy Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Shake chicken in bag of flour and seasonings. Line 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish with foil; add margarine and place dish in oven until margarine sizzles.
3. Place chicken in dish, skin down.
4. Bake for 30 minutes; turn and bake another 30 minutes.
5. Do not cover.
6. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Melt butter in saucepan.
3. Mix cereal crumbs, onion, salt and pepper in a bowl.
4. Dip chicken in butter, then into cereal mixture.
5. Place skin side up in ungreased baking pan.
6. Pour remaining butter over chicken.
7. Bake, uncovered, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done.
8. Serves 4.
title: Crunchy Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. In a pie pan, combine crumbs, cheese, parsley, salt, thyme and pepper.
3. In an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish, melt butter with garlic powder.
4. Dip chicken pieces in garlic-butter, then in crumb mixture.
5. Place in baking dish, skin side up.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 55 to 65 minutes, until chicken is tender.
7. Do not turn chicken pieces during baking.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Golden Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Cut chicken into serving pieces.
2. Place flour, meal, salt, pepper and paprika into a paper bag.
3. Shake several times to mix. Place 2 pieces at a time in bag so that chicken is well coated. Put melted butter in baking dish large enough for chicken to lie flat.
4. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.
5. Turn chicken several times during baking to assure browning.
6. Serves 4.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Cook onion, garlic and green pepper in hot oil in skillet until soft.
2. Add zucchini, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
3. Cover; cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until zucchini is tender. Serve topped with parsley and Parmesan cheese.
4. Makes 8 servings.
title: Creole Zucchini

ingredients.text: 3 lb. raw shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Heat oil.
2. Saute next 4 ingredients until tender.
3. Add tomatoes and brown.
4. Stir in paprika, cayenne, salt and water. Add a bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Add shrimp and continue simmering for 10 to 12 minutes.
6. Thicken sauce with cornstarch mixed with a little cold water.
7. Serve with rice.
8. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Shrimp Creole

steps: 1. For basting sauce, saut onions and celery in the butter until soft. Add tomato puree, vinegar and molasses. Blend well. Place meat on a roasting rack in pan. Brush with part of the sauce. Bake at 350° for about 1 1/2 hours or until pork is tender and juices run clear when pierced with a fork. Do brush the pork from time to time during cooking for best flavor. Cooking time depends on thickness of meat. Makes 4 servings.
title: Southern Pork Loin

steps: 1. Dip chicken pieces in mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Melt fat in shallow baking pan in hot (400°) oven. Remove pan from oven.
3. Place floured chicken in pan, turning to coat with butter.
4. Leave skin side down.
5. Keep chicken in single layer.
6. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
7. Turn chicken and bake for 30 minutes or until tender.
8. Serves 4.
title: Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Arrange fish in greased shallow baking pan or casserole. Saute onion and green pepper in margarine.
2. Add seasonings and tomatoes.
3. Pour over fish.
4. Bake at 375°
5. for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Fish Creole

steps: 1. Cut steak into serving size pieces.
2. Blend egg and milk.
3. Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs.
4. Slowly brown meat in hot oil, turning once. Cover and cook over low heat 45 to 60 minutes until tender.
5. Season.
6. Serves 6.
title: Chicken Fried Steak

steps: 1. Brown sausage in heavy skillet.
2. Remove from drippings.
3. Add flour to drippings.
4. Brown flour until dark.
5. Add onions, parsley and garlic.
6. Cook until soft, then add water and rice, salt and pepper and sausage.
7. When it comes to a boil, lower heat to lowest point and cook for about 1 hour, covered tightly.
8. When rice is done, remove lid and let cook for a few minutes until rice dries a little.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Jambalaya

steps: 1. Fill Dutch oven or deep fryer 1/3 full with shortening.
2. Heat to 350°.
3. Combine flour and seasoning in plastic bag.
4. Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk, then into flour mixture.
5. Fry in hot shortening 12 to 15 minutes.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Line shallow baking dish with aluminum foil.
2. Combine corn flakes, salt, paprika and pepper.
3. Blend together mustard, vinegar, Tabasco, Worcestershire sauce, then stir in Pet milk. Dip chicken in milk mixture, then roll in corn flake mixture. Place on foil lined baking dish, skin side up.
4. Do not crowd. Bake 1 hour at 350° uncovered.
5. Do not turn.
6. Serves 8.
title: Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine first eight ingredients.
2. Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat.
3. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
4. Remove chicken from marinade; coat each piece with crumbs.
5. Arrange on a shallow baking pan.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until juices run clear. Yield:
7. 8 servings.
8. Diabetic Exchanges:
9. One serving equals 3 1/2 lean meat, 1 starch, 1/4 skim milk; also, 271 calories, 293 mg sodium, 76 mg cholesterol, 22 gm carbohydrate, 32 gm protein and 5 gm fat.
title: Better Than Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Sift together the dry ingredients.
2. Mix egg, milk and 1 tablespoon corn oil.
3. Add to flour mixture and beat.
4. Dip chicken into batter, coating completely. Drain.
5. Pour corn oil into deep fryer or 3-quart saucepan.
6. Heat oil to 375°.
7. Carefully add chicken, a few pieces at a time. Fry about 4 minutes; drain. Place in a shallow baking pan and bake in a 350° oven about 30 minutes or until tender.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Two-Step Batter Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in large pan.
2. Saute onion, green pepper and garlic until tender.
3. Add chicken, ham and sausage.
4. Cook 5 minutes.
5. Add remaining ingredients.
6. Mix well.
7. Bring to boil.
8. Cover and reduce heat.
9. Cook approximately 20 minutes to 25 minutes or until rice is done and liquid is absorbed.
10. Serves 8.
title: Jambalaya

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy pot; slowly brown meat and sausage and sprinkle with flour and blend in.
2. Add onion, pepper, celery, seasoning and 1 cup water.
3. Cook very slowly over low heat for about 10 minutes or until vegetables wilt.
4. Add remaining water and rice.
5. Bring to
6. a boil, stirring frequently to mix meat and rice.
7. Cook over low heat, covered, until rice is tender.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Pork Jambalaya

steps: 1. Mix flour, salt and pepper in a plastic bag.
2. Add one or two pieces of chicken at a time in the bag and shake to coat thoroughly.
3. In large frypan, place oil and heat to high temperature (425°).
4. Add chicken, skin side down, and cook for 10 minutes, turning often or until brown on all sides.
5. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook about 20 minutes longer or until fork inserts into chicken with ease.
6. Serves 4.
title: Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. smoked sausage (hot and mild may be combined)
1/2 Tbsp. garlic salt (2 toes of diced garlic)

steps: 1. Cut sausage into 1/2-inch slices and brown in heavy 3-quart saucepan or Dutch oven. Add diced onions and green peppers. Saute until onion is clear. Add remaining spices and stir well. Add the hot water and bring to a boil. Add the uncooked rice and stir once to mix ingredients. Cover and cook over a low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until rice is tender and fluffy. (If mild sausage only is used, add a dash of Louisiana hot sauce or 1/4 teaspoon red pepper.) Serve with a green salad and favorite beverage.
2. Serves 4.
title: Sausage Jambalaya

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Melt margarine in pan.
3. Mix all dry ingredients.
4. Coat chicken.
5. Place chicken skin side down in pan.
6. Bake in covered overproof 13x9x2 pan for 35 minutes.
7. Turn chicken and continue baking until done.
8. (Approximately 25 minutes longer.)
9. Makes 4 servings.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. uncooked shrimp, cleaned and split lengthwise

steps: 1. In large skillet, saute onion, green pepper and rice in shortening until onion is transparent.
2. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer, stirring occasionally with fork, until rice is tender, about 40 minutes.
3. Makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Bayou Jambalaya

ingredients.text: 2 to 3 lb. frying chicken, cut in serving size pieces

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400° (moderately hot).
2. Coat chicken with mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
3. Dip in mixture of eggs and milk which has been slightly beaten.
4. Roll in Parmesan cheese and bread crumb mixture.
5. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
6. Melt butter and oil in shallow baking pan in heated oven.
7. Place coated chicken, skin-side down in pan.
8. Bake 30 minutes.
9. Turn skin-side up and continue baking until tender, about 30 minutes.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Brown pork in heavy skillet.
2. Remove and place in oblong baking dish.
3. Add 1/2 cup water to skillet and onions, mushroom and celery.
4. Saute until tender.
5. Mix 1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon flour, add to vegetables.
6. Stir until thickened.
7. Pour veggies over meat, cover and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until fork-tender.
8. Serves 5 to 6. Serve with rice.
title: Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 4 slices bread, made into fresh bread crumbs (use food processor)
1 chicken (3 to 4 lb.), cut up and skin removed

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Coat a 13 x 9-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray.
3. Put milk in a shallow dish.
4. Mix remaining ingredients except chicken in a medium size bowl.
5. Dip each piece of chicken in milk, then in crumbs, pressing so crumbs adhere to form a thick, even coating.
6. Arrange meaty sides up in a single layer in prepared pan.
7. Bake 1 hour or until browned and juices run clear.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Crumb Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat; add chicken and cook 10 minutes.
2. Turn chicken; add mushrooms and shallots.
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper; cook 10 minutes or until tender.
4. Transfer chicken to platter; sprinkle cheese over chicken.
5. Top with mushrooms and shallots.
6. Cover and let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
7. Yields 4 servings.
title: Special Occasion Chicken

steps: 1. Combine first nine ingredients; mix well.
2. Beat the eggs puffy, fold into carrot mixture.
3. Pour into a well-greased 1 1/2-quart ring mold.
4. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
5. Turn out onto a warm platter.
6. Fill center with warmed sweet English peas. Garnish outside ring with parsley.
7. Serves 8 to 12.
title: Carrot Ring

steps: 1. Drain pineapple and set aside in refrigerator to chill. Combine sour cream, honey and candied ginger.
2. Chill.
3. Spoon over chilled and drained pineapple chunks in individual serving dishes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
4. A nice dessert.
title: Gingered Pineapple

steps: 1. Heat a small amount of oil in a large skillet; fry chicken until browned.
2. Drain;
3. place chicken in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.
4. In a saucepan, saut onion in butter until tender, stir in remaining ingredients.
5. Simmer, uncovered for 15 minutes. Pour over chicken.
6. Bake at 350 about 1 hour or until chicken is done, baking occasionally.
7. Yield:
8. 6-8 servings.
title: Oven Barbecue Chicken

steps: 1. Spray casserole with Pam.
2. Mix all ingredients together.
3. Chill in refrigerator overnight.
4. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
5. Great for brunches!
6. Serves 10 people.
title: Christmas Eggs

steps: 1. Combine meat, rice, onion and salt.
2. Mix well and form into balls.
3. Place in a deep baking dish.
4. Combine juice, sugar, Worcestershire sauce and salt to taste.
5. Pour over meatballs. Cover dish.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Serve hot.
8. Yields 5 to 6 servings.
title: Porcupine Balls

steps: 1. Place banana and peanut butter in a blender.
2. Mix until smooth. Slowly add ice cream, then milk.
3. Mix until smooth.
4. Serves 2.
title: Summer Coolers

steps: 1. Mix egg, milk, salt and pepper.
2. Beat slightly.
3. Add crackers. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Mix well.
5. Shape mixture and bake. This recipe makes 4 meat loaves.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Meat Loaves

steps: 1. In a small plastic bag, put flour, salt, pepper and chili powder.
2. Add stew meat; shake to coat well.
3. In heavy pan, heat oil.
4. Add meat and brown.
5. Cook meat at medium-low heat for 30 minutes.
6. You will need to add water to meat occasionally.
7. This will make a nice gravy.
8. Add onion and celery; let cook for another 15 to 20 minutes, adding water as needed.
9. Add carrots and potatoes; cook until tender, adding water as needed.
10. Serves 6.
title: Beef Stew Ala Fitz

steps: 1. Divide meat into eight portions.
2. Flatten each portion into a thin patty.
3. In a small bowl, combine cheeses with a fork until well blended.
4. Add garlic and onion, mixing well.
5. Divide the cheese mixture between four patties, topping with the remaining patties.
6. Seal each patty.
7. Place on a platter and put in the freezer about 1/2 hour before grilling to seal patties well. Grill over hot charcoal until well browned.
8. Serves 4.
title: Blueburgs

steps: 1. Wash zucchini and cut into 1/4-inch slices.
2. Cook in small amount of salted water until soft.
3. Place in casserole.
4. Combine milk, egg and cheese.
5. Pour over zucchini. Dot with butter.
6. Bake in a hot 400° oven until cheese is melted and the top nicely browned.
7. Serves 4.
title: Zucchini And Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. Pour orange juice in freezer container.
2. Freeze until slushy. Using a blender, add milk, sugar and vanilla.
3. Blend well.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sunshine Sipper

steps: 1. Cube meat, brown and drain.
2. Beat eggs; add milk, mustard and bread.
3. Stir in cheese and meat.
4. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
5. Before baking remove foil.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 large chicken breasts, split and boned

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Stir together butter and seasonings. Loosen skin on one side of each chicken breast to form pockets, keeping remaining outer edges intact.
3. Place about 1 tablespoons of butter-herb mixture in each pocket.
4. Close pocket and press, smoothing mixture under skin.
5. Place chicken, skin side up, in shallow baking pan.
6. Place chicken, skin side up, in shallow baking pan.
7. Bake for about 35 minutes or until juices run clear; baste occasionally with pan drippings.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Yields 8 servings.
title: Chicken Breasts Tarragon

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. fryer chicken, cut up and skinned

steps: 1. Coat chicken pieces with flour and salt.
2. Melt butter in skillet.
3. Place chicken in skillet; turn once.
4. Separately, combine all other ingredients in a saucepan.
5. Bring to a boil. Pour mixture over chicken in skillet.
6. Cover and cook over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, until chicken is tender.
7. Serves 4 nicely.
title: Christmas Chicken

steps: 1. Cook the rutabaga until soft (about 20 minutes) in salted water to cover; drain and mash.
2. Soak the bread crumbs in the cream and stir in the nutmeg, salt and beaten eggs; combine with the rutabaga.
3. Turn into a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole, dot with butter and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until lightly browned.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Rutabaga Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon over medium heat until crispy; drain on paper towels.
2. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat.
3. Slice zucchini; add to hot fat.
4. Add onion and garlic.
5. Cook, stirring often, until soft, but not mushy.
6. Add tomatoes.
7. Cook for 2 minutes.
8. Serve with bacon crumbled over top.
9. Serves 4.
title: Sauteed Zucchini

steps: 1. Brush the zucchini with olive oil and arrange the zucchini slices in a baking pan.
2. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, Mozzarella, salt, pepper and oregano.
3. Broil for about 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Grilled Zucchini

steps: 1. Combine corn syrup, sugar and vinegar in saucepan.
2. Cook to hard ball stage or 260° on candy thermometer, stirring frequently. Remove from heat.
3. Stir in soda and butter.
4. Beat until smooth and creamy. Spread on buttered dish.
5. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Pull taffy with buttered hands until firm.
6. Yields 24 servings.
title: Taffy

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. cooked long grain rice, cooked without salt or fat

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl; stir well.
2. Divide mixture in half, shaping each portion into a 3/4-inch thick patty.
3. Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray.
4. Place over medium heat until hot.
5. Add patties; cook 5 minutes on each side or until done. Yields 2 servings.
title: Chicken Burgers

steps: 1. Peel shrimp, leaving tails on.
2. Devein and butterfly.
3. Cook shrimp in boiling water 1 minute.
4. Drain and place in shallow baking dish.
5. Saute onion, green pepper and celery in 1/4 cup butter in skillet.
6. Combine crab meat and next 6 ingredients.
7. Mix, then stir into sauteed vegetables.
8. Top each shrimp with 3 tablespoons crab meat mixture.
9. Sprinkle with paprika and drizzle butter over shrimp.
10. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
11. Baste occasionally.
12. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Crab-Stuffed Shrimp

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Use a small baking dish.
3. Peel, half and core pears.
4. Combine butter, brown sugar, curry powder and salt; mix with a spoon.
5. Cook 35 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Curried Pears

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except pork chops, simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. Cool, pour over pork chops in bowl.
3. Refrigerate for several hours.
4. Arrange chops in shallow baking pan; pour sauce over.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
6. Baste with sauce occasionally.
7. Yields 2 servings.
title: Barbecue Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 1 lb. raw shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. Shell and devein shrimp.
2. In heavy skillet, heat margarine and add garlic.
3. Cook, stirring briefly, without browning.
4. Add shrimp and stir briefly.
5. Add remaining ingredients and cook until shrimp are no longer translucent (about 5 minutes).
6. Do not overcook. Serve over rice.
7. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. Place apples in bottom of a greased 8-inch square pan.
2. In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
3. Sprinkle over apples.
4. Bake 30 minutes or until apples are golden.
5. Serves 4.
6. Delicious with ice cream or yogurt!
title: Apple Crackle

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine flour and salt; cut in shortening until crumbly. Gradually add water, tossing with a fork until a ball forms. On a lightly floured surface, roll out pastry into a 10-in. square; brush with 1 tablespoon butter. Fold into thirds. Roll into a 10-in. x 6-in. rectangle; cut lengthwise into four strips. Brush with butter.
2. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle half over the strips. Place an apple wedge on each; wrap pastry around apple. Line a baking sheet with foil and coat the foil with cooking spray.
3. Place wraps on prepared pan. Brush with remaining butter; sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 400° for 28-32 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Yield: 2 servings.
title: Cinnamon Apple Wraps

steps: 1. Season beef with salt and pepper.
2. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Dredge with flour and brown in hot oil.
3. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of oil in pan; push beef to one side and saute garlic, onion and tomatoes until mixture is mushy.
4. Add vinegar, bay leaf and enough water to cover beef.
5. Bring to a boil; lower heat and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until beef is tender.
6. Taste for seasoning.
7. Bring back to boiling; add green beans and carrots and cook until vegetables are done (about 10 minutes).
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Estofadong Carne(Tangy Braised Beef)

steps: 1. Lightly mix ground beef, pecans, salt and pepper.
2. Shape into 4 patties.
3. Brown on both sides.
4. Drain.
5. Add wine and onion. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Remove patties to platter.
7. Blend water and cornstarch.
8. Add to pan juices.
9. Cook and stir until boiling.
10. Pour over patties on serving platter.
11. Makes 4 servings.
title: Burgundy Pecan Burgers

steps: 1. Saute the sausage, drain all the grease and set aside. Beat the eggs, add milk, salt and mustard, stir. Layer the bread cubes on the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Then layer the sausage, followed by cheese. Pour the egg mixture over the top, cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Christmas Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 medium zucchini, cut in slices or chunks
12 oz. frozen tofu, thawed, rinsed, squeezed dry and crumbled

steps: 1. Steam zucchini until tender.
2. Mix in a large bowl the Cheddar cheese, tofu, eggs, salt, dill weed and croutons.
3. Add well drained zucchini and stir gently.
4. Turn into a shallow, oiled 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 3 as a main dish or 6 as a side dish.
title: Cheesy Zucchini Puff

steps: 1. Peel and slice eggplant.
2. Steam until tender; drain.
3. Blend soup, mayonnaise, beaten egg, onion and cheese. Fold cooked and drained eggplant into this mixture.
4. Put in buttered dish and top with Ritz crackers or Pepperidge stuffing.
5. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Baked Eggplant

steps: 1. Stir until thick.
2. Get a tablespoon and get out the mix.
3. You can get a pouring pitcher.
4. Fix the mix; make little pancakes on top of the stove on high heat.
5. Serves 1.
title: Fritters

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken on both sides with garlic, basil, thyme and pepper.
2. Arrange chicken in shallow bowl.
3. Mix together vinegar and orange juice; pour over chicken.
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
5. Place chicken on broiler pan.
6. Set temperature control at broil, 500°.
7. Arrange oven rack so chicken is about 4 inches from heat.
8. Broil, turning, about 6 minutes per side, or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease.
9. Sprinkle with salt.
10. Serve with wild rice, pouring pan drippings over rice. Makes 2 servings.
title: Broiled Marinated Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except salmon.
2. Pour mixture over salmon in shallow glass pan.
3. Marinate 1 hour.
4. Preheat nonstick skillet; remove fillets from marinade and saute 5 minutes on each side.
5. Remove to warm platter.
6. Bring remaining marinade to a boil; pour over fillets and serve.
7. Serves 4.
title: Sauteed Salmon Fillets

steps: 1. Saut (cook slow with butter) the onions, green pepper and ground beef until vegetables are tender. Drain well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done. Yields 8 servings.
title: Texas Hash

ingredients.text: 1 boneless pork loin roast (3 to 4 lb.)

steps: 1. In blender or food processor, combine garlic, oil, rosemary and salt.
2. Blend until it turns into a paste.
3. Rub over roast and let stand 30 minutes.
4. Place on a greased baking rack, fat side up, in a roasting pan.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until internal temperature is 160° to 170°.
6. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.
7. Yields 10 to 12 servings.
title: Tuscan Roast Pork

steps: 1. Fix peppers and remove seeds.
2. Put peppers into boiling water for 2 or 3 minutes.
3. Remove and drain.
4. Cook rice as directed. Brown ground beef and onion.
5. Add to rice and mix.
6. Stuff peppers with mixture.
7. Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
8. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Stuffed Green Peppers

steps: 1. In large bowl, gently toss strawberries with sugar; cover. Refrigerate 2 hours, tossing occasionally.
2. Just before serving, alternately spoon strawberries, raspberries and blueberries into large bowl.
3. Combine ice cream with orange peel.
4. Spoon some on top of berries to garnish.
5. Pass remainder in small bowl.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Makes 10 servings.
title: Very Berry Compote

steps: 1. Wash berries and place in sherbet dishes. Stir brown sugar into cream and spoon mixture on berries.
2. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Brown Berries

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Peel and slice onions.
3. Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet.
4. Add onions and green pepper.
5. Cook until tender.
6. Stir in chopped pimiento.
7. Place half of onion mixture in shallow baking dish.
8. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs.
9. Repeat layers of onions and cheese.
10. Beat eggs with light cream, salt and pepper.
11. Pour over onions. Combine remaining cracker crumbs with melted butter.
12. Sprinkle over top.
13. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until set.
14. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Vidalia Onion Scallop

ingredients.text: 4 lb. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed

steps: 1. Combine all, except pecans.
2. Pour into a greased, 2 1/2-quart casseorle.
3. Arrange pecans around the edge.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Yummy Yams

steps: 1. Cook zucchini whole until tender-crisp.
2. Drain and cut into 1/2-inch slices.
3. Saute onions in shortening.
4. Add ground meat and brown lightly.
5. Drain.
6. Add crumbs, salt, pepper and oregano. Melt butter in pan; add flour.
7. Add milk; stir.
8. Cook until thickened.
9. Add cheese; stir until melted.
10. Place 1/2 of zucchini in 2-quart casserole, then 1/2 of beef, then cheese sauce.
11. Repeat layers.
12. Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.
13. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Beef Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Spray crock-pot with nonstick spray.
2. Mix dry ingredients together.
3. Stir in peaches and pour in crock-pot.
4. Cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.
5. Serves 6.
title: That'S Good Peaches - Crock-Pot Style

steps: 1. Combine and pound the flour, salt and pepper into the steak. Brown slowly in shortening in a heavy skillet.
2. Pour tomatoes over meat.
3. Top with sliced onion.
4. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Cover and bake about 1 hour, until steak is fork-tender.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swiss Steak

ingredients.text: 2 strawberries, fresh and sliced for garnish (optional)

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, combine the rhubarb, 2 tablespoons sugar and water. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until tender. Transfer to a small bowl; cool to room temperature.

2. Place strawberries and remaining sugar in a food processor; cover and process until pureed. Stir into rhubarb mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon into two parfait glasses or dessert dishes. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Garnish with additional berries if desired. Yield: 2 servings.
3. Note: If using frozen rhubarb, measure rhubarb while still frozen, then thaw completely. Drain in a colander, but do not press liquid out.
title: Strawberry Rhubarb Cream

steps: 1. In a large pot, place onions in water to cover.
2. Cook for 10 minutes.
3. Remove.
4. With one fork, secure onion; pull out 1/2 inch onion center with another fork.
5. Fill with cheese.
6. Place in a greased baking dish.
7. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, until tender. Serves 6.
title: Cheesy Red Onions

ingredients.text: 1 small Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored and cubed

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients.
2. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
3. Serves 2.
4. Contains 185 calories, 6 gm fat and 81 mg sodium.
title: Apple Yogurt Treat

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. In large Dutch oven, melt margarine in oil.
3. Add cut-up chicken, turning until golden (5 to 10 minutes). Tilt pan and spoon off all but 2 tablespoons fat.
4. Add garlic and stir.
5. Sprinkle with lemon, thyme, salt, pepper and water.
6. Cover tightly and bake 1 1/2 hours.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken With 40 Cloves Of Garlic

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Brown chops in hot fat.
3. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over chops.
4. Bake in slow oven (325°) for 1 1/2 hours.
5. Turn chops once during baking.
6. Makes 8 servings.
title: Barbecued Pork Chops

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Combine first 11 ingredients in a shallow 9 x 13-inch dish.
3. Cover tightly and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and stir in carrots and celery.
4. Bake, covered, 40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
5. Stir in green pepper and parsley. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top.
6. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes until cheese melts.
7. Serves 6.
title: Baked Lentils With Cheese

steps: 1. Clean and slice mushrooms.
2. Heat butter in skillet.
3. Add mushrooms to skillet.
4. Cook slowly, occasionally turning until brown.
5. Makes 2 servings.
title: Fried Mushrooms

steps: 1. Saute scallops in butter with wine.
2. Add garlic powder and salt.
3. Add onion, green pepper and mushrooms when scallops are half done.
4. Stir in tomato just before serving.
5. Serve with rice (wild rice is best).
6. Sprinkle with paprika and garnish with lemon.
7. Makes 2 to 3 servings.
title: Saute Of Scallops

steps: 1. Mix sugar and flour together.
2. Beat eggs well; mix with sugar and flour.
3. Add the pineapple.
4. Put in a greased baking dish. Crumble bread on top; slice the stick of butter on top.
5. Bake for 1 hour at 400°.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
7. Delicious served as a side dish with baked ham.
title: Baked Pineapple

ingredients.text: 7 slices bread, trimmed and in pieces

steps: 1. Butter a 7 x 10-inch casserole dish.
2. In one bowl, mix eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper.
3. In another bowl, mix bread and cheese.
4. Place cheese and bread in casserole dish.
5. Pour egg mixture over bread and cheese.
6. Refrigerate overnight.
7. Sprinkle with bacon bits.
8. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
9. Serves 8.
title: Christmas Morning Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. butter, melted or substitute with nonfat

steps: 1. Rinse salmon and pat dry. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Mix well and brush over salmon. Place salmon on an oil grill over medium heat for about 5 minutes per side, basting with butter. Fish is done when it reaches an internal temperature of 150° and flakes easily when tested with a fork. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Barbecued Salmon

steps: 1. Put all ingredients, except nutmeg, into blender with 1 cup ice cubes.
2. Whip 30 seconds. Pour into tall glasses.
3. Dust with nutmeg. Serve at once. Makes 2 servings.
title: Banana Nog

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
2. Drain. Spoon into casserole.
3. Layer rice, potatoes, onion, green pepper and tomatoes over ground beef.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until rice and vegetables are tender.
5. Yields 4 servings.
title: Six In One

steps: 1. Brown onion and celery in oleo until tender.
2. Add salt, paprika and pepper.
3. Add chicken and brown about 10 minutes. Cover with water and cook 45 minutes.
4. Make paste of sour cream and flour.
5. Add and stir until it comes to a boil.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Chicken Paprikish

ingredients.text: 4 medium-size green tomatoes, cut into 1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in shallow dish; set aside.
2. Dip tomato slices in water; dredge in cornmeal mixture.
3. Place on baking sheet coated with cooking spray; spray each slice of tomato.
4. Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes more or until golden.
5. Serve immediately.
6. Yields 8 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Green Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups crisp rice cereal, coarsely crushed
4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (4 ounces each)

steps: 1. In a shallow bowl, combine cereal, flour and seasonings.
2. Place butter in another shallow bowl.
3. Dip chicken in butter, then roll in cereal mixture.
4. Place in a greased 11-in. x 7-in. x 2-in. baking pan.
5. Drizzle with remaining butter.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 20-25 minutes or until juices run clear.
7. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Crispy Chicken

steps: 1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce.
2. Place in a baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar.
3. Pour remaining soy sauce over chicken. Bake, uncovered, for 1/2 hour at 350°.
4. Uncover.
5. Add pepper and pineapple.
6. Bake 1/2 hour longer.
7. Serves 6.
title: Hawaiian Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together except bread crumbs and butter. Pour into an ungreased 1-quart casserole dish.
2. Toss bread crumbs in butter; sprinkle over seafood mixture.
3. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Serves 6.
title: Baked Crab And Shrimp Casserole

ingredients.text: 6 medium carrots, sliced into 1/2-inch thick pieces
8 oz. fresh mushrooms, cut in half

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Cut turkey into 1/2 x 1/2-inch slices. Heat oil in 5-quart pot (suitable for baking) over medium heat until oil is hot, about 1 minute.
3. Place turkey, potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in pan.
4. Cook and stir frequently until turkey is no longer pink, about 10 minutes.
5. Sprinkle flour over turkey mixture.
6. Cook and stir 1 minute.
7. Stir in chicken broth, wine, thyme and pepper and bring to a boil.
8. Add mushrooms.
9. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
10. Stir in parsley.
11. Serves 4.
title: California "Blonde" Stew

ingredients.text: 1 lb. bulk sausage, crumbled and browned
12 slices white bread, cubed, including crust

steps: 1. In 3-quart casserole dish, layer bread, cheese and sausage. Repeat.
2. Beat eggs and milk together.
3. Pour over casserole. Refrigerate for 24 hours.
4. Remove from refrigerate at least 1 hour before baking.
5. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large skillet and saute onions until tender. Coat beef cubes in flour and brown them in a separate skillet with oil and butter.
2. Add browned meat, salt, pepper and garlic to onions.
3. Add enough beer to cover.
4. Cover tightly and simmer until meat is tender.
5. Serves 6.
title: Beef 'N Beer

ingredients.text: 6 Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened and divided

steps: 1. Pound chicken to flatten evenly; set aside. In a skillet, melt 3 tablespoons of butter; add garlic and 1/2 teaspoon dill. Add chicken; cook until juices run clear. Remove and keep warm. Spread both sides of bread with remaining butter. In a skillet or griddle, grill bread on both sides until golden brown. In small bowl, combine cream cheese, lemon juice and remaining dill; spread on one side of grilled bread. Place lettuce, chicken and tomato on 4 slices of bread; top with remaining bread. Makes 4 servings.
title: Dilly Chicken Sandwiches

steps: 1. Saute macaroni, onion, green pepper and garlic in hot oil until macaroni turns slightly yellow.
2. Add tomato juice and the seasonings.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Cover and boil for about 1 minute. Keep covered and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Macaroni Saute

steps: 1. Mix ingredients in paper bag.
2. Heat in large heavy skillet over medium gas flame (325° to 350° dial setting on controlled burner), 1/4-inch melted shortening.
3. Shake in paper bag until each piece is well coated with flour (2 pheasants, cut in serving pieces and skin removed).
4. Add pheasants to hot fat and brown well on each side. Cover; reduce flame to simmer (200° to 225° dial setting on controlled burner) and cook until tender, about 40 minutes.
5. Remove cover and continue cooking 5 minutes.
6. Drain on absorbent paper. Serves 4.
title: Fried Pheasant

steps: 1. Peel eggplant and cut into small pieces.
2. Boil in salted water until tender.
3. Drain well and mash.
4. Stir in other ingredients and mix well.
5. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a well-greased griddle. Fry on both sides until golden brown.
6. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Eggplant Patties

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix sugar and water; cook until syrup. Add margarine.
3. Shred yams into a gallon of water.
4. Add 1 tablespoon salt.
5. Drain and wash well.
6. Put in Pyrex dish, 12 x 6 x 3-inch.
7. Pour pineapple juice over, then syrup.
8. Cook at 350° in oven for 35 minutes or until they are transparent.
9. Serves 12. For best taste, many like the potatoes baked for approximately one hour.
title: Shredded Yams

steps: 1. In bowl stir together 5 ingredients.
2. Add water and egg; stir until smooth.
3. Pour 1 qt. (about) corn oil into large skillet to depth of 1/2 inch, filling no more than 1/3 full.
4. Heat over medium heat to 375°.
5. Dip 4 cups cut up vegetables,
6. 1 lb boneless chicken 13 breasts cut into in cubes a few pieces at a time.
7. Fry 2 to 3 minutes turning once until brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Light Batter

steps: 1. Cut carrots in large chunks; cook.
2. Drain; add milk, butter and brown sugar.
3. Let simmer for about 2 minutes.
4. Remove from heat. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Candied Carrot Yams

steps: 1. Cook Brussels sprouts in steamer for 15 minutes or until tender.
2. Saute onion in butter until rich brown.
3. Stir in sour cream and heat, stirring constantly.
4. Add Brussels sprouts and mix well.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Brussels Sprouts In Onion Cream

steps: 1. Melt shortening; add onions and cook until tender.
2. Stir in flour and salt.
3. Add milk gradually.
4. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and beginning to boil.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Stir in mustard and cheese.
7. Cut wieners in 1/4-inch slices.
8. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes, wieners and cheese sauce in 2-quart buttered casserole dish.
9. Top with cheese sauce. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sunday Supper Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 large green tomatoes (1 1/2 lb.), sliced 1/2-inch thick

steps: 1. Cook bacon in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat until crisp; drain on paper towels.
2. Discard drippings. Meanwhile, sprinkle slices evenly on both sides with sugar, salt and pepper.
3. Place flour and egg separately in 2 shallow dishes. Dip tomatoes in flour to coat, shaking off excess.
4. Dip in egg, turning to coat completely.
5. Then dip in flour again.
6. Add butter or margarine to same skillet and melt over medium heat.
7. Add tomato slices and cook until golden (about 3 minutes) per side. Serve with bacon.
8. Yields 4 servings.
title: Fried Green Tomatoes

steps: 1. Mix egg, water, salt, sesame seed and flour.
2. Dip chicken, which has been skinned, boned and cut into 1 x 1 1/2-inch pieces, into batter; drain.
3. Put oil into heavy pan or deep fryer.
4. Heat to 375° and carefully add chicken, 1 layer at a time.
5. Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden.
6. Drain.
7. Serves 6.
title: Golden Chicken Nuggets

steps: 1. Heat 4 tablespoons butter or margarine in a large skillet. Add chopped vegetables and cook.
2. Stir 5 minutes.
3. Stir in the catsup, water, brown sugar and vinegar; heat to boiling.
4. Reduce heat; simmer about 30 minutes longer, covered.
5. Stir once or twice.
6. Serve over rice, noodles or mashed potatoes or toast. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Barbecue Leftovers

ingredients.text: 2 large purple onions, cut in 1/4-inch slices
6 large, firm tomatoes, peeled and quartered
1 bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips

steps: 1. Place onions, tomatoes and bell pepper in a bowl.
2. In a saucepan, bring all other ingredients to a boil.
3. Boil for 1 minute only.
4. Pour over vegetables and chill.
5. This is good with charcoaled steak.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Fire And Ice

steps: 1. Chop salmon fine. Add salt, pepper, crumbs and lemon juice. Add beaten egg yolks, mixing thoroughly, then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Place in greased custard cups.
2. Set in pan of hot water and bake in moderate oven at 375° for 30 minutes. Unmold on a hot platter. Garnish each with a sprig of parsley and serve with a sauce.
3. Serves 6.
title: Salmon Puffs

steps: 1. Combine first six ingredients in bowl, mixing well.
2. Add eggplant and mushrooms.
3. Pour into 2-quart casserole.
4. Sprinkle cheese on top.
5. Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes or until set. Yields 8 servings.
title: Eggplant Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken breast, skinned, boned and sliced into cutlets
2 large ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and cubed

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes.
2. Combine chicken and mushrooms in a shallow layer in a nonstick skillet; add olive oil.
3. Cook over high heat until mushrooms and chicken begin to brown on both sides.
4. Add remaining ingredients, except tomatoes.
5. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
6. Uncover and simmer 3 to 4 more minutes until sauce is thick.
7. Stir in tomatoes at last minute, only until heated through.
8. Remove bay leaves before serving.
9. Serves 4.
title: Garden Chicken Marengo

steps: 1. Combine all the dry ingredients.
2. Heat milk to boiling point. Pour over cocoa mix and stir until well mixed.
3. Add vanilla and serve at once in warm cups.
4. Makes 12 servings.
title: Kyra'S Hot Chocolate

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Dissolve bouillon cube in water.
3. Add lemon juice, soy sauce, onion powder, garlic powder, ginger and pepper; mix well.
4. Pour over chicken, turning to coat all sides. Cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours, turning once.
5. Arrange chicken on a rack in a broiler pan.
6. Broil until chicken is tender, about 45 minutes, turning and brushing frequently with marinade.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Honolulu(Contains Approximately 250 Calories Per Serving)

steps: 1. Blend cornstarch and hot water in a bowl.
2. Combine all ingredients, except steak, green onions, garlic and butter. Place steak on a deep platter.
3. Pour soy sauce mixture over steak. Let stand for 1 hour, turning once.
4. Saute green onions and garlic in butter until tender.
5. Cook steak in a slightly greased grill, saving the sauce.
6. Cook steak to your desire after basting it with sauce.
7. Remove steak to platter and pour garlic and onion, mixing over it.
8. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing.
9. Serves 6.
title: Barbecue Beef Grill

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Grease custard cup.
3. Crack egg into cup.
4. Sprinkle with cheese.
5. Place custard cup on tray.
6. Bake 18 to 20 minutes.
7. Yields 1 serving.
title: Baked Eggs

steps: 1. Boil macaroni in water until tender; drain thoroughly.
2. Stir in butter and egg.
3. Mix salt and mustard with 1 tablespoon water and add to milk.
4. Add cheese to milk, reserving enough to sprinkle on top.
5. Pour macaroni into buttered casserole; add milk mixture. Mix thoroughly and sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until custard is set and top is crusty.
7. Serves 6.
title: President Reagan'S Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Combine ingredients in blender until frothy, about 1 minute. Serves 3.
title: Pina Colada(Non-Alcoholic)

steps: 1. Melt butter in flat, low casserole, then add rest of the ingredients.
2. Mix.
