3. Roll chicken pieces in this mixture (using only the one dish).
4. Arrange pieces in a single layer. Bake at 375° for 1 hour, uncovered.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Honey Chicken(A Honey Of A Recipe!  Your Friends Will Think You Slaved!)

steps: 1. Make a well with flour.
2. Beat eggs and add to center.
3. Slowly add flour to the eggs.
4. When all together, knead 8-10 mins.
5. Put through pasta machine.
6. Serves 4.
title: Homemade Pasta

steps: 1. Cook sausage until brown; drain.
2. In same pan, melt butter; brown hash browns.
3. In 2-quart dish, layer sausage, potatoes and cheese.
4. Beat eggs, milk and salt; pour over casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.
6. Serves 8.
title: Eggs Strata

steps: 1. In a large baking dish (9 x 13-inch), melt butter. Stir in honey, pineapple juice, mustard, salt and curry powder. Coat chicken well and arrange in baking dish. Bake about 1 hour at 375° (uncovered).
2. Turn at least once during baking. Serves 4.
title: Honey Baked Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Place meat in crock-pot; mix flour, salt and pepper.
2. Coat meat in crock-pot.
3. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix. Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 4 to 6 hours. Serves 6.
title: Crock-Pot Stew

steps: 1. Cook hamburger until crumbly.
2. Add onions and green pepper. Cook until pepper is tender.
3. Stir in tomatoes, rice, chili powder, salt and pepper.
4. Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
5. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Uncover last 15 minutes.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Texas Hash

ingredients.text: 3 small zucchini, cut diagonally in 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. Cook carrots in boiling water for 5 minutes.
2. Drain.
3. Combine carrots, zucchini and tomatoes in rectangular dish.
4. In saucepan, stir cornstarch, milk, 1/2 cup cheese and butter until smooth and thick.
5. Pour sauce over vegetables.
6. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and almonds.
7. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Zucchini, Carrot And Tomato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine eggs, sugar and spices in mixing bowl.
2. Beat at medium speed until sugar is dissolved.
3. Beat in ice cream and juices at low speed.
4. Chill covered until serving time.
5. Pour into punch bowl and add ginger ale slowly.
6. Fold gently to mix.
7. Float ice rings with orange slices in punch.
8. Garnish with nutmeg.
9. Yields 36 servings.
title: Glogg Nog

steps: 1. Wash the squash and cut off both ends.
2. Cook in small amount of boiling salted water until tender; drain.
3. When cooled, cut in halves lengthwise and scoop out the center.
4. Combine centers of squash, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, onion and egg; mix thoroughly. Fill squash shells with mixture and place stuffed squash on a shallow pan.
5. Sprinkle tops with grated cheese.
6. Broil 8 to 10 minutes until cheese is melted and filling is heated thoroughly. Serves 4.
title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. flour, seasoned with 1/4 tsp. salt and a little pepper
1 bunch scallions (green and all), cut into 1/4-inch pieces

steps: 1. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and shake off excess.
2. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add breast halves, 3 at a time, and fry quickly until golden on both sides.
4. Remove to a serving platter.
5. (The centers should not be cooked through.) Add a bit more butter (if desired) and the scallions to the pan and saute for 1 minute.
6. Add cream and boil until reduced to a sauce-like consistency.
7. Return breasts to pan to heat through and finish cooking in the center (2 minutes, roughly).
8. When the centers are just barely done, remove chicken to a serving platter, pour on sauce and serve.
9. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Breast Fillets With Scallions And Cream

ingredients.text: 1/4 to 1/3 tsp. black pepper (depending on your taste for pepper)

steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl.
2. Form into large flat steaks about 1 1/2-inches thick.
3. Broil on both sides 3 inches from heat source until desired rareness.
4. Serve topped with fried onions if desired.
5. Serves 2.
title: Hamburger Delmonico Steaks

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into pieces

steps: 1. Combine vinegar, soy sauce, onion, garlic and pepper. Marinate chicken at least 3 hours in refrigerator; drain.
2. Save marinade for later.
3. Mix mustard and 4 tablespoons ketchup.
4. Brush each piece of chicken with mustard mixture, coating well.
5. Bake, skin side down, at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. (Bake on foil sprayed with Pam.)
7. Turn pieces.
8. Mix remaining ketchup with milk and reserved marinade.
9. Pour sauce over chicken; bake additional 45 minutes.
10. Serve with rice.
11. Serves 4.
title: Voodoo Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 large Granny Smith apples, cored, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices

steps: 1. Place apples in bowl.
2. Add sugar, lemon juice, nutmeg, cinnamon and cloves; toss to coat.
3. Saute bacon in large skillet until crisp.
4. Transfer bacon to paper towels to drain.
5. Add apples to pan drippings and saute until tender, about 10 minutes.
6. Transfer apples and juices in skillet to bowl.
7. Sprinkle with bacon.
8. Serves 4.
title: Fried Apples With Bacon

steps: 1. Put sugar and orange juice in a large saucepan and cook to soft ball stage.
2. Turn off heat and add orange rind and pecans. Stir with wooden spoon until mixture turns cream color, about 5 to 7 minutes.
3. Pour onto waxed paper on cookie sheet.
4. When cool enough to handle, break apart.
5. Serves 6.
title: Orange Pecans

ingredients.text: 4 large green tomatoes (firm), cut in 1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. Wash and slice tomatoes.
2. Combine meal, salt, pepper and paprika.
3. Dredge tomatoes in this and fry in skillet, with a 1/4-inch of oil, until brown, turning once.
4. Serves 6.
title: Fried Green Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 2 lb. butter, margarine or bacon fat

steps: 1. Saute onions in butter until golden.
2. Add hamburger; cook slowly until done.
3. Drain excess fat.
4. Grease a casserole dish. Combine macaroni with all ingredients, including half of the cheese.
5. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Turn into casserole dish; sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.
7. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Macaroni Hamburg Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon crisp; drain and crumble.
2. Reserve bacon drippings and saute onions, then mushrooms.
3. In large mixing bowl, combine bacon, onions, mushrooms, seasonings, cheese, eggs and milk.
4. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: "Everyone Wants This Recipe" Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Split fillets lengthwise and roll up; use toothpick if necessary.
3. Place in shallow baking dish.
4. Pour milk over fish; add salt and pepper.
5. Bake for 30 minutes.
6. When done, pour off milk and add slowly to melted margarine into which flour has been added.
7. Add cheese and stir until melted.
8. Add lemon juice and pour sauce over fillets.
9. Brown quickly under broiler.
10. Serves 3 to 4, depending on size of fillets.
title: Fish Fillets Thermidor

steps: 1. Melt butter in shallow baking dish. Stir in remaining ingredients. Roll chicken pieces in butter mixture to coat, then arrange meaty side up in single layer.
2. Do not cover.
3. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and a rich golden color. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Diablo

steps: 1. Slice tenderloins into 3/4-inch medallions. Combine remaining ingredients and process in food processor or blender until well mixed. Pour over meat and marinate for 1 hour or overnight. Grill over hot coals 20 to 30 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Marinated Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 4 lb. chicken pieces (1 whole chicken, cut up)

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet.
2. Measure flour, salt, paprika and pepper into paper or plastic bag. Shake chicken, one piece at a time, in bag or until thoroughly coated. Brown chicken in oil over medium heat.
3. Heat oven to 350°. Place chicken, skin side up, in ungreased 9 x 12-inch baking pan.
4. Mix broth and garlic powder. Pour broth mixture on chicken.
5. Cover with aluminum foil and bake until tender, 50 minutes or so, basting occasionally with remaining broth.
6. Uncover the last 5 minutes to crisp chicken. Makes 6 servings.
title: Deluxe Baked Chicken

steps: 1. On 15-inch round glass dish, place head of cauliflower in center.
2. Arrange broccoli and carrots around outside.
3. Pour butter over veggies.
4. Sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper.
5. Cover with plastic wrap, turning back one edge to vent.
6. Microwave at High for 17 to 19 minutes.
7. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Vegetable Medley

steps: 1. In a food processor, puree the pineapple and bananas. Transfer to large bowl.
2. Stir in the yogurt and maple syrup. Freeze.
3. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Frozen Pineapple Yogurt

steps: 1. Place onions and water in saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat until tender, about 12 minutes. In another saucepan, combine sugar, flour, salt and vinegar. Stir until smooth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir 2 minutes. Stir in butter until melted. Drain onions and add to sauce. Sprinkle with parsley. Yields 5 servings.
title: Harvard Onions

steps: 1. Saute bacon until crisp.
2. Remove, drain and crumble.
3. Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings; add mushrooms for 2 minutes. Spread toast with mayonnaise; top with sauteed mushrooms, crumbled bacon, onion rings and cheese.
4. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 8 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted.
5. Serves 3 as entree or cut into quarters and serve as hors d'oeuvres.
title: Grilled Mushroom And Cheese Sandwich

steps: 1. Combine beef, green peppers and onion in skillet until brown. Add mixed oats, flour, salt and water with barbecue sauce and cook until done.
2. This recipe will serve 6 people.
title: Teenage Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. In large mixing bowl, combine bread crumbs, onions, ketchup, egg, salt and pepper.
2. Blend well.
3. Add meat, mix well but do not overmix.
4. Shape into oval patties 1/2-inch thick.
5. Broil under preheated hot broiler until done as desired, about 4 to 5 minutes on each side.
6. Makes 6 portions.
title: Salisbury Steaks

steps: 1. Combine bread crumbs with melted margarine; set aside for topping.
2. Stir together the rest of the ingredients.
3. Spoon mixture into a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with topping. Bake for 35 minutes at 325°.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Golden Turkey Bake

steps: 1. Combine turkey with next 8 ingredients and add 1/2 teaspoon salt in bowl; mix well.
2. Spoon into 8 x 13-inch baking dish.
3. Mix remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, flour, sesame seed, cheese and butter in bowl.
4. Spread over turkey mixture.
5. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
6. Yield:
7. 12 servings.
title: Turkey Hustle Up

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Remove shells from shrimp, leaving shell on tail.
3. Devein.
4. Wash thoroughly.
5. Drain on paper towels. Melt oleo in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish in oven.
6. Add salt, garlic and 1 tablespoon of parsley.
7. Mix well.
8. Arrange the shrimp in single layer in baking dish.
9. Bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Turn shrimp; sprinkle with lemon peel, lemon juice and remaining parsley.
10. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender.
11. Arrange on serving platter.
12. Pour garlic butter over all.
13. Garnish with lemon wedges.
14. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Scampi

ingredients.text: 1/2 green pepper, cut into tiny pieces
1/2 red pepper, cut into tiny pieces

steps: 1. Wash and place chicken flat in a baking dish (pre-sprayed with Pam cooking spray).
2. Layer the chicken with the pre-cut green pepper, red pepper, onion and tomato. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle shredded Mozzarella cheese on top and bake until cheese melts.
3. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Pamela

steps: 1. Combine ingredients in plastic bag. Refrigerate overnight, turning bag occasionally. Roast pork until meat thermometer registers 170°. Allow about 30 minutes per pound. Midway through roasting, pour marinade over meat. Serves 6.
title: Key Largo Roast Pork

steps: 1. Season, stew, cool and shred chuck roast. Dice and brown onion. Add rest of ingredients. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Add shredded beef. Mix well. Serve on toasted buns. Serves 12.
title: Barbecue Beef

steps: 1. Peel, core and slice apples.
2. Peel and cut sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch slices.
3. Saute apples and sweet potatoes in 2 tablespoons of butter.
4. Put in greased casserole dish.
5. Sprinkle with salt. Add chopped pecans.
6. Put remaining melted butter and maple syrup over it.
7. Bake at 350° for about an hour or until potatoes are soft.
8. Serves 16.
title: Swapples

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients. Chill for at least 30 minutes. Just before serving, add coconut and spoon into sherbet glasses. Makes 3 or 4 servings.
title: Peach Ambrosia

steps: 1. Place uncooked macaroni in casserole dish.
2. Add margarine, salt and cheese.
3. Mix; pour milk over ingredients and stir.
4. Bake in oven 1 hour at 350°.
5. Do not stir.
6. Bake uncovered.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Quick Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in baking pan.
2. Mix mayonnaise and yogurt together.
3. Spread mixture over chicken; cover pan with foil.
4. Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
5. Serves 4.
title: Aunt Sharon'S Yogurt Chicken

steps: 1. Place 2 cups croutons in a buttered 2-quart casserole.
2. In a large bowl, combine sausage, celery, green pepper, onion and pimiento.
3. Fold in mayonnaise and mustard.
4. Spread over croutons.
5. Top with cheese and remaining croutons.
6. Combine eggs and half and half.
7. Pour over croutons.
8. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
9. Bake in a preheated 375° oven, uncovered, for 1 hour or until set.
10. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.
11. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Cheese And Sausage Medley

steps: 1. Brown ground beef.
2. Add onion, celery and green pepper.
3. Mix other ingredients together in small bowl; add to ground beef mixture.
4. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
5. Serve on hard roll buns or hamburger buns.
6. Yields 12 servings.
title: Barbecue

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked turkey breast, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. In a 2-quart casserole, combine turkey, celery, mayonnaise, onion and lemon juice.
3. Top with almonds, cheese and noodles.
4. Bake 30 minutes.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Post Thanksgiving Turkey Casserole

steps: 1. In a small bowl or a jar with tight-fitting lid, mix the first 9 ingredients.
2. Layer onion and tomatoes in a shallow glass dish. Pour the marinade over; cover and refrigerate for several hours. Yields 12 servings.
title: Tangy Tomato Slices

ingredients.text: 2 green peppers, seeded and cut lengthwise into thirds
2 red peppers, seeded and cut lengthwise into thirds
2 yellow peppers, seeded and cut lengthwise into thirds

steps: 1. Place pepper pieces on metal skewers, alternating colors. Brush peppers with oil. Cook on grill for 10 minutes, turning frequently.
2. Serves 4.
title: Grilled Peppers

steps: 1. Wash, trim and shred zucchini.
2. Mix zucchini in bowl with all the other ingredients, except Parmesan cheese and eggs.
3. Spoon the mixture into a greased baking dish.
4. Beat the 4 eggs and pour over zucchini.
5. Mix lightly with a fork.
6. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until the top is set.
7. Top with Parmesan cheese.
8. Makes 4 servings; 130 calories per serving.
title: Baked Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. In a skillet, brown beef, onion and garlic; drain and set aside.
2. Combine remaining ingredients except buns in a slow cooker; stir in beef mixture. Cover; cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours or on high setting for 3 to 4 hours.
3. Spoon onto buns.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Slow-Cooker Sloppy Joes

ingredients.text: 1 c. cooked chicken, cut into small pieces

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients.
2. Beat egg yolks until thick; add milk.
3. Add to dry ingredients.
4. Add chicken and peas.
5. Add stiffly beaten egg whites.
6. Cook in a frying pan in hot fat. Drain on paper towel.
7. Serves 8.
title: Chicken And Green Pea Fritters

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Rinse and dry salmon fillet.
3. Place on large piece of aluminum foil, skin side down.
4. Squeeze 1/2 lemon juice over fish.
5. Sprinkle onions and capers along top of fish. Season with fresh grated pepper.
6. Wrap foil to seal edges.
7. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
8. The fish should be just firm when pressed lightly with finger.
9. Garnish with 1/2 lemon, sliced.
10. Serves 3 to 4. Excellent served with pasta marinara and Caesar salad.
title: Baked Salmon With Capers

steps: 1. Chicken may be skinned, if preferred.
2. Place chicken snugly in baking dish, skin side down.
3. Mix honey, mustard, curry and soy sauce.
4. Pour over chicken and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight, covered.
5. Turn chicken skin side up.
6. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour at 350°.
7. Baste well with sauce and continue baking, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
8. Spoon sauce over chicken and serve.
9. Serves 4.
title: Day Ahead Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 whole chicken, cut in 8 parts, skinned, but not boned

steps: 1. Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Brown chicken 5 to 8 minutes over medium-high heat; remove to plate and keep warm.
3. Recoat skillet with cooking spray. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook peppers, mushrooms, onion and garlic until peppers are crisp-tender, 5 to 8 minutes.
4. Whisk together hot pepper sauce, vinegar and sugar.
5. Add to skillet and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low.
6. Add chicken; cover and simmer, turning occasionally, until chicken is tender, about 30 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Chicken With Balsamic Vinegar

steps: 1. Place chicken in shallow pan.
2. In skillet, saute onion in oil until tender.
3. Add apples; saute 1 minute longer.
4. Pour onion and apples over chicken, melt margarine.
5. Combine juice, honey and salt and pour over the chicken and vegetables.
6. Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked.
7. Serves 6.
title: Apple-Onion Chicken

steps: 1. Put croutons and ham into a greased casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients in a blender or with a mixer and pour over the croutons and ham.
2. Refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake uncovered 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Eggs Rebel Recipe

steps: 1. Spread softened cream cheese over 1 side of fillets. Place fillets cream side up in a sprayed nonstick 9-inch square pan. Thinly slice 1 lemon and place over top of fillets. Squeeze juice of other lemon over fish. Sprinkle top of fish with dill weed. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Dill Fillets

steps: 1. Cut off tops; remove seeds from peppers.
2. Cook pepper shells in boiling water for 5 minutes, then put at once into cold water.
3. Cut shrimp slightly.
4. Combine with eggs, crumbs and milk.
5. Saute chopped ingredients in butter for 3 minutes; add to shrimp mixture. Add seasonings; stuff into pepper shells, putting a few bread crumbs and a drop of butter on top of each.
6. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in moderate oven (375°).
7. Serves 6.
title: Shrimp Stuffed In Bell Peppers

steps: 1. In a large saucepan on medium heat, combine cranberry sauce, barbecue sauce, allspice and orange rind, whisking to blend. Stir in cubed turkey. Heat and put in a serving dish.
2. Serves 6.
title: Turkey Tidbits

ingredients.text: 2 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned

steps: 1. Saute chicken in butter over low heat about 20 minutes or until tender.
2. Remove chicken to a warm platter.
3. Blend flour into pan drippings; cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly.
4. Gradually stir in broth and half and half; cook until smooth and thickened, stirring constantly.
5. Stir in mustard.
6. Add chicken; cover and simmer about 10 minutes.
7. Yield:
8. 2 servings.
title: Chicken Dijon

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak (3/4-inch thick), cut into 6 pieces

steps: 1. Cut round steak into 6 pieces.
2. Pound flour into the meat. Brown well in shortening.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Add garlic and onion and continue cooking until the onion is tender and browned.
5. Add paprika, onion salt and water.
6. Cover and bake in a moderate oven (375°) for 2 hours, or until meat is tender. Add more water if necessary.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swiss Steak Ranch Style

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. In a 2-quart casserole combine all ingredients except cheese, mix well.
3. Bake covered at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until macaroni is tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in cheese; cover until cheese melts.
4. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, melt margarine; set aside.
3. Blend eggs, water, soy sauce and pepper in a shallow dish.
4. Dip each chicken breast into flour, then egg mixture.
5. Sprinkle with sesame seed and place in baking dish. Bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and tender.
6. Serves 6.
title: Baked Sesame Chicken

steps: 1. Trim fat from chops and roll in flour. Brown chops in garlic in hot fat over medium heat. Season with salt and pepper. Place sliced potatoes in baking pan; top with pork chops. Separate onion slices into rings and lay over chops. Blend in sour cream and mustard. Pour over top. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Makes 4 servings.
title: Farmer'S Pork Chops

steps: 1. Mix all together with rotary beater.
2. Pour into custard cups. Microwave on High until pumpkin starts to bubble.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Microwave Pumpkin Cups

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Brush bottom of rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch, with oil.
3. Mix Bisquick, Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, paprika and pepper; coat chicken.
4. Arrange skin-sides down in pan.
5. Bake 45 minutes.
6. Turn chicken; divide chili sauce among breast halves.
7. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
8. Bake until melted, about 5 minutes longer.
9. Sprinkle with snipped parsley if desired.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Mozzarella

steps: 1. Melt fat and stir in flour.
2. Gradually add boiling water and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
3. Add vinegar, sugar and seasonings.
4. Mix well until sugar dissolves.
5. Add beets and cook until thoroughly heated.
6. If canned beets are used, substitute 1/4 cup liquid from the can of beets for the water.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Harvard Beets

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Saute corn in butter until just tender. Set aside to cool.
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
4. Add cooled corn and mix.
5. Pour into oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake 1 hour or until firm and golden on top.
6. Serve with sour cream, tomatoes, guacamole and salsa.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Brunch Eggs California

ingredients.text: 1 lb. bulk sausage, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Layer sausage, mushrooms, green onions, tomatoes and cheese in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish which has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Beat remaining ingredients; pour over sausage mixture. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven until golden brown. Cool about 30 minutes. Cut into 12 (3-inch) squares. Serves 12.
title: Holiday Brunch Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. crushed pineapple, packed in own juice (no sugar added)

steps: 1. Cube cantaloupe and place in freezer container.
2. Cover with pineapple.
3. Freeze.
4. Thaw partially before serving.
5. Yield: 1 serving.
title: Frozen Cantaloupe(Dietetic)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced or 1 (20 oz.) bag frozen sliced carrots

steps: 1. In a saucepan, cook carrots just until crisp-tender; drain and reserve 1/4 cup cooking juice.
2. Place carrots in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
3. Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and reserved cooking juice.
4. Spread evenly over carrots.
5. Sprinkle with cheese; top with bread crumbs.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Creamy Carrot Casserole

steps: 1. Cook sausage and onion until brown; drain off excess fat.
2. Add rice, chicken bouillon cubes and hot water.
3. Heat to boiling. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
4. Add peas; cover and simmer for 10 more minutes.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sausage Skillet Dinner

steps: 1. Season and brown roast.
2. Cook until done. Shred roast into small pieces.
3. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes or until mixture is thick.
4. Serve over toasted buns.
5. Yields 12 servings.
title: Barbecue Beef

steps: 1. Wash beef to remove brine.
2. Place in large kettle.
3. Cover with water and slowly bring to boil.
4. Cook 5 minutes.
5. Remove scum. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 hours.
6. Skim fat.
7. Return to rolling boil. Add whole onions, carrots, potatoes and parsnips.
8. Reduce heat and cook gently, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
9. Core and cut cabbage in eighths.
10. Add cabbage and cook 20 minutes.
11. Transfer meat to platter.
12. Arrange vegetables around meat.
13. Yields 8 servings.
title: New England Boiled Dinner

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in a large shallow dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients; stir well and pour over chicken.
3. Cover and refrigerate chicken for 2 hours.
4. Remove chicken from marinade. Grill over hot coals about 8 minutes on each side, using marinade for basting.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Marinated Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Cook chicken breasts in pot of water with bouillon cubes for about 1/2 hour.
2. Chop broccoli into small pieces and cook as usual.
3. Cook rice.
4. Saute onion in margarine.
5. Tear chicken into small pieces.
6. Combine all cooked ingredients and place in casserole.
7. Slice pieces of Velveeta cheese and lay on top of ingredients.
8. Cook at 350° for 15 minutes, stirring once.
9. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Combine cheese, flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
2. Set aside. Combine milk and egg.
3. Dip fillets in egg-milk mixture then dredge in flour mixture.
4. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
5. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with almonds.
6. Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Baked Catfish Parmesan

steps: 1. Simmer lobster meat in butter until it reaches a good pink color.
2. Slowly add milk and cream, stirring constantly until stew has developed a rich salmon color.
3. Remove from heat and let age 5 or 6 hours.
4. Reheat slowly.
5. Serves 8.
title: Lobster Stew

steps: 1. Mash or puree berries.
2. Make syrup of sugar and water.
3. Add gelatin that has been soaked in cold water.
4. Chill.
5. Add berries and juice of 1 lemon; freeze.
6. If berries are very acid, increase sugar.
7. Serves 6.
title: Strawberry Sherbet(Without Milk)

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in blender.
2. Blend until smooth and frothy. Makes 2 servings.
title: Purple Cows

steps: 1. In skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
2. Add white wine, garlic and mussels.
3. Cover and cook until mussels are opened, 2 to 3 minutes.
4. Stir in tomato, basil and red pepper flakes.
5. Reduce heat; simmer 2 minutes more.
6. Makes 2 servings.
title: Bob'S Mussels

steps: 1. Combine ingredients.
2. Pour into a buttered ring mold and bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
3. Unmold and fill with seasoned peas.
4. Serves 6.
title: Carrot Ring

steps: 1. Brown beef with onion.
2. Drain.
3. Mix other ingredients together.
4. Add to meat.
5. Simmer 3 minutes, covered.
6. Serve on warm buns.
7. Great on buttered toast.
8. Serves 6.
title: Hamburger Goo

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and dice into small pieces; fry on medium heat in a large frypan . In another pan, fry ground beef and season.
2. When potatoes are cooked, add the beef; stir in well.
3. Slowly add cheese (let melt before you add another handful).
4. Stir after each handful.
5. Cover and let stand a couple of minutes.
6. Serves 5 to 6.
title: Hamburger Hash

steps: 1. Slice vegetables thinly.
2. In a buttered 2-quart casserole, place a layer of vegetables.
3. Mix all dry ingredients together. Add 1/2 of this to first layer.
4. Also, add 1/2 of cheese (both kinds).
5. Dot with margarine.
6. Continue with layers of vegetables, dry ingredients, cheese and margarine.
7. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
8. Remove cover and bake 10 minutes or so longer.
9. Will serve 6.
10. Very good!
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Stir or shake for 1 minute or in blender, mix 1/2 minute at high speed.
2. Pour into prechilled glasses.
3. Serve with pineapple spear.
4. Yields 2 servings.
title: Pina Coladas

steps: 1. Cook sausage until done; spread bread with butter and cube. Use 13 x 9-inch pan.
2. Place bread cubes in bottom.
3. Sprinkle crumbled sausage over bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese.
4. Combine milk, eggs, salt and mustard.
5. Pour over baking dish.
6. Chill for 5 hours.
7. Bake for 30 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
9. Can be made before hand and frozen before baking.
title: Sausage And Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 lb. uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
2. Add shrimp, garlic salt and lemon juice. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
3. Add onions. Cook 2 more minutes. Serve over pasta. One of my favorites.
4. Yields 6 servings.
5. Has 320 calories, 5 g fat.
title: Scampi

steps: 1. Season liver with salt and pepper; coat with flour.
2. In large skillet, brown quickly in hot
3. oil,
4. about	1
5. minute on each side.
6. Place in greased
7. baking
8. dish.
9. Add seasoning and tomatoes; cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
10. Remove cover and bake for 10 to 15 minutes
11. longer to thicken gravy.
12. Serve on rice.
13. Makes 6 servings.
title: Busy Day Bake

steps: 1. Pour grape juice into blender. Add ice cream. Cover and whirl just until blended. Pour into glasses and serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.
title: Purple Ape

steps: 1. Mix chicken, celery, croutons, Miracle Whip, milk, onion and Swiss cheese.
2. Sprinkle almonds on top.
3. Bake in a 2-quart baking dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
4. Favorite dish at gatherings! Serves 6.
title: Alpine Chicken

ingredients.text: 8 boneless chicken breasts (with skin left on)

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish.
2. Drizzle with honey.
3. Sprinkle with rosemary.
4. Pour the lemon juice and then the soy sauce evenly over the chicken.
5. Place orange slices randomly in the pan.
6. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes and then broil until the tops are somewhat blackened.
7. Serve over wild rice.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chicken Elia

steps: 1. Brown sausage.
2. Remove from skillet and brown diced onion in 3 tablespoons of the drippings.
3. Add flour and stir to a paste.
4. Add salt, pepper, chili sauce, Worcestershire sauce and juice drained from the green beans.
5. Cook until thick, stirring well.
6. Add the drained green beans.
7. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
8. Top with the browned sausage.
9. Sprinkle with cheese.
10. Bake in a hot oven (400°) for 20 minutes.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Sausage And Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 lb. bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled

steps: 1. Combine broccoli, cauliflower and onion.
2. In small bowl, combine cheese, sugar, salt, basil and mayonnaise; mix well.
3. Add dressing to vegetables.
4. Toss gently.
5. Refrigerate.
6. Just before serving, add bacon.
7. You can also add 1 head of lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces, 2 cups seasoned croutons and 8 ounce can sliced water chestnuts, drained just before serving.
8. Makes 20 to 24 servings with lettuce.
title: Parmesan Vegetable Toss

ingredients.text: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place meat in 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch pan.
2. Slice onion. Diagonally slice celery.
3. Pare carrots and cut into chunks.
4. Add vegetables to baking pan.
5. Blend salt, sugar and cornstarch. Sprinkle over ingredients in baking dish.
6. Add tomato juice. Cover pan with sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil and crimp edges to seal lightly.
7. Bake stew (do not stir) in slow oven (250°) for 4 hours.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Easy Beef Stew

steps: 1. Grind wafers to fine crumbs.
2. Spread half of crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Cream butter and sugar.
4. Add egg and beat until creamy.
5. Spread creamed mixture over crumbs to edge of pan. Combine fruits and granulated sugar.
6. Let stand 20 minutes. Spread over creamed mixture.
7. Cover fruit with whipped cream.
8. Top with rest of vanilla wafer crumbs.
9. Chill 12 to 24 hours.
10. Serves 24.
title: Cranberry Torte

ingredients.text: 4 tart apples, cored, pared and sliced

steps: 1. Arrange apples in greased pie tin and dot with butter. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and 1/4 cup sugar together twice. Cut in shortening.
2. Add enough milk gradually to make a soft dough.
3. Spread over apples.
4. Bake in hot oven at 400° until apples are tender.
5. Turn out upside down.
6. Serve hot with whipped cream. Sprinkle cinnamon and chopped nuts.
7. Serves 6.
title: Apple Crows Nest

steps: 1. Cut butter into flour until texture resembles coarse meal. Mix in cheese, cayenne pepper and salt.
2. Fold in Rice Krispies. Pinch off small pieces; place on cookie sheet and pat flat.
3. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
4. Double the recipe serves 150 people.
title: Cheese Wafers

steps: 1. Core apples.
2. Peel top third of each.
3. Place in shallow baking dish.
4. Combine
5. raisins,	pecans and
6. cinnamon.
7. Fill cavities of	apples	with
8. mixture.	Pour
9. maple
10. syrup
11. over apples.
12. Top each
13. with 1 tablespoon butter.
14. Pour water into bottom of	dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serves 2.
title: Baked Apples

steps: 1. Cut each shrimp in half lengthwise.
2. Cut each egg into eighths. In large bowl, combine the shrimp, egg sections, Blue cheese, Cheddar cheese, mayonnaise, honey and salt.
3. Mix very gently and slowly, until well blended.
4. Rub a 2-quart casserole with butter or margarine.
5. Turn the shrimp mixture into it, and sprinkle with 1 cup of finely crushed potato chips.
6. Bake in a preheated 250° oven for 1 hour.
7. Serves 6. Rich and delicious.
title: Shrimp Superb

ingredients.text: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt, thyme and pepper.
2. Coat meat cubes with flour mixture.
3. In large saucepan, brown meat, half at a time, in hot Crisco.
4. Sprinkle any remaining flour mixture over meat during browning.
5. Return all meat to saucepan.
6. Stir in the cider, water and vinegar.
7. Cook and stir until mixture boils.
8. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until meat is tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
9. Add potatoes, carrots, onions and celery.
10. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes more.
11. Skim off excess fat.
12. Makes 8 servings.
title: Homestyle Stew

ingredients.text: 5 c. grated Mozzarella cheese (2 1/2 c. per layer)

steps: 1. Thinly slice zucchini and line the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart pan. Add enough grated Mozzarella cheese to cover or to your liking. Sprinkle on 1/2 of the browned sausage and repeat layer once more. Place in oven at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.
2. Makes a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
3. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. In large skillet, saute onion and butter until tender. Transfer to a bowl.
2. Add shrimp, olive oil, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
3. Toss together.
4. Arrange shrimp in large shallow baking pan.
5. Pour the sauce over the shrimp in the baking pan.
6. Broil 3 to 5 minutes.
7. Turn over and broil the other side. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Scampi

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Arrange chicken in shallow baking pan, skin side up.
3. Combine next 5 ingredients and pour over the chicken.
4. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350°, basting every 15 minutes until chicken is tender and nicely browned.
5. Serves 6.
6. Good served over rice.
title: Honey Chicken

steps: 1. Brown ground sirloin and onion.
2. Do not add Minute rice when browning meat.
3. Add tomatoes, rice, salt, pepper and sugar. Sprinkle flour over top.
4. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Wash peppers; cut in half and remove seeds.
6. Drop into boiling water and boil 1 minute; drain. Stuff with meat mixture.
7. Top with buttered crumbs and grated cheese.
8. Bake 1/2 hour at 375°.
9. Do not cover.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Stuffed Peppers

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients until well mixed.
2. If desired, top with Cool Whip and/or nutmeg.
3. Yield:
4. 4 to 6 servings.
title: Egg Nog

ingredients.text: 2 medium red potatoes, cut in chunks
1 c. (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

steps: 1. Place chicken in a greased shallow 2-quart baking dish.
2. Top with the carrots, potatoes and celery.
3. Combine the soup, water, salt and pepper.
4. Pour over vegetables.
5. Cover and bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
6. Yields 5 servings.
title: Chicken Veggie Casserole

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients well.
2. If you are using raw honey ,you may want to heat the water to just under a boil before mixing with the honey,to ensure it all mixes together smoothly.
3. Serve by the shot glass as is or serve 1/2 cup in warmed mugs.
title: Cayenne Lemon Tonic

steps: 1. Cook yams, peel and quarter.
2. Arrange yams in single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
3. Bake in 325° oven for 15 minutes. In a 2-quart saucepan, combine remaining ingredients, stirring constantly.
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 5 minutes. Pour over yams.
5. Bake, basting frequently for 15 minutes longer, or until glazed.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Butterscotch Yams

ingredients.text: 2 large green peppers, tops and seeds removed

steps: 1. Cook peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes.
2. Drain and rinse with cold water; set aside.
3. In a skillet, cook turkey, onion and garlic until meat is no longer pink; drain fat and set aside.
4. In same skillet, melt butter.
5. Add flour, salt and pepper, stirring until smooth.
6. Gradually add milk; bring to boil, stirring constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened.
7. Return turkey to skillet.
8. Stir in tomato and 2 tablespoons cheese.
9. Heat through.
10. Spoon mixture into peppers.
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
12. Place in greased 1-quart baking dish.
13. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
14. Serves 2.
title: Turkey-Stuffed Peppers For Two

ingredients.text: 4 to 5 lb. chicken, cut in pieces

steps: 1. Saute onion and garlic in shortening. Add seasonings and chicken. Saute about 10 minutes. Add water (2 cups) and simmer until chicken is tender.
2. Remove chicken.
3. Add sour cream to liquid.
4. Simmer 10 minutes.
5. Mix flour and remaining water as for thickening gravy.
6. Add to liquid.
7. Add dumplings.
8. Arrange chicken on top.
9. Heat thoroughly and serve.
10. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Paprikas(Czirkepaprikas)

steps: 1. Spread bread cubes in bottom of greased 13 1/2 x 8 3/4 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.
2. Sprinkle cheese over bread.
3. Blend eggs, milk, pepper, salt, mustard and onion.
4. Pour over bread and cheese mixture.
5. Bake at 325° until egg mixture is set (40 to 45 minutes).
6. Sprinkle bacon bits over casserole last 10 minutes or baking.
7. Serves 10.
title: Brunch Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. Pour milk over bread crumbs to soften; add remaining ingredients except eggs. Stir in eggs. Pour mixture into a well-greased loaf pan or a 6 x 8-inch casserole. Set the dish in a container of hot water and bake for about 45 minutes or until an inserted knife comes out clean. Serves 6.
title: Company Crab Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 large eggplant, cut into 1/2 inch slices

steps: 1. Steam the eggplant for about 8 minutes or just until it begins to soften.
2. While the eggplant steams, push the garlic through a garlic press, into a small bowl.
3. Stir in the onions and oil until well mixed.
4. Arrange the eggplant slices in one layer or on baking sheet coated with no-stick spray.
5. Brush with half of the garlic mixture.
6. Broil about 5 inches from the heat for about 5 minutes or until the slices begin to turn golden.
7. Turn, brush with the remaining oil mixture and broil until golden brown.
8. Serve hot. Makes 8 servings.
title: Eggplant Grill

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to directions on package and drain. Stir in butter immediately.
2. Beat egg with 1 teaspoon salt, mustard and cream.
3. Toss macaroni with grated cheese, leaving 1/3 cup of cheese.
4. Place in a baking dish.
5. Pour on cream mixture and top with rest of cheese.
6. Bake about 40 minutes at 350°.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Baked Macaroni

steps: 1. Place bacon in bottom of a baking dish.
2. Sprinkle salmon with salt and pepper; lay on top of bacon.
3. Saute garlic, onion and green peppers together for 3 minutes in hot oil.
4. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes.
5. Pour over salmon.
6. Bake in a 400° preheated oven for 30 minutes, basting often.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Barbecued Salmon

steps: 1. Mix well and spread on sandwich bread.
2. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hawaiian Ham Filling

ingredients.text: 2 lb. jumbo shrimp, peeled (leaving tails on)

steps: 1. Slit peeled shrimp down center to butterfly leaving tails on. Remove veins.
2. Place butter in a bowl; mix in rest of ingredients to blend completely.
3. Put shrimp on a shallow broiling pan.
4. Place a dab of butter mixture on each shrimp.
5. Broil about 5 minutes. Makes about 6 servings.
title: Savory Shrimp

ingredients.text: 10 3/4 oz. can cream of mushroom soup

steps: 1. Brown onion, celery and barley in butter about 3 minutes.
2. Put soup, parsley and water in casserole dish; stir until slightly mixed.
3. Add browned onion, celery and barley and stir until uniform.
4. Bake, covered, 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
5. Stir before serving.
6. Serves 6.
title: Barley Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 large onions, halved and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients; shape into 6 patties. Cook patties in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 3 minutes on each side. Remove patties from skillet. Add onion and 1/4 cup water to skillet; cook, covered, over medium heat for 15 minutes. Uncover and stir; cook 10 more minutes. Remove half of onion from skillet. Return patties to skillet. Top patties with reserved onion; cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Smothered Hamburger Steaks

steps: 1. Have all ingredients cold.
2. Place all ingredients in large bowl.
3. Beat with egg beater until frothy.
4. Serve immediately. Yields about 20 servings.
title: Syllabub

steps: 1. Slice potatoes in a 2-cup microwave casserole.
2. Cover with lid, cook on High for 5 to 6 minutes, or until tender, stirring once.
3. Top with picante sauce and cheese.
4. Cover until cheese is melted.
5. Serves 2.
title: Pican-Toes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Wrap each shrimp in bacon and fasten with toothpick.
3. Spread on a cookie sheet and bake, turning frequently, until bacon is crisp.
4. Drain on paper towels.
5. Place in a chafing dish and pour warmed rum over shrimp; ignite.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Yields 12 servings.
title: Shrimp Flambe

steps: 1. Melt butter in foil-lined 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Place chicken in butter and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt.
3. Blend remaining salt, honey, mustard and lemon juice.
4. Brush 1/2 honey mixture on chicken.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Turn chicken; brush with remaining honey mixture.
7. Bake 20 minutes longer until tender. Makes 4 servings.
title: Honey Chicken

steps: 1. Prepare macaroni according to package instructions.
2. Drain. In a large saucepan, melt butter.
3. Add onion. Cook until tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Blend in milk.
4. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Add cheese.
5. Stir until melted.
6. Combine macaroni and cheese mixture.
7. Mix well.
8. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake in a 350° oven until hot and bubbly, about 30 minutes.
9. Garnish as desired.
10. Refrigerate leftovers.
11. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Old-Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. In large skillet over medium heat, brown the chicken in oil on both sides.
2. Transfer to a slow cooker.
3. Combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, water, garlic, and ginger; pour over chicken.
4. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour.
5. Reduce heat to low; cook 4-5 hours longer or until the meat juices run clear.
6. Remove chicken to a serving platter and sprinkle with almonds.
7. Spoon juices over chicken and serve with hot rice if desired.
8. Serves 4-6.
title: Slow Cooked Oriental Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 small (8 oz.) can pork and beans

steps: 1. Brown beef lightly in skillet without any added fat, stirring frequently.
2. Add pork and beans, tomatoes and salt.
3. Grease a baking dish.
4. Pour half the mixture in.
5. Cover with slices of onion.
6. Add remaining meat-bean mixture.
7. Top with strips of bacon and sprinkle with brown sugar.
8. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
9. Makes 4 servings.
title: Saturday Night Special

steps: 1. Peel turnips and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices.
2. Melt butter in a skillet and add turnips.
3. Cook over low heat until barely tender.
4. Add beef broth; cover and simmer over low heat until turnips are tender, about 15 minutes.
5. Remove lid and allow some of the broth to cook down, leaving a small amount of sauce. Sprinkle with lemon juice and chopped parsley.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Braised Turnips

ingredients.text: 1 lb. chicken breasts, skinned and cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a small bowl, mix all ingredients together except the chicken.
2. Add the chicken and coat evenly.
3. Spread the chicken out on a broiling pan.
4. Broil for 10 minutes or until lightly browned, turning once.
5. Serve with barbecue sauce or stuff into a pita pocket with lettuce and tomato.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Sesame Chicken Nuggets

steps: 1. Sprinkle strawberries with sugar.
2. Cover and refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes.
3. Just before serving, whip cream until stiff. Gently stir in orange juice.
4. Fold in berries, or serve individually, in small bowls topped with the flavored cream. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Strawberries Romanoff

steps: 1. Mash garlic, thyme, oregano and salt and saute in butter in bottom of saucepan. Add milk and bring to a boil; remove from heat and add cheese. Set aside to cool.
2. Boil macaroni in salt water until just tender. Add to milk-cheese sauce after 3 eggs have been mixed into sauce until blended.
3. Pour into a greased 3-quart casserole dish.
4. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes or until brown. Serves 6.
title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. crushed Ritz (16) crackers (Mel uses Pepperidge Farm dressing mix)

steps: 1. Melt margarine in 12 x 7-inch glass baking dish.
2. Set aside. Combine rest of ingredients except chicken in flat dish.
3. Roll chicken in melted margarine, then in seasoned crumbs.
4. Place chicken pieces in Pam-sprayed baking dish.
5. Sprinkle remaining bread crumbs on top.
6. Microwave 20 to 25 minutes on High or until meat is cooked.
7. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
8. Don't overcook.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Seasoned Crumb Chicken(Microwave)

steps: 1. Cook pork, onion and pepper.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer 30 minutes until noodles are tender, adding more water if necessary.
3. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Chili Sausage Supper

steps: 1. Saute ground beef with next four ingredients in skillet until crumbly.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Pour into 2-quart casserole.
5. Bake, covered, at 325° for one hour.
6. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Ground Beef Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 large green pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Freeze meat 1 hour to firm to make slicing easier; slice into thin strips.
2. In small bowl, combine soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch; mix well.
3. In large skillet over high heat, cook pepper and onion in oil until tender-crisp.
4. Add meat mixture; stir fry until meat loses its pink color and sauce thickens slightly.
5. Add tomatoes; heat through.
6. Serve over rice.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Stir-Fried Beef

steps: 1. Mix first four (4) ingredients together; set aside.
2. Put oleo in 2-quart casserole and place in 350° oven until melted.
3. Remove dish and mix together all ingredients and dump into 2-quart oleoed baking dish.
4. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
5. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Mix ingredients.
2. Put into muffin pans or popover cups.
3. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.
4. Reduce heat to 350° for 20 minutes or until done.
5. Serves 4.
title: Popovers

steps: 1. Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch slices.
2. Lightly grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch casserole dish.
3. Combine flour with 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon oregano and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
4. Toss zucchini in seasoned flour to coat well.
5. Slowly heat oil in large heavy skillet.
6. Saute zucchini until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side.
7. Drain.
8. Cover dish with zucchini; top with tomatoes. Combine sour cream, rest of salt, oregano and pepper and spread over tomatoes.
9. Sprinkle with cheese.
10. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Cheesy Zucchini

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. pork sausage (1 lb. mild and 1/2 lb. hot)

steps: 1. Trim crust from bread and fit bread into bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish.
2. Brown sausage in skillet; drain.
3. Stir in mustard.
4. Spoon sausage evenly over bread and sprinkle with cheese.
5. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cheese and sausage.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sausage Strata

steps: 1. Roast at 325° on baking sheet for 45 minutes (approximately), turning until all sides are shriveled (not black!)
2. Break peppers, allowing juice to run in bowl.
3. Skin and slice peppers.
4. Add to juice in bowl, salt.
5. Add 2 cloves garlic.
6. Refrigerate overnight. To serve:
7. Arrange on platter; sprinkle with oregano, olive oil and ground pepper.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Roasted Red Peppers

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Oil roasting pan, to just cover bottom. Brown sausage in oven.
3. Wash and slice into wedges, onions, peppers and potatoes.
4. When sausage is brown, add these.
5. Cook for about 1 hour or until peppers, onions and potatoes are tender and golden brown.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Baked Sausage And Peppers

steps: 1. Heat milk and sugar to near boiling.
2. Cool and place in freezer until partially frozen.
3. Remove from freezer and add juices.
4. Stir and place in freezer again until firm.
5. Serves 4. Ingredients can be doubled to serve 8.
title: Florida Milk Sherbet(Grandmother Newman'S)

ingredients.text: 1 chicken breast, skinned, boned and sliced

steps: 1. Cook broccoli until crisp-tender.
2. Combine salad dressing, flour and salt.
3. Gradually add milk.
4. Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened.
5. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted.
6. Layer broccoli, chicken and sauce in 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
7. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
8. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Makes 2 servings.
9. Recipe may be doubled.
10. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
title: Chicken Divan Supreme

steps: 1. Combine oil, catsup, garlic, salt and paprika.
2. Stir well. Add scallops and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
3. Remove scallops from marinade; place in 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
4. Pour enough marinade over scallops to coat, but not cover (about 1 cup).
5. Broil 2 minutes.
6. Turn scallops over and broil 2 minutes or until done.
7. Serve hot.
8. Yields 4 servings.
title: Broiled Scallops

3. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with nuts.
4. In another bowl, blend 3 eggs, corn syrup, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1/2 cup sugar until smooth.

title: Rising To The Occasion

steps: 1. Cook sausage; drain.
2. Slightly beat eggs.
3. Pull bread apart into bite size pieces.

5. Spoon in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

steps: 1. Cook apples in melted butter until tender.
2. Add sugars.
3. Cook until sugars melt.
4. Add last four ingredients; stir together well. Combine with beans.
5. Mix well!
6. Pour all into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 400° about 1 hour.

title: Apple Bean Bake

steps: 1. Cut pork into 1/2 inch slices and pound to flatten. Combine butter and garlic powder; brush over pork. Combine seasonings; sprinkle over pork. title: Herbed Pork Medallions

ingredients.text: 2 lb. lean beef, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place meat in a large kettle.
2. Add all ingredients and cover. When mixture comes to steaming point, reduce heat to simmer.
3. Stir occasionally.
4. Should more liquid be needed, add either water or tomato juice.
5. This mixture should end more like a thick sauce than a thin mixture.
6. Serve over hot rice.
7. Serve with chutney, ground peanuts or coconut, sprinkled over the top.

9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Curried Beef Stew

title: Linaga (Boiled Chicken Stew)

ingredients.text: 6 medium yams, baked, peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Cut yams and apples in 1/2-inch slices.
2. Layer in buttered 3-quart deep casserole dish, starting with apples and ending with yams.

6. Bring to a boil and remove from heat.
7. Pour over yams.
8. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until apples are done.

title: Yam And Apple Casserole

steps: 1. Arrange fish fillets in 12 x 7 x 2-inch microproof baking dish with the thick edges toward the outside of the dish.
2. Dot with butter.
3. Stir lemon juice into wine and sprinkle with remaining ingredients over top.
4. Cover with waxed paper, cook on High (max power) 5 minutes.
5. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
6. Yields 3 to 4 servings.
7. Cooking time:
8. 5 minutes.
title: Microwave Fish Fillets With Mushrooms

steps: 1. Combine eggs, milk, mustard, onion and Tabasco; mix well. Stir in ham, cheese and crackers. Pour into baking dish and set in shallow pan of hot water.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
3. Serves 6.
title: Ham 'N Cheddar Cheese Casserole

ingredients.text: 8 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Saute chicken in butter in a skillet over medium heat for 10 minutes on each side.
2. Remove chicken to a serving platter. Reserve pan drippings in skillet.
3. Keep chicken warm.
4. Add lemon juice and next 3 ingredients to pan drippings.
5. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
6. Stir in chives and parsley.
7. Pour over chicken.
8. Yields 8 servings.
title: Vera'S Dijon Herb Chicken

ingredients.text: 6 to 8 oz. thinly sliced Muenster cheese

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1 to 2-inch squares. Soak in beaten eggs for 45 minutes. Coat with bread crumbs and brown in margarine or oil. Place in single layer in baking dish.
2. Cover with mushrooms and add chicken broth.
3. Place cheese slices over all. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes, covered, and 10 minutes, uncovered.
4. Serves 4.

steps: 1. In a large bowl, toss bread crumbs and broth. Add chicken, rice, pimentos, parsley and salt. Mix well. Transfer to greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour eggs over mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pork Chop-Vegetable Casserole

steps: 1. Put the gammon in a very large pan with 2 litres water and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and drain off the water – this helps to get rid of some of the saltiness. Recover with 2 litres cold water and bring to the boil again. Put everything but the frozen peas into the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 1½-2½ hrs, topping up the water as and when you need to, to a similar level it started at. As the ham cooks and softens, you can halve it if you want, so it is all submerged under the liquid. When the ham is tender enough to pull into shreds, it is ready.

2. Lift out the ham, peel off and discard the skin. While it is still hot (wear a clean pair of rubber gloves), shred the meat. Remove bay from the soup and stir in the frozen peas. Simmer for 1 min, then blend until smooth. Add a splash of water if too thick, and return to the pan to heat through if it has cooled, or if you are making ahead.
3. When you are ready to serve, mix the hot soup with most of the ham – gently reheat if made ahead. Serve in bowls with the remaining ham scattered on top, and eat with crusty bread and butter.
title: Split Pea Soup

steps: 1. Combine onions, salt, pepper, butter and cooked okra.
2. Layer in casserole with cheese, egg and bread crumbs.
3. Top with buttered bread crumbs.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Escalloped Okra

steps: 1. Lightly brown bacon; tear into pieces.
2. Lightly brown onion. Add all ingredients; simmer for about 10 minutes.
3. Cook mixture until okra is done, about 15 minutes.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Ham Gumbo

steps: 1. Cut corn off the cob; scrape well to remove corn milk.
2. Place cut corn in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
3. Add needed amount of water, sugar, butter and cornmeal; stir well.
4. Cover with plastic wrap or glass lid.
5. Microwave at High 2 minutes.
6. Stir well; rotate dish 1/2 turn.
7. Microwave at High 3 to 5 minutes; stir well.
8. Let stand, covered, 2 to 3 minutes before serving.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Southern Creamed Corn

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and slice as thin as possible. Layer potatoes in a 9 x 13 buttered casserole dish. Add rest of ingredients and bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Southern Living Potatoes

steps: 1. Cut corn from cob.
2. Heat butter or margarine in skillet and add corn.
3. Cook at medium for about 5 minutes, stirring often (may stick to bottom of pan if not stirred often).
4. Sprinkle flour, sugar and salt on top of corn and stir well.
5. Add milk and stir again.

steps: 1. Cut off tips of corn kernels into a bowl.
2. Scrape milk and remaining pulp from cob with a knife.
3. Set aside.

5. Reduce heat; cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Makes 8 servings.

steps: 1. Cook onion in oil just until tender.
2. Add chili sauce, salt and drained beans.
3. Cook until heated through, stirring often. Serves 6.

steps: 1. Cook bacon until crisp.
2. Remove bacon.
3. Into remaining bacon fat in pan, add onion and green pepper and cook until tender. Blend in flour, sugar, Worcestershire, salt and pepper and the mustard.
4. Add the tomatoes.
5. Cook, stirring unti thickened.
6. Add the green beans and heat well.
7. To serve add the beans with the bacon.
8. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Creole Style Green Beans

steps: 1. Saute onions in margarine until tender.
2. Add okra and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

8. 2 servings.

7. Combine sugar, eggs, mustard, 1 cup water, vinegar, salt and pepper; mix well.
8. Add to flour paste.
9. Place over low heat; cook until thick, stirring constantly.
10. Pour over potato mixture; mix lightly.
11. Let stand in cold place for several hours.
12. Yield:
13. 12 servings.
title: Covered Bridge Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 4 medium potatoes, cooked, peeled, sliced (about 4 c.)

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook onions in margarine 2 to 3 minutes.
2. Stir in next 5 ingredients.
3. Add potatoes and continue cooking, stirring constantly, about 2 minutes or until heated through (do not boil).
4. Garnish with parsley and bacon. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hot 'N Hearty Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain.
2. Heat oven to 350°.
3. Mix all ingredients, except cheese.
4. Place in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch square baking dish.
5. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 40 minutes.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Noodles Romanoff

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 lb. potatoes, peeled and sliced thin

steps: 1. Melt butter in shallow 2-quart microwave-safe dish.
2. Stir in flour until smooth.
3. Gradually add broth until blended. Microwave, uncovered, on High for 4 to 4 1/2 minutes until thickened.
4. Stir once.
5. Stir in mayonnaise.
6. Gently stir in potatoes and onion to coat.
7. Cover with lid and microwave 16 to 18 minutes.
8. Rotate dish 1/4 turn twice until potatoes in center are tender.
9. Let stand 10 minutes to complete cooking.
10. Makes 8 servings.
title: Microwave Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Heat beans. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Toss lightly over medium heat until beans are coated.
2. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Green Beans In Golden Crumbs

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together. Chill before serving.
2. Yields 6 servings.
title: Fresh Broccoli Salad

steps: 1. Coat roast with pepper.
2. Place, uncovered, in a roasting pan with drip rack.
3. Roast for 1 hour at 350°.
4. Add potatoes which have been tossed with oil and sprinkled with rosemary and salt. Bake 1 more hour.
5. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes. Slice roast.
6. Serves 8.
title: Peppered Pork Roast With Rosemary Potatoes

steps: 1. Pick over and wash beans.
2. Soak overnight in cold water (enough to cover).
3. Drain beans; combine with 6 cups water in pan. Bring to a boil and simmer 45 minutes until beans are firm tender.
4. Drain beans, reserving water.
5. Cut up pork.
6. Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart bowl.
7. Pour enough bean water to cover. Bake covered in slow oven (275°) for 3 hours.
8. Uncover; bake 2 hours more.
9. Stir beans occasionally and add water as needed. Serves 6.
title: New England Baked Beans

steps: 1. Pour oil into Teflon frypan.
2. Slice or chop garlic and brown lightly in oil.
3. Add chopped broccoli to oil and stir occasionally.
4. Cook about 5 to 10 minutes to desired tenderness. Pour over 1 pound cooked pasta and toss.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Broccoli, Garlic And Oil Over Pasta

steps: 1. Cook rice according to package directions.
2. Transfer to bowl; cover and chill.
3. Combine mayonnaise and sugar.
4. Fold in whipped topping.
5. Add celery, apples, walnuts and raisins to chilled rice. Fold in topping mixture.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Waldorf Rice Salad

ingredients.text: 4 (6-ounce) baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Place potato pieces in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap; cut a 1-inch slit in center of plastic wrap. Microwave at HIGH 10 minutes. Let stand for 2 minutes. Add sour cream and remaining ingredients to bowl; mash with a potato masher.

2. Omit sour cream and chives; decrease milk to 2 tablespoons and salt to 1/4 teaspoon. Add 3/4 cup plain low-fat yogurt; 1 tablespoon chopped chipotle chile, canned in adobo sauce; and 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin. Yield: 4 servings (serving size: about 1 cup). CALORIES 206; FAT 1g (sat 6g); SODIUM 236mg

3. Note: You can find roasted garlic cloves at the salad bar in many grocery stores. Omit sour cream and chives; increase milk to 3/4 cup. Add 1/4 cup coarsely chopped roasted garlic cloves and 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage. Yield: 4 servings (serving size: about 1 cup). CALORIES 223; FAT 9g (sat 7g); SODIUM 329mg

4. Decrease salt to 1/4 teaspoon. Add 1/4 cup (1 ounce) shredded reduced-fat extra-sharp cheddar cheese and 1 slice center-cut bacon, cooked and crumbled; mash with a potato masher to desired consistency. Yield: 4 servings (serving size: about 1 cup). CALORIES 254 (0% from fat); FAT 1g (sat 7g); SODIUM 280mg
title: Microwave Smashed Potatoes

steps: 1. Saute squashes, onion and garlic in butter, covered, until just tender, about 7 minutes.
2. Stir in tomato; sprinkle with cheese and basil.
3. Re-cover and continue cooking a couple of minutes until cheese melts.
4. Serves 4.
title: Mixed Squash And Tomatoes

steps: 1. Heat to boiling, first 4 ingredients.
2. Add Minute rice; remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes.
3. Add sour cream, stirring until rice is covered.
4. Serve hot.
5. Serves 4.
title: Rice And Sour Cream

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked yellow squash, drained well
4 green onions, cut into bite-sized pieces (optional)
1 c. sharp Cheddar cheese, cut into bite-size

steps: 1. Mix well.
2. Pour into a 1-quart casserole dish.
3. Bake 350° for one hour.
4. Makes 6 servings.
