title: Microwave-Herbed Potatoes

steps: 1. Place beans in baking dish. Combine syrup and brown sugar. Pour over beans and mix well. Add tomato sauce and onions. Bake at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Yields 6 servings.
title: Texas Style Baked Beans

ingredients.text: 6 large potatoes, peeled and cut into eighths

steps: 1. Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
2. Moisten potatoes with water, shaking off excess.
3. Shake a few at a time in the bag, coating well.
4. Pour margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
5. Place potatoes in a pan in a single layer.
6. Bake at 375° for 1 hour, turning once.
7. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired.
8. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes

steps: 1. Mix cabbage and salt and let stand for 30 minutes; squeeze by hand to drain off moisture.
2. Cook macaroni in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, or until tender.
3. Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again.
4. Combine butter or margarine, sugar, pepper, caraway seed, cabbage and macaroni in large skillet.
5. Cook slowly, stirring frequently, until lightly browned.
6. Add pimiento. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Fried Cabbage And Macaroni

steps: 1. Wash the potatoes well.
2. Cut the potatoes in half, then in half again.
3. In a paper bag, mix the Parmesan cheese and flour.
4. Place the potatoes in the bag of flour mixture and shake until well coated.
5. Place the potatoes on a baking dish and pour the melted butter or margarine over the potatoes.
6. Bake in a 350° oven until golden brown and tender when pierced with a fork.
7. It may be necessary to rotate or turn the potatoes once while they are cooking to ensure even cooking.
8. Serves 4 healthy eaters.
title: Seasoned Baked Potato Wedges

ingredients.text: 1 carrot, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Place olive on cutting board
2. and
3. lay a spatula on top of each olive.
4. Smash down to crack skin.
5. Put olives, carrots and celery in a large bowl
6. with lid.
7. Combine the rest of the ingredients and pour mixture on top of olives.
8. Cover container and toss occasionally.
9. Serve
10. after
11. 24 hours.
12. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
13. Store in refrigerator but serve at room temperature.
title: Marinated Green Olive Salad(Insalata Di Olvia Verdi)

steps: 1. Cook mushrooms, onions and rice in butter for 5 minutes. Place mixture into casserole dish.
2. Add broth and salt.
3. Cover and bake at 350° in oven for 45 minutes.
4. Serves 4.
title: Gourmet Rice

ingredients.text: 6 to 8 medium potatoes, peeled and diced

steps: 1. Cook all ingredients over medium flame until potatoes appear done and mash easy with a fork when tested.
2. Serve hot.
3. Serves 8 to 10 people.
title: Old Fashioned Potato Soup

steps: 1. In stockpot, combine carrots, zucchini, tomatoes, celery, mushrooms, onion, garlic, beef broth and V-8 juice.
2. Heat to boiling, reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are just tender.
3. Stir in basil, red wine, salt, pepper and parsley.
4. Add cheese just before serving.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Garden Cheddar Soup

steps: 1. Scrape small new potatoes; cook in boiling salted water until done; drain.
2. Combine 1 cup sour cream, dill seed and salt; pour over potatoes.
3. Heat 1 to 2 minutes, turning potatoes to coat. Makes 4 servings.
title: Dilly Potatoes

steps: 1. Toss all ingredients. Serve on salad greens. Serves 4.
title: Pear Waldorf Salad

ingredients.text: 1 pound pork butt, cut into small cubes
1 cup sauerkraut, plus around 4 tablespoons juice

steps: 1. (1) Place the pork in a medium stockpot with the chicken stock, water, allspice, bay leaves, and marjoram. Bring to a boil and then simmer on low heat for about 2 hours. Remove the pork and set aside on a plate to cool. Skim fat from stock, leaving a few "eyes" of fat for flavor. Add sauerkraut and simmer for 20 minutes. (2) Add potato and simmer for 5 minutes. (3) Add the carrots, celery, onion, and cabbage and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the pork and simmer for 10 more minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add sauerkraut juice. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cabbage Soup

steps: 1. In a large kettle, cook vegetables until tender, about 20 minutes.
2. Drain, reserving liquid.
3. Set aside.
4. Saute onions in oleo until soft.
5. Stir in flour and season to taste.
6. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly.
7. Stir in vegetables.
8. Add 1 cup or more of liquid.
9. Cook until desired consistency.
10. Makes 8 to 10 servings, 2 1/2 quarts.
title: Hearty Potato Soup

steps: 1. Cook potatoes, celery and onion in 3 cups water until tender. Add milk, bouillon cubes and margarine.
2. Mix flour with sour cream and add to the soup.
3. Stir constantly until thickened.
4. Stir in salt and pepper.
5. Serves 8-10.
title: Sour Cream Potato Soup

steps: 1. Scrub the potatoes and boil in salt water until they can easily be pricked with a fork.
2. Drain. Cut into small slices and place in serving dish.
3. Pour over the sour cream and then the olives. Serve immediately.
4. Serves 5.
title: Potato Slices With Sour Cream And Mock Caviar

ingredients.text: 3 c. cooked rice, cooked in chicken broth

steps: 1. Cook onion, carrot, walnut, marjoram, thyme and rosemary in butter.
2. In a large skillet over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender and crisp.
3. Stir in rice and parsley; heat thoroughly. Serves 6.
title: Herbed Walnut Rice

steps: 1. Cook squash and onion in 1/2 cup boiling water until tender; drain and mash.
2. Combine squash mixture, sour cream, salt, pepper and basil.
3. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.
4. Combine breadcrumbs, cheese, butter and paprika.
5. Sprinkle over squash mixture.
6. Top with bacon.
7. Bake at 300° for 20 minutes.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Country Club Squash

steps: 1. Mix mustard, salad dressing, vinegar and seasonings.
2. Add to the chopped cabbage and celery.
3. Makes 4 servings.
4. Chopped chives may be sprinkled over the salad, if desired.
title: Celery And Cabbage Slaw

steps: 1. Combine sliced carrots and grated onion.
2. Slightly cover with water and cook until tender and about half of the water is boiled out.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients, cooking and stirring until thickened.
4. This makes an attractive side dish with beef or pork slices.
5. Serves 3 or 4.
title: Carrots Vichy

ingredients.text: 4 large potatoes, peeled, cooked and quartered

steps: 1. In a large skillet, slowly saute potatoes in butter until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.
2. Sprinkle with paprika. Yield:
3. 4 to 6 servings.
title: Paprika Potatoes

steps: 1. Shred cabbage into large plastic bowl.
2. Place onions and peppers on top.
3. Sprinkle sugar over all.
4. DO NOT STIR!!!
5. Put rest of ingredients into a saucepan and bring to full boil.
6. Pour over cabbage mixture.
7. AGAIN,
8. DO NOT STIR!!!
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours.
10. (This can remain saturating for 3 days in fridge.)
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Juanita'S 3-Day Slaw

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Line a baking sheet with heavy duty foil.
3. Cut each potato into eight wedges; place on foil.
4. Coat with nonstick cooking spray.
5. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and seasonings.
6. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender.
7. Serves 8.
title: Parmesan Potato Wedges

steps: 1. Cut cranberry sauce into cubes.
2. Drain pineapple.
3. Beat together
4. sour cream, cheese and dash of salt.
5. Fold in chicken, pineapple, celery, nuts and green pepper.
6. Refrigerate up to
7. 24 hours.
8. Before serving, top chicken mixture with cranberry cubes. Makes 4 or 5 servings.
title: Fruited Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Combine the rice, flour and milk. Heat butter in a 10-inch skillet. Add onions and cook until tender. Spread the rice mixture evenly in the skillet. Press it down firmly with a spatula. Cook over medium heat until bottom is golden brown. Turn out onto serving dish, brown side up. Serves 4.
title: Hashed Brown Rice

ingredients.text: 3 c. thinly sliced, peeled, raw potatoes

steps: 1. Apply evenly in greased 2-quart baking dish the potatoes and 1 tablespoon of onions.
2. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/8 teaspoon of pepper and parsley flakes.
3. Mix ground beef, milk, cracker crumbs, catsup, 1/4 cup onions, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
4. Spread evenly over potatoes.
5. Bake in a 350° oven until potatoes are tender (50 to 60 minutes).
6. Serves 4 large helpings.
title: Beef And Potato Bake

steps: 1. Mix Parmesan cheese, olive oil and red pepper flakes in a large bowl.
2. Add potatoes and toss until well coated.
3. Place on baking sheet, in single layer.
4. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
5. Turn after 30 minutes.
6. Remove from oven and sprinkle with basil. Serve hot.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Parmesan Potatoes

steps: 1. Put cream in blender container and blend until stiff.
2. Add bananas, a few pieces at a time, and process until bananas are well chopped.
3. Scrape mixture from sides of container occasionally.
4. Add mayonnaise and salt and run until well blended.
5. Add marshmallows, a few at a time, and blend.
6. Add pecans and fruit and blend until just mixed.
7. Pour into freezer tray and freeze.
8. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Frozen Fruit Salad

steps: 1. Boil water, salt
2. and
3. oil; add macaroni and cook until tender (8 to 10 minutes).	Drain and cool.
4. Mix with remaining ingredients and
5. chill.
6. May
7. garnish with tomato wedge, hard-boiled egg wedge and/or parsley.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Seaside Salad

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients.
2. Sprinkle with sugar; set aside.
3. In a saucepan, combine dressing ingredients; bring to a boil.
4. Remove from the heat and pour over vegetables, stirring to cover evenly.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Stir well before serving.
7. Yield: 12 to 16 servings.
title: Overnight Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients.
2. Set aside.
3. Mix last 3 ingredients until smooth.
4. Pour dressing over salad and toss. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Favorite Broccoli Salad

ingredients.text: 1 lb. carrots, scrubbed and sliced 1/4-inch thick

steps: 1. In small saucepan, melt butter, peel, onion and dill.
2. Add oranges. Heat.
3. Cook carrots until tender.
4. Combine with sauce. Sprinkle with cashews.
5. Serves 6.
title: Golden Carrots

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Toss with 8 cups torn romaine lettuce.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Creamy Caesar Salad

ingredients.text: 8 medium potatoes, boiled and then peeled

steps: 1. After boiling potatoes, cool under cold running water.
2. Cube potatoes.
3. Place in lidded bowl. Add 3/4 cup vinegar to potatoes. Place lid on bowl.
4. Rotate bowl slowly to allow vinegar to go all over potatoes. Chill overnight.
5. Thoroughly mix onion, celery, pepper, salt and celery seed.
6. Add flavoring mixture to vinegar marinated potatoes, mixing thoroughly.
7. Serves 7.
title: Mom'S Potato Salad

steps: 1. Rinse chicken.
2. Combine with water, onion, celery, bay leaf, salt and pepper in heavy saucepan.
3. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes.
4. Remove and cool chicken; discard bay leaf.
5. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.
6. Add rice and carrot to broth in saucepan.
7. Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
8. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until rice is tender.
9. Add chicken. Heat to serving temperature.
10. Yield:
11. 6 servings.
title: Chicken And Rice Soup

steps: 1. In a large pan, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
2. Drain and save the liquid.
3. In same pan, saute the onion in butter until soft.
4. Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
5. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
6. Gently stir in cooked vegetables and 1 cup or more of reserved liquid until soup is desired consistency.
7. You can also add cooked beef or fried ground beef to this.
8. Yields 8 to 10 servings/2 1/2 quarts.
title: Hearty Potato Soup

steps: 1. Place chicken, water, leeks, bay leaf, parsley, salt and peppercorns in large pot and bring to a boil.
2. Lower heat; cover and simmer 1 1/4 hours or until chicken is tender.
3. Remove chicken and let cool.
4. Strain and reserve broth.
5. Remove skin from chicken and slice meat into strips.
6. Bring 3 cups of reserved broth to a boil.
7. Add rice and stir once with a fork.
8. Lower heat; cover and cook rice about 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
9. Heat oil in a large, heavy casserole and saute onions and garlic until golden brown.
10. Add rice and cook until lightly browned, stirring frequently.

11. Add chicken, shrimp, crabmeat, ham, coriander, cumin, chili powder, mace and about 1/4 cup broth and combine thoroughly. Cook over low heat about 10 minutes or until ingredients are heated through.
12. Stir frequently.
13. Stir in peanuts and serve immediately.
14. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chicken, Shrimp And Rice(From Guyana)

steps: 1. Wash rice and place in a large pot.
2. Add all of the remaining ingredients; stir with a large fork until all are well mixed together.
3. Cook for 1 hour without top on pot.
4. Stir every 15 minutes until done.
5. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Sonja And Sybil'S Red Rice

steps: 1. Add dressing to cabbage and pepper; toss and chill. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
2. Serves 6.
title: Easy Creamed Cabbage

steps: 1. Soak beans in cold water overnight.
2. Saute carrots, onion and celery to a golden color in heavy kettle or Dutch oven.
3. Brown ground beef and drain.
4. To the vegetables in kettle, add 1 gallon water or stock, if available.
5. Add 2 medium raw, cubed potatoes and ground beef.
6. Simmer 3 to 4 hours.
7. Peel the tomatoes; cut up and add to soup.
8. Salt and pepper.
9. Yields 8 servings.
title: Old-Fashioned Navy Bean Soup

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish.
3. Peel potatoes; cook with garlic in boiling salted water.
4. Meanwhile, saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.
5. Drain potatoes; discard garlic.
6. Whip potatoes with 1/4 cup butter, cream, egg yolks, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and dash of pepper.
7. Stir in mushrooms and parsley.
8. Spoon into casserole.
9. Melt rest of butter; toss with bread crumbs.
10. Sprinkle over potatoes.
11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
12. Serves 8.
title: Potato Mushroom Bake

steps: 1. Boil, cook and coarsely grate potatoes.
2. Add remaining ingredients, except 3 tablespoons butter.
3. Mix thoroughly.
4. Top with 3 tablespoons of butter.
5. Bake until bubbly and heated through, approximately 45 minutes at 350°. May be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen until cooking time.
6. If frozen, defrost before baking.
7. Serves 8.
title: Tasty Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Saute the onion in the butter until translucent.
2. Add the potatoes and combine.
3. Add the lemon juice, thyme and salt.
4. Mix. Spray a casserole dish with nonstick vegetable cooking spray.
5. Put half the potato mixture in the casserole and sprinkle with the flour.
6. Add the rest of the potatoes.
7. Pour in the skim milk and sprinkle with the bread crumbs.
8. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and slightly browned on top.
9. Yields 4 servings.
title: Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Combine oil and seasonings in a bowl.
2. Add potatoes, stir to coat, and arrange in a single layer on an ungreased 15 x 10 inch pan.
3. Bake uncovered at 450° for 15 minutes.
4. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp tender.
5. Serves 6.
title: Crispy Potato Wedges

steps: 1. Saute onion, celery and garlic in butter in a Dutch oven; add broth, brown rice, salt and pepper.
2. Cover and cook over low heat 40 minutes.
3. Stir in chopped carrot and cook an additional 10 minutes.
4. Yields 12 servings.
title: Garden Rice

ingredients.text: 4 small ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Steam green beans 5 minutes.
2. Heat oil in skillet.
3. Saute garlic, onion and beans 3 to 4 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, parsley, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
5. Cook for 5 minutes more.
6. Chill.
7. Serve at room temperature.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Green Beans With Tomatoes

steps: 1. Shred the cabbage fine.
2. Cook in small amount of salted boiling water until tender but still crisp.
3. Drain well.
4. Place cabbage and cheese in layers in greased baking dish.
5. Melt butter; blend in flour.
6. Stir in milk slowly; cook and stir until sauce comes to a boil.
7. Add salt, paprika, onion and parsley.
8. Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes until crumbs are brown.
9. Serves 6.
title: Creamed Cabbage With Cheese

steps: 1. Coarsely slice cabbage.
2. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Slightly brown meat with onions; salt and pepper to taste.
3. Pour over cabbage.
4. In a bowl mix together rice, sugar, tomatoes and catsup.
5. Pour over meat and cabbage.
6. Do not stir.
7. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cabbage Casserole

steps: 1. Scrub potatoes; cook in boiling water 30 minutes.
2. Drain and cool.
3. Peel potatoes; cut into 1/2-inch cubes and set aside.
4. Cook bacon until crisp.
5. Remove bacon; save 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
6. Crumble bacon; set aside.

7. Saute onions, green onion and celery in reserved bacon drippings until tender; set aside. Combine flour, sugar, salt, pepper and mustard in medium saucepan; add vinegar and water and cook ten minutes over medium heat or until slightly thickened.
8. Combine potatoes and onion mixture in a large mixing bowl; top with vinegar mixture, tossing gently. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
9. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Janet Cruz'S Hot Potato Salad

steps: 1. Run tines of fork lengthwise down side of unpared cucumber. Thinly slice cucumber and onion.
2. Mix vinegar, water, sugar and salt; pour on cucumber and onion in glass bowl.
3. Cover; refrigerate at least 2 hours.
4. Drain and serve on crisp salad greens.
5. Equal sweetener may be substituted for sugar.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Marinated Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Bring 1-inch of water to a boil.
2. Add all ingredients. Simmer, covered, 15 minutes or until tender.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Nutmeg Buttered Carrots

steps: 1. With electric mixer, beat cream cheese until smooth.
2. Add potatoes and rest of ingredients.
3. Beat to blend.
4. Spoon into 2-quart casserole and cover.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Mashed Potato Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. melted butter, shortening or vegetable oil

steps: 1. Rinse rice under cold running water.
2. Add salt and enough cold water to cover rice by 1-inch and allow to soak for at least 3 to 4 hours.
3. Drain.
4. Add rice to 15 cups boiling water while slowly stirring.
5. Continue to boil until the rice is tender.
6. After thoroughly draining in a strainer, rinse with cold water to remove starches.
7. Drain again.
8. In a saucepan, combine grease and 1/6 cup water.
9. Pour 1/4 of this mixture into the bottom of pot and add rice.
10. Poke a few holes in the rice, pouring the rest of the mixture over the rice and into the holes.
11. Wrap the lid of the pot with a dish towel and use to cover the rice.
12. Cook on medium heat for 10 minutes followed by an additional 15 to 20 minutes on low heat.
13. Serves 8.
title: Chelo(Che' Lo) (Rice)

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. hamburger (I use a little more)
1 c. brown sugar (I use 1/2 to 3/4 c.)

steps: 1. Brown hamburger in skillet; add to beans.
2. Mix in remaining ingredients.
3. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until brown.
4. Serves 6.
title: Baked Beans Supreme

steps: 1. Combine half of the croutons with all the remaining ingredients.
2. Turn into baking dish and cover with remaining croutons.
3. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
4. May be prepared ahead, but if so, do not put in croutons until baking time.
5. This is good for a luncheon or light dinner with a congealed or fruit salad and rolls.
6. Serves 6.
7. Psalms 103.
title: Hot Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, grated onion, celery seed, sugar, salt and pepper.
2. Drain the cabbage thoroughly and mix with the dressing.
3. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Cole Slaw

steps: 1. In a large bowl, break lettuce; top with cauliflower and layer onion in thin slices with crisp bacon pieces.
2. I also use chopped fresh broccoli and thawed frozen peas.
3. Combine mayonnaise and sugar and spread over bacon; try to seal vegetables below.
4. Do not stir.
5. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
6. Just before serving, add Parmesan cheese and toss.
7. Serves 5 to 6 with the added vegetables.
title: Cauliflower Salad

steps: 1. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in large skillet. Add potatoes and fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove potatoes. Melt remaining butter; saute onions. Stir in spices, water and salt. Cook about 3 minutes; return potatoes to pan and add the whole eggs. Cook 5 minutes over low heat until potatoes are tender and eggs heated. Serves 8.
title: Nepalese Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook potatoes, whole with skins on.
2. (Should be 6 cups diced, cooked potatoes, about 6 medium potatoes.)
3. Skin and dice while warm.
4. Immediately add the vinegar, prepared mustard, pepper, celery seed and salt, then add the cucumber, onion, green pepper, pimento and eggs.
5. Mix Cool Whip and mayonnaise together and add to potato mixture.
6. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Calico Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook sugar, cornstarch and egg in double boiler until sauce is very thick; add butter, stirring well.
2. Cool; mix pineapple, marshmallows and walnuts into sauce.
3. Pour into serving dish; chill.
4. Yield 8-10 servings.
title: Pineapple Salad

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Saute onion and pepper in butter in skillet until tender.
3. Stir in flour; gradually add milk, salt, pepper and mustard.
4. Cook, stirring constantly until smooth.
5. Add cheese and cook over medium heat until cheese melts.
6. Combine ham and potatoes with cheese mixture.
7. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish.
8. Combine melted butter and bread crumbs.
9. Sprinkle over casserole.
10. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
11. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Potato And Ham Casserole

steps: 1. Cover potatoes with cold water; refrigerate overnight.
2. In a large kettle, melt butter; add flour, salt and pepper.
3. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
4. Gradually add milk and cream. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
5. Drain potatoes; place in eight 3-quart baking pans.
6. Add onions.
7. Pour the sauce over and stir gently.
8. Cover and bake at 300° for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.
9. Yields 70 to 80 servings.
title: Escalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Mix together. Pour into greased round 8-inch casserole. Spread catsup on top.
2. Bake in pan of water 1 inch deep at 350° for 1 hour.
3. Serves 6.
title: Corn Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. In a large skillet, brown ground beef and drain off excess fat.
2. Add onion, bell pepper and bacon cut into pieces.
3. Cook until slightly tender.
4. Add the remaining ingredients with the cabbage last and cook for 20 minutes over medium to low heat or until cabbage is semi-tender.
5. Makes 4 servings.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Ground Beef And Cabbage

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.	Remove from pan; drain and crumble. Saute onions in bacon fat until glossy (do not brown).
2. Turn off heat.
3. Stir in flour, then heat until light yellow.
4. Stir in water and vinegar.
5. Add sugar, salt and spices.
6. Cook until mixture is of medium thickness.
7. Add potatoes, crumbled bacon and parsley.
8. Mix carefully to prevent mashing potatoes.
9. Yield:
10. 6 to 8 servings.
title: Hot Potato Salad - The Hofbran Haus Way

steps: 1. Combine the zucchini with the salt in a large mixing bowl. Let set for 15 minutes.

3. Meanwhile heat the olive oil and saute the onion and garlic for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Place half the onions and a coating of oil in a 9 inch pie plate. Squeeze the zucchini dry and combine with the potatoes, carrots, basil, chives and cheese. Put this mixture into pie plate and top with the remaining onions and garlic.
5. Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes. Pour the cream over, low heat to 350 degrees and cook for 20 to 30 minutes until lightly browned on top. Cut in wedges to serve. Serves 6.
title: Easy Potato And Carrot And Zucchini

steps: 1. Cook new potatoes in jackets.
2. Remove jackets. Combine butter, lemon juice and parsley. Add potatoes; toss until coated. Serves 6.
title: Parsleyed New Potatoes

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add garlic and ginger and cook 20 seconds.
3. Add beans, carrots and onions; cook, stirring, 2 minutes.
4. Add water, soy sauce and sugar. Reduce heat to medium; cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Stir-Fried Vegetables

steps: 1. Wash squash and split lengthwise; scrape out seeds. Place cut side down on baking sheet lined with foil. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until squash is tender.
2. Turn squash over.
3. Add 1/2 slice bacon, butter, salt and pepper to each. Return to oven and bake for 30 minutes longer or until bacon is cooked. Yields 6 servings.
title: Acorn Squash

steps: 1. Combine carrots and raisins in a large bowl. Mix together the mayonnaise, sugar, salt, milk and lemon juice. Toss with carrots and raisins. Chill well before serving.
2. Yields 6 servings.
title: Carrot Raisin Salad

steps: 1. Cut corn from cob; combine corn, onion and green pepper. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter 5 minutes.
2. Spoon half of corn mixture into 2-quart casserole; top with half of tomato slices. Sprinkle with half of salt and pepper.
3. Repeat layers.
4. Combine bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter; sprinkle evenly over casserole.
5. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
6. Yields 8 servings.
title: Corn And Tomato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips. Place in greased casserole dish.
2. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, until bubbly.
3. Last 5 to 10 minutes before done, place on cheese and crushed chips.
4. Serves 6.
title: Hot Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Remove and discard husks and silks from corn.
2. Brush corn with butter; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
3. Wrap each ear tightly in aluminum foil.
4. Grill, covered with lid, over medium coals 15 to 20 minutes, turning often.
5. Yield:
6. 6 servings.
title: Grilled Corn On The Cob

steps: 1. Cut cabbage, onions and green pepper.
2. Bring sugar, vinegar, celery seed, salt and dry mustard to boil.
3. Remove from fire and add Wesson oil.
4. Pour over cabbage, onion and pepper.
5. Place in refrigerator.
6. Keeps well for several days.
7. Serves 10.
title: Cabbage Slaw

steps: 1. Prepare bananas and sprinkle with lemon juice.
2. Add whipped cream and blend.
3. Chill thoroughly; place in serving dishes. Stuff one nut in each date and place on top of bananas.
4. Garnish with coconut and serve chilled.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Banana And Date Salad

steps: 1. Turn the warm drained rice into a 3-quart bowl.
2. Cut marshmallows into eighths.
3. Use a fork to toss rice and marshmallows.
4. Whip the cream, then add sugar.
5. Turn cream over rice.
6. Add pineapple and fold.
7. Chill in refrigerator.
8. When ready to serve, top with cherries.
9. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Glorified Rice

ingredients.text: 2 lb. red potatoes, boiled and cubed

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Chill 30 minutes to 4 hours. Yields 4 servings.
2. Has 225 calories, fat free.
title: Dill Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cut cabbage in wedges.
2. Place in buttered casserole.
3. Mix beef, onions and rice together and arrange between wedges. Combine water, tomatoes and seasonings and pour over casserole. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
4. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Cabbage Casserole

steps: 1. Blend together mayonnaise, garlic, onion and mustard.
2. Shred chicken into very small pieces.
3. Combine all ingredients; cover and chill before serving.
4. Store in refrigerator.
5. Yield:
6. 4 servings.
title: Valley Fresh Chicken Salad

steps: 1. In a 1 1/2-quart nonstick saucepan, combine onion and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is translucent.
2. Add remaining ingredients except water and stir to combine.
3. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
4. Add water and bring to a boil.
5. Cover and cook over medium heat until vegetables are soft, about 20 minutes.
6. Using a slotted spoon, remove about 1/2 cup vegetables from saucepan and set aside.
7. In two batches, puree remaining soup in blender.
8. Return pureed mixture to saucepan and reserved vegetables and heat.
9. Yield:
10. 2 servings, 2 1/4 vegetable exchange.
title: Vegetable Soup

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt and pepper.
2. Put a third of the potatoes into a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
3. Sprinkle with half of the flour-salt mixture.
4. Add half the ham.
5. Cover with half the flour mixture.
6. Add half the ham.
7. Cover with second third of potatoes, then remaining ham, then rest of potatoes.
8. Sprinkle on rest of flour mixture.
9. Dot with margarine; pour milk over all. Bake in 375° oven for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and brown on top.
10. Serves 4.
title: Ham And Scalloped Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Scrub potatoes and cut lengthwise into 3/8-inch slices.
2. Toss potatoes with ingredients in bowl.
3. Place potatoes single layer on greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking dish.
4. Bake at 475° for 15 minutes.
5. Turn over and bake 10 minutes longer or until crisp and tender.
6. Serves 4.
title: Baked French Fries

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Shred cheese; set aside.
3. In 2 quart saucepan, melt butter over low heat.
4. Blend in flour; add milk all at once; cook stirring constantly, until thickened.
5. Add cheese, salt and pepper.
6. Continue cooking and stirring until cheese melts. Remove from heat.
7. Spread 1/2 cheese sauce in bottom of shallow 2 1/2 quart baking dish.
8. Slice potatoes and onions.
9. Arrange potato and onion slices over cheese sauce layer.
10. Top with remaining cheese sauce.
11. Bake at 350° for 1 hour until potatoes are done. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in small amount of water until just glossy. Melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour, salt and pepper.
2. Add milk gradually, stirring constantly.
3. Cook and stir until thick and smooth.
4. Remove from heat; add cheese, stirring until melted. Spoon potatoes in baking dish;
5. arrange onion over potatoes.
6. Pour cheese sauce over all.
7. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 30 minutes.
8. Yields 10 to 12 servings.
title: Cheese-Scalloped Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into spears

steps: 1. Heat 1 inch water (salted if desired) to boiling.
2. Add broccoli.
3. Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
4. Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes or just until stems are tender; drain.
5. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over broccoli.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Broccoli With Oil And Lemon

steps: 1. Add cream-style corn.
2. Simmer 5 minutes.
3. Add milk and grated cheese.
4. Stir until cheese melts and chowder is heated through. Do not boil.
5. Serves 4.
title: Cheese And Corn Chowder

steps: 1. Mix all together and pour into a casserole dish.
2. Cook at 350° until brown.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Squash Casserole

steps: 1. Combine ingredients and mix lightly.
2. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrot Salad

steps: 1. Combine egg and milk.
2. Add remaining ingredients, except crumbs in order listed.
3. Pour into greased casserole.
4. Top with buttered crumbs.
5. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Corn And Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Blend mayonnaise and lemon juice together.
2. Pour over remaining ingredients and combine thoroughly.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrot Salad

steps: 1. Slice the potatoes about 1/4 inch thick.
2. Brush the slices with the vegetable oil.
3. Place in a baking pan; sprinkle with the thyme and oregano.
4. Bake in a 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
5. Yields 4 servings.
title: Oven-Baked Herb Potatoes

steps: 1. Chop bell pepper and cook in a little oil.
2. Mix squash, eggs, cheese, bell pepper, salt, butter and 1/2 the bread crumbs.
3. Pour into baking dish.
4. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.
5. Bake 1 hour at 350° (uncovered).
6. Serves 6.
title: Squash Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 c. frozen cut green beans, thawed

steps: 1. Cook and stir onion in hot margarine until tender.
2. Add broth, lemon juice and garlic powder.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Stir in rice. Return to boil.
5. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
6. Stir in green beans, almonds and dill; cover. Let stand 5 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Rice Almondine

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.
2. Add onion, carrots, celery and green pepper.
3. Cook until tender, but not too brown.
4. Add beef; cook until crumbly.
5. Stir in tomato juice, potatoes and seasonings.
6. Cover and cook over low heat until vegetables are tender, 20 to 30 minutes.
7. Combine flour with 1 cup milk.
8. Beat until free of lumps.
9. Stir into soup mixture.
10. Add remaining milk; heat, stirring frequently, but do not boil.
11. Makes 10 servings.
title: Hamburger Chowder

ingredients.text: 1 c. fresh okra, cut in 1/4 inch rounds

steps: 1. Fry okra and onions (scallions) in 2 tablespoons bacon grease until onions are clear and okra is still bright green (overcook and it will be slimy).
2. Remove okra and onions.

3. In same skillet stir eggs until they start thickening, then return okra and onions and carefully work mixture to desired doneness (about 5 to 9 minutes). Serves 4 to 5. Very good served with cornbread.
title: Okra Lover'S Omelet

steps: 1. Brown first 4 ingredients.
2. Mix rest of ingredients together well.
3. Add browned meat mixture.
4. Put into greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
5. At this point, you may refrigerate and bake the next morning.
6. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in a 350° oven or until lightly browned.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat milk, salt and mustard.
2. Add bread, cheese, ham; mix.
3. Put in well-greased 9 1/2 x 13 inch glass baking dish.
4. Dot with butter.
5. Cover with foil.
6. Must refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
8. Serves 8.
title: Baked Breakfast

steps: 1. Crumble sausage, brown and drain.
2. Line a greased 13 x 9-inch pan with rolls and mash.
3. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine other ingredients and beat well.
4. Pour over rolls.
5. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes and let stand 5 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Chop onions and ham.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Bake in greased casserole for 40 minutes at 350°.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together.
2. Blend shortening into flour as you would when making biscuits, working until they resemble corn meal.
3. Beat egg yolks and add milk.
4. Beat together thoroughly. Add dry ingredients and beat only until the two are blended.
5. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
6. Bake until light goes out on waffle iron.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Waffles

ingredients.text: 1 loaf bread, cubed (cinnamon bread is the best)

steps: 1. Place cubed bread in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over bread.
3. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon and dot with butter, if desired.
4. Cover; refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: French Toast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat eggs well.
2. Add other ingredients; mix well.
3. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
5. Serves 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Crumble sausage in a medium skillet; cook over medium heat until browned, stirring occasionally.
2. Drain well.
3. Spread bread crumbs in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish; top with sausage and cheese.
4. Combine eggs, milk and seasonings; beat well and pour over cheese.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Make-Ahead Breakfast

steps: 1. Fry sausage and onion.
2. Drain fat.
3. Layer sausage in pan, 13 x 9-inches.
4. Layer bread cubes over sausage.
5. Sprinkle cheese over bread.
6. Mix eggs, dry mustard, salt and milk.
7. Pour over top. Refrigerate overnight.
8. In the morning bake 1 hour at 355° or until firm.
9. Serves 5.
title: Linda'S Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Remove crusts from bread; butter, dice and place in bottom of baking dish.
2. Cover bread with grated cheese.
3. Beat eggs, milk and seasoning together and pour over bread and cheese.
4. Cover with cooked and drained sausage.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Bake

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain.
2. Spread crumbled sausage on bottom of 2-quart baking dish.
3. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the bread crumbs.
4. Mix the eggs and milk together and pour over the mixture. Cover the casserole and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.
5. It will keep 48 hours before baking.
6. Put in cold oven at 350° and bake for 40 minutes.
7. Let stand 2 minutes before serving.
8. Yields 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown and drain sausage and set aside.
2. Beat eggs and milk, salt and mustard.
3. Gently stir in bread, cheese and sausage.
4. Put in 8 x 12-inch buttered pan and refrigerate overnight.
5. Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Yields 6 servings.
title: Facelift Casserole(Breakfast Casserole)

steps: 1. Place bread cubes in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

2. Place cheese and bacon on top. Mix eggs, milk, parsley and seasoning; pour over bread, etc. Melt oleo and drizzle over top. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat egg whites with fork for 2 minutes.
2. Fry onion in nonstick pan until transparent.
3. Add green pepper.
4. Add egg whites. Serve with sliced tomatoes.
5. Serves 1.
title: Vegetarian Omelette

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. crushed onion, bacon or Canadian bacon, browned

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. In oven melt butter in baking dish (9 x 13-inch) until dish is coated on bottom.
3. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs, sour cream, milk and salt until blended.
4. Stir in onion.
5. Pour into dish.
6. Bake until eggs are set but still moist, about 35 minutes.
7. Makes 12 servings.
title: Oven Omelet Brunch

ingredients.text: 1 lb. hot sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained of all fat

steps: 1. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a buttered baking dish. Combine eggs, milk, salt and dry mustard; pour over the ingredients in the baking dish.
2. Refrigerate overnight.
3. Bake the next morning in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Great Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 lb. sausage, ham or bacon, browned and drained

steps: 1. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Place bread slices on bottom of pan (cut where necessary to fit).
3. Beat eggs.
4. Add milk and remaining ingredients, except cheese.
5. Pour over bread.
6. Top with grated cheese.
7. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
8. Uncover and bake at 350° for 1 hour (let stand 5 minutes before serving). Serves 12.
title: Easy Company Breakfast

steps: 1. Crumble sausage in medium-sized heavy skillet and cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally.
2. Drain well. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 12 x8 x 2-inch baking dish and top with sausage and cheese.
3. Combine eggs, milk and seasonings. Beat well and pour over cheese.
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Bake

ingredients.text: 3 slices white bread, crust removed and cubed

steps: 1. Brown sausage. Beat eggs; add milk and salt. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread sausage in bottom of pan. Next layer bread cubes. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until center is done. Makes 6 servings.
2. You may use bacon or ham instead of sausage.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat together the milk, eggs, cinnamon and 2 tablespoons honey.
2. Dip the bread slices in the milk mixture.
3. Arrange the bread by overlapping the slices in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar and drizzle with the melted butter and remaining 2 tablespoons of honey.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Honey-Baked French Toast

steps: 1. Melt margarine into the bottom of a sheet cake pan or oven roaster.
2. Preheat oven to 375°.
3. Crack and beat eggs.
4. Add hot milk and salt and pour into prepared pan.
5. Bake 25 minutes, then stir gently to loosen edges.
6. Bake an additional 15 minutes or until eggs are set to your liking.
7. Serves 25.
8. Easy way to feed a crowd; we use this at camp a lot.
title: Oven Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Cook sausage well and drain.
2. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
3. Tear bread into small pieces and sprinkle over butter. Sprinkle drained sausage over bread crumbs.
4. Sprinkle cheese over sausage.
5. Beat eggs and other ingredients.
6. Pour over mixture. Chill 8 hours or overnight.
7. Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 slices white bread, cubed enough to cover bottom of dish

steps: 1. Saute sausage; drain.
2. Beat eggs with milk and salt; layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; pour egg mixture on top.
3. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake at 350°
5. for 45 minutes.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Company Breakfast(This Can Be Made The Day Before)

steps: 1. Saute green pepper and onion in butter until tender.
2. Remove and set aside.
3. In a medium bowl, beat eggs with milk, dill, salt & pepper.
4. Pour egg mixture into a non-stick skillet and cook until nearly set.
5. Add pepper mixture and tomato.
6. Cook and stir until heated through and the eggs are set.
7. Serve immediately.
8. Serves 4.
title: Calico Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.text: 12 slices bread, buttered on both sides
1 lb. bacon, ham or sausage, cooked
8 to 12 oz. grated cheese (Cheddar, Swiss or American)

steps: 1. Place bread in bottom and up sides of a 9 x 13-inch pan (cut slices for sides).
2. Combine milk and eggs.
3. Beat.
4. Pour over bread.
5. Put meat and cheese mix on top; push bread into mixture to saturate.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
7. Remove cover and push bread into mixture again before baking.
8. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
9. Serves 5 to 8 adults.
title: Holiday Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon and drain.
2. Break into pieces.
3. You can use ham or sausage.
4. Cut cheese into halves and arrange on slightly buttered 9-inch pie pan.
5. Beat eggs and milk together.
6. Add chopped bacon. Pour over cheese and bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes.
7. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Sunday Morning Omelet

steps: 1. With a fork, lightly beat the eggs, salt, nutmeg, sugar and milk until well mixed.
2. Melt butter in frying pan and heat until butter begins to brown.
3. Dip each slice of bread in the egg mixture until well soaked and place in the frying pan to cook. Cook one side until lightly browned and flip over to brown the other side.
4. You can keep the cooked French toast hot in a warm oven until you've cooked all your bread.
5. Serve hot with butter and syrup.
6. Yield: 2 to 3 servings.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Cook sausage over medium heat until done, stirring to crumble. Drain well.
2. Set aside.
3. Combine sausage and remaining ingredients, mixing well.
4. Pour into a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
5. Refrigerate, covered, overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Yield: 8 to 10 servings.
title: Company Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown sausage and set aside.
2. Butter bread and cube.
3. Put bread cubes in bottom of pan.
4. Put drained sausage on bread cubes. Sprinkle cheese on sausage.
5. Beat eggs; add milk, salt and mustard.
6. Pour over sausage and bread cubes.
7. Chill overnight. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Put butter, sugar and corn syrup in saucepan and bring to boil, stirring until syrupy.
2. Spray cookie sheet with Pam.
3. Pour syrupy mixture on cookie sheet and cover bottom.
4. Layer bread 2 high across pan.
5. Combine rest of ingredients and mix well.
6. Pour over bread, making sure all bread is covered.
7. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
8. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
9. Check after 30 minutes.
10. When removing from pan, flip bread from bottom to top. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
11. Serves 12 to 14 people.
title: Oven French Toast

steps: 1. Butter bread and cut each slice into fourths.
2. Lay bread on bottom of casserole dish.
3. Brown sausage and crumble on bread. Put shredded cheese on sausage. Beat eggs and add milk.
4. Pour over cheese. Bake covered with foil for 15 minutes at 350°. Take off foil and bake 15 minutes longer.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Spread butter on both sides of bread.
2. Cut bread into cubes. In a big bowl, combine bread, ham, cheese, salt and pepper. Separately beat eggs until foamy.
3. Stir in milk with eggs.
4. Add eggs to bread mixture.
5. Mix well.
6. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
7. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
8. Before baking, remove cover.
9. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 1 hour.
10. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Ham And Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 c. raw potatoes, chopped or diced

steps: 1. Place potatoes, salt and pepper in nonstick skillet.
2. Cook for approximately 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
3. Reduce heat and add onions, if desired.
4. Cook potatoes about 30 minutes or until tender.
5. Spray occasionally with nonstick spray if necessary to keep potatoes from sticking to skillet.
6. Fold like an omelet and serve.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Hash Brown Potatoes

steps: 1. Saute ham and onion in 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet until onion is tender.
2. Add eggs and cook over medium-high heat; stir to form large, soft curds.
3. When eggs are set, stir in Cheese Sauce (recipe follows).
4. Spoon eggs into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
5. Sprinkle with paprika and chill overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
7. Serves 8.
title: Scrambled Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Melt butter in large skillet over low heat.
2. Combine remaining ingredients in mixing bowl; mix until smooth.
3. Pour mixture into skillet.
4. As eggs cook, lift outside edges to allow uncooked eggs to flow to outer edge of skillet.
5. Continue stirring until eggs are cooked, but mixture still has a creamy appearance.
6. Serve or cover and keep warm until serving time.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Heat And Hold Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Whisk together first three ingredients.
2. Heat an omelet pan over medium heat.
3. Add butter, coating bottom of pan.
4. Pour egg mixture into pan.
5. As it cooks, gently lift the edges of the omelet with a spatula, tilting pan to allow the uncooked portion to flow underneath the cooked portion.
6. Sprinkle herbs over omelet.
7. Fold in half, transfer to plate.
8. Use parsley for garnish, if desired. Makes 4 servings.
title: Omelette Aux Fines Herbes

ingredients.text: 1 (8 oz.) loaf French bread, cut in 1-inch slices

steps: 1. Combine eggs, orange juice, milk, sugar, nutmeg and vanilla. Mix with a wire whisk. Place bread in a single layer in a tight fitting casserole. Pour milk mixture over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight, tuning once. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Pour melted butter evenly over top. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
3. Serve with maple syrup and butter. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Pecan French Toast

ingredients.text: 2 c. bread cubes (to cover bottom of dish)

steps: 1. Saute sausage; drain.
2. Beat eggs with milk and salt.
3. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
4. Pour egg mixture on top.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Will serve 6 to 8 people.
title: Night-Before Breakfast

ingredients.text: 12 slices bread, cubed with crust removed

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain and cool.
2. Beat eggs with milk and add bread and salt.
3. Stir in cheese and sausage.
4. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish (or pan) cover with fill and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes uncovered.
6. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Melt as much butter as desired in a frypan set at 320° or medium heat.
2. Cream the cream cheese in mixer bowl on #4 speed until creamy.
3. Add eggs; beat 1/2 minute on #8 speed.
4. Scrape bowl and beaters.
5. Add milk, salt and pepper.
6. Blend in on #4 speed.
7. Pour mixture into frypan.
8. Cook slowly, scraping a few times from bottom and sides with a spoon.
9. Do not stir constantly. Cook only until set, but still moist.
10. Serve with bacon, ham or sausage.
11. Garnish with chopped parsley or chives.
12. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.text: 1 lb. sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add milk and salt.
2. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Pour egg mixture on top.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Overnight Breakfast

steps: 1. Cook, crumble and drain sausage.
2. Butter bread and cut into cubes.
3. Place cubed bread in a large greased casserole dish. Sprinkle sausage and shredded Longhorn cheese over bread.
4. Combine eggs, half and half, salt and mustard.
5. Beat well.
6. Pour over sausage.
7. Chill for 8 hours.
8. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown sausage in skillet and drain.
2. Combine half and half, eggs and salt.
3. Mix well.
4. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a 10 x 15-inch baking dish.
5. Pour egg mixture over layers. Chill overnight, covered.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat egg, cinnamon and sugar in medium to small mixing bowl. Dip 1 slice of bread into bowl.
2. Put 1 teaspoon butter into heated pan along with 1 slice of bread.
3. Fry until lightly browned. Repeat the process for the second slice.
4. Serves 2 people.
title: Jerica'S French Toast

steps: 1. Sure!
2. Crabmeat for breakfast!
3. Drain and flake about 6 ounces.
4. Slice green onions with tops very thin.
5. Cook 2 or 3 minutes in 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet.
6. Beat eggs. Add skim milk, salt, pepper and paprika.
7. Pour over onions and cook slowly until firm and browned on the bottom.
8. When done, sprinkle with crabmeat, fold over and turn out on a hot platter. Makes 4 servings and each portion contains only about 215 calories.
title: Crabmeat Omelet(Virginia Seafood Council)

steps: 1. Blend flour into 2 tablespoons melted butter in saucepan. Cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.
2. Stir in milk gradually. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
3. Stir in salt, pepper and cheese until cheese is melted.
4. Saute ham in 3 tablespoons butter in skillet.
5. Add eggs.
6. Cook over medium heat until eggs are set, stirring constantly.
7. Stir in cheese sauce. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
8. Sprinkle with mixture of bread crumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter.
9. Chill, covered, overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
10. Yield:
11. 12 servings.
title: Scrambled Egg Casserole

steps: 1. In food processor or blender, combine all ingredients except ice.
2. Cover and on high speed with machine running, drop in ice cubes, one at a time.
3. Blend about 10 seconds or until thick and frothy.
4. To serve, pour into glasses.
5. Per serving about 60 calories and 0 fat.
6. Yields 1 serving.
title: Strawberry-Banana Breakfast Treat

ingredients.text: 1 lb. mild pork sausage, browned, crumbled, drained and cooled
6 slices white bread, decrusted and cubed

steps: 1. Mix beaten eggs, milk, cubed bread, salt and mustard in large bowl.
2. Mix by hand with large spoon.
3. Add sausage and cheese. Stir well.
4. Pour into greased Pyrex 9 x 9-inch or 8 x 10 1/2-inch pan.
5. Cover and set overnight in refrigerator.
6. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 350°.
7. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into squares.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat the eggs very lightly in a bowl.
2. Add the remaining ingredients, except the butter.
3. Melt the butter in a 9-inch skillet or omelette pan, letting it heat until it has a nutty fragrance, but it is not browned.
4. Pour the egg mixture into the pan; cook over low heat until lightly browned, pulling the mixture from the sides of the pan with a fork as it cooks.
5. Turn and brown lightly on the other side.
6. Serves 4.
title: Cheese Omelette

steps: 1. Place 6 slices of bread on the bottom of an extra large casserole pan.
2. Brown sausage and drain.
3. Spread half of sausage on bread.
4. Spread half of both cheeses over sausage.
5. Layer again. Mix egg, milk and salt; pour over layers.
6. Cook, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 12 slices white bread, cut in quarters

steps: 1. Cook sausage until browned; drain all drippings except 2 tablespoons.
2. Saute the onion in the reserved drippings, until tender.
3. In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer the ingredients.
4. Begin with 1/2 of the bread, then 1/2 the sausage, 1/2 onion and 1/2 cheese.
5. Repeat layers.
6. Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard, then pour over the layers. Cover; refrigerate for at least overnight before cooking.
7. When ready to bake, remove baking dish from refrigerator 1 hour before baking to bring to room temperature, then bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
8. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 c. crushed cornflakes (4 c. before crushing)

steps: 1. In mixing bowl, combine sour cream and chicken soup.
2. Stir in potatoes, ham, Velveeta and onion.
3. Spread in 13 x 9-inch dish. Combine cornflakes and melted butter, sprinkle over mixture.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
6. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Hash Brown-Ham Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. cubed fully cooked lean ham
1 c. (4 oz.) reduced fat shredded Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat the egg whites, eggs, milk, seasoned salt and pepper. Pour into a 10-inch ovenproof skillet coated with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle with the ham, broccoli, cheese, tomatoes and onion. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until eggs are almost set. Broil 4 to 6-inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until the eggs are set and top lightly browned. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Early-Riser Oven Omelet

ingredients.text: 1 loaf bread (26 to 28-inch long and 2-inches wide)

steps: 1. Arrange bread in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
2. Beat ingredients until well blended and sugar is dissolved.
3. Pour over bread.
4. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour and can be 24 hours, allowing bread to soak up liquid.
5. Heat oven to 425°.
6. Lightly grease a jelly roll pan and transfer bread, making sure slices don't touch.
7. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and lightly browned.
8. Dust with confectioners sugar and serve immediately.
9. Makes 4 servings: 423 calories, 10 g fat, 63 g car, 560 mg sod and 228 mg chol.
title: Overnight French Toast

ingredients.text: 2 c. rolled oats (regular or quick; not instant)

steps: 1. In a heavy saucepan, combine the milk, oats, salt, raisins and apples.

2. Bring the oatmeal to a boil, reduce the heat, cover the pan and simmer the cereal, stirring it often, for about 5 minutes. Add the sunflower seeds and cook the oatmeal for another 5 minutes or until it reaches the desired consistency.
3. Serve the oatmeal sprinkled with cinnamon-sugar, if desired.
4. Serves 4.
title: Hearty Oatmeal

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350˚F.

2. Mix all the crust ingredients (graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, granulated sugar and ground cinnamon) in a medium bowl. Set aside about 2 Tbsp (30 mL) for later and press the mixture into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate in the bottom and up the sides. Bake crust for 10 minutes, it will only brown slightly.

3. Combine the vanilla custard filling ingredients (milk, granulated sugar, cornstarch, egg yolks, vanilla extract and salt together) and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly, until it bubbles and thickens to the texture of pudding. Set aside to cool while you make the meringue topping.

4. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the beater attachment or in a large bowl using an electric mixer beat the meringue ingredients (egg whites, granulated sugar, cream of tartar) together until it holds stiff and glossy peaks.

5. To assemble the pie, pour the filling into the crust and top with a thick layer of the meringue, making little spikes that will brown on top. Sprinkle the reserved crumb over the top and place it into the preheated oven.
6. Bake until the meringue browns, around 10 minutes, making sure to watch it carefully.
7. Chill in the fridge and eat within a few hours of baking. This pie is best eaten the same day as the meringue will soften and liquify.
title: Flapper Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a 10x14x2-inch baking pan.

2. Heat margarine in a skillet over medium heat; stir in onion. Cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook and stir until onion is very tender and dark brown, about 40 minutes more.

3. Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot; stir in chicken breasts, reduce heat, and simmer until chicken is no longer pink at the center, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Remove chicken breasts to a plate using a slotted spoon; reserve broth.

4. Juice potatoes with an electric juicer; place dry potato flesh into a bowl and discard juice. Stir salt and pepper into potatoes; stir in enough reserved broth to make the mixture the consistency of oatmeal. Set remaining broth aside.

5. Spread half of potato mixture evenly into the prepared pan. Lay cooked chicken breast evenly over potatoes; scatter caramelized onion evenly over chicken. Spread remaining potato mixture over onions and chicken to cover.
6. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 1 hour. Reheat chicken broth; pour over individual servings as desired.
title: Rappie Pie

steps: 1. Place the pumpkin in a large saucepan, cover with water and bring to the boil. Cover with a lid and simmer for 15 mins or until tender. Drain pumpkin; let cool.

2. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and use it to line a 22cm loose-bottomed tart tin. Chill for 15 mins. Line the pastry with baking parchment and baking beans, then bake for 15 mins. Remove the beans and paper, and cook for a further 10 mins until the base is pale golden and biscuity. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly.

3. Increase oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Push the cooled pumpkin through a sieve into a large bowl. In a separate bowl, combine the sugar, salt, nutmeg and half the cinnamon. Mix in the beaten eggs, melted butter and milk, then add to the pumpkin purée and stir to combine. Pour into the tart shell and cook for 10 mins, then reduce the temperature to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Continue to bake for 35-40 mins until the filling has just set.
4. Leave to cool, then remove the pie from the tin. Mix the remaining cinnamon with the icing sugar and dust over the pie. Serve chilled.
title: Pumpkin Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Beat eggs and sugar in medium bowl. Add corn syrup, butter and vanilla.
3. Mix well. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake 50 minutes until set.
4. Makes 8 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients together.
2. Add onions, then buttermilk and finally the beaten egg.
3. Drop by spoonfuls into pan in which fish is being fried.
4. Fry to a golden brown.
5. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 4 servings.
title: Hush Puppies(Fishermen'S Bread)

steps: 1. In medium bowl, combine sugar and flour. Stir in corn syrup. Whisk in eggs. Stir in pecans, evaporated milk and vanilla. Pour into frozen pie crust. Bake in preheated 350° oven on preheated baking sheet for 50 minutes or until firm. Cool on wire rack. Makes 8 servings.
title: Creamy Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Pour milk into top of double boiler and cook until it almost comes to a boil.
2. Slowly add corn meal, stirring constantly.
3. Cook until mixture is thick and smooth, approximately 1 minute.
4. Add butter and salt and cool slightly.
5. Beat yolks and add to corn meal mixture.
6. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into corn meal. Pour into buttered casserole dish and bake in preheated 375° oven for 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and well browned.
7. Serve immediately.
8. Serves 6.
title: Southern Spoon Bread

steps: 1. Beat eggs slightly.
2. Beat in next five ingredients.
3. Stir in pecans and pour in pastry shell.
4. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
5. Cool.
6. Serves 8.
title: Southern Pecan Pie

ingredients.text: 1 large fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper.
2. Stir in the onion, jalapeno pepper and buttermilk just until combined.
3. Let stand for a few minutes to thicken.
4. Drop hush puppies, using two spoons, a few at a time, into the hot (365°) oil.
5. Fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden, turning once.
6. Drain on paper towels.
7. Serve hush puppies warm with catfish.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Jalapeno Hush Puppies

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine flour and brown sugar; stir in milk.
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more.
3. Remove from the heat.
4. Gradually stir about 1 cup hot mixture into egg yolks.
5. Return all to the saucepan.
6. Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes. Remove from the heat; stir in butter and vanilla.
7. Cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally.
8. Fold in the whipped cream. Layer a third of the pudding in a 2 quart glass bowl.
9. Top with half the bananas.
10. Repeat layers.
11. Top with remaining pudding. Cover and chill at least 1 hour before serving.
12. Yield:
13. 8 servings.
title: Layered Banana Pudding

steps: 1. Mix sugar, salt and flour thoroughly.
2. Beat eggs slightly and add with margarine to dry mixture.
3. Mix. Add syrup, nuts and vanilla.
4. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add onion, then buttermilk and finally add beaten egg.
3. Drop by spoonfuls into the pan in which fish is being fried.
4. Fry to a golden brown; drain on paper towels. Yields 4 servings.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. In a medium mixing bowl, combine sugar, butter, cornmeal, white vinegar and vanilla.
2. Add eggs and mix well.
3. Pour into pie shell.
4. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
5. Cool completely before serving.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Finish Line Chess Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add onion, egg and milk; mix well.
3. Drop by spoonfuls into deep fat.
4. Fry until golden brown.
5. Drain on paper.
6. Yield:
7. 8 servings.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Beat eggs in bowl until light.
2. Stir in buttermilk and oil. Combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl.
3. Mix in buttermilk mixture until smooth.
4. Pour in greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
5. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Texas Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine dry ingredients in large bowl; stir to blend.
2. Combine eggs, melted margarine and milk.
3. Pour over dry ingredients.
4. Stir until all dry ingredients are moist.
5. Pour and scrape into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
6. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
7. Makes 18 to 24 servings.
title: Superior Cornbread

steps: 1. Mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Mix together milk and egg and oil and sugar.
3. Add to the cornmeal mixture. Stir only enough to mix.
4. Fill greased baking pan half full.
5. Bake at 425° about 25 minutes or until lightly brown.
6. Can also be baked in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine all ingredients (except pecans and coconut) in large bowl, mixing well.
3. Stir in pecans and coconut.
4. Pour mixture into unbaked 9-inch pastry shell.
5. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350° until crust is golden and center is set. Cool completely on wire rack.
6. Makes 8 servings.
title: Golden Ambrosia Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Sift first 4 ingredients into bowl.
2. Add other ingredients and blend well.
3. Shape into small balls with spoon.
4. Fry in deep fat until well browned.
5. Drain on paper towels.
6. Serves 6.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add eggs, milk and shortening.
3. Beat until smooth.
4. Do not overbeat.
5. Pour into greased 8-inch round or square pan or cornbread skillet.
6. Bake at 425° for 35 to 40 minutes.
7. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Cornbread

steps: 1. Add and blend all ingredients.
2. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry to a golden brown.
3. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Grease inside of 10-inch ovenproof skillet and heat in oven for 3 minutes.
3. Tilt skillet to coat bottom with oil evenly.
4. Mix thoroughly all ingredients.
5. Pour into hot skillet.
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
7. Makes 9 to 10 servings.
title: Skillet Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in large mixing bowl;
2. set aside.
3. Combine milk, egg and cheese and add to dry ingredients; mix thoroughly.
4. Pour batter into hot, greased 10-inch skillet.
5. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until cornbread is golden.
6. Serves 10 to 12 people.
title: Skillet Cheddar Cornbread

ingredients.text: 2 large sweet potatoes, cooked and peeled (1 to 1 1/2 lb.)

steps: 1. Preheat oven and baking sheet to 375°.
2. Remove pie crust from freezer.
3. Meanwhile, in medium bowl, beat sweet potatoes until smooth.
4. Mix in butter and sugar.
5. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Mix in nutmeg, salt and evaporated milk.
6. Place pie crust on preheated baking sheet.
7. Pour filling into pie crust.
8. Bake in center of oven for 60 to 65 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
9. Cool completely before serving.
10. Makes 8 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. Start heating oven to 350°.
2. Husk corn.
3. With sharp knife split corn kernels cutting lengthwise of corn kernels.
4. Then, with back of knife, scrape out kernels until you have 2 cups corn pulp. Combine with salt (or unseasoned salt), cream and pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour.
6. Serve hot with butter.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Southern Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Combine bread and milk in small bowl.
2. Allow to soak 5 minutes.
3. Combine beef, onion, eggs, salt and bread mixture; mix well.
4. Shape meat mixture into a loaf.
5. Place in lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
6. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf.
7. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Meat Loaf(Published In Southern Living)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Mix sugar, flour and cornstarch in saucepan.
3. Add butter and orange juice.
4. Cook over low heat until thick.
5. Add orange peel, pecans and peaches.
6. Place in pie shell. Bake 10 minutes.
7. Reduce heat to 325°.
8. Bake 30 minutes or more. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Fresh Peach Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Sift meal, flour, baking powder, salt and garlic salt together in bowl.
2. Beat egg; add egg and milk to meal mix and stir until well mixed.
3. Let stand for 5 minutes; add more milk if needed (mixture should be thin enough to drop from spoon).
4. Drop by small spoonfuls in hot corn oil at 375°.
5. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients into bowl.
2. Add egg, milk and shortening.
3. Beat with eggbeater until smooth, about 1 minute.
4. Do not overbeat.
5. Bake in greased 8-inch square pan in hot oven (425°) for 20 to 25 minutes.
6. Yields 9 servings.
title: Golden Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°. Beat the eggs well, combine with corn. Mix flour, sugar, salt and pepper, then add to corn mixture. Stir in butter and cream, mixing well. Pour into a greased 2 quart casserole. Bake for about an hour, or until firm and golden brown. Great served with ham. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Southern Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Set oven at 400°. Cream together butter, sugar, vanilla and flour. Mix well. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in Kahlua, corn syrup, milk and pecans. Mix well and pour into chilled crust. Bake for 10 minutes, then reduce heat to 325° and bake until firm (about 40 minutes). Chill. When ready to serve, garnish with whipped cream and pecan halves. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Kahlua Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine egg, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, onion, green pepper, celery, mushrooms and garlic in a large bowl, mixing well.
2. Add ground beef; mix just until blended.
3. Shape into an 8 x 4-inch loaf and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Combine catsup and water.
6. Spoon over loaf.
7. Bake an additional 1 hour or until done.
8. Serves 6 people.
title: Southern Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Heat over to 425°.
2. Cream softened butter and sugar.
3. Add vanilla.
4. Beat one egg in at a time with a fork, but do not over beat.
5. Add meal, milk, and vinegar.
6. Stir until mixed in well, but do not beat hard.
7. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
8. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
9. Reduce heat to 300° and continue baking for 40-45 minutes.
10. Serves 8.
title: Best Ever Chess Pie

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.
2. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
3. Makes 8 servings.
title: Southern Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. In a large bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
3. In a medium bowl, beat the egg, milk and margarine.
4. Add egg mixture and sour cream to flour mixture.
5. Stir until just blended.
6. Pour mixture into a greased 8-inch square pan.
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden and wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
8. Yield:
9. about 9 servings.
title: Sour Cream Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine milk, sugar substitute, butter, eggs, cornstarch and salt in heavy saucepan.
2. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until well blended and slightly thickened.
3. Remove from heat, stir in pecans and vanilla and allow filling to cool 10 minutes.
4. Sprinkle raisins on bottom of unbaked pie shell and pour pecan mixture over them.
5. Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Yield: 8 servings, calories per serving 199 plus pie shell calories.
title: Raisin Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. Grease a 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch baking pan. Sift flour with cornmeal, baking powder, salt and sugar; set aside.
3. In medium bowl, combine eggs, milk, butter and corn.

4. Add flour mixture, stirring only until flour mixture is moistened. Spoon batter into prepared pan; bake 25 to 30 minutes, or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean and top is golden brown.
5. Spread butter or margarine on top, as this makes it soft and moist.
6. Cut into squares.
7. Serve hot.
8. Makes about 9 servings. This is Ray Watley's favorite.
title: Double Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven at 425°.
2. Lightly oil iron skillet or heavy baking pan and heat in oven.
3. Sift dry ingredients.
4. Beat egg whites, buttermilk and oil; add to dry ingredients.
5. Stir lightly with wooden spoon.
6. Pour batter into preheated skillet.
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
8. Makes 6 servings, 160 calories per serving.
title: Kentucky Cornbread

title: Chocolate Chip Pecan Pie

ingredients.text: 2 c. (6 oz.) grated mild Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325° and grease a 9-inch pie plate.
2. Sprinkle 1/2 cup bread crumbs evenly on bottom of pie plate.
3. Arrange half of tomatoes on bread crumbs and top with half onion.
4. Sprinkle half of cheese on top of onion.
5. Repeat layering with remaining tomatoes, onions and cheese.
6. Pour eggs over cheese and add salt and pepper to taste.
7. Top pie with remaining 1/2 cup of bread crumbs.
8. Arrange bacon on top of pie and bake on middle rack of oven 45 minutes or until bacon is crisp.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Tomato Pie

steps: 1. Set oven to 325°.
2. Combine dry ingredients and set aside. Blend margarine, oil and sugar until creamy.
3. Add eggs and vanilla.
4. Mix well.
5. Add alternately the flour, milk and raw zucchini.
6. Blend until mixture is smooth.
7. Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan for 45 minutes.
8. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts while cake is warm.
9. Serves 10.
10. Preparation time:
11. 15 minutes.
title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake

ingredients.text: 2 c. day old bread, cut in 1 inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and salt. Add bread cubes, brown sugar and raisins. Pour into 8 inch round pan. Bake 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Bread Pudding

steps: 1. In a large pan, fry bacon until crisp.
2. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside.
3. Add onion and celery.
4. Saute until tender, about 5 minutes.
5. Stir in vinegar, molasses, mustard and salt.
6. Heat to boiling point.
7. Add shredded cabbage.
8. Stir to mix.
9. Cover and simmer until very tender, about 15 minutes.
10. Serves 6.
title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage

steps: 1. Beat eggs.
2. Add milk. Add dry ingredients and oil.
3. Mix well. Yields 85 servings.
title: Pancakes For A Crowd

steps: 1. Grease and lightly flour two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans. In a mixing bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients.
2. Add shortening and bananas; beat on low speed of electric mixer until combined.
3. Add buttermilk or sour milk, eggs and vanilla; beat 2 minutes on medium speed.
4. Turn batter into prepared pans.

steps: 1. Drop tortillas in hot oil, one at a time.

3. Drain well on paper towels and keep warm in low heat oven.
4. To serve, open each torilla gently and insert filling.
5. Yield: 12 servings. Carbohydrate 16 g, protein 6 g, fat 4 g, calories 124.
6. One serving without the meat or chicken filling, 1/2 meat high fat exchange, 1 bread starch exchange.
title: Tacos

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. Grease pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
3. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat 20 strokes.
4. Pat in pan with floured hands, pressing 1/2 inch up sides of pan.
5. Cook and stir ground beef until brown; drain.
6. Layer beef, tomatoes, and green pepper on dough.
7. Mix remaining ingredients; spoon over top. Sprinkle with paprika.
8. Bake until edges are light brown (25 to 30 minutes).
9. Serves 10.
title: Mexican Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 small can mild green chilies, drained

steps: 1. In food processor or blender, blend all ingredients together until desired consistency. Let set at least 1 hour before serving. Serve with your favorite chips or crackers. Store in refrigerator in tightly covered container. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time: 0:30.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
2. Cook meat and onion.
3. Drain off excess grease. Add cumin, garlic, chili powder, salt, pepper and water.
4. Simmer for about 10 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated.
5. Pour 1/2 taco sauce in bottom of baking dish. Cut 6 tortillas in strips and put in bottom of dish.
6. Pour 1/2 cup sauce evenly over tortillas. Spoon in meat mixture and top with sour cream.
7. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the cheese. Arrange last 6 tortillas over cheese. Spread rest of the sauce over the tortillas.
8. Top with rest of cheese.
9. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes at 375°.
10. Remove foil and continue baking for 5 more minutes.
11. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Enchilada Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 lb. round steak, cut in bite size chunks

steps: 1. Turn heat on high and cook the water out of the meat.
2. Remove from heat and add spices and flour.
3. Blend all together, then add water slowly.
4. Turn on heat to medium-high until it begins to thicken, then turn down to low and cook slowly, but stirring occasionally.
5. The flavor is even better if made a day ahead. Cook 1 to 3 hours.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chili Con Carne

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a 2-quart glass casserole dish.
2. Add ground beef and onion.
3. Cook with microwave 4 to 5 minutes, stirring several times.
4. Cook until all pink has left the meat and chopped onion is limp.
5. Add flour and stir well to combine.
6. Add remaining ingredients.
7. Cover and cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Recipe yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Chili Con Carne

ingredients.text: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine the oil, garlic powder and oregano; brush over both sides of eggplant slices.
2. Grill, uncovered, over indirect medium heat for 2 minutes on each side or until tender. To serve, spoon a small amount of salsa onto the center of each slice; sprinkle with cheese.
3. Serves 6.
title: Grilled Eggplant Mexicano

steps: 1. Combine crab, 1/2 ounce of Jack cheese, 1/3 cup picante sauce, celery, cream cheese, onions and garlic powder.
2. Mix well.
3. Spoon 1/3 cup of filling onto each tortilla center.
4. Roll up and lay seam side down in Pam sprayed baking dish.
5. Spoon remaining picante over top evenly.
6. Cover with foil and bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
7. Top with remaining Jack cheese.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Low-Fat Crab Enchiladas

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.
2. To make marinade, combine garlic, oil, lemon juice, Worcestershire and pepper in bowl.
3. Cut chicken into 3/8-inch strips.
4. Marinate in sauce 10 to 20 minutes in refrigerator.
5. Slice onion and pepper into 1/8-inch strips.
6. In nonstick skillet, heat 2 teaspoons oil over medium heat.
7. Add onion and pepper and saute, stirring occasionally, until onion is brown.
8. Wrap tortillas in foil and heat in oven.
9. Line broiler pan with foil.
10. Place chicken on foil and broil about 3 inches from heat for 4 minutes.
11. Serve 3 chicken strips on each tortilla.
12. Top with onion, pepper and garnishes as desired.
13. Roll tortilla around chicken and eat with fingers.
title: Chicken Fajitas

steps: 1. Saute onion, garlic, green pepper and mushrooms until onions are transparent.
2. Add tomato sauce, chili powder and beans.
3. Heat through.
4. Stir yogurt and cottage cheese together.
5. In a 1 1/2-quart nonstick casserole, put a layer of sauce.
6. Top with yogurt mixture.
7. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
8. Serve hot. Serves 8.
title: Enchilada Casserole

steps: 1. Cook onion,green pepper,celery,jalapeno & garlic in olive oiled skillet. Heat until onion and peppers are soft.
2. Add tomato,tomato sauce,water and hot sauce simmer gently about 15 minutes, add more water if the sauce begins to dry out. You don't want the sauce to be thick.
3. While sauce is cooking, heat corn tortillas in a small skillet sprayed with cooking spray or olive oil. Heat until just soft, do not fry the tortilla hard, set aside.
4. Cook 2 eggs over-easy, set aside.
5. Put two corn tortillas on each serving dish, top with 1 fried egg and cover with tomato sauce or put tortilla,sauce and egg on top. (that's the way I like it).
title: Mexican Eggs
