steps: 1. In Dutch oven, put ground chuck, onion, green pepper and celery on medium heat, stirring constantly, until meat is browned. Add cut up tomatoes, chili powder, tomato paste and sugar.

3. Let mixture come to a boil. Turn stove on low and cook for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add kidney beans and cook 15 minutes longer.
4. Stir to mix well.
5. Remove from heat and serve over rice.
title: Chili Con Carne

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees Farenheit.

steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients.

steps: 1. For each taco, spread 1/2 scrambled eggs, 1/4 cup of cheese and 1/4 cup of salsa on tortilla. Roll up. Warm in microwave for about 30 seconds or until cheese melts. Serve immediately.

steps: 1. Heat oil in a heavy large pot over medium high heat. Brown roast, letting it sit undisturbed on each side until it is more easily removed from the pan, creating a nice golden crust on the exposed edges (this adds flavor, do not omit). Remove to crock pot large enough to hold the roast.
2. Deglaze pan, turn off heat of pan but while still hot, add the broth to the pan and stir until the bits on the bottom of the pan are cleaned off. Add broth and browned bits to crock pot.

3. Add salsa, garlic, brown sugar and soy sauce to crock pot. Cook until meat falls apart, about 4-6 hours on high or 8-10 hours on low, depending on your crock pot (another good reason to do ahead of time, if the meat doesn't fall apart, keep cooking it in the crock pot).
4. When meat falls apart, remove from the crock pot in batches, shred using two forks and put in a container, discarding fat (this is the majority of the preparation time).

5. Skim fat from the juices left in the crock pot, then pour the juices over the shredded meat in the container. Refrigerate overnight (the meat will soak the juices back up if you do this) or freeze.
6. When ready to eat, reheat in a pan on the stove and add lime juice and cilantro. If frozen, thaw in refrigerator or microwave.
7. Can serve with tortillas and traditional fixings like lettuce, tomato, cheese, salsa, avocado, sour cream and additional salsa, or it's really good with salad greens and black beans.

title: Pork Soft-Shell Tacos

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine ham and onions; place about 1/4 cup down the center of each tortilla. Top with 2 tablespoons cheese. Roll up and place seam side down in a greased 13x9-in. baking dish.
2. In another large bowl, combine the flour, cream, eggs and, if desired, salt until smooth. Pour over tortillas. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Uncover; bake for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese; bake 3 minutes longer or until the cheese is melted. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Brunch Ham Enchiladas

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper and onions, cook and stir 2 minutes. Add ham and olives; cook and stir for 1 minute.
3. Lightly beat eggs with wire whisk in medium bowl. Add eggs to skillet; cook until eggs are set but still soft.
4. Spoon 1/3 cup egg mixture evenly down center of each tortilla; top with 1 Tbl cheese. Roll tortillas up and place seam side down in 11x7 baking dish.
5. Combine enchilada sauce and salsa together and pour evenly over enchiladas.
6. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes; uncover and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake an additional 10 minutes, uncovered.
7. Serve each enchilada with a slice of avocado and 1 T sour cream.
title: Ham And Egg Enchiladas

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. 2. Heat a greased skillet to medium. Rub chicken pieces with garlic, salt, pepper and cumin to taste and add to hot skillet. Cook until brown on both sides and no longer pink (10-15 minutes)
3. 3. Transfer meat to 9x13 inch baking dish, top with salsa and then cheese and bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes (until the cheese is bubbly and starts to brown).
4. Serve with mexican rice or over buttered noodles....we just ate green beans with it!
title: Mexican Chicken

steps: 1. Brown meat in shortening.
2. Add all other ingredients.
3. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
4. Makes enough to fill 12 taco shells.
title: Beef Taco Filling

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together; set aside.
2. Prepare tortillas, (dip in heated butter or moisten in microwave).
3. Prepare sauce as directed.
4. Place filling in tortillas, roll up and place in baking dish with cover.
5. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole

steps: 1. Cook meat in skillet with spices until brown (done); get tomato juice hot.
2. Dip tortillas in hot tomato juice.
3. Put hot tortilla in pan you are going to cook them in; place 1 tablespoon meat and 1/2 diced cheese on tortilla and roll up.
4. Continue until you have all 12 tortillas rolled up side by side.
5. Pour remaining tomato juice on top and bake until cheese is melted.
6. Cook in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve with chopped onion.
title: Enchiladas(Low-Fat)

steps: 1. Combine cheese, chili powder, mustard and salt.
2. Place 1/3 cup of mixture on each of 3 thin hamburger patties.
3. Top with remaining patties and seal edges.
4. Place on cold broiler pan and broil until done, about 15 minutes, turning once.
title: Mexican Cheeseburger

ingredients.text: 3/4 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, grated

steps: 1. Heat all ingredients together over low heat, stirring until melted.
2. Eat with tortilla chips!
title: Moe'S Queso Copycat

steps: 1. (Mole Sauce).
2. In saucepan, place butter and melt over medium heat.
3. Add flour, stirring until smooth.
4. Gradually add Kahlua, stirring. Remove from heat and set aside.

5. In blender container, place chili sauce, sugar, chopped macadamia nuts, cocoa powder, pineapple juice, 1 tablespoon oil, ground cloves, cinnamon, ground red pepper, salt and pepper. Add Kahlua mixture and blend until nearly smooth.
6. In large frypan, place 3 tbs oil over medium heat.
7. Add chicken and cook about 10 minutes or until brown on both sides.

8. Remove chicken to large casserole dish. Pour prepared Mole Sauce over chicken, cover and bake in 350 degree F. oven for about 30 minutes or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease, and juices run clear.
9. To serve, arrange chicken on platter; spoon sauce on top.
10. Garnish with sesame seeds, sour cream, chopped tomatoes, and green onion.
title: Kahlua Mole Chicken

steps: 1. Drizzle honey over one tortilla; sprinkle with cinnamon and chocolate chips. Top with remaining tortilla.
2. In a small skillet, cook quesadilla in oil over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Cut into four wedges. Serve immediately.
title: Chocolate Chip Quesadilla

steps: 1. Brown meat.
2. Add onion, cumin, jalapenos and tomatoes for about 10 minutes.
3. Cook the diced potatoes in water for about 12 to 15 minutes, then add to the meat for another 5 minutes.
4. Serve on the tortillas with shredded Cheddar cheese and lettuce.
title: Beefy Burritos

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup grated reduced fat Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Mix ham, Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, sour cream, cottage cheese and onions in a medium bowl.
2. Place 2 tortillas on a baking skeet. Spread each with 1/2 the ham mixture, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Top each with another tortilla. Spray with no stick cooking spray.
3. Bake for 5 mins or until golden and crisp. Cut in half to serve.
title: Ham And Cheese Quesadillas

steps: 1. Stir chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water until smooth; cool.
2. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients in medium bowl.
3. Using electric mixer, beat 1 3/4 cups sugar and butter in large bowl until light.
4. Beat in eggs 1 at a time, then vanilla and chocolate.
5. Gradually add dry ingredients, beating just until combined.
6. Chill dough until firm, about 2 hours.
7. Preheat oven to 350°F.
8. Lightly butter 2 large baking sheets.
9. Place powdered sugar in shallow pan.
10. Form dough into 1-inch balls.
11. Roll each ball in sugar to coat; shake off excess sugar.
12. Arrange cookies on prepared baking sheets, spacing 1 1/2 inches apart.
13. Press 1 cherry half into center of each cookie.
14. Bake until cookies puff and crack but are still soft, about 10 minutes.
15. Transfer cookies to rack and cool completely.
16. (Cookies can be prepared ahead. Store in airtight container at room temperature up to 1 week, or freeze up to 1 month.).
title: Mexican Chocolate-Cherry Rounds

steps: 1. Preheat oven to broil. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
2. Place zucchini, broccoli, bell pepper, carrot, onion and mushrooms in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water, and cover. Cook until tender but still firm, about 2 to 6 minutes. Drain.
3. Place two tortillas, side by side, on the prepared baking sheet. On each tortilla layer cheddar cheese, vegetables, then Monterey jack cheese. Top each with another tortilla.
4. Place under the broiler and cook until lightly browned. Carefully turn tortillas and cook on the other side until lightly browned.
title: Vegetable Quesadillas

steps: 1. Stir together salsa, juices, yogurt, salt, and mustard.
2. Pour over chicken; cover and refrigerate for 30 to 45 minutes.
3. Remove chicken and reserve marinade.
4. Broil in pan 5 to 6 inches from heat for 10 minutes.
5. Turn chicken over and and brush with reserved marinade mixture.
6. Broil for 15 minutes more.
title: Chicken Mexicano

steps: 1. In blender, combine onion, water and tomatoes.
2. Puree.
3. Then combine all other ingredients and mix.
4. Roll small amount lightly in corn meal and wrap lightly in paper.
5. Place tamales in large pot.
title: Hot Tamales

steps: 1. Saute onion in a non-stick pan sprayed with non-stick spray. Add ground turkey and cook till browned.
2. Add refreied beans and 1/2 can enchilada sauce and mix well.
3. Pur 1/4 cup of enchilada sauce in a 9/13 in/ pan, and use it to coat each tortilla on both sides. Arrange tortillas in pan to cover the bottom completely.
4. Spread half the turkey mixture over the tortillas, then add 1/4 to 1/2 cup encilada sauce on top. Repeat tortilla and turkey layers again, then sprinkle with the cheese.
5. Bake uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes.
title: Joann'S Ww Enchilada Casserole

steps: 1. Put cheese, onion and olives in separate dishes.
2. Brown meat, drain and set aside.
title: Enchilada Supreme

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts, cubed, or pork or beef

steps: 1. Save some Cheddar cheese for topping.
2. Brown meat in oil.
3. Mix in cheeses and salsa with browned meat.
4. Wrap in tortillas.
5. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
6. Sprinkle some Cheddar cheese on top and melt.
title: Mexican Quesadillas With Meat

ingredients.text: 10 3/4 ounces cream of celery soup (you won't taste it)

steps: 1. Mix the last four ingredients together in a large, non-stick pot. I use my dutch oven.
2. DO NOT DRAIN any of the veggies. Dump the liquid in along with everything else.
3. Cube the velveeta and add to the canned ingredients.
4. Cook over low heat until the velveeta melts.
5. Stir often.
6. This makes a lot! But, it warms up great in the microwave.
7. Serve with chips or use to top enchiladas or even use in quesadillas.
8. Variation: Try adding some spicy ground meat or canned chili (with or without beans). Add other veggies like black olives or onion, too.
title: Easy (5 Ingredients) Queso

steps: 1. Cut the pork roast into thirds, and place in a pot with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 1 hour, or until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees F (63 degrees C). Drain, cool, and shred.
2. Place the shredded pork in a bowl, and season with garlic salt, salt, and pepper. Mix in the Cheddar cheese and onion.

3. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place equal amounts of the pork mixture in the center of each corn tortilla, and fold in half to form tacos. One or two at a time, cook the tacos in the hot oil until golden brown.
title: Mindy'S Pork Tacos

steps: 1. Combine chicken broth and taco seasoning mix in a bowl. Place chicken in a slow cooker and pour chicken broth mixture over chicken.
2. Cook on Low for 6 to 8 hours. Shred chicken.
title: Fiesta Slow Cooker Shredded Chicken Tacos

steps: 1. Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.
2. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Prepare a large bowl of ice water.

3. Place poblano peppers on a baking sheet. Broil until skin bubbles and areas of burned skin appear. Dip peppers into boiling water for about 30 seconds, then place immediately into ice water. When peppers are chilled, remove skin. Slit peppers lengthwise and remove veins and seeds.
4. Stuff each pepper with 1/4 the cotija cheese and secure pepper openings closed with toothpicks. Place flour into a shallow bowl and dip each pepper in the flour; set aside for coating to set.
5. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

6. Beat egg whites in a glass or metal bowl until stiff peaks form. Lift your beater or whisk straight up: the tip of the peak formed by the egg whites should stand up. Gently whisk egg yolks into whites. Dip floured peppers into egg mixture to coat.
7. Fry peppers in the hot oil until browned and the cheese has melted, flipping once, about 5 minutes per side.
title: Chiles Rellenos Autenticos

ingredients.text: 3 lbs beef roast, trimmed of excess fat (I have used brisket, chuck, sirloin, bottom round)
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped (leave some seeds if you want it spicier)

steps: 1. Place onion in slow cooker and top with beef roast.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together remaining ingredients and pour over beef roast.
3. Cook on low for about 8 hours.
4. Remove roast from slow cooker, reserving juice.
5. Use 2 forks to shred meat; mix in enough of the reserved juice until it is the desired consistency.
6. Use as filling to tacos, burritos, enchiladas, quesadillas, or nachos.
title: Shredded Beef For Tacos Or Burritos

steps: 1. Saute pork with onion until browned and cooked through.
2. Add green onion, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil.
3. Cook on medium low for 2 minutes or until onions are tender.
4. Warm tortillas at 300° for a few minutes.
5. Spread 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce on each tortilla.
6. Divide pork mixture in center of each.
7. Roll up each tortilla so meat mixture is enclosed tightly.
8. Garnish with sliced peppers and serve with fried rice.
title: Ground Pork Burritos

steps: 1. Mix together black beans, corn, and Rotel, and refried beans.
2. Heat in microwave until warm.
3. Fill taco shells and finish with spinach, cheese, and sour cream.
title: No Meat Tacos

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in pan. Add onion and garlic, and saute about 8 minutes. Remove from heat; and transfer to oven-safe casserole dish if not already using one.
3. Add quinoa, tomatoes, chick peas, water, tomato paste and spices. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
4. COVER and place in oven
5. Caferfully remove casserole from oven and stir in spinach. It will wilt from the heat.
6. Top with sour cream, diced avocado and/or cilantro and serve.
title: Baked Mexican Quinoa Casserole

steps: 1. In a blender, combine the first seven ingredients; cover and process until mixture forms a powder. Store in an airtight container. Yield: about 2-1/4 cups mix.
2. To prepare mocha drink: In a mug, stir 3 tablespoons mix with 1 cup hot milk until blended. Garnish with a cinnamon stick if desired.
title: Mexican Mocha Mix

steps: 1. Debone chicken in large pieces.
2. Mix flour, chili powder and garlic salt.
3. Coat chicken pieces in mixture.
4. Saute onions and peppers in oil.
5. Add chicken and brown.
6. Add remaining ingredients, plus 1 cup water.
7. Salt and pepper to taste.
8. Simmer on low 45 minutes.
9. Check rice for doneness.
title: Mexican Chicken

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Stir in the taco sauce, chilies and salt. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 6-8 minutes or until heated though. Spoon over chips; sprinkle with cheese.
title: Taco Plate For Two

steps: 1. Mix salad dressing and soy sauce for use as marinade.
2. Set aside 1/4 cup of marinade.
3. Add chicken to remainder of marinade. Cover and chill at least 1 hour, may do longer, such as overnight. Saute onion in reserved 1/4 cup marinade over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes; set aside.
4. Drain chicken.
5. Grill over hot coals about 5 minutes on each side or until done.
6. Baste twice with marinade. Cut chicken into 1/4-inch strips.
7. Wrap tortillas and heat according to package directions.
title: Chicken Fajitas

steps: 1. In a blender, whirl 1 cup nonfat milk, 1 1/2 ounces unsweetened chocolate (coarsely chopped), 2 tablespoons honey, 1/2 teaspoon grated orange peel, and 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon until chocolate is finely ground. Add 1 pint vanilla nonfat frozen yogurt and 2 cups ice cubes; whirl until smoothly pureed (chocolate forms streaks). Pour into glasses.
2. Nutritional analysis per cup.
title: Iced Mexican Chocolate

steps: 1. Cook chicken pieces in margarine at medium temperature.
2. When chicken pieces are browned, add picante sauce and water.
3. Cover and simmer until all moisture has evaporated.
title: Chicken Tacos

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup Splenda sugar substitute (or other sweetner)

steps: 1. Peel and dice apple.
2. Spray frying pan with cooking spray and saute apple until lightly browned (about 4-5 minutes) Remove apple from pan and re-spray.
3. Place in pan 1 flour tortilla and scoop 1/2 apple, 1/2 Splenda, 1/2 cinnamon, and 1 cheese slice in center.
4. Cover pan and cook on medium heat until underside is golden and cheese melts.
5. (about 4-5 minutes) Fold tortilla in half and remove to serving plate.
6. Repeat process for second tortilla.
7. Serve warm with fat free whipped topping.
8. Enjoy!
title: Apple Cheese Quesadilla

steps: 1. Evenly distribute chicken and onions into 8 tortillas. Sprinkle some cheese into each one, and then roll. Place in a sprayed or non-stick 13x9 dish with seam sides down.
2. Mix sour cream, soup, tomatoes, chilies, and chicken broth. Spread evenly over the top of rolled tortillas. Evenly sprinkle remaining cheese over top of sauce.
3. Bake for 20-25 mins at 400°F.
title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas

ingredients.text: 1 None onion, peeled and cut into strips
1 None green pepper, deseeded and cut into strips
3 oz jalapeno peppers (from a jar), sliced

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and place 2 tortillas on each. In a bowl, mix the tomatoes, paprika and chili powder. Spoon over the tortillas.
2. Heat 1 tsp oil in a frying pan and fry the onion and peppers for 3 mins, turning. Season with salt and arrange over the tomato sauce. Sprinkle with parsley.
3. Heat 1 tsp oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry the eggs to your liking. Lay an egg on each tortilla and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake for 5 mins. Sprinkle over the jalapenos before serving.
title: Egg And Cheese Tostadas

steps: 1. 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl except water.
2. 2. Mix well.
3. 3. Pour water into pan and add meat.
4. 4. Stir occasionally breaking up any large chunks.
5. 5. Cook for about 5-10 minutes or until done.
title: Primary Taco Meat Recipe

steps: 1. Melt margarine in a saucepan.
2. Add rice, green pepper, onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender.
3. Add tomatoes, water, sweet basil, oregano and pepper. Cover and simmer until all liquid is absorbed, about 15 to 25 minutes.
4. Makes 6 servings.
5. One serving equals 239 mg sodium.
title: Low Sodium Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 1 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise and cut in pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large, heavy skillet.
2. Add rice; brown until rice is golden brown.
3. Add garlic and onion; saute 1 to 2 minutes. Add tomato sauce, water, cumin, salt and pepper.
4. Add sausage and carrots.
5. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
6. Add zucchini.
7. Cover; simmer another 10 minutes, or until the liquid is evaporated and the rice is soft.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Smoked Sausage, Vegetables And Mexican Rice

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, combine milk and flour and whisk over medium heat until no lumps remain (about 1 minute).
2. Stir in mustard, salt, black pepper and cayenne.
3. Cook, stirring frequently, until lightly thickened and no floury taste remains (about 4 minutes).
4. Stir in the Pepper Jack cheese and remove from heat.
5. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to boil.
6. Add broccoli and cook until crisp-tender (about 3 minutes).
7. Drain well and transfer to a serving dish.
8. Pour in cheese sauce and toss to coat well.
9. Makes 4 servings.
title: Tex-Mex Broccoli

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large salad bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Top with your favorite salad dressing.
4. Serves 4.
title: Mexican Salad

ingredients.text: 1 tsp. onion powder (you amount to your taste)

steps: 1. In a lightly oiled cooking skillet, stir-fry the rice, chopped onion and the seasonings over a medium flame until the rice is lightly golden brown.
2. Pour 2 of the cups of hot chicken broth and the small can of tomato sauce.
3. Very important:
4. After adding the chicken broth, do not stir the rice while it is cooking.
5. Let the rice come to a boil in the uncovered cooking skillet.
6. Cover the rice and let simmer over a low flame.
7. As the broth begins to evaporate from the skillet, gradually add the other 1 cup hot chicken broth to the rice.
8. Continue simmering over a low flame until all the chicken broth has evaporated.
9. Remove from heat and serve hot.
10. Makes approximately 8 servings.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Brown hamburger in margarine.
2. Add chopped green pepper and cook 5 minutes.
3. Add tomato soup, milk, cooked noodles, corn, olives and 1/2 cup grated cheese.
4. Put in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top.
5. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Mexican Beefy Noodles

ingredients.text: 6 cups very thinly sliced green cabbage

steps: 1. Place cabbage and carrots in a colander and rinse in cold water; let drain for 5 minutes.

2. Whisk rice vinegar, olive oil, and cilantro together in a large salad bowl. Stir cabbage and carrots into dressing; season with salt. Slaw can be served immediately or covered and refrigerated for up to 1 day.
title: Simple Mexican Coleslaw

steps: 1. Whisk all, except corn and chilies, together. Add corn and chilies, cover and cook 2-3 hours on low. Stir occasionally.
title: Crock Pot Mexican Creamed Corn

steps: 1. Cut potatoes into bite-size pieces and place in greased casserole dish.
2. Melt butter. Stir in taco seasoning.
3. Pour over the potatoes and stir to coat well.
4. Bake uncovered at 425 degrees Fahrenheit for 40 minutes.
5. Stir -- bake 10 minutes longer.
6. Brown and crumble beef; add onion and cook until soft -- then drain.
7. Stir in salsa and chopped peppers.
8. Pour over potatoes.
9. Top with grated cheese.
10. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes.
title: Mexican Potato Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cooked and diced

steps: 1. Saute garlic, onion and peppers in olive oil until soft.
2. In a soup pot, heat chicken broth and stir in tomato sauce, Worcestershire, chili powder, cumin and coriander.
3. Add chicken and veggies.
4. Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, approximately 20 minutes.
5. Mix flour and water, whisk into soup and bring back to a boil. (omit this step if you don't want a thicker soup).
6. Stir in sour cream and cheese and cook until smooth.
7. Salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve with more shredded cheese on top or crispy tortillas.
title: Mexican Chicken And Cheese Soup

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine rice, onion, garlic, salt and 1 cup water. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a simmer and cook, covered 10 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, bring 2 to 3 inches water to a boil in a deep skillet.
3. When rice is done, stir in bell pepper, salsa and tomato. Set aside, covered.

4. Break cold eggs, one at a time, into a custard cup or saucer. Holding dish close to water's surface, slip eggs, one by one, into boiling water. Adjust heat to maintain a simmer. Cook until whites are set and yolks begin to thicken but are not hard, about 5 minutes.
5. With slotted spoon, lift out eggs. Drain in spoon or on paper towels. Trim any ragged edges, if desired.
6. To serve, divide rice mixture between 2 plates and top each with a poached egg. Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.
title: Arroz Con Huevos (Rice With Eggs)

ingredients.text: 440 g red kidney beans, rinsed and drained

steps: 1. Coat a pan with cooking spray, saute onion until it is softened.
2. Stir in the beef mince and brown, Add the garlic, paprika and cumin, cooking for 1 minute.
3. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
4. Add the kidney beans and warm through.
5. Scatter with the grated cheese and parsley before serving.
title: Chili Con Carne Soup

ingredients.text: 6 -8 cups water (depending of your crock pot size)

steps: 1. Soak the beans for at least 8 hours. If they are old, 24 hours is great. You must change the water at least 3 times to rinse the white foam that appears in the surface.

2. Pour the beans in the crock pot with the water, the bay leaves, the onion and garlic. (Cut in half the garlic cloves to take out the stem that germinates so it is nicer for your tummy, you can plant the stem or just through it away).
3. Cook on high for 12-15 hours. Check the amount of water around the 8th hour and fill again if necessary.
4. Turn of the crock pot and add the salt, stir softly and let it rest for at least 30 minute.

5. *You can use more beans, depending of the capacity of your crock pot. It will be a nice soup that you can enjoy hot or cold. Separate the beans for using them in other recipes like fried and mashed beans.
title: Frijoles Negros- Crock Pot Mexican Black Beans

ingredients.text: 2 jalapenos, chopped (seeded if you don't want it too spicy)

steps: 1. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces.
2. Lightly coat a large saucepan with oil and set over med-high heat.
3. Add about 1/2 the chicken without crowding.
4. Saute the chicken until no longer pink, about 3 minutes, remove to a very large stock/soup pot.
5. Repeat with remaining chicken.
6. Once all chicken has been removed, add onions, add more oil if needed.
7. Stir until slightly softened, about 2 minutes.
8. Stir in peppers, tomatoes, celery, jalapenos and seasoning, cook 3 more minutes.
9. Add to stock pot, add broth.
10. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to med-low.
11. Simmer, covered and stirring occasionally until all vegetables are tender, from 10-15 minutes.
12. Add corn during last 2 minutes of simmering.
13. Stir in lime juice.
14. Just before serving, top with cilantro.
15. Soup will keep well in the fridge for 3 days or in the freezer for 3 mths.
title: Mexican-Style Chicken Soup

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, whisk together the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato paste, and 3 cups of water.
2. Add the rice and stir briefly to combine. Cover the pan, raise the heat to high, and bring to a full boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Remove the pan from the heat and let the rice stand, undisturbed, for 20 minutes more.
4. Remove the lid, fluff the rice with a fork, and serve.
title: Taco Rice

steps: 1. Cook and stir garlic in oil in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat until brown; remove garlic.
2. Cook and stir rice in oil until golden, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir in chicken broth and salsa.
4. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally; reduce heat.
5. Cover and simmer 20 minutes (do not lift cover or stir).
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Add oil to large skillet and heat over medium high. Add diced chicken, 1 TBSP taco seasoning and salt and pepper to taste; saute until cooked through. Add water (or chicken broth) and remaining taco seasoning. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add minute rice and diced velvetta cheese. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Stir and serve.
title: Cheesy Chicken Taco Rice

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup green bell pepper, diced small

steps: 1. In a large skillet (with a lid), saute the pepper and onion in the butter until slightly softened.
2. Add the rice, and cook until the rice is coated with the butter.
3. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
4. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 20 minutes or until the broth is absorbed and the rice is tender.
title: Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 1 head broccoli, broken into large florets

steps: 1. Steam, boil or microwave broccoli until crisp-tender. Coarsely chop and set aside.
2. In a large nonstick frypan, heat 1 teaspoon oil.
3. Add onion; saute for 3 to 4 minutes to soften.
4. Add garlic, cumin, chili powder and cinnamon; cook 1 minute.
5. Add broccoli, peppers and tomatoes.
6. Stir well and saute for 3 to 4 minutes.
7. Put in a bowl and stir in cilantro.
8. Set aside.
title: Broccoli Quesadilla

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes

steps: 1. In a large (2 gallon) stockpot over medium heat, combine oil, chicken base, diced onion, cumin, chili powder, garlic and cayenne pepper. Saute, stirring occasionally, until onions are tender. Place masa harina in a large saucepan over low-medium heat. Gradually add 1 quart of water, stirring constantly, to blend and remove lumps. Add masa harina mixture to onions and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer mixture 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly to eliminate the raw taste of the masa. Add remaining water to stockpot. Add tomatoes and allow mixture to return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add cheese. Continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts. Remove from heat and add chicken. Ladle into serving bowls.
title: Chicken Enchilada Soup

steps: 1. Toss the shrimp in a small pan with butter and cook for a few minutes untill opaque. Add spinach and garlic powder and stir to combine.
2. Brush griddle with 1/2 of the melted butter and lay one whole tortilla on the griddle.
3. Evenly spread the cheeses over the tortilla, not too close to center or edge.
4. Spread the spinach filling over the cheese - spacing the shrimp out evenly.
5. Cover with second tortilla.
6. Brush top with remaining melted butter.
7. When first side is BGD (golden brown and delicious) flip and cook until side two is GBD.
8. Move to cutting board and cut into 8 equal pieces, using a pizza wheel, with one shrimp in the center of each piece.
9. Enjoy!
title: Shrimp And Spinach Quesadillas

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and onion; add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube.
2. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes, covered.
3. Serve over hot cooked rice.
4. Garnish with chopped tomatoes, sour cream, grated cheese and black olives.
title: Taco Rice

ingredients.text: 3/4 bell pepper, chopped (green, yellow, and or red)
10 3/4 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup
1 cup cheese, shredded (Mexican blend = Mild Cheddar, Monterey Jack, Queso Quesadilla, and Asadero)

steps: 1. In large pot; onion, garlic, and bell peppers in oil.
2. Add chicken, soup, tomato sauce, water, spices, and corn.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Cover and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Crush tortilla chips into each bowl.
6. Ladle soup over the top.
7. Sprinkle with cheese.
title: Flavorful Chicken Enchilada Soup

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients.
2. Heat until thoroughly heated.
title: Mexican Mashed Potatoes

steps: 1. Saute rice in oil until rice begins to brown.
2. Add Onion and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Pour in tomato sauce, water and add chicken bouillon.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Turn heat to a medium-low. Cover with a lid and cook 20 minutes.
6. Open and sprinkle with black pepper.
7. Let sit about 10 minutes before you serve to absorb any excess fuilds.
title: Grandma Vicky'S Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Combine corn, black beans and remaining ingredients in medium size bowl, except fresh parsley and cilantro.
2. (Salsa can be made 1 day ahead.) Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour.
3. Bring to room temperature before serving and add freshly chopped parsley and cilantro.
4. Serving Size: 9.
title: Mexican Corn & Black Bean Salad

steps: 1. Add corn meal to boiling water in a large sauce pan.
2. Cook until thick.
3. In another saucepan, cook corn, olives, onion and chilies in tomato sauce over medium high heat until onion is transparent; if mixture boils down too much, add some water.
4. In casserole dish, place half of cornmeal. Pour vegetable mixture over this.
5. Top with remaining cornmeal mixture.
6. Label, Cover, Freeze.
7. To serve: Defrost overnight and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until hot and cooked through or place directly into 350° oven from freezer and bake 2 hours or until hot and cooked through.
title: Tamale Corn Casserole (Oamc)

steps: 1. Bring chicken broth to boil.
2. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil for 2 minutes.
3. Add rice; saute for 2 minutes.
4. Add boiling chicken broth, cumin and pepper.
5. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tomato and chives; simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Remove from heat; stir and set aside (covered) for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Mexican Rice(Serves 4)

ingredients.text: 12 ounces frozen crabmeat, thawed and drained
1/3 cup red bell pepper finely chopped
1 tablespoon small capers, rinsed and drained
1/2 cup hellmann's or best foods real mayonnaise

steps: 1. Combine crabmeat, avocado, onion, red pepper and jalapeno pepper in small bowl. Stir in Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Real Mayonnaise, lime juice and cilantro; set aside.

2. Heat oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook tortillas, one at a time, 1 minute or until crisp, turning once; drain on paper towels. To serve, arrange tortillas on serving platter and evenly top with lettuce, then crab salad.
title: Tostadas With Crabmeat Salad

ingredients.text: 1 cup brown rice, long grain, organic
1 1/2 cups vegetable stock (ideally your own, commerical ok but often very salty)

steps: 1. Saute onion, carrot, zucchini in olive oil, medium hot, til just soft. Add garlic.
2. Add rice and dry seasonings. Brown lightly, approx 5 minutes. After the browning, add cilantro.
3. Add enough boiling stock to come 1 inch above rice.
4. Cover with tight lid and bake in 350 F oven about 50 minutes, until liquid completely absorbed.
5. Serve.
title: Baked Mexican Brown Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet at medium. Add rice. Stir constantly until rice is puffed and golden. Sprinkle salt and cumin over rice. Stir in onions and cook until tender. Stir in tomato sauce and broth. Bring to a boil; reduce and cover. Simmer 20 minutes.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. In a large pot, add carrots, celery, onion and potatoes to broth (I get my broth heating while I chop my veg). Add chili powder, cumin, garlic and salt.
2. Bring to a boil and reduce to medium heat. Cook, simmering over medium heat until potatoes and carrots are tender (about 15 minutes).
3. Meanwhile, prepare your roux. In a large bowl (make sure it's big enough -- you don't want it to boil over), melt butter in the microwave. Whisk in flour first, then milk.
4. Heat in the microwave at 1 minute intervals (no longer), whisking each time, until thickened.
5. Add to the soup once vegetables are cooked. Stir in corn and cheddar cheese.
6. Garnish with more corn and cheese if desired.
title: Creamy Nacho Potato Soup

steps: 1. Peel and slice potatoes (thin). Cook in small amount of shortening until brown. Add onion, then stir in eggs. Warm tortillas and fill with egg/potato mixture.
title: Potato And Egg Burritos

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. With a sharp knife slice both ends off the butternut squash. Then peel the skin off the squash. You can also use a vegetable peeler to do this.
2. Slice the squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds of both halves. Then cut the squash into 2"x2" cubes and place in a large bowl. Set aside.
3. After peeling and cutting the ends of the onion, slice into large cubes. Place the onion in the same bowl as the squash.
4. Peel the garlic cloves and place in the bowl.
5. To the squash, onions, and garlic add the olive oil, sage, rosemary, salt and pepper. Mix to evenly coat the vegetables with the herbs.
6. Pour everything in a roasting pan or baking dish. Place in the oven for 50 minutes to an hour until the squash is very tender.

7. After the vegetables come out of the oven, place the prosciutto on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and put in the 400° oven for 15 minutes until crispy like bacon. Remove from oven and allow to cool. With your fingers crumble the crisp prosciutto. Set aside and reserve for the topping.
8. Place the roasted squash, onions and garlic in the blender. Add 1 cup of the chicken broth and blend on high until smooth. About one minute.

9. Pour mixture into a large soup pot over medium heat and add the remaining 2 cups of broth. Stir and heat until combined. Add more salt and pepper if needed and pour into soup bowls. Top with the prosciutto and crumbled queso fresco.
title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup With Prosciutto And Queso Fresco

steps: 1. Heat the sour cream, cheese, egg yolk, butter, salt and chives.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Top with dry bread crumbs, dots of butter and grated cheese.
4. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
title: Mexican Squash Casserole

steps: 1. Cut each potato lengthwise into 4 equal wedges.
2. Set aside. Place butter in 10-inch square casserole.
3. Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until butter melts.
4. Add potatoes, turning to coat with butter.
5. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over potatoes.
6. Cover.
7. Microwave on High for 14 to 18 minutes or until potatoes are tender, rearranging potatoes twice. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.
title: Mexican Seasoned Potatoes

ingredients.text: 6 ears of fresh corn, husked or 1 pound frozen corn kernels
4 ounces Cotija cheese (or ricotta salata), crumbled

steps: 1. To roast the corn: Remove the kernels from the husks and place on a rimmed baking sheet. If using frozen corn, defrost on a clean dish towel to remove any moisture, then place on a rimmed baking sheet. Place under the broiler until lightly charred, about 3-4 minutes (keep an eye on it so it doesn't burn).

2. To make elote: Turn oven from broil to 350 degrees. Place toasted corn in a bowl and add crabmeat, mayo, hot sauce, lime zest and juice, cheese, and scallions. Toss to combine and place into an oven proof dish. Bake 10 minutes until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with cilantro. Serve as a dip with tortilla chips or as a crostini on top of toasted baguette slices.
title: Corn And Crab Elote

steps: 1. Peel and dice the cucumbers and onion, and add to a salad bowl. Dice the tomatoes, and add. Peel and dice the avacados. Juice the limes over the vegetables, add all the seasonings, and mash together coarsely. Add your lettuce, cilantro and seeds, and toss.

2. I didn't use jalapeno, but this or any other pepper to taste would have worked fine. You could also use nuts instead of sunflower seeds, add cheese, add beans, or whatever other salad enhancements you enjoy.
title: Guacamole Salad (Eat To Live)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Lightly brush tortillas with oil. (I do both sides). Sprinkle with salt and pepper to your liking.
3. Press tortilla into the ovenproof bowl. (Edges will look slightly wavy) Bake about 13 minutes.
4. Transfer tortilla to a cooling rack and repeat with remaining tortillas. Fill with your taco salad and listen to your guests rave!
title: Taco Salad Tortilla Bowl

ingredients.text: 3 green onions, sliced thinly (white and green parts)

steps: 1. In a large serving bowl, combine cabbage, cilantro and green onion. If using carrot or bell pepper, add it too.
2. In a small bowl, combine the olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Adjust seasoning. If preparing in advance, stop here and refrigerate both bowls until serving time.
3. Right before serving, stir the dressing then add it to cabbage mix and toss well to coat. Serve immediately or it will wilt.
title: Mexican Coleslaw

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in a sauce pan. Add rice and fry for about five minutes. Stir occasionally so it doesn't stick. Add onion, garlic, and jalapeno and cook until onion is tender.
2. Add chicken broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Once it boils, turn heat down to low and cook for 20 minutes. Do not lift lid while cooking!
3. When done cooking, remove from heat and fluff with fork. Enjoy!
title: Restaurant Style Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Blend salsa and sour cream.
2. Set aside.
3. Chop lettuce, olives, onions, tomatoes and crab meat.
4. Toss together.
5. Add cheese and chips.
6. Toss with the sour cream mixture.
7. Chill.
8. Enjoy!
title: Mexican Crab Salad

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
4 tbsp fresh cilantro, chopped + extra sprigs, to garnish

steps: 1. For tomato salad, whisk vinegar with honey and olive oil and season. Toss with tomatoes, red onion and chives. Set aside.

2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a frying pan, season chicken and saute for 4-5 mins until cooked through. Meanwhile, beat cream cheese with lime juice and chili. Add chicken and distribute between 2 tortillas, spreading it almost to edges. Add chopped cilantro and cheese. Place remaining tortillas on top.

3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a frying pan, add 1 quesadilla and cook until crisp and golden on each side. Repeat with remaining quesadilla. Cut into quarters and garnish with cilantro. Serve with tomato salad.
title: Chicken Quesadillas With Tomato Salad

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon Tabasco sauce (more or less to taste)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, stir together the sour cream,mayonnaise,lime juice,cumin,salt,pepper& Tabasco.
2. This is the salad dressing, so taste and adjust if you need.
3. In seperate bowl, combine chicken, carrots, red& green bell pepper, onion avacado& cilantro.
4. Pour the dressing over chicken and vegetables and mix well.
5. Chill for at least one houe before serving.
title: Mexican Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Bring chicken broth, onion, bell pepper, carrots, celery, jalapeno pepper, rice, parsley, chili powder, garlic, and oregano to a boil in a large pot. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until vegetables and rice are tender, about 25 minutes. Add turkey; simmer until turkey is heated through, about 10 minutes more.
title: Mexican Turkey Soup

steps: 1. In a skillet, brown turkey.
2. In a large salad bowl, combine chopped lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, brown turkey and crushed corn chips.
3. Toss lightly.
4. Add taco sauce and mix.
title: Turkey Taco Salad

ingredients.text: 1 garlic cloves, minced or 1 teaspoon garlic paste
2 tablespoons Cotija cheese (or Mexican blend cheese)

steps: 1. 1.Melt butter in skillet on medium-high.
2. 2.Add corn and mix with butter.
3. 3.Let corn char on bottom of pan. Then stir and char again.
4. 4.Add the jalapeno, saute for a minute and then remove from heat.
5. 5.Place into a bowl and add mayonnaise, garlic, green onions, cilantro, lime juice, cheese, chili powder and avocado.
6. 6.Serve warm or chilled, your choice.
title: Esquites (Mexican Corn Salad)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large over medium heat and add rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until puffed and golden. While rice is cooking, sprinkle with salt and cumin.
2. Stir in onions and cook until tender.
3. Stir in tomato sauce and broth; bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes. Don't lift the lid or stir while its cooking. Fluff with fork.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. In a bowl, mix together the cabbage, jalapeno pepper, red onion, carrot, cilantro, and lime juice.
title: Taco Slaw

steps: 1. Mix, spread into flour tortillas.
2. Serve with sauce.
title: Turkey Salad Burritos

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy saucepan over medium heat.
2. Stir in rice and cook about 1 minute.
3. Stir in onion and garlic and saute about 3 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent.
4. Stir in remaining ingredients.
5. Increase heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.
6. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
7. Let stand 5 minutes.
8. Fluff rice and serve.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. In a large bowl, toss lettuce, cherry tomatoes, avocado, lime juice, cheddar cheese and salsa. Serve immediately.
title: Tex Mex Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except tomatoes.
2. Cover and cook over moderate heat 7 minutes.
3. Add tomatoes; cook 2 minutes, uncovered, or until tomatoes are heated thoroughly.
title: Mexican Corn

steps: 1. In a heavy large skillet, melt the butter over medium-high heat. Add the corn, bell pepper, zucchini, green onions and jalapeno pepper. Saute until vegetables are tender, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat and refrigerate vegetables until chilled.
2. Add salsa and chopped cilantro to vegetable mixture. Stir and season with salt and pepper to taste.
title: Mexican Corn Salad

steps: 1. Clean and slice mushrooms and set aside.
2. Start to brown meat in a large skillet; add mushrooms, rice, onion and pepper. Continue browning until rice is lightly browned.
3. Stir in tomatoes, water and seasoning.
4. Turn into a 3-quart casserole and cover.
5. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
6. Remove cover for last 10 minutes of baking time.
title: Mexican Rice Casserole

steps: 1. Mix all.
2. Chill and serve with chips or use as a condiment for tacos or fajitas.
title: Guacamole Salad

ingredients.text: 2 cups sweet corn (fresh is best, frozen can be used)
1/2 fresh jalapeno, seeded and chopped (more if you like it!)

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
2. Add onion, corn, salt and cayenne and cook, stirring, until very soft, 5 minutes or so.
3. Add garlic and jalapeno, stir to mix, and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add cheese and milk and cook gently over low heat, stirring, until cheese melts and mixture is smooth.
5. Remove from heat and pour into serving bowl, serve with whatever you would like to dip into it (bread, crackers, veggies, etc).
6. Serve immediately.
title: Corn Con Queso

steps: 1. Add oil, celery, onion, green pepper, garlic and cumin to 12-inch skillet.
2. Saute over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until rice is browned.
3. Remove from heat.
4. Combine water and bouillon in medium saucepan.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Add to rice mixture; stir in tomato sauce.
7. Heat just until mixture simmers.
8. Cover and continue to simmer 20 minutes.
9. Remove from heat.
10. Let stand, covered, 10 minutes before serving.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. You will need a medium-sized, heavy-bottomed sauce pan that has a tight fitting lid.

2. Heat the oil on high heat and add rice. Stir the rice until it starts to brown and smells like popcorn. Quickly add the salsa and stir until all the liquid is absorbed. Add the catsup and then the water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer and cover. Simmer for 20 minutes, remove from heat and then let sit with the lid on for 10 minutes.
title: Fantastic Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Brown sausage and onion in a skillet.
2. Drain.
3. Add potatoes and eggs; scramble all together.
4. Place generous amounts of cooked mixture in a steamed tortilla.
5. Use picante sauce, if desired.
title: Breakfast Burrito

steps: 1. Scramble eggs in skillet. Lay tortillas flat and spoon eggs over the 4 tortillas. Sprinkle with ham and cheese. Roll up to enclose filling. Place tacos in a microwave-safe dish. Microwave for 30 seconds or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.
title: Breakfast Taco

steps: 1. Scramble sausage cooking till brown with grated potatoes. Drain.
2. Scramble eggs in another pan.
3. Warm tortillas divide eggs and meat mixture onto tortillas.
4. Salt and pepper
5. to taste. Divide cheese on top.
6. Roll and warm in microwave.
7. Serve with salsa if desired.
title: Breakfast Burrito

steps: 1. Combine first three ingredients in bowl and mix well.
2. Heat up small skillet with oil over medium heat, add mixed ingredients.
3. As the omelette cooks lift edges with spatula and mix centre so it is not too thick.
4. When omelette is relatively solid add other ingredients and allow cheese to melt.
5. Fold in half and serve.
6. Enjoy!
title: Mexican Omelette

ingredients.text: 2 cups (8 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided

steps: 1. Sprinkle cooked ham and chopped green onions evenly down the center of each tortilla; top each with 2 Tbsp. shredded cheese. Roll up tortillas, and place, seam sides down, in a lightly greased 13- x 9-in. baking dish.
2. Whisk together eggs and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Pour mixture evenly over tortillas.
3. Cover and chill at least 8 hours. Remove from refrigerator, and let stand 30 minutes at room temperature before baking.

4. Bake, covered, at 350° for 20 minutes; uncover and bake 15 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 3/4 cup Cheddar cheese, and bake 3 to 4 more minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
title: Breakfast Enchiladas

ingredients.text: 3 corn tortillas, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese (2 ounces)

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the tortilla pieces and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until they begin to get crisp, stirring occasionally.
3. Add the onion, jalapeno pepper, and garlic, and saute for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the onion is transparent.
4. Stir in the tomato and oregano; mix well.
5. Add the eggs and stir to scramble until the eggs are set.
6. Remove the skillet from the heat, add the cheese,and stir until the cheese is melted.
7. Top with the salsa and serve.
title: Mexican Breakfast

steps: 1. Scramble egg substitute with ham.
2. Place tortillas on broiler pan, top each one with 1/2 of the cheese, 1/2 of egg/ham mixture, 1/2 of baked beans.
3. Broil 3 in under broiler until cheese is melted and eggs etc are warm.
4. Transfer to serving plate, top with salsa and slice into forths.
title: Bean, Egg And Ham Breakfast Tostada

steps: 1. Saute sausage in skillet until brown.
2. Stir until sausage is crumbly.
3. Drain sausage well.
4. Saute onion and green pepper in butter in skillet until tender.
5. Add eggs.
6. Cook and stir until eggs are set.
7. Spoon eggs and sausage onto tortillas.
8. Sprinkle with cheese.
9. Spoon sour cream over cheese.
10. Arrange tomato on top.
11. Fold tortillas in half to serve.
title: Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. Scramble eggs, cooking to a dry consistancy. Cool and put in a mixing bowl.
2. Brown sausage, drain fat and cool. Add to the eggs.
3. Saute vegetables until they have released their liquid and it has evaporated. Cool, add to egg mixture.
4. Add the salsa and cheese, mix to combine.
5. Heat tortillas briefly to soften. Scoop 1/3-1/2 cup of filling into each tortilla and roll up.
6. Place each burrito in a zip-top sandwich bag and seal, squeezing out all air. Place burritos in a freezer safe container and freeze.
7. To reheat, remove frozen burrito from the sandwich bag, place on a microwave safe plate, and cook on full power until heated through, 1 - 1 1/2 minutes.
title: Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. Shred the tortillas and fry in oil until crispy. Add onions, green pepper and tomato. Pour eggs over pan mixture. Cook until set. Serve with hot sauce.
title: Mexican Breakfast

steps: 1. Cut bacon into pieces. Fry in skillet over med-low heat.

2. When bacon almost cooked; add diced potatoes and chopped onions. No need to drain grease from bacon, in fact, you may need to add more depending on how much you ended up with. Cook until desired doneness.
3. If you have a lot of grease left, you may want to remove some at this point.
4. When potatoes and onions cooked; add eggs. Stirring constantly to scramble.
5. Place in warmed flour tortilla shells. Top with cheese and salsa. Wrap tortilla to form a burrito fold.
title: Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. In medium bowl combine eggs and milk; beat well.
2. In medium skillet melt margarine and add egg mixture and cook until eggs are done.
3. Stir in cheese.
4. To serve, spoon eggs onto warm tortillas.
5. Top with salsa, roll up and serve.
title: Scrambled Huevos Rancheros

steps: 1. Heat oil in medium skillet.
2. Cut tortillas into thin strips. Add to oil and saute' til crispy.
3. While those are cooking break all eggs into bowl and whisk.
4. Add scrambled eggs to crispy tortilla strips and cook until desired done-ness. I like mine a little soft, but hubby likes em cooked til dry, must be why he needs the ketchup ;).
title: Mexican Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Scramble eggs and set aside.
2. Cook bacon, crumble and set aside.
3. On medium-high heat, melt 1 tablespoon of butter.
4. Place 1 tortilla shell in pan for 30 seconds.
5. Turn shell quickly.
6. Put 1/4 of scrambled eggs, 1/4 of crumbled bacon and 1/2 slice of cheese on half of the tortilla shell.
7. Fold other half of shell over fillings.
8. Remove from heat.
9. Makes 4.
title: Mexican Breakfast

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add chili, tomato and onion.
3. Stir-fry until heated through (still crisp). Push vegetables to side of skillet.
4. Add eggs.
5. Cook and stir until eggs are almost set, then stir in vegetables and cook 1 or 2 minutes longer.
6. Season with salt to taste.
7. Serve with flour tortillas, either rolled or under.
8. May be served with chopped potatoes and chorizo (Mexican sausage) fried.
title: Mexican Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Serves 2.
2. Ingredients.
3. 2 tablespoons Canola Oil, divided.
4. 1/4 cup onion, chopped.
5. 1/4 green bell pepper, chopped.
6. 1 cup baby spinach.
7. 1/4 cup chorizo, cubed.
8. 4 eggs.
9. 1/8 cup 1% milk.
10. 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder.
11. 1/4 teaspoon paprika.
12. black pepper.
13. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan.
14. Add onion. Saute until translucent.
15. Add green pepper. Saute for 2 minutes.
16. Add chorizo and baby spinach. Saute for 2 minutes.
17. Whisk together eggs and milk in a bowl.
18. Add last tablespoon of oil to hot pan. Allow to heat. Pour in egg mixture.
19. Add spices.
20. Cook until eggs are desired firmness.
title: Tex-Mex Breakfast Scramble

steps: 1. Place mayonaise on one side of burrito, place second burrito on top, roll up and set aside.
2. Cook bacon in skillet to desired doneness, we like it crunchy. Remove from pan and drain on paper plate.
3. In same skillet, add mushrooms and cook 3 minutes over medium high heat.
4. Mix up the eggs and pour into mushrooms. As eggs cook, lift up the edges with a spatula and let the uncooked roll underneath.
5. Unroll tortillas and divide to 2 plates.
6. Place 2 tomato slices on each and 2 bacon slices on each.
7. Divide eggs in half and place on plate.
8. Roll each up burrito style and enjoy!
title: One Skillet Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the vinegar, chili powder, oregano, salt and garlic; crumble pork over mixture and mix well. Cover and chill overnight.

2. In a large skillet, cook pork mixture over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain; set aside and keep warm. In a large bowl, whisk eggs and milk. In a another large skillet, heat oil until hot. Add egg mixture; cook and stir over medium heat until eggs are completely set.
3. Spoon about 1/4 cup pork mixture and 1/4 cup egg mixture down the center of each tortilla. Top with taco sauce and roll up.
title: Zesty Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. Brown sausage; crumble, drain and set aside.
2. Stir together the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until beaten well enough for scrambling.
3. Stir in jalapenos and sausage.
4. Spray skillet with Pam; cook just as you would scrambled eggs.
5. Lay flour tortilla flat; fill with a spoonful or two of egg mixture.
6. Add a spoonful of Cheddar cheese; roll up in tortilla shell.
7. These may be heated in microwave, one or two at a time, for a few seconds or until cheese melts.
8. Serve with salsa on top, if desired.
9. You may halve this recipe, if you wish.
10. Refrigerate leftovers in airtight container.
title: Breakfast Burritos

ingredients.text: 14 1/2 ounces canned diced tomatoes, fire roasted-variety
2 tablespoons scallions, minced, green part only
1 medium jalapeno pepper, seeded, minced (don't touch seeds with bare hands)

steps: 1. To prepare salsa, pour tomatoes into a fine-mesh strainer set in sink; press on tomatoes to drain off all liquid, leaving about 1 cup of diced tomato. Spoon tomatoes into a medium bowl; stir in chili powder, scallion, cilantro, lime juice, salt and pepper. Stir salsa; set aside while making scrambled eggs.
2. To make eggs, in a medium bowl, beat together eggs, egg whites, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper; set aside.

3. Coat a medium nonstick skillet with cooking spray; heat over medium heat for 30 seconds. Add shallot and jalapeno; cook, stirring occasionally, until shallots are tender, about 3 minutes. Pour egg mixture into skillet; cook until eggs are almost cooked through, scrambling occasionally, about 4 to 5 minutes. Serve eggs topped with salsa or salsa on the side. Yields about 1 cup of eggs and 1/2 cup of salsa per serving.
4. Notes.
5. If you can find canned tomatoes with chipotle chiles, use them and omit the chili powder in the salsa. You can also save time by using your favorite spicy jarred salsa instead of making your own.
6. To make this recipe truly Tex-Mex, top with some baked tortilla strips (could affect POINTS values).
title: Tex-Mex Scrambled Eggs (3 Ww Points)

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. flank steak, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Prepare rice as directed on package.
2. Cook and stir meat, vegetables and garlic powder in hot oil in large skillet until browned.
3. Add remaining ingredients; bring to boil.
4. Reduce heat; simmer for 5 minutes.
5. Serve over rice.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Fajita Pie

steps: 1. Cook and stir ground beef until brown, drain.
2. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cheese and onion and set aside.
3. Mix Bisquick and water until soft dough forms.
4. Pat dough in an 8 x 8 x 2 greased baking pan pressing the dough 1/2 inch up the sides. Layer beef, tomatoes and green peppers on top of the dough.
5. Spoon sour cream mixture over top.
6. Sprinkle with Paprika if desired.
7. Bake until edges of dough are light brown, 25 to 30 minutes.
8. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Deep Dish Taco Squares

steps: 1. In a heavy skillet, heat oil and cook onion until soft.
2. Add beef and cook until lightly browned.
3. Stir in all remaining ingredients, except olives and cheese, mixing well.
4. Add olives. Cover pie with chunks of cheese.
5. Cover and cook on top of stove over low heat, about 20 to 25 minutes.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Easy Tamale Pie

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan.
3. Mix together first 5 ingredients.
4. Set aside.
5. Combine milk, sour cream, vegetable oil, egg, chilies, cheese and corn.
6. Stir into dry ingredients.
7. Spoon into prepared pan and bake 30 minutes. Serve warm.
8. Serves 6.
title: Mexican Cornbread

steps: 1. Grease a square baking dish.
2. Brown ground beef; drain.
3. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cheese and onion; reserve.
4. Combine biscuit mix and water until soft dough forms.
5. Pat in pan, pressing dough 1/2-inch up sides.
6. Layer beef, tomato and green pepper in pan.
7. Spoon sour cream mixture over top.
8. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.
9. Bake in 375° oven until edges of dough are light brown, about 25 to 30 minutes.
10. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Taco Squares

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Put in oiled loaf pan and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
3. Yield:
4. 4 servings.

5. Form the arepas: Divide the dough into 6 portions, shape into balls, and flatten into thick discs.

6. For a flakier crust, incorporate a tablespoon of vinegar into the dough mixture. This helps prevent gluten formation.

3. Sprinkle some panko on a small rimmed baking sheet. Put a piece of chicken on top,and cover with more panko. Then, with your fist, pound the panko into the chicken to adhere. Pound slowly at first, and then a little harder, until the crumbs stick.

4. Pour 1/4 inch of oil (about 1 cup) into a 10-inch nonstick skillet and heat over medium to medium-high heat. It's ready when a sprinkle of panko sizzles. Fry 1 to 2 cutlets at a time, without crowding, flipping only once, until nicely browned, about 3 minutes on the first side and 1 minute on the second. Transfer to a tray lined with paper towels.
title: Milanesas De Pollo (Argentinian Chicken Cutlets)

ingredients.text: 4 -5 lbs pork shoulder (or large Boston Butt Roast with bone in, skin on)

steps: 1. Directions (Oven Version with Crackling):

2. Puree the garlic, onion, orange juice, lime juice, rum, olive oil, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper in a food processor or blender, place 2/3 of the mixture into a large sealable bag with the pork and marinate in the fridge overnight.
3. Pull the pork out of the fridge 1 hour before roasting, take it out of the bag, set it with its skin side up, wipe the skin dry and let sit for 1 hour.
4. Score the skin in 1/2 inch intervals and rub salt generously into the skin.
5. Place the pork in a roasting pan, skin side up, roast in a preheated 450F oven for 20 minutes or until the skin has become crackling, ie it has become golden, hardened and crispy.

6. Reduce the heat to 325F and roast until the pork reaches 170F for slicing or 195F for shredding, about 2-3 hours or 4-6 hours respectively. If the skin starts to get too dark tent it loosely with foil without folding the edges over to prevent steaming.

7. Let the pork rest for 15 minutes, remove crackling and cut into small pieces, discard any extra fat and then slice or shred the pork. Remove the fat from the juices and serve with sliced pork or mix into shredded pork.
8. Meanwhile heat 2 tablespoons of the juices from the roasting pan in a pan over medium-high heat, add the onion and saute until tender and caramelized, about 7-10 minutes.
9. Serve the pork with the caramelized onions and remaining mojo.
10. Directions (Slow Cooker Version):

11. Puree the garlic, onion, orange juice, lime juice, rum, olive oil, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper in a food processor or blender, place 2/3 of the mixture into a large sealable bag with the pork and marinate in the fridge overnight.
12. Place the pork in a slow cooker/crock-pot with the skin side up along with the marinade and cook on low for 8-10 hours.
13. Let the pork rest for 15 minutes, discard the fat layer and then shred the pork.
14. Meanwhile heat 2 tablespoons of the juices from the slow cooker/crock-pot in a pan over medium-high heat, add the onion and saute until tender and caramelized, about 7-10 minutes.
15. Serve the pork with the caramelized onions and remaining mojo.
16. Tip: Mix some mojo into the pork after pulling it; man is that mojo ever good! Make sure to make enough pork to make Cuban Sandwiches with leftovers!
title: Cuban Roast Pork

ingredients.text: 1 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped

steps: 1. Combine the milk, sugar, vanilla bean and seeds in a large, 4-quart saucepan and place over medium heat.
2. Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved. Once the sugar has dissolved, add the baking soda and stir to combine.
3. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered at a bare simmer. Stir occasionally, but do not re-incorporate the foam that appears on the top of the mixture. Continue to cook for 1 hour.
4. Remove the vanilla bean after 1 hour and continue to cook until the mixture is a dark caramel color and has reduced to about 1 cup, approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
5. Strain the mixture through a fine mesh strainer. Store in the refrigerator in a sealed container for up to a month.
title: Good Eats Dulce De Leche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Grease (or spray) the bottoms of 24 (or 48) mini-muffin cups.
3. Blend milk, oil and eggs, then add tapioca starch and finally, cheese. The result must be something very liquid.
4. Pour the mixture in the muffins cups, filling about 2/3 of each one.
5. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
6. Bake at 350°F until done or golden brow, about 18 minutes. They should double the size (most of that is air inside the bread).
7. Serve warm.
8. Tip: if you don't worry with calories, you can serve with cream-cheese and butter. We can even add small pieces of bacon before bake.
9. Note: if you don't have Parmesan, you can use any other hard cheese, like asiago or provolone.
title: Pão De Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Puffs)

steps: 1. In a skillet, brown the chicken in oil over medium-high heat.
2. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the chicken to the slow cooker, and add the potatoes and tomatoes to the slow cooker.
3. Add the onion, green pepper, garlic, brown sugar, ginger, pepper, cayenne, thyme and salt to the skillet and cook over medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
4. Stir the broth into the skillet, then transfer the mixture to the slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours.
5. Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 30 minutes on low.
title: Crock Pot Caribbean Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. In a food processor or blender, combine the green onions, onion, chile pepper, soy sauce, vinegar, vegetable oil, brown sugar, thyme, cloves, nutmeg and allspice. Mix for about 15 seconds. Place the chicken in a medium bowl, and cover with the marinade mixture. Refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours, or overnight. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil grate. Cook chicken on the prepared grill until no longer pink and juices run clear.
title: Jerk Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 (4 lb) whole chickens, cut into pieces

steps: 1. Leave skin on the chicken; put it on a plate. Sprinkle the green onion, cilantro, garlic, onion, salt and pepper over it. Cover. Let it sit for 30 minutes.

2. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pot over medium heat. Stir in the sugar, and cook until the sugar has melted into a nice golden brown syrup. Add the chicken pieces, and brown quickly while turning continuously. Cover the pot, and let it cook for 2 minutes.

3. Pour in 1 cup of water, coconut milk and pepper flakes. Cover again; cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Stir in the ketchup and butter. Continue cooking until chicken is fork tender, 20 to 30 minutes. The chicken skin won't be crispy, so throw it out or give it to an appreciative dog. (If cat, only a little bit. Don't want to give them too much fat at once, you know.). You'd have to pick off any little pieces of garlic and onion first tho, as those aren't good for our companion animals.
title: Trinidad Stewed Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste

steps: 1. Place pork into a large bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the vinegar, cumin, turmeric, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Pour over the pork, and stir to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove pork from the marinade, reserving the marinade, and place in the hot skillet. Cook until nicely browned on the outside. Add orange juice, 1/2 cup water, dried onion, and the reserved marinade. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 30 minutes, or until the pork is fork tender.
3. In a small cup, stir together the flour and 2 tablespoons of water. Stir into the skillet, and simmer uncovered until thickened, 2 to 4 minutes.
title: Spicy Peruvian Pork

steps: 1. Blend soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and oil in a blender.
2. Put chicken in a large sealable bag and add marinade. Seal bag and marinate, chilled, 8 to 24 hours. Turn occasionally to assure even marinating.
3. Prepare grill for medium-high heat.
4. Discard marinade, then pat chicken dry. Oil grill rack.
5. Grill chicken over area with no coals (or over a turned-off burner), skin side down first, covered, turning over once, until cooked through, about 30 to 35 minutes (add charcoal to maintain heat).
6. Garnish with lime wedges.

7. (IF OVEN ROASTING - Preheat oven to 500°F, and roast chicken for 30 minutes in a 13x9-inch roasting pan with 1 cup water. After 30 minutes of roasting time, tent with foil and continue roasting until browned and cooked through, or about 15 minutes longer.).
title: Pollo A La Brasa (Peruvian Grilled Chicken)

ingredients.text: 1 c. grated sharp cheese (for the topping)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all ingredients and add 1 cup grated sharp cheese.
3. Put in baking dish.
4. Top with small amount of bread crumbs and grated cheese.
5. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
6. Put lid on and remove the lid the last 10 minutes.
title: Caribbean Baked Crab

steps: 1. Cream the soft butter together with the powdered sugar until the mixture is fluffy. If your butter is very soft already, this should take no more than a couple of minutes with a handheld mixer.
2. Whisk together the cornstarch and the all-purpose flour, then combine it with the butter and sugar using a large wooden spoon until the dough starts coming together into a ball.

3. Preheat the oven to 350° F (175° C) and line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Place the disk of dough on a floured surface, dust it with some extra flour, then carefully roll the dough out to a thickness of no more than 5 millimeters (about 1/8-inch thick).

4. Using a 5-centimeter (2-inch) round cookie cutter, cut out 24 cookies (you will have to re-roll the dough a couple of times to do this), and place the dough circles on the prepared sheet pan, leaving about 1 centimeter (about 1/2 inch) of space between the cookies.
5. Place the sheet pan in the fridge for approximately 10 minutes, so that the cookies can firm up.
6. Bake them for 10 to 12 minutes, or until they're just starting to color around the edges. Lift the cookies onto a cooling rack and leave them to cool.

7. Once they're at room temperature, top half of the cookies with dulce de leche, using about 1 teaspoon on each one. Then sandwich those cookies with the plain ones. As you press the cookies together, carefully rotate the two cookies in opposite directions, which will help spread the dulce de leche all the way to the edge of the cookies.
title: Homemade Alfajores

steps: 1. Cut off crown (leafy part) of pineapple and slice it in half lengthwise.
2. Cut each half lengthwise again into 3 wedges.
3. Remove the hard, middle core of all 6 wedges by slicing it off with a knife.
4. Carefully cut each wedge into 1 inch slices, but do not cut through the skin.
5. In a saucepan, bring honey, rum, brown sugar and butter to a boil.
6. Place pineapple on a well-oiled grill grid.
7. Indirect or low heat works best.
8. Baste with rum mixture.
9. Continue cooking for 30 minutes, turning and basting every 10 minutes, until pineapple is light brown.
10. ENJOY!
title: Jamaican Pineapple For The Bbq

steps: 1. Divide the cabbage into 4 parts, core, and finely shred crosswise in about 1/4 - 1/2 inch strips. Add the shredded carrot, scallions, cilantro, vinegar and salt, and mix thoroughly. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1/2 hour, so that all of the flavors can marry.
title: El Salvadorian Curtido

ingredients.text: 1 pineapple - peeled, cored, and cut into 6 wedges

steps: 1. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
2. Whisk brown sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl. Pour sugar mixture into a large resealable plastic bag. Place pineapple wedges in bag and shake to coat each wedge.
3. Grill pineapple wedges on the preheated grill until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes per side.
title: Brazilian Grilled Pineapple

steps: 1. Mash bananas with RawSpiceBar's Jamaican Sweet Spices, honey, salt and vanilla extract. Stir flour into banana mixture.
2. Heat 1-2 tbsp canola oil on medium-high heat in a nonstick pan. Using a serving spoon, spoon batter into pan.
3. Pan fry fritters until crisp and brown on one side, about 2 minutes. Gently flip and fry other side to golden brown, about 1 minute more.
title: Jamaican Chili Banana Fritters

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper to taste

steps: 1. In a food processor, combine onion, garlic, habanero pepper, and ginger. Pulse until ingredients are minced. Blend in olive oil, brown sugar, vinegar, orange juice concentrate, soy sauce, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, cilantro, salt, and pepper. In a container, combine marinade with chicken. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.
2. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate.
3. Grill chicken for 10 minutes per side, or until no longer pink and juices run clear.
title: Runaway Bay Jamaican Chicken

steps: 1. Heat broiler. Place apricot halves, cut side up, on one half of a baking sheet. Brush tops with 2 tablespoons of butter; sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of sugar.

2. In a small bowl, toss pecans with remaining butter and sugar and spread them out on the other half of the baking sheet. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, watching carefully, until apricots begin to brown and pecans are lightly toasted.
3. Place three apricot halves on each plate, drizzle with warm dulce de leche, and sprinkle with the pecans.
title: Roasted Apricots With Sugared Pecans And Dulce De Leche

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lbs collard greens, stems and center ribs discarded and leaves halved lengthwise

steps: 1. Stack half of collard leaves and roll into a cigar shape. Cut crosswise into very thin strips (1/16 inch wide). Repeat with remainder.
2. Mince and mash garlic to a paste with salt.

3. Heat oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium heat until it shimmers, then cook garlic, stirring, 30 seconds. Add collards with 1/4 teaspoon pepper and cook, tossing, until just tender and bright green, 3 to 4 minutes.
title: Easy Brazilian Collard Greens

steps: 1. Blend oil, pepper, nutmeg and cinnamon in small bowl. Brush mixture evenly onto roast. Place pork in shallow pan; roast in 350 degrees F. oven for 1 hour (20 minutes per pound) or until internal temperature on a thermometer reads 145 degrees F. Remove roast from oven; let rest about 10 minutes. before slicing.
title: Caribbean Roast Pork

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup finely chopped jalapeno pepper (with or without seeds, depending on how hot you want it)
1 1/2 pounds salmon fillet, on its skin and in one piece approximately 8-inches long and 8-inches wide

steps: 1. In a small bowl, mix together all the ingredients, except the salmon.

2. Assemble the dish at least 2 1/2 hours before serving and as much as 12 hours: With a very sharp, long-bladed knife, slice the salmon as thin as possible, working at a sharp diagonal and cutting in the same direction as the grain of the fish-in other words, the way smoked salmon is usually sliced. Discard the skin.
3. Arrange half the salmon slices in one layer (they may be very slightly overlapping) in a large, shallow serving dish or 9- by 12-inch glass (or stainless steel) baking (or roasting) pan.
4. Drizzle on half the sauce.
5. Cover with the rest of the salmon slices and spread with the remaining sauce.
6. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
7. Serve with wedges of lime, if desired, and thinly sliced white toast or black bread.
title: Salmon Ceviche Recipe

steps: 1. In a blender, combine jalapenos, water, vinegar, lemon juice, green onions, cilantro and salt. Blend until smooth; refrigerate until ready to serve.
title: Colombian Aji

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Spread olive oil on the bottom of a shallow casserole dish.
3. Spread sliced onion in the bottom of the casserole dish.
4. Salt and pepper the tilapia fillets evenly.
5. Arrange fish on top of onions in dish.
6. Evenly distribute the lemon juice amongst the tilapia.
7. Bake in hot oven about 15 minutes or when fish easily flakes with a fork.
title: Chilean Tilapia

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken until mixture forms a paste (or in a food processor).
2. Rub chicken evenly with spice mixture; cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours, preferably overnight.
3. Preheat broiler. Broil chicken on rack 10-15 minutes, turning once, until cooked through.
title: Weight Watcher Jerk Chicken

steps: 1. Combine milk with spices and sugar in a large heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring to dissolve sugar, until milk just starts to bubble around the edges (scalding). Lower heat and cook 10 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to steep 10 additional minutes, then strain into another large heavy pot. Heat gently, then add chocolate and rum (add rum off flame). Whisk briskly 5 minutes over low flame until chocolate is completely melted.
title: Venezuelan Spiced Hot Chocolate

ingredients.text: 10 cloves garlic, or more to taste
5 pounds pork shoulder, trimmed of excess fat

steps: 1. Combine olive oil, vinegar, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper in a mortar and pestle; mash into a paste.
2. Make deep slits into the pork with a small knife. Stuff slits with the paste; rub any remaining paste over the pork.
3. Place pork in a plastic roasting bag and put in a roasting pan with a rack. Let marinate in the refrigerator, 8 to 48 hours.
4. Take pork out of the refrigerator, uncover, and bring to room temperature, 1 to 2 hours.
5. Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C).

6. Roast pork skin-side down in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 2 hours. Flip pork and continue roasting, skin-side up, until juices run clear and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), 2 to 4 hours more.
title: Daddy Eddie'S Roast Pork (Pernil), Puerto Rican-Style

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. On a baking sheet, toss leek and garlic in 2 tablespoons oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
3. Roast until leek starts to blacken, about 30 minutes; set aside to cool.

4. In a food processor, blend leek, avocado, lime juice, vinegar, oregano, thyme, parsley, red pepper flakes, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper; puree until smooth, adding water a little bit at a time until sauce is slightly runny.
5. Serve immediately over steak or chicken, or refrigerate for up to 5 days.
title: Roasted Leek & Avocado Chimichurri

steps: 1. Mix together the first 9 ingredients in a small bowl.
2. Rub spice mixture evenly over chicken.
3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat.
4. Coat pan with cooking spray.
5. Add chicken to skillet; cook 5 minutes on each side or until done.
title: Jamaican Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Whisk flour, turmeric, baking powder in a large bowl. Cut butter into small pieces and quickly rub them into the dry ingredients with your fingers until smaller but still visible.
2. Add oil and toss with a fork to combine.

3. Whisk water and egg yolk in a small bowl. Add to the flour mixture and stir until the dough begins to come together. Knead in the bowl a few times until it forms a ball. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
4. Cook ground beef, scallions and Jalapeno in a frying pan over medium heat, breaking up the beef. Stir in breadcrumbs, water, thyme, turmeric and mix well. Let cool.
title: Living The Gourmet Jamaican Beef Patties

steps: 1. Place vanilla bean, 3 cups of milk, sugar, water and baking soda in slow cooker.
2. Whisk together.
3. Cook for 9 hours on HIGH, uncovered.
4. Remove vanilla bean and whisk milk mixture gently.
5. Use a dull-edged knife to carefully scrape down the crust of sugar that accumulates on sides of the insert.
6. Do not skim foam.
